papers.title: RA-ClipScore: Making Generative Model Evaluation More Interpretable
papers.abstract_en: Generative models can produce images nearly indistinguishable from real data, yet rigorous and interpretable evaluation remains challenging. Conventional metrics such as FID provide only scalar scores with limited diagnostic insight. Widely adopted CLIP-based metrics enable semantic evaluation beyond simple training class labels, but inherit limitations from CLIP's training paradigm that restrict attribute-wise analysis. We propose RA-CLIPScore, a novel metric that mitigates these issues and extends CLIP-based evaluation to spatial distribution alignment, measuring whether generated objects adhere to the positional priors found in the training data. RA-CLIPScore introduces dual prompts to decouple competing attributes and leverages local patch tokens to capture fine-grained regional semantics. We evaluate image generative models on their ability to match both attribute and spatial distributions of the training data. Extensive experiments show that RA-CLIPScore provides more robust and interpretable evaluations than prior methods, particularly under distribution misalignment or partially irrelevant textual attributes. We further demonstrate how it reveals spatial biases in generative models. User evaluations confirm that Regional Single Attribute Divergence based on our RA-CLIPScore aligns more closely with human perception of visual diversity than existing semantic metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RA-CLIPScore，一种面向生成模型评估的可解释指标。它通过双提示 (dual prompts) 解耦相互竞争的属性，并利用局部 patch token 捕获细粒度区域语义，从而将 CLIP 类评估扩展到空间分布对齐，衡量生成物体是否符合训练数据中的位置先验。实验表明该方法在分布错位或文本属性部分无关时比既有指标更稳健、更具可解释性，并能揭示生成模型的空间偏差。
Motivation: FID 等传统指标只给出标量分数，诊断信息有限；CLIP 类指标虽支持语义评估，但受 CLIP 训练范式限制，难以进行属性级分析，也无法评估生成物体在空间上的分布对齐情况。
Method: 提出 RA-CLIPScore，引入双提示来解耦相互竞争的属性，并利用局部 patch token 捕获细粒度区域语义，以度量生成对象与训练数据中位置先验的符合程度；同时定义基于该指标的 Regional Single Attribute Divergence 用于区域单属性评估。
Result: 大量实验显示 RA-CLIPScore 在分布错位或文本属性部分无关的情况下比以往方法更稳健、更可解释；用户评估表明基于其提出的 Regional Single Attribute Divergence 与人类对视觉多样性的感知比现有语义指标更一致，并可用于揭示生成模型中的空间偏差。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 RA-CLIPScore 使生成模型评估更具可解释性，能够同时覆盖属性与空间分布匹配，并指出其在揭示生成模型空间偏差方面的价值。

papers.title: Look What the Probes Dragged In! Real-World Chest X-ray Shortcuts in MedCLIP
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models, such as contrastive language-image pre-training (CLIP)-based approaches, have reached state-of-the-art (SOTA) results in medical artificial intelligence. However, recent work reveals that CLIP-based models remain vulnerable to shortcuts. We investigate how real-world shortcuts manifest across different layers of the medical CLIP-based model, MedCLIP, and its vision encoder, a frozen ResNet-50. We attach 17 linear classification probes to the intermediate layers of the ResNet-50 and train them on three different dataset configurations and targets: NIH-CXR14 (pneumothorax) and PadChest (cardiomegaly and pneumothorax). This setup allows us to observe model behaviour during evaluation using subgroup-based calibration and layer-wise confidence curves. We find that the final linear probes achieve a high AUROC but poor calibration in the models. The layer-wise confidence analyses suggest that shortcuts emerge at different depths. Patterns consistent with localised shortcuts, such as drains, appear at later layers, while patterns consistent with diffuse shortcuts, such as scanner-specific noise patterns, emerge earlier, aligning with previous work. Finally, we conduct a manual analysis of the images, which reveals data quality issues in both NIH-CXR14 and PadChest. Our findings underscore that even SOTA models remain vulnerable to shortcuts, and the need for high-quality and well-annotated datasets to draw solid conclusions. Code can be found on our GitHub: https://github.com/nikodice4/MedCLIP_shortcuts.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 3 figure, poster presentation at the joint FAIMI, BRIDGE, and EPIMI workshop at MICCAI 2026 (Strasbourg, France) conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究医学视觉-语言模型 MedCLIP 及其冻结 ResNet-50 视觉编码器对真实世界捷径 (shortcut) 的脆弱性。作者在 ResNet-50 中间层挂接 17 个线性分类探针 (linear probes)，在 NIH-CXR14（气胸）和 PadChest（心脏肥大、气胸）上以三种数据集配置与目标训练，并结合基于子组的校准 (subgroup-based calibration) 与逐层置信度曲线分析。摘要报告最终线性探针 AUROC 高但校准差，局部化捷径（如引流管）在较后层出现、弥散性捷径（如扫描仪特定噪声模式）在较前层出现，同时人工图像检查发现两个数据集存在数据质量问题。
Motivation: CLIP-based 模型虽然在医学 AI 上达到 SOTA，但近期工作表明它们仍易受捷径影响；现有研究尚未充分揭示真实世界捷径如何在医学 CLIP 模型的不同层中分布和显现。
Method: 在 MedCLIP 的冻结 ResNet-50 各中间层上附加 17 个线性分类探针，使用 NIH-CXR14（气胸）和 PadChest（心脏肥大、气胸）的三种数据集配置与目标进行训练，并通过基于子组的校准和逐层置信度曲线来观察模型在评估阶段的行为，最后对图像进行人工分析。
Result: 摘要报告最终线性探针取得高 AUROC 但校准较差；逐层置信度分析显示捷径在不同深度出现，与局部化捷径（如 drains）一致的模式出现在较后层，与弥散性捷径（如扫描仪特定噪声模式）一致的模式出现在较前层，这与先前工作一致；人工分析还揭示 NIH-CXR14 和 PadChest 中的数据质量问题。
Conclusion: 作者强调即使是 SOTA 模型仍易受捷径影响，并指出需要高质量、标注良好的数据集才能得出可靠结论。代码已公开在 GitHub。

papers.title: NAE: Normalizing AutoEncoder
papers.abstract_en: We consider the setting of Normalizing flows with approximate inverses, an established paradigm spanning both full-dimensional ($d=D$) and bottleneck ($d<D$) settings, and group these models under the term flow autoencoders. We present a theoretical investigation into their training dynamics and prove that the proposed loss used by existing approaches is suboptimal; specifically, both encoder and decoder surrogates must be optimized in alignment with reconstruction loss. Guided by these insights, we propose Normalizing Autoencoder (NAE), which employs a novel conditional loss that aligns the surrogate loss gradient with that of reconstruction loss, directly improving upon the current standard. Extensive experiments across molecule generation, tabular data, and image benchmarks demonstrate that NAE achieves state of the art performance. Our work highlights the importance of loss alignment in flow autoencoders and establishes NAE as a powerful generative framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对具有近似逆的归一化流（normalizing flows）进行了理论分析，将全维（d=D）和瓶颈（d<D）两类设置统一称为流自编码器（flow autoencoders）。作者证明现有方法使用的损失是次优的，并提出 Normalizing Autoencoder（NAE），采用一种新的条件损失来对齐代理损失梯度与重建损失梯度。在分子生成、表格数据和图像基准上的实验表明 NAE 达到了最先进水平。
Motivation: 现有流自编码器方法在训练时使用的损失与重建损失不对齐，导致编码器和解码器代理（surrogate）无法被正确优化；作者从理论上指出，两者的优化必须与重建损失保持一致，这是当前方法的根本缺陷。
Method: 通过理论分析训练动态，证明现有损失次优，并提出 NAE：一种新的条件损失，使代理损失梯度与重建损失梯度方向对齐，从而直接改进现有训练范式。
Result: 摘要报告 NAE 在分子生成、表格数据和图像基准上均达到当前最优（state of the art）性能，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者强调损失对齐在流自编码器中的关键作用，并将 NAE 确立为一种强大的生成框架；其验证范围集中于分子生成、表格数据与图像基准。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Faithful, Sufficient and Understandable: Rethinking Graph Counterfactual Explanations via Discrete Diffusion Inversion
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) achieve strong predictive performance on graph-structured data across domains such as chemistry, biology, and network analysis, yet they provide no intrinsic explanation of their predictions. This limits their adoption in high-stakes and safety-critical settings. Counterfactual explanations address this by revealing the minimal structural modifications that would change a model's prediction. On graphs, however, such a modification is hard to produce. The search space is discrete and combinatorial, and a valid answer must respect categorical node and edge types together with domain rules such as chemical valency in the case of molecular graphs. Existing explainers give up one of two things. Either edits are not held on the data manifold, or the search does not span the full edit space. We propose Graph Diffusion Counterfactual Explanation via Inversion (GDCE-I), which gives up neither. A discrete denoising diffusion model with a novel discrete inversion scheme enables distribution-aware edits leveraging the whole domain edit space. We further address the incomplete and inconsistent evaluation of graph counterfactuals by deriving a framework of explanation desiderata and applying it to every method under one shared protocol. Across four benchmarks, GDCE-I outperforms related work by a large margin on the defined framework. For the molecular domain, we further qualitatively show that GDCE-I attains interpretable in-distribution solutions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Graph Diffusion Counterfactual Explanation via Inversion (GDCE-I)，用于图反事实解释。该方法利用离散去噪扩散模型和新的离散反演方案，使编辑保持在数据流形上并覆盖整个编辑空间。在四个基准上，GDCE-I 在作者定义的评估框架上大幅优于相关工作，并在分子域中定性显示出可解释的分布内解。
Motivation: GNN 在预测上缺乏内在解释，而反事实解释需要找到改变预测的最小结构修改，但图搜索空间是离散且组合的，还必须满足类别约束和化学价等域规则。现有方法要么让编辑脱离数据流形，要么搜索不覆盖完整编辑空间。
Method: 提出 GDCE-I，基于离散去噪扩散模型配合新颖的离散反演 (discrete inversion) 方案，实现分布感知的编辑并利用整个域编辑空间。同时推导了一套解释期望 (explanation desiderata) 框架，并在统一协议下对每个方法进行评估。
Result: 在四个基准上，GDCE-I 在所定义的框架上大幅超越相关工作。对于分子域，定性结果展示其能够获得可解释的分布内解。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过离散扩散反演可以同时保留数据流形并覆盖完整编辑空间，同时提出更完善的图反事实解释评估框架。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 Graph Diffusion Counterfactual Explanation via Inversion (GDCE-I)，用于图反事实解释。该方法利用离散去噪扩散模型和新的离散反演方案，使编辑保持在数据流形上并覆盖整个编辑空间。在四个基准上，GDCE-I 在作者定义的评估框架上大幅优于相关工作，并在分子域中定性显示出可解释的分布内解。

papers.title: Better Slots, Better Worlds: Representation Quality & Robustness in Object-Centric World Models
papers.abstract_en: Learning world models from offline trajectories enables agents to accomplish different tasks through planning. Object-centric (OC) representations, which decompose a scene into a set of slots that bind to its objects, have been proposed as an inductive bias for world models that are more sample-efficient and generalize better. Yet prior object-centric world models (OCWMs) take the slot encoder as given and evaluate only in-distribution, leaving open whether the object-centric bias actually delivers for planning and what within the OCWM drives it. We conduct a controlled study of OCWMs for visual model-predictive control along two axes: object-centric representation quality and generalization under distribution shift relative to scene-centric models. We find that (i) planning success correlates positively with unsupervised slot-quality metrics (FG-ARI, mBO), though the gains saturate at high slot quality; (ii) with well-bound slots, the auxiliary proprioception inputs and masking inductive bias that prior methods relied on become unnecessary; and (iii) under unseen distribution shifts, the OCWM with well-bound slots is more robust overall than the end-to-end trained scene-centric LeWM, while DINO-WM, built on similar frozen pretrained features, remains competitive -- pointing to pretrained features as a key contributor to robustness.
papers.comment: Published at Model-Based RL in the Era of Generative World Models Workshop at RLC 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对面向视觉模型预测控制 (visual model-predictive control) 的目标中心世界模型 (object-centric world models, OCWMs) 做受控研究，沿目标中心表征质量和分布漂移泛化两个轴，与场景中心模型对比。摘要报告规划成功与无监督 slot 质量指标 (FG-ARI, mBO) 正相关但高质量处饱和；良好绑定的 slot 使先验方法依赖的辅助本体感觉输入和掩码归纳偏置不再必要；在未见分布漂移下，OCWM 整体比端到端训练的场景中心 LeWM 更鲁棒，而基于相似冻结预训练特征的 DINO-WM 仍具竞争力，说明预训练特征是鲁棒性的关键贡献者。
Motivation: 先前目标中心世界模型把 slot 编码器当作既定组件，且只在分布内评测，未回答目标中心偏置是否真的有利于规划、以及其中什么因素驱动收益。本文通过受控研究填补这一空白。
Method: 对 OCVMs 进行受控对比研究，沿两个轴：目标中心表征质量（用 FG-ARI、mBO 等无监督 slot 质量指标衡量）和分布漂移下的泛化，并与场景中心模型 LeWM 以及基于冻结预训练特征的 DINO-WM 比较。
Result: 摘要报告规划成功与 FG-ARI、mBO 等 slot 质量指标正相关但增益在高 slot 质量处饱和；当 slot 绑定良好时，辅助本体感觉输入和掩码归纳偏置变得不必要；在未见分布漂移下，OCWM 整体上比 LeWM 更鲁棒，DINO-WM 保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调良好绑定的 slot 可以消除先前方法对辅助输入和掩码偏置的依赖，并指出预训练特征 (pretrained features) 是分布漂移下鲁棒性的重要来源。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Draw This First
papers.abstract_en: We invert the typical formulation of sketch generation: instead of drawing strokes in order, we predict a 2D field that defines the order in which strokes are drawn. We use a pretrained latent flow-matching transformer to supply the image prior to predict an intermediate representation, while training the VAE's decoder to predict the order field, stroke mask, and stroke segmentation. We vectorize the predicted segmentation into polylines and sort them by the field, producing an ordered vector sketch. Our model can predict an ordered vector sketch from a text description or derender an image into ordered vectors; for either, it follows text instructions specifying the order of drawing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种反转草图生成范式的模型：不按顺序逐笔绘制，而是预测一个定义笔画绘制顺序的二维场（order field）。模型利用预训练 latent flow-matching transformer 提供图像先验并预测中间表示，同时训练 VAE 解码器预测顺序场、笔画掩码和笔画分割，再将分割矢量化成折线并按场排序，得到有序矢量草图。模型既可依据文本描述生成有序矢量草图，也可将图像 derender 为有序矢量，并服从指定绘制顺序的文本指令。
Motivation: 常规草图生成按顺序逐笔绘制，本文认为可以反转该设定，通过先预测绘制顺序场来直接获得有序草图，从而统一文生图与图像矢量化（derendering）中的顺序控制。
Method: 使用预训练 latent flow-matching transformer 提供图像先验与中间表示；训练 VAE 解码器同时预测顺序场、笔画掩码和笔画分割。预测的分割被矢量化（vectorize）为折线（polylines），再按顺序场排序，输出有序矢量草图。
Result: 摘要未给出定量结果；模型声称能从文本描述生成有序矢量草图，也能将图像 derender 为有序矢量，且二者都支持以文本指令指定绘制顺序。
Conclusion: 作者通过预测顺序场而非逐笔生成，使草图生成具备可指定的绘制顺序，可用于文本到草图和图像到有序矢量的双重任务。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Learning Loco-Manipulation From SMPC Demonstrations With Sparse Offline-to-Online RL
papers.abstract_en: Integrating locomotion and manipulation is essential for robot autonomy, but scaling standard Reinforcement Learning (RL) to complex tasks is severely bottlenecked by the slow, manual process of dense reward shaping. To bypass this limitation, we leverage Sample-based Model Predictive Control (SMPC) entirely in simulation as an automated, rapidly tunable expert to generate massive offline datasets. Because this data solves the fundamental exploration problem, we can train an off-policy RL agent using purely sparse task rewards, drastically reducing the time required to learn new skills and eliminating the need for manual tuning. Integrating this high-level agent with a low-level dynamic stability controller yields more optimal behaviors that strictly align with true task objectives, ultimately allowing the learned policies to surpass the original optimal control teacher. We validate the robustness of this sim-to-real framework by successfully deploying complex loco-manipulation skills across different morphologies, including an arm-equipped Spot quadruped and a G1 humanoid.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个结合仿真 SMPC 专家数据与稀疏奖励离策略强化学习（off-policy RL）的框架，用于学习腿臂协同操作（loco-manipulation），并宣称学到的策略能超过原最优控制教师。作者在带机械臂的 Spot 四足机器人和 G1 人形机器人等不同形态上完成 sim-to-real 部署，验证了该框架的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 标准强化学习扩展到复杂腿臂协同任务时，严重受限于人工密集奖励整定的缓慢过程，因此需要绕过稠密奖励设计、加速新技能学习的自动方案。
Method: 在仿真中完全使用基于采样的模型预测控制（SMPC）作为可快速调节的专家，离线生成大规模示范数据以解决探索问题；随后仅用稀疏任务奖励训练 off-policy RL 智能体，并将其与低层动态稳定性控制器集成。
Result: 摘要报告称集成后的高层智能体能够生成严格对齐真实任务目标的更优行为，使策略超越原始最优控制教师；在 Spot 四足机器人和 G1 人形机器人等不同形态上成功部署复杂 loco-manipulation 技能，验证了 sim-to-real 的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 该框架可大幅缩短新技能学习时间并消除人工奖励调参，且学到的策略能超越生成数据的专家；摘要未讨论该方法的失败场景或适用范围边界。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Preference Tree Optimization: Enhancing Goal-Oriented Dialogue with Look-Ahead Simulations
papers.abstract_en: Developing dialogue systems capable of engaging in multi-turn, goal-oriented conversations remains a significant challenge, especially in specialized domains with limited data. This research proposes a novel framework called Preference Tree Optimization (PTO), designed to iteratively improve agent models in such dialogue systems, by generating preference data using a method called Preference Tree with Look-Ahead. Focusing on Motivational Interviewing (MI) -- a counseling technique aimed at facilitating behavioral change -- we leverage virtual patients and an oracle evaluator to simulate conversations and generate rich preference datasets. By combining this method with Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), we aim to enhance the agent's decision-making capabilities over iterative training cycles. The proposed framework addresses data scarcity and advances the development of more nuanced and effective dialogue systems in goal-oriented domains. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that the PTO framework enhances dialogue agents' performance in goal-oriented conversations within the domain of Motivational Interviewing (MI). Models trained with PTO consistently outperformed the baseline in key metrics such as session satisfaction and working alliance. Additionally, incorporating look-ahead simulations led to improved long-term planning and more effective conversational strategies, with deeper look-ahead configurations yielding the most stable and high-scoring results.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at an ICLR 2025 workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Preference Tree Optimization (PTO) 框架，用于在多轮目标导向对话系统中迭代改进 agent 模型。该方法通过 Preference Tree with Look-Ahead 生成偏好数据，并结合 Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)，在动机性访谈 (Motivational Interviewing, MI) 领域借助虚拟病人和 oracle 评估器进行实验。结果显示 PTO 在会话满意度和工作联盟等指标上超过基线，且 look-ahead 模拟改善了长期规划能力。
Motivation: 多轮目标导向对话系统在数据稀缺的专业领域仍具挑战，现有方法难以生成丰富的偏好数据来迭代优化 agent 决策。
Method: 提出 Preference Tree Optimization 框架，用 Look-Ahead 模拟生成偏好树数据，结合虚拟病人与 oracle 评估器构建对话仿真，并将该偏好数据与 DPO 结合进行多轮迭代训练。
Result: 实验表明 PTO 训练的模型在 MI 领域目标导向对话中持续优于基线，主要指标包括会话满意度和工作联盟；加入 look-ahead 模拟带来更优的长期规划与对话策略，且更深层 look-ahead 配置结果最稳定且得分最高。
Conclusion: PTO 框架能缓解数据稀缺问题并提升目标导向对话系统的表现，但实验范围集中在动机性访谈领域，其泛化到其他专业领域仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Towards Truly Unsupervised Evaluation of Feature Selection
papers.abstract_en: Feature selection is one of the most important and fundamental tasks in data mining, tackled by a family of methods with an established set of evaluation techniques to measure the quality of a specific method. Most of the methods commonly used for the unsupervised evaluation of feature selection algorithms suffer from critical design flaws which question their unsupervised nature. In this paper, we provide a critical discussion on the established allegedly unsupervised evaluation techniques, and shed light on the reasons why they are not truly unsupervised but, at best, supervised evaluation under an unsupervised downstream task. We also propose a novel, truly unsupervised evaluation framework to measure the quality of the feature selection algorithms without any form of information about the labels. The proposed framework utilizes unsupervised Principal Component Analysis, and optimal transport to measure the quality of the feature selection methods in a truly unsupervised manner.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文批判性地讨论现有无监督特征选择（feature selection）评估技术，认为它们并非真正无监督，至多是在无监督下游任务上的有监督评估。作者提出一个真正无监督的评估框架，利用无监督主成分分析（PCA）与最优输运（optimal transport）在完全没有标签信息的条件下衡量特征选择方法的质量。
Motivation: 现有用于无监督评估特征选择算法的方法存在关键设计缺陷，其无监督性质受到质疑，导致特征选择算法质量评估不可靠。
Method: 提出一个真正无监督的评估框架，结合无监督主成分分析（PCA）和最优输运（optimal transport），在不使用任何标签信息的条件下度量特征选择方法的质量。
Conclusion: 作者认为所提框架是真正无监督的特征选择评估方案，避免了以往评估方法中隐含的标签信息使用，更符合无监督评估的初衷。

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为所提框架是真正无监督的特征选择评估方案，避免了以往评估方法中隐含的标签信息使用，更符合无监督评估的初衷。

papers.title: Do Not Forget the Obvious - RISC: A Risk-Informed Slice-Coverage Protocol for Safe Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Aggregate metrics may not fully reflect performance in insufficiently examined high-risk driving conditions. We propose RISC (Risk-Informed Slice Coverage), a practical protocol for risk-guided stress testing and coverage-qualified evaluation. Risk-guided stress testing directs a finite audit budget toward risk-relevant sub-datasets, called risk slices, while coverage-qualified evaluation reports results together with explicit statements about which slices are sufficiently or insufficiently covered. The protocol translates safety concerns into machine-readable risk slices, uses lightweight signals to tag candidate data, selects a compact audit set by risk, and qualifies the results using coverage evidence. An LLM can optionally support this process by surfacing relevant but potentially overlooked conditions during test planning, thereby helping engineers not to forget the obvious. RISC is model-agnostic and can be applied to perception modules, driving models, and other autonomous-driving subsystems. We instantiate the protocol for monocular pedestrian perception using 1,000 frames from the Zenseact Open Dataset, image statistics, and a YOLO-based detector proxy. In this proof-of-concept study, risk-guided selection increases critical failure discovery from 34.0% under random sampling to 98.5%. RISC provides a lightweight, assurance-oriented evaluation layer that complements scenario categorization, coverage assessment, and broader testing-and-verification workflows.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the ECCV 2026 Workshop on Safe and Defensive Autonomous Driving (SDAD). Non-archival workshop paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RISC (Risk-Informed Slice Coverage)，一个用于自动驾驶风险引导压力测试与覆盖率限定评估的轻量协议。协议将安全关切转化为机器可读的 risk slices，用轻量信号为候选数据打标签，按风险挑选紧凑审计集，并基于覆盖率证据限定评测结果；LLM 可作为可选辅助在测试规划阶段提示容易被忽略的条件。针对单目行人感知的原型验证中，风险引导选择将关键失效发现率从随机采样的 34.0% 提升到 98.5%。
Motivation: 聚合指标 (aggregate metrics) 可能无法反映在审计不足的高风险驾驶条件下系统的真实表现，因此需要一种把有限审计预算导向风险相关子数据集、并显式报告哪些切片覆盖充分或不充分的评估协议。
Method: 提出 RISC 协议，包含将安全关切翻译为机器可读的 risk slices、用轻量信号标记候选数据、按风险选择紧凑审计集以及用覆盖率证据限定结果；LLM 可辅助测试规划以提示相关但可能被忽略的场景。该协议与模型无关，适用于感知模块、驾驶模型及其他自动驾驶子系统。
Result: 在使用 Zenseact Open Dataset 的 1,000 帧、图像统计和 YOLO-based detector proxy 的单目行人感知原型中，风险引导选择将关键失效发现率从随机采样的 34.0% 提升至 98.5%。
Conclusion: 摘要将 RISC 定位为轻量、面向保证 (assurance-oriented) 的评估层，用于补充场景分类、覆盖率评估及更广泛的测试与验证工作流；目前结论基于单一感知任务的原型验证。

papers.title: Predicting Functions, Not Features: KANs with Function-Space Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning for Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks (KANs) introduce explicit functional representations by parameterizing each network edge as a learnable univariate function. However, existing KAN-based segmentation models optimize edge functions only through objectives defined after edge aggregation, leaving individual functions without an explicit pre-aggregation learning target. To address this limitation, we propose Function-Space Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning (FS-JEPA) for medical image segmentation. Our FS-JEPA framework moves predictive learning into the pre-aggregation function space of KANs. A masked online branch predicts structured signatures of sampled KAN edge functions generated by a full-context exponential moving average target branch, while shared edge indices preserve correspondence between predictions and targets. Rather than predicting an isolated edge response, we represent each sampled edge function using a multi-radius signature composed of function evaluations around its input anchor. This structured representation captures local functional variations that cannot be characterized by a single response and provides a more informative predictive target. The function-space objective is jointly optimized with the segmentation loss during training, while the predictive branch is removed at inference. Experiments on five medical image segmentation benchmarks show that our FS-JEPA achieves the best average Dice and outperforms the strongest competing KAN-based method by +2.25 percentage points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks（KAN）在医学图像分割中边缘函数缺少显式预聚合学习目标的问题，提出 Function-Space Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning（FS-JEPA）。该方法在 KAN 的预聚合函数空间内加入掩码预测学习，用多半径签名（multi-radius signature）表征采样边缘函数，并与分割损失联合优化，推理时移除预测分支。在五个医学图像分割基准上，FS-JEPA 取得最佳平均 Dice，并超过最强对比 KAN 方法 2.25 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有 KAN 分割模型只在边缘聚合后定义优化目标，使得每个边缘函数在聚合前没有明确的学习信号，难以充分刻画局部函数变化。
Method: FS-JEPA 将预测学习迁移到 KAN 的预聚合函数空间：带掩码的在线分支预测由全上下文指数移动平均（EMA）目标分支产生的采样边缘函数结构表征，通过共享边缘索引对齐预测与目标；每个采样边缘函数用多半径签名表示，以捕获单个响应无法体现的局部函数变化。该函数空间目标与分割损失联合训练，推理时删除预测分支。
Result: 在五个医学图像分割基准上，FS-JEPA 的平均 Dice 达到最优，且比最强的对比 KAN 方法高出 2.25 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，为 KAN 边缘函数提供显式的预聚合预测目标、并用结构化函数签名作为监督，可以提升医学图像分割性能，同时预测分支在推理阶段被移除。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Localizing to Debias: A Patch-Level Benchmark and Baseline for Weakly Supervised Spatial Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Despite growing interest in weakly supervised video anomaly detection (WSVAD), current methods struggle to bridge the gap between coarse temporal supervision and fine-grained spatial reasoning. A key obstacle is the tendency of temporal detectors to latch onto background and scene-level cues rather than truly discriminative anomaly evidence. This background bias raises ethical concerns: models may inadvertently associate anomalies with societal or environmental context rather than authentic crime-related cues. Without spatial grounding, such biases remain hidden and unauditable. To address this, we propose SST-WSVADL, a sparse spatio-temporal framework that bridges temporal anomaly detection with fine-grained spatial localization. Rather than processing all spatial regions indiscriminately, SST-WSVADL progressively focuses on the most anomaly-relevant spatio-temporal regions through dynamic sparsification, naturally suppressing background dominant content while preserving discriminative evidence. The temporal and spatial branches are coupled end-to-end via motion-aware regularization that guides sparsification toward dynamically informative regions, without relying on external detectors or vision-language prompts. We publicly release frame-level spatial annotations and a method-agnostic evaluation protocol for three public datasets: UCF-Crime, XD-Violence, and MSAD. These resources enable the community to audit spatial biases in WSVAD predictions, supporting progress toward more ethical and accountable anomaly detection. Experiments demonstrate that SST-WSVADL is competitive with prior methods across benchmarks while enabling localization and patch-level auditability of scene bias, providing a reproducible foundation for interpretability-oriented evaluation of WSVAD models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对弱监督视频异常检测（WSVAD）中粗粒度时间监督与细粒度空间推理之间的鸿沟，提出稀疏时空框架 SST-WSVADL。该方法通过动态稀疏化逐步聚焦最具异常相关性的时空区域，抑制背景主导内容，并用运动感知正则化端到端耦合时间与空间分支，无需外部检测器或视觉-语言提示。作者还公开了 UCF-Crime、XD-Violence、MSAD 三个数据集的帧级空间标注与方法无关评估协议。实验显示该方法与既有方法表现相当，同时支持定位与 patch 级场景偏差审计。
Motivation: 现有 WSVAD 方法容易让时间检测器依赖背景和场景级线索，而非真正判别性的异常证据；这种背景偏差可能让模型把异常与社会或环境语境关联，缺乏空间依据时这类偏差难以被发现和审计，带来伦理与可解释性问题。
Method: 提出稀疏时空异常定位框架 SST-WSVADL，通过动态稀疏化渐进聚焦最相关的时空区域，抑制背景主导内容；时间分支与空间分支通过运动感知正则化端到端耦合，引导稀疏化朝向动态信息丰富区域，全程不依赖外部检测器或视觉-语言提示。同时发布帧级空间标注和与模型无关的评估协议。
Result: 摘要报告 SST-WSVADL 在多个基准上与先前方法竞争性相当，同时实现了时空定位能力，并能对场景偏差进行 patch 级审计。
Conclusion: 作者认为所发布的空间标注与评估协议能让社区审计 WSVAD 预测中的空间偏差，推动更道德、可问责的异常检测，并为 WSVAD 模型的可解释性评估提供可复现基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Direct Acceleration of Stochastic Root-Finding Without Variance Reduction and Regularization
papers.abstract_en: Acceleration for deterministic root-finding problems has been extensively studied in recent years; specifically, the anchor-based, or Halpern-type methods achieve optimal convergence rates with respect to the operator norm. However, acceleration via these methods does not directly carry over to stochastic setting due to accumulation of errors, unless one enforces diminishing variance via increasing batch sizes or variance reduction techniques. In this work, we show that another class of acceleration, namely the dual-anchor mechanism, extends to the stochastic setting without such error accumulation, in contrast to anchor-based algorithms. Consequently, we cleanly achieve $O(ε^{-3})$ complexity with iteration-independent batch size, without any variance reduction or double-loop recursive regularization, for stochastic root-finding (resp. fixed-point) problems with cocoercivity (resp. square-nonexpansivity) in expectation. For strongly monotone operators, the same algorithm attains a sharper $\widetilde{O} (ε^{-2})$ complexity, nearly matching the lower bound in terms of $ε$-dependence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究随机根求解 (stochastic root-finding) 的加速问题。作者指出锚点式 (anchor-based, Halpern-type) 加速在随机环境下会因误差累积而失效，转而证明 dual-anchor 机制能够避免这类误差累积。摘要称该方法在不使用方差缩减 (variance reduction) 和双循环递归正则化 (double-loop recursive regularization) 的情况下，以与迭代次数无关的批大小达到 O(ε^{-3}) 复杂度；对强单调算子则可达到 \widetilde{O}(ε^{-2})。
Motivation: 确定性根求解中锚点式/Halpern 型加速已达到最优收敛率，但直接迁移到随机设置会因误差累积而退化，通常需要增大批大小或引入方差缩减。本文试图找到一类能在随机设置下保持加速、且不依赖这些额外机制的算法。
Method: 提出基于 dual-anchor 机制的加速算法，替代 anchor-based 算法；针对在期望意义下满足 cocoercivity（随机根求解）或 square-nonexpansivity（随机不动点）的算子，证明其加速性质在没有方差缩减和双循环递归正则化的情况下仍然成立。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在 cocoercive 随机根求解/平方非扩张随机不动点问题上达到 O(ε^{-3}) 复杂度，且批大小与迭代次数无关；对强单调算子达到 \widetilde{O}(ε^{-2})，在 ε 依赖上接近下界。
Conclusion: 作者认为 dual-anchor 加速机制在随机设置下不会像锚点式方法那样累积误差，从而可在无方差缩减和正则化条件下实现干净的加速复杂度。摘要没有涉及具体数据实验，属于理论性方法研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Clustered Randomized Smoothing for Stochastic Prediction Functions
papers.abstract_en: Modern stochastic predictors can model rich, multi-modal outcome distributions. However, this expressive power comes with challenges in ensuring robust predictions $-$ a critical requirement in safety-critical domains. Randomized smoothing is a leading technique for improving robustness, particularly against adversarial perturbations. Yet, in stochastic multi-modal regression settings, randomized smoothing often fails due to mode collapse, yielding averaged predictions that do not reflect the underlying distribution. To address this limitation, we propose clustered $α$-smoothing, a framework that (1) partitions noisy samples using an arbitrary clustering algorithm, (2) applies $α$-smoothing locally within each cluster, and (3) combines the resulting predictions into a mixture distribution. By interpreting the smoothing distribution as a mixture of $α$-smoothers, we derive a lower bound on the probability that the smoothed prediction lies within a union of compact regions corresponding to distinct modes. We empirically evaluate our framework on two benchmarks, demonstrating substantial improvements over state-of-the-art methods. In stochastic trajectory prediction on a driving simulator dataset, our approach achieves, on average, a $27\%$ lower Wasserstein distance to the ground-truth distribution compared to $α$-smoothing. In quadrotor control, where modes correspond to distinct feasible paths to a target, our method reduces the collision rate by $81\%$ relative to the state-of-the-art randomized smoothing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 clustered α-smoothing，一种针对随机多模态回归预测器的鲁棒性框架。作者指出标准随机平滑 (randomized smoothing) 在该场景下会因模式坍缩 (mode collapse) 而失效，因而先对噪声样本做任意聚类，再在各簇内局部应用 α-smoothing，最后组合成混合分布。摘要报告该方法在驾驶模拟器轨迹预测上平均降低 27% 的 Wasserstein 距离，在四旋翼控制中将碰撞率较现有最优随机平滑方法降低 81%。
Motivation: 随机预测器能建模丰富的多模态输出分布，但在安全关键领域中保证鲁棒预测困难；随机平滑是其主流方案，却在随机多模态回归中常因模式坍缩而失效，得到的平均预测无法反映真实分布。
Method: 提出 clustered α-smoothing 框架：用任意聚类算法划分噪声样本，在每个簇内局部应用 α-smoothing，再合成混合分布；同时将平滑分布解释为 α-smoothers 的混合，推导平滑预测落在对应不同模式的紧致区域并集内的概率下界。
Result: 在两个基准上的实验显示，该方法大幅优于现有最优方法：驾驶模拟器的随机轨迹预测中，相对 α-smoothing 平均降低 27% 的 Wasserstein 距离；在四旋翼控制中，模式对应到达目标的不同可行路径，碰撞率相对现有最优随机平滑降低 81%。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架通过按簇的混合 α-smoothing 缓解模式坍缩，从而提升随机多模态回归的鲁棒性；摘要中的验证场景限于轨迹预测与控制两类基准。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Mechanist: AI as a Scientific Instrument for Discovering the Mechanisms of Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: AI models have achieved remarkable success across diverse domains, yet the mechanisms underlying their capabilities and the risks they may pose remain poorly understood. As AI development becomes faster and increasingly automated, mechanistic exploration remains largely manual, widening the gap between what models can do and our ability to understand and control them. To bridge this gap, we introduce Mechanist, an agentic system that uses AI as a scientific instrument for the autonomous discovery of mechanisms underlying AI intelligence. To support autonomous mechanistic discovery, we construct an interpretability-focused knowledge graph of approximately 13,000 papers and integrate it with a multidisciplinary database of 43 million papers spanning 26 fields. We further curate a library of 32 foundational methods for mechanism analysis, causal intervention, and validation. Compared with Claude Code and existing AI-scientist systems, Mechanist generates more valuable mechanism hypotheses and executes experiments more reliably. Mechanist also demonstrates a progression from discovering model behaviors to explaining and controlling AI models. Specifically, Mechanist first uncovers a counterintuitive safety risk in scientific laboratories, showing that unsafe traits can transfer across modalities through apparently safe training data. Mechanist then develops a mechanism theory of belief, revealing how models represent world knowledge, form beliefs, infer the beliefs of others, and how these mechanisms emerge during pretraining. Finally, Mechanist translates these mechanistic insights into practical interventions that improve model performance across diverse scenarios and steer scientific foundation models toward generating DNA sequences with specified properties.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Mechanist，一个将 AI 用作科学仪器、自主发现 AI 智能机制的智能体系统 (agentic system)。系统集成了约 13,000 篇可解释性论文构建的知识图谱、跨 26 个领域的 4,300 万篇论文数据库，以及 32 种机制分析与因果干预方法。相比 Claude Code 与现有 AI-scientist 系统，Mechanist 能生成更有价值的机制假设并更可靠地执行实验；案例展示它从发现模型行为到解释、控制模型的递进，包括发现跨模态安全风险转移、构建信念的机制理论，并用机制洞察改进模型性能。
Motivation: AI 模型能力提升迅速且开发日益自动化，但对其能力与风险的机制理解仍主要依赖人工探索，导致模型能力与人类理解和控制之间的鸿沟不断扩大。
Method: 构建面向可解释性的知识图谱并集成跨学科论文数据库，整理 32 种机制分析、因果干预与验证方法，形成能够自主提出机制假设、执行实验并验证结论的智能体系统。
Result: 与 Claude Code 及现有 AI-scientist 系统的比较中，Mechanist 生成更有价值的机制假设且实验执行更可靠；实例显示它先发现不安全特质可经看似安全的数据跨模态转移，再建立信念的机制理论，最后将机制洞察用于提升模型性能并引导科学基础模型生成指定性质的 DNA 序列。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 AI 可作为科学仪器实现从行为发现、机制解释到模型控制的自主机制研究闭环，但该工作标注为 work in progress，未给出具体基准数据。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: How Far from Clinical Deployment? Evaluating the Complete Unsupervised Domain Adaptation Pipeline in Medical Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Deploying unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) in clinical practice requires choosing which algorithm to use and which of its trained models to ship. However, the deployment (target) domain is unlabeled, so models cannot be evaluated directly on it, leaving it unclear which to select. We address this by evaluating the complete UDA pipeline, considering both adaptation and label-free selection together. Our study covers eleven clinically relevant cross-domain scenarios from nine medical imaging datasets, with ten UDA algorithms and 13 label-free selection methods (validators), evaluating over 80,000 trained models in total. By this, we find that a capable adapted model usually exists, but identifying it without target labels is difficult: the validator-selected models leave a large and structural target performance gap to the best available one, with no evaluated validator consistently reliable. Towards closing it, we explore two strategies, ensembling and a small target-labeling budget; both narrow this gap but do not close it entirely. Overall, deployable UDA depends on the complete pipeline; addressing the less explored selection step could bring much of current UDA closer to clinical use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估医学影像中完整无监督领域自适应（UDA）管线，将模型适应与无目标标签模型选择结合起来考察。覆盖 9 个医学影像数据集的 11 个临床跨域场景、10 种 UDA 算法和 13 种无标签选择方法（validator），合计评估超过 80,000 个训练模型。结果表明性能良好的自适应模型通常存在，但无标签选择困难，且验证器选出的模型与最佳模型存在结构化目标性能差距。
Motivation: 临床部署 UDA 面临的问题是无法直接在无标签目标域上评估和选择模型，而过往研究较少同时考虑适应与模型选择。
Method: 将适应与无标签选择作为完整管线统一评估，用多种 validator 在大量医学影像跨域场景中挑选候选模型，并尝试集成和小额目标标注预算两种策略。
Result: 摘要报告验证器选择模型与最佳可用模型之间留下较大且结构性的目标性能差距，没有验证器持续可靠；集成和小额目标标注预算能缩小但无法完全消除该差距。
Conclusion: 作者认为可部署的 UDA 取决于完整管线，改进尚未被充分研究的选择步骤可使现有 UDA 方法更接近临床应用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LoSA: Near-Lossless Sparse Attention for Training-Free Video Diffusion Acceleration
papers.abstract_en: Video diffusion transformers are costly to sample: every denoising step applies self-attention over a long 3D token sequence, a quadratic cost that dominates as resolution and duration grow. Sparse attention reduces this cost without retraining, but existing methods pursue aggressive sparsity, where further speedup costs disproportionately more attention fidelity. We target the opposite end of this trade-off: fix near-lossless fidelity by construction, and remove as much computation as this constraint permits. Two observations make this regime practical: roughly 40% of block interactions can be removed while retaining 99% of the attention mass, and the high-mass support remains stable across denoising steps. We propose LoSA, a training-free sparse-attention method that fixes a retained-mass threshold of 99% rather than a sparsity ratio: it measures exact block attention masses at one early dense step, keeps, for each head and query block, the smallest key/value block set meeting the threshold, and reuses the frozen block indices for all remaining steps. On Wan2.1-1.3B, LoSA alone gives a $1.36\times$ speedup with a 0.06-point VBench Overall drop. The benefit is largest under composition: combined with feature caching, LoSA reaches a $3.2\times$ speedup on HunyuanVideo at a 0.02-point drop, versus 0.32 points for the strongest sparse baseline at comparable speed. Across three video diffusion transformers and speedups up to $3.2\times$, LoSA consistently achieves the best training-free speed-quality trade-off.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LoSA，一种免训练稀疏注意力方法，用于加速视频扩散 Transformer 的采样。其核心思路是固定 99% 的注意力质量保留阈值而非固定稀疏率：在一个早期 dense 步骤中精确测量各 block 的注意力质量，为每个 head 和 query block 保留满足阈值的最小 key/value block 集合，并在后续所有去噪步骤中复用该冻结索引。在 Wan2.1-1.3B 上单独提速 1.36 倍、VBench Overall 下降 0.06 点；与特征缓存组合后在 HunyuanVideo 上达到 3.2 倍提速、仅下降 0.02 点。
Motivation: 视频扩散 Transformer 的采样代价高，每一步去噪都要对长 3D token 序列做自注意力，计算量随分辨率和时长二次增长。现有免训练稀疏注意力追求激进稀疏，进一步提速会不成比例地损失注意力保真度；本文转向相反策略：先通过构造保证近无损保真度，再在该约束下尽量移除计算。
Method: 提出免训练的稀疏注意力方法 LoSA，用保留质量阈值 99% 替代固定稀疏率。作者观察到约 40% 的 block interaction 可以移除且保留 99% 注意力质量，且高权重支撑在不同去噪步骤间保持稳定；因此在一个早期 dense 步骤测量精确的 block 注意力质量，冻结每个 head/query block 满足阈值的最小 key/value block 集合，并在剩余步骤中复用。
Result: 约 40% 的 block interaction 可被移除而保留 99% 的注意力质量，高权重支撑跨去噪步骤稳定。在 Wan2.1-1.3B 上，LoSA 单独实现 1.36 倍提速，VBench Overall 下降 0.06 点；与特征缓存组合后，在 HunyuanVideo 上达到 3.2 倍提速，下降 0.02 点，而最强稀疏基线在相近速度下下降 0.32 点。
Conclusion: 在三个视频扩散 Transformer 上、最高 3.2 倍提速范围内，LoSA 持续取得最优的免训练速度-质量权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Probabilistic Constrained Clustering from Entangled Pairwise Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Pairwise constrained clustering typically relies on hard must-link/cannot-link labels, whereas realistic pairwise supervision may be real-valued and entangle intrinsic ambiguity, expert judgment, and stochastic corruption. Existing deep constrained clustering (DCC) methods mainly target hard, expert-agnostic constraints, treating soft labels mostly numerically rather than semantically. We formalize this setting as uncertainty-aware probabilistic constrained clustering (UPCC), defining a canonical aleatoric target through a heterogeneous observation process and analyzing its conditional identifiability. We introduce ProbPair, an angular pairwise objective for probabilistic relations, and build ECI-PP, an estimator--corrector--integrator framework that refines imperfect supervision via belief estimation, correction, and reliability-aware integration. Across challenging probabilistic supervision settings, experiments on diverse benchmarks show that ECI-PP outperforms state-of-the-art DCC methods and remains robust with a shared default configuration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文形式化了一种不确定性感知的概率约束聚类 (UPCC) 问题，其中成对监督是实值且纠缠了内在歧义、专家判断和随机损坏。作者提出 ProbPair 角向目标以及 ECI-PP（估计-校正-集成）框架，通过信念估计、校正和可靠性感知集成来精炼不完美监督。在多种具有挑战性的概率监督设置和多个基准上，ECI-PP 优于现有深度约束聚类方法，并在共享默认配置下保持鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有深度约束聚类 (DCC) 方法主要处理硬性的、与专家无关的 must-link/cannot-link 约束，对软标签多从数值角度处理而缺乏语义建模；真实世界中成对监督往往是实值、并混合了内在歧义、专家判断和随机损坏。
Method: 将问题正式定义为 UPCC，通过异构观测过程定义经典的偶然不确定性目标 (aleatoric target) 并分析其条件可辨识性；提出针对概率关系的角向目标 ProbPair，并构建 ECI-PP 框架，包含估计器、校正器和集成器，实现信念估计、监督校正与可靠性感知集成。
Result: 在多种概率监督设置下的不同基准实验中，ECI-PP 的性能优于现有深度约束聚类方法，并且在共享默认配置下依然保持鲁棒；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调对软成对约束进行概率语义建模能够显著改善聚类性能，ECI-PP 框架对不完美监督具有较好的鲁棒性。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有深度约束聚类 (DCC) 方法主要处理硬性的、与专家无关的 must-link/cannot-link 约束，对软标签多从数值角度处理而缺乏语义建模；真实世界中成对监督往往是实值、并混合了内在歧义、专家判断和随机损坏。
summary_sections.method: 将问题正式定义为 UPCC，通过异构观测过程定义经典的偶然不确定性目标 (aleatoric target) 并分析其条件可辨识性；提出针对概率关系的角向目标 ProbPair，并构建 ECI-PP 框架，包含估计器、校正器和集成器，实现信念估计、监督校正与可靠性感知集成。
summary_sections.result: 在多种概率监督设置下的不同基准实验中，ECI-PP 的性能优于现有深度约束聚类方法，并且在共享默认配置下依然保持鲁棒；摘要未给出具体数值。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调对软成对约束进行概率语义建模能够显著改善聚类性能，ECI-PP 框架对不完美监督具有较好的鲁棒性。

papers.title: SoftWater: Class-Aware Rate Allocation for Softmax Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization pipelines routinely leave the softmax output layer in high precision. Yet in small LLMs with modern vocabularies, the head holds 15--30\% of all parameters, so a nominal ``2-bit'' model with an fp16 head can store several times as many bits per weight. We pose softmax-layer quantization as a rate-distortion problem under the KL divergence between the original and quantized output distributions. A second-order analysis reveals a class-aware geometry: quantization error is weighted jointly by feature covariance and class-specific softmax curvature. A separability approximation replaces the $Kn\times Kn$ Cholesky with one $n\times n$ factorization rescaled per class, making the lattice encodable by successive interference cancellation, with both statistics from a single forward pass. The resulting method, SoftWater, gives fine grids to frequent, low-variance classes and coarse grids to rare ones, a large gap under Zipfian token distributions. Across five models from 1B to 32B, SoftWater outperforms the released WaterSIC quantizer (near-optimal under linear-layer WMSE but not output KL) at matched head rates on 59 of 60 test points, using none of that pipeline's refinements and cutting head-induced KL by $6.5\times$--$8.3\times$ at 2 bits. On Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct with quantized bodies, a 2-bit head removes 45--60\% of stored bytes for a $2.9$--$3.7\%$ perplexity increase. Because the class-side statistic comes from calibration data, matching calibration to the deployment domain gives the lowest KL on that domain throughout. On a tied model, a 4-bit head is near-lossless and a 2-bit head costs under 4\% perplexity, making head quantization of such models practical.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SoftWater，一种面向 softmax 输出层的后训练量化方法，将量化建模为原始与量化输出分布之间 KL 散度意义下的率失真问题。二阶分析表明量化误差由特征协方差与类别相关的 softmax 曲率联合加权；通过可分离近似，作者将 Kn×Kn 的 Cholesky 分解替换为按类别缩放的 n×n 分解，并采用逐次干扰消除 (successive interference cancellation) 编码格点。在 1B 到 32B 的五个模型上，SoftWater 在 59/60 个测试点上优于已发布的 WaterSIC，且无需其改进，并在 2-bit 下将 head 引起的 KL 降低 6.5–8.3 倍。
Motivation: 后训练量化通常将 softmax 输出层保留为高精度，但在现代词表的较小 LLM 中，head 占据全部参数的 15–30%，使得标称 2-bit 模型若 head 为 fp16，其每权重实际位数显著更高。现有线性层量化器（如 WaterSIC）在 WMSE 意义下接近最优，但并未针对输出 KL 进行优化。
Method: 将 softmax 层量化视为在原始与量化输出分布之间 KL 散度下的率失真问题；通过二阶分析导出色知几何，并用可分离近似将 Kn×Kn 的 Cholesky 分解替换为每个类别重新缩放的单个 n×n 分解，使格点可通过逐次干扰消除编码，所有统计量来自单次前向传播。
Result: 在五个 1B–32B 模型上，匹配 head 位率时 SoftWater 在 60 个测试点中的 59 个上优于 WaterSIC，并将 head 引起的 KL 在 2-bit 下降低 6.5–8.3 倍。在 Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct 上，量化 body 后使用 2-bit head 可移除 45–60% 的存储字节，困惑度增加 2.9–3.7%；在 tied 模型中，4-bit head 接近无损，2-bit head 的困惑度损失低于 4%。
Conclusion: 作者强调，将校准数据与部署域匹配可在该域上获得最低 KL；对于 tied 模型，head 量化变得实用。由于类别侧统计量来自校准数据，部署域匹配是方法有效性的关键条件。

papers.title: From Safety Documentation to Safety Knowledge Support: An Evidence-Grounded LLM Framework for Medical Devices
papers.abstract_en: Medical devices are becoming more software-intensive, connected, and AI-enabled. Their development requires risk-management evidence aligned with ISO 14971 and, for software, IEC 62304. This evidence must be kept consistent across requirements, design decisions, software changes, verification results, complaints, and post-market data. These tasks are costly and depend on scarce safety and domain experts. Large language models (LLMs) may reduce parts of this effort because medical-device safety work is highly document-based. However, current LLM-based safety-engineering studies often address isolated methods, rely on generic prompting or public examples, and provide limited support for source links, traceability, uncertainty handling, lifecycle updates, and recorded expert review. This limits their use in regulated medical-device development. This paper argues that the central research problem is not safety-text generation, but source-linked safety-knowledge support. We propose an evidence-grounded framework that connects device artifacts, controlled knowledge storage and retrieval, method-specific generation of candidate safety items, critique and uncertainty checks, and recorded expert review. The framework prepares, links, checks, and updates candidate safety artifacts for expert decision-making. It does not decide whether a device is safe and does not provide regulatory approval. We also outline an evaluation strategy using non-public or newly built medical-device case studies and expert reference analyses to assess coverage, correctness, relevance, traceability, duplicate rate, unsupported claims, and review effort.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对医疗器械安全工程中的文档密集型工作，提出一个基于证据的 LLM 框架，将重点从安全文本生成转向源链接的安全知识支持。框架连接设备工件、受控知识存储与检索、候选安全项生成、批评与不确定性检查以及记录专家评审，旨在为专家决策提供可追溯的候选安全工件。作者明确指出该框架不判断设备是否安全，也不提供监管批准。
Motivation: 医疗器械开发需满足 ISO 14971 和 IEC 62304 的风险管理证据要求，并需在需求、设计、变更、验证、投诉和上市后数据之间保持一致，成本高昂且依赖稀缺专家。现有基于 LLM 的安全工程研究多处理孤立方法、依赖通用提示或公共示例，在源链接、可追溯性、不确定性处理、生命周期更新和专家评审记录方面支持有限，难以用于受监管的医疗器械开发。
Method: 提出一个证据支撑的框架，由设备工件连接、受控知识存储与检索、方法特定的候选安全项目生成、批评与不确定性检查、记录专家评审等部分组成。框架对候选安全工件进行准备、链接、检查和更新，供专家决策使用。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数据，而是概述了一种评估策略：使用非公开或新建的医疗器械案例研究及专家参考分析，评估覆盖率、正确性、相关性、可追溯性、重复率、无依据声明和评审工作量。
Conclusion: 本文的立场是核心研究问题不是安全文本生成，而是源链接的安全知识支持；所提框架服务于专家决策，不做出设备安全性判定，也不提供监管批准。

papers.title: Reducing Symmetry Increase in Equivariant Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Equivariant Neural Networks (ENNs) have empowered numerous applications in scientific fields. Despite their remarkable capacity for representing geometric structures, ENNs suffer from degraded expressivity when processing symmetric inputs: the output representations are invariant to transformations that extend beyond the input's symmetries. The mathematical essence of this phenomenon is that a symmetric input, after being processed by an equivariant map, experiences an increase in symmetry. While prior research has documented symmetry increase in specific cases, a rigorous understanding of its underlying causes and general reduction strategies remains lacking. In this paper, we provide a detailed and in-depth characterization of symmetry increase together with a principled framework for its reduction: (i) For any given feature space and input symmetry group, we prove that the increased symmetry admits an infimum determined by the structure of the feature space; (ii) Building on this foundation, we develop a computable algorithm to derive this infimum, and propose practical guidelines for feature design to prevent harmful symmetry increases. (iii) Under standard regularity assumptions, we demonstrate that for most equivariant maps, our guidelines effectively reduce symmetry increase. To complement our theoretical findings, we provide visualizations and experiments on both synthetic datasets and the real-world QM9 dataset. The results validate our theoretical predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究等变神经网络（Equivariant Neural Networks, ENNs）处理对称输入时出现的对称性增加现象，即输出表示对超出输入对称性的变换保持不变，从而降低模型表达力。作者从理论上刻画了这类对称性增加，证明其存在由特征空间结构决定的下确界，并据此提出可计算的算法与特征设计准则来抑制有害的对称性增加。合成数据与 QM9 数据集上的实验验证了理论预测。
Motivation: ENN 在处理对称输入时会发生对称性增加，输出表示会额外对输入不具有的对称性保持不变，损害表达力；此前研究仅在个别案例中记录该现象，缺乏对其成因的严格理解与通用的抑制策略。
Method: 给出对称性增加的详细刻画，并在给定特征空间与输入对称群下证明增加后的对称性存在由特征空间结构决定的下确界；在此基础上设计可计算该下确界的算法，并提出防止有害对称性增加的特征设计准则。
Result: 在标准正则性假设下，作者证明所提准则对大多数等变映射能有效降低对称性增加；合成数据集与真实 QM9 数据集上的可视化与实验验证了理论预测。
Conclusion: 该工作为降低 ENN 中的对称性增加提供了原则性框架，强调特征空间结构对最小可实现对称性的决定作用，并给出实用的特征设计指导。

papers.title: Adaptive Bregman Proximal Stochastic Gradient with a Stabilized Barzilai--Borwein Step Size
papers.abstract_en: Bregman proximal stochastic gradient (BPSG) methods bring variance-reduced composite optimization to objectives whose geometry is poorly captured by Euclidean smoothness. Their performance, however, remains sensitive to the step size: raw stochastic curvature estimates can fluctuate sharply, whereas line searches add repeated proximal evaluations. We introduce Ada-BPSG, a line-search-free BPSG method that couples the SAGA gradient table with a stabilized Barzilai--Borwein (BB) candidate. A mediant aggregates incremental secant information so that nearly singular local ratios receive little weight, and an explicit safeguard translates the resulting curvature estimate into the bounded step-size sequence required for convergence. This design yields a direct analytical chain from relative smoothness and component-wise variance control to convergence in finite-dimensional normed spaces. We prove an $O(n/K)$ ergodic rate for convex objectives, a restarted linear rate under relative quadratic growth, and an $O(1/K)$ bound for a Bregman proximal residual in the nonconvex setting. On logistic regression and sparse nonnegative matrix factorization, Ada-BPSG combines low objective values with substantially less sensitivity to the initial step size than standard variance-reduced baselines, while avoiding line search.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Ada-BPSG，一种免线性搜索的 Bregman 近端随机梯度方法，将 SAGA 梯度表与稳定化的 Barzilai-Borwein（BB）步长结合。作者用 mediant 聚合增量割线信息以削弱近似奇异的局部曲率比，并加入显式安全防护将有界步长序列与相对光滑性、分量级方差控制联系起来，从而在有限维赋范空间中给出收敛性证明。实验表明该方法在逻辑回归和稀疏非负矩阵分解上对初始步长远不如标准方差缩减基线敏感。
Motivation: 现有 BPSG 方法对步长选择敏感：原始随机曲率估计波动剧烈，而线性搜索需要重复计算近端算子，代价较高。作者希望在不引入线性搜索的前提下获得稳定的自适应步长，使方差缩减复合优化在不同几何下更可靠。
Method: 提出 Ada-BPSG，把 SAGA 方差缩减与稳定化的 BB 候选步长结合；利用 mediant 聚合增量割线信息，使近似奇异的局部比率获得较小权重，并用显式安全防护将曲率估计映射为满足收敛要求的有界步长序列。理论分析从相对光滑度和分量级方差控制推导出有限维赋范空间中的收敛性。
Result: 摘要报告了三种收敛保证：凸目标下 O(n/K) 遍历率、相对二次增长假设下的重启线性率、非凸情形下 Bregman 近端残差的 O(1/K) 界。在逻辑回归和稀疏非负矩阵分解上，Ada-BPSG 能达到较低目标值，且对初始步长的敏感性显著低于标准方差缩减基线，同时避免线性搜索。
Conclusion: 作者认为稳定化的 BB 步长设计可以替代线性搜索，在凸和非凸组合优化中同时保证收敛性和对初始步长的鲁棒性。摘要未明确讨论该方法的局限或适用边界。

summary_sections.method: 提出 Ada-BPSG，把 SAGA 方差缩减与稳定化的 BB 候选步长结合；利用 mediant 聚合增量割线信息，使近似奇异的局部比率获得较小权重，并用显式安全防护将曲率估计映射为满足收敛要求的有界步长序列。理论分析从相对光滑度和分量级方差控制推导出有限维赋范空间中的收敛性。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告了三种收敛保证：凸目标下 O(n/K) 遍历率、相对二次增长假设下的重启线性率、非凸情形下 Bregman 近端残差的 O(1/K) 界。在逻辑回归和稀疏非负矩阵分解上，Ada-BPSG 能达到较低目标值，且对初始步长的敏感性显著低于标准方差缩减基线，同时避免线性搜索。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为稳定化的 BB 步长设计可以替代线性搜索，在凸和非凸组合优化中同时保证收敛性和对初始步长的鲁棒性。摘要未明确讨论该方法的局限或适用边界。

papers.title: Dual-Model Sentiment Analysis of Consumer Reviews in the Retail Coffee Sector Using Machine Learning and Deep Learning Approaches
papers.abstract_en: Consumer reviews play an important role in shaping brand perception and business strategies, particularly in service-driven industries such as retail coffee. This study presents a comparative sentiment analysis framework for Starbucks customer reviews using classical machine learning and deep learning approaches. The dataset, collected from ConsumerAffairs, contains more than 700 reviews and was analyzed through preprocessing and exploratory data analysis to identify temporal and geographic patterns. Sentiment labels were generated by binarizing star ratings, with ratings of 4 and 5 classified as positive and ratings of 1 to 3 as negative. The resulting dataset was substantially imbalanced toward negative sentiment. Five machine learning classifiers, including Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machine (SVM), Decision Tree, Random Forest, and Naive Bayes, were evaluated alongside five deep learning models: LSTM, RNN, Bidirectional LSTM, GRU, and CNN. Model performance was assessed using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. SVM achieved the highest accuracy among the machine learning models at 91.0 percent, while Bidirectional LSTM showed the strongest performance among the deep learning models and demonstrated good generalization on unseen data. The findings also show that class imbalance negatively affected positive sentiment recall across several models. Overall, this study provides a comparative evaluation of machine learning and deep learning approaches for real-world consumer sentiment analysis and highlights the importance of appropriate model selection and preprocessing for customer experience analytics in the retail coffee sector.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对比了经典机器学习和深度学习方法在零售咖啡行业消费者评论情感分析中的表现，以 Starbucks 在 ConsumerAffairs 上的 700 余条评论为数据集，将星级评分二值化为正负情感标签。实验评估了五种机器学习分类器（Logistic Regression、SVM、Decision Tree、Random Forest、Naive Bayes）和五种深度学习模型（LSTM、RNN、Bidirectional LSTM、GRU、CNN），发现 SVM 在机器学习模型中准确率最高（91.0%），Bidirectional LSTM 在深度学习模型中表现最强，且类别不平衡对正面情感召回率造成负面影响。
Motivation: 消费者评论影响品牌认知和商业策略，尤其在零售咖啡等服务驱动型行业中，需要对比不同情感分析方法的适用性，以支持客户体验分析。
Method: 构建基于星级评分二值化（4-5 星为正，1-3 星为负）的情感标签，进行预处理和探索性数据分析，并系统比较五种经典机器学习模型与五种深度学习模型，以准确率、精确率、召回率和 F1-score 评估性能。
Result: SVM 在机器学习模型中取得最高准确率 91.0%；Bidirectional LSTM 在深度模型中表现最强且在未见数据上泛化良好；类别不平衡显著降低了多个模型的正面情感召回率。
Conclusion: 研究提供了真实消费者评论情感分析中机器学习与深度学习方法的比较评价，强调合适的模型选择与预处理对零售咖啡行业客户体验分析的重要性。

papers.title: RealisticTritonBench: A Benchmark for Triton-Kernel Generation in Real-World AI Frameworks
papers.abstract_en: In modern AI frameworks, GPU kernels are key to overall system performance. Combining usability, portability, and near-handwritten CUDA performance, Triton is widely adopted for implementing GPU kernels. Recent advances show the potential of large language models (LLMs) to automatically generate Triton kernels, reducing the manual effort required from expert kernel developers. Several benchmarks evaluate LLM-generated Triton kernels. However, they suffer from three key limitations: (1) they restrict tasks to PyTorch-to-Triton translation, failing to reflect the diversity and complexity of real-world Triton tasks; (2) they evaluate only individual-kernel performance rather than end-to-end performance, the core criterion for real-world deployment in AI frameworks; and (3) they rely on manually written evaluation scripts for individual kernels, which may contain flaws that models can exploit to bypass correctness checks and obtain inflated scores. To address these limitations, we introduce RealisticTritonBench, the first benchmark to derive Triton kernel generation tasks from real-world pull requests in popular AI frameworks, enabling realistic, production-like evaluation. RealisticTritonBench systematically extracts PRs that modify Triton kernels from popular open-source AI frameworks and transforms them into generation tasks with concrete engineering contexts. Each task takes a natural language requirement as input and requires a corresponding Triton kernel implementation, with a complete and reproducible evaluation environment. Unlike prior benchmarks focused on isolated kernel performance, RealisticTritonBench integrates generated kernels into their original frameworks and evaluates them using end-to-end tests, enabling a more faithful assessment. We evaluate leading LLMs on RealisticTritonBench and find that they still struggle with real-world Triton kernel generation tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RealisticTritonBench，一个从主流 AI 框架的真实 pull request 中提取 Triton 内核生成任务的基准。与先前只评估单个内核性能的基准不同，它将生成的 Triton 内核集成回原始框架，用端到端测试进行评测。作者对领先 LLM 的评估显示，这些模型在真实世界 Triton 内核生成任务上仍然表现困难。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 生成 Triton 内核的基准存在三个缺陷：任务局限于 PyTorch 到 Triton 的翻译，不能反映真实任务的多样性和复杂性；只评估单个内核性能而非端到端性能；依赖手写评估脚本，可能被模型利用来绕过正确性检查。因此需要一个更贴近生产环境的评估基准。
Method: 从流行的开源 AI 框架中系统提取修改 Triton 内核的 pull request，将其转化为带具体工程上下文的生成任务；每个任务以自然语言需求为输入，要求输出对应的 Triton 内核实现，并提供完整可复现的评估环境。评测时把生成的内核集成回原框架，使用端到端测试。
Result: 在 RealisticTritonBench 上评估了多个领先 LLM，结果表明它们在真实世界的 Triton 内核生成任务上仍然表现困难。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: RealisticTritonBench 提供了更真实的、基于端到端测试的 Triton 内核生成评估方式。摘要强调该基准能更忠实评估模型，而现有 LLM 尚未能胜任真实世界任务。

papers.title: CTBench: Evaluating Troubleshooting Capabilities of AI Agents in Realistic Telecom Network Operations
papers.abstract_en: Agents are increasingly considered for automating network operations and maintenance, where engineers must diagnose network faults, optimize configurations to enhance services, and reduce operational costs while acting under strict constraints. However, existing evaluations fail to accurately model real network characteristics or assess agents under partially observable telecom environments with diverse vendors, devices, protocols, and interfaces. In this paper, we introduce CTBench, a public benchmark for assessing whether an agent behaves like a competent telecom troubleshooting engineer. CTBench focuses on root cause analysis and path restoration. Each task is constructed by experts and annotated with rich task metadata, including golden evidence steps. CTBench uses expert-grounded metrics that evaluate both final answers and the diagnostic evidence. Experiments with representative harness-model combinations show that state-of-the-art agents perform very well at identifying endpoints in path-restoration tasks but, more generally, underperform in root cause analysis. In particular, agents struggle with interface state, link-layer, service-management, and other operational faults. Most importantly, even when agents produce plausible or correct final answers, they often fail to provide the evidence-grounded diagnoses required in operational practice. Our results further show that path restoration is generally more resource expensive, yet larger resource usage does not necessarily translate into better diagnosis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CTBench，一个用于评估 AI agent 在真实电信网络运维中故障排查能力的公开基准。每个任务由专家构建，聚焦根因分析和路径恢复两类任务，并使用专家依据的指标同时评估最终答案和诊断证据。实验表明，最先进的 agent 在路径恢复的端点识别上表现很好，但普遍在根因分析上欠佳；即便有时给出正确最终答案，也往往缺乏证据支撑的诊断，且更大资源使用并不必然带来更好的诊断。
Motivation: 现有评估不能准确建模真实网络特征，也未能评估 agent 在不完全可观测电信环境（包含多厂商、设备、协议和接口）下的表现。因此需要一个更贴近实际运维的基准来判断 agent 是否具备合格电信排障工程师的能力。
Method: CTBench 聚焦根因分析 (root cause analysis) 和路径恢复 (path restoration)；任务由专家构建并用丰富任务元数据（包括 golden evidence steps）标注。采用专家依据的指标来评估最终答案和诊断证据，并使用代表性的 harness-model 组合进行测试。
Result: 实验显示 SOTA agent 在路径恢复的端点识别上表现很好，但在根因分析上普遍不足，尤其难以处理接口状态、链路层、服务管理及其他运维故障。即使 agent 给出合理或正确的最终答案，也常常无法提供运维实践所需的证据化诊断；路径恢复通常更耗资源，但更大资源使用并不必然提升诊断质量。
Conclusion: 摘要强调当前 agent 在证据化诊断能力上的明显短板，CTBench 可作为一个公开基准来评估这类与真实运维要求匹配的能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Remote Sensing and Machine Learning-Based Analysis of Land Use and Vegetation Change in Dhaka District, Bangladesh
papers.abstract_en: Rapid urbanization in Dhaka District, Bangladesh has triggered substantial alterations in land use and environmental conditions, necessitating systematic monitoring for informed urban planning and ecological sustainability. This study employs remote sensing data and machine learning techniques to analyze spatiotemporal changes in land cover and vegetation dynamics between 2019 and 2024. High-resolution satellite imagery from Sentinel-2 MSI and Landsat 8 was utilized to classify land cover types and compute spectral indices including the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI), Normalized Difference Built-up Index (NDBI), and Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI). A supervised machine learning approach incorporating Decision Tree, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), and Random Forest classifiers was applied using labeled geospatial training points within Google Earth Engine. Accuracy assessments were conducted using confusion matrices and kappa statistics. Results indicate a 59.5% increase in urban built-up areas and a significant decline in vegetation (-8.46%) and water bodies (-7.77%) over the five-year period. Land conversion from vegetated and aquatic areas to urban infrastructure was identified as a dominant trend. Among the models, Random Forest demonstrated the highest classification accuracy. These findings underscore the growing environmental pressures driven by unregulated urban expansion in Dhaka. The study highlights the potential of remote sensing and machine learning tools in providing timely, actionable data to support sustainable urban development, land-use regulation, and ecosystem conservation policies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用遥感影像与机器学习方法分析孟加拉国达卡地区 2019 至 2024 年间土地利用与植被覆盖的时空变化。研究基于 Sentinel-2 MSI 和 Landsat 8 影像，结合 NDVI、NDBI、NDWI 等光谱指数，并在 Google Earth Engine 中采用 Decision Tree、KNN 和 Random Forest 三种监督分类器。结果显示城市建成区面积增加 59.5%，植被和水体分别下降 8.46% 和 7.77%，Random Forest 分类精度最高。
Motivation: 达卡地区快速城市化引发显著的土地利用和环境变化，需要系统性监测来支撑城市规划与生态可持续性决策。
Method: 使用高分遥感影像计算 NDVI、NDBI、NDWI 等光谱指数，并在 Google Earth Engine 中基于标注地理训练点训练 Decision Tree、K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) 和 Random Forest 三种监督机器学习分类器，利用混淆矩阵和 kappa 统计进行精度评估。
Result: 2019 至 2024 年间城市建成区增加 59.5%，植被减少 8.46%，水体减少 7.77%；植被和水体向城市基础设施的转化是主导趋势，Random Forest 分类精度最高。
Conclusion: 研究凸显了达卡无管制城市扩张带来的环境压力，并表明遥感与机器学习工具可为可持续城市发展、土地利用监管和生态保护政策提供及时、可操作的数据支持。

papers.title: Beyond Local Power: Functional Connectivity Analysis for Subject-Independent Learning Style Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Identifying individual learning styles optimizes pedagogical efficacy. While traditional questionnaires are structured, behavioral tracking methods require prolonged interaction log accumulation. To overcome these temporal constraints, this paper proposes an objective Electroencephalography (EEG) approach evaluating Phase Locking Value (PLV) connectivity against localized features across the Active-Reflective (AR) and Verbal-Visual (VV) Felder-Silverman dimensions. EEG signals were recorded from 28 participants during Raven's Advanced Progressive Matrices tasks. Support Vector Machine classification used Leave-One-Subject-Out Cross-Validation (LOSO-CV) alongside a 70:30 intra-subject split. The VV dimension achieved 70.00% subject-level accuracy driven by distinct fronto-occipital polarization. Conversely, the AR dimension yielded lower cross-subject generalizability (55.56%) due to overlapping executive networks and a "Systematic Neural Inversion" phenomenon, where stable individual connectivity signatures operated diametrically opposed to global boundaries (up to 20-0 voting margins). Ultimately, these outcomes demonstrate that rigid "one-size-fits-all" classifiers are bounded by biological diversity, emphasizing the need for future adaptive feature transformation techniques to bridge the cross-subject generalization gap.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于脑电 (EEG) 的客观学习风格识别方法，在 Felder-Silverman 的 Active-Reflective (AR) 与 Verbal-Visual (VV) 维度上比较 Phase Locking Value (PLV) 连接特征与局部特征。28 名被试在 Raven's Advanced Progressive Matrices 任务中的 EEG 经 Support Vector Machine 分类，采用 Leave-One-Subject-Out Cross-Validation (LOSO-CV) 与 70:30 被试内划分评估；VV 维度达到 70.00% 的被试级准确率，而 AR 维度跨被试泛化仅 55.56%。作者认为刚性统一分类器受生物多样性限制，需要自适应特征变换来弥合跨被试泛化差距。
Motivation: 传统问卷识别学习风格虽结构化但依赖自我报告，行为追踪方法又需要长时间交互日志积累；该文旨在利用 EEG 在单次任务中实现客观、快速的学习风格维度识别。
Method: 记录 28 名被试完成 Raven's Advanced Progressive Matrices 任务时的 EEG，提取 PLV 功能连接特征并与局部特征对比，针对 AR 与 VV 两个 Felder-Silverman 维度使用 SVM 分类，并用 LOSO-CV 与 70:30 被试内划分评估跨被试与被试内表现。
Result: VV 维度取得 70.00% 的被试级准确率，由明显的前额-枕叶极化驱动；AR 维度跨被试泛化较低 (55.56%)，并出现 "Systematic Neural Inversion" 现象，即稳定的个体连接特征与全局分类边界方向相反，投票差距最高达 20-0。
Conclusion: 摘要指出固定的 "one-size-fits-all" 分类器受个体生物学差异制约，跨被试泛化差距依然存在，未来需要自适应特征变换技术来改善学习风格识别。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Remote Approach to Cashew Orchard Detection: Leveraging Active Learning with Satellite Imagery in Guinea-Bissau
papers.abstract_en: Cashew production is a widespread economic activity in Guinea-Bissau, as well as other countries in West Africa. However, unregulated cashew production can be directly associated with increasing regionwide deforestation rates, biodiversity losses, and a fragile economic structure. There is no nationwide database for listing or georeferencing cashew orchards, so there is a clear need to remotely map their locations. In recent years, multiple methods for detecting orchards have been developed, though they have only been applied on a regional level. This work expands regional analyses to a nationwide scale. It develops a scalable and cost-effective remote approach, based on Sentinel-2 satellite imagery, using Machine Learning techniques to detect cashew orchards automatically. Margin-based Active Learning techniques were employed to develop an optimal training set in terms of the number of points and their informativeness, leading to a cashew map with 94.0% balanced accuracy obtained entirely off-site. We created two datasets and a 2021 cashew map with 10m spatial resolution that are openly accessible through GitHub. The results demonstrate the possibility of a broader cashew orchard mapping, creating a new stepping stone for this environmental application.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把腰果果园 (cashew orchard) 检测从区域分析扩展到几内亚比绍的全国尺度，基于 Sentinel-2 卫星影像和机器学习自动识别果园，并用边缘采样 (margin-based) 主动学习策略筛选训练点。摘要报告整体离岸完成，最终达到 94.0% 的平衡准确率，产出 2021 年、10m 分辨率的腰果地图，并开放两个数据集。
Motivation: 几内亚比绍及西非多国缺乏腰果果园的全国性清单和地理参考，而无序种植与森林砍伐、生物多样性丧失和经济脆弱性相关，因此需要可扩展、低成本的遥感制图工具；已有检测方法只在区域层面应用。
Method: 采用基于 Sentinel-2 卫星影像的机器学习流程，利用边缘采样的主动学习策略构建训练集，以在样本数量和信息量上达到最优，从而实现腰果果园的自动检测；整个过程完全离岸完成。
Result: 摘要报告该方法取得 94.0% 的平衡准确率 (balanced accuracy)，并生成 10m 空间分辨率的 2021 年腰果地图；两个开放数据集通过 GitHub 公开。
Conclusion: 结果表明腰果果园制图可以从区域层面推广到更广的全国尺度，为该环境应用提供新的基础；摘要未给出明确的局限性说明。

papers.title: Latent variable models for simultaneous EOV identification and removal in population-based SHM
papers.abstract_en: The robust treatment of environmental and operational variability (EOV) is an open challenge in population-based structural health monitoring (PBSHM). The difficulty is compounded in the case that the EOV signals are unmeasured. A common approach in conventional SHM is to apply \emph{projection-based} methods that discard subspaces of healthy feature data, reasoning that the EOV signal dominates the variance of the measured features. However, a common pitfall of projection-based approaches is that when damage acts close to the same variance-dominant direction, damage sensitivity is removed along with the EOV. An alternative identifying assumption for the removal of particular unmeasured EOVs is slowness; the latent EOV process is characterised by its long temporal correlation. In this paper, the latent EOV is cast as a state-space Gaussian process, enabling tractable $\mathcal{O}(T)$ inference via a Kalman filter. A robust hierarchical Bayesian identification framework is developed that enables population-level identification of latent EOVs and EOV-free residual features, using a Laplace approximation. The approach is first validated on a single laboratory-scale benchmark structure from the literature, subject to thermal EOVs, demonstrating robust damage detection and EOV recovery. The method is then applied to a simulated nine-turbine offshore wind farm with staggered deployment and damage, where it delivers a substantial true-positive uplift over projection and cointegration-based baselines at matched false-positive rates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向群体结构健康监测（PBSHM）中未测量的环境与运行变异性（EOV）问题，提出将潜在 EOV 建模为状态空间高斯过程，通过卡尔曼滤波实现 O(T) 推理，并采用层次贝叶斯框架结合拉普拉斯近似进行群体级 EOV 识别与 EOV-free 残差特征提取。方法在受热 EOV 的实验室基准结构上验证了损伤检测与 EOV 恢复，并在模拟九涡轮海上风电场中相对投影法和协整法基线在匹配假阳性率下获得显著真阳性提升。
Motivation: PBSHM 中 EOV 信号常未测量，传统投影类方法通过丢弃特征数据中的方差主导子空间去除 EOV，但当损伤方向与该子空间接近时会同时损失损伤敏感性；因此需要利用 EOV 慢变性（长时间相关）这一替代识别假设来同时识别并去除 EOV。
Method: 将潜在 EOV 过程建模为状态空间高斯过程，借助卡尔曼滤波实现可处理的 O(T) 推理；在此基础上建立鲁棒的层次贝叶斯识别框架，使用拉普拉斯近似完成群体级潜在 EOV 识别以及 EOV-free 残差特征的推断。
Result: 在单个实验室规模基准结构（含热 EOV）上验证了鲁棒的损伤检测与 EOV 恢复；在模拟的九涡轮海上风电场（含交错部署与损伤）中，方法在匹配假阳性率条件下相比投影法和协整法基线带来显著的真阳性提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于慢变性假设的潜变量方法能够在不牺牲损伤敏感性的前提下同时识别并去除未测量的 EOV，为 PBSHM 中投影类方法提供了一种替代方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Claim-Level Reliability Assessment for Efficient Test-Time Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: We propose claim-level falsification as a principle for test-time scaling and instantiate it through Claim-Level Reliability Assessment (CLR), a training-free framework that reallocates test-time compute from additional solution sampling to targeted verification. Since whole-trace evaluation often obscures decisive errors due to signal dilution from routine tokens, CLR condenses each reasoning trace into a compact set of decision-critical claims, thereby isolating its logical anchors. Furthermore, recognizing the inherent difficulty of generating entirely correct solutions under fixed model capabilities, CLR shifts the focus to semantic falsification. This approach exploits a fundamental asymmetry between solution construction and claim refutation. Constructing a valid solution requires a flawless reasoning path, whereas refuting an incorrect claim requires identifying only a single decisive flaw. This targeted search for negative evidence systematically compresses the survival space of high-confidence incorrect traces, effectively suppressing erroneous consensus via nonlinear reliability scoring. Across four LLMs and four reasoning benchmarks under matched budgets, CLR generally improves upon pass@1 and self-consistency. On GPT-OSS-20B/CMIMC25, for instance, CLR exceeds pass@1 by 27.15 percentage-points and raises self-consistency accuracy from 77.50\% to 82.19\% with 37.0\% fewer tokens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出以 claim 级别的证伪 (claim-level falsification) 作为 test-time scaling 的原则，并实例化为 Claim-Level Reliability Assessment (CLR)：一个无需训练 (training-free) 的框架，将测试时计算从额外采样转移到针对性验证。CLR 把推理轨迹压缩为关键论断集合，并通过语义证伪来抑制高置信度的错误轨迹。在四个 LLM 和四个推理基准的匹配预算下，CLR 普遍提升 pass@1 与 self-consistency。
Motivation: 整条轨迹的评估会因常规 token 的信号稀释而掩盖决定性错误；同时，在固定模型能力下生成完全正确的解非常困难，而反驳一个错误论断只需找到一个关键缺陷。作者利用这种构造与证伪之间的不对称性，将测试时计算重新分配给验证。
Method: CLR 将每条推理轨迹压缩为一组决策关键论断 (decision-critical claims)，聚焦其逻辑锚点，然后进行语义证伪 (semantic falsification)，通过非线性可靠性评分压缩高置信度错误轨迹的生存空间。该方法无需训练，直接作用于现有模型输出。
Result: 在匹配预算下，跨四个 LLM 和四个推理基准，CLR 通常优于 pass@1 和 self-consistency。例如在 GPT-OSS-20B/CMIMC25 上，CLR 比 pass@1 高 27.15 个百分点，并将 self-consistency 准确率从 77.50% 提升到 82.19%，同时少用 37.0% 的 token。
Conclusion: 作者认为，将测试时计算从解构造转向针对性的 claim 证伪是一种有效的 scaling 方式，能够以更少的 token 提升推理可靠性；该框架训练无关，可直接用于既有模型。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Auditing Frame-Level AUC in Weakly Supervised Video Anomaly Detection: Granularity, Resolution, and Scene Bias
papers.abstract_en: Frame-level area under the ROC curve (AUC) is the dominant evaluation metric for weakly supervised video anomaly detection (WSVAD). Its standard form measures whether an anomalous frame outranks a normal frame drawn from anywhere in the test set. We refer to this comparison as pooled AUC, since it aggregates frame pairs across test videos regardless of source. Pooled AUC therefore credits both event localization and differences between video sources. We audit this protocol on UCF-Crime across recent state-of-the-art models spanning different backbone families. Holding each model's frame scores fixed, we read them under three pairing granularities: global, per anomaly category, and within each video, then repeat the same three-granularity readout on zero-shot scores computed from the models' internal representations. We assess ranking reliability with a paired video bootstrap. Three findings follow. First, pooled AUC does not reliably predict within-video anomaly localization: models with similar pooled scores exhibit large localization differences and rank reversals under stricter granularities. Second, at the benchmark's test-split size, pooled AUC lacks the resolution to support state-of-the-art margins reported in the field. Within each backbone family, it resolves no comparison at those margins, while within-video AUC resolves several over identical predictions. Learned representations further reveal that within-video anomaly structure and detector localization are decoupled. Third, on normal footage alone, every model we examine separates videos by recording properties, such as resolution and color encoding, indicating that scene sensitivity is shared across the setting rather than specific to any architecture. We publicly release a granularity-aware protocol computable from existing predictions and scene-factor annotations for UCF-Crime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文审计弱监督视频异常检测 (WSVAD) 中占主导地位的评估指标——帧级 area under the ROC curve (AUC)，并在 UCF-Crime 上对多个 SOTA 模型（涵盖不同骨干网络）进行系统性检查。作者固定各模型的帧分数，在全局、异常类别内和视频内三种配对粒度下重新读取分数，并加入成对视频 bootstrap 评估排序可靠性。摘要报告三个发现：pooled AUC 不能可靠预测视频内异常定位；在基准测试集的规模下 pooled AUC 分辨率不足以支撑当前 SOTA 报告的微小差距；所有模型在正常片段上都可按分辨率、颜色编码等记录属性分离视频，说明场景敏感偏差是共享的而非特定于某种架构。
Motivation: 标准帧级 pooled AUC 从整个测试集任意抽取帧对进行比较，因此同时奖励事件定位和视频来源差异，可能掩盖真正的定位性能问题。
Method: 保持每个模型的帧分数不变，采用全局、按异常类别、按视频内三种配对粒度读取 AUC；对模型内部表示计算零样本分数并重复三种粒度的读取；使用成对视频 bootstrap 评估排序的可靠性，并基于现有预测和场景因子注释发布粒度感知的评估协议。
Result: 摘要报告相似 pooled AUC 的模型在更严格粒度下表现出大的定位差异和排序反转；同一骨干族内 pooled AUC 无法分辨 SOTA 的 margin，而 within-video AUC 在相同预测上可分辨多个比较；对正常片段的分析显示所有模型都按记录属性（如分辨率和颜色编码）分离视频。
Conclusion: 作者认为标准 pooled AUC 在 WSVAD 中的粒度和分辨率均有局限，并且场景敏感性是整个评估设置共有的偏差；为此公开一个可由现有预测和 UCF-Crime 场景因子注释计算的粒度感知协议。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文审计弱监督视频异常检测 (WSVAD) 中占主导地位的评估指标——帧级 area under the ROC curve (AUC)，并在 UCF-Crime 上对多个 SOTA 模型（涵盖不同骨干网络）进行系统性检查。作者固定各模型的帧分数，在全局、异常类别内和视频内三种配对粒度下重新读取分数，并加入成对视频 bootstrap 评估排序可靠性。摘要报告三个发现：pooled AUC 不能可靠预测视频内异常定位；在基准测试集的规模下 pooled AUC 分辨率不足以支撑当前 SOTA 报告的微小差距；所有模型在正常片段上都可按分辨率、颜色编码等记录属性分离视频，说明场景敏感偏差是共享的而非特定于某种架构。
summary_sections.motivation: 标准帧级 pooled AUC 从整个测试集任意抽取帧对进行比较，因此同时奖励事件定位和视频来源差异，可能掩盖真正的定位性能问题。
summary_sections.method: 保持每个模型的帧分数不变，采用全局、按异常类别、按视频内三种配对粒度读取 AUC；对模型内部表示计算零样本分数并重复三种粒度的读取；使用成对视频 bootstrap 评估排序的可靠性，并基于现有预测和场景因子注释发布粒度感知的评估协议。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告相似 pooled AUC 的模型在更严格粒度下表现出大的定位差异和排序反转；同一骨干族内 pooled AUC 无法分辨 SOTA 的 margin，而 within-video AUC 在相同预测上可分辨多个比较；对正常片段的分析显示所有模型都按记录属性（如分辨率和颜色编码）分离视频。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为标准 pooled AUC 在 WSVAD 中的粒度和分辨率均有局限，并且场景敏感性是整个评估设置共有的偏差；为此公开一个可由现有预测和 UCF-Crime 场景因子注释计算的粒度感知协议。

papers.title: HCGRec: Hint-Conditioned Generative Recommendation with Semantic IDs
papers.abstract_en: Semantic-ID generative recommenders represent each item as a short sequence of discrete semantic tokens and predict the next item by autoregressively generating this token sequence. This paradigm enables a unified generation interface for item IDs, histories, and item text, but it also creates a structured optimization bottleneck during reward-based post-training: when an early semantic token enters the wrong branch of the item-token space, finite rollout groups rarely reach the ground-truth item, so group-relative optimization receives identical zero rewards and produces no useful advantage. We propose Hint-Conditioned Generative Recommendation (HCGRec), a semantic-ID generative recommendation framework that recovers learning signal for such hard training instances. HCGRec diagnoses each instance with checkpoint rollouts and supplies a minimal target-prefix hint only when the current generator cannot reach the correct item. The model then generates the unhinted suffix under the hinted semantic branch, turning zero-reward groups into informative comparisons over item-token completions. Hinting also changes token identity: hinted prefix tokens are oracle-provided item context, while unhinted suffix tokens are sampled generation actions. We therefore introduce hint-aware credit decomposition, using supervised learning to preserve item-semantic and prefix-structure alignment for hinted tokens and GRPO to optimize the sampled suffix. Experiments on sequential recommendation benchmarks show that HCGRec substantially improves over supervised fine-tuning and vanilla reward-based post-training, while reducing zero-advantage training samples from over 70% to below 20%. The code is accessible at https://github.com/WncFht/GRec.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Hint-Conditioned Generative Recommendation (HCGRec)，一种语义 ID 生成式推荐框架，针对奖励后训练中早期语义 token 进入错误分支导致 rollout 组获得相同零奖励、无法产生有用优势的问题。HCGRec 通过 checkpoint rollouts 诊断困难实例，仅在生成器无法到达正确项时提供最小目标前缀提示，并引入提示感知信用分解：对提示 token 用监督学习保持语义对齐，对未提示后缀用 GRPO 优化。实验表明该方法在顺序推荐基准上显著优于监督微调和朴素奖励后训练，并将零优势训练样本从超过 70% 降至 20% 以下。
Motivation: 语义 ID 生成式推荐将物品表示为离散语义 token 序列，并以自回归生成方式预测下一物品，但奖励后训练存在结构化优化瓶颈：早期 token 一旦进入错误分支，有限 rollout 很少到达真实物品，组相对优化只能得到相同的零奖励，从而无法产生有效学习信号。
Method: HCGRec 提出提示条件生成机制：用当前模型的 checkpoint rollouts 诊断每个训练实例，仅当生成器无法到达正确物品时，才提供最小长度的目标前缀提示；模型在该提示分支下生成未提示的后缀。同时引入提示感知信用分解，对提示 token 使用监督学习以保留物品语义与前缀结构对齐，对未提示后缀使用 GRPO 优化采样动作。
Result: 在顺序推荐基准上，HCGRec 相比监督微调和 vanilla 奖励后训练有显著提升，并将零优势训练样本比例从 70% 以上降低到 20% 以下。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过为困难实例提供目标前缀提示并分解提示与生成 token 的优化目标，可以有效恢复语义 ID 生成式推荐在奖励后训练中的学习信号，且代码已公开。

papers.title: Retry, Switch, or Abstain? Learning Strategy-Aware Tool-Use Policies via Controlled Error Injection
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using LLM agents are commonly trained and evaluated in environments where tool calls succeed reliably, yet deployed tools can fail transiently, persistently, or silently. Robust recovery therefore requires more than repeated retries: an agent may need to retry the same path, switch to an alternative, or recognize that no viable path remains. We present BENCH2ROBUST, a framework that converts failure-free tool-use benchmarks into controlled stochastic environments with scenario-controlled solvability, where episodes explicitly require retrying, switching, or stopping after available paths are exhausted. We use BENCH2ROBUST to study two complementary interventions: structured runtime recovery context through Bayesian Tool Memory (BTM), and curriculum-controlled reinforcement learning. Across 7 models from 4 families and two multi-turn benchmark families, tool failures produce a near-universal robustness gap. On held-out Retail tasks, BTM improves robustness by up to 16.8 percentage points without retraining, while RL learns complementary recovery behavior that remains beneficial without inference-time BTM. Combining the two reaches 40.8-45.5% under injection while preserving failure-free performance. These results suggest that robust tool use benefits from combining environment-specific recovery knowledge with learned recovery behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BENCH2ROBUST 框架，将无故障的工具使用基准转换为可由场景控制可解性的随机环境，使 episodes 明确需要重试、切换或放弃。作者用该框架研究两种互补干预：贝叶斯工具记忆 (BTM) 提供的结构化解耦恢复上下文，以及课程式强化学习；在 7 个模型、4 个模型家族和两类多轮基准上验证。摘要报告工具失败会造成普遍存在的鲁棒性缺口，BTM 在无需重训的情况下最多提升 16.8 个百分点，结合 RL 后达到 40.8–45.5% 的鲁棒性提升且不损伤无故障性能。
Motivation: 工具型 LLM agent 通常在工具调用可靠的环境中被训练和评估，但部署环境中工具可能瞬时、持续或静默地失败；仅靠重复重试不足以稳健恢复，可能还需要切换到备选路径或识别无剩余可行路径。
Method: 提出 BENCH2ROBUST 框架：将无故障工具基准改造为受控随机环境，设定场景级可解性以显式要求重试、切换或停止；同时研究两种干预措施，即贝叶斯工具记忆 (Bayesian Tool Memory, BTM) 提供的运行时恢复上下文，以及课程控制的强化学习 (curriculum-controlled RL)。
Result: 跨 7 个模型、4 个模型家族和两类多轮基准，工具失败导致近乎普遍的鲁棒性缺口；在保留的 Retail 任务上，BTM 无需重训即可将鲁棒性最高提升 16.8 个百分点，RL 学到无 BTM 推理时仍然有益的互补恢复行为，二者结合在注入失败下达到 40.8–45.5% 的鲁棒性同时保持无故障性能。
Conclusion: 稳健的工具使用可能需要结合环境特定的恢复知识与学习到的恢复行为；论文强调两种干预是互补的，但未讨论除 Retail 外的其他保留任务表现或长期部署中的限制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TESLA: Taylor Expansion of Sinusoidal Learnable Activations
papers.abstract_en: The parity problem--deciding whether the number of ones in a binary vector is odd or even--remains challenging for standard neural networks due to linear inseparability and the need for global interactions. We propose TESLA, an activation defined as a learnable combination of sine and cosine terms, enabling explicit control over polynomial degree and selective amplification of high-order components. Theoretically, we show that constraining TESLA's coefficients yields Lipschitz/Rademacher complexity bounds and shapes the training dynamics to emphasize higher-frequency structure. Empirically, on parity with input length n = 32, TESLA attains strong generalization with 100K training samples (approximately 0.002% of the 2^32 input space) and remains robust under heavy corruption, retaining high accuracy with up to 30% label noise. We also compare against periodic and frequency-based baselines (SIREN, SNAKE, and Fourier feature embeddings) on parity and Forrelation. Beyond synthetic structure, TESLA delivers comparable performance on ImageNet-100, indicating that activation-level degree control transfers to more general vision workloads. Code: https://github.com/KAU-QuantumAILab/TESLA
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 29th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Statistics (AISTATS 2026), PMLR 300, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TESLA，一种由可学习正弦和余弦项组合定义的激活函数，用于解决神经网络中因线性不可分和全局交互需求而困难的奇偶校验 (parity) 问题。理论部分说明约束 TESLA 系数可得到 Lipschitz/Rademacher 复杂度界，并塑造训练动态以强调高频结构；实验部分在输入长度 n=32 的 parity 任务上以 10 万训练样本（约 2^32 空间的 0.002%）获得强泛化，且在 30% 标签噪声下保持高准确率，并与 SIREN、SNAKE 和 Fourier feature embeddings 等基线比较，在 ImageNet-100 上表现相当。
Motivation: 标准神经网络难以解决奇偶校验问题，原因在于该问题线性不可分且需要全局交互；现有激活函数对多项式次数和高阶分量的控制不足。
Method: 提出 TESLA 激活函数，即正弦与余弦项的可学习组合，允许显式控制多项式次数并选择性放大高阶分量；理论上通过对 TESLA 系数施加约束来推导复杂度界并调控训练动力学。
Result: 在 n=32 的 parity 任务上，TESLA 以 10 万训练样本（约输入空间的 0.002%）实现强泛化，并在高达 30% 标签噪声下保持高准确率；在 parity 和 Forrelation 上与 SIREN、SNAKE、Fourier feature embeddings 对比，在 ImageNet-100 上取得相当性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调激活层面的多项式次数控制能够迁移到更通用的视觉任务，并指出该方法的理论复杂度保证；代码已开源。
