papers.title: Towards Understanding On-Policy Distillation through the Lens of Test-Time Scaling
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as a promising post-training technique for enhancing LLM reasoning. It is commonly believed to enable the student model to distill knowledge from a stronger teacher model, thereby expanding capabilities beyond the pre-OPD base model. In this study, we examine this view through the lens of test-time scaling by varying the sampling budget K and evaluating performance with pass@K and avg@K. Specifically, across several OPD variants, we observe that OPD-trained models maintain superior avg@K performance across sampling budgets, while the advantage in pass@K gradually shifts to the pre-OPD base models as K increases. These results suggest that OPD primarily improves sampling efficiency rather than consistently expanding the student's reasoning capability boundary. The pass@K dynamics throughout OPD training further reveal a progressive shift toward stronger small-K performance at the expense of the large-K capability boundary. Furthermore, a problem-level solvability analysis using pass@1024 as the criterion reveals an asymmetry: OPD causes more previously solvable problems to become unsolvable than previously unsolvable problems to become solvable. Together, these findings suggest that, from the perspective of capability expansion, OPD behaves more like an "illusory distillation": its apparent gains arise primarily from improved sampling efficiency rather than from acquiring genuinely new reasoning capabilities from the teacher.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从测试时扩展 (test-time scaling) 的视角重新审视 on-policy distillation (OPD) 对 LLM 推理的作用。作者通过改变采样预算 K 并用 pass@K 与 avg@K 评估多种 OPD 变体，发现 OPD 模型在不同 K 下保持 avg@K 优势，但 pass@K 优势随 K 增大逐渐转移到未经过 OPD 的基础模型。进一步的问题级可解性分析显示，OPD 使更多原本可解的问题变得不可解，作者据此提出 OPD 更像是一种“幻觉式蒸馏”(illusory distillation)，其表观收益主要来自采样效率提升而非真正的能力边界扩展。
Motivation: OPD 被视为提升 LLM 推理能力的有效后训练技术，通常被认为能让学生模型从更强的教师模型中蒸馏知识，从而扩展超越基础模型的能力。本文质疑这一观点，希望通过测试时扩展的框架检验 OPD 是否真正扩展了推理能力边界，还是仅改善了采样效率。
Method: 作者在多个 OPD 变体上变化采样预算 K，以 pass@K 和 avg@K 评估模型性能，并利用 pass@1024 作为问题级可解性的判定标准，分析训练过程中 pass@K 的动态变化以及问题由不可解变为可解或相反方向的转移。
Result: OPD 训练出的模型在所有采样预算下保持 avg@K 优势，但 pass@K 优势随 K 增大逐渐转向基础模型；训练过程中的 pass@K 动态显示模型向更强的小 K 性能转移，但以大 K 能力边界下降为代价。问题级分析表明，OPD 使更多原本可解的问题变得不可解，而不是使更多原本不可解的问题变得可解。
Conclusion: 作者认为从能力扩展的角度看，OPD 的表现更像“幻觉式蒸馏”：其表观收益主要源于采样效率提升，而非从教师模型获得真正的新推理能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Located but Not Releasable: Silent Gate Inversion and Bounded Linear Release
papers.abstract_en: A growing body of work reports that language models represent task-relevant latent structure that they fail to use. Whether such structure, once located, can be converted into behavior is a separate question that is rarely tested end to end. We submit the complete pipeline -- detect, localize, and release -- to a fully preregistered stress test on a 25.7M transformer trained on causal-evidence discrimination, where a known suppression phenomenon (latent causal structure present but behaviorally unused) has previously been documented. Every threshold, claim template, and decision-tree branch was hashed and archived before any corresponding data existed. Three findings. (i) Localization succeeds: interventions at observation-evidence channels of mid layers restore target behavior on otherwise-suppressed worlds (paired release advantages $0.563$ and $0.854$, 97.5% CIs excluding zero; best-site release rate $0.889$). (ii) Gating fails out of distribution: a detector calibrated to trigger on zero out-of-distribution calibration worlds triggers on 6.9-7.3% of held-out in-distribution generations and on zero of the 2,400 held-out generations that actually need it -- a complete inversion that silently reduces the gated pipeline to its base model. (iii) Linear release is capped: removing the gate and injecting a per-instance linear direction unconditionally yields a monotone dose-response that plateaus far below the preregistered release margin (intercept $0.382 \to 0.311 \to 0.264$ vs. threshold $\le 0.08$); per-instance adaptivity adds less than $\pm 0.03$. The failure is doubly located: the detector is OOD-inverted, and the entire family of linear release directions at this site and resolution is bounded away from sufficiency. The two failures are dissociable, and neither overturns localization. Every number traces to a hashed artifact in the released audit chain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对一个25.7M transformer在因果证据判别任务上的完整"检测-定位-释放"流程进行了预注册压力测试。结果显示定位成功（干预中间层观测证据通道可恢复目标行为），但门控检测器在分布外完全反转（基准确认零触发却在真正需要时零触发），且线性释放方向被系统性地限制在充分性以下。作者强调两种失败是可分离的，且均不推翻定位本身的有效性。
Motivation: 已有工作报告语言模型内部存在任务相关的潜在结构但行为上未使用，而"定位到的结构能否转化为行为"这一端到端问题很少被系统测试。
Method: 将检测、定位、释放的完整流程提交给全预注册压力测试，所有阈值、声明模板和决策树分支在数据产生前哈希归档；训练因果证据判别模型，通过干预中间层观测证据通道来释放被抑制的行为，并校准检测器与线性注入方向。
Result: 定位成功：配对释放优势分别为0.563和0.854（97.5% CI排除零），最佳位点释放率0.889；门控在分布外完全失败：校准为零OOD触发后，却在6.9-7.3%的分布内生成上触发，而对2400个实际需要释放的held-out生成触发率为零，门控管线静默退化为基座模型；无门控的逐实例线性注入呈单调剂量反应并远低于预注册释放边际（截距0.382→0.311→0.264，阈值≤0.08），逐实例自适应增益小于±0.03。
Conclusion: 摘要指出失败是双重定位的：检测器呈OOD反转，且该位点与分辨率下整个线性释放方向族都达不到充分性；两种失败可分离，且都不推翻定位结果，所有数字可追溯到审计链中的哈希工件。

papers.title: TD-VAD: Breaking Visual Dependence in Video Anomaly Detection with Text-Driven Learning
papers.abstract_en: Visual data is typically a prerequisite for training existing video anomaly detection (VAD) methods. However, obtaining sufficient annotated anomaly data for training is challenging and not scalable due to the rarity of anomaly data and the wide variety of abnormal events. In this work, we advocate that the effectiveness of treating texts as video sequences for the VAD model and propose a novel Text-Driven Video Anomaly Detection (TD-VAD) approach to break visual dependence. In contrast to the anomaly video data, text descriptions of abnormal events are easy to collect, and their class labels can be directly derived. Specifically, our method utilizes video-like text descriptions with temporal characteristics generated by LLM to train a VAD model, without any reliance on target-domain anomaly data. To capture the long- and short-range temporal logic of events, we design the event evolution causal attention module to model contextual dependencies across time. During inference, considering the domain gap between the texts and video sequences, we use the frozen CLIP encoder to extract embeddings of video frames to align the text modality while retaining crucial visual information. Comprehensive experiments on two large-scale VAD datasets, XD-Violence and UCF-Crime, demonstrate that our method outperforms prior one-class and unsupervised VAD methods by a large margin.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种文本驱动的视频异常检测方法TD-VAD，利用LLM生成的具有时间特征的类视频文本描述来训练VAD模型，从而摆脱对目标域异常视频数据的依赖。方法引入事件演化因果注意力模块以建模跨时间的上下文依赖，并在推理时使用冻结的CLIP编码器对齐视频帧嵌入与文本模态。在XD-Violence和UCF-Crime两个大规模VAD基准上，该方法大幅优于此前的一类和无监督VAD方法。
Motivation: 现有VAD方法通常依赖标注的异常视频数据进行训练，但异常数据稀缺且事件类型多样，难以规模化收集。相比之下，异常事件的文本描述易于获取且类别标签可直接得到，因此作者尝试用文本替代视觉数据来训练VAD模型。
Method: 提出TD-VAD方法，使用LLM生成带有时间结构的文本序列作为训练数据，不依赖目标域异常视频；设计事件演化因果注意力模块捕捉事件的长短期时间逻辑；推理时用冻结的CLIP编码器提取视频帧嵌入，以对齐文本模态并保留关键视觉信息。
Result: 在XD-Violence和UCF-Crime两个大规模数据集上的综合实验表明，该方法比此前的一类和无监督VAD方法有明显更优的性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为文本驱动训练可以打破VAD对视觉数据的依赖，为缺乏异常视频标注的场景提供了一种可行方案；摘要未明确讨论该方法的局限性。

papers.title: How China-Origin Vision-Language Models Move from Refusal to Reframing in State Alignment
papers.abstract_en: State-aligned distortion has been documented in China-origin text-based large language models (LLMs), but whether, and in what form, it arises in multimodal systems has not been systematically examined. We construct a balanced benchmark of 200 core entries spanning ten politically sensitive topics, plus a seven-variant visual-abstraction probe, and run nine vision-language models (VLMs), seven China-origin and two non-China, across four elicitation paradigms and two prompt languages, yielding 21,708 trials. Each response is audited on six dimensions -- explicit refusal, information integrity, visual grounding, state-aligned framing, language consistency, and response length -- by two independent frontier LLM judges, validated against three human experts on a 200-trial sample. Measuring each dimension separately lets us decompose multimodal censorship into individual signals rather than a single refusal-based score; in particular, refusal and framing are measured independently, so a model can stop refusing while still reframing. We find that (i) Chinese-language prompting roughly triples the odds of state-aligned framing, within every model; (ii) China-origin models reframe more than non-China models (direction robust across judges and human raters; magnitude 1.6--3.2x); (iii) the effect is strongest in text-only political commentary (36.5%) and is gated by recognition of the depicted subject rather than pixel detail, persisting even at silhouette for iconic images; and (iv) across four Qwen generations, state-aligned framing rises while explicit refusal falls: censorship migrates from a visible act (refusal) to an invisible one (fluent reframing). We argue this shift to invisible reframing is fundamentally a problem of human-AI interaction: it removes the very signal users rely on to recognize that information has been withheld.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统考察中国来源的视觉语言模型（VLM）中是否存在国家对齐的扭曲（state-aligned distortion），构建了包含200个核心条目和七种视觉抽象变体的平衡基准，在九个VLM（七个中国来源、两个非中国）上使用四种诱导范式和两种提示语言运行，共产生21,708次试验。作者独立测量六个维度（明确拒绝、信息完整性、视觉接地、国家对齐框架、语言一致性、响应长度），发现中文提示使国家对齐框架的几率大约增加两倍，中国来源模型比非中国模型更倾向重构（幅度1.6–3.2倍），且在四代Qwen中明确拒绝下降而国家对齐框架上升，审查从可见的拒绝迁移为流畅的重构。
Motivation: 已有研究记载了中文文本大语言模型中的国家对齐扭曲，但多模态系统是否以及以何种形式出现这种扭曲尚未被系统检验。作者认为此前基于单一拒绝分数的度量无法刻画审查的多面性，因此需要将多模态审查分解为独立信号，尤其要独立测量拒绝与框架重构。
Method: 构建一个平衡基准，包含200个覆盖十个政治敏感话题的核心条目，加上七变体视觉抽象探针；使用四种诱导范式、两种提示语言，对九个VLM（七个中国来源、两个非中国）进行测试，共21,708次试验。每个响应由两个独立的前沿LLM裁判在六个维度上审计，并在200条样本上对照三位人类专家进行验证。
Result: 摘要报告：中文提示使国家对齐框架的几率约增加两倍（在每个模型内部均成立）；中国来源模型比非中国模型更频繁地重构（方向稳健，幅度1.6–3.2倍）；效果在纯文本政治评论中最强（36.5%），且由识别所描绘主体而非像素细节门控，即使在轮廓图中也持续存在；在四代Qwen中，国家对齐框架上升而明确拒绝下降。
Conclusion: 作者认为，这种向不可见重构的转变本质上是一个人机交互问题：它移除了用户赖以识别信息被扣留的信号。该工作强调拒绝与框架重构应被独立测量，并将多模态审查分解为多个可审计维度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning with Bilevel-Minimax Optimization for Efficient and Reliable Transfer Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Transfer-based adversarial attacks craft adversarial examples using surrogate models to mislead black-box victim models. Beyond perturbation generation, transferability is fundamentally governed by the coupling of initialization, surrogate adaptation, and gradient dynamics. We revisit this challenge from a bilevel-minimax perspective and propose BMAT (Bilevel-Minimax Adversarial Transfer). The bilevel formulation captures the dependency between initialization and perturbation, while the inner minimax problem promotes surrogate robustness for cross-architecture generalization. Algorithmically, we develop an integrated bottom-up solver that combines a Soft Weight Modulator and an Implicit Gradient Approximator to enable ternary coupling among initialization, surrogate adaptation, and perturbation optimization. We further provide theoretical insights into the optimization dynamics of the proposed bilevel-minimax framework. Extensive experiments on classification and segmentation benchmarks show that BMAT outperforms more than 10 strong baselines across more than 30 victim models, improving both intra- and cross-architecture transfer and yielding up to a 2x reduction in mIoU. Code is available at https://github.com/callous-youth/BMAT.
papers.comment: Accepted by ECCV 2026. 21 pages in total. Code available at https://github.com/callous-youth/BMAT
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从双层极小极大优化 (bilevel-minimax) 视角重新审视迁移攻击，提出 BMAT (Bilevel-Minimax Adversarial Transfer) 方法，将初始化、替代模型适应与扰动优化三者联合建模。算法上结合 Soft Weight Modulator 与 Implicit Gradient Approximator 的集成自底向上求解器，并给出优化动力学理论分析。在分类与分割基准上，BMAT 在超过 30 个受害者模型上优于 10 余个强基线，改善跨架构迁移性，最高可将 mIoU 降低 2 倍。
Motivation: 迁移性不仅取决于扰动生成，还受初始化、替代模型适应和梯度动力学的耦合影响；现有方法缺少对这一三元耦合关系的统一建模。
Method: 提出双层极小极大优化框架：外层双层结构刻画初始化与扰动之间的依赖，内层极小极大问题提升替代模型的跨架构鲁棒性；并用 Soft Weight Modulator 和 Implicit Gradient Approximator 构成集成求解器，实现初始化、替代模型适应与扰动优化的三元联合。
Result: 在分类和分割基准上，BMAT 在超过 30 个受害者模型上胜过 10 余个强基线，同时改善架构内与跨架构迁移性，分割任务上最多将 mIoU 降低 2 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调双层极小极大框架能有效耦合初始化、替代模型适应与扰动优化，为高效可靠的迁移攻击提供新的优化视角。

papers.title: Can Vision Models Read the Radar Display? On the Feasibility of Radar Imagery for Air Traffic Complexity Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Air traffic controllers perceive traffic complexity through the radar display, suggesting that a computer vision model operating on the same imagery may provide a natural architecture for modeling controller-perceived complexity; however, whether radar imagery is a viable input format for deep learning vision models remains unclear. Unlike natural images, radar images are extremely sparse and self-similar, consisting primarily of a black background and a few visually identical aircraft blobs, while small changes in aircraft positions can substantially alter sector-level complexity. To test whether a vision model can capture these operationally important differences, we encode each traffic situation as a position image supplemented by five channels representing aircraft state variables, including heading, speed, and altitude, and train a Vision Transformer (ViT) to regress four intrinsic complexity components derived from pairwise geometric relations among aircraft. The model achieves $R^2 > 0.96$ for all four components, and a one-aircraft-removal perturbation study shows that its response changes proportionally to how much the removed aircraft contributed to sector complexity rather than treating every removal as equivalent. These results demonstrate that, despite its atypical visual characteristics, radar imagery is a viable input format for air traffic complexity modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究雷达显示画面能否作为视觉模型的输入来估计空中交通复杂度。作者将每个交通态势编码为位置图像并补充五个表示飞机状态变量的通道（如航向、速度、高度），训练 Vision Transformer (ViT) 回归由飞机两两几何关系导出的四个内在复杂度分量；模型对所有四个分量均取得 R²>0.96，且单机移除扰动研究表明模型响应按被移除飞机对扇区复杂度的贡献比例变化。结论认为尽管雷达图像视觉特征不典型，仍是空中交通复杂度建模的可行输入格式。
Motivation: 空中交通管制员通过雷达显示感知交通复杂度，因此直接用同一图像训练的视觉模型可能是建模管制员感知的自然架构；但雷达图像与自然图像差异很大，极其稀疏且自相似，主要由黑色背景和少量外观相同的飞机光点组成，飞机位置的微小变化却会大幅改变扇区级复杂度，雷达图像是否适合深度学习视觉模型尚不清楚。
Method: 将每个交通态势编码为一张位置图像，并以五个额外通道补充飞机状态变量（如航向、速度、高度），训练 Vision Transformer (ViT) 来回归从飞机两两几何关系中导出的四个内在复杂度分量。

Conclusion: 摘要强调，尽管雷达图像具有非典型的视觉特征，实验结果表明雷达图像仍是空中交通复杂度建模的可行输入格式。

papers.title: CoDiR: Confidence-Guided Diffusion Refinement for Semi-Supervised Histopathology Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Semi-supervised histopathology segmentation is challenging due to scarce annotations and unreliable pseudo-labels in ambiguous gland regions. To address this problem, we propose Confidence-Guided Diffusion Refinement (CoDiR), a semi-supervised framework that combines a Mean Teacher segmentation model with diffusion-based pseudo-label refinement. Given an unlabeled image, the teacher first produces a soft prediction, and only low-confidence regions are refined by a conditional diffusion model trained to capture plausible mask structures from labeled data. The refined mask is then fused with reliable teacher predictions and used to train the student with confidence weighting and consistency regularization. On the GlaS and CRAG datasets CoDiR reaches 88.09\% and 89.83\% mDice with 10\% labeled data, and 89.19\% and 90.29\% mDice with 20\%, matching or exceeding the strongest published method on seven of the eight benchmark metrics. Ablations attribute the largest single contribution to the refinement module, which adds +6.36\% mDice over the Mean Teacher baseline. The implementation code is publicly available at: https://github.com/vongla345/codir
papers.comment: Accepted to the MICCAI COMPAYL Workshop 2026 (11 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Confidence-Guided Diffusion Refinement (CoDiR)，一种用于半监督组织病理学图像分割的框架，结合 Mean Teacher 分割模型与基于扩散模型的伪标签细化。教师网络对未标注图像生成软预测，仅对低置信度区域用条件扩散模型细化，再与高置信度教师预测融合，用于训练学生网络。在 GlaS 和 CRAG 数据集上，10% 标注数据下达到 88.09% 和 89.83% mDice，20% 下达到 89.19% 和 90.29%，在八个基准指标中的七个上匹配或超过最强已有方法，消融显示细化模块贡献最大，较 Mean Teacher 基线提升 +6.36% mDice。
Motivation: 半监督组织病理学分割因标注稀缺且腺体区域模糊导致伪标签不可靠而具有挑战性，现有方法难以在低标注比例下获得稳健分割。
Method: 提出 CoDiR 框架：Mean Teacher 教师网络生成软预测，仅对低置信度区域调用基于条件扩散模型的细化模块，以学习标注数据中合理的掩膜结构；细化结果与可靠的教师预测融合，并用置信度加权和一致性正则化训练学生网络。
Result: 在 GlaS 和 CRAG 数据集上，10% 标注数据下 mDice 分别为 88.09% 和 89.83%，20% 下为 89.19% 和 90.29%；在八项基准指标中的七项上匹配或超过最强已有方法；消融实验表明细化模块贡献最大，较 Mean Teacher 基线提升 +6.36% mDice。
Conclusion: 摘要强调置信度引导的扩散细化能够有效增强半监督组织病理学分割中的伪标签质量，代码已公开。

papers.title: Towards Model-based Run-time Cybersecurity: On Control-Flow Anomaly Detection, Attack Identification, and Hardware Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Methods to increase the resilience of systems to cyber-attacks become increasingly important. Control-flow monitoring provides a principled basis to ensure integrity and detect possible anomalies at run-time. Once anomalies have been detected, so-called attack trees can be used to identify possible types of attacks. However, this approach is vulnerable to camouflage, by which attackers try to evade detection (and correct identification) by deliberately manipulating also the system's observed control flow. In this paper, we outline a model-based approach that provides more robust intrusion detection and attack identification through an architecture that combines software- with hardware-based monitoring. In this approach, software-level observation indicates suspicious activities, while hardware-level monitoring checks them separately in more detail, making it much harder for attacks to camouflage themselves and go undetected. We illustrate the approach with an authentication-service example that captures a realistic failure mode: a software-level observer sees an anomalous but apparently harmless control-flow deviation, maps it to a benign root cause in an attack tree, but misses the true intrusion. A second, independent hardware control-flow monitor observes the actual transition sequence and thereby changes the attack-tree diagnosis from a low-severity configuration or maintenance issue to a high-confidence code-injection or control-flow hijack. In this scenario, the proposed combination of control-flow anomaly detection, attack-tree based intrusion identification, and hardware-based monitoring can improve not only anomaly detection, but also the diagnostic precision of attack-tree-based cyber-attack identification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于模型 (model-based) 的运行时网络安全方法，将控制流异常检测、基于攻击树 (attack tree) 的入侵识别与硬件监控结合，以应对攻击者通过操纵控制流进行伪装 (camouflage) 从而逃避检测的问题。作者用一个认证服务示例说明，仅靠软件级观察会把异常误判为良性根因，而独立的硬件控制流监控能把诊断从低严重性的配置/维护问题改为高置信度的代码注入或控制流劫持。摘要认为该组合不仅能改进异常检测，还能提升攻击树诊断精度。
Motivation: 现有控制流监控易受伪装攻击影响：攻击者可刻意操纵系统被观察到的控制流，以逃避检测并误导攻击树对攻击类型的识别。需要更鲁棒的入侵检测与识别架构。
Method: 提出将软件级与硬件级监控相结合的模型化架构：软件级观察先标记可疑活动，再由硬件级监控独立、更细致地检查，使攻击难以伪装；异常检测后利用攻击树进行攻击类型识别。
Result: 在认证服务示例中，软件观察者把异常但不明显的控制流偏差映射为攻击树中的良性根因，漏掉真实入侵；而第二个独立的硬件控制流监控观察到实际转移序列，将诊断从低严重性的配置或维护问题转变为高置信度的代码注入或控制流劫持。摘要称该组合可同时改进异常检测与攻击树诊断精度。
Conclusion: 作者认为结合控制流异常检测、基于攻击树的入侵识别和硬件监控，能显著提升攻击识别诊断精度；该结论基于一个认证服务示例的阐述。

papers.title: JAPE: Joint Anomaly Prediction and Intrinsic Explanation in Multivariate Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Multivariate time-series anomaly prediction aims to identify whether and when anomalies will occur over a future horizon from historical observations. Existing methods primarily characterize anomalies as deviations in future numerical values, which may overlook subtle dependency changes induced by weak anomaly precursors and provide no native variable-level explanation together with the alert. To bridge these gaps, we propose JAPE, a Joint Anomaly Prediction and Explanation framework that lifts anomaly prediction from numerical-deviation modeling to dependency-structure modeling. JAPE is the first anomaly prediction framework to explicitly model evolving dependency structures for both point-wise alerting and native variable-level explanation. Specifically, JAPE (i) proposes a Decoupled Spatio-Temporal Representation (DSTR) backbone that decouples temporal and spatial modeling and captures lag-aware dependencies via learnable lag aggregation, thereby perceiving structural precursors before numerical deviations emerge; (ii) designs a dual-view alerting mechanism that fuses numerical forecasts with evolving dependency graphs for point-wise anomaly prediction, capturing structural evidence even under subtle numerical deviations; and (iii) presents Native Predictive Explanation (NPE), which directly reuses the predicted dependency graphs to rank variables by structural deviations without additional models or training. Extensive experiments on five real-world benchmarks across three prediction horizons demonstrate that JAPE improves average F1 and AUC-PR by 19.7% and 41.3%, respectively, while improving explainability with 26.6% gain in MRR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 JAPE，一个面向多元时间序列的联合异常预测与解释框架，将异常预测从数值偏差建模提升为依赖结构建模。JAPE 显式建模演化的依赖结构，用于逐点告警和原生变量级解释；在五个真实基准、三个预测时域上的实验显示平均 F1 提升 19.7%、AUC-PR 提升 41.3%、可解释性 MRR 提升 26.6%。
Motivation: 现有多元时间序列异常预测方法主要把异常刻画为未来数值的偏差，容易忽略弱异常前兆引发的细微依赖变化，并且无法随告警原生存活变量级解释。
Method: JAPE 包含三个部分：解耦时空表示（DSTR）主干通过可学习的滞后聚合捕获带滞后依赖的结构前兆；双视角告警机制融合数值预测与演化的依赖图进行逐点异常预测；原生预测解释（NPE）直接复用预测的依赖图按结构偏差对变量排序，无需额外模型或训练。
Result: 在五个真实基准和三个预测时域上，JAPE 平均 F1 提升 19.7%、AUC-PR 提升 41.3%，可解释性 MRR 提升 26.6%。
Conclusion: 作者称 JAPE 是首个在异常预测框架中显式建模演化依赖结构、同时支持逐点告警和原生变量级解释的方法，将异常预测从数值偏差建模转向依赖结构建模。

papers.title: Orientation, not magnitude: the causal structure of task-vector interference in merged language models
papers.abstract_en: Model merging by task arithmetic works until it doesn't, and the field diagnoses why with magnitudes: layerwise representation bias, deviations from cross-task linearity, parameter overlap. Tracking the exact layerwise cross-term of merged LLMs through a factorial ledger and intervening on it directly, we find magnitude insufficient - and inconsistent across model families - as a diagnostic axis. An exact decomposition of the layerwise flux shows it is dominated by amplifying transport of the existing cross-term (~65-70% in both families, gain >1 per late block), and erasing the term is undone by propagation - rebuilt to 99% of its norm at cosine 0.99 - unless applied near the output; a basin test with six starting displacements establishes the carried direction as an attractor of the forward pass. That direction is causally load-bearing: erasure along it removes expressed interference dose-dependently and saturates at exact erasure, while norm-matched wrong-direction controls fail or backfire. Instruction wrappers gate the effect: the same erasure finds 13x less relative interference to remove under a wrapper that internally amplifies the cross-term, because the wrapper drowns the interaction in a template-pinned main effect rather than shrinking it - a structure that replicates across further instruction templates but not under a length-matched control. Magnitude, by contrast, is at best a coarse correlate, and the striking +-15% "universality" of naive bfloat16 generation turns out to be quantization roughness. Task pairs whose local cross-term generation differs by at most 1.9x differ by 14x-337x in causally removable interference. All 46 predictions were preregistered and frozen before their data; falsifications, including of our own headline expectations and of behavioral recovery under a validated continuous endpoint, are reported as such.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过分解合并语言模型（merged LLMs）逐层交叉项（cross-term）的因果结构，指出任务向量（task vector）干扰的因果主轴是方向（orientation）而非幅度（magnitude）。作者用因子式台账（factorial ledger）追踪并直接干预逐层交叉项，发现该交叉项主要被放大输运（约65–70%），且擦除会被前向传播重建；沿承载方向的擦除按剂量去除干扰，而范数匹配的错误方向对照失败或适得其反。所有46项预测均为预注册，并如实报告了包括对自身预期在内的证伪结果。
Motivation: 领域通常用幅度类指标（逐层表示偏差、跨任务线性偏差、参数重叠）诊断模型合并何时失效，但这些诊断在不同模型家族间不一致且不充分。作者想厘清任务向量干扰的因果结构，而不是停留在相关诊断。
Method: 提出一种精确的逐层通量分解，通过因子式台账对合并模型逐层交叉项进行追踪，并直接对其施加干预（如在特定层擦除交叉项）。还设计了盆地测试（basin test，六个起始位移）来检验前向传播的吸引子性质，并比较沿承载方向的擦除与范数匹配的错误方向对照。
Result: 摘要报告：放大输运主导交叉项（两个家族均约65–70%，晚层增益>1）；除非在靠近输出处擦除，否则擦除后交叉项会被重建到其范数的99%（余弦0.99）；沿承载方向擦除以剂量依赖方式去除表达出来的干扰并在完全擦除时饱和，范数匹配的错误方向对照失败或适得其反；指令包装（instruction wrapper）会使相对可去除干扰减少13倍；±15%的“普适性”实为量化粗糙；局部交叉项生成差异至多1.9倍的任务对在可因果移除干扰上相差14–337倍。
Conclusion: 作者强调干扰的方向是因果上承重的（causally load-bearing），幅度至多只是粗略相关；指令包装不是缩小交叉项而是以固定模板主效应淹没交互。46项预测全部预注册并冻结，附录如实报告了证伪结果，包括行为恢复的验证性终点失败。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文通过分解合并语言模型（merged LLMs）逐层交叉项（cross-term）的因果结构，指出任务向量（task vector）干扰的因果主轴是方向（orientation）而非幅度（magnitude）。作者用因子式台账（factorial ledger）追踪并直接干预逐层交叉项，发现该交叉项主要被放大输运（约65–70%），且擦除会被前向传播重建；沿承载方向的擦除按剂量去除干扰，而范数匹配的错误方向对照失败或适得其反。所有46项预测均为预注册，并如实报告了包括对自身预期在内的证伪结果。
summary_sections.motivation: 领域通常用幅度类指标（逐层表示偏差、跨任务线性偏差、参数重叠）诊断模型合并何时失效，但这些诊断在不同模型家族间不一致且不充分。作者想厘清任务向量干扰的因果结构，而不是停留在相关诊断。
summary_sections.method: 提出一种精确的逐层通量分解，通过因子式台账对合并模型逐层交叉项进行追踪，并直接对其施加干预（如在特定层擦除交叉项）。还设计了盆地测试（basin test，六个起始位移）来检验前向传播的吸引子性质，并比较沿承载方向的擦除与范数匹配的错误方向对照。

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调干扰的方向是因果上承重的（causally load-bearing），幅度至多只是粗略相关；指令包装不是缩小交叉项而是以固定模板主效应淹没交互。46项预测全部预注册并冻结，附录如实报告了证伪结果，包括行为恢复的验证性终点失败。

papers.title: Toward Meaningful Transparency for AI Chatbots: Disclosing Persuasive Intent Reduces Persuasion
papers.abstract_en: The growing role of AI-generated content and AI-enabled systems in public communication has led regulators to demand clear disclosure of content provenance and AI involvement. But the effects of such disclosures remain uncertain. We test two disclosure approaches in their impact on an AI chatbot's persuasive appeal. In a preregistered experiment, 1,500 UK adults held a short conversation with a persuasive chatbot about one of 60 policy issues. The chatbot was identical for everyone. We randomized the disclosure that people received: nothing (control), a prominent disclosure that they were interacting with an AI (T1), or that disclosure plus the chatbot's persuasive intent and instructions (T2). The chatbot shifted attitudes by 12.6 points on a 100-point scale in the control group. The AI-identity disclosure was practically equivalent to no disclosure, with a 13.1-point shift, whereas the additional intent disclosure cut the persuasive effect roughly in half to 6.3 points. It also made participants view the campaign's methods as less acceptable and support stronger penalties against it. For direct chatbot interactions, transparency about AI identity alone does not meaningfully impact its influence. While current rules emphasize what a system is, our results show why the regulation of persuasive AI must also address what the system is trying to do.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过一项预注册实验（1,500名英国成年人，60个政策议题）检验AI聊天机器人披露方式对其说服效果的影响。实验使用完全相同的说服型聊天机器人，随机分配三种条件：不披露、披露AI身份、披露AI身份外加说服意图。结果显示，仅披露AI身份几乎不改变说服力（态度偏移13.1点 vs 对照组的12.6点），而额外的意图披露将说服效果大致减半（6.3点），并降低参与者对相关宣传手段的接受度及对更强处罚的支持。
Motivation: 监管机构要求对AI内容来源和参与进行清晰披露，但这类披露对AI聊天机器人说服效果的实际影响尚不明确。论文针对当前规则仅强调系统是什么、而忽略系统试图做什么的缺口展开研究。
Method: 作者设计预注册实验，让参与者与一个说服型聊天机器人围绕随机选取的60个政策议题之一进行简短对话。机器人对所有参与者相同，仅随机改变参与者收到的披露信息：无披露（对照）、AI身份披露（T1）、AI身份加说服意图与指令披露（T2）。
Result: 对照组中聊天机器人使态度在100点量表上偏移12.6点；AI身份披露组偏移13.1点，几乎等价于无披露；而增加意图披露后偏移降至6.3点，约为原来的一半。意图披露还使参与者认为宣传手段更不可接受，并更支持对其实施更强处罚。
Conclusion: 对于直接聊天机器人交互，仅披露AI身份并不实质性影响其影响力。作者认为，对说服型AI的监管不仅要说明系统是什么，还必须处理系统试图做什么。

papers.title: PolarSym: Polar Geometry-aware Attention for CAD Floorplan Parsing
papers.abstract_en: CAD plan parsing is a fundamental task in Building Information Modeling (BIM), aiming to automatically extract architectural elements including walls, doors, windows, and furniture from 2D engineering drawings. Existing Transformer-based methods capture global semantic dependencies via self-attention, yet they infer spatial relationships merely from semantic features without explicitly characterizing the intrinsic geometric symmetry of building layouts. Such methods tend to produce mismatched correspondences in long-range matching and complex symmetric spatial layouts. To tackle this limitation, we propose PolarSym, a polar-coordinate geometry-aware attention framework for CAD plan parsing. The framework decouples geometric relationships of buildings into two complementary components, direction and distance, which are modeled independently. Structural consistency is strengthened by directional constraints, while long-range symmetric correspondences are built with distance constraints. A dynamic gating mechanism is adopted to synergistically fuse the two geometric information branches while maintaining the vanilla Transformer architecture. This design boosts geometric modeling capacity with negligible extra computation. Experiments on a public CAD plan parsing dataset show that PolarSym surpasses the reproduced SymPoint V2 baseline by 1.73% PQ, 1.54% RQ and 4.31% mIoU under identical training settings. PolarSym also converges faster and yields more stable optimization. Ablation experiments verify the complementary effects of direction and distance modeling. Our results reveal that PolarSym improves the geometric awareness of Transformers at low computational cost, offering an effective geometric modeling paradigm for CAD plan parsing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PolarSym，一种面向 CAD 平面图解析的极坐标几何感知注意力框架。该框架将建筑布局的几何关系解耦为方向和距离两个互补成分，分别建模以增强结构一致性，并用动态门控机制融合两个分支，同时保持原始 Transformer 架构。实验表明 PolarSym 在公共 CAD 平面图解析数据集上以极小的额外计算量超越 SymPoint V2 基线。
Motivation: 现有基于 Transformer 的 CAD 平面图解析方法通过自注意力捕获全局语义依赖，但仅从语义特征推断空间关系，未显式刻画建筑布局内在的几何对称性，导致长距离匹配和复杂对称空间布局中出现不匹配对应关系。
Method: 提出极坐标几何感知注意力框架 PolarSym，将几何关系解耦为方向和距离两个独立建模的分支；方向约束加强结构一致性，距离约束建立长距离对称对应关系，并通过动态门控机制协同融合两个几何信息分支，且保持 vanilla Transformer 架构不变。
Result: 在公共 CAD 平面图解析数据集上，相同训练设置下 PolarSym 较复现的 SymPoint V2 基线提升 1.73% PQ、1.54% RQ 和 4.31% mIoU；同时收敛更快、优化更稳定。消融实验验证了方向与距离建模的互补作用。
Conclusion: PolarSym 以低计算成本提升 Transformer 的几何感知能力，为 CAD 平面图解析提供了一种有效的几何建模范式。

papers.title: High-Order Liquid Evidence Encoding for Gradual GNSS Spoofing Detection in Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Accurate Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS)-based localization is essential for safe and reliable autonomous driving. However, spoofing attacks can manipulate vehicle position estimates. Continuous and subtle attacks are particularly difficult to detect because individual GNSS observations may remain plausible while the inconsistency between GNSS-implied displacement and onboard vehicle motion gradually increases. Existing methods often rely on static vehicle-behavior features or a single residual signal and do not explicitly model this evolution. To address this problem, we propose a causal high-order liquid evidence framework for GNSS spoofing detection. The method first constructs a physics-guided GNSS--motion inconsistency residual by comparing GNSS-implied displacement with onboard-motion-derived displacement. It then forms separate evidence streams for the residual level and its first- and second-order discrete variations, with relevant contextual cues selected according to the evidence order. Each stream is processed by a separate adaptive liquid encoder, and the resulting temporal states are hierarchically coupled to predict spoofing at the window endpoint using only current and past observations. Experiments on three subsets of the real-world AV-GPS dataset show that the proposed method achieves the highest F1-scores among the evaluated temporal models on Dataset~1 and Dataset~3, reaching 0.9535 and 0.9777, respectively. On Dataset~3, it detects both labeled normal-to-attack transitions within four sampling steps. Code and datasets are publicly available at: https://github.com/pangjunbiao/GNSS_Spoofing.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自动驾驶中逐渐发生的 GNSS 欺骗攻击检测问题，提出一种因果高阶液体证据框架。方法先用物理引导的残差刻画 GNSS 位移与车载运动位移的不一致性，再对残差层级及其一阶、二阶离散变化分别构造证据流，并用自适应液体编码器处理后分层耦合，在窗口端点仅利用当前与历史观测预测欺骗。在真实 AV-GPS 数据集的三个子集上，该方法在 Dataset 1 和 Dataset 3 上取得最高 F1，分别为 0.9535 和 0.9777，并在 Dataset 3 上于四个采样步内检测到两次正常到攻击的转换。
Motivation: 连续且隐蔽的 GNSS 欺骗攻击难以检测，因为单次 GNSS 观测仍然合理，而 GNSS 隐含位移与车载运动的偏差会逐渐增大；现有方法多依赖静态车辆行为特征或单一残差信号，未显式建模这种演化过程。
Method: 提出因果高阶液体证据框架：先构造物理引导的 GNSS–运动不一致残差，再按证据阶数为残差水平及其一阶、二阶离散变化分别建立证据流并选择相应上下文线索；每条流由独立的自适应液体编码器 (adaptive liquid encoder) 处理，时间状态被分层耦合后在窗口端点输出欺骗预测。
Result: 在 AV-GPS 数据集三个子集上的实验中，该方法在 Dataset 1 和 Dataset 3 上取得评估的时序模型中最高的 F1 分数，分别为 0.9535 和 0.9777；在 Dataset 3 上，它在四个采样步内检测到两次标注的正常到攻击转换。
Conclusion: 作者认为显式建模不一致残差的时序演化并采用高阶证据流，可以提升渐进式 GNSS 欺骗攻击的检测性能。

papers.title: Anti-Shortcut Distillation via Temporal Negative Knowledge Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge distillation (KD) trains a compact student by attracting it towards a converged teacher. It is silent about which directions the teacher itself learned to suppress: repulsive and bias-aware objectives exist, but none exploits the teacher's own trajectory to identify what the student should avoid. We observe that the missing signal is already encoded in the teacher's optimization trajectory: features that an early-stage teacher emphasizes but that a converged teacher attenuates are precisely the shortcut directions worth pushing the student away from. We instantiate this observation as \textbf{A}nti-\textbf{S}hortcut \textbf{D}istillation (ASD), a push--pull KD framework that treats the converged teacher $\Tfinal$ as a positive semantic anchor and an early-checkpoint teacher $\Tearly$ as a temporal negative reference. ASD couples two losses: a temporal contrastive loss ($\Ltc$) that places the early-teacher feature as a same-sample negative against in-batch and memory-bank final-teacher features in an InfoNCE objective; and a shortcut suppression loss ($\Lss$) that penalizes student projection onto the top eigenvectors of $\E[\Dh\Dh^{\top}]$, the uncentered second-moment matrix of early-to-final feature displacements. Across 13 teacher--student pairs on CIFAR-100, ImageNet-100, and TinyImageNet, ASD attains the highest clean top-1 accuracy on more than 10 pairs and outperforms standard KD on 12. On CIFAR-100-C corruption robustness, ASD obtains the lowest mean Corruption Error ($86.1$\,mCE) on the most challenging cross-architecture pair (WRN-40-2$\to$ShuffleNet-V2). Mechanistic diagnostics confirm the intended geometry: the ASD student is systematically anti-aligned with the shortcut direction, while its projection onto the robust subspace is substantially larger ($0.45$ vs.\ $0.12$).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Anti-Shortcut Distillation (ASD)，一种推-拉式知识蒸馏框架，利用教师优化轨迹中早期检查点与收敛教师的特征差异来识别并抑制捷径方向。ASD 将收敛教师作为正语义锚、早期检查点教师作为时间负参考，配合时间对比损失和捷径抑制损失训练学生网络。在 CIFAR-100、ImageNet-100 和 TinyImageNet 的 13 个师生对上，多数配对取得最高干净 top-1 准确率，并在损坏鲁棒性上优于标准 KD。
Motivation: 现有知识蒸馏只让学生贴近收敛教师，却未利用教师自身学会抑制的方向；作者观察到早停教师强调而收敛教师衰减的特征恰好是值得学生避免的捷径方向，这一信号已编码在教师的优化轨迹中。
Method: 提出 ASD 框架，包含两个损失：时间对比损失将早期教师特征作为同样本负样本，与批内及 memory bank 中的收敛教师特征构成 InfoNCE 目标；捷径抑制损失惩罚学生向早期到最终特征位移的无中心二阶矩矩阵特征向量方向上的投影。
Result: 在 13 个师生对中，ASD 在超过 10 对上取得最高 clean top-1 准确率，并在 12 对上优于标准 KD；在 CIFAR-100-C 上最难跨架构配对 WRN-40-2→ShuffleNet-V2 取得最低平均 Corruption Error（86.1 mCE）。机制诊断显示学生与捷径方向系统性反对齐，且向鲁棒子空间的投影显著更大（0.45 vs 0.12）。
Conclusion: 摘要表明利用教师优化轨迹中的时间负知识进行推-拉蒸馏，可以系统性地抑制捷径学习，同时改善干净准确率与损坏鲁棒性。

papers.title: TELLME: Test-Enhanced Learning for Language Model Enrichment
papers.abstract_en: Continual pre-training (CPT) has been widely adopted as a method for domain adaptation in large language models. However, CPT has consistently been accompanied by challenges, such as the difficulty of acquiring large-scale domain-specific datasets and high computational costs. In this study, we propose a novel method called Test-Enhanced Learning for Language Model Enrichment (TELLME) to alleviate these issues. TELLME leverages the TestEnhanced Learning (TEL) principle, whereby the model's training efficiency is improved using quizzes during training. It integrates this principle with CPT, thereby promoting efficient domain-specific knowledge acquisition and long-term memory retention. Experimental results demonstrate that TELLME outperforms existing methods by up to 23.6% in the financial domain and achieves a 9.8% improvement in long-term memory retention.

papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 持续预训练 (CPT) 是大型语言模型领域自适应的常用方法，但其一直面临获取大规模领域特定数据集困难以及计算成本高昂的挑战。
Method: 提出 TELLME，利用测试增强学习 (TEL) 原理，通过在训练过程中使用测验 (quizzes) 提升模型训练效率，并将其与持续预训练 (CPT) 相结合，以促进高效的领域知识获取和长期记忆保持。

papers.title: GRPO for Financial Advice Generation: Outperforming Commercial LLMs under CATE Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Generating actionable financial advice from business records demands that models integrate numerical reasoning, domain knowledge, and sound judgment, while avoiding recommendations that could harm the business. Direct supervision is difficult: historical decisions are not necessarily optimal, and high-quality free-form labels are expensive to obtain. We formulate financial advice generation as a reinforcement learning problem and fine-tune an open-weight language model using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Our reward is an LLM-as-a-judge rubric that scores each recommendation across multiple binary dimensions of advice quality, augmented with a safety gate for harm prevention. Since LLM-based evaluation alone cannot confirm whether improvements reflect genuine business value rather than adaptation to the judge, we complement it with a judge-independent audit based on a standard doubly-robust Conditional Average Treatment Effect (CATE) estimator. Under this observational off-policy audit, our trained LLM achieves approximately twice the estimated gross-profit lift of the strongest evaluated commercial baseline ($0.0228$ vs.\ $0.0104$), together with the lowest downside rate and the least negative tail risk of any policy evaluated. Notably, the two evaluations do not rank the baselines identically: the untrained base model places last on the judge rubric but second on the causal audit, indicating that the audit captures a signal the judge does not. Our results demonstrate that GRPO with a finance-grounded reward signal can produce substantially more useful business recommendations than commercial LLMs, and that a judge-independent causal audit is a valuable complement to, rather than a confirmation of, LLM-as-a-judge assessment in financial NLP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将金融建议生成建模为强化学习问题，使用 GRPO 微调开放权重语言模型，奖励函数为 LLM-as-a-judge 评分规则并附加安全门。作者引入基于双重稳健 CATE 估计的审计，结果表明训练模型在估计毛利提升上约为最强商业基线的两倍，且因果审计与评判者评分给出不一致的排名。
Motivation: 从商业记录生成可执行金融建议需要数值推理、领域知识和判断，同时要避免有害建议；直接监督困难，因为历史决策不一定最优，高质量自由文本标签又昂贵。
Method: 将金融建议生成视为强化学习问题，用 GRPO 微调开放权重模型；奖励为 LLM-as-a-judge 规则，按多个二元质量维度打分，并加入安全门；另以标准双重稳健 CATE 估计器做与评判者无关的审计。
Result: 在离策略观测审计下，训练模型估计毛利提升约为 0.0228，最强商业基线为 0.0104，约两倍；同时具有最低下行率和最小负尾部风险。未训练基础模型在评判者评分中垫底，但在因果审计中排第二，说明审计捕捉到评判者未反映的信号。
Conclusion: GRPO 配合金融接地奖励能产生比商业 LLM 更有用的商业建议；评判者独立的因果审计是 LLM-as-a-judge 评估的有价值补充，而非对其的简单确认。

papers.title: TradingMoE: Routing the Right Experts in Evolving Markets
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for financial analysis and trading, but direct trading remains challenging because the predictive capabilities required can vary across assets, decision fields, and market conditions. Existing LLM-based trading systems either coordinate human-defined external experts or adopt conventional internal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routers that do not directly evaluate how individual experts contribute to trading decisions. Moreover, these routers receive no direct signal indicating when an inactive expert has become more suitable as market conditions change. We find that native router scores poorly reflect how much individual experts improve trading decisions, frequently leaving better alternatives unselected. We further reveal that token-specific expert usefulness exhibits a compact low-dimensional structure. Based on these findings, we propose TradingMoE, a trading-oriented sparse MoE that augments a frozen dense LLM with lightweight residual experts. We introduce a Query-Key router that represents the expertise required by each token under the current market context as a low-dimensional query and matches it with learnable expert keys. We further propose a sparse expert selection update mechanism that samples a few inactive experts during training and estimates whether they should replace the weakest expert in the current Top-k route. This mechanism enables the router to update expert selection as market conditions change while preserving sparse computation. Experiments against 22 baselines on stock and cryptocurrency markets show that TradingMoE improves cumulative return over the best-performing baselines by 30.89% and 30.7%, respectively. Rolling paper-trading experiments further demonstrate that its advantage persists under forward-only deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TradingMoE，一个面向交易的稀疏 Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) 系统，为冻结的稠密大语言模型 (LLM) 增加轻量残差专家，用于金融市场交易。作者发现原生路由器分数不能很好反映单个专家对交易决策的贡献，并揭示 token 级别的专家有用性具有低维结构。摘要报告 TradingMoE 在股票和加密货币市场上对 22 个基线中的最佳基线分别将累计收益提升 30.89% 和 30.7%。
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的交易系统要么协调人工定义的外部专家，要么使用不直接评估单个专家对交易决策贡献的常规内部 MoE 路由器；路由器也没有直接信号来判断当市场条件变化时某个不活跃专家是否已变得更合适。
Method: 提出 Query-Key 路由器，将当前市场背景下每个 token 所需的专业知识表示为低维 query，并与可学习的专家 key 匹配；提出稀疏专家选择更新机制，训练时采样少量不活跃专家，估计它们是否应替换当前 Top-k 路由中最弱的专家，从而在保持稀疏计算的同时随市场条件更新专家选择。
Result: 在股票和加密货币市场上与 22 个基线对比，TradingMoE 相对最佳基线的累计收益分别提升 30.89% 和 30.7%；滚动 paper-trading 实验表明该优势在前向部署下仍然保持。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 TradingMoE 通过面向交易的路由设计和动态专家更新机制来改进 LLM 直接交易的效果，但摘要未提及该方法在金融领域之外的泛化性或其局限。

papers.title: Coarsening Latent-Class Probabilities: Directional Distortion and Coverage Loss
papers.abstract_en: Outcomes are increasingly regressed on a calibrated probability vector for unobserved class membership, and that vector is often coarsened to a hard label first. Under a constant-coefficient structural mean and conditional calibration, the observed-data problem is a partially linear regression of the outcome on the probability vector; we take this reduction as the starting point and ask what coarsening costs. For any coarsening, the plug-in estimator converges to $\mathcal{A}τ$, where the coarsening operator satisfies $\mathcal{A}=I+D^{-1}\mathbb{E}[a_{h}u^{\top}]$ with $u$ the discarded signal. Coarsening is therefore free exactly when what is discarded is uncorrelated with what is kept, and is otherwise anisotropic: it distorts some contrasts far more than others. The same operator governs inference. The Wald interval built from coarsened labels has limiting coverage $Φ(z-λ)-Φ(-z-λ)$, with $λ$ the ratio of the coarsening bias to the reported standard error; because $\mathcal{A}$ and that standard error depend on observables alone, the coverage implied by the estimated index can be approximated before the interval is reported. Simulations show severe coverage loss after argmax coarsening, and three real-data audits exhibit the direction-specific distortion that hard labels induce.
papers.comment: 43 pages, 6 figures, 11 tables. Includes supplementary material with all proofs, two further identification results, additional experiments, and a land-cover audit
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究将未观测类别归属的校准概率向量 (calibrated probability vector) 先粗化为硬标签再用于回归时带来的代价。在常系数结构均值与条件校准假设下，观测数据问题被化为结果对概率向量的部分线性回归；作者定义粗化算子 A，并证明估计量收敛到 Aτ，其中 A=I+D^{-1}E[a_h u^⊤]，u 为被丢弃的信号。粗化仅在丢弃信号与保留信号不相关时无成本，否则会产生各向异性 (anisotropic) 的对比度扭曲；同一算子还控制推断的覆盖性质。
Motivation: 实际应用中，结果变量越来越多地回归到未观测类别归属的校准概率向量上，且该向量常先被粗化为硬标签；作者希望从部分线性回归的约简出发，量化这种粗化在估计与推断上造成的损失。
Method: 将观测数据问题形式化为部分线性回归，引入粗化算子 A 刻画插件估计量的极限；推导 Wald 区间在粗化标签下的极限覆盖率为 Φ(z-λ)-Φ(-z-λ)，其中 λ 为粗化偏差与报告标准误之比，并利用模拟与三项真实数据审计验证理论。
Result: 理论结果表明粗化无成本当且仅当被丢弃的信号与保留信号不相关，否则扭曲是各向异性的，某些对比度受影响远大于其他；模拟显示 argmax 粗化后覆盖损失严重，三项真实数据审计展示了硬标签导致的特定方向扭曲。
Conclusion: 由于算子 A 与报告标准误仅依赖可观测量，可在区间报告前用估计得到的指标近似其覆盖概率；论文含 43 页正文、6 图、11 表，补充材料还包括全部证明、两个额外的识别结果、更多实验以及一次土地覆盖审计。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: VOLA: Improving Open-World Driving by VLM-Based Semantic Attribute Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Driving in the real world is open-world: a car may encounter a fallen mattress, a deer, or other objects outside its training data. Naming them is not enough. The system must know how to treat each region: can it drive over it, and how severe would a collision be? We therefore shift scene perception from category labels to dense action-relevant attributes, where each pixel is labeled by how it should affect motion rather than by object name. We instantiate this general formulation with two ordered attributes: 7-rank drivability and 5-rank vulnerability. We read Qwen3.5 image-token hidden states directly as a spatial semantic representation. A lightweight boundary-aware decoder then turns this coarse token grid into sharp full-resolution attribute maps. The whole process requires neither autoregressive text generation nor an external mask model such as SAM. We train on dense attribute labels built in CARLA and test transfer to real scenes and to novel obstacles never seen in training. We compare with vision-only segmenters trained on the same attributes and prompted VLM segmenters. Our model matches strong vision-only segmenters on familiar categories and improves transfer to real open-world anomalies, reaching 69.4% mean vulnerability-rank recall versus 57.1% for the best vision-only baseline and 53.9% for the best prompted VLM baseline. These results show that VLM image tokens provide useful semantic cues for transferring driving attributes to objects outside the training vocabulary.

TL;DR: 本文提出 VOLA，一种基于视觉语言模型 (VLM) 的开放世界驾驶场景感知方法，将场景感知从类别标签转向稠密的动作相关属性 (dense action-relevant attributes)，用 7 级可行驶性 (drivability) 和 5 级脆弱性 (vulnerability) 对每个像素标注。方法直接读取 Qwen3.5 的图像 token 隐藏状态作为空间语义表示，并配一个轻量级边界感知解码器生成全分辨率属性图，无需自回归文本生成或 SAM 等外部掩码模型。训练使用 CARLA 中构建的稠密属性标签，并测试向真实场景及未见过的障碍物迁移。

Result: 与在相同属性上训练的纯视觉分割器及提示式 VLM 分割器相比，模型在熟悉类别上匹配强纯视觉分割器，并改善向真实开放世界异常的迁移，达到 69.4% 的平均脆弱性等级召回率，而最佳纯视觉基线为 57.1%，最佳提示式 VLM 基线为 53.9%。
Conclusion: 结果表明 VLM 图像 token 为将驾驶属性迁移到训练词汇之外的物体提供了有用的语义线索。

papers.title: The Sleeping Agent: What Gist-Based Context Compression Loses and Why
papers.abstract_en: Gist-based context compression---summarising older conversation history into compact representations---is a common approach in long-horizon language model agents, yet its effect on different types of memory retrieval is poorly understood. We use Salience-Weighted Consolidation (SWC), a biologically-inspired compression framework motivated by sleep-based memory consolidation, as a diagnostic probe to study when gist compression helps and when it hurts. SWC scores conversation history by salience, partitions it into priority tiers, and applies structured gist abstraction to mid-priority content. Evaluating four conditions on all ten LoCoMo conversations---1,935 matched text-only questions in total, 1,501 used in the primary aggregate after excluding Category 5 (adversarial) questions---at temperature 0, we find a consistent task-type interaction: gist compression substantially outperforms truncation on multi-hop reasoning and single-hop factual questions, but temporal questions remain substantially harder under compression, with compressed conditions scoring well below the full-context reference on the conversations where both are evaluated. We trace this failure to a specific mechanism: the gist abstraction prompt preserves relational and event structure while discarding dates and times. A preservation analysis across all ten conversations confirms the mechanism: an approximately 20-fold increase in temporal expression preservation (3.05% to 62.39%) with a one-sentence prompt modification, while named entity and event preservation rates barely change (x1.02 and x1.11), demonstrating that the fix is a precision instrument. The prompt modification recovers +0.314 [0.254, 0.375] judge accuracy on category-2 (temporal) questions in the matched set. Code and results: https://github.com/kyrkewood/sleeping-agent.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 5 tables, appendices. Code and results at https://github.com/kyrkewood/sleeping-agent
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以 Salience-Weighted Consolidation (SWC) 为诊断探针，研究基于要点 (gist) 的上下文压缩对长时程语言智能体不同记忆检索类型的影响。作者在全部 10 个 LoCoMo 对话、1,935 个匹配的纯文本问题上评估四种条件，发现要点压缩在多跳推理和单跳事实问题上明显优于截断，但时间类问题在压缩下显著变差。机制分析表明，gist 抽象提示在保留关系与事件结构的同时丢弃了日期和时间；仅需一句话的提示修改即可将时间表达保留率从 3.05% 提升到 62.39%，并在匹配集的时间类问题上恢复 +0.314 的裁判准确率。
Motivation: 基于要点的上下文压缩在长时程语言智能体中很常见，但它对不同类型记忆检索的影响尚不明确，尤其是时间类信息为何受损缺乏机制层面的理解。
Method: 使用受睡眠记忆巩固启发的 Salience-Weighted Consolidation (SWC) 框架作为诊断工具：按显著性对对话历史评分、划分为优先级层级、对中优先级内容应用结构化 gist 抽象；在温度 0 下比较四种条件，并进行时间表达保留率的消融分析。
Result: 在多跳推理和单跳事实问题上，要点压缩显著优于截断；但压缩条件下的时间类问题得分远低于全上下文参考。保留率分析显示，一句话的提示修改使时间表达保留率从 3.05% 增至 62.39%，而命名实体和事件保留率几乎不变（x1.02 与 x1.11）；该修改在匹配集中时间类问题上带来 +0.314 [0.254, 0.375] 的裁判准确率提升。
Conclusion: 作者将压缩对时间类问题的损害归因于 gist 抽象提示的系统性丢弃日期/时间信息，并证明一个高度精准的提示修改即可恢复大部分时间信息，说明该失败机制是可定位、可修复的。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Achieving Near-Zero-Overhead Multi-Model Hierarchical Classification in Real-Time Detection Pipelines
papers.abstract_en: Edge-deployed vision systems in target recognition, surveillance, autonomous vehicles, and drone domains require hierarchical inference pipelines where a detection model identifies objects of interest and downstream classifiers provide fine-grained attribute analysis. Running all models on the GPU creates a serial bottleneck that limits real-time throughput as pipeline stages grow. Modern edge SoCs pair GPUs with dedicated neural accelerators (NPUs, DLAs) capable of concurrent execution, yet deploying custom models on these accelerators remains impractical due to strict operator constraints, quantization incompatibilities, and an undocumented end-to-end pipeline. We target NVIDIA Jetson DLA cores as the representative platform. We present a five-step methodology for zero GPU fallback DLA INT8 deployment of classification backbones, comprising architecture adaptation, manual dynamic range workaround to rescue TensorRT's implicit quantization (recovering 94.0% accuracy from implicit quantization's 75%) for rapid pipeline validation before explicit quantization, quantization-aware training, ONNX graph surgery for DLA compilation, and a concurrent GPU-detection/DLA-classification inference pipeline. We document nine engineering constraints with root-cause analysis and generalizable solutions. Validation on a dual-head person attribute classifier running on DLA alongside a GPU object detector on a Jetson Orin NX demonstrates near-zero pipeline overhead (12.5 vs. 13.3~FPS detector-only at 1080p), with dual-DLA scaling at no additional cost. The methodology is backbone-agnostic and generalizes to any detection-classification edge pipeline.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 17 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to Journal of Real-Time Image Processing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对边缘部署视觉系统中检测模型与下游细粒度分类器串行运行造成的 GPU 瓶颈，提出一套面向 NVIDIA Jetson DLA 的零 GPU 回退 INT8 分类骨干部署方法论，涵盖架构适配、手动动态范围修正、量化感知训练、ONNX 图手术以及 GPU 检测/DLA 分类并发推理。在 Jetson Orin NX 上验证了双头行人属性分类器与 GPU 物体检测器并行的近零管线开销。
Motivation: 边缘视觉系统（目标识别、监控、自动驾驶、无人机）需要层级推理管线，但所有模型在 GPU 上串行运行会随阶段增多形成实时吞吐瓶颈；边缘 SoC 虽有可并行的 NPU/DLA，却因算子约束、量化不兼容及缺乏端到端文档而难以部署自定义模型。
Method: 提出五步方法论：架构适配、手动动态范围修正以挽救 TensorRT 隐式量化（将准确率从 75% 恢复到 94.0%，用于快速管线验证）、量化感知训练 (quantization-aware training)、面向 DLA 编译的 ONNX 图手术，以及 GPU 检测与 DLA 分类并发的推理管线；同时记录九条工程约束并给出根因分析与通用解决方案。
Result: 在 Jetson Orin NX 上，双头行人属性分类器运行于 DLA、GPU 物体检测器同时运行的条件下，1080p 下检测器单独约 13.3 FPS，叠加分类后约 12.5 FPS，实现近零管线开销；双 DLA 扩展无额外成本。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法与骨干网络无关 (backbone-agnostic)，可推广到任意检测-分类边缘流水线；摘要未明确说明局限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: HyperANFIS: Enhancing Rule Representation and Interpretability in Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Systems via Hyperbolic Geometry
papers.abstract_en: The adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) is an interpretable reasoning framework capable of generating explicit IF-THEN fuzzy rules, making it suitable for tasks requiring transparent reasoning. However, existing ANFIS models generally construct rule antecedents and perform inference in Euclidean space, limiting their representational capacity and predictive performance. To address this issue, we propose Hyperbolic ANFIS (HyperANFIS), a hyperbolic extension of ANFIS. HyperANFIS preserves the fuzzy semantics and core architecture of conventional ANFIS while performing rule-prototype learning, rule activation, and consequent aggregation in hyperbolic space. It also retains the ability to generate interpretable IF-THEN rules. By exploiting the representational properties of hyperbolic geometry, HyperANFIS strengthens the fuzzy inference process, thereby improving predictive accuracy, inter-rule collaboration, and the credibility of its interpretable rules. Experimental results show that HyperANFIS consistently outperforms the standard ANFIS baseline and various ANFIS variants across all datasets, while also generating higher-quality fuzzy rules.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HyperANFIS，一种基于双曲几何 (hyperbolic geometry) 的自适应神经模糊推理系统扩展。该方法保留传统 ANFIS 的模糊语义与核心架构，但在双曲空间中完成规则原型学习、规则激活与后件聚合，并继续生成可解释的 IF-THEN 规则。摘要报告称，HyperANFIS 在所有数据集上一致优于标准 ANFIS 基线及多种 ANFIS 变体，并产生更高质量的模糊规则。
Motivation: 现有 ANFIS 模型通常在欧几里得空间中构造规则前件并进行推理，限制了表征能力和预测性能；作者希望在不丧失可解释性的前提下增强模糊推理过程。
Method: 提出 HyperANFIS，将 ANFIS 的规则原型学习、规则激活与后件聚合迁移到双曲空间，同时保留可解释 IF-THEN 规则的生成能力，以利用双曲几何的表征特性强化模糊推理。
Result: 实验结果显示 HyperANFIS 在全部数据集上持续优于标准 ANFIS 基线和多种 ANFIS 变体，并且生成的模糊规则质量更高。
Conclusion: 作者认为利用双曲几何可以提升 ANFIS 的预测精度、规则间协作能力以及可解释规则的可信度。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Instruction Alignment for Binary Code Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Binary code representation learning is a fundamental problem in software security and reverse engineering. Existing methods mainly learn function-level embeddings that capture coarse-grained semantic relationships between binary functions, but they largely ignore fine-grained instruction-level correspondences. This limitation misses valuable supervision signals available from compiler debug information, which can support the learning of more accurate and interpretable binary code representations. We propose to leverage instruction alignment knowledge to further improve binary code representation learning. Our preliminary study reveals that models finetuned for function-level binary code similarity exhibit substantially better instruction alignment than their pre-trained model, suggesting a strong correlation between instruction alignment and function-level embedding quality. Motivated by this observation, we design a training approach that explicitly incorporates instruction alignment as an auxiliary training objective. Our experiments show that instruction alignment training improves retrieval accuracy and provides more discriminative signal for the model's similarity judgments.
papers.comment: In proceedings of the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对二进制代码表示学习中缺乏细粒度指令级对应关系的问题，提出利用编译器调试信息中的指令对齐知识来改进函数级嵌入训练。作者先观察到经过函数级二进制代码相似性微调的模型比预训练模型表现出明显更好的指令对齐，说明二者强相关，进而将指令对齐作为辅助训练目标。实验表明该方法能提升检索准确率，并为相似性判断提供更具区分性的信号。
Motivation: 现有二进制代码表示学习方法主要学习函数级嵌入，捕获粗粒度的语义关系，忽略指令级对应关系，从而丢失了编译器调试信息中可用的监督信号，限制了表示的准确性与可解释性。
Method: 将指令对齐作为辅助训练目标显式加入二进制代码表示学习过程，利用编译器调试信息提供的指令级对应关系来增强函数级嵌入的训练。
Result: 初步研究表明指令对齐与函数级嵌入质量强相关；实验显示指令对齐训练提高了检索准确率，并使模型的相似性判断更具区分性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调指令对齐可以作为有价值的辅助监督信号来改善二进制代码表示学习，但未提及方法在真实逆向工程场景中的局限性或更多评测细节。

papers.title: ProBAG: Prototype-Guided Boundary-Aware Graph Diffusion for Weakly Supervised Histopathology Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Weakly supervised semantic segmentation enables histopathology tissue segmentation from image-level annotations, avoiding costly pixel-level labeling by expert pathologists. However, CAM-based methods often localize only highly discriminative regions and remain unreliable near tissue interfaces. We propose ProBAG, a stage-1 pseudo-mask generator that combines dataset-specific visual prototypes with pathology-aligned CONCH text prototypes over multi-scale frozen UNI features. ProBAG introduces two complementary mechanisms: class-wise power recalibration that reshapes inter-class competition while preserving the total foreground activation mass at each pixel, and one-step graph diffusion in which feature affinities are penalized by a late-transformer attention-context discrepancy used as a soft structural boundary cue. The resulting stage-1 pseudo-masks require neither CRF nor an external segmentation model; for complete two-stage comparison, they additionally supervise a downstream Phikon-FPN segmenter. Experiments on BCSS-WSSS and LUAD-HistoSeg show consistent gains over recent WSSS approaches, while ablations indicate that pathology-aligned text semantics provide the largest improvement and graph refinement provides a smaller complementary gain. The code is available at: https://github.com/wterrr/WSSS
papers.comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Accepted by MICCAI Workshop (COMPAYL) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ProBAG，一个用于弱监督组织病理图像分割的阶段一伪掩码生成器。它结合数据集特定视觉原型与病理对齐的 CONCH 文本原型，并引入类级功率重校准和单步图扩散两种机制，在 BCSS-WSSS 和 LUAD-HistoSeg 上取得优于近期 WSSS 方法的结果。消融实验表明病理对齐文本语义贡献最大，图细化提供较小的互补增益。
Motivation: 弱监督语义分割可从图像级标注实现组织病理分割，避免昂贵的像素级标注，但基于 CAM 的方法往往只定位高判别区域，在组织界面附近不可靠。
Method: ProBAG 基于多尺度冻结 UNI 特征，融合数据集特定视觉原型和病理对齐的 CONCH 文本原型；引入类级功率重校准以重塑类间竞争同时保留每像素总前景激活质量，并采用单步图扩散，用晚期 Transformer 注意力上下文差异作为软结构边界线索惩罚特征亲和力。阶段一伪掩码无需 CRF 或外部分割模型。
Result: 在 BCSS-WSSS 和 LUAD-HistoSeg 上，ProBAG 相对于近期 WSSS 方法取得一致提升；消融显示病理对齐文本语义带来的改善最大，图细化提供较小的互补增益。
Conclusion: 阶段一伪掩码还可用于监督下游 Phikon-FPN 分割器以完成两阶段比较，代码已公开。

papers.title: A comparison of CNN architectures for Alzheimer's disease detection in single-view MRI scans
papers.abstract_en: Alzheimer's disease is a leading cause of death with no cure. Therefore, early detection is critical to slow progression and preserve quality of life. Diagnosis relies on medical history, cognitive tests, physical exams, and MRI brain scans, making deep learning suitable for Alzheimer's classification. This work proposes a benchmark that evaluates ten different convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures (including ResNet, DenseNet, MobileNet, EfficientNet, and VGG family models) under the same held-out test split protocol. A two-stage transfer learning and full fine-tuning pipeline is introduced to perform training using a class-balanced subset (3,900 images) derived from the OASIS medical imaging dataset, comprising 86,437 single-view MRI brain scans labeled into four classifications of Alzheimer's disease: Non-Demented, Very Mild Dementia, Mild Dementia, and Moderate Dementia. The best results were achieved by VGG16, with a 0.9637 validation accuracy and a 0.9533 test accuracy score. A key finding documented in this work is the difficulty of classifying the transition from Non-Demented to Very Mild Demented stages, observed consistently across all ten architectures.
papers.comment: Accepted at SPIE Optics + Photonics 2026 for oral presentation. 14 pages, 7 figures, 8 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基准，在相同留出测试集协议下评估十种不同 CNN 架构（包括 ResNet、DenseNet、MobileNet、EfficientNet 和 VGG 家族）用于阿尔茨海默病单视图 MRI 扫描分类。采用两阶段迁移学习与全微调流程，在来自 OASIS 数据集的类平衡子集（3,900 张图像，原始 86,437 张单视图 MRI）上进行训练，任务为四分类：Non-Demented、Very Mild Dementia、Mild Dementia 和 Moderate Dementia。最佳结果为 VGG16，验证准确率 0.9637，测试准确率 0.9533。所有架构一致表现出从 Non-Demented 到 Very Mild Dementia 阶段转换难以分类的问题。
Motivation: 阿尔茨海默病尚无治愈方法，早期检测对延缓进展和维持生活质量至关重要。现有诊断依赖病史、认知测试、体格检查和 MRI 脑部扫描，为深度学习分类提供了合适场景，但缺乏在统一协议下对不同 CNN 架构的系统比较。
Method: 提出一个包含十种 CNN 架构的基准，在相同留出测试集分割协议下评估。引入两阶段迁移学习与全微调训练流程，使用从 OASIS 数据集中抽取的类平衡子集（3,900 张图像，来自 86,437 张单视图 MRI 扫描），分类为四种阿尔茨海默病阶段。
Result: VGG16 取得最佳结果，验证准确率 0.9637，测试准确率 0.9533。所有十种架构在 Non-Demented 到 Very Mild Dementia 阶段的分类转换上都表现出一致的困难。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，在统一基准下比较多种 CNN 架构有助于评估阿尔茨海默病 MRI 分类方法的性能，并指出早期阶段（非痴呆到极轻度痴呆）的区分是各架构普遍面临的难点。

papers.title: Tight Nonasymptotic Local Convergence of Sinkhorn-Knopp
papers.abstract_en: We revisit the Sinkhorn-Knopp (SK) algorithm for the matrix scaling problem. Despite extensive literature on the global convergence of SK and its variants, its local linear convergence behavior remains less understood. We address this gap by providing the first nonasymptotic local analysis of SK that matches the rate obtained from existing asymptotic Jacobian-based arguments. We show that under certain connectivity conditions, SK is a polynomial-time algorithm for doubly stochastic matrix scaling. With the developed tools, we showcase the local suboptimality of SK and provide accelerated variants. Finally, for dense matrices, we improve the complexity of existing first-order matrix scaling algorithms from $O(\tfrac{n^{7/3}}{\varepsilon^{2/3}})$ to $O(\tfrac{n^{9/4}}{\sqrt{\varepsilon}})$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视矩阵缩放问题中的 Sinkhorn-Knopp (SK) 算法，在已有大量全局收敛文献的背景下，首次给出与渐近 Jacobian 论证所得速率匹配的非渐近局部收敛分析。作者证明在某种连通性条件下，SK 是求解双随机矩阵缩放的多项式时间算法，并基于所发展的工具展示 SK 的局部次优性、给出加速变体，同时将稠密矩阵上的一阶矩阵缩放算法复杂度从 O(n^{7/3}/ε^{2/3}) 改进到 O(n^{9/4}/√ε)。
Motivation: 尽管 Sinkhorn-Knopp 及其变体的全局收敛已有大量研究，但其局部线性收敛行为仍缺乏深入理解，这一理论空白限制了对其效率的更精确刻画。
Method: 在特定连通性条件下对 SK 进行非渐近局部收敛分析，建立与渐近 Jacobian 方法一致的收敛速率，并借助该分析框架构造加速变体。
Result: 首次获得与渐近速率匹配的 SK 非渐近局部收敛结论，证明 SK 对双随机矩阵缩放是多项式时间算法；对稠密矩阵，一阶矩阵缩放算法复杂度由 O(n^{7/3}/ε^{2/3}) 降为 O(n^{9/4}/√ε)。
Conclusion: 摘要强调现有 SK 在局部意义下是次优的，所提出的加速变体可改善其表现，并将稠密矩阵一阶缩放算法的复杂度界显著改进。

papers.title: Automated binary classification of hazelnut X-ray images: A deep-learning benchmark for quality assessment
papers.abstract_en: Non-destructive X-ray imaging can reveal internal hazelnut defects that are difficult to detect by external inspection alone; however, automated interpretation remains challenging because of subtle radiographic differences among classes, marked class imbalance, and limited annotated data. Here, we present a benchmark for binary hazelnut quality classification (healthy versus defective) based on 799 segmented single-kernel X-ray images (224 x 224 pixels, grayscale), grouped into 101 acquisition units. Seven single-model configurations and ten probability-aggregation ensembles were evaluated using a group-wise split-rotation protocol across five data splits generated using different random seeds. Decision thresholds were selected on the validation set, and performance was assessed deterministically on validation and test sets. Under the expert-reassessed annotation condition, the average-probability ensemble of the binary cross-entropy-trained convolutional neural network and frozen Swin Transformer achieved the highest mean balanced accuracy (86.3% +/- 1.8%, five seeds), with several other ensembles providing comparable performance. Across methods, substantial split-to-split variability was observed, indicating that multi-split evaluation is essential for reliable model comparison at this dataset scale. Expert reassessment of ambiguous samples improved the performance of all 17 evaluated methods by 2.8-8.1 percentage points, while having only a limited effect on cross-split variance. The results highlight both the potential of deep learning for automated X-ray-based hazelnut quality assessment and the importance of rigorous evaluation and label curation in small, imbalanced agricultural imaging datasets.
papers.comment: 26 pages (including 5 pages of supplementary material), 4 figures, 5 tables. Dataset available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21739932
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了一个基于799张分割后单仁榛子X射线图像（224x224灰度）的二分类基准（健康 vs 有缺陷），并系统评估了7种单模型配置和10种概率聚合集成。采用分组划分旋转协议（group-wise split-rotation）和5个随机种子，在验证集上选择阈值后在测试集上确定性评估。专家重新复核标注条件下，由BCE训练的卷积神经网络（CNN）与冻结Swin Transformer组成的平均概率集成取得最高平均平衡准确率（86.3% ± 1.8%），且多个集成性能相近。
Motivation: 无损X射线成像能发现外部检查难以察觉的内部榛子缺陷，但类别间灰度差异细微、类别不平衡和标注数据有限使自动化判读困难；在小规模农业图像数据集上，可靠的模型比较还需要严谨的多划分评估协议。
Method: 使用101个采集单元的799张分割单仁X射线图像，按采集单元分组进行划分，生成5个不同随机种子的数据划分；比较7种单模型和10种概率聚合集成，包括二元交叉熵训练的CNN与冻结Swin Transformer的平均概率集成；决策阈值在验证集上选取，并在验证集和测试集上确定性评估，同时引入专家对模糊样本的重新评估。
Result: 摘要报告最佳集成在专家复核标注条件下达到86.3% ± 1.8%的平均平衡准确率（5 seeds）；多种集成表现相近。跨划分的显著变异性表明多划分评估对可靠比较很重要；专家重新评估模糊样本使全部17种方法的性能提升2.8–8.1个百分点，但对跨划分方差影响有限。
Conclusion: 结果表明深度学习可用于基于X射线的自动化榛子质量评估，但也强调在小规模、不平衡的农业成像数据集中，严格的评估协议和标签整理（label curation）至关重要。

papers.title: UniSwap: Streaming Audio-Visual Identity Swapping for Talking Videos
papers.abstract_en: Talking-video character replacement requires coordinated transfer of appearance and voice while preserving the source motion, scene, linguistic content, and audio-video timing. Existing methods use separately optimized models for the two modalities, making audio-visual consistency difficult to enforce. We present UniSwap, the first framework for streaming joint audio-visual identity replacement in talking videos. Given a source video, a reference image, and a reference voice clip, UniSwap transfers the reference appearance and vocal timbre within a single audio-visual diffusion transformer while preserving the source content and dynamics. To address the scarcity of aligned cross-identity training pairs, we introduce a swap-and-reconstruct pipeline that removes visual and vocal identity from real clips and uses the original clips as reconstruction targets. Starting from a bidirectional backbone, we progressively adapt the model through In-context Pretraining for joint replacement, Conditional Streaming Adaptation for block-causal KV-cached generation, and Efficient Self-forcing DMD for mitigating exposure bias and reducing sampling from 30 to 3 denoising steps per block. Efficient Multi-LoRA Switching enables the three DMD roles to share a single frozen backbone. Feature-RoPE Decomposition keeps cached positions within the training range, supporting stable long-form inference. Experiments demonstrate strong audio-visual synchronization, competitive identity preservation, efficient streaming, and stable long-form generation.

papers.title: MOON: Multi-Objective OrthoNormalized Updates for Multitask Learning
papers.abstract_en: Multi-objective optimization (MOO) has demonstrated significant success in multi-task learning by mitigating task conflicts through gradient manipulation. However, most existing methods flatten model parameters into vectors and perform gradient manipulation under Euclidean geometry, thereby overlooking the matrix structure prevalent in modern architectures such as Transformers. In this paper, we show that gradient manipulation in Euclidean space does not generally yield the steepest descent direction under matrix geometry, potentially limiting optimization efficiency. Drawing from the theory of steepest descent for matrix-valued parameters, we propose MOON (Multi-Objective OrthoNormalized Updates), which performs gradient manipulation under spectral--nuclear norm geometry and uses the orthonormalized manipulated gradient for parameter updates. Theoretically, for smooth non-convex objectives, we establish convergence of the averaged Pareto-stationarity measure at rates of $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/2})$ in the deterministic setting and $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/4})$ under stochastic gradients. Empirical results across various benchmarks show that MOON consistently improves both optimization efficiency and final multi-task performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/KunlinLyu/MOON.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MOON (Multi-Objective OrthoNormalized Updates)，一种面向多任务学习的多目标优化方法。作者指出现有基于梯度的多任务优化通常在欧几里得几何下将参数展平为向量，忽略了 Transformer 等现代架构中参数的矩阵结构。MOON 在谱-核范数几何下进行梯度操纵，并用正交归一化后的操纵梯度更新参数，理论上对光滑非凸目标给出 Pareto 驻点测度的收敛率，实验显示能提升优化效率与最终多任务性能。
Motivation: 现有多任务学习中的多目标优化方法大多把模型参数展平成向量并在欧几里得空间进行梯度操纵，这忽略了现代架构（如 Transformer）中参数的矩阵结构。作者认为欧氏空间中的梯度操纵在矩阵几何下不一定是最陡下降方向，从而可能限制优化效率。
Method: 基于矩阵值参数的最陡下降理论，提出 MOON：在谱-核范数几何下执行多目标梯度操纵，并使用正交归一化后的操纵梯度进行参数更新。理论部分针对光滑非凸目标，给出确定性梯度下降下 Pareto 平稳性测度均值的 O(T^{-1/2}) 收敛率，以及随机梯度下 O(T^{-1/4}) 的收敛率。
Result: 摘要报告在多个基准上的实验表明，MOON 一致地提升优化效率和最终多任务性能；理论分析给出了确定性设定和随机梯度设定下的 Pareto 驻点收敛率。
Conclusion: 作者认为在矩阵几何下进行多目标梯度操纵能够改善多任务学习的优化效率，并将代码开源在 GitHub。

papers.title: Dual Modality Prompted Diffusion Priors for Zero Shot Hyperspectral Pansharpening
papers.abstract_en: Hyperspectral pansharpening aims to reconstruct a high resolution hyperspectral (HRHS) image from a panchromatic (PAN) image and a low resolution hyperspectral (LRHS) image while preserving both spatial details and spectral fidelity. Recent diffusion based methods exploit pretrained image priors by generating a low dimensional representation and subsequently mapping it to the hyperspectral domain. However, the observed panchromatic and hyperspectral images are typically imposed only through external reconstruction objectives, limiting their direct interaction with the diffusion prior. To address this issue, we propose dual-modality image-prompted diffusion model (DIDM) for zero shot hyperspectral pansharpening. DIDM encodes the low resolution hyperspectral and panchromatic observations into spectral and spatial prompt tokens, respectively, and injects them into intermediate features of a frozen remote sensing diffusion model through cross attention, allowing complementary spectral and spatial information to directly guide diffusion feature evolution. In addition, we introduce a panchromatic guided weighted pixel aware total variation regularizer that combines low resolution hyperspectral degradation fidelity and panchromatic response fidelity with gradient adaptive structural regularization, thereby preserving structural discontinuities while suppressing spurious variations in homogeneous regions. Extensive experiments on Pavia, Chikusei, and Houston under reduced resolution protocols show that DIDM achieves the best performance across all evaluated metrics, while full resolution evaluation on FR1 yields the highest HQNR among the compared methods. These results demonstrate that internal dual modality prompting and panchromatic guided structural regularization provide an effective balance between spatial detail enhancement and spectral preservation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种零样本高光谱全色锐化 (hyperspectral pansharpening) 方法 DIDM，利用双模态图像提示的双向注意力机制将低分辨率高光谱 (LRHS) 与全色 (PAN) 观测注入冻结的遥感扩散模型，并引入全色引导的加权像素感知全变分正则化以保持结构不连续性。在 Pavia、Chikusei、Houston 的降分辨率协议及 FR1 数据集的全分辨率评估中，DIDM 在各项指标上均取得最佳或领先性能。
Motivation: 现有基于扩散的高光谱全色锐化方法通常只通过外部重建目标约束观测图像，PAN 与 LRHS 信息与扩散先验缺乏直接交互，限制了空间与光谱信息的互补利用。
Method: DIDM 将 LRHS 与 PAN 观测分别编码为光谱提示 token 与空间提示 token，通过交叉注意力注入冻结遥感扩散模型的中间特征；同时提出全色引导的加权像素感知全变分正则化，将 LRHS 退化保真度与 PAN 响应保真度结合梯度自适应结构正则化。
Result: 在 Pavia、Chikusei 和 Houston 降分辨率协议下，DIDM 在所有评估指标上取得最佳性能；在 FR1 全分辨率评估中取得最高的 HQNR。
Conclusion: 摘要表明内部双模态提示与全色引导的结构正则化能够在空间细节增强与光谱保持之间取得有效平衡。

papers.title: Making Every Step Count: Spatio-Temporal Information Allocation for Imaging Inverse Problems
papers.abstract_en: Flow-based generative models have emerged as powerful image priors for training-free inverse problem solving, capturing coherent semantics and fine-grained structure. Despite these strengths, existing flow-based inverse solvers primarily focus on the design of individual updates, largely overlooking spatio-temporal information allocation under a fixed number of function evaluations (NFEs). Temporally, insufficient early exploration can trap the flow trajectory in an incorrect semantic basin, whereas excessive allocation of NFEs to early stages leaves little budget for late-stage refinement. Spatially, data consistency provides direct constraints only within observed regions, whereas the recovery of missing regions relies mainly on the generative prior. To address these two issues, we introduce two complementary and training-free components, i.e., Spectrum-Adaptive Scheduling (SAS) and Measurement-Prioritized Attention (MPA). For temporal allocation, SAS distributes the available NFEs over flow time according to the degradation spectrum and logSNR geometry, thus better balancing semantic exploration and detail refinement. For spatial propagation, MPA exploits data-prior conflicts to guide information toward weakly constrained regions, thereby enhancing semantic and structural fidelity. Extensive experiments on standard image inverse problems, e.g., super-resolution, motion deblurring, and inpainting, demonstrate that the proposed components can be integrated into existing flow-based inverse solvers in a plug-and-play manner without retraining or additional flow-model evaluations, and can also significantly improve the restoration quality of existing solvers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于流的生成模型（flow-based generative models）在无训练逆问题求解中的信息分配问题，提出两个互补且无需训练的组件：频谱自适应调度（Spectrum-Adaptive Scheduling, SAS）和测量优先注意力（Measurement-Prioritized Attention, MPA），分别处理固定函数评估次数（NFEs）下的时间分配与空间信息传播。作者在超分辨率、运动去模糊和图像修复等标准成像逆问题上验证，组件可以即插即用地集成到现有基于流的逆求解器中，在无需重训练或额外流模型评估的情况下显著提升重建质量。
Motivation: 现有基于流的逆问题求解器主要关注单步更新设计，忽略了在固定NFEs条件下对时间和空间两维度的信息分配。时间上，早期探索不足会使流轨迹陷入错误的语义盆地，而早期分配过多NFEs又会挤压后期的细节精修预算；空间上，数据一致性只在观测区域内提供直接约束，缺失区域的恢复主要依赖生成先验。
Method: SAS根据退化频谱（degradation spectrum）和logSNR几何分布将可用NFEs分配到流时间轴上，以平衡语义探索与细节精修；MPA利用数据与先验之间的冲突，将信息引导到弱约束区域，增强语义和结构保真度。两个组件均为无训练、即插即用设计。
Result: 在超分辨率、运动去模糊和图像修复等标准成像逆问题上的实验表明，该方法能以即插即用方式集成到现有基于流的逆求解器中，无需重训练或额外的流模型评估，并显著提升现有求解器的重建质量。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过SAS和MPA分别处理时间与空间上的信息分配，可以在不增加流模型评估成本的前提下改善现有基于流的逆问题求解器的恢复性能。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: Epiplexity Guided Data Selection and Generation for Out-of-Distribution Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Modern systems are increasingly expected to transfer across tasks not specified during training. What data facilitates generalization in these new, unanticipated settings? One hypothesis is that data with more structural information could contain shared circuits and subprograms that could be recycled in a wider array of downstream settings. Epiplexity, a recently proposed measure of the structural information a compute-bounded learner can extract from data, provides a mechanism to reason about this relationship. In this paper, we show how to operationalize epiplexity as an online training signal for data selection and synthetic data generation. For selection, we fit scaling laws to the training loss curves of natural data domains to predict the expected epiplexity gain as a function of training tokens, and use this signal to adaptively determine the sampling weights over domains during training. For synthetic data generation, we define a generator's reward as the change in learner epiplexity over a buffer of previously generated data and use REINFORCE policy gradients to guide the generator toward an epiplexity-maximizing distribution. In both cases, higher epiplexity predicts improved downstream performance on zero-shot and fine-tuning based tasks, supporting the hypothesis that data rich in structural information yield representations that transfer across domains.
papers.comment: Code available for EpiSelect (https://github.com/eysu35/EpiSelect) and EpiGen (https://github.com/eysu35/EpiGen)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将 epiplexity（计算受限学习者可从数据中提取的结构信息度量）作为在线训练信号，用于数据选择与合成数据生成。选择方面，作者对自然数据域的训练损失曲线拟合 scaling laws，预测随训练 token 变化的 epiplexity 增益，并据此自适应调整各域的采样权重；生成方面，以生成数据缓冲区上学习者 epiplexity 的变化作为奖励，用 REINFORCE 策略梯度引导生成器逼近 epiplexity 最大化的分布。摘要报告，在零样本和微调下游任务上，更高 epiplexity 预测更好的迁移表现，支持富含结构信息的数据有助于跨域泛化的假设。
Motivation: 现代系统需要在训练时未指定的新任务上迁移，但什么数据有利于这些未预见场景的泛化仍不明确。作者假设含有更多结构信息的数据可能包含可复用的共享电路或子程序，而 epiplexity 为检验这一关系提供了可操作的机制。
Method: 选择方面，拟合自然数据域训练损失曲线的 scaling laws 来预测 epiplexity gain 与训练 token 的函数关系，并用该信号在线决定各域采样权重（EpiSelect）。生成方面，将生成器奖励定义为学习者在一批先前生成数据上的 epiplexity 变化，使用 REINFORCE 策略梯度优化生成分布（EpiGen），两者代码均已开源。
Result: 摘要表明，在数据选择和合成数据生成两种设定下，更高的 epiplexity 均能预测零样本与微调任务上更好的下游性能，从而支持结构信息丰富的数据带来可迁移表征的假设；摘要未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为 epiplexity 可以作为指导数据选择与生成的有效在线训练信号，其与下游迁移性能的正向关联支持了结构信息驱动跨域泛化的观点。
Relevance: 6

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出将 epiplexity（计算受限学习者可从数据中提取的结构信息度量）作为在线训练信号，用于数据选择与合成数据生成。选择方面，作者对自然数据域的训练损失曲线拟合 scaling laws，预测随训练 token 变化的 epiplexity 增益，并据此自适应调整各域的采样权重；生成方面，以生成数据缓冲区上学习者 epiplexity 的变化作为奖励，用 REINFORCE 策略梯度引导生成器逼近 epiplexity 最大化的分布。摘要报告，在零样本和微调下游任务上，更高 epiplexity 预测更好的迁移表现，支持富含结构信息的数据有助于跨域泛化的假设。
summary_sections.motivation: 现代系统需要在训练时未指定的新任务上迁移，但什么数据有利于这些未预见场景的泛化仍不明确。作者假设含有更多结构信息的数据可能包含可复用的共享电路或子程序，而 epiplexity 为检验这一关系提供了可操作的机制。
summary_sections.method: 选择方面，拟合自然数据域训练损失曲线的 scaling laws 来预测 epiplexity gain 与训练 token 的函数关系，并用该信号在线决定各域采样权重（EpiSelect）。生成方面，将生成器奖励定义为学习者在一批先前生成数据上的 epiplexity 变化，使用 REINFORCE 策略梯度优化生成分布（EpiGen），两者代码均已开源。
summary_sections.result: 摘要表明，在数据选择和合成数据生成两种设定下，更高的 epiplexity 均能预测零样本与微调任务上更好的下游性能，从而支持结构信息丰富的数据带来可迁移表征的假设；摘要未给出具体数值结果。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为 epiplexity 可以作为指导数据选择与生成的有效在线训练信号，其与下游迁移性能的正向关联支持了结构信息驱动跨域泛化的观点。

papers.title: LiveAnimate: Stable Long-Form Streaming Human Animation in Real-Time
papers.abstract_en: Pose-driven human animation synthesizes a video of a target person from a single reference image and a driving pose stream. Real-time generation is essential for interactive applications such as live streaming, telepresence, and virtual avatars, yet diffusion-based systems require minutes to hours per clip, precluding responsive interaction. We present LiveAnimate, to our knowledge the first animation system to combine real-time streaming with stable long-form generation at billion scale, built on a 14B-parameter video Diffusion Transformer (DiT). A two-stage training pipeline first adapts a pretrained bidirectional DiT into a block-causal autoregressive generator through Reference-Anchored Teacher-Forcing Adaptation, and then reduces the sampling budget to three steps through Block-wise Self-Forcing Distillation. To preserve appearance over extended streams, we introduce Pose-Retrieval Sink Attention (PR-Sink), a bounded KV-cache mechanism combining a Static Sink that permanently anchors the first generated block, a Dynamic Sink that holds a pose-retrieved historical block, and a three-slot Rolling Window. When a pose recurs, PR-Sink restores the relevant appearance context without retaining the entire sequence, so memory and per-block latency remain constant regardless of stream duration. Together with Ulysses sequence parallelism and operator fusion, these designs enable 19.63\,FPS streaming inference on two NVIDIA H100 GPUs. On a three-minute benchmark, LiveAnimate maintains nearly constant perceptual quality and identity from the first 30 seconds to the final minute (IQA 4.047 vs.\ 4.026), while prior systems degrade substantially or require hours of offline computation for the same rollout. These results establish a new operating point in quality, latency, and duration for interactive full-body animation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LiveAnimate，据称是首个结合实时流式与稳定长时生成、规模达十亿级的人类动画系统，基于 14B 参数的视频 Diffusion Transformer (DiT)。系统利用两阶段训练把预训练双向 DiT 变成块因果自回归生成器并把采样步数压到三步，同时引入 Pose-Retrieval Sink Attention (PR-Sink) 有界 KV 缓存，使内存与单块延迟不随流时长增长。在两张 NVIDIA H100 上实现 19.63 FPS 的流式推理，并在三分钟基准上保持近乎恒定的感知质量与身份一致性。
Motivation: 姿态驱动的人类动画对实时交互应用（直播、远程呈现、虚拟化身）至关重要，但现有扩散系统生成单段视频需要数分钟到数小时，无法支持响应式交互。
Method: 采用两阶段训练：第一阶段通过 Reference-Anchored Teacher-Forcing Adaptation 将预训练双向 DiT 适配为块因果自回归生成器；第二阶段通过 Block-wise Self-Forcing Distillation 将采样预算降到三步。引入 PR-Sink，一种有界 KV 缓存机制，包含固定锚定首个生成块的 Static Sink、保存姿态检索历史块的 Dynamic Sink 以及三轮滚动窗口，并配合 Ulysses 序列并行与算子融合。
Result: 在两个 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上实现 19.63 FPS 流式推理；在三分钟基准上，从最初 30 秒到最后一分钟的图像质量保持近乎恒定（IQA 4.047 vs 4.026），而先前系统明显退化或需要数小时离线计算。
Conclusion: 摘要认为这些结果在质量、延迟和时长方面为交互式全身动画建立了新的工作点。
