papers.title: JieZi: A Large-Scale Expert-Audited Dataset and Benchmark for Ancient Chinese Character Exegesis
papers.abstract_en: The scholarly exegesis of ancient Chinese characters demands integrating visual observation, linguistic analysis, and historical context. However, existing computational approaches focus narrowly on subtasks such as character recognition and retrieval, lacking the structured datasets and benchmarks required for comprehensive scholarly analysis. To address this limitation, we introduce Ancient Chinese Character Exegesis (ACCE), a vision-language question answering (VQA) task that models the scholarly exegesis process. ACCE is organized into four progressive levels: basic character identification, glyph-form analysis, meaning exegesis, and diachronic evolution analysis. To support this task, we construct two complementary resources. JieZi-Dataset is the first large-scale, expert-audited VQA training dataset for ACCE, comprising over 500K QA pairs. It is constructed via a pipeline that reduces factual errors by constraining generation with expert-designed templates and source-text references. Human verification is further applied at each key stage to ensure scholarly accuracy. JieZi-Bench is an evaluation benchmark aligned with the exegesis process, constructed and verified by human experts to ensure evaluation reliability. It consists of four levels with reference answers curated from authoritative lexicographic works held separate from the training data. Experiments on multimodal large language models show that current models perform well on basic identification but struggle with glyph analysis, semantic reasoning, and diachronic understanding. Fine-tuning on JieZi-Dataset substantially improves performance across all four levels. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Ran00w/JieZi.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 13 figures. Accepted to the Dataset Track of ACM Multimedia 2026 for oral presentation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出古文字训诂 (Ancient Chinese Character Exegesis, ACCE) 任务，将训诂过程建模为视觉-语言问答 (VQA)，并构建 JieZi-Dataset（超过 500K QA 对）与 JieZi-Bench 评测基准。实验表明多模态大模型在基础识别上表现良好，但在字形分析、语义推理和历时演变理解上较弱；在 JieZi-Dataset 上微调可显著提升四个层级的性能。
Motivation: 现有计算古文字研究局限于识别、检索等子任务，缺少支撑完整学术训诂过程的结构化数据集与基准，难以进行综合性的学术分析。
Method: 定义四级递进的 ACCE 任务：基础字符识别、字形分析、字义训诂、历时演变分析；通过专家设计的模板与源文本引用约束生成 QA 对，并在关键阶段加入人工核验来构建 JieZi-Dataset；另由人类专家依据权威字书构建与训练数据分离的 JieZi-Bench 基准。
Result: 多模态大模型在基础识别任务上表现较好，但在字形分析、语义推理和历时演变理解上表现不足；使用 JieZi-Dataset 微调可全面改善四个层级的性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为将训诂过程显式建模为分层 VQA 任务，并配合专家审核的数据集与基准，有助于推动古文字综合研究。代码与数据集已公开。

papers.title: G0.5: One Autoregressive Stream for Robot Reasoning and Action
papers.abstract_en: The prevailing recipe for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models couples a pretrained VLM with a separately trained flow-matching action expert. This makes the VLM a context encoder rather than a decision-maker. We introduce G0.5, a pretrained autoregressive VLA in which a single transformer decoder emits reasoning and action tokens under a single objective. Three components make this tractable at foundation-model scale: a learnable cross-embodiment action tokenizer that maps heterogeneous robot actions into a shared vocabulary; a native chain-of-thought stream interleaving task decomposition, object grounding, and action hints with action tokens; and a visual memory module that injects multi-second history through the vision encoder. Because reasoning and action share a single set of weights, the pretrained VLM's capabilities carry over to physical behavior: the model follows instructions closely, and prompts directly steer action granularity, task horizon, and out-of-distribution scene handling without further training. Pretrained on a large collection of robot datasets together with VQA samples, G0.5 surpasses state-of-the-art models across 7 independent regimes: real-world fine-tuning on R1lite and R1pro robots (76.7\% vs.\ 53.3\% for $π_{0.5}$ and 24.4\% for GR00T-N1.7), the 2025 BEHAVIOR Challenge on 50 long-horizon household mobile manipulation tasks using a generalist policy (31.4\% vs.\ 26.3\% for $π_{0.5}$ and 26.1\% for the challenge winner), DROID post-training followed by zero-shot transfer to an unseen environment and objects (82.5\%), a language-following Pick-and-Place benchmark, LIBERO (98.9\%), RoboTwin 2.0 (93.3\%), and SimplerEnv-Bridge (87.3\%).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 G0.5，一种预训练的自回归视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，用单个 Transformer decoder 在统一目标下同时生成推理 token 和动作 token，而不是像主流方案那样把预训练 VLM 仅当作上下文编码器并外接 flow-matching 动作专家。模型通过可学习的跨具身动作 tokenizer、原生 chain-of-thought 流和视觉记忆模块，使推理与动作共享同一套权重。摘要报告其在 7 个独立基准上超过现有 SOTA 模型，包括真实机器人微调、BEHAVIOR Challenge、DROID 零样本迁移、LIBERO 等。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型的主流做法是耦合预训练 VLM 与单独训练的 flow-matching 动作专家，这使得 VLM 只承担上下文编码角色而非真正的决策者。作者希望让推理与动作在同一个自回归模型中联合生成，从而继承预训练 VLM 的能力并实现指令跟随和可提示的行为控制。
Method: G0.5 在单一目标下用一个 transformer decoder 同时输出推理 token 和动作 token。三个关键组件使其在基础模型规模下可行：可学习的跨具身动作 tokenizer（将异构机器人动作映射到共享词表）、原生 chain-of-thought 流（在动作 token 间穿插任务分解、物体 grounding 和动作提示）、以及通过视觉编码器注入多秒历史信息的视觉记忆模块。模型在大量机器人数据集和 VQA 样本上预训练。
Result: 摘要报告 G0.5 在 7 个独立基准上超越 SOTA：R1lite/R1pro 真实机器人微调（76.7%，对比 π0.5 的 53.3% 和 GR00T-N1.7 的 24.4%）；2025 BEHAVIOR Challenge 50 个长时程家庭移动操作任务（31.4%，对比 π0.5 的 26.3% 和挑战赛冠军的 26.1%）；DROID 后训练加零样本迁移到未见环境与物体（82.5%）；语言跟随 Pick-and-Place；LIBERO（98.9%）；RoboTwin 2.0（93.3%）；SimplerEnv-Bridge（87.3%）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，因为推理和动作共享同一套权重，预训练 VLM 的能力可以直接迁移到物理行为：模型能紧密遵循指令，且无需额外训练即可通过 prompt 直接控制动作粒度、任务时域和分布外场景处理。

papers.title: Advancing MLLM-based UAV Image Understanding and Reasoning: A Benchmark and a Training-Free Multi-Agent System
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM)-based UAV aerial image understanding and reasoning is essential for aerial intelligence yet poses distinct challenges arising from extreme scale variation, arbitrary camera orientations, and high object density. Despite growing interest, existing evaluations remain fragmented across individual datasets and narrow tasks, leaving a critical gap in unified assessment of UAV understanding and reasoning capabilities. To fill this gap, we construct UAVQA-Bench, a benchmark of 1,500 human-annotated QA pairs drawn from 13 public UAV datasets, covering 6 capability dimensions and 16 tasks in both multiple-choice and visual grounding formats. Systematic evaluation of a broad range of open-source and closed-source MLLMs as well as agent-based systems on UAVQA-Bench identifies three key failure modes: domain-toolset mismatch, unchecked error propagation, and static reasoning. Motivated by these findings, we propose UAV-MAS, a training-free multi-agent system for MLLM-based UAV aerial image understanding and reasoning, comprising a Domain-Specific Perception Engine (DSPE) that routes queries to task-appropriate visual tools, a Context-Aware Iterative Refinement module (CAIR) that validates intermediate reasoning to curb error accumulation, and a Difficulty-Aware Adaptive Search mechanism (DAAS) that adjusts search depth to question difficulty. UAV-MAS with a 32B open-source MLLM achieves 77.0% overall accuracy on UAVQA-Bench, surpassing Gemini 3 Pro by 4.0\%, while the 8B variant improves 8.7\% over its base model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出UAVQA-Bench，一个基于13个公开无人机数据集构建的1,500个人工标注QA对基准，覆盖6个能力维度和16个任务，用于评估MLLM在无人机航拍图像理解与推理上的表现。对多款开源和闭源MLLM及agent系统的评估揭示了三类失败模式：domain-toolset mismatch、unchecked error propagation和static reasoning。作者进一步提出无需训练的multi-agent系统UAV-MAS，由DSPE、CAIR和DAAS三个模块组成，在UAVQA-Bench上以32B开源MLLM达到77.0%总体准确率，超过Gemini 3 Pro 4.0%。
Motivation: 基于MLLM的无人机航拍图像理解与推理面临尺度剧烈变化、任意相机朝向和高目标密度等挑战，现有评估分散在不同数据集和窄任务上，缺乏统一的评测基准。
Method: 构建UAVQA-Bench基准，包含从13个公开无人机数据集收集的1,500个人工标注QA对，覆盖6个能力维度和16个任务，格式包括多项选择和视觉定位。基于评测发现的三种失败模式，提出UAV-MAS：DSPE将查询路由到任务合适的视觉工具，CAIR验证中间推理以遏制错误累积，DAAS根据问题难度调整搜索深度。
Result: 摘要报告UAV-MAS配合32B开源MLLM在UAVQA-Bench上达到77.0%总体准确率，比Gemini 3 Pro高4.0%；8B变体相对其基础模型提升8.7%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调统一的评测基准和无需训练的multi-agent系统能有效提升MLLM在无人机图像理解与推理上的表现；但未提及限制。

summary_sections.motivation: 基于MLLM的无人机航拍图像理解与推理面临尺度剧烈变化、任意相机朝向和高目标密度等挑战，现有评估分散在不同数据集和窄任务上，缺乏统一的评测基准。
summary_sections.method: 构建UAVQA-Bench基准，包含从13个公开无人机数据集收集的1,500个人工标注QA对，覆盖6个能力维度和16个任务，格式包括多项选择和视觉定位。基于评测发现的三种失败模式，提出UAV-MAS：DSPE将查询路由到任务合适的视觉工具，CAIR验证中间推理以遏制错误累积，DAAS根据问题难度调整搜索深度。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告UAV-MAS配合32B开源MLLM在UAVQA-Bench上达到77.0%总体准确率，比Gemini 3 Pro高4.0%；8B变体相对其基础模型提升8.7%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调统一的评测基准和无需训练的multi-agent系统能有效提升MLLM在无人机图像理解与推理上的表现；但未提及限制。

papers.title: Locating and Controlling Implicit Personalization in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) often shift their outputs in response to implicit demographic cues even when users never state a demographic identity. Previous work has documented this behavior, but the connection between these behavioral changes and the model's internal activations remains unclear. Using matched cued and neutral conversations across five LLMs, we establish that a localized internal activation signal tracks changes in recommendations, with correlations up to r=0.87. When multiple cues appear together, their internal signals largely combine, but the changes in output do not simply add up. We further show that removing the internal signal associated with one cue can suppress its influence, often more effectively than asking the model to ignore demographics via prompting, while largely preserving general benchmark performance. However, the ability to selectively remove one dimension's influence while leaving co-present dimensions intact remains highly model- and attribute-specific. These results connect implicit personalization behavior to an internal signal that can be analyzed and causally controlled.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）在用户未明确说明身份时，如何因隐式人口统计线索（implicit demographic cues）而改变输出。作者用五个 LLM 的匹配提示与中性对话，发现一个局部化的内部激活信号能追踪推荐变化，相关系数最高达 r=0.87；多个线索同时出现时内部信号大致叠加，但输出变化并非简单加和。移除某一线索对应的内部信号能比提示模型忽略人口统计更有效地抑制其影响，并大体保持通用基准性能，但这种选择性移除在不同模型和属性上差异很大。
Motivation: 已有工作记录了 LLM 对隐式人口统计线索的行为变化，但这种行为变化与模型内部激活之间的联系尚不清楚。
Method: 在五个 LLM 上构造成对的带线索（cued）与中性（neutral）对话，定位随推荐变化而变化的局部内部激活信号，并对比通过移除该内部信号与通过提示词要求模型忽略人口统计这两种控制方式。
Result: 内部激活信号与推荐变化的相关系数最高达 r=0.87；多个线索的内部信号大体线性组合，但输出变化不满足加和性；移除单一线索的内部信号往往比提示更有效地抑制该线索影响，同时大体保留通用基准性能，但选择性移除的效果高度依赖模型和属性。
Conclusion: 这些结果将隐式个性化行为与可分析且可因果控制的内部信号联系起来。

papers.title: A 12-CNOT Double Qubit Excitation Gate
papers.abstract_en: Effective implementation of high-level quantum gates is essential for practical quantum computing. To the best of our knowledge, we present the first reported 12-CNOT decomposition of the double qubit excitation operator, improving upon state-of-the-art (SOTA) implementations with 13 CNOTs. Our new circuit has the lowest CNOT count (12), lowest CNOT depth (10), and lowest total circuit depth (16) among all the previous SOTA circuits. Further, we only added 2 extra one-qubit gates compared to the lowest one-qubit gate count (11) among the previous SOTA circuits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出双量子比特激发算子（double qubit excitation operator）的首个 12-CNOT 分解，优于此前最优的 13-CNOT 实现。新电路在 CNOT 数量（12）、CNOT 深度（10）和总电路深度（16）上均低于所有先前 SOTA 电路，且相比此前最低的单量子比特门数量（11）仅增加 2 个。
Motivation: 高层级量子门的有效实现是实用量子计算的关键。此前双量子比特激发门的最优分解需要 13 个 CNOT，论文旨在进一步降低 CNOT 开销以提升电路效率。
Method: 提出一种新的双量子比特激发算子的电路分解方案，实现 12 个 CNOT 的分解，并通过电路级优化同时降低 CNOT 深度和总体深度。
Result: 新分解达到最低 CNOT 数（12）、最低 CNOT 深度（10）和最低总电路深度（16），在所有这些指标上优于之前的 SOTA 电路；单量子比特门数量为 13，比此前最低的 11 个仅多 2 个。
Conclusion: 作者报告这是首个 12-CNOT 分解，改进了此前 13-CNOT 的 SOTA 实现，为双量子比特激发门提供了更高效的电路。

papers.title: Fingerprinting Text-to-Image Diffusion Models via Collapsed Generation
papers.abstract_en: Proprietary text-to-image diffusion models are increasingly distributed as hosted services and downloadable checkpoints, making their intellectual property (IP) protection an increasingly critical concern when model leakage, copying, or unauthorized fine-tuning is disputed. In this work, we present a non-invasive model fingerprinting framework based on \emph{collapsed generation}, a phenomenon where certain input conditions produce highly consistent images across multiple stochastic seeds. We show that collapsed generation is an intrinsic, model-dependent property of the learned generation process. These collapse-prone conditions therefore expose model-specific behavioral signatures, enabling reliable ownership verification without embedding invasive watermarks. After preparing conditions on the source model, the framework verifies a suspect model under two access settings: (1) white-box pipeline access, where optimized continuous embeddings can be injected into the generation process, and (2) black-box API-only access, where natural language prompts are queried through the service interface. In both cases, ownership evidence is measured by whether the suspect model reproduces the source model's collapse behavior across stochastic samplings. Extensive experiments across UNet- and transformer-based diffusion models show that collapsed generation fingerprints can distinguish different source models with low confusion. These fingerprints remain verifiable in fine-tuned derivatives and under common and adaptive model- or query-level obfuscations, while requiring only a modest verification query budget. Together, these results establish collapsed generation as a reliable intrinsic evidence source for non-invasive diffusion model ownership verification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种非侵入式的文本到图像扩散模型指纹识别框架，基于“坍缩生成”（collapsed generation）现象——某些输入条件下多个随机种子会生成高度一致的图像——将其作为模型特定的行为签名，用于版权归属验证。框架可在白盒（注入优化连续嵌入）和黑盒（仅API查询）两种访问设置下验证可疑模型，实验表明该方法能低混淆度地区分不同源模型，并在微调衍生模型及常见/自适应混淆下保持可验证性。
Motivation: 专有文本到图像扩散模型常以托管服务和可下载checkpoint形式分发，模型泄露、复制或未授权微调时的知识产权保护成为关键问题；现有侵入式水印需要修改模型，缺乏非侵入式、不改变模型行为的验证手段。
Method: 利用坍缩生成这一模型内在特性构造行为指纹：先在源模型上准备易坍缩的条件（白盒下为优化连续嵌入，黑盒下为自然语言提示），再通过检查可疑模型在多次随机采样中是否复现源模型的坍缩行为来判断归属。
Result: 在UNet和Transformer两类扩散模型上的大量实验显示，坍缩生成指纹能以低混淆度区分不同源模型；这些指纹在微调衍生模型以及常见和自适应的模型级/查询级混淆下仍可验证，且只需适度的验证查询预算。
Conclusion: 摘要将坍缩生成确立为一种可靠的内在证据来源，可用于非侵入式的扩散模型所有权验证，无需嵌入水印。

papers.title: Harness-IF: Evaluating Instruction Following Across Instruction Surfaces in Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: When a coding agent obeys a rule, it may simply have been going to do that anyway. Existing instruction-following benchmarks cannot tell the difference: they concentrate rules in the user turn, while coding-agent benchmarks emphasize final task success. We introduce Harness-IF, which scores operational rules one at a time from execution evidence: 60 realistic multi-turn coding items drawn from a 642-rule library, 256 rules receiving verdicts, placed on the five configurable surfaces a deployed agent reads. To separate compliance from coincidence we introduce Against-Prior Accuracy (AP-Acc), which scores only rules labeled as opposing unprompted defaults, observed by re-running tasks with the rule withheld across nine probe builds and curated otherwise. Across 12 frontier models, accuracy spans 72.1-85.9% and AP-Acc 66.1-78.6%; every model is worse on against-prior rules, by 3.6 to 7.4 points (mean 5.81), and the direction survives a common-support analysis with item-clustered intervals. Aggregate scores therefore overstate compliance by a model-specific margin: prior control leaves the top build unchanged and exchanges three adjacent rank pairs. A counterbalanced conflict pilot on nine separate builds adds a second result: pooled precedence does not follow prompt depth, with system prompts, project files, and user instructions ahead of tool and skill descriptions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Harness-IF，一个针对编码代理指令遵循的评估基准，通过执行证据逐条给操作规则打分。基准包含 60 个真实多轮编码任务、256 条有判定的规则，分布在部署代理读取的五个可配置表面上，并引入 Against-Prior Accuracy (AP-Acc) 以区分真正服从规则与碰巧如此。在 12 个前沿模型上，准确率为 72.1%-85.9%，AP-Acc 为 66.1%-78.6%，所有模型在反对先验规则的条目上均更差；另一个冲突试点还显示提示优先级不遵循提示深度。
Motivation: 现有指令遵循基准将规则集中在用户轮次，编码代理基准则强调最终任务成功，因此无法判断代理遵守规则是真的服从还是本来就会那样做。
Method: 构建 Harness-IF：从 642 条规则库中抽取 60 个多轮任务，其中 256 条规则获得判定，并放置在五个可配置表面；引入 AP-Acc 指标，只对标记为反对无提示默认值的规则打分，通过撤走规则重跑任务观察行为差异，并设置九个探针构建；另设一个 counterbalanced conflict pilot 比较不同表面的优先级。
Result: 在 12 个前沿模型中，准确率跨度 72.1%-85.9%，AP-Acc 跨度 66.1%-78.6%；每个模型在反对先验规则上的表现都更差，差距为 3.6 到 7.4 个百分点（平均 5.81），该结论在共同支持分析中成立。先验控制使顶部队列保持不变，并交换了三对相邻排名对；冲突试点显示系统提示、项目文件和用户指令优先于工具和技能描述。
Conclusion: 聚合的指令遵循分数会以模型特定的幅度高估真实服从度；提示优先级并不随提示深度变化。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Proportional Analogies on Probability Distributions via Bayesian Updating
papers.abstract_en: Analogies are quaternary relations of the form "A is to B as C is to D". Among the various formalizations of analogical reasoning, proportional analogies provide an important axiomatic framework by characterizing valid analogies through a set of postulates. While proportional analogies have been extensively studied over Boolean, symbolic, and real-valued domains, their extension to probability distributions remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we introduce a notion of proportional analogy for probability distributions based on Bayesian updating. Our approach builds upon the idea that two distributions are related whenever one can be transformed into the other through Bayesian updating induced by a suitable set of observations. We investigate this framework for several standard members of the exponential family and discuss how it naturally extends to arbitrary probability distributions through Gaussian mixture approximations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于贝叶斯更新（Bayesian updating）的概率分布上的比例类比（proportional analogy）概念，用合适观测集合诱导的贝叶斯更新来刻画两个分布之间的转换关系。作者在指数族（exponential family）的若干标准成员上研究该框架，并讨论通过高斯混合近似（Gaussian mixture approximations）将其推广到任意概率分布。
Motivation: 比例类比已在布尔、符号和实值域上被广泛研究，但扩展到概率分布领域仍基本空白；本文旨在填补这一缺口，为概率分布建立比例类比的公理化形式化。
Method: 以贝叶斯更新为基础定义分布间的比例类比：当且仅当一个分布可通过由合适观测集诱导的贝叶斯更新转换为另一个分布时，称两者相关。该框架在指数族若干标准成员上得到实例化，并借助高斯混合近似扩展到任意分布。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数值或基准结果；主要贡献是给出基于贝叶斯更新的概率分布比例类比定义、其在指数族中的实例化以及面向任意分布的扩展路径。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架将比例类比从布尔、符号和实值域延伸至概率分布，且可通过高斯混合近似处理一般分布情形。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 以贝叶斯更新为基础定义分布间的比例类比：当且仅当一个分布可通过由合适观测集诱导的贝叶斯更新转换为另一个分布时，称两者相关。该框架在指数族若干标准成员上得到实例化，并借助高斯混合近似扩展到任意分布。
summary_sections.result: 摘要未报告具体实验数值或基准结果；主要贡献是给出基于贝叶斯更新的概率分布比例类比定义、其在指数族中的实例化以及面向任意分布的扩展路径。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调该框架将比例类比从布尔、符号和实值域延伸至概率分布，且可通过高斯混合近似处理一般分布情形。

papers.title: Chain-of-Thought Shows the Path to a Tree: Realizing Branching Complexity
papers.abstract_en: Chain of Thought (CoT) lifts the expressive ceiling of bounded-depth Transformers, with characterizations tying the number of CoT steps to circuit complexity classes. What remains largely missing are concrete instantiations with explicit, depth-bounded constructions, and the traversal procedures such characterizations presuppose. We close this gap for branching complexity. We give CoT realizations of depth-first search (DFS) and of Dijkstra algorithm, the latter subsuming breadth-first search, by unique hard-attention decoders of at most two layers, and use them as a shared computational substrate: reusing the DFS decoder yields the Strahler number of an $n$-vertex tree in $2n-1$ steps with four layers, and reusing the Dijkstra decoder yields its width in $n-1$ steps with three. Since computing the Strahler number of a binary tree given as a term is \textsf{NC\textsuperscript{1}}-complete, and our constructions handle arbitrary $n$-ary trees without layer normalization or positional encodings, this is a non-trivial witness for the linear-step regime of the CoT hierarchy. Exploiting the classical bijection between ordered trees and Dyck paths, itself realized by our DFS construction, which emits the path as it traverses, we give independent constructions for both measures on the path representation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为有界深度 Transformer 的思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）研究补齐了具体的深度有界构造：作者给出深度优先搜索（DFS）与 Dijkstra 算法的 CoT 实现，二者都只用至多两层且具有唯一硬注意力（hard attention）的解码器。以这两个解码器为共享计算基元，作者用 4 层在 2n-1 步内计算 n 顶点树的 Strahler 数，用 3 层在 n-1 步内计算树的宽度；这些构造不依赖层归一化或位置编码，并支持任意 n 叉树。论文还将有序树与 Dyck 路径的经典双射通过 DFS 构造实现，并在路径表示上给出两种度量的独立构造。
Motivation: 现有理论工作已把 CoT 步数与电路复杂度类联系起来，但缺少具有显式、深度有界构造的具体实例，也缺少这些刻画所预设的遍历过程。
Method: 作者给出唯一硬注意力解码器（至多两层）对 DFS 和 Dijkstra（涵盖 BFS）的 CoT 实现，并复用 DFS 解码器计算 Strahler 数、复用 Dijkstra 解码器计算树宽，同时利用 DFS 构造实现有序树与 Dyck 路径的双射，在路径表示上给出独立构造。
Result: 摘要报告：用 4 层在 2n-1 步内计算 Strahler 数，用 3 层在 n-1 步内计算树宽；由于以项形式给出的二叉树 Strahler 数计算是 NC¹-完全的，该构造成为 CoT 层级中线性步数区间的非平凡见证，且适用于任意 n 叉树并免去层归一化和位置编码。
Conclusion: 作者强调这些深度有界的显式构造为 CoT 层级的线性步数区间提供了非平凡证据，并说明其方法可同时作用于树表示与 Dyck 路径表示。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: When the API Speaks the Wrong Language: Revisiting Post-Training for Multilingual Tool Use
papers.abstract_en: The reliability of Large Language Models (LLMs) for API calling degrades in multilingual settings. A common failure occurs when a model selects the correct tool but generates argument values in an inconsistent language, which we term Argument Language Mismatch (ALM). Although semantically correct, such outputs are operationally invalid and not captured by standard API-calling metrics. We revisit post-training strategies for mitigating ALM and find that, in our benchmark, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) provides a strong baseline, substantially improving argument language consistency and end-to-end function call accuracy. Under consistent model selection, SFT achieves performance comparable to, and sometimes exceeding more complex reinforcement learning (RL) approaches. We further examine whether RL with structured, argument-aware rewards offers additional benefits. While methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) can improve language consistency and better preserve general reasoning ability, these gains are incremental and most pronounced in generalization and multi-objective trade-offs. Overall, our results suggest that much of the performance in multilingual API grounding can be achieved through careful supervised training, with RL providing targeted rather than fundamental improvements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多语言环境下 LLM 调用 API 的可靠性问题，聚焦于模型选对工具但生成的参数值语言不一致的失败模式，作者称之为 Argument Language Mismatch (ALM)。作者重新考察后训练 (post-training) 策略，发现监督微调 (SFT) 已构成强基线，在参数语言一致性和端到端函数调用准确率上表现良好；在模型选择一致时，SFT 的效果可与更复杂的强化学习 (RL) 方法相当甚至更好。基于 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 的参数感知奖励可带来语言一致性提升并较好保持通用推理能力，但增益是增量式的。
Motivation: LLM 的 API 调用可靠性在多语言场景下会下降，常见失败是模型选对工具但参数值使用语言不一致 (ALM)，这类输出语义正确但在操作上无效，且现有 API 调用指标无法捕捉。
Method: 重新审视缓解 ALM 的后训练策略：以 SFT 作为基线，并对比带结构化、参数感知 (argument-aware) 奖励的 RL 方法，特别是 GRPO。
Result: 在作者构建的基准上，SFT 显著提升参数语言一致性和端到端函数调用准确率；在模型选择一致时，SFT 达到与 RL 相当甚至更优的性能。GRPO 能提升语言一致性并更好地保持通用推理能力，但增益有限，主要体现在泛化与多目标权衡上。
Conclusion: 多语言 API grounding 的大部分性能可通过精心设计的监督训练获得，RL 提供的是针对性而非根本性的改进。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: High-dimensional Multi-objective Bayesian Optimization with Learned Variable Interactions
papers.abstract_en: Multi-objective Bayesian optimization (MOBO) is effective in identifying the Pareto fronts for expensive black-box problems. However, most current MOBO approaches are limited to low-dimensional decision space due to its exponential sampling complexity. This paper presents decision variable interaction analysis-based MOBO, ViaMOBO, a generic framework for expensive multi-objective problems with high-dimensional decision space. The key idea of ViaMOBO is that it utilizes a variable interaction analysis model to determine whether the decision space can be completely or partially divided, and then performs local Bayesian optimization in the divided decision subspaces. Through the variable analysis model, it can be derived whether the objectives in black-box problems are separable, partially separable, or non-separable based on the potential independent or interdependent relationships among decision variables without any strong assumptions. We compare ViaMOBO with the state-of-the-art MOBO methods on both synthetic and real-world benchmarks. The experimental results demonstrate that ViaMOBO outperforms other related MOBO baselines in approximating the Pareto front of high-dimensional expensive multi-objective problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ViaMOBO，一种面向高维昂贵多目标问题的高维多目标贝叶斯优化（MOBO）通用框架。其核心是利用变量交互分析模型判断决策空间是否可完全或部分划分，然后在划分出的子空间内执行局部贝叶斯优化。在合成和真实基准上，ViaMOBO 在逼近 Pareto 前沿方面优于现有 MOBO 基线。
Motivation: 现有 MOBO 方法大多局限于低维决策空间，因为采样复杂度随维度指数增长，难以直接处理高维昂贵黑箱多目标问题。
Method: 通过变量交互分析模型判断目标函数是可分离、部分可分离还是不可分离，据此将决策空间完全或部分划分，并在各子空间内进行局部贝叶斯优化，无需强假设。
Result: 在合成与真实世界基准上，ViaMOBO 在逼近高维昂贵多目标问题的 Pareto 前沿方面优于相关 MOBO 基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调变量交互分析驱动的决策空间划分能够有效扩展 MOBO 到高维情形，但未给出具体数值或局限性说明。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Making Your LLMs More Objective: Stabilizing LLM Safety Behavior Across Traits with Trait-Invariant Safety Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Aligned large language models (LLMs) are expected to exhibit safety behavior based on the content of the user request: they should refuse unsafe requests and comply with safe ones. However, we show that the same request can elicit substantially different safety decisions under different traits assigned in the system prompt, a failure mode we call trait-induced safety variation. To measure this failure, we introduce refusal-based metrics: Trait-Induced Deviation measures dataset-level deviation from the no-trait baseline, while Trait-Induced Flip Rate measures whether the same request receives different safety decisions across traits. We then provide a representation-level analysis of the mechanism behind trait-induced safety shifts and find that traits perturb the model's safety representations within a low-dimensional subspace. To achieve trait-invariant safety, where safety behavior remains stable across traits, we introduce Trait-Invariant Safety Tuning (TIST), a simple yet effective self-distillation framework that aligns an LLM's trait-conditioned behavior with its no-trait behavior. Guided by our analysis, we further propose Trait-Subspace Neutralization (TraSN), an instantiation of TIST, which enforces invariance only within the identified trait subspace. Experiments show that TraSN improves trait-invariant safety and strengthens harmful-request safety while preserving general capability. Our results highlight traits as an important factor in LLM safety and robust model behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出对齐大语言模型 (LLM) 的拒答行为会随系统提示中指定的人格特质 (trait) 而显著变化，称为 trait-induced safety variation。作者提出基于拒答行为的指标（Trait-Induced Deviation 与 Trait-Induced Flip Rate），并从表示层面分析发现特质会在低维子空间内扰动安全表示。为稳定跨特质的安全行为，作者提出 Trait-Invariant Safety Tuning (TIST) 及其实例 Trait-Subspace Neutralization (TraSN)，实验显示该方法在提升有害请求安全性的同时保持通用能力。
Motivation: 对齐 LLM 应依据请求内容决定是否拒绝，但同一请求在不同系统提示特质下可能得到不同的安全决策，这种 trait-induced safety variation 是现有安全对齐中未被充分研究的失败模式。
Method: 提出自蒸馏框架 TIST，将模型在特质条件下的行为与其无特质基线行为对齐；并基于表示分析提出 TraSN，仅在识别出的特质子空间内实施不变性约束。
Result: 摘要报告 TraSN 改善了 trait-invariant safety，增强了对有害请求的安全性，同时保持通用能力。
Conclusion: 结果表明特质是影响 LLM 安全行为的重要因素，凸显了在安全对齐中考虑特质不变性的必要性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Robust and Efficient Noisy-Label Time-Series Classification via Dynamic Time Warping Based Granular Ball Computing
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic Time Warping (DTW)-based Nearest-Neighbor (NN) classifiers are effective for time-series classification but are vulnerable to mislabeled training samples and require numerous DTW computations during inference. We propose DTW-based Granular Ball Computing (DTW-GBC), which organizes temporally similar training samples into granular balls and performs classification at the granule level. We further develop two granular-ball construction strategies for DTW-GBC. Experiments on four benchmark datasets with symmetric label noise show that the two DTW-GBC variants generally mitigate the performance degradation caused by label noise while requiring substantially fewer comparisons than DTW-based 1-NN during inference. These findings suggest that DTW-GBC provides a favorable balance between classification robustness and inference efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于动态时间规整的粒球计算（DTW-based Granular Ball Computing, DTW-GBC），用于带噪标签的时间序列分类。方法将时间上相似的训练样本组织成粒球（granular balls），在粒球层面进行分类，并给出两种粒球构造策略。在四个基准数据集上的对称标签噪声实验中，两种变体普遍缓解了标签噪声导致的性能下降，同时推理时所需的 DTW 比较次数远少于 DTW 1-NN。
Motivation: DTW 最近邻分类器在时间序列分类上有效，但容易受错误标注训练样本影响，且推理时需要大量 DTW 计算；论文针对这两个问题提出更鲁棒且高效的分类框架。
Method: 提出 DTW-GBC，把时间上相似的训练样本组织为粒球，并将分类从样本级提升到粒球级；同时开发了两种粒球构造策略来配合 DTW-GBC。
Result: 在四个基准数据集上加入对称标签噪声的实验表明，DTW-GBC 的两个变体普遍缓解了标签噪声带来的性能下降，并在推理阶段显著减少了与 DTW 1-NN 相比所需的比较次数。
Conclusion: 作者认为 DTW-GBC 在分类鲁棒性与推理效率之间提供了较好的平衡。
Relevance: 10

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为 DTW-GBC 在分类鲁棒性与推理效率之间提供了较好的平衡。

papers.title: Consolidator: Learning Persistent Routed Memory Across Context Boundaries
papers.abstract_en: Copying short-term memory (STM) into a slower store can preserve state across a context boundary, but persistence alone does not ensure that the retained state influences subsequent memory access. We test this distinction in a Phasor Memory Network (PMNet) using Consolidator, a shared slot-local operator that transforms routed STM before accumulating it into long-term memory (LTM), without replaying the source tokens. After each consolidation, the KV cache and STM are cleared. The retained LTM can still be read and is also fed into the hierarchical router, thereby conditioning which explicit-memory slots subsequent inputs access. We evaluate this mechanism on a two-segment modulo-10 mapping task in which the second segment updates the mapping at the same memory address. Following a second consolidation and reset, a held-out query must recover the updated mapping from LTM. The backbone and memory interface are frozen, leaving only 12.35K Consolidator parameters trainable (0.041\% of a 29.95M model). Across five paired runs from the same STM-pretraining checkpoint, direct LTM routing raises updated-mapping recall from $44.38\pm1.94\%$ to $87.02\pm1.76\%$ ($+42.64\pm1.10$ percentage points), while immediate STM recall remains 89.90\% in both conditions; both train separate Consolidators and retain the same LTM read paths. Learned consolidation outperforms forced identity accumulation by $21.40\pm1.91$ percentage points without routing and $68.70\pm1.76$ with routing. Thus, on this task, consolidated LTM serves as both retrievable content and an access state that shapes subsequent slot selection.

TL;DR: 本文提出 Consolidator，一个共享的 slot-local 算子，在 Phasor Memory Network (PMNet) 中先把被路由的短期记忆 (STM) 变换后再累积到长期记忆 (LTM)，且不重放源 token。每次 consolidation 后 KV cache 与 STM 被清空，残留的 LTM 既可被读取，也会送入层次路由器，从而影响后续输入访问哪些显式记忆槽。作者在二段式 modulo-10 映射任务上验证该机制：冻结 backbone 和记忆接口，仅训练 12.35K 个 Consolidator 参数（占 29.95M 模型的 0.041%）。
Motivation: 把短期记忆复制到更慢的存储可以跨上下文边界保留状态，但仅靠持久化并不保证被保留的状态会影响后续记忆访问。论文直接检验这一区别，关注持久化内容与访问状态之间的耦合。
Method: Consolidator 是一个共享的 slot-local 算子，在将路由后的 STM 累积进 LTM 之前对其做变换；consolidation 后清空 KV cache 和 STM，不再重放源 token。保留的 LTM 既作为可读内容，又被输入层次路由器，从而调节后续输入访问哪些显式记忆槽。任务设定为两段式 modulo-10 映射更新，第二次 consolidation 与 reset 后，用 held-out query 从 LTM 恢复更新后的映射。
Result: 在五对来自同一 STM 预训练检查点的运行中，直接 LTM 路由把更新映射召回率从 44.38±1.94% 提升到 87.02±1.76%（+42.64±1.10 个百分点），而即时 STM 召回率在两种条件下均为 89.90%。学习式 consolidation 比强制恒等累积分别高出 21.40±1.91 个百分点（无路由）和 68.70±1.76 个百分点（有路由）。
Conclusion: 在该任务上，consolidated LTM 同时充当可检索的内容和塑造后续槽位选择的访问状态 (access state)。摘要未提及其他任务或通用性的证据。

papers.title: STAR: A Spatial-Topology Aware Routing Framework for Generalizable 3D Scene Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Constructing a unified 3D scene understanding model has long been hindered by the topological discrepancies across sensor modalities. While applying the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture is a flexible approach for multi-domain 3D understanding, we observe that conventional feature-only MoE routers may underrepresent local sampling topology under semantic supervision, making expert allocation difficult when semantic consistency coexists with geometric heterogeneity. To overcome this challenge, we propose STAR (Spatial-Topology Aware Routing Framework). Specifically, we introduce a multi-attribute self-supervised pre-training branch, covering topological and textural variations, to anchor cross-domain structural priors. Building upon this, we design a domain-aware expert branch with two mechanisms: Domain-Spatial-Guided Routing (DSR), which captures local topological variations from spatial context, and Entropy-controlled Dynamic Allocation (EDA), which adjusts the number of activated experts according to routing uncertainty. Together, these branches combine stable cross-domain representation learning with adaptive expert allocation. Extensive experiments across various tasks, encompassing both indoor and outdoor scenes, demonstrate the effectiveness of STAR. It achieves 80.1% mIoU on the ScanNet validation set and 77.2% mIoU on S3DIS, consistently improving over strong baselines. Code is available at our project page (https://xmw666.github.io/STAR/).
papers.comment: The third author is the corresponding author
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 STAR（Spatial-Topology Aware Routing Framework），用于可泛化的统一 3D 场景理解，解决不同传感器模态间的拓扑差异问题。作者观察到常规基于特征的 MoE 路由器在语义监督下可能低估局部采样拓扑，因此引入多属性自监督预训练分支来锚定跨域结构先验，并设计带 Domain-Spatial-Guided Routing (DSR) 与 Entropy-controlled Dynamic Allocation (EDA) 的领域感知专家分支。摘要报告该方法在 ScanNet 验证集上达到 80.1% mIoU，在 S3DIS 上达到 77.2% mIoU，稳定超过强基线。
Motivation: 构建统一的 3D 场景理解模型长期受传感器模态间的拓扑差异阻碍；现有仅基于特征的 MoE 路由器在语义一致性与几何异质性并存时，难以合理分配专家，导致专家分配困难。
Method: 提出 STAR 框架，包含一个覆盖拓扑与纹理变化的多属性自监督预训练分支，以及一个领域感知专家分支；后者通过 DSR 从空间上下文捕获局部拓扑变化，并通过 EDA 依据路由不确定性动态调整激活专家数量，从而将稳定的跨域表示学习与自适应专家分配结合起来。
Result: 在室内与室外多种任务上的大量实验表明该方法有效，摘要给出在 ScanNet 验证集上 80.1% mIoU、在 S3DIS 上 77.2% mIoU，并一致性地优于强基线。
Conclusion: 作者强调结合稳定的跨域表示学习与自适应专家分配可以提升 3D 场景理解的可泛化性，并已在项目页面公开代码。

papers.title: REOPD: Reliability-Adaptive Reward Extrapolation for On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own trajectories under dense token-level supervision from a teacher. Reward-extrapolation methods such as ExOPD amplify the teacher-reference log-likelihood ratio to move beyond direct imitation, but apply a single global coefficient $λ$ to every token. This can drive the student to fit extreme peaks in the implicit reward, causing reward hacking and unstable training, and the optimal $λ$ varies across domains, requiring costly sweeps. We propose REOPD, a reliability-adaptive reward extrapolation framework for OPD. REOPD combines a token-level compatibility weight with a batch-level adaptive budget, yielding a token-wise coefficient $λ_{b,t}=1+γ_b q_t$ that preserves teacher alignment while selectively extrapolating along reliable teacher-reference directions. It requires no verifier, reward model, value model, or extra rollout beyond standard OPD. REOPD outperforms G-OPD on single-teacher mathematics and on both domains in the multi-teacher setting, while matching G-OPD on single-teacher code, demonstrating effective fine-grained reliability adaptation across domains and teacher configurations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 REOPD，一种用于 on-policy distillation (OPD) 的可靠性自适应奖励外推框架。REOPD 通过 token 级兼容性权重与 batch 级自适应预算，构造 token 级系数 λ_{b,t}=1+γ_b q_t，在保持教师对齐的同时沿可靠方向选择性外推。摘要报告其在单教师数学任务和多教师设置的两个领域上超越 G-OPD，在单教师代码任务上与 G-OPD 持平。
Motivation: 现有奖励外推方法（如 ExOPD）对所有 token 使用同一全局系数 λ，容易导致学生拟合隐式奖励中的极端峰值，引发 reward hacking 和训练不稳定；且最优 λ 随领域变化，需要昂贵的超参数搜索。
Method: REOPD 将 token 级兼容性权重与 batch 级自适应预算结合，得到逐 token 系数 λ_{b,t}=1+γ_b q_t，在保持教师对齐的同时仅沿可靠的教师参考方向进行外推。该方法不需要 verifier、奖励模型、价值模型或标准 OPD 之外的额外 rollout。
Result: 在单教师设置下，REOPD 在数学任务上优于 G-OPD，在代码任务上与 G-OPD 持平；在多教师设置下，两个领域均优于 G-OPD，表明其细粒度可靠性自适应在不同领域和教师配置下有效。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，无需额外模型或 rollout 的细粒度可靠性自适应奖励外推能够提升 OPD 在多种教师配置下的表现。

papers.title: Boundary-Enhanced Segmentation of Pig Point Clouds in Commercial Housing Environments
papers.abstract_en: In real pigsty environments, pig point clouds often come into close contact with background structures, resulting in blurred target boundaries, local adhesion, and background mis-segmentation. This reduces the accuracy of subsequent point cloud completion and body size measurement. To address these challenges, this study proposes a pig point cloud segmentation method based on boundary feature analysis. The proposed method adopts Octree Transformer as the backbone network and integrates local geometric details with global semantic context through octree convolution, self-attention encoding, and multi-scale feature fusion. Furthermore, soft-distance boundary pseudo-labels are generated to provide continuous boundary supervision, and a bidirectional cross-boundary semantic module is designed to enable explicit interaction between boundary and semantic features. Experiments conducted on a comprehensive dataset demonstrate that the proposed method significantly outperforms various state-of-the-art models in terms of segmentation accuracy, mean intersection over union, and boundary delineation. The results indicate that the method effectively alleviates boundary adhesion, providing reliable point cloud inputs for downstream precision livestock farming tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对真实猪舍环境中猪点云与背景粘连导致的边界模糊和误分割问题，提出一种基于边界特征分析的猪点云分割方法。方法以 Octree Transformer 为骨干，结合八叉树卷积、自注意力编码和多尺度特征融合，并引入软距离边界伪标签与双向跨边界语义模块进行显式边界-语义交互。实验表明方法在分割精度、平均交并比和边界描绘上显著优于多种现有模型。
Motivation: 在真实猪舍环境中，猪点云常与背景结构紧密接触，造成目标边界模糊、局部粘连和背景误分割，进而降低后续点云补全与体尺测量的精度，影响精准畜牧业下游任务。
Method: 提出基于边界特征分析的分割方法：采用 Octree Transformer 作为骨干网络，通过八叉树卷积、自注意力编码和多尺度特征融合整合局部几何细节与全局语义上下文；生成软距离边界伪标签以提供连续边界监督，并设计双向跨边界语义模块使边界特征与语义特征显式交互。
Result: 在综合数据集上的实验表明，该方法在分割精度、平均交并比和边界描绘方面显著优于多种 state-of-the-art 模型，并有效缓解边界粘连问题。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法能有效减轻边界粘连，为下游精准畜牧业任务（如点云补全和体尺测量）提供可靠的点云输入。

papers.title: The Wording Effect: Quantifying Two-Way Drift in LLM Benchmark Performance
papers.abstract_en: A benchmark score comes from a single phrasing of each problem. That single phrasing is treated as if it stood for the whole space of ways the same problem could be asked, but it does not. We show that rephrasing a problem while keeping its meaning and answer fixed routinely flips a model's answer in both directions, so some failures become successes and some successes become failures. We call this drift. BenchDrift generates meaning-preserving variations of benchmark problems along four axes, namely linguistic, referential, pragmatic, and structural, and measures how often, and why, correctness flips under each. Across eight models and three benchmarks (GSM8K, MMLU, MATH-Hard), we observe that drift is large in both directions. Two findings stand out. First, phrasing sensitivity does not fade as models get better. Instead, it changes sign. Weak models gain more from rephrasing than they lose, while strong models lose far more than they gain. We find that the best models on a benchmark are therefore the ones whose scores depend most on the wording they happened to be given. Second, the models largely agree on which rephrasings cost the most correct answers even though they differ in how much they drift, so fragility belongs to the rephrasing and not to the model. Furthermore, rephrasing breaks answers a model was confident about, whether the problem is made shorter or longer. Code and Data: https://github.com/IBM/BenchDrift/tree/demo-ui
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 LLM 基准测试分数对问题措辞的敏感性，提出 BenchDrift 工具，沿语言（linguistic）、指称（referential）、语用（pragmatic）和结构（structural）四个轴生成保持语义与答案固定的改写，并测量正确性在两个方向上的翻转。在八个模型和 GSM8K、MMU、MATH-Hard 三个基准上，作者发现双向漂移都很大，且措辞敏感度并不随模型变强而消失。
Motivation: 基准分数只来自每个问题的一种固定表述，却被当作整个提问空间的代表；作者指出这种单一表述并不能代表同义提问空间，且改写会在两个方向上翻转模型答案，导致评测分数不可靠。
Method: 提出 BenchDrift 框架，沿语言、指称、语用和结构四个轴生成保持意义与答案不变的变体，并量化正确性翻转的频率及原因。
Result: 在八个模型和三个基准上观察到双向漂移很大；措辞敏感度并不随模型能力增强而消失而是改变符号：弱模型从改写得益多于损失，强模型损失远多于收益，因而最强的模型恰恰是分数最依赖所碰巧给定措辞的模型。不同模型在哪些改写最伤正确率上高度一致，表明脆弱性属于改写而非模型；改写还会破坏模型本来自信的答案，无论问题被变短还是变长。
Conclusion: 作者强调基准评分的措辞效应使得最佳模型的分数高度依赖其碰巧得到的表述，且脆弱性存在于改写本身而非具体模型；这对基准设计与模型评估的稳健性提出警示。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: HUGIN: Enhancing Vision-Language Planning for Autonomous Logistics Sorting
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous logistics sorting systems (ALSS) are an important industrial application of embodied AI, which requires joint planning over spatially disjoint camera views. We formulate this setting as Joint Multi-Scene Understanding (JMSU). With open-world visual understanding and task-planning capabilities, vision-language models (VLMs) are promising candidates for JMSU. However, directly applying existing VLMs to JMSU is non-trivial due to scarce cross-scene supervision and attention dispersion caused by long visual context in JMSU. To address these challenges, we propose HUGIN, a training framework with two complementary components. Endogenous Data Augmentation recombines verified atomic facts under operating constraints, while Global Context Ranking aligns the instruction representation more strongly with the complete visual context than with a partial visual context. To support ongoing research, we construct a high-quality industrial sorting dataset and benchmark named SortingBench from four layouts of autonomous logistics sorting systems. Across five open VLMs, HUGIN consistently outperforms matched baselines; for example, the accuracy on SortingBench of Qwen3-VL-8B increases from 63.6% to 78.8%. Additional experiments verify the effectiveness of each component and JMSU's spillover benefits in embodied tasks. Deployment tests involving more than 15,000 packages support the practical viability of VLM-based planning for autonomous logistics sorting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向自主物流分拣系统 (autonomous logistics sorting systems) 中的具身智能规划问题，将其形式化为 Joint Multi-Scene Understanding (JMSU)，并提出训练框架 HUGIN。HUGIN 包含内生数据增强 (Endogenous Data Augmentation) 与全局上下文排序 (Global Context Ranking) 两个互补组件，并配套构建了工业级数据集与基准 SortingBench。实验表明，在五个开源 VLM 上 HUGIN 均优于对应基线，例如 Qwen3-VL-8B 的准确率从 63.6% 提升到 78.8%。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 直接应用于 JMSU 存在两个难点：跨场景监督信号稀缺，以及长视觉上下文导致注意力分散，因此需要专门设计训练方法来增强 VLM 在空间分离相机视图下的联合规划能力。
Method: 提出 HUGIN 训练框架，包含两个组件：内生数据增强在运行约束下重组已验证的原子事实以扩充训练数据；全局上下文排序则让指令表示与完整视觉上下文的对齐强于与部分视觉上下文的对齐，从而缓解注意力分散问题。
Result: 在 SortingBench 上，HUGIN 在五个开放 VLM 上一致优于匹配基线，其中 Qwen3-VL-8B 准确率从 63.6% 提升至 78.8%；消融实验验证了各组件的有效性，并展示 JMSU 在具身任务中的外溢收益。部署测试涉及超过 15,000 个包裹，支持 VLM 规划在自主物流分拣中的实际可行性。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，通过针对跨场景监督和长视觉上下文设计的训练组件，VLM 能够胜任自主物流分拣中的联合多场景规划任务，且该方法在实际部署中具备可行性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LEMUR: Latent Entropy-aware Multimodal Unlearning via Visual-anchored Reasoning Redirection
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training equips multimodal large reasoning models (MLRMs) with exploratory chains of thought (CoT), substantially improving visual reasoning. However, we find that this capability introduces a distinct privacy vulnerability: even when a sensitive fact is successfully unlearned from the final answer, the model may still reproduce it in its reasoning trace. This leakage is substantially more pronounced in natively RL-trained MLRMs than in their non -reasoning base models, revealing a privacy risk that existing unlearning methods are not designed to address. We show that RL-induced exploration leaves sensitive content with a distinctive token-level entropy signature that is largely absent from base models. Based on this observation, we propose LEMUR, a fully training-free, inference-time unlearning framework for natively RL-trained multimodal models. LEMUR uses entropy dynamics as a control signal to identify when sensitive reasoning begins and when sanitization should stop. During this interval, it redirects the reasoning trajectory through entropy-modulated visual-anchor latent injection, replacing committed tokens with sanitized, probability-weighted embeddings re-grounded in the input image. Across diverse MLRMs, LEMUR consistently outperforms existing unlearning met hods in suppressing both reasoning-trace and answer leakage, while better preserving non-sensitive utility and output fluency. These results demonstrate that RL-induced entropy dynamics provide a distinctive signal for privacy leakage and that exploiting this signal enables effective training-free unlearning for reasoning-capable multimodal models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现强化学习（RL）后训练赋予多模态大推理模型（MLRM）探索性思维链（CoT）能力的同时，引入了一种隐私漏洞：即使敏感事实已从最终答案中被成功遗忘，模型仍可能在推理轨迹中复现该事实，且此现象在原生 RL 训练的 MLRM 中比非推理基础模型更明显。作者据此提出 LEMUR，一个完全免训练（training-free）的推理时遗忘框架，利用 token 级熵动态作为控制信号定位敏感推理区间，并通过熵调制的视觉锚点潜在注入（visual-anchor latent injection）将已生成的 token 替换为重新锚定到输入图像的概率加权嵌入。实验表明，该方法在多种 MLRM 上优于现有遗忘方法，在抑制推理轨迹与答案泄漏的同时更好地保留非敏感效用和输出流畅性。
Motivation: 现有遗忘方法未考虑 RL 训练带来的推理链隐私泄漏：模型可能绕过最终答案而在 CoT 推理轨迹中输出敏感内容，且这种泄漏在原生 RL 训练的推理模型中显著强于基础模型。
Method: LEMUR 是推理时的免训练遗忘框架：以熵动态作为控制信号判断敏感推理何时开始、清洗应在何时停止，并在该区间内通过熵调制的视觉锚点潜在注入，将已提交的 token 替换为重新基于输入图像的概率加权嵌入。
Result: 在多种 MLRM 上，LEMUR 一致优于现有遗忘方法，既能更有效地抑制推理轨迹和最终答案的敏感信息泄漏，也能更好地保留非敏感内容效用与输出流畅性。
Conclusion: 作者认为 RL 诱导出的熵动态为隐私泄漏提供了独特信号，利用该信号可以实现面向具备推理能力的多模态模型的有效免训练遗忘。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Drift and Dependence: Layer-wise Information-Theoretic Bounds for Replay-Based Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning must absorb new tasks without erasing old ones, and replay---mixing a small buffer of past examples into current training---is among the most effective remedies for catastrophic forgetting. Yet its generalization behavior is shaped by two coupled effects that existing analyses fold into a single hypothesis-level quantity: finite memory replaces each past distribution with an empirical proxy, and repeated reuse couples the buffer, the current data, and the final hypothesis through a shared optimization trajectory. We develop a layer-wise information-theoretic framework that separates these effects at every depth. Our main result decomposes the expected generalization gap into a replay-induced representation drift and an optimization-dependence term, the latter further resolved into stability, plasticity, interaction, and residual-coupling components. Two refinements make the framework operational. A Wasserstein relaxation of the drift term, valid under support mismatch, yields a depth-dependent drift--sensitivity trade-off whose minimizer identifies which interior layer to stabilize. An SGLD instantiation of the optimization term reduces it to a trajectory-level log-determinant budget, exposing a curvature-aware gradient-alignment statistic that serves as an online diagnostic of task-wise forgetting. Controlled and benchmark experiments confirm the predicted memory scaling, the interior funnel, and the alignment signal's link to forgetting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个逐层信息论框架，用于分析基于回放（replay）的持续学习（continual learning）的泛化行为。作者将期望泛化差距分解为回放引发的表示漂移（representation drift）与优化依赖项，后者进一步分解为稳定性、可塑性、交互和残差耦合成分。通过Wasserstein松弛和SGLD实例化，框架给出深度相关的漂移-敏感性权衡与曲率感知的梯度对齐统计量，实验验证了存储缩放、内部漏斗及对齐信号与遗忘的联系。
Motivation: 现有分析将有限记忆对过去分布的替代效应与共享优化轨迹对缓冲区、当前数据和最终假设的耦合效应折叠成单一假设级量，无法逐层理解replay的泛化行为。
Method: 开发逐层信息论框架，将期望泛化差距分解为replay-induced representation drift和optimization-dependence项；漂移项采用Wasserstein松弛以处理支持不匹配，优化项通过SGLD实例化归约为轨迹级log-determinant预算。
Result: 摘要报告了理论分解结果，并通过受控与基准实验验证了预测的存储缩放、内部漏斗现象，以及梯度对齐统计量与任务遗忘之间的关联。
Conclusion: 该框架将replay的泛化差距拆解为可操作的深度相关组件，并提供曲率感知的梯度对齐统计量作为任务级遗忘的在线诊断。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: APEX: Adaptive Expert Prefetching for Memory-Efficient Edge MoE Inference
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models are attractive for edge deployment because they provide high model capacity while activating only a small subset of parameters per token, improving compute efficiency. However, MoE inference at the edge is fundamentally limited by memory. Expert parameters are large and often reside in off-chip memory due to capacity, cost, and power constraints, putting expert loading to the critical path. We present APEX: Adaptive Expert Prefetching, a predictive resource management framework that overlaps expert loading with useful computation. APEX introduces a lightweight prefetch router that predicts candidate experts before the attention block to dynamically fetch additional experts using a learned confidence model. This adaptive strategy achieves over 99% overlap accuracy, significantly outperforming fixed top-k prefetching techniques. APEX supports two execution modes: a correctness-preserving mode that guarantees exact routing semantics, and a stall-free mode that eliminates residual stalls by operating on available experts with negligible impact on application accuracy. Across multiple MoE models, the correctness-preserving mode reduces per-token latency by up to 26% and improves energy-delay product (EDP) by up to 41% over state-of-the-art baselines, while the stall-free mode provides additional efficiency gains with negligible impact on application accuracy. These results establish adaptive, confidence-driven expert prefetching as an effective approach for efficient MoE inference on edge systems.
papers.comment: Accepted at IEEE/ACM ESWEEK (CODES) 2026; the official version will appear in IEEE TCAD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 APEX，一个面向边缘 MoE 推理的自适应专家预取框架。它引入轻量级预取路由器，在注意力块之前用学习的置信度模型预测候选专家并动态预取，使专家加载与有用计算重叠。摘要报告该方法实现超过 99% 的重叠准确率，显著优于固定 top-k 预取；在多个 MoE 模型上，正确性保持模式将每 token 延迟降低最多 26%，能量-延迟积 (EDP) 改善最多 41%。
Motivation: 边缘端 MoE 推理受内存制约：专家参数庞大且通常因容量、成本和功耗限制存放在片外内存，导致专家加载成为推理关键路径。
Method: 提出 APEX，包含一个轻量级预取路由器，在注意力块之前预测候选专家，并利用学习的置信度模型动态获取额外专家；支持保证精确路由语义的正确性保持模式，以及基于可用专家运行、消除剩余停顿的免停顿模式。
Result: 自适应预取实现超过 99% 的重叠准确率；正确性保持模式相比最先进基线降低每 token 延迟最多 26%，并改善 EDP 最多 41%；免停顿模式在应用精度影响可忽略的前提下提供额外效率收益。
Conclusion: 作者认为，自适应、置信度驱动的专家预取是边缘系统高效 MoE 推理的有效方法。

summary_sections.result: 自适应预取实现超过 99% 的重叠准确率；正确性保持模式相比最先进基线降低每 token 延迟最多 26%，并改善 EDP 最多 41%；免停顿模式在应用精度影响可忽略的前提下提供额外效率收益。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为，自适应、置信度驱动的专家预取是边缘系统高效 MoE 推理的有效方法。

papers.title: EGM-Det: Entropy-Guided Multimodal Adaptive Fusion for UAV RGB-IR Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Joint use of RGB and infrared (IR) imagery can improve UAV-view object detection, but most existing methods fuse multimodal features with static or fixed weights and therefore overlook spatially varying modality reliability. We propose EGM-Det, an entropy-guided multimodal adaptive fusion framework for RGB-IR object detection. EGM-Det employs a dual-stream architecture to preserve modality-specific representations and introduces an Entropy Offset Gate Fusion module for adaptive multi-scale fusion. The module derives shallow entropy priors from input intensity, local entropy, and cross-modal discrepancy, and uses them to guide local offset alignment and spatial-channel gated fusion. It therefore selectively aggregates reliable RGB and infrared cues instead of uniformly combining heterogeneous features. We further introduce cross-modal distillation to regularize the learned fusion gates and reduce fusion degradation. Each student branch extracts complementary knowledge from the cross-modality teacher branch matched to the main branch, while entropy-adaptive supervision emphasizes uncertain modality decisions. Experiments on DroneVehicle, LLVIP, and VEDAI demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across all three benchmarks; in particular, EGM-Det outperforms prior approaches by more than 10 percentage points on VEDAI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EGM-Det，一个针对无人机RGB-IR目标检测的熵引导多模态自适应融合框架。它采用双流架构保留模态特有表示，通过熵偏移门控融合模块（Entropy Offset Gate Fusion）利用输入强度、局部熵和跨模态差异生成浅层熵先验，指导局部偏移对齐与空间-通道门控融合，选择性聚合可靠的RGB和红外线索；同时引入跨模态蒸馏来正则化融合门并减少融合退化。实验在DroneVehicle、LLVIP和VEDAI三个基准上达到最先进性能，其中在VEDAI上比之前方法提升超过10个百分点。
Motivation: 现有RGB-IR融合检测方法大多以静态或固定权重融合多模态特征，忽略了空间上变化的模态可靠性，因而难以在无人机视角下充分利用异构信息。
Method: 提出熵引导的自适应融合框架EGM-Det：双流结构保持模态特异性；熵偏移门控融合模块从输入强度、局部熵和跨模态差异推导浅层熵先验，用于局部偏移对齐和空间-通道门控融合；跨模态蒸馏中每个学生分支从与主分支匹配的交叉模态教师分支提取互补知识，并用熵自适应监督强调不确定的模态决策。
Result: 在DroneVehicle、LLVIP和VEDAI三个基准上均取得最先进性能，尤其EGM-Det在VEDAI上相较先前方法提升超过10个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过熵先验引导的门控融合与跨模态蒸馏，EGM-Det能够自适应聚合可靠的RGB和红外特征，从而提升无人机视角目标检测性能。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: FrontierFinance: A Challenging Benchmark for Measuring Frontier Intelligence of Finance Agents
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are increasingly deployed for professional investment research, yet no benchmark captures the complexity of the full investor workflow. Existing benchmarks mainly target financial data extraction, a narrow slice that current models have largely saturated, while reference-based metrics and generic LLM-as-a-judge scoring fall short on the open-ended, long-form answers that real analyst queries demand. We introduce FrontierFinance, a fully open benchmark of 220 expert-crafted queries and 11,543 source-attributed rubrics spanning six crucial use cases across the full investor workflow. FrontierFinance is both broader and harder than existing public finance benchmarks. Evaluating frontier models and agent systems under a common harness restricted to publicly available data, we find that the tool harness, not the model alone, strongly shapes quality and efficiency; that Samaya's in-house system leads at 56.0%, ahead of the strongest frontier model (Claude Fable 5, 49.2%) at roughly 2.2x lower cost; and that the best open-weight model (Kimi K3, 46.4%) nearly matches the best proprietary model at 4.5x lower cost. Screening & Discovery and Sector, Industry & Macro remain the hardest use cases across all systems, where even the best systems reach only 33% and 39%. We make the dataset and grading code publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FrontierFinance，一个面向金融投资全流程的开放基准，包含 220 条专家级查询和 11,543 条带来源标注的评分细则 (rubrics)，覆盖六类关键用例。作者在统一测试框架下评估前沿模型与智能体系统，发现工具框架 (tool harness) 对质量和效率的影响强于模型本身，并报告了各系统在成本与性能上的对比。
Motivation: 现有金融基准主要针对数据抽取，模型已接近饱和；而基于参考文本的指标和通用 LLM-as-a-judge 评分无法胜任真实分析师查询所需的开放式长答案评估，因此缺少能刻画完整投资者工作流复杂度的基准。
Method: 构建包含 220 条专家级查询与 11,543 条来源归属评分细则的开放基准 FrontierFinance，覆盖完整投资者工作流的六个关键用例，并在仅使用公开数据的统一测试框架下评估前沿模型和智能体系统。
Result: Samaya 的内部系统以 56.0% 领先，成本约为最强前沿模型 (Claude Fable 5, 49.2%) 的 2.2 分之一；最强开源权重模型 (Kimi K3, 46.4%) 以 4.5 倍更低成本接近最强专有模型。Screening & Discovery 与 Sector, Industry & Macro 是最难的用例，最优系统仅达到 33% 和 39%。
Conclusion: 作者强调工具框架而非模型本身是影响质量与效率的关键因素，并公开数据集与评分代码；基准面向金融投资智能体评测，未涉及其它领域。

papers.title: Learning from Multimodal Pseudo-Labels for Robust Open-Vocabulary Instance and Panoptic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: This work addresses the challenge of open-vocabulary instance segmentation (OVIS) and open-set panoptic segmentation (OSPS), which aim to recognize both predefined and unseen object categories without exhaustive human annotations. Existing methods often suffer from noisy pseudo-masks, limited visual-textual grounding, and difficulty handling synonyms or out-of-vocabulary (OOV) words. To overcome these challenges, we propose a multimodal framework that leverages pre-trained vision-language models for automatic pseudo-label generation, CLIP-guided synonym filtering, and GPT-based caption reconstruction. In our target-vocabulary-assisted pseudo-labeling setting, the framework first constructs pseudo segmentation masks, descriptive captions, and semantically aligned synonym sets using Grounded SAM, LLaVA, and CLIP, providing multimodal supervision without manual annotation. We then enhance visual-textual alignment through three complementary training objectives: an extended grounding loss that incorporates visually grounded synonyms, a semantic consistency loss, and a generative caption reconstruction loss. Extensive experiments on the COCO dataset demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms previous state-of-the-art approaches under this protocol, achieving substantial improvements on both OVIS and OSPS benchmarks.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向开放词汇实例分割（OVIS）与开放集全景分割（OSPS）任务，提出一个多模态伪标签框架。该框架利用预训练视觉语言模型自动生成伪分割掩码、描述性字幕和语义对齐的同义词集，并通过三种互补训练目标增强视觉-文本对齐。在 COCO 数据集上的实验表明，该方法在该评估协议下优于先前最先进方法。
Motivation: 现有 OVIS/OSPS 方法常受噪声伪掩码、视觉-文本对齐不足以及对同义词或词表外（OOV）词语处理困难等问题的困扰，且依赖大量人工标注，难以高效覆盖预定义与未见类别。
Method: 提出目标词表辅助伪标注（target-vocabulary-assisted pseudo-labeling）的多模态框架：用 Grounded SAM、LLaVA 和 CLIP 自动构造伪分割掩码、描述性字幕与语义对齐同义词集，提供无需人工标注的多模态监督；训练时使用包含视觉接地同义词的扩展接地损失（extended grounding loss）、语义一致性损失和生成式字幕重建损失三种互补目标。
Result: 在 COCO 数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在该协议下于 OVIS 和 OSPS 基准上均持续优于先前的最先进方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，借助多模态伪标签和互补训练目标，可以缓解噪声伪掩码及同义词/OOV 词带来的鲁棒性问题，从而改进开放词汇实例与全景分割。

papers.title: AgenticTwin: An Agentic LLM Framework Integrated with Digital Twin for Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Digital twins are increasingly used to monitor and simulate the behavior of cyber-physical systems. Even with skilled operators, interpreting anomalies detected within digital twin pipelines is challenging, as the sheer complexity and volume of raw sensor data make thorough analysis difficult. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) offer promising capabilities for reasoning and explanation, yet their integration into digital twin-driven anomaly analysis remains underexplored. In this work, we propose AgenticTwin, an agentic framework that integrates LLM-driven reasoning with a digital twin-based anomaly detection pipeline. The framework grounds LLM-generated explanations in outputs from a digital twin-driven anomaly classifier and enables human operators to ask relevant natural-language questions about the system. Beyond the framework itself, we introduce a benchmark-oriented evaluation pipeline constructed over synthetic anomalies injected into a real-world weather sensor dataset, enabling controlled generation of operator queries over anomaly events. We further evaluate the feasibility of deploying lightweight, open-source LLMs for practical cyber-physical environments. Experimental results demonstrate that structured agent collaboration and knowledge-grounded reasoning improve diagnosis quality, contextual retrieval, and mitigation quality across diverse possible anomaly scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AgenticTwin，一个将LLM驱动的推理与数字孪生异常检测管线集成的智能体框架。框架将LLM生成的解释锚定在数字孪生异常分类器的输出上，并允许操作员用自然语言提问。作者在真实天气传感器数据上注入合成异常，构建基准评估管线，并评估了轻量级开源LLM的部署可行性。实验表明结构化智能体协作与知识接地推理改善了诊断质量、上下文检索和缓解质量。
Motivation: 数字孪生广泛用于监控网络物理系统，但异常解读困难，原始传感器数据复杂且量大。LLM虽有推理和解释能力，其与数字孪生驱动的异常分析集成尚未充分探索。
Method: 提出AgenticTwin框架，结合LLM推理与数字孪生异常检测；通过将LLM解释接地于异常分类器输出来支持操作员自然语言查询；并构建基于真实天气传感器数据注入合成异常的基准评估管线，评估轻量级开源LLM的部署可行性。
Result: 实验显示结构化智能体协作和知识接地推理在多种异常场景中改善了诊断质量、上下文检索和缓解质量；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架有效集成LLM与数字孪生异常检测，并验证了轻量级开源模型在实用网络物理环境中的可行性。

papers.title: XBridge: Entity-Grounded Latent Bridge for Heterogeneous LLM Communication
papers.abstract_en: Heterogeneous multi-agent LLM systems, where agents are powered by different model families, can outperform homogeneous configurations by reducing redundant reasoning patterns. Yet existing communication protocols either operate through text, discarding the sender's internal representations, or require architectural homogeneity for latent-level transfer. We identify the entity grounding problem in cross-architecture communication: cross-attention bridges that transfer continuous representations across different LLM families suffer from rare-token compression collapse, where entity identity is lost in the continuous bottleneck (bridge-only F1 ~30%). We propose XBRIDGE, a decode-free communication protocol that addresses this through two mechanisms. Lexical Anchor Mapping (LAM) maps the sender's original context tokens to the receiver's vocabulary, providing discrete entity anchors. A Latent Enrichment Bridge (LEB) lets the receiver query the sender's hidden states for contextual enrichment. The entity anchors ground the bridge's contextual signals to specific entities through the receiver's own self-attention. Across three model families (Llama, Qwen, and Mistral), seven benchmarks, and both communication directions, XBRIDGE outperforms text-based communication on all seven tasks for each model pair while achieving 11x lower latency, and in a same-architecture setting it also exceeds a KV-sharing baseline on six of seven tasks. LEB requires only 264M trainable parameters (3.8% of the receiver), is trained on a small balanced sample set, and adds negligible inference overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 XBRIDGE，一种面向异构 LLM 多智能体系统的免解码通信协议，解决跨架构传递连续表示时的实体接地问题。该方法通过词法锚映射 (LAM) 与潜在富集桥 (LEB) 结合离散实体锚与连续上下文信号，在 Llama、Qwen、Mistral 三族模型及七个基准上超越文本通信，并实现 11 倍更低延迟。
Motivation: 异构多智能体 LLM 系统可减少冗余推理模式，但现有通信协议要么使用文本而丢弃发送方内部表示，要么要求架构同质才能进行潜在级传输。跨注意力桥在传递连续表示时存在稀有标记压缩坍缩，导致实体身份丢失（桥接仅 F1 约 30%），形成实体接地问题。
Method: 提出 XBRIDGE，包含两个机制：词法锚映射 (Lexical Anchor Mapping, LAM) 将发送方原始上下文标记映射到接收方词表，提供离散实体锚；潜在富集桥 (Latent Enrichment Bridge, LEB) 允许接收方查询发送方隐藏状态以获取上下文增强，实体锚通过接收方自身自注意力将桥接的上下文信号绑定到具体实体。
Result: 在三个模型家族 (Llama、Qwen、Mistral)、七个基准及两种通信方向上，XBRIDGE 在每个模型对上全部七个任务均优于基于文本的通信，并实现 11 倍更低延迟；在同构架构下也超过 KV 共享基线七个任务中的六个。LEB 仅需 264M 可训练参数（占接收方的 3.8%），在小规模平衡样本集上训练，推理开销可忽略。
Conclusion: 摘要强调离散实体锚与连续潜在信号的结合能有效解决跨架构通信中的实体接地问题，且计算开销低。

papers.title: FunnelCausalNet: Funnel-aware Joint Conversion-Revenue Uplift for Multi-tier Coupon Allocation
papers.abstract_en: Coupon campaigns seek to lift both conversion and revenue, but gross merchandise value (GMV) follows a deterministic funnel from conversion to conditional order value and is zero-inflated and heavy-tailed. We propose FunnelCausalNet, an uplift estimator coupling a binary conversion head with a nonnegative conditional-value head through $μ_{\mathrm{gmv}}=μ_{\mathrm{conv}}μ_{\mathrm{val}}$. Under explicit RCT, support, rate-gap, and cross-head covariance-control assumptions, an idealized leading-order MSE comparison identifies a regime in which funnel composition can reduce pointwise variance; this is a heuristic, not a guarantee for the shared-representation neural model. The estimator is paired with marginal split-conformal CATE summaries, combined through a Bonferroni union as audit bands, and a Lagrangian budgeted allocator using RCT-anchored estimates for subsidy-aware ROI accounting. On semi-synthetic multi-tier Criteo-MT7, FunnelCausalNet's mean AUUC_GMV is within one seed standard deviation of the leading feature-interaction baseline among eleven baselines, while a controlled ablation reduces GMV effect error versus direct GMV regression by 18--48% across tested zero-inflation regimes. On de-identified industrial Hotel-Coupon RCT logs with about 4.9 million hold-out exposure records per seed, expected-outcome evaluation sweeps full LP frontiers; FunnelCausalNet has the best seed-averaged mean DeltaROI at all seven correlated anchors from 10% to 60%, which we treat as descriptive frontier consistency rather than independent significance. On sparse binary-spend public benchmarks, revenue-focused rankers can dominate uplift-curve proxies, defining an explicit regime boundary.

papers.title: GCPO: Diagnosing and Constraining Subspace Geometry in Rollout RL for LLMs
papers.abstract_en: On-policy rollout methods such as GRPO are central to post-training of large language models, yet they frequently suffer from training instabilities, cross-task capability degradation, and response-length inflation. Although prior work has characterized the subspace geometry of aggregate updates, the stepwise variation of this geometry and its relationship to model performance remain unclear. We introduce Principal-Subspace Overlap, a dimension-corrected measure of individual rollout updates relative to the dominant singular subspaces of pretrained weights. Despite low average overlap, transient spikes often precede performance degradation. To address this, we propose GCPO (Geometrically Constrained Policy Optimization), which applies hard bilateral orthogonal projections to constrain updates to the complementary subspaces, preventing such excursions by construction. Across mathematical reasoning, code generation, and tool-use tasks on Qwen3-8B and GLM4-9B, GCPO consistently outperforms GRPO and recent variants, including DAPO and GSPO, improving over the base models and the strongest baseline by up to 27.69 and 2.37 points, respectively. Furthermore, GCPO preserves general capabilities, eliminates response-length inflation, and stabilizes policy entropy. Our findings provide a new diagnostic lens and a principled design perspective for stable reinforcement learning post-training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM后训练中on-policy rollout方法（如GRPO）的训练不稳定、跨任务能力下降和响应长度膨胀问题，提出主子空间重叠（Principal-Subspace Overlap）作为诊断指标，并据此提出GCPO（Geometrically Constrained Policy Optimization），通过硬双边正交投影将更新限制在预训练权重的补子空间中。实验在数学推理、代码生成和工具使用任务上基于Qwen3-8B和GLM4-9B进行，GCPO优于GRPO及DAPO、GSPO等变体。
Motivation: GRPO等on-policy rollout方法是LLM后训练的核心，但常出现训练不稳定、跨任务能力退化与响应长度膨胀。已有工作刻画了聚合更新的子空间几何，却未厘清该几何的逐步变化及其与模型性能的关系。
Method: 提出维度校正的Principal-Subspace Overlap指标，衡量单个rollout更新相对于预训练权重主奇异子空间的几何关系；并提出GCPO，对更新施加硬双边正交投影，使其约束在互补子空间中，从构造上避免瞬态尖峰所预示的性能退化。
Result: 摘要报告在Qwen3-8B和GLM4-9B上的数学推理、代码生成与工具使用任务中，GCPO一致优于GRPO及DAPO、GSPO等近期变体，相对基座模型和最强基线分别最高提升27.69和2.37个点。此外，GCPO保持通用能力、消除响应长度膨胀并稳定策略熵。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作提供了诊断LLM强化学习后训练稳定性的新视角，以及约束子空间几何的 principled 设计思路。

papers.title: Rubric Dropout: A Simple Way to Mitigate Reward Hacking in Rubric-as-Reward RL
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning against rubrics, lists of criteria graded by an LLM judge, has become a standard way to post-train language models on tasks with no deterministic answer. The rubric, however, is a fixed proxy for quality, never a complete description of it, and a policy trained against it long enough will learn to exploit the difference. We measure this directly. Training Qwen3-8B with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on medical and science rubrics and grading out-of-distribution (OOD) benchmarks with both the training judge and a stronger gold judge, we find that the two scores diverge during training. The training judge's score keeps climbing while the gold judge's score peaks and then falls, by 3 points on HealthBench-Hard and by 22 points on ResearchQA. A judge with a fixed bias would shift the gold curve by a constant, not send it down while the training score rises, so the divergence is reward hacking, not judge noise. We propose Rubric Dropout, a one-line fix borrowed from neuron dropout. At every step, we randomly drop a subset of the rubric's criteria before computing the reward, so the policy never optimizes the same rubric twice. The dropped subset is shared across each rollout group, so GRPO's group-relative advantages stay comparable, and evaluation always uses the full rubric. Comparing no dropout against dropout at 30% and 50% on both benchmark pairs, dropout raises the OOD gold score at every matched checkpoint (+1 to +2 points on HealthBench-Hard, +6 to +7 points on ResearchQA), lowers the two hacking measures we track, and costs nothing in domain. Sweeping the dropout fraction shows a broad 30-50% sweet spot, while the natural alternative, reweighting criteria by how useful they are to training, performs worse than no intervention at all in our setting.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables. Work in progress
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于评分标准 (rubric) 的奖励强化学习中出现的奖励黑客 (reward hacking) 现象。作者用 GRPO 训练 Qwen3-8B 的医疗与科学评分任务，发现训练评判分数持续上升而更强的金牌评判分数先升后降，证明这是奖励黑客而非评判噪声。提出的 Rubric Dropout 在每步随机丢弃一部分评分标准再计算奖励，使策略不会重复优化同一组标准，实验显示在 OOD 基准上稳定提升金牌分数且无领域代价。
Motivation: 基于 LLM 评判的评分标准是后训练无确定性答案任务的标准方式，但评分标准只是质量的固定代理，策略训练过久会利用该代理与实际质量的差异，即奖励黑客。作者希望直接测量这种现象并提出简单缓解方法。
Method: 提出 Rubric Dropout，灵感来自神经元 dropout：在每一步随机丢弃评分标准中的一部分子项后再计算奖励，使策略每次面对的评分标准不同；丢弃子项在每个 rollout 组内共享以保持 GRPO 的组内相对优势可比，评估时始终使用完整评分标准。
Result: 在 HealthBench-Hard 和 ResearchQA 上，训练评判分数上升而金牌评判分数分别下降 3 点和 22 点，证实奖励黑客。与无 dropout 相比，30% 与 50% dropout 在每个匹配检查点提升 OOD 金牌分数（HealthBench-Hard +1 到 +2，ResearchQA +6 到 +7），降低两类黑客度量且不损失领域表现；dropout 比例在 30–50% 有宽泛最佳区间，而按训练有用性重新加权标准的替代方法比不干预更差。
Conclusion: Rubric Dropout 是一种单行修改的简单有效方法，可缓解 rubric-as-reward RL 中的奖励黑客，作者强调其成本为零且优于标准重加权方案。论文标注为 work in progress。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Zero-OVCD: Bridging Training-Free Foundation Models and Pseudo-Label Learning for Open-Vocabulary Change Detection
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary change detection (OVCD) enables the identification of user-specified land-cover changes in bitemporal remote sensing images, but existing training-free pipelines remain vulnerable to inaccurate candidate masks, ambiguous semantic assignments, and accumulated inference errors. To address these issues, we propose Zero-OVCD, a two-stage framework that requires no pixel-level annotations from the target domain. In the first stage, high-quality change pseudo-labels are generated through complementary candidate-mask refinement, multiscale semantic similarity fusion with margin-based reliability filtering, and response-guided mask correction and completion. These components jointly suppress noisy candidates, enhance mask-level semantic discrimination, and recover missed change regions. In the second stage, a change detector is trained using the generated pseudo-labels, while checkpoint voting and high-agreement sample selection are introduced to mitigate residual pseudo-label noise. On LEVIR-CD, WHU-CD, and S2Looking, Stage I achieves F1 scores of 86.25%, 85.82%, and 50.48%, while Stage II further improves them to 88.65%, 88.85%, and 57.96%, respectively. On SECOND, the macro-average F1 across six category-wise one-vs-rest tasks increases from 47.91% to 50.92%. These results demonstrate that bridging training-free foundation-model inference with noise-aware pseudo-label learning provides an effective solution for open-vocabulary change detection without target-domain pixel-level annotations. Code will be available at https://github.com/1321663019/Zero-OVCD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Zero-OVCD，一个无需目标域像素级标注的两阶段框架，用于开放词汇变化检测 (open-vocabulary change detection, OVCD)。第一阶段通过互补候选掩膜精炼、基于边际可靠度滤波的多尺度语义相似度融合、以及响应引导的掩膜校正与补全来生成高质量变化伪标签；第二阶段用这些伪标签训练变化检测器，并引入 checkpoint voting 和高一致性样本选择来抑制残留噪声。在 LEVIR-CD、WHU-CD、S2Looking 和 SECOND 上的实验表明该方法显著提升 F1 分数。
Motivation: 现有免训练 (training-free) 的 OVCD 流程受限于不准确的候选掩膜、模糊的语义分配以及累积的推理误差，导致检测性能不稳定。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：阶段一用互补候选掩膜精炼、多尺度语义相似度融合与边际可靠性过滤、响应引导的掩膜校正补全三个组件生成变化伪标签；阶段二用这些伪标签训练变化检测器，并通过 checkpoint voting 和高一致性样本选择减轻伪标签噪声。
Result: 在 LEVIR-CD、WHU-CD、S2Looking 上，阶段一 F1 分别达 86.25%、85.82%、50.48%，阶段二进一步提升至 88.65%、88.85%、57.96%；在 SECOND 上，六个逐类 one-vs-rest 任务的宏平均 F1 从 47.91% 提升到 50.92%。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，将免训练基础模型推理与噪声感知伪标签学习相结合，是在无目标域像素级标注条件下解决开放词汇变化检测的有效途径。代码将在 GitHub 上公开。
Relevance: 10

summary_sections.result: 在 LEVIR-CD、WHU-CD、S2Looking 上，阶段一 F1 分别达 86.25%、85.82%、50.48%，阶段二进一步提升至 88.65%、88.85%、57.96%；在 SECOND 上，六个逐类 one-vs-rest 任务的宏平均 F1 从 47.91% 提升到 50.92%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要认为，将免训练基础模型推理与噪声感知伪标签学习相结合，是在无目标域像素级标注条件下解决开放词汇变化检测的有效途径。代码将在 GitHub 上公开。

papers.title: Low-Interaction-Rank Learning: Unifying Multiplicative Dual-Encoder Heads
papers.abstract_en: A multiplicative dual-encoder network computes a real-valued output for a pair of inputs as the inner product of their separate encodings. This architecture has been developed independently in operator learning, bipartite matching, contrastive vision-language models, retrieval, and other areas, yet no unified theory guides the basic design decisions: how many interaction modes to represent, how to normalize the encoders, and when the architecture should be avoided. We provide such a foundation by introducing the class of functions of low interaction rank, a class whose intrinsic complexity is measured by its interaction spectrum. Within this framework, approximation error decomposes into a spectral truncation term and an encoder-realization term; sample complexity is governed by the sum of the two encoder complexities rather than their product; and a usability criterion based on spectral decay determines when the architecture can succeed. The same framework exposes a central identifiability problem: the encoders are defined only up to a linear gauge symmetry that leaves the learned coordinates arbitrary. We show that normalization is gauge fixing and that whitening pins the interaction modes up to permutation and sign, thereby explaining the uninterpretability of contrastive dimensions and providing a constructive remedy. Experiments on synthetic kernels, operator learning, and CLIP models validate the theoretical predictions: spectral decay rates match the predicted scaling, whitening recovers the true modes, and independently trained CLIP models are related by a single rotation which, after removal by whitening, exposes interpretable concept axes. The code of this paper is provided at https://github.com/RS2002/Mul-Net .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为乘性双编码器 (multiplicative dual-encoder) 网络建立统一的理论框架，引入低交互秩 (low interaction rank) 函数类，并以交互谱 (interaction spectrum) 衡量其内在复杂度。作者证明逼近误差可分解为谱截断项与编码器实现项，样本复杂度由两个编码器复杂度之和而非乘积决定，并给出基于谱衰减的可用性判据。框架还揭示了编码器仅定义到线性规范对称性的可辨识性问题，指出归一化即规范固定，白化 (whitening) 可将交互模式固定到置换与符号级别，从而解释对比学习维度的不可解释性并提供构造性修正。
Motivation: 乘性双编码器结构在算子学习、二分匹配、对比视觉-语言模型、检索等领域被独立发展，但缺乏统一理论来指导基本设计决策：应表示多少交互模式、如何归一化编码器，以及何时应避免该架构。
Method: 提出低交互秩函数类及其交互谱复杂度度量，建立逼近误差、样本复杂度与可用性判据的理论结果；将归一化解释为规范固定，并证明白化能消除线性规范自由度，把交互模式固定到置换和符号级别。
Result: 在合成核、算子学习和 CLIP 模型上的实验验证了理论预测：谱衰减率与预测标度一致，白化能恢复真实模式，且独立训练的 CLIP 模型之间仅相差一个旋转，去除该旋转后可暴露可解释的概念轴。
Conclusion: 论文强调该框架统一了乘性双编码器架构的设计原则，并为对比维度不可解释性提供了原理性解释与构造性修复方案；实验覆盖合成与真实模型，验证了理论的有效性。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Hybrid-Policy Self-Editing for Composable Unstructured Knowledge Editing
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) achieve remarkable performance across natural language tasks, yet they are trained on static corpora and their knowledge quickly becomes outdated in a fast-changing world. This motivates knowledge editing (KE), which updates specific knowledge in an LLM without changing unrelated others. Recent works move from structured knowledge triples toward unstructured KE (UKE), where the edit is a free-form passage that may state multiple facts at once. Nonetheless, existing editors inject such a passage yet fail to use it: the edited model can recall the passage, but can neither answer atomic questions about its facts nor compose them into multi-hop reasoning. We attribute this missing property, which we term composability, to editors' passive reliance on the fixed passage as the sole learning source. In response, we cast editing as a proactive self-distillation from a privileged in-context state of the same model, which requires no external supervision. We further reveal that due to the novelty of the injected knowledge, the pre-edited model's own rollouts rarely cover it, which limits the effectiveness of pure on-policy distillation. To close this gap, we propose HPSE, which builds a hybrid rollout that steps in to place missing facts onto the student's own trajectory precisely where its coverage fails, while staying on-policy elsewhere. We theoretically analyze HPSE's advantage over pure on-policy distillation, and empirically establish its plug-and-play improvements across four LLM backbones and two KE editors under various scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HPSE（Hybrid-Policy Self-Editing），针对非结构化知识编辑（unstructured knowledge editing, UKE）中编辑后模型只能复述注入段落、却无法回答原子问题或进行多跳推理的 composability 缺失问题。作者将编辑重构为从同一模型特权上下文状态进行的主动自蒸馏（self-distillation），并提出混合 rollout，在模型自身轨迹覆盖失败的位置精确补入缺失事实，其余位置保持 on-policy。理论分析说明该方法优于纯 on-policy 蒸馏，实验在四个 LLM 骨干和两个知识编辑器上展示了即插即用的改进。
Motivation: 现有 UKE 编辑器把自由文本段落注入模型，但模型仅能回忆该段落，无法对其中的事实进行原子问答或多跳组合推理，这一缺失属性被称为 composability；作者认为根源是编辑器被动地把固定段落当作唯一学习来源。
Method: 将编辑建模为对同一模型特权上下文状态（privileged in-context state）的主动自蒸馏，不需要外部监督；由于新注入知识具有新颖性，编辑前模型自身 rollout 很少覆盖它，因此 HPSE 构造混合 rollout，在覆盖失败处把缺失事实放到学生轨迹上，其余位置保持 on-policy 蒸馏，并对该方法相对纯 on-policy 蒸馏的优势给出理论分析。
Result: 摘要报告 HPSE 在四个 LLM 骨干和两个知识编辑器上的多种场景下取得即插即用的改进，并给出理论上的优势分析；未提供具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为将编辑视为主动自蒸馏并辅以混合 rollout，可以弥补模型自身 rollout 对新事实覆盖不足的问题，从而提升非结构化知识编辑的可组合性；该工作限定于 LLM 知识编辑场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Is Per-Agent Policy Composition Safe? Rethinking Successor-Feature Transfer in Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Many reinforcement learning systems, from fleet management to traffic signal control, must serve an objective that changes dynamically after deployment, and retraining a policy for each new objective is prohibitively expensive. For a single agent, this problem is well understood: successor features with generalized policy improvement, together with their universal extension, recombine a library of learned policies into a policy for any new objective, with a guarantee that the result is never worse than any policy in the library. However, multi-agent transfer has received far less attention, and the common practice of letting each agent recombine its own library independently inherits the recipe but not the guarantee. We prove that this independent composition can produce joint behavior strictly worse than every policy in the library, because recombining teammates changes the environment each agent faces and invalidates the values it relies on, a failure with no single-agent counterpart. We further show that the only unconditionally safe fixed rule is synchronized composition, which moves the whole team to one jointly trained policy but cannot serve objectives that assign different goals to different agents. To attain safety and flexibility at once, we propose MA-USFA, a hierarchical method with two layers: a lower layer of universal successor feature approximators that predicts each agent's successor features while conditioned on its teammates' objectives, and an upper composer that selects, across agents, which library entry each agent should follow and supplies the cross-agent correction a per-agent value cannot represent. Trained once over the distribution of objectives, it is applied at deployment with no per-task adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究合作多智能体强化学习 (MARL) 中基于后继特征 (successor features) 的策略复用问题。作者证明各智能体独立重组自身策略库会产生比库中所有策略都更差的联合行为，并提出 MA-USFA 这一两层层次化方法，在部署时无需针对新目标进行训练即可同时保证安全性与灵活性。
Motivation: 许多强化学习系统在部署后目标会动态变化，逐目标重训策略代价过高；单智能体的后继特征与广义策略提升 (generalized policy improvement) 已有安全保证，但多智能体环境下各智能体独立复用策略库的做法继承了方法却没有继承保证。
Method: MA-USFA 采用两层结构：底层是通用后继特征近似器 (universal successor feature approximators)，在条件于队友目标的情况下预测每个智能体的后继特征；上层组合器跨智能体选择每个智能体应遵循的库中条目，并提供单个智能体值函数无法表示的跨智能体修正。
Result: 论文证明独立组合可能产生严格劣于库中所有策略的联合行为，因为队友重组改变了每个智能体所处环境并使原有值函数失效；唯一无条件安全且固定的规则是同步组合，但它无法服务于不同智能体目标不同的场景。
Conclusion: MA-USFA 在目标分布上训练一次、部署时无需逐任务适配，目标是同时获得安全性和灵活性；论文强调安全组合需要跨智能体层次的协调而非各智能体独立重组。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Semantic Lenia: Emergence of Homeostatic Solitons within the Semantic Space of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Semantic Lenia, an artificial life framework that transforms Large Language Model (LLM) inference from a static optimization problem into a continuous dynamical system within the macroscopic logit space. By establishing a non-linear homeostatic feedback loop to dynamically balance semantic attraction and syntactic repulsion, we demonstrate the emergence of "Autonomous Semantic Solitons" -- macroscopic dissipative structures that avoid repetitive crystallization. Our exhaustive parameter sweeps map a critical "Habitable Ridge" where applied steering forces perfectly balance the model's intrinsic syntactic inertia. This approach successfully maintains generative trajectories at the edge of chaos, triggering profound abductive leaps without structural collapse and establishing a physical scaling law for machine cognition.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 5 figures. Code, datasets, and interactive phase diagrams are available at https://y-kayama.github.io/semantic-lenia/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Semantic Lenia，一个将大语言模型(LLM)推理从静态优化问题转化为宏观 logit 空间中连续动力系统的人工生命框架。作者通过建立非线性稳态反馈回路，在语义吸引与句法排斥之间动态平衡，观察到‘自主语义孤子’(Autonomous Semantic Solitons)这类宏观耗散结构的涌现，并绘制出一条临界的‘适居脊’(Habitable Ridge)。摘要声称该方法能让生成轨迹维持在混沌边缘，支持大幅溯因跳跃而不发生结构崩塌，并为机器认知建立物理标度律。
Motivation: 论文针对 LLM 推理作为静态优化问题时所面临的重复性结晶(repetitive crystallization)等局限，试图将生成过程视为连续动力系统，以探索更丰富的语义动力学行为。
Method: 在 LLM 的 logit 空间上构造非线性稳态反馈回路，动态平衡语义吸引力与句法排斥力；通过穷举参数扫描刻画‘适居脊’，即外部引导力与模型内在句法惯性恰好平衡的临界区域。
Result: 摘要报告通过参数扫描找到 Habitable Ridge，并在该临界区域实现 Autonomous Semantic Solitons 的涌现；生成轨迹可维持于混沌边缘，触发深刻溯因跳跃而不发生结构塌缩，同时推导出关于机器认知的物理标度律。
Conclusion: 作者认为将 LLM 推理重构为 logit 空间中的非线性动力系统，并让其运行在混沌边缘，是避免重复生成并实现创造性跳跃的有效途径；这一框架还试图为机器认知建立物理标度律。
Relevance: 0
