papers.title: Hand Visibility Detector: Per-Keypoint Visibility Estimation for Hands
papers.abstract_en: Hand Pose Estimation (HPE) is a fundamental technology for various applications such as AR/VR and robotics. In these applications, the visibility of each hand joint in the image is crucial for assessing the reliability of estimation results under occlusion. However, most existing HPE methods output joint positions without explicitly indicating their visibility. Although some methods account for occlusion or visibility, visibility estimation has mainly been used as an auxiliary signal for improving pose estimation. To our knowledge, per-joint hand visibility estimation has not been systematically studied as a standalone task. In this work, we propose Hand Visibility Detector, a model for estimating the visibility of individual hand joints, and present the first systematic investigation of visibility estimation as an independent task. We show that leveraging the prior knowledge of HPE models pretrained on large-scale data as a backbone yields high performance in this task. We further demonstrate the utility of Hand Visibility Detector on a downstream task of 3D hand pose annotation via multi-view triangulation of 2D keypoints, showing that visibility-weighted triangulation reduces reprojection error. Our method is released as a ready-to-use package, and the code and demo are available at https://github.com/ryhara/hand_visibility_detector .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Hand Visibility Detector，将手部关节点的可见性估计作为独立任务进行系统研究。方法利用在大规模数据上预训练的手部姿态估计（HPE）模型作为骨干，输出每个关节点的可见性；并在下游任务——基于 2D 关键点多视角三角化的 3D 手部姿态标注——中验证，可见性加权三角化（visibility-weighted triangulation）能降低重投影误差（reprojection error）。代码和 demo 已开源。
Motivation: 现有手部姿态估计方法大多只输出关节位置，不显式给出各关节点在图像中的可见性，导致遮挡场景下难以评估估计结果的可靠性；此前可见性估计主要作为辅助信号用于提升位姿估计，尚未被作为独立任务系统研究。
Method: 提出 Hand Visibility Detector，以大规模数据预训练的 HPE 模型作为骨干网络，估计每个手部关节点的可见性，并将其应用于可见性加权三角化以辅助 3D 手部姿态标注。
Result: 摘要报告利用预训练 HPE 骨干可取得该任务的高性能；在基于多视角三角化的 3D 手部姿态标注下游任务中，可见性加权三角化降低了重投影误差。
Conclusion: 作者将逐关节点手部可见性估计确立为独立任务，并验证其在下游标注任务中的实用性；方法以可直接使用的软件包形式发布。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Reinforcing Step-level Reasoning for Effective Self-Correction in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Achieving effective self-correction, where models verify and correct their own mistakes, remains a fundamental challenge for large language models (LLMs). In this work, we propose Self-Fix Step-DPO (SFS-DPO), a reinforcement learning based, two-stage framework for step-level self-verification and self-correction. The first stage strengthens step-level reasoning via step-level preference optimization, while the second stage explicitly trains models to self-verify and self-correct. We further introduce a teacher-assisted variant, SFS-DPO-R, which incorporates explanatory rationales for error verification to provide stronger corrective signals. Comprehensive in-domain and out-of-domain evaluations across multiple LLMs demonstrate that SFS-DPO and SFS-DPO-R consistently outperform prior step-level training baselines. Our analysis further reveals improvements in self-correction frequency and effectiveness, highlighting the importance of strengthening step-level reasoning for robust performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Self-Fix Step-DPO (SFS-DPO)，一个基于强化学习的两阶段框架，用于 LLM 的逐步自验证与自纠正。第一阶段通过逐步偏好优化强化逐步推理，第二阶段显式训练模型自验证和自纠正，并引入教师辅助变体 SFS-DPO-R 以提供错误验证的解释性理由。跨多个 LLM 的域内与域外评估表明该方法持续优于先前的逐步训练基线，并提升自纠正的频率与有效性。
Motivation: LLM 的自校正（self-correction）仍是一个基本挑战，现有模型在验证和纠正自身错误方面能力不足，尤其缺乏对逐步推理的强化。
Method: 提出 SFS-DPO，两阶段框架：第一阶段用逐步级偏好优化（step-level preference optimization）增强逐步推理，第二阶段训练模型显式执行自验证与自纠正；SFS-DPO-R 变体进一步加入教师生成的错误验证解释性理由（explanatory rationales）作为更强的纠正信号。
Result: 在多个 LLM 上的域内和域外评估中，SFS-DPO 与 SFS-DPO-R 持续优于先前的逐步级训练基线；分析还显示自纠正的频率和有效性均得到提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调强化逐步级推理（step-level reasoning）对于稳健自纠错性能的重要性，并指出该方法在多个模型和基准上带来一致改进。

papers.title: RECAST: A Machine-Learning Framework for Correction and Super-Resolution of Coarse-Grid PDE Solvers
papers.abstract_en: Coarse-grid numerical solvers can substantially reduce the computational cost of time-dependent PDE simulation, but under-resolution often degrades both the trajectory and the spatial fidelity of the solution. We introduce RECAST (Recurrent Error Correction And Super-resolution of coarse-grid Trajectories), a machine-learning framework designed to restore this lost accuracy while retaining coarse-grid evolution. RECAST combines learned correction within the numerical time-stepping loop with reconstruction of the corresponding fine-grid state from the corrected coarse history. We evaluate the framework on six one-dimensional PDE systems spanning transport, diffusion, dispersion, reaction, and wave dynamics, using spatial grids coarsened by factors of 8-16 and 1000-step closed-loop rollouts from unseen initial conditions. Across the test cases, RECAST remains closely aligned with the fine-grid reference solutions and reduces time-averaged relative error by approximately 50-92% compared with the corresponding uncorrected coarse-grid solvers. Additional tests show generalization to unseen PDE parameter values, while comparison with a contemporary coarse-correction architecture shows that RECAST achieves lower error and better long-horizon agreement with the fine-grid reference over 5000-step rollouts. These results demonstrate that the learned correction and reconstruction capabilities of RECAST can enable substantially coarser PDE evolution without the corresponding loss of solution fidelity, providing a proof-of-concept route toward machine-learning acceleration of higher-dimensional numerical simulations across science and engineering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RECAST（Recurrent Error Correction And Super-resolution of coarse-grid Trajectories），一个在粗网格数值求解器的时间步进循环内加入学习校正、并从校正后的粗历史重建细网格状态的机器学习框架。在六个一维 PDE 系统（涵盖输运、扩散、色散、反应和波动）上，使用 8-16 倍粗化网格和 1000 步闭环 rollout 测试，RECAST 相比未校正的粗网格求解器将时间平均相对误差降低约 50-92%，并能在未见过的参数值上泛化，且在 5000 步 rollout 中优于一种当代粗校正架构。
Motivation: 粗网格数值求解器能大幅降低随时间变化的 PDE 模拟的计算成本，但分辨率不足会同时损害解的轨迹和空间保真度，需要一种方式在保留粗网格演化的同时恢复丢失的精度。
Method: RECAST 将学习到的校正集成在数值时间步进循环内部，并利用校正后的粗历史重建对应的细网格状态，从而结合误差校正与超分辨率重建。
Result: 在六个一维 PDE 系统上，RECAST 与细网格参考解保持高度一致，相比未校正的粗网格求解器将时间平均相对误差降低约 50-92%；额外实验表明其可泛化到未见过的 PDE 参数值，并在 5000 步 rollout 中比一种当代粗校正架构取得更低的误差和更好的长时程一致性。
Conclusion: 作者认为学习式校正与重建能力可以在不相应损失解保真度的前提下实现大幅更粗的 PDE 演化，为将机器学习加速推广到更高维数值模拟提供了概念验证路径。

papers.title: Sparse and robust geometric twin support vector machine via asymmetric RoBoSS loss function
papers.abstract_en: In real-world scenarios, the training data usually contains redundant features, label noise and feature noise, which provide severe challenges for the efficiency of machine learning methods. Since standard support vector machine (SVM) adopts $l_2$-norm penalty and hinge loss function, it lacks the ability of selecting significant features and is sensitive to noise. To address these issues, this paper proposes a novel asymmetric, robust, bounded, sparse and smooth (aR) loss function for $l_1$-norm penalized geometric twin SVM (aRSGTSVM) to handle classification and regression tasks. The $l_1$-norm penalty can achieve the feature selection. The proposed aR loss function can not only effectively mitigate the impact of label noise, but also significantly enhance the stability to resampling noise, i.e., the zero-mean feature noise around the boundary hyperplanes. Furthermore, a statistical analysis of the robustness of aRSGTSVM was also conducted using the influence function. Since aRSGTSVM involves nonconvex and nonsmooth optimization, we develop a fast and stable proximal gradient descent based solving algorithm. Compared with related state-of-the-art methods, experimental results demonstrate the superiority of the proposed aRSGTSVM on both synthetic and UCI datasets. Furthermore, we apply aRSGTSVM to index tracking tasks, where results for tracking the different indices in the China stock market show that it can achieve satisfactory performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对标准 SVM 使用 l2 范数惩罚和 hinge 损失导致无法选择显著特征、对噪声敏感的问题，提出一种非对称、鲁棒、有界、稀疏且光滑的 aR 损失函数，并用于 l1 范数惩罚的几何孪生 SVM（aRSGTSVM），以处理分类和回归任务。摘要通过影响函数 (influence function) 对方法的鲁棒性做了统计分析，并设计了基于近端梯度下降的求解算法。实验在合成数据集、UCI 数据集以及中国股市指数跟踪任务上验证了该方法的优越性。
Motivation: 现实数据常包含冗余特征、标签噪声和特征噪声，而标准 SVM 的 l2 范数惩罚和 hinge 损失既不能进行特征选择，又对噪声敏感，这限制了其在实际场景中的有效性。
Method: 提出 aR 损失函数并结合 l1 范数惩罚构建 aRSGTSVM；l1 惩罚用于特征选择，aR 损失用于缓解标签噪声并增强对决策边界超平面附近零均值重采样特征噪声的稳定性。由于目标函数非凸非光滑，作者开发了基于近端梯度下降 (proximal gradient descent) 的快速稳定求解算法，并利用影响函数进行鲁棒性统计分析。
Result: 在合成数据集和 UCI 数据集上，aRSGTSVM 相比相关最先进方法表现出优越性；在中国股市不同指数跟踪任务中取得了令人满意的性能。
Conclusion: 摘要认为将稀疏 l1 惩罚与鲁棒有界损失结合，可以同时实现特征选择和抵抗标签噪声与特征噪声，并能在分类、回归及指数跟踪等任务中有效工作。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Measuring Browser Webcam Gaze Honestly: A Capture-Clock Methodology and Open Reference Implementation
papers.abstract_en: Browser-based webcam gaze trackers are increasingly used for crowd-scale data collection and in clinical settings where lab eye trackers are impractical, but the reported latency numbers may not represent real world functionality. The common practice of timestamping each gaze sample when it is emitted, rather than when its source frame was captured, makes the measured inference latency read about $0\,$ms no matter how slow the engine really is. We show how to measure it honestly, recovering a per-frame capture clock from the browser's \texttt{re\-quest\-Video\-Frame\-Call\-back} (rVFC) API (\texttt{captureTime} where the browser exposes it for local camera streams, else \texttt{presentationTime}, in which case every recovered latency is a verifiable lower bound): exact source-frame pairing through a per-frame queue for engines that expose their inference pipeline, and a further lower bound for engines that do not, such as WebGazer. We release an open TypeScript implementation and benchmark harness, demonstrated on two interchangeable engines: WebGazer and a new FaceMesh+KRR pipeline.
papers.comment: Accepted at DEMI 2026 (MICCAI 2026 Workshop on Data Engineering in Medical Imaging). Final version to appear in Springer LNCS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对浏览器端网络摄像头视线追踪器（webcam gaze tracker）的延迟测量问题，指出常见的做法是在视线样本发射时打时间戳，而非在其源帧被捕获时打时间戳，这会让测得的推理延迟无论真实引擎多慢都读作约 0ms。作者提出一种诚实的测量方法，从浏览器的 requestVideoFrameCallback（rVFC）API 恢复逐帧捕获时钟（captureTime，或 presentationTime 作为可验证下界），并通过逐帧队列对暴露推理管线的引擎做精确源帧配对，对不暴露管线的引擎（如 WebGazer）给出进一步下界。论文还发布了开源的 TypeScript 实现与基准测试工具，并在 WebGazer 和新的 FaceMesh+KRR 两条可互换管线上演示。
Motivation: 浏览器端 webcam 视线追踪器正越来越多地用于大规模数据采集和临床场景，但已报告的真实延迟数字可能并不能代表实际功能；由于时间戳打在发射时刻而非帧捕获时刻，测量出的推理延迟会系统性地被低估为约 0ms。
Method: 利用 rVFC API 恢复逐帧捕获时钟：在浏览器暴露本地摄像头流的 captureTime 时直接使用，否则使用 presentationTime，此时所有恢复出的延迟都是可验证的下界；对暴露推理管线的引擎采用逐帧队列进行精确的源帧配对，对不暴露管线的引擎（如 WebGazer）则推导另一重下界。同时发布开源 TypeScript 实现与基准测试工具，演示于 WebGazer 和 FaceMesh+KRR 两条引擎管线上。
Result: 摘要未给出具体量化数字，主要结果是提出并验证了能诚实地测量 webcam 视线追踪推理延迟的捕获时钟方法，并给出开源实现与基准测试工具。
Conclusion: 本文的取态是：通过捕获时钟（capture clock）而不是发射时间戳来测量延迟，可以为浏览器端视线追踪给出可验证的诚实延迟估计；该方法对是否暴露推理管线的引擎都适用，并以开放实现的形式供社区使用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Alignment of Similarity-Transformed Images Based on Fourier--Mellin Transform Using Auxiliary Function Method
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes an algorithm for estimating the similarity transformation, namely translation, scale, and rotation, between two images with subpixel accuracy. Image registration is a fundamental technique for aligning images acquired under different viewpoints and imaging conditions, and a representative approach based on maximizing discrete cross-correlation is the Fourier--Mellin registration. However, the Fourier--Mellin approach often fails to achieve sufficient alignment accuracy when subpixel-level estimation is required. The proposed method integrates (i) scale-and-rotation estimation from the Fourier magnitude spectrum in a log-polar representation and (ii) maximization of phase-only correlation based on the auxiliary function method. This integration enables a two-stage estimation procedure: it first estimates scale and rotation without being affected by translation, and then estimates translation with subpixel precision in the spatial domain using the corrected image pair. A simulation experiment on image pairs subjected to random similarity transformations demonstrates that the proposed method reduces estimation errors in scale, rotation, and translation compared with Fourier--Mellin-based registration methods using discrete cross-correlation.
papers.comment: Accepted to APSIPA ASC 2026. 6 pages, 4 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种以亚像素精度估计两幅图像间相似变换（平移、缩放、旋转）的配准算法，核心是将傅里叶-梅林变换与辅助函数法相结合。方法先在 log-polar 表示的傅里叶幅度谱上估计尺度和旋转，再基于辅助函数法最大化相位相关以在空间域估计亚像素平移。仿真实验表明，与使用离散互相关的傅里叶-梅林配准方法相比，该方法的尺度、旋转和平移估计误差更小。
Motivation: 傅里叶-梅林配准是代表性的图像配准方法，但在需要亚像素级精度时往往无法达到足够的对齐精度，而许多应用场景要求亚像素级估计。
Method: 提出两阶段估计流程：第一阶段利用 log-polar 表示下的傅里叶幅度谱估计尺度与旋转，从而不受平移影响；第二阶段在空间域对校正后的图像对使用基于辅助函数法的相位相关最大化，实现亚像素平移估计。

papers.title: Repurposing RGB-based Foundation Model for Depth Estimation on Thermal Images Using Hierarchical Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Depth estimation from thermal images is highly valuable for robotic applications in adverse conditions, such as nighttime and rainy weather. Recent studies have sought to transfer knowledge from RGB-based foundation models to thermal modalities, yet the rich hierarchical representations these models encode remain underutilized. To address this limitation, we propose RGB-HS, a novel framework for thermal-image depth estimation that leverages hierarchical supervision from an RGB-based foundation model. Specifically, we first replace the baseline thermal encoder with a foundational model and introduce a parallel RGB branch that also employs a foundational model as an encoder of the same architecture, taking RGB images as input. The alignment is then performed across multiple levels between the tokens of the two encoders, allowing the thermal student branch to capture both structural precision and semantic abstraction from the RGB teacher branch. Furthermore, we introduce verification to refine the alignment process by weighting tokens from the RGB branch based on RGB image quality. Extensive experiments on the popular benchmark demonstrate that RGB-HS achieves competitive performance and more effectively exploits the representational capacity of RGB-based foundation models for depth estimation on thermal images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RGB-HS，一个用于热成像深度估计的框架，通过层级监督 (hierarchical supervision) 从基于 RGB 的基础模型向热模态迁移知识。作者将热成像编码器替换为基础模型，并引入同架构的 RGB 平行分支，在多个层级间对齐两个编码器的 token，同时根据 RGB 图像质量加权 token 以细化对齐过程。在公开基准上的实验表明该方法取得有竞争力的性能，并更充分地利用了 RGB 基础模型的表征能力。
Motivation: 热成像深度估计对夜间、雨天等恶劣条件下的机器人应用很有价值，现有研究尝试从 RGB 基础模型迁移知识，但模型编码的丰富层级表征仍未得到充分利用。
Method: 先提出将热成像编码器替换为基于 RGB 的基础模型，并加入使用同架构基础模型作为编码器的平行 RGB 分支；随后在两个编码器的多个层级之间进行 token 级对齐，使热学生分支同时获得结构精度与语义抽象；最后引入验证机制，根据 RGB 图像质量对 RGB 分支的 token 加权以改进对齐。
Result: 摘要报告在公开基准上的大量实验表明 RGB-HS 达到有竞争力的性能，并能更有效地利用 RGB 基础模型的表征能力；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为层级监督结合质量加权的对齐方式能够提升热成像深度估计中 RGB 基础模型的迁移效果。

papers.title: From Synthesis to Removal: Physics-Grounded Reflection Simulation and Diffusion-Based Video Dereflection
papers.abstract_en: Videos captured through glass often contain reflections that degrade visual quality and interfere with downstream vision tasks. Although single-image reflection removal has been extensively studied, video reflection removal remains largely underexplored due to the lack of paired video data, temporally coherent removal models, and dedicated evaluation benchmarks. We present a closed-loop framework that unifies physics-grounded reflection simulation, diffusion-based video dereflection, and benchmark evaluation. Our S2R-Synthesis pipeline generates paired reflected and reflection-free videos by performing physics-grounded augmentation in the structure space and rendering realistic reflected videos with a trained video diffusion renderer; the augmentation models key glass-related effects including roughness-induced blur, thickness-induced ghosting, and reflectance variation. Based on the synthesized data, we introduce S2R-Removal, the first diffusion-based video reflection removal model, which adapts a pretrained video diffusion prior through reflection-aware latent adaptation and one-step pixel-geometric refinement, recovering the clean transmission in a single denoising step. We further build S2R-Bench, the first benchmark for video reflection removal, supporting both full-reference evaluation and real-world human perceptual assessment. Experiments on S2R-Bench and multiple public image benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance and faster inference than even non-diffusion baselines, and validate the effectiveness of S2R-Synthesis. Project page: https://codingwzp.github.io/VideoDereflection_S2R.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向视频反射去除的闭环框架，包含物理基础的反射视频合成、基于扩散模型的视频去反射以及专用基准评估。S2R-Synthesis 在结构空间进行物理增强并利用训练好的视频扩散渲染器生成成对的反射/无反射视频；S2R-Removal 是首个基于扩散的视频反射去除模型，通过反射感知的潜在空间适配和单步像素-几何细化恢复清晰透射；S2R-Bench 是该任务的首个基准，支持全参考评估和真实场景人类感知评估。实验表明该方法在 S2R-Bench 和多个公开图像基准上达到最新最优性能，且推理速度快于部分非扩散基线。
Motivation: 视频透过玻璃拍摄常带有反射，损害画面质量并干扰下游视觉任务；现有单图反射去除研究较充分，但视频反射去除因缺少成对视频数据、时序一致的去除模型和专用评估基准而研究不足。
Method: 框架由三部分组成：S2R-Synthesis 在结构空间做物理增强（建模粗糙度导致的模糊、厚度导致的鬼影、反射率变化），并用训练的视频扩散渲染器生成逼真反射视频；S2R-Removal 通过反射感知潜在适配与一步像素-几何细化，在单次去噪步骤中从预训练视频扩散先验恢复干净透射；S2R-Bench 构建视频反射去除基准并支持全参考与人类感知评估。
Result: 在 S2R-Bench 和多个公开图像基准上的实验显示该方法达到最先进性能，且推理速度快于甚至非扩散基线，同时验证了 S2R-Synthesis 合成的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调物理模拟、扩散去除与基准评估构成的闭环框架能够有效推动视频反射去除任务，并指出这是该任务首个扩散模型与首个专用基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Offline Evaluation Misleads: A Diagnostic Protocol for Reward and Policy Selection in Delayed-Feedback Contextual Bandits
papers.abstract_en: Personalizing marketing messages with contextual multi-armed bandits (CMABs) drives real business value, yet the objective that ultimately matters - a downstream conversion - is observed only weeks later, too late to drive online learning. Teams therefore train the bandit on a fast proxy reward, and separately must judge whether a contextual bandit is worth its complexity over sending one best message. Settling both decisions with the usual offline checks - a batch off-policy estimate, a marginal arm-discrimination test, a confidence interval - can mislead systematically under delayed feedback. We give an ordered diagnostic protocol that screens a reward-and-policy candidate on two axes, alignment (does optimizing the reward move the north-star?) and learnability (can the bandit identify the reward-optimal policy?), before trusting any reported lift. We validate it where the truth is known - a public off-policy-evaluation benchmark and a controllable synthetic generator - and illustrate it on a deployed large-marketplace push system (where, with five arms and one split, the evidence is directional rather than powered). Two lessons recur. (N1) A single offline number can mis-rank rewards: a denser reward signal gives the bandit more to learn from, so rewards that look tied in a static estimate pull apart once learning happens online. (N2) If you cannot tell in advance which single message is best, a per-user policy partly just avoids betting on the wrong one - that looks like personalization but is really robustness, so a "personalization premium" is easily overstated. Our contribution is methodological rather than algorithmic: the ordered protocol, the two lessons it surfaces, and the end-to-end experience of applying it to a delayed-feedback CMAB.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对延迟反馈上下文多臂老虎机（CMAB）中离线评估可能系统性误导的问题，提出一个有序诊断协议，在信任任何报告的性能提升前，从对齐（alignment）和可学习性（learnability）两个维度筛选奖励与策略候选。作者在已知真实标签的公共离策略评估基准和可控合成生成器上验证该协议，并在一个真实的大市场推送系统上演示其应用。文中总结出两个反复出现的教训：单一离线数字可能错误排序奖励，以及逐用户策略的“个性化溢价”容易被高估，因为它实际上更多是鲁棒性而非真正的个性化。
Motivation: 在延迟反馈场景下，最终目标（下游转化）要数周后才能观测，无法用于在线学习，因此团队只能基于快速代理奖励训练老虎机，同时需要判断上下文老虎机是否值得相对于发送单一最佳消息的复杂度。常规离线检查（批量离策略估计、边际臂判别测试、置信区间）在这种延迟反馈下会系统性地误导这两个决策。
Method: 给出一个有序诊断协议，在奖励和策略候选上检查两个轴：对齐（优化该奖励是否会推动北极星目标）和可学习性（老虎机能否识别出奖励最优策略）。该协议在公共离策略评估基准和可控合成数据生成器上验证，并完整应用于一个已部署的大规模市场推送系统（五臂、一次数据划分，证据仅为方向性而非统计有力）。
Result: 摘要报告两个反复出现的教训：N1——单一的离线数字可能对奖励错误排序，更密集的奖励信号给老虎机更多可学习内容，因此静态估计中看似持平的奖励在在线学习后会拉开差距；N2——如果无法事先知道哪个单一消息最优，逐用户策略在某种程度上只是避免押注在错误消息上，这看起来像个性化但实为鲁棒性，因此“个性化溢价”容易被高估。
Conclusion: 作者的贡献是方法论而非算法：有序诊断协议、协议揭示的两个教训，以及将其应用于延迟反馈 CMAB 的端到端经验。论文强调在信任任何报告的提升之前先用该协议筛选候选，但在真实系统上的证据仍只是方向性的。

papers.title: Certifying What Helps Customer-Return Timing: A Screen-and-Confirm Test for Conditioning Signals, and Why Decay Is Nearly Enough
papers.abstract_en: Practitioners enrich customer-return models with ever more signals (lifetime value, category, recency/frequency, calendar, geography), and the temporal-point-process (TPP) literature follows suit with covariate- and external-covariate-conditioned intensities. But does any of it improve the timing, and how would you know? A null ("feature X doesn't help") is only meaningful if the model could have found a signal. We make two contributions--a method and a measurement--to answer this credibly. (i) A screen-and-confirm protocol that certifies whether a candidate signal improves a TPP's event-timing likelihood: a positive control plants a coupling of known strength and confirms the model recovers it, so a real-data null can be read as "no signal" rather than "weak method." The control is validated for categorical and continuous encodings, and on a real clock-driven dataset (NYC taxi hour-of-day). (ii) A model-free ceiling quantifying how little of customer-return timing is point-predictable at all (a single-digit percentage of gap variance from any covariate; returns are near-memoryless). With these we certify a clean result on three public benchmarks (Amazon, Taobao, RetailRocket) and a real marketplace (Thumbtack): the inter-event clock--continuous-time decay, long known to beat frozen-intensity models--is nearly sufficient, and the conditioning the field keeps adding is redundant or harmful on top of it (statistically null on the public benchmarks, at most 0.06 NLL; null to mildly harmful on the marketplace). We do not claim to discover that decay helps; our contribution is the tools that turn "conditioning doesn't help" into a checkable, certified statement--plus an honest-evaluation account of the read-out/leakage pitfalls we hit and retracted.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 5th Workshop on End-to-End Customer Journey Optimization (KDD 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个“筛查-确认”（screen-and-confirm）协议，用于认证候选信号是否真正提升时间点过程（TPP）的事件时间似然，并引入一个无模型上限来量化客户回流时间能被点预测的程度。作者在 Amazon、Taobao、RetailRocket 和 Thumbtack 上认证：连续时间衰减（decay）几乎足够，额外加入的条件化信号是冗余甚至有害的。作者强调贡献不在于发现衰减有效，而在于把“条件化无帮助”变成可检验、可认证的陈述，并诚实记录了评估中遇到的读出/泄漏（read-out/leakage）陷阱。
Motivation: 实践者和 TPP 文献不断加入生命周期价值、类别、最近/频率、日历、地理等信号来条件化强度，但缺少可信的方法回答这些信号是否真的改善时间预测；零结果（null）只有在模型确实有能力发现信号时才有意义。
Method: 提出 screening 与 confirmation 两部分的认证协议：阳性对照（positive control）植入已知强度的耦合并用真实数据确认模型能恢复它，使真实数据上的零结果可被解读为“无信号”而非“方法弱”；该对照在类别和连续编码以及真实时钟驱动数据集（NYC 出租车小时）上验证。同时给出一个无模型上限，量化事件时间中可被任意协变量解释的方差比例。
Result: 在 Amazon、Taobao、RetailRocket 三个公共基准和真实市场 Thumbtack 上，连续时间衰减几乎足够，额外条件化在公共基准上统计上为零（最多 0.06 NLL），在市场数据上为零到轻度有害；任何协变量只能解释个位数百分比的间隔方差，回流接近无记忆（near-memoryless）。
Conclusion: 作者明确不声称发现衰减有帮助，贡献在于提供把“条件化无帮助”变为可检查、可认证陈述的工具，并透明交代了评估中的读出/泄漏陷阱。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Beyond Single-Turn Confidence: Trajectory-Adapted Uncertainty Quantification for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods for language models are typically evaluated on single-turn outputs, where uncertainty is attached to one generated answer. For LLM agents, however, the unit of observation is an interactive trajectory, where the model can ask clarifying questions, call tools, update state, and make intermediate decisions whose errors propagate to the final outcome. We study whether three common families of single-turn UQ methods transfer to this setting. Across five LLMs and four multi-turn tool-use datasets from BFCL-v4 and $τ^2$-bench, we evaluate white-box scorers based on action-token probabilities, black-box consistency scorers based on resampled trajectories, and reflexive scorers based on model self-assessment of the trajectory. We find that transfer is often useful but uneven. Token-probability scores are highly sensitive to the choice of aggregator used across turns, reflexive scores provide the strongest low-cost baseline in most evaluated settings, and black-box self-consistency is often the strongest UQ family, with trajectory-equivalence and action-set consistency typically ranking highest among its variants. These results suggest that UQ methods developed for single generations should be revalidated at the trajectory level, with careful attention to the consistency measurement, aggregator choice, and computational budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究单轮不确定性量化（UQ）方法能否迁移到LLM智能体的多轮工具调用轨迹上。作者在五个LLM和四个多轮工具使用数据集（BFCL-v4和τ²-bench）上评估了基于动作token概率的白盒评分器、基于重采样轨迹的黑盒一致性评分器，以及基于模型自我评估的反思式评分器，发现迁移通常有用但不均匀。结果建议UQ方法应在轨迹级别重新验证，并注意一致性度量、聚合器选择和计算预算。
Motivation: 现有语言模型的UQ方法通常在单轮输出上评估和校准，但LLM智能体的基本单位是交互式轨迹，其中中间决策的错误会传播到最终结果，因此单轮UQ方法是否适用于轨迹层面尚不清楚。
Method: 对三类常见的单轮UQ方法进行系统评估：基于动作token概率的白盒评分器、基于重采样轨迹的黑盒一致性评分器（包括轨迹等价和动作集一致性变体），以及基于模型轨迹自我评估的反思式评分器，覆盖五个LLM和四个BFCL-v4与τ²-bench数据集。
Result: 摘要报告称迁移通常有用但不均匀：token概率分数对跨轮的聚合器选择高度敏感；反思式评分器在大多数评估设置中提供了最强的低成本基线；黑盒自一致性通常是最强的UQ家族，其中轨迹等价和动作集一致性变体排名最高。
Conclusion: 作者强调为单轮生成开发的UQ方法需要在轨迹级别重新验证，且要仔细关注一致性度量、聚合器选择和计算预算。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Boundary-Continuous Cross-Camera RGB Mapping via Hue-Split Model Trees
papers.abstract_en: We propose a hue-split model-tree method for boundary-continuous cross-camera RGB mapping. Cross-camera RGB mapping aims to produce consistent color representations across cameras whose recorded RGB values differ due to sensor spectral sensitivities and image-signal processing pipelines. A common chart-based remedy is to estimate a single global affine color correction matrix (CCM), but such a global model cannot capture hue-specific discrepancies between cameras. To capture that behavior, we recursively partitions the source-camera color space along a scalar hue coordinate and builds an model tree that stores an affine CCM at every node. For fitting the node CCMs, we utilize a log-domain error objective. To prevent false contours that arise from hard hue splits, we further introduce a boundary-continuous formulation in which the prediction is obtained by blending the log-domain outputs of all node CCMs along the root-to-leaf path. The path-wise blending weights are optimized under a simplex constraint using both a chart-pair fitting loss and an explicit continuity regularizer defined on deterministic boundary prototype pairs placed just on either side of each learned hue threshold. We conducted an experiment on a Canon EOS-1Ds Mark II to Canon EOS 20D mapping using the Middlebury Registered Color Checker dataset. The results show that hue splitting substantially reduces log-RMSE over a single global affine CCM and that the proposed path blending with boundary prototype regularization simultaneously improves accuracy and suppresses chromaticity gaps at the learned hue thresholds across two illuminants and multiple exposure conditions.
papers.comment: Accepted to APSIPA ASC 2026. 6 pages, 4 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于色调分裂模型树（hue-split model tree）的跨相机 RGB 映射方法，用于在相机间生成一致的色彩表示。方法沿标量色调坐标递归划分源相机颜色空间，在每个节点存储仿射颜色校正矩阵（CCM），并采用对数域误差目标进行拟合；为避免硬色调分裂产生伪轮廓，引入边界连续公式，通过路径上所有节点 CCM 的对数域输出混合得到预测。在 Canon EOS-1Ds Mark II 到 Canon EOS 20D 的映射实验中，该方法相比单一全局仿射 CCM 显著降低 log-RMSE，并在两个照明条件和多曝光设置下提升精度、抑制色调阈值处的色度跳变。
Motivation: 跨相机 RGB 映射中，传感器光谱灵敏度与图像信号处理流程差异导致相机记录值不同；常用的基于色卡的单一全局仿射颜色校正矩阵无法捕捉相机间随色调变化的差异。
Method: 提出色调分裂模型树：按标量色调坐标递归划分源相机颜色空间，在每个节点拟合仿射 CCM 并用对数域误差目标；预测时沿根到叶路径混合所有节点 CCM 的对数域输出，混合权重在单纯形约束下优化，并加入基于色调阈值两侧边界原型对的显式连续性正则项。
Result: 在 Middlebury Registered Color Checker 数据集上的 Canon EOS-1Ds Mark II 到 Canon EOS 20D 映射实验中，色调分裂相对单一全局仿射 CCM 大幅降低 log-RMSE；所提路径混合与边界原型正则同时提升精度并抑制学习到的色调阈值处的色度差，效果跨两个照明条件和多种曝光条件保持。
Conclusion: 作者认为边界连续的路径混合可以避免硬色调分裂带来的伪轮廓，并同时改善精度与色调阈值处的连续性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Through Van Gogh's Eyes: Global Style Transfer with Diffusion Mod
papers.abstract_en: Artistic image synthesis aims to recreate the expressive visual identity of a target artist, yet existing methods often fail to capture an artist's global style. Conventional style transfer methods transfer the style of one or a few reference artworks to a content image in a One-to-One manner, making them effective for artwork-level stylization but limited in representing the broader stylistic distribution of an artist. Text-to-image diffusion models conditioned on artist names, such as '~ in Van Gogh style', offer greater flexibility, but they often suffer from text-induced bias and reproduce patterns from only a few iconic works. To address these limitations, we introduce Global Style Transfer (GST), an artistic image synthesis paradigm, in a Many-to-One manner, that aggregates multiple artworks from a target artist and transfers their shared global style to a single content image. For GST, we propose Global Style Guidance (GSG), which learns a residual global style offset in the intermediate feature space, or h-space, of a diffusion model under a fixed prompt. By learning artist-level style semantics purely from visual statistics, GSG mitigates text-dependent artistic bias. We further propose Content Alignment Guidance (CAG), a training-free perceptual guidance mechanism that preserves the semantic structure of the content image while allowing artist-specific geometric deformation. Experiments on WikiArt demonstrate that GST achieves superior stylistic fidelity, content preservation, and output diversity compared to existing style transfer and diffusion-based artistic synthesis methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的艺术图像合成范式 Global Style Transfer (GST)，以 Many-to-One 方式聚合目标艺术家的多幅作品，将共享的全局风格迁移到单张内容图像上。为此作者提出 Global Style Guidance (GSG)，在扩散模型中间特征空间 h-space 中学习残差全局风格偏移，并配合训练免费的 Content Alignment Guidance (CAG) 保持内容语义结构。在 WikiArt 上的实验表明，相比现有风格迁移和基于扩散的艺术合成方法，GST 在风格保真度、内容保持和输出多样性上更优。
Motivation: 现有风格迁移方法多以 One-to-One 方式处理单张参考艺术品，难以刻画艺术家的整体风格分布；而基于艺术家名字的文本到图像扩散模型容易受文本诱导偏差影响，仅复现少数标志性作品的模式。
Method: 提出 GST 范式，并给出两个核心组件：GSG 在固定提示条件下于扩散模型中间特征空间学习残差全局风格偏移，纯粹从视觉统计中提取艺术家级风格语义；CAG 是一种无需训练的感知引导机制，在允许艺术家特有几何形变的同时保持内容图像的语义结构。
Result: 摘要报告在 WikiArt 数据集上，GST 相比现有风格迁移和基于扩散的艺术合成方法，在风格保真度、内容保持和输出多样性方面表现更优。
Conclusion: 作者认为从视觉统计中学习艺术家级风格语义可缓解文本依赖的艺术偏差，并将 GST 定位为可泛化的艺术图像合成范式；摘要未明确讨论局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DLESyM-Ocean: A Deep Learning Probabilistic Global Model for Simulating Present-Day Upper Ocean and Sea Ice
papers.abstract_en: While AI has shown remarkable promise in atmospheric and meteorological forecasting, accurately simulating other components of the Earth system with AI remains an active frontier. We present DLESyM-Ocean, a Deep Learning Earth System Model that simulates global present-day sea ice and upper ocean conditions. Unlike conventional probabilistic models optimized via diffusion objectives or losses such as continuous-ranked probability score, DLESyM-Ocean is trained using a patch energy score loss. When driven by atmospheric forcing, DLESyM-Ocean produces a well-calibrated, spatially coherent, and skillful ensemble of sea ice and upper ocean conditions with minimal bias relative to reanalysis products. DLESyM-Ocean is stable when autoregressively run for multi-year simulations and produces a climatology and variability with minimal bias compared with reanalysis. We evaluate case studies including a recent sea ice extreme, a severe marine heatwave, the 2023 El Niño transition, and the 2023 spike in global mean temperature. In all of these case studies, DLESyM-Ocean produces realistic surface and subsurface trajectories and ample ensemble diversity in response to common atmospheric forcing, suggestive of learned autoregressive ocean dynamics. When coupled with other Earth system components, such as the atmosphere, the computational efficiency of DLESyM-Ocean makes it a promising tool for subseasonal to seasonal forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DLESyM-Ocean 是一个基于深度学习的全球地球系统模型，用于模拟当代全球海冰和上层海洋状态。模型采用 patch energy score loss（而非扩散目标或连续排序概率分数）训练，在大气强迫下能生成校准良好、空间连贯且技巧较高的海冰与上层海洋集合预报。该模型可自回归稳定运行多年，其气候态和变率与再分析资料偏差较小，并在海冰极端事件、海洋热浪、2023年厄尔尼诺转变及全球均温飙升等案例中表现出合理轨迹和集合多样性。
Motivation: AI 在天气和大气预报中已展现潜力，但用 AI 准确模拟地球系统的其他分量（如海洋与海冰）仍是前沿难题；本文旨在填补这一空白，构建可耦合的深度学习海洋-海冰模拟器。
Method: 提出名为 DLESyM-Ocean 的深度学习地球系统模型，使用 patch energy score loss 进行概率训练，由大气强迫驱动，以自回归方式生成全局海冰和上层海洋的集合模拟。
Result: 摘要报告该模型相对再分析产品偏差很小，集合概率预报校准良好且空间连贯，多年代自回归运行稳定；在 2023 年 El Niño 转变、严重海洋热浪、近期海冰极值和 2023 全球均温飙升等案例中均产出真实的海表和次表层轨迹以及足够的集合多样性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 DLESyM-Ocean 的计算效率使其适合与大气等地球系统分量耦合，是次季节到季节（subseasonal to seasonal）预测的有前景工具。

papers.title: Fine-Tuning Generative Models for Extreme Events via CVaR-Penalized Wasserstein Gradient Flows
papers.abstract_en: We propose CVaR-penalized Generative Particle Algorithm (CVaR-GPA), a robust, tail-agnostic algorithm for fine-tuning generative models to learn heavy-tailed distributions and capture extreme events, requiring no prior knowledge or estimation of the target's tail characteristics. The method is the Wasserstein gradient flow of the Lipschitz-regularized Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence penalized by a Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) discrepancy term: the Lipschitz-regularized KL divergence enables robust learning under minimal assumptions on the target distribution, while the CVaR penalty restores the velocity that otherwise vanishes prematurely in the under-sampled tails. The penalized flow admits a bounded but non-Lipschitz velocity field. This departs from the Lipschitz transport maps of standard generators, which preserve the tail behavior of a light-tailed source, and enables transport toward heavier-tailed targets. To define this flow on empirical measures, we derive the first-variation subgradients of CVaR from its Rockafellar-Uryasev representation, valid precisely where the classical density-based formula fails. The particle algorithm CVaR-GPA fine-tunes the output samples of any pre-trained model, without access to its architecture, and runs on an adaptive time horizon set by a kinetic-energy stopping criterion rather than a preset depth. On synthetic isotropic and anisotropic Student-$t$ target distributions, Neal's funnel distribution, and the real-world high-dimensional Fama-French 25 portfolio dataset, CVaR-GPA dramatically improves global and tail accuracy on heavy-tailed targets over the pre-trained baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CVaR 罚生成粒子算法 (CVaR-GPA)，用于将预训练生成模型微调为能刻画重尾分布与极端事件的模型，且无需预知目标分布的尾部特征。该方法本质上是 Lipschitz 正则化 KL 散度加 CVaR 差异罚项的 Wasserstein 梯度流，诱导出有界但非 Lipschitz 的速度场，从而能向更重尾的目标分布传输。在合成 Student-t、Neal's funnel 以及高维 Fama-French 25 组合数据上，CVaR-GPA 相比预训练基线显著提升重尾目标上的全局与尾部精度。
Motivation: 预训练生成模型通常只刻画轻尾分布，在欠采样的尾部区域速度场过早消失，导致难以捕获极端事件；同时目标的尾部特征往往未知，需要一种鲁棒且不依赖尾部假设的微调方法。
Method: CVaR-GPA 将 Wasserstein 梯度流定义为 Lipschitz 正则化 KL 散度与 CVaR 差异罚项之和的下降流，其中 Lipschitz 正则化保证在最小假设下鲁棒学习，CVaR 罚项恢复尾部速度。作者从 CVaR 的 Rockafellar-Uryasev 表示推导其一阶变分次梯度，以在经验测度上定义该流；算法仅使用任何预训练模型输出的样本进行微调，无需访问模型结构，并由动能停止准则决定自适应时间步数。
Result: 在合成各向同性与各向异性 Student-t 分布、Neal's funnel 分布以及真实高维 Fama-French 25 资产组合数据集上，CVaR-GPA 针对于重尾目标相比预训练基线大幅改进全局精度与尾部精度。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种尾部无关的生成模型微调途径，通过有界非 Lipschitz 速度场突破标准生成器 Lipschitz 传输映射对轻尾源尾部行为的保持，并能直接作用于任意预训练模型的输出样本。

papers.title: Robust Ambiguity Detection (RAD) From Model- and Feature-Space Consistency
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning models should be robust, in the sense of remaining predictively consistent under permissible variations. A model's predictions should ideally remain unchanged when it is replaced by a functionally equivalent one, or when its inputs are subject to minor, admissible perturbations. If such changes alter a prediction significantly, then the prediction is "ambiguous" with respect to the model. Models should abstain from making such ambiguous predictions and/or should flag them for human inspection, especially in high-stakes decision-making scenarios. However, in practice, such ambiguity is not easy to identify once a model is deployed. Here, the Robust Ambiguity Detection (RAD) framework is advanced for quantifying predictive ambiguity using two complementary metrics: Model-Space Consistency and Feature-Space Consistency. These two scores, the RAD Score-Pair, visualised through the RAD Plot, provide an interpretable characterisation of the sources of ambiguity and the actions a user may consider in response. RAD is evaluated on synthetic datasets with systematically controlled overlap, as well as several real-world datasets where the level of ambiguity cannot be directly inspected. Finally, we demonstrate a downstream application of RAD where samples are ranked by their RAD Pareto-Rank and the most ambiguous are abstained from prediction, achieving performance comparable to existing rejection-based approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Robust Ambiguity Detection (RAD) 框架，通过模型空间一致性 (Model-Space Consistency) 与特征空间一致性 (Feature-Space Consistency) 两个互补指标来量化预测的模糊性。两个得分组成的 RAD Score-Pair 借助 RAD Plot 可视化，提供对模糊性来源及用户应对措施的可解释刻画。作者在系统控制重叠程度的合成数据集和多个真实数据集上评估，并展示下游应用：按 RAD Pareto-Rank 对样本排序并放弃最模糊样本的预测，性能与现有基于拒绝 (rejection-based) 的方法相当。
Motivation: 模型预测在等价模型替换或轻微输入扰动下若显著改变，则该预测相对模型是模糊的；高风险决策场景中模型应放弃此类预测或标记人工检查，但部署后这种模糊性难以识别。
Method: 提出 RAD 框架，用模型空间一致性与特征空间一致性两个分数组成 RAD Score-Pair，并通过 RAD Plot 可视化，以刻画模糊性的来源以及用户可采取的响应行动。
Result: 在合成数据集（可控重叠程度）和多个无法直接检查模糊水平的真实数据集上进行评估；下游应用中，按 RAD Pareto-Rank 对样本排序并放弃最模糊样本，取得的性能与现有拒绝式方法相当。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 RAD 提供可解释的模糊性来源刻画，并可作为拒绝预测的排序依据，达到与现有方法相当的效果。

papers.title: A Conceptual Framework for Enhancing Workforce Readiness for Smart Manufacturing in the AI Era
papers.abstract_en: The convergence of artificial intelligence (AI), Industrial Internet of Things, cyber-physical systems, and advanced robotics is reshaping manufacturing faster than engineering curricula can adapt, widening the gap between the competencies required on the shop floor and those delivered by traditional engineering and technology education. This paper proposes a Workforce Readiness Level (WRL) framework, which adapts the Technology Readiness Level scale into nine progressive competency stages and a four-pillar rubric, digital and AI literacy, cyber-physical systems fluency, human-machine collaboration, and data-driven decision making, aggregated through a composite stage score and a cohort-level workforce-readiness index under a ``no-thin-pillar'' rule. The framework is instantiated at a university smart-manufacturing teaching laboratory and draws on 89 sponsored capstone projects delivered over four semesters, four of which are analyzed in depth. Four pillars jointly span the relevant ABET student outcomes. Across the highlighted cohorts the workforce-readiness index ranged from 5.2 to 6.4, and the no-thin-pillar rule was diagnostically informative in three of the four cases and the binding certification constraint in one, repeatedly surfacing cyber-physical and data-driven-decision gaps concealed behind strong analytics profiles; advancement to the highest stages was gated by industry-embedded experience rather than additional coursework. WRL offers educators, accreditation bodies, and regional workforce systems a common, evidence-based instrument for diagnosing and advancing workforce readiness; future work will calibrate pillar weights and test reliability and predictive validity.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 11 figures, submission for ASEE Journal of Engineering Education
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向智能制造的人才就绪度评估框架 Workforce Readiness Level (WRL)，将技术就绪度量表改编为九个递进能力阶段，并围绕数字与 AI 素养、信息物理系统熟练度、人机协作、数据驱动决策四个支柱构建评分规则。该框架在一所大学的智能制造教学实验室中落地，基于四个学期 89 个赞助毕业设计项目中的四个深入案例进行检验，索引得分在 5.2 到 6.4 之间。作者认为 WRL 可为教育者、认证机构和区域劳动力系统提供统一的循证诊断工具。
Motivation: AI、工业物联网、信息物理系统与高级机器人正在重塑制造业，其速度超过了工程课程体系的更新能力，导致车间所需能力与传统工程教育所传授能力之间的差距不断扩大。
Method: 提出 WRL 框架，借鉴技术就绪度 (Technology Readiness Level) 量表设计九个递进能力阶段，并用四个支柱（数字与 AI 素养、信息物理系统熟练度、人机协作、数据驱动决策）通过复合阶段得分和群体层面劳动力就绪度指数进行聚合，同时设置"无薄弱支柱"规则；框架在大学的智能制造教学实验室中实例化，并基于 89 个赞助毕业设计项目（其中四个深入分析）进行检验。
Result: 四个支柱共同覆盖相关的 ABET 学生成果；在所分析群体中，劳动力就绪度指数介于 5.2 至 6.4。"无薄弱支柱"规则在四例中的三例具有诊断信息价值，在一例中成为认证约束条件，反复暴露了被强分析能力画像掩盖的信息物理系统与数据驱动决策缺口；进入最高阶段受制于行业嵌入经验而非额外课程。
Conclusion: WRL 为教育者、认证机构和区域劳动力系统提供了一个共同的循证诊断与推进工具；未来工作将校准支柱权重，并检验信度与预测效度。

papers.title: Generative Semantic Segmentation via an Observable Semantic-Image Interface and Hierarchical Generator Evidence Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Generative semantic segmentation exposes structured predictions as images, but direct color decoding is susceptible to color drift and boundary mixing, whereas latent-feature decoders that predict a separate output distribution may relegate the rendered image to an intermediate visualization. We present Semantic Prism, a conditional semantic-image generation-and-refinement framework with deterministic inference. A diffusion-distilled one-step generator renders a semantic RGB image; per-pixel distances from the rendered colors to a fixed class-color codebook define an explicit probabilistic interface. Hierarchical Generator Evidence Alignment spatially aligns multi-level generator features and uses a zero-initialized output projection to predict an additive residual in the interface logit space, retaining the image-defined interface as the reference for the final distribution. The interface and refined distributions further enable Contextual Interface--Hierarchy Disagreement (C-IHD), a fixed readout for ranking remaining pixel errors without an auxiliary predictor or additional forward pass. On the 500-image Cityscapes validation set, Semantic Prism achieves 72.07% mean intersection over union, 11.39 mIoU points above direct-interface decoding, with 0.41% expected calibration error. Matched-capacity ablations over three seeds support the benefit of jointly aligned multi-level evidence. A separately trained model attains 62.22% mIoU on BDD100K, while the Cityscapes-trained model reaches 46.89\% mIoU under source-frozen transfer to the Adverse Conditions Dataset with Correspondences, without target-domain adaptation. Across all three datasets, C-IHD consistently improves the area under the precision--recall curve for pixel-error ranking over maximum softmax probability on the same segmentation predictions; on ACDC, it raises AUPR from 0.6580 to 0.7557.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Semantic Prism，一种条件语义图像生成与精炼框架，用于生成式语义分割。扩散蒸馏的一步生成器渲染语义 RGB 图，并以渲染颜色到固定类颜色码本的逐像素距离定义显式概率接口；层次化生成器证据对齐在接口 logit 空间中预测加性残差，保留图像定义的接口作为最终分布参考。在 Cityscapes 500 张验证集上达到 72.07% mIoU，比直接接口解码高 11.39 点，期望校准误差 0.41%，并验证了 C-IHD 在像素错误排序上的收益。
Motivation: 直接颜色解码容易受颜色漂移和边界混合影响，而预测独立输出分布的潜在特征解码器可能把渲染图像降级为中间可视化；因此需要一种既能保持图像接口又改进预测分布的方法。
Method: Semantic Prism 框架包含扩散蒸馏的一步生成器、固定类颜色码本的显式概率接口，以及分层生成器证据对齐（Hierarchical Generator Evidence Alignment），后者在空间上对齐多级生成器特征并用零初始化输出投影预测接口 logit 空间的加性残差。另提出 Contextual Interface–Hierarchy Disagreement (C-IHD)，一种无需辅助预测器或额外前向的固定读出，用于排序剩余像素错误。
Result: 在 Cityscapes 500 张验证集上 mIoU 达 72.07%，比直接接口解码高 11.39 mIoU 点，期望校准误差 0.41%；匹配容量三种子消融支持联合对齐多级证据。单独训练的模型在 BDD100K 上为 62.22% mIoU，Cityscapes 训练模型源冻结迁移到 ACDC 为 46.89% mIoU。三个数据集上 C-IHD 均提升像素错误排序的 AUPR，其中 ACDC 上从 0.6580 提高到 0.7557。

papers.title: CT-$Δ$Bench: A Benchmark for Longitudinal 3D Medical Imaging Difference Reporting with Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: In medical imaging, the clinical value of Computed Tomography (CT) lies not only in depicting current disease status, but crucially in enabling longitudinal comparison of serial scans to determine disease evolution, a process that underpins response assessment, recurrence detection, and ongoing patient management. Yet, despite this central role of temporal comparison in clinical decision-making, existing medical foundation models remain largely confined to single-study understanding, leaving temporally grounded cross-examination insufficiently addressed. To address this gap, we study longitudinal imaging difference reporting, a task in which a model takes two temporally separated scans from the same patient and generates a clinically meaningful report describing interval changes between them. We introduce CT-$Δ$Bench, a dedicated benchmark for this task with patient-level splitting to prevent information leakage. To better evaluate this task beyond surface-level text similarity, we further develop change-aware metrics specifically designed to capture clinically meaningful longitudinal changes, and conduct an independent physician validation to assess the reliability of the synthesized references and event extraction pipeline. We also compare direct paired-CT reasoning with an indirect two-stage pipeline that first generates single-timepoint reports and then performs textual differencing. Finally, we propose DeltaMed, a baseline model for direct paired-CT difference reporting, and train it on the benchmark training set. Together, these contributions lay the groundwork for temporally aware medical foundation models that better reflect real-world longitudinal clinical reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CT-ΔBench，一个用于纵向3D医学影像差异报告的基准：模型输入同一患者的两次时间分离CT扫描，生成描述间隔变化的临床报告。论文还开发了针对临床有意义变化评估的change-aware指标，进行独立医生验证，并比较直接配对CT推理与间接两阶段文本差异流程，最后训练基线模型DeltaMed。
Motivation: 现有医学基础模型大多局限于单次影像理解，缺乏对纵向序列扫描的跨时间比较能力，而临床决策（如治疗反应评估、复发检测）高度依赖此类时间对比。
Method: 构建CT-ΔBench基准，使用患者级划分（patient-level splitting）防止信息泄露；设计能捕捉临床有意义纵向变化的change-aware指标，并通过独立医生验证合成参考和事件提取流程；比较直接配对CT推理与先生成单时间点报告再做文本差异化的两阶段流程；提出直接配对CT差异报告基线模型DeltaMed并在基准训练集上训练。
Result: 摘要未报告具体的量化性能结果，主要贡献在于基准构建、评估指标设计、流程对比以及基线模型的建立。
Conclusion: 这些工作为时间感知的医学基础模型奠定基础，以更贴合真实世界的纵向临床推理需求。

papers.title: Hierarchical Federated Transfer Learning in Digital Twin-Based Vehicular Networks
papers.abstract_en: In recent research on the Digital Twin-based Vehicular Ad hoc Network(DT-VANET), Federated Learning (FL) has shown its ability to provide data privacy. However, Federated learning struggles to adequately train a global model when confronted with data heterogeneity and data sparsity among vehicles, which ensure suboptimal accuracy in making precise predictions for different vehicle types. To address these challenges, this paper combines Federated Transfer Learning (FTL) to conduct vehicle clustering related to types of vehicles and proposes a novel Hierarchical Federated Transfer Learning (HFTL). We construct a framework for DT-VANET, along with two algorithms designed for cloud server model updates and intra-cluster federated transfer learning, to improve the accuracy of the global model. In addition, we developed a data quality score-based mechanism to prevent the global model from being affected by malicious vehicles. Lastly, detailed experiments on real-world datasets are conducted, considering different performance metrics that verify the effectiveness and efficiency of our algorithm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对数字孪生车载自组网 (DT-VANET) 中联邦学习 (FL) 在车辆数据异构和数据稀疏下全局模型精度不足的问题，提出层次联邦迁移学习 (HFTL)。方法结合按车辆类型聚类的联邦迁移学习 (FTL)，构建 DT-VANET 框架并设计云服务器模型更新与簇内联邦迁移学习两种算法，同时引入基于数据质量评分的机制以抵御恶意车辆影响。在真实数据集上的实验验证了算法的有效性和效率。
Motivation: 联邦学习在车载网中能提供数据隐私保护，但面对车辆间数据异构 (data heterogeneity) 和数据稀疏 (data sparsity) 时难以充分训练全局模型，导致对不同车辆类型的预测精度欠佳。
Method: 提出层次联邦迁移学习 (Hierarchical Federated Transfer Learning, HFTL)，将车辆按类型进行聚类并在簇内执行联邦迁移学习；构建 DT-VANET 框架，设计用于云端模型更新和簇内联邦迁移学习的两种算法，并加入基于数据质量评分的机制来降低恶意车辆对全局模型的影响。
Result: 在真实世界数据集上，针对不同性能指标进行的详细实验验证了所提算法在有效性和效率方面的表现。
Conclusion: 摘要认为将联邦迁移学习与车辆聚类结合，并辅以数据质量评分机制，可以改善数字孪生车载网络中全局模型的预测精度与鲁棒性。

papers.title: Keep the Future, Drop the Rollout: RIFT for World Action Models
papers.abstract_en: World action models (WAMs) condition robot actions on predicted futures, but iterative video rollout increases deployment latency. We ask whether action generation requires the evolving rollout trajectory or only its future representation. Across four WAMs on all 40 LIBERO tasks, paired closed-loop interventions show that masking or reassigning future-cache values changes execution and reduces success, indicating sensitivity to future values and their assigned positions. For Joint and Cosmos-2, however, replaying one fixed final-clean key/value (K/V) cache nearly preserves unmodified execution, with $1.7$ to $1.9$~cm end-effector average displacement error and $97.9\%$ to $98.2\%$ success. This separates cache consumption from production: these models can reuse a fixed cache but still require iterative rollout to construct it. We therefore propose RIFT (\emph{Rollout-free Imagination via Future Tokens}), which uses learned anticipation tokens to construct a complete future K/V cache in one backbone pass while retaining the original future-read interface. On LIBERO, RIFT achieves $98.8\%$ success, close to rollout-based Joint, IDM, and LingBot-VA at $98.4\%$ to $98.6\%$, while reducing action-chunk latency by $68.2\%$ to $89.1\%$. On RoboTwin~2.0, RIFT reaches $92.9/92.6\%$ on clean/randomized scenes, the highest observed among the evaluated methods. These results support rollout-free future conditioning without iterative video generation at deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对世界动作模型（WAM）部署时迭代视频 rollout 带来的延迟问题，通过配对闭环干预实验发现模型对 future-cache 值及其位置敏感，但 Joint 和 Cosmos-2 可复用固定 final-clean K/V 缓存。作者据此提出 RIFT（Rollout-free Imagination via Future Tokens），用学习到的 anticipation tokens 在单次骨干网络前向中构建完整未来 K/V 缓存，并在 LIBERO 与 RoboTwin 2.0 上取得接近或超过 rollout 基线方法的成功率，同时大幅降低动作块延迟。
Motivation: 世界动作模型需要根据预测的未来条件化机器人动作，但迭代视频 rollout 增加了部署延迟。论文质疑是否必须使用演化中的 rollout 轨迹，还是仅需其未来表示即可支撑动作生成。
Method: 在四种 WAM 上对全部 40 个 LIBERO 任务做配对闭环干预，包括掩蔽或重赋值 future-cache 值，发现执行会改变且成功率下降；但对 Joint 和 Cosmos-2，重放固定 final-clean K/V 缓存几乎保持原执行。基于此提出 RIFT，使用可学习的 anticipation tokens 在一次前向中构造完整未来 K/V 缓存，并保留原始 future-read 接口。
Result: 在 LIBERO 上 RIFT 达到 98.8% 成功率，接近 rollout 基线的 Joint、IDM、LingBot-VA（98.4%–98.6%），动作块延迟降低 68.2%–89.1%；在 RoboTwin 2.0 上达到 clean/randomized 场景 92.9%/92.6%，为评估方法中最高。
Conclusion: 这些结果支持在部署时可完全省略迭代视频生成，仅通过一次前向构建未来缓存实现 rollout-free 的未来条件化；同时指出部分模型仍需要迭代 rollout 来构造缓存，即缓存消费与生产可分离。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FLARE++: Low-rank attention with dynamic attention routing
papers.abstract_en: Full self-attention is a strong token mixer for PDE surrogates on irregular domains, but its quadratic cost limits its use on high-resolution problems. Efficient latent-attention models such as the Fast Low-rank Attention Routing Engine (FLARE) avoid that cost by routing all N tokens through M << N learned latent queries, but those queries are parameters: once trained, the same learned query templates serve every input. We remove this restriction with FLARE++, a low-rank attention architecture with dynamic token routing. FLARE++ reuses FLARE's own encoder to build its routing queries: learned latent seeds drive one extra encode call that gathers the N input tokens into M input-conditioned queries, and those queries then determine how the same tokens are compressed and redistributed. This preserves FLARE's explicit low-rank factorization and linear O(NM) complexity, and expresses the complete routing operation with standard scaled dot-product attention (SDPA) calls alone. We also provide a multi-GPU context-parallel implementation that shards input tokens across devices without ever gathering the full token sequence on one of them. FLARE++ is competitive across a set of standard PDE surrogate benchmarks, improving on fixed-query FLARE by 24% on average, and it gains 2.3 points of average accuracy on Long Range Arena.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FLARE++ 是一种低秩注意力架构，在 FLARE (Fast Low-rank Attention Routing Engine) 的基础上引入动态令牌路由：复用 FLARE 自身的编码器，用学到的潜在种子 (latent seeds) 额外执行一次编码调用，把 N 个输入令牌聚合成 M 个输入相关的查询，再由这些查询决定令牌的压缩与再分配。该方法保持显式低秩分解和线性 O(NM) 复杂度，并完全用标准缩放点积注意力 (SDPA) 表达路由操作；摘要还报告了一个多 GPU 上下文并行实现。实验上，FLARE++ 在一组标准 PDE 代理基准上平均比固定查询的 FLARE 提升 24%，并在 Long Range Arena 上平均准确率提高 2.3 点。
Motivation: FLARE 通过让所有 N 个令牌经过 M << N 个学到的潜在查询来规避全自注意力的二次复杂度，但这些查询是训练后固定的参数，同一套查询模板服务于所有输入，缺乏对输入的自适应性。
Method: FLARE++ 复用 FLARE 的编码器来构建路由查询：学到的潜在种子驱动一次额外的编码调用，把 N 个输入令牌汇聚为 M 个输入条件化的查询，再由这些查询决定同一组令牌如何被压缩和重分布；整个路由过程仅由标准缩放点积注意力 (SDPA) 调用组成，并保留了显式低秩分解与 O(NM) 复杂度。此外还提供了多 GPU 上下文并行实现，将输入令牌分片到不同设备而不在单设备上聚合完整序列。
Result: 在标准 PDE 代理基准上，FLARE++ 平均比固定查询的 FLARE 提升 24%；在 Long Range Arena 上平均准确率提高 2.3 点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 FLARE++ 在保留 FLARE 低秩线性复杂度的同时，通过输入条件化的动态路由提升了表达能力和性能。
Relevance: 35

summary_sections.method: FLARE++ 复用 FLARE 的编码器来构建路由查询：学到的潜在种子驱动一次额外的编码调用，把 N 个输入令牌汇聚为 M 个输入条件化的查询，再由这些查询决定同一组令牌如何被压缩和重分布；整个路由过程仅由标准缩放点积注意力 (SDPA) 调用组成，并保留了显式低秩分解与 O(NM) 复杂度。此外还提供了多 GPU 上下文并行实现，将输入令牌分片到不同设备而不在单设备上聚合完整序列。
summary_sections.result: 在标准 PDE 代理基准上，FLARE++ 平均比固定查询的 FLARE 提升 24%；在 Long Range Arena 上平均准确率提高 2.3 点。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调 FLARE++ 在保留 FLARE 低秩线性复杂度的同时，通过输入条件化的动态路由提升了表达能力和性能。

papers.title: New Orthogonal Multiwavelet Filters Derived by Matrix Spectral Factorization
papers.abstract_en: The paper considers the construction of two new orthogonal multiwavelets with supercompact support by using the Fast Bauer's method for matrix spectral factorization on the matrix product filter of the orthogonal CL multiwavelet filter. The new multiwavelets possess orthogonality, symmetry/antisymmetry, and one of them provides better coding and smoothness than other supercompact multiwavelets. The performance of the new multiwavelet filters in subband-based edge detection, grayscale and color image compression and 1D and 2D signal denoising is compared with the GHM, SA4, CL, Integer Haar and Alpert multifilters. The comparative analysis shows that new multiwavelets can provides better human visual measures, SSIM and MS-SSIM in image compression and denoising applications.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用 Fast Bauer 方法对正交 CL 多小波滤波器的矩阵乘积滤波器进行矩阵谱分解，构造出两种具有超紧支撑 (supercompact support) 的新正交多小波。新多小波具备正交性、对称/反对称性，其中一种在编码和平滑性上优于其他超紧支撑多小波。作者在子带边缘检测、灰度与彩色图像压缩以及 1D/2D 信号去噪中与 GHM、SA4、CL、Integer Haar 和 Alpert 等多滤波器比较，报告新多小波在图像压缩与去噪中能提供更好的人眼视觉度量、SSIM 和 MS-SSIM。
Motivation: 现有正交多小波滤波器需要在超紧支撑、对称性、编码效率与平滑性之间折衷，论文目标是构造同时具备正交性、对称/反对称性且综合性能更好的新多小波滤波器。
Method: 采用 Fast Bauer 方法对正交 CL 多小波滤波器的矩阵乘积滤波器进行矩阵谱分解 (matrix spectral factorization)，由此构造两种新的正交多小波，并保持超紧支撑和对称/反对称性质。
Result: 对比分析显示，新多小波在基于子带的边缘检测、灰度与彩色图像压缩以及 1D/2D 信号去噪中，相对 GHM、SA4、CL、Integer Haar 和 Alpert 等多滤波器，报告可获得更好的人眼视觉度量、SSIM 与 MS-SSIM；其中一种在编码和平滑性上优于其他超紧支撑多小波。
Conclusion: 摘要表明通过矩阵谱分解可以生成具有更好感知质量的多小波滤波器，其优势主要体现在图像压缩与去噪应用中。

papers.title: Long-window 4DVar for reanalysis using a differentiable weather model
papers.abstract_en: Atmospheric reanalyses combine observations with model forecasts using complex data assimilation systems. We test whether a differentiable weather model permits a simpler and more accurate method based on a long-window four-dimensional variational data assimilation (4D-Var) formulation that omits the conventional background-error term. The method uses automatic differentiation to find optimal NeuralGCM initial conditions that minimize the misfit to real surface-pressure observations distributed across overlapping windows of two to seven days, assuming no model error. Cycling at 6-hour intervals for three months beginning 1 January 2015 yields a stable reanalysis with smaller error relative to ERA5 in 500-hPa geopotential height than the Twentieth Century Reanalysis version 3 (20CRv3), which uses an ensemble Kalman filter to assimilate the same observations. Every window produces smaller errors than 20CRv3, with analysis error for the four-day window approximately 55% smaller than for 20CRv3. At the end of the four-day window, which does not benefit from future observations, error remains approximately 38% smaller than 20CRv3. Analyses degrade slightly beyond four days, which we attribute to the increasing importance of model error.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文测试可微天气模型是否能基于省略常规背景误差项的长窗口四维变分同化（4D-Var）实现更简单且更准确的再分析。方法利用自动微分寻找最优 NeuralGCM 初始条件，以最小化对真实海平面气压观测的拟合，窗口长度为 2 至 7 天。以 6 小时间隔循环三个月后，得到的再分析在 500-hPa 位势高度上相对 ERA5 的误差小于使用相同观测的 20CRv3。
Motivation: 传统大气再分析依赖复杂资料同化系统，作者希望验证可微天气模型能否通过更简单的长窗口 4D-Var 公式（省略背景误差项）提升精度，从而简化再分析流程。
Method: 提出不含背景误差项的长窗口 4D-Var 方法，通过自动微分优化 NeuralGCM 的初始条件以最小化与观测的海平面气压误差，并在重叠的 2 至 7 天窗口上以 6 小时间隔循环同化，假设无模型误差。
Result: 从 2015 年 1 月 1 日开始三个月的循环实验产生稳定再分析，500-hPa 位势高度误差低于 20CRv3。四天窗口的分析误差比 20CRv3 小约 55%，四天窗口结束时误差仍小约 38%；超过四天后分析质量略有退化。
Conclusion: 可微天气模型结合长窗口 4D-Var 可在省略背景误差项的前提下取得优于 20CRv3 的再分析效果，但窗口长度受模型误差制约，超过四天后精度下降。

papers.title: Learning Preference Adaptation for Large Language Model Personalization via Verbal Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Natural language user preferences provide an interpretable interface for LLM personalization. However, universal preference summaries often contain information irrelevant to a particular downstream task. Directly supplying the full preference summary therefore wastes context capacity and introduces cross-task distraction, while manually designing task-specific preference views is difficult to scale. In this work, we study \emph{task-specific preference adaptation}: given a universal user preference summary and a downstream task, derive a task-conditioned representation that preserves sufficient decision-relevant evidence while removing redundant context. To this end, we propose \textsc{AlignXada}, a training-free meta-learning framework that induces reusable textual refinement policies for adapting universal preference summaries to task-specific ones. The refinement policy is iteratively optimized by a meta learner through verbal reinforcement learning. Across 13 tasks and three downstream models (39 task--model cells), \textsc{AlignXada} achieves an average gain of 3.82 points, improving 33 cells while retaining only 22.8\% of the original profile tokens and outperforming RAG in 36 cells. An extended faithfulness analysis further shows that the refined profiles remain largely grounded in the source preferences while preserving task-relevant personalization signals, suggesting that profile-side adaptation serves as a practical complement to universal memory construction for lifelong personalized agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型（LLM）个性化中的任务特定偏好适应问题，提出训练免费的元学习框架 AlignXada。该方法通过言语强化学习（verbal reinforcement learning）迭代优化可复用的文本细化策略，将通用偏好摘要转换为任务特定表述。摘要报告在 13 个任务和三个下游模型（共 39 个任务-模型单元）上平均提升 3.82 点，仅保留原始 profile 词元的 22.8%，并在 36 个单元上优于 RAG。
Motivation: 通用偏好摘要常包含与特定下游任务无关的信息，直接提供完整摘要会浪费上下文容量并引入跨任务干扰；而手动设计任务特定的偏好视图难以扩展到大量任务。
Method: 提出 AlignXada，一种训练免费的元学习框架：元学习器通过言语强化学习迭代优化文本细化策略，从通用用户偏好摘要中推导任务条件化的精简表示，保留决策相关证据并移除冗余上下文。
Result: 在 13 个任务、三个下游模型组成的 39 个任务-模型单元上，AlignXada 平均提升 3.82 点，改善其中 33 个单元，仅保留原始 profile 词元的 22.8%，并在 36 个单元上超过 RAG；扩展的忠实性分析表明细化后的 profile 基本保持对源偏好的依赖并保留任务相关个性化信号。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 profile 侧的偏好适应可以作为通用记忆构建的实用补充，服务于终身个性化代理；细化后的表示在压缩上下文的同时仍保持对源偏好的忠实度。

papers.title: VANE: Reliable Test-Time Training for Vision-Language-Action Models via Future Visual Representation Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Test-time training (TTT) offers a lightweight way to adapt vision--language--action (VLA) policies from unlabeled deployment streams, but it remains difficult to use reliably in closed-loop manipulation. A shared adaptation space can mix incompatible task corrections, while an online update can alter subsequent actions before its consequences are known. We introduce a reliable TTT framework for VLA policies (VANE). VANE conditions prompt adaptation on the current vision--language context and learns from the future visual consequences of executed actions. Candidate updates are isolated from the live policy, evaluated on subsequent observations, and committed only when supported by future evidence, making adaptation selective and reversible. On SimplerEnv WidowX, VANE improves average success by $3.2$ percentage points over the corresponding TTT baseline. Results on Google Robot further show that deployment-time gains remain task- and embodiment-dependent. Together, these results demonstrate a constrained, evidence-based approach to adapting VLA policies during interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VANE，一个面向视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的可靠测试时训练（TTT）框架。VANE 以当前视觉-语言上下文为条件进行提示适配，并从已执行动作的未来视觉后果中学习；候选更新与在线策略隔离，仅在后续观测提供证据支持时才提交，使适配具有选择性和可逆性。在 SimplerEnv WidowX 上，VANE 相比对应 TTT 基线平均成功率提升 3.2 个百分点；Google Robot 上的结果则显示部署期收益仍依赖任务与本体。
Motivation: 现有测试时训练在闭环操作中难以可靠使用：共享适配空间可能混合不兼容的任务修正，在线更新会在后果未知前改变后续动作。
Method: VANE 将提示适配条件化在当前视觉-语言上下文上，并从执行动作的未来视觉结果中学习；候选更新与在线策略隔离，仅在后续观测支持时才提交，从而让适配具有选择性与可逆性。
Result: 在 SimplerEnv WidowX 上，VANE 平均成功率比对应 TTT 基线提高 3.2 个百分点；Google Robot 结果进一步表明部署期收益仍取决于任务与本体。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果展示了一种受约束的、基于证据的 VLA 策略交互期适配方法。

papers.title: Rethinking Medical Landmark Localization with Prototype Learning-based Progressive Offset Correction
papers.abstract_en: Accurate landmark localization in medical images is a fundamental step for quantitative clinical measurement and downstream analysis. Existing localization methods have advanced, among which multi-stage refinement is a superior solution. Although this strategy mitigates the anatomical ambiguity inherent in single-stage global predictions, its high computational cost limits practical applicability. In this work, we propose a parameter-economic model, PPOC-LL, which leverages Prototype learning-based Progressive Offset Correction for Landmark Localization. Our contribution is three-fold. First, to drive coarse-to-fine landmark optimization, we introduce a multi-scale dynamic perception strategy for patch-level feature pyramid modeling. Second, to effectively handle anatomically similar patterns, we design a similarity-driven prototype learning mechanism that captures informative local semantics for robust offset prediction. Last, to stabilize the model learning and improve the overall performance, we incorporate a novel error-aware reliability regularization via tolerance-based balancing. We collected a large validation cohort, including two public and one private datasets spanning X-ray and ultrasound modalities, covering cephalometric, symphysis-fetal head, and fetal heart landmarks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PPOC-LL achieves satisfactory performance with a favorable trade-off between accuracy and model complexity.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Accepted by MICCAI MLMI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PPOC-LL，一种基于原型学习（prototype learning）的渐进式偏移校正（progressive offset correction）参数经济型模型，用于医学图像中的地标定位（landmark localization）。方法通过多尺度动态感知策略构建补丁级特征金字塔，以相似度驱动的原型学习捕获局部语义，并用基于容差的误差感知可靠性正则化稳定训练。在 X 光和超声模态的颅颌、胎儿头部及胎儿心脏地标数据上验证了精度与模型复杂度之间的良好平衡。
Motivation: 多阶段细化定位能缓解单阶段全局预测的解剖模糊性，但计算成本高，限制了实际应用。本文目标是降低计算成本同时保持精确定位。
Method: 提出 PPOC-LL，包含三部分贡献：多尺度动态感知策略用于补丁级特征金字塔建模，实现 coarse-to-fine 优化；相似度驱动的原型学习机制处理解剖相似模式并进行鲁棒偏移预测；错误感知可靠性正则化（error-aware reliability regularization）通过基于容差的平衡（tolerance-based balancing）稳定学习并提升整体性能。
Result: 在包含两个公开和一个私有数据集的验证队列上，覆盖 X 光与超声模态（头影测量、胎盘-胎头、胎儿心脏地标），PPOC-LL 取得满意性能，并在准确度与模型复杂度之间获得有利权衡。

papers.title: Causal State-Space Model for Causal Inference: Estimating Longitudinal Individual Treatment Effects
papers.abstract_en: Estimating counterfactual outcomes over time from longitudinal observational data is central to clinical decision support. Existing methods rely on domain confusion -- adversarial training that renders representations invariant to treatment assignment -- yet this invariance creates a mutual information conflict: it suppresses treatment-correlated covariate signals necessary for accurate outcome prediction. We formalise this tension via a Jensen-Shannon divergence bound on counterfactual prediction error and develop two complementary models. CSSD (Causal State-Space model with Direct decoder) adapts selective State Space Models with a parallel multi-step decoder that eliminates accumulated rollout error by producing all prediction horizons simultaneously in a single forward pass. CSSPD (Causal State-Space model with Predictive regularisation and Direct decoder) augments CSSD with Contrastive Predictive Coding and Local Information Maximisation to reinforce temporal predictability in the balancing representation and recover local covariate information destroyed by domain confusion. On MIMIC-III, CSSPD achieves lower counterfactual RMSE than the Causal Transformer at every horizon tau >= 2 at O(T) encoder cost, with gains from 0.02 (2-step) to 0.07 (6-step). On Cancer Simulation across confounding strengths gamma in {0,1,2,3,4}, CSSPD outperforms CT at gamma <= 3 (margins 25.9%--37.0%), and CSSD achieves the lowest overall average RMSE (12.7% reduction over CT), confirming the MI conflict analysis. To our knowledge, this is the first work to formalise the balancing-prediction MI conflict and propose a structured resolution through complementary predictive and information-theoretic training objectives.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对纵向前瞻性观测数据中的反事实结果估计问题，指出现有基于领域混淆（domain confusion）的对抗训练会在表征不变性与结果预测所需的治疗相关协变量信号之间产生互信息（MI）冲突，并给出了对应的 Jensen-Shannon 散度界。作者提出两种互补模型：CSSD 采用选择性状态空间模型（selective State Space Model）加并行多步解码器，避免 rollout 误差累积；CSSPD 在此基础上引入对比预测编码（Contrastive Predictive Coding）与局部信息最大化，恢复被领域混淆破坏的局部协变量信息。在 MIMIC-III 与 Cancer Simulation 上，CSSPD 和 CSSD 相比 Causal Transformer 取得更低的反事实 RMSE。
Motivation: 现有时序反事实推断方法依赖对抗训练让表征对治疗分配不变，但这种不变性会抑制与治疗相关的协变量信号，而这些信号对准确的结果预测是必要的；已有方法未显式处理这一平衡与预测之间的互信息冲突。
Method: 提出 CSSD 与 CSSPD 两个模型：CSSD 将选择性状态空间模型与并行多步解码器结合，在单次前向传播中同时产生所有预测时域，以消除累积 rollout 误差；CSSPD 在 CSSD 上加入对比预测编码与局部信息最大化（Local Information Maximisation），强化平衡表征中的时间可预测性并恢复被领域混淆破坏的局部协变量信息。
Result: 在 MIMIC-III 上，CSSPD 在每一个时域 tau>=2 的反事实 RMSE 均低于 Causal Transformer，增益为 0.02（2 步）到 0.07（6 步），且编码器复杂度为 O(T)。在 Cancer Simulation 上，当混淆强度 gamma 属于 {0,1,2,3,4} 时，CSSPD 在 gamma<=3 的情况下优于因果 Transformer（优势幅度 25.9%–37.0%），CSSD 取得最低的平均 RMSE（较因果 Transformer 降低 12.7%）。
Conclusion: 作者认为这是首次将平衡-预测互信息冲突形式化，并通过互补的预测性与信息论训练目标提出结构化解决方案。

papers.title: Ego-OSCAR: Egocentric Open source Stereo CAptuRe System
papers.abstract_en: We present Ego-OSCAR, an open-hardware, low-cost, head-mounted stereo-inertial capture device for egocentric data collection in the wild. EgoOSCAR pairs a hardware-synchronized global-shutter stereo camera with a 6- axis IMU, an embedded Linux SBC for on-device video encoding, and a realtime microcontroller for user feedback and watchdog functions. The complete bill of materials is under USD 200 per unit, using only commercially available components and 3D-printed parts. Alongside the device, we release a complete software stack (hardware-accelerated recording pipeline, IMU sampling daemon, time-synchronization tooling, and watchdog firmware) and roughly 550 hours of egocentric stereo video per camera with synchronized IMU, collected by a distributed contributor network across everyday indoor environments. The release is annotated rather than raw: free-form action captions cover essentially the entire recorded timeline with an open vocabulary, and per-frame 3D hand reconstructions ship alongside per-session stereo calibration. Ego-OSCAR does not aim to match the per-unit fidelity of research-grade systems such as Project Aria; it aims to be the cheapest defensible substrate for crowdsourced egocentric capture, and to lower the activation energy for any team that wants to collect egocentric data at scale. All hardware designs, software, and the dataset are open-sourced
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Ego-OSCAR，一个开源、低成本、头戴式立体惯性采集设备，用于野外 ego-centric 数据采集。设备由硬件同步的全局快门立体相机、6 轴 IMU、嵌入式 Linux SBC 和实时微控制器组成，单台物料成本低于 200 美元，仅使用商用组件和 3D 打印部件。作者同时发布完整软件栈和约 550 小时带同步 IMU 的 ego-centric 立体视频数据集，并配有自由文本动作标注和逐帧 3D 手部重建。
Motivation: 现有研究级 ego-centric 采集系统（如 Project Aria）单台保真度高但成本与门槛高，不利于大规模众包采集。作者希望提供最便宜且可防御的开放硬件基底，降低任何团队规模化采集 ego-centric 数据的激活能量。
Method: 设计并实现开源头戴式立体惯性采集设备，包括硬件同步的全局快门双相机加 6 轴 IMU、用于端上视频编码的嵌入式 Linux SBC、以及负责用户反馈和看门狗功能的实时微控制器。配套发布硬件加速录制管线、IMU 采样守护进程、时间同步工具和看门狗固件，并开放全部硬件设计、软件与数据集。
Result: 单台物料成本低于 200 美元，使用全商用组件和 3D 打印件；通过分布式贡献者网络在室内日常环境中采集约 550 小时每相机的 ego-centric 立体视频并同步 IMU。数据集以标注而非原始形式发布，几乎覆盖全部时间线的开放词表动作描述，以及逐会话立体标定和逐帧 3D 手部重建。
Conclusion: 作者明确表示 Ego-OSCAR 不以匹配 Project Aria 等研究级系统的单机保真度为目标，而是作为众包 ego-centric 采集的最廉价可行基底，降低大规模采集门槛；所有硬件、软件和数据集均开源。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Do Evaluation Metrics Detect Errors in Classical Chinese to English Translations?
papers.abstract_en: Although large language models can translate some historical languages surprisingly well, their usefulness in digital humanities workflows is limited by the lack of reliable evaluation. We investigate whether existing automatic evaluation metrics developed for modern languages are reliable in this setting, using translation from Classical Chinese to English as a test case. We introduce a diagnostic framework based on minimal pairs capturing error types salient in scholarly use, probing both reference-based and reference-free metrics for error sensitivity and tolerance to valid variation. We find that all metrics exhibit blind spots, however MetricX24 performs best overall. Our findings highlight the need for more robust and interpretable metrics for historically and culturally distinct translation settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究现有自动评估指标在历史语言翻译场景中的可靠性，以文言文到英文翻译为测试案例。作者引入基于最小对（minimal pairs）的诊断框架，探测参考型与免参考型指标对学术使用中关键错误类型的敏感性和对有效变化的容忍度。结果表明所有指标都存在盲点，其中MetricX24整体表现最好。
Motivation: 大型语言模型虽能较好地翻译某些历史语言，但在数字人文学科工作流中的实用性受限于缺乏可靠评估。现有面向现代语言开发的自动评估指标在此类场景下是否可靠尚不清楚。
Method: 以文言文到英文翻译为测试案例，提出一个基于最小对（minimal pairs）的诊断框架，覆盖学术使用场景中重要的错误类型，并系统探测参考型与免参考型评估指标的错误敏感度和对合法变异的容忍度。
Result: 在测试的所有评估指标中，MetricX24的整体表现最佳，但所有指标均展现出不同程度的盲点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，针对历史上和文化上独特的翻译场景，需要开发更稳健且更具可解释性的评估指标。

papers.title: ED-CSP: Crystal Structure Prediction from Electron Diffraction
papers.abstract_en: Recovering a periodic 3D crystal structure from sparse, unindexed electron diffraction (ED) observations is a challenging generative inverse problem. Existing ED-based learning methods mainly predict crystallographic labels, reconstruct structures from indexed reflections, or retrieve candidates from finite structure libraries. Here, we introduce ED-CSP, a machine learning framework that predicts crystal structures from chemical composition, atom count, and multiple detector-plane ED spot sets. ED-CSP combines a relational set encoder, permutation-invariant multi-view aggregation, and a periodic flow generator to jointly predict lattice parameters and fractional atomic coordinates. To train the model, we construct ED-CS, a dataset of 4.85 million simulated multi-view ED crystal structures, deduplicated across seven materials repositories and filtered to exclude CHILI-100K overlaps. On 2,075 held-out CHILI-100K materials, ED-CSP trained only on CHILI achieves a structural match rate of 57.49% MR@5, outperforming PXRDGen (52.92%), a state-of-the-art crystal structure prediction model conditioned on powder X-ray diffraction. Scaling training data further improves performance: initializing from a one-million-structure precursor raises MR@5 to 66.27%. On 1,024 compositions absent from the training retrieval library, the model still achieves 53.52% MR@5, demonstrating true generative capability beyond exact-formula retrieval. Replacing target ED observations with diffraction from non-isomorphic structures of identical composition decreases MR@5 by 22.09 percentage points, confirming that predictions depend on the input diffraction patterns rather than composition alone. ED-CSP and ED-CS establish a benchmark for generative crystal structure prediction from sparse ED observations and provide a foundation for future transfer to experimental data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ED-CSP，一个从化学组成、原子数和多探测器平面电子衍射 (electron diffraction, ED) 斑点集合预测周期性 3D 晶体结构的机器学习框架。模型结合关系集合编码器、排列不变多视角聚合和周期流生成器，联合预测晶格参数与分数原子坐标。作者构建了包含 485 万个模拟多视角 ED 晶体结构的 ED-CS 数据集，并在 2,075 个 CHILI-100K 留出材料上取得 57.49% 的 MR@5，超过基于粉末 X 射线衍射的 PXRDGen。
Motivation: 从稀疏且未索引的电子衍射观测中恢复 3D 晶体结构是一个困难的生成逆问题；现有基于 ED 的学习方法只能预测晶体学标签、从索引进反射重建结构或从有限结构库中检索，缺乏直接生成完整结构的通用能力。
Method: ED-CSP 使用关系集合编码器处理输入，通过排列不变多视角聚合融合多个探测器平面的 ED 斑点集，并借助周期流生成器 (periodic flow generator) 联合输出晶格参数和分数原子坐标。作者还构建了大规模模拟数据集 ED-CS，并采用去重与过滤以避免与 CHILI-100K 重叠。
Result: 仅在 CHILI 上训练的 ED-CSP 在 2,075 个留出 CHILI-100K 材料上达到 57.49% MR@5，优于 PXRDGen 的 52.92%；用一百万个结构预训练后 MR@5 提升至 66.27%。在 1,024 个训练检索库中不存在的组成上仍达到 53.52% MR@5；将输入换成同组成非同构结构的衍射后 MR@5 下降 22.09 个百分点，表明预测确实依赖衍射图样。
Conclusion: ED-CSP 与 ED-CS 为从稀疏 ED 观测进行生成式晶体结构预测建立了基准，并为未来迁移到实验数据提供了基础。

summary_sections.method: ED-CSP 使用关系集合编码器处理输入，通过排列不变多视角聚合融合多个探测器平面的 ED 斑点集，并借助周期流生成器 (periodic flow generator) 联合输出晶格参数和分数原子坐标。作者还构建了大规模模拟数据集 ED-CS，并采用去重与过滤以避免与 CHILI-100K 重叠。
summary_sections.result: 仅在 CHILI 上训练的 ED-CSP 在 2,075 个留出 CHILI-100K 材料上达到 57.49% MR@5，优于 PXRDGen 的 52.92%；用一百万个结构预训练后 MR@5 提升至 66.27%。在 1,024 个训练检索库中不存在的组成上仍达到 53.52% MR@5；将输入换成同组成非同构结构的衍射后 MR@5 下降 22.09 个百分点，表明预测确实依赖衍射图样。
summary_sections.conclusion: ED-CSP 与 ED-CS 为从稀疏 ED 观测进行生成式晶体结构预测建立了基准，并为未来迁移到实验数据提供了基础。

papers.title: Continual Learning in Transition
papers.abstract_en: Classical continual learning (CL) has primarily focused on enabling models to update and retain knowledge through parameter-centric mechanisms, e.g., training strategies, architectural designs, and weight adaptation. However, emerging paradigms are reshaping the scope of CL beyond this traditional model adaptation view. For instance, on-policy learning broadens the space of update mechanisms; test-time training extends CL from the training phase to inference; and external harness components such as memory, skill libraries, and interaction protocols extend the evolutionary boundaries of model capabilities far beyond the static parameter space. Collectively, these developments indicate a transition from parameter-centric learning toward system-level adaptation. To characterize this transition, we examine the evolution of continual learning through three dimensions: When, How, and Where learning occurs. The How dimension encompasses off-policy, on-policy, and beyond-gradient optimization mechanics. The When dimension captures evolution across pre-training, post-training, and inference-time stages. The Where dimension delineates updates occurring within internal parameters versus external structural constraints. Anchored by this tri-axial framework, we systematically survey representative methods, trace the ongoing transition of continual learning, and discuss the key challenges, broader implications, and future directions arising from this paradigm shift.
papers.comment: Survey on continual learning in the LLM and agentic-AI era
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于持续学习 (continual learning, CL) 在 LLM 与智能体 AI 时代范式转变的综述。作者提出从学习发生的 How、When、Where 三个维度刻画传统参数中心化学习向系统级适应的过渡，并系统梳理了 off-policy/on-policy/超越梯度的优化机制、预训练/后训练/推理时阶段以及内部参数与外部结构约束下的更新。摘要表明，测试时训练 (test-time training)、外部记忆、技能库与交互协议等发展正将 CL 的边界从静态参数空间扩展到更广的系统层面。
Motivation: 经典持续学习主要关注参数中心化的机制（训练策略、架构设计、权重适应），但新范式如 on-policy 学习、测试时训练和外部组件正在重塑 CL 的范畴，现有视角难以刻画这一转变。
Method: 提出一个三轴框架：How（off-policy、on-policy、超越梯度的优化机制）、When（预训练、后训练、推理时阶段）、Where（内部参数与外部结构约束），并基于该框架系统调查代表性方法。
Result: 作为综述，摘要未报告具体实验数据，而是追踪持续学习从参数中心化到系统级适应的转型过程，并总结关键挑战与未来方向。
Conclusion: 作者认为持续学习正在经历从参数中心化学习向系统级适应的范式转移，并指出这一转变带来的关键挑战、更广泛的影响和未来研究方向。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Grounded Well-Condition Anomaly Detection on the Volve Field: Constructed Labels, a Baseline, and a Dual-Head Model
papers.abstract_en: Most public benchmarks for machine-condition monitoring come from test rigs, where faults are induced on purpose and every event is known. Real production fields rarely offer that. They give you sensor histories with no fault log attached, which is exactly the situation where an anomaly-detection method has to invent its own labels, and where quiet assumptions can slip in unnoticed. We work with the open Volve field data released by Equinor and take two things seriously that such datasets usually skip. First, we build anomaly labels that are not just patterns in the numbers but are checked against what the field's own engineering documents say can physically go wrong, and we release the reasoning behind every label. Second, we test whether those constructed labels are learnable at all, using both an unsupervised baseline and a small dual-head model that marks when an event happens and what kind it is, an idea we carry over from earlier work on defect detection in metal parts. The results are honest. An unsupervised detector that never sees the labels still lands on the same regions our rules flagged, which tells us the labels are not arbitrary. A compact supervised model recovers event presence and event type well across wells it has never seen, and locates events in time only roughly. We report what worked, what did not, and every assumption in between. The dataset, grounded labels, per-label provenance, baseline scores, trained model, and code are released publicly under CC-BY-NC-SA 4.0.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于Equinor公开的Volve油田数据，构建了经过工程文档验证的异常标签，并评估了无监督基线与小型双头模型在该数据上的表现。摘要报告称无监督检测器无需标签即可落在规则标记的相同区域，监督模型能较好地恢复未见井的事件存在性与类型，但时间定位仅大致准确。数据、标签、推理过程、代码等以CC-BY-NC-SA 4.0公开。
Motivation: 公开机器状态监测基准多来自测试台架，故障是人为诱导且事件已知；真实生产油田只有传感器历史而没有故障日志，异常检测方法需要自行构建标签且容易引入隐含假设。
Method: 先依据油田工程文档构建物理上可解释的异常标签并记录每条标签的推理依据；再用无监督基线验证标签可学习性，并引入一个小型双头模型同时输出事件发生时刻与事件类型。
Result: 无监督检测器未见标签时仍与规则标记区域一致，说明标签并非任意；紧凑监督模型在未见井上能较好恢复事件存在性与类型，但事件时间定位仅粗略。
Conclusion: 作者如实报告了有效与无效的环节及全部假设，并公开数据集、grounded标签、逐标签来源、基线分数、训练模型与代码。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LoDA: A Level of Detection Aware Method and a Multimodal Sensing Benchmark for Object Level Change Detection
papers.abstract_en: High-definition 3D LiDAR maps are important for autonomous driving and smart-city services, which require reliable detection of object-level changes in multi-temporal urban LiDAR to keep digital maps aligned with the physical world. Existing approaches from raster height differencing to depth image and point-cloud networks often remain tile-based and threshold-driven, yielding per-point scores without explicit detection limits or consistent object-level labels. We propose an object-level 3D change-detection pipeline that integrates detection-limit-aware registration, geometry-driven object proxies with rule-based semantic and instance segmentation, and displacement cues in height, volume, and surface-normal direction to assign five change labels with confidence. By decoupling registration, geometry, and semantics, the pipeline propagates pose uncertainty into spatially varying detection limits, stabilizes cross-epoch correspondences, and suppresses false changes caused by residual misalignment and density variation. We also present LoDA, a level-of-detection (LoD) aware benchmark for the Subiaco district with fused multi-temporal vehicle-LiDAR maps constructed with LiDAR, GNSS, and IMU support, semantic instances, and object-level annotations. On this benchmark, our method achieves 95.0% accuracy, 90.8% macro F1, and 83.0% macro IoU, exceeding the best baseline by 8.7 IoU points and 4.4 F1 points. On the public Urb3DCD-V2 benchmark evaluated under the official point-wise protocol, it reaches 96.81% mean accuracy and 89.52% mean change IoU, improving over the strongest reported baselines by 1.36 points in mAcc and 3.18 points in mIoUch.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LoDA，一个面向城市多时相 LiDAR 数据的对象级 3D 变化检测流水线，并配套发布 Subiaco 区域的 LoD 感知基准。流水线将检测限感知配准、基于几何对象代理的规则化语义与实例分割、以及高度/体积/法向位移线索相结合，输出带置信度的五类变化标签。在自建基准上达到 95.0% 准确率、90.8% macro F1 与 83.0% macro IoU，并在公开 Urb3DCD-V2 点级协议下优于现有基线。
Motivation: 高精度 3D LiDAR 地图需要可靠检测多时相城市场景中的对象级变化，以保持数字地图与物理世界对齐。现有基于栅格高度差、深度图像或点云网络的方法多为瓦片级、阈值驱动，只能给出逐点分数，缺乏显式检测极限和一致的对象级标签。
Method: 提出对象级 3D 变化检测流水线，包含检测限感知配准、结合规则化语义与实例分割的几何驱动对象代理，以及高度、体积和表面法向方向的位移线索，用于分配五种带置信度的变化标签。通过解耦配准、几何与语义，将位姿不确定性传播为空间变化的检测限，稳定跨时期对应关系并抑制残差对齐和密度变化造成的虚假变化。
Result: 在 Subiaco 基准上，方法达到 95.0% 准确率、90.8% macro F1 和 83.0% macro IoU，较最优基线分别提升 8.7 IoU 点和 4.4 F1 点；在官方逐点协议下的 Urb3DCD-V2 基准上达到 96.81% 平均准确率和 89.52% 平均变化 IoU，较最强基线提升 1.36 mAcc 与 3.18 mIoUch。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，解耦配准、几何与语义并显式建模检测极限，可以稳定跨时期对应并抑制虚假变化，从而在对象级变化检测上取得优于现有基线的性能。
Relevance: 0
