papers.title: Unscented KalmanNet: Structure-Preserving Deep Learning with Calibrated Posterior Uncertainty under Incomplete Physics and Unknown Noise
papers.abstract_en: Nonlinear state estimation requires sequentially fusing model-based predictions with noisy measurements. Under imperfect dynamics and unknown, time-varying noise statistics, this fusion can degrade in both accuracy and statistical consistency. Existing learning-aided filters largely treat accuracy and uncertainty estimation separately, limiting their ability to correct model-mismatch-induced bias while retaining an explicit, calibrated posterior covariance. This paper introduces Unscented KalmanNet (UKN), a model-based deep learning architecture that extends the Unscented Kalman Filter (UKF) with learned mechanisms for these two sources of filtering error while preserving explicit posterior covariance propagation. NoiseNet learns time-varying process and measurement covariances as bounded multiplicative corrections to baseline covariances, guaranteeing positive definiteness, while GainNet learns a bounded residual correction to the analytical UKF gain to compensate for model-mismatch-induced bias. A calibration-aware training objective couples state error with posterior covariance and innovation consistency terms through adaptive weighting, jointly optimizing accuracy and calibration. UKN is benchmarked against UKF, KalmanNet, and Bayesian KalmanNet on three synthetic systems and real-flight UZH-FPV data. It achieves the lowest state-estimation error in all four examples and reduces RMSE by 26.4-49.7% compared with UKF in the synthetic cases. Leave-one-sequence-out cross-validation over 11 flights shows 22.4% and 34.3% reductions in mean position and velocity RMSE, respectively. UKN also yields the lowest fold-to-fold variability, with dimension-normalized NEES and empirical coverage closest to nominal values among covariance-reporting filters. These results show that structured learned adaptation improves estimation accuracy while retaining calibrated uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Unscented KalmanNet (UKN)，一种基于模型的深度学习架构，在无迹卡尔曼滤波 (UKF) 基础上引入两个学习机制：NoiseNet 学习时变过程与测量协方差的有界乘性修正，以保证正定性；GainNet 学习 UKF 增益的有界残差修正，以补偿模型失配导致的偏差。作者使用校准感知的训练目标，将状态误差、后验协方差与创新一致性项通过自适应加权联合优化。在三个合成系统与真实 UZH-FPV 飞行数据上，UKN 在四个例子中均取得最低状态估计误差，并在合成案例中将 RMSE 较 UKF 降低 26.4%-49.7%。
Motivation: 非线性状态估计在动力学不完善且噪声统计未知或时变时，模型预测与噪声测量融合的精度和统计一致性都会下降。现有学习辅助滤波器大多将精度与不确定性估计分开处理，难以在修正模型失配偏差的同时保持显式且校准的后验协方差。
Method: UKN 扩展 UKF，保留显式后验协方差传播；NoiseNet 将时变过程/测量协方差建模为基线协方差的有界乘性修正，保证正定性；GainNet 学习对解析 UKF 增益的有界残差修正以补偿模型失配偏差。训练目标通过自适应加权联合优化状态误差、后验协方差与创新一致性项，同时优化精度与校准。
Result: 在三个合成系统与真实 UZH-FPV 数据集上，UKN 的四个测试例子均取得最低状态估计误差；合成案例较 UKF 降低 RMSE 26.4%-49.7%；11 次飞行的留一序列交叉验证显示平均位置与速度 RMSE 分别降低 22.4% 和 34.3%。此外，UKN 的跨折变异性最低，其维度归一化 NEES 和经验覆盖率在所有提供协方差的滤波器中最为接近名义值。
Conclusion: 摘要认为结构化的学习式自适应（structured learned adaptation）能够在提高估计精度的同时保持校准的不确定性。
Relevance: 55

summary_sections.result: 在三个合成系统与真实 UZH-FPV 数据集上，UKN 的四个测试例子均取得最低状态估计误差；合成案例较 UKF 降低 RMSE 26.4%-49.7%；11 次飞行的留一序列交叉验证显示平均位置与速度 RMSE 分别降低 22.4% 和 34.3%。此外，UKN 的跨折变异性最低，其维度归一化 NEES 和经验覆盖率在所有提供协方差的滤波器中最为接近名义值。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要认为结构化的学习式自适应（structured learned adaptation）能够在提高估计精度的同时保持校准的不确定性。

papers.title: Beyond Representational Similarity: Source-Conditioned Description-Length Gain for Generative Plagiarism Detection and Candidate Source Reranking
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) pose challenges to academic integrity and peer review. Yet generative plagiarism detection remains an underexplored and largely unresolved challenge. Prior work on LLM-generated-text detection targets AI involvement, which may be permissible, rather than source reuse, while similarity-based methods struggle after extensive rewriting and multi-source synthesis. Motivated by the description-length view of probabilistic prediction, in which relevant side information can reduce a target sequence's code length, we introduce Source-Conditioned Description-Length Gain (SCDG), a directional, training-free framework that contrasts a frozen language model's description length of a suspicious document $P$ with and without a candidate source $S$. This contrast yields token-level log-likelihood gains that measure the incremental predictive evidence supplied by $S$. We evaluate SCDG on the PAN at CLEF benchmarks for generative plagiarism. On a PAN 2025-derived pairwise benchmark, SCDG achieves 0.92 Precision, 0.97 Recall, and 0.94 F1, outperforming all baselines; on PAN 2026's multi-source retrieval task, it reaches 0.83 nDCG@10 and 0.96 Recall@100, surpassing all baselines. On a same-topic, same-event Multi-News test, the calibrated gain-distribution SCDG classifier predicts source reuse for only $0.125\%$ of pairs, supporting robustness to topical overlap under this evaluation protocol. These results establish SCDG as a unified and token-decomposable signal for source-specific content reuse under extensive transformation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Source-Conditioned Description-Length Gain (SCDG)，一个无需训练的方向性框架，用于生成式抄袭检测与候选源重排序。它通过对比冻结语言模型在有无候选源 $S$ 条件下对可疑文档 $P$ 的描述长度，得到 token 级对数似然增益，以此度量 $S$ 提供的增量预测证据。在 PAN 2025 派生配对基准上达到 0.92 Precision、0.97 Recall、0.94 F1，在 PAN 2026 多源检索任务上达到 0.83 nDCG@10 和 0.96 Recall@100，均超过所有基线。
Motivation: 大语言模型对学术诚信和同行评审构成挑战，但生成式抄袭检测仍未被充分研究。已有 LLM 文本检测关注 AI 参与而非源复用，且基于相似度的方法在大量改写和多源综合后失效。
Method: SCDG 基于概率预测的描述长度视角，将相关 side information 能缩短目标序列编码长度这一原理转化为可计算的信号。它对比同一冻结语言模型对可疑文档在给定与不给定候选源时的描述长度，产生方向性的 token 级增益，无需训练。
Result: 在 PAN 2025 派生配对基准上，SCDG 取得 0.92 Precision、0.97 Recall、0.94 F1，超过所有基线；在 PAN 2026 多源检索任务上取得 0.83 nDCG@10 和 0.96 Recall@100，同样超过所有基线。在同主题同事件的 Multi-News 测试中，校准后的增益分布分类器仅对 0.125% 的配对预测为源复用，表明在该评估协议下对主题重叠具有鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要将 SCDG 确立为一种统一且可逐 token 分解的信号，用于检测经过大幅变换的特定源内容复用。其鲁棒性结论限定于该评估协议下，且论文本身属于抄袭检测领域，与天气相关关键词无直接关联。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: EchoCache: Energy-Guided Cross-Modal Caching for Efficient Audio-Driven Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Audio-driven video generation (A2V) has achieved promising progress in synthesizing temporally coherent and audio-visually aligned videos, yet its inference remains expensive due to the iterative denoising process of diffusion models. Existing caching methods mainly exploit temporal redundancy in visual features while overlooking the cross-modal alignment of A2V, where audio drives visual generation with highly non-uniform temporal importance. In this paper, we identify two levels of misalignment in existing A2V caching methods: temporal-semantic and computation-storage misalignment. To address them, we propose EchoCache, an energy-guided cross-modal caching framework for efficient A2V generation. EchoCache leverages audio time-frequency energy as a saliency anchor to guide latent-level cache updates and further introduces a dynamic timestep-latent caching mechanism with quantized cache management for joint efficiency and memory optimization. Extensive experiments on mainstream A2V models show that EchoCache consistently improves the latency-quality trade-off while preserving generation quality and audio-visual consistency. In particular, on Wan2.2-S2V over the EMTD benchmark, EchoCache achieves a 2.46x speedup with the best overall performance. Code is available at https://github.com/IF-LAB-PKU/EchoCache.
papers.comment: EchoCache is honored to be accepted by ACM MM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EchoCache，一种面向音频驱动视频生成（A2V）的能量引导跨模态缓存框架。现有缓存方法主要利用视觉特征的时间冗余，忽略了音频驱动视觉生成中高度非均匀的时间重要性；EchoCache 以音频时频能量作为显著性锚点指导潜在层缓存更新，并引入动态 timestep-latent 缓存机制与量化缓存管理。实验表明该方法在主流 A2V 模型上一致改善延迟-质量权衡，并在 Wan2.2-S2V 上于 EMTD 基准取得 2.46x 加速且保持最佳整体性能。
Motivation: 音频驱动视频生成（A2V）由于扩散模型的迭代去噪过程导致推理成本高昂；现有缓存方法仅挖掘视觉特征的时间冗余，忽视了 A2V 中音频驱动视觉生成的非均匀时间重要性，存在时间-语义和计算-存储两个层面的错配（misalignment）。
Method: 提出 EchoCache 框架：利用音频时频能量作为显著性锚点（saliency anchor）引导潜在层（latent-level）缓存更新，并设计动态 timestep-latent 缓存机制配合量化缓存管理，在提升效率的同时优化内存占用。
Result: 在主流 A2V 模型上的实验表明，EchoCache 一致改善延迟-质量权衡并保持生成质量与音视频一致性；在 Wan2.2-S2V 上于 EMTD 基准达到 2.46x 加速并取得最佳整体性能。
Conclusion: 摘要认为能量引导的跨模态缓存能够解决现有 A2V 缓存方法中的跨模态错配问题，为高效音频驱动视频生成提供了有效方案。

papers.title: Empowering Credit Risk Detection in Weixin Pay with Billion-Scale Deep Graph Learning
papers.abstract_en: Credit risk detection, particularly mitigating individual fraud, is crucial for maintaining the stability of digital financial ecosystems. Accurately identifying credit fraud among billions of users is critical for minimizing financial losses and safeguarding the sustainability of inclusive financial services. Given that credit fraud risks are often concealed within heterogeneous user-risk graphs, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have emerged as an effective tool for risk mining by capturing complex dependencies. To address the scalability bottleneck of industrial GNNs, distributed training based on subgraphs is indispensable. However, existing strategies often compromise topological integrity for load balancing. This can be catastrophic for risk detection, as it indiscriminately severs the long-tail evidence chains essential for risk propagation. Overlapping subgraphs can restore severed risk contexts but inevitably introduce redundancy and noise, while overlooking the representation alignment across different local subgraphs. In this paper, we propose a risk-aware overlapping subgraph learning framework for large-scale credit risk detection. We first construct base partitions to ensure load balance. Then, we perform budget-constrained sampling that selects informative long-tail nodes, thereby preserving critical risk diffusion patterns while filtering out noise. To mitigate representation inconsistency, we design a cross-subgraph consistency alignment mechanism. By enforcing alignment constraints on the overlapping nodes, we harmonize the local representations into a globally consistent latent space. Extensive experiments on Weixin Pay's production dataset demonstrate that our model significantly outperforms existing strategies for risk detection, offering a scalable and effective solution for industrial graph learning.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (KDD '26), pp. 7679-7690, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向微信支付十亿级用户信用风险检测的风险感知重叠子图学习框架。针对工业 GNN 分布式训练中子图划分破坏拓扑完整性的问题，框架采用预算约束采样保留长尾节点，并通过跨子图一致性对齐机制统一表示空间。在微信支付生产数据集上的实验表明，该方法显著优于现有风险检测策略。
Motivation: 工业 GNN 的分布式训练依赖基于子图的划分，但现有策略常在负载均衡与拓扑完整性之间取舍，割裂长尾证据链会破坏风险传播；重叠子图虽能恢复风险上下文，却引入冗余与噪声，且缺乏跨子图的表示对齐。
Method: 先构造基础划分保证负载均衡；再进行预算约束采样以选取信息量大的长尾节点，保留关键风险扩散模式并过滤噪声；最后设计跨子图一致性对齐机制，对重叠节点施加对齐约束，将局部表示统一到全局一致的隐空间。
Result: 在微信支付生产数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在风险检测上显著优于现有策略，提供了可扩展且有效的工业图学习方案。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架能兼顾大规模扩展性与风险语义完整性，适用于工业环境中的大规模信用风险检测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Latent-Centroid Steering: Single-Pass Classifier-Free Guidance for Command-Aligned Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for end-to-end autonomous driving, enabling agents to map multimodal inputs and high-level navigation instructions directly to executable trajectories. However, in practice, these models exhibit a persistent command-following gap: predicted trajectories often show weak sensitivity to navigation commands, resulting in incorrect behavior at critical decision points. We identify this issue as a form of conditional policy collapse, where regression-based training under multimodal trajectory distributions encourages the model to rely on dominant visual priors while marginalizing the language-conditioned signal. To address this issue, we introduce a principled formulation of classifier-free guidance (CFG) for regression-based vision-language driving. We show that CFG can be interpreted as isolating the instruction-induced residual in the action space by contrasting conditional and unconditional predictions, thereby explicitly amplifying the effect of the navigation command at inference time. However, a standard two-pass CFG introduces prohibitive latency for real-time control and produces noisy instance-level guidance directions. Building on a mean-shift interpretation of CFG, we propose Latent-Centroid Steering (LCS), a single-pass guidance mechanism that replaces instance-level residuals with class-level latent shifts. By projecting conditional representations toward precomputed command-specific centroids, LCS performs class-level latent steering based on cluster geometry that is both more stable and computationally efficient. We demonstrate that LCS reduces inference latency by approximately 50% while achieving stronger command adherence and improved driving performance on both closed-loop (Bench2Drive) and open-loop (nuScenes) benchmarks. Code will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉-语言模型（VLM）端到端自动驾驶中导航指令不敏感的问题，提出一种基于回归的单遍无分类器引导（classifier-free guidance, CFG）机制 Latent-Centroid Steering (LCS)。作者将命令跟随失败归因于条件策略坍塌，并借鉴 CFG 的 mean-shift 解释，用预计算的指令特定质心进行类级潜在空间引导，替代标准双遍 CFG 的实例级残差。摘要报告该方法在推理延迟上约降低 50%，并在闭环 Bench2Drive 与开环 nuScenes 基准上同时提升指令遵循度和驾驶性能。
Motivation: VLM 端到端驾驶模型存在持续的命令跟随差距（command-following gap），预测轨迹对导航指令敏感度低，在关键决策点出现错误行为。作者将其识别为一种条件策略坍塌：多模态轨迹分布下的回归训练使模型依赖主导视觉先验而弱化语言条件信号，且标准双遍 CFG 对实时控制延迟过高、实例级引导方向噪声大。
Method: 提出 Latent-Centroid Steering (LCS)：基于 CFG 的 mean-shift 解释，将条件表示投影到预计算的指令特定质心，以类级潜在偏移替代实例级残差，实现单遍的类级潜在引导。该方法在推理时显式放大导航指令的影响，且无需双遍前向。
Result: 摘要报告 LCS 将推理延迟降低约 50%，同时在闭环 Bench2Drive 和开环 nuScenes 基准上取得更强的命令遵循度和更优的驾驶性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于簇几何的类级潜在引导比实例级残差更稳定且计算高效，能有效缓解条件策略坍塌并改善指令对齐；代码将公开发布。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A foundation model of numerical intelligence with cross-disciplinary generalization
papers.abstract_en: Intelligence is commonly understood as the ability to acquire and apply knowledge, adapt to unfamiliar situations and solve new problems. Large language models exhibit this capacity by inferring task-relevant knowledge from textual context and applying it to new tasks. Yet intelligence need not be confined to language. For scientific and social systems, we need models that acquire and apply knowledge from numerical context-an ability we call numerical intelligence. Here we introduce UNified In-Context Operator Networks (UNICON), a foundation model that exhibits numerical intelligence across disciplines. Using graph-based examples from a system as context, UNICON infers the predictive relation shared across them and applies it to queries from the same system. Across scientific and social systems, including those from disciplines absent from training, the same model approaches specialist performance without retraining. Combining UNICON with language-model agents to perform contextual ensemble learning (CEL) yields further gains, enabling it to surpass state-of-the-art specialists in a discipline unseen during training. We further show that training-corpus diversity improves generalization to unseen disciplines. Together, these results establish UNICON as a foundation model of numerical intelligence and position it as a building block for a broader ecosystem of artificial intelligence.

TL;DR: 本文提出 UNified In-Context Operator Networks (UNICON)，一个面向“数值智能”(numerical intelligence) 的基础模型。它以同一系统的图结构示例作为上下文，推断共享的预测关系并应用到新查询，在科学与社会系统（包括训练中未见的学科）上无需再训练即可接近专家性能。与语言模型智能体结合进行上下文集成学习 (contextual ensemble learning, CEL) 后，还能在未见学科上超过现有专门模型。研究同时表明训练语料多样性会提升对未见学科的泛化能力。
Motivation: 通用智能不应局限于语言；科学与社会系统需要从数值上下文中获取并应用知识的能力，而现有模型缺少这种跨学科的数值理解能力。
Method: 提出 UNICON，一种使用图结构示例作为上下文的基础模型，从同一系统的样本中推断预测关系再迁移到查询；并设计了将 UNICON 与语言模型智能体结合、实现上下文集成学习 (CEL) 的框架。
Result: 在同一模型上，跨科学和社会系统（包括训练中未出现的学科）都接近专家性能而无需重训练；结合 CEL 后可在未见学科上超越 state-of-the-art 专门模型；训练语料多样性对未见学科的泛化有正向作用。
Conclusion: 摘要将 UNICON 定位为数值智能的基础模型，并认为它可作为更广泛人工智能生态的构建块。摘要未明确讨论方法的适用范围或局限。

papers.title: DREvo: Distilling Recalibrated Historical Experience for Harness Self-Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Harness plays a critical role in large language model agent performance, and building a high-performing harness requires substantial expert effort. Therefore, recent research has increasingly explored harness self-evolution, which iteratively proposes, evaluates, and improves harnesses using historical trial experience. However, accumulated historical experience does not always translate into stable search guidance, and performance often fluctuates substantially across evolution iterations, making it difficult to reliably discover high-performing harnesses under a limited evolution budget. We identify two limitations in how existing harness self-evolution methods leverage historical experience: (1) Lack of dynamic reassessment of whether historical experience remains valid for the current harness, and (2) Lack of explicit mechanisms for translating valid historical experience into actionable search directions. To address these limitations, we propose a new harness self-evolution method, named DREvo, which integrates function-level evidence anchoring, state-dependent evidence recalibration, and role-conditioned search intent distillation to determine which historical evidence remains valid and where the harness should evolve next. Under limited evolution budgets, DREvo exhibits smoother evolution trajectories, achieves the highest accuracy on all five benchmarks, and delivers average gains of 16.2% and 14.2% over the evaluated baselines on domain reasoning and agentic tasks, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DREvo，一种用于大语言模型智能体 harness 自进化（self-evolution）的方法。该方法通过函数级证据锚定、状态相关证据重校准和角色条件搜索意图蒸馏，解决历史经验利用不稳定的问题。在有限进化预算下，DREvo 在五个基准上取得最高准确率，并在领域推理和智能体任务上分别平均超过基线 16.2% 和 14.2%。
Motivation: 现有 harness 自进化方法利用历史经验时存在两个局限：缺乏对历史经验是否仍适用于当前 harness 的动态重评估，以及缺乏将有效经验转化为明确搜索方向的机制。这导致进化过程中性能波动大，难以在有限预算下可靠发现高性能 harness。
Method: DREvo 集成了函数级证据锚定（function-level evidence anchoring）、状态相关证据重校准（state-dependent evidence recalibration）和角色条件搜索意图蒸馏（role-conditioned search intent distillation），用于判断哪些历史证据仍然有效以及下一步应向何处进化。
Result: 摘要报告 DREvo 在有限进化预算下表现出更平滑的进化轨迹，并在全部五个基准上达到最高准确率；相比评估基线，在领域推理和智能体任务上分别平均提升 16.2% 和 14.2%。
Conclusion: 作者认为，动态重校准历史证据并将有效经验蒸馏为搜索意图，可以稳定 harness 自进化过程并提升有限预算下的搜索效率。

papers.title: Understanding Knowledge Transfer Mechanism in Heterogeneous MLLM Fusion: A Simple Linear Approach
papers.abstract_en: Training-free fusion of heterogeneous multimodal large language models (MLLMs) provides a direct route for cross-scale capability transfer, yet improvements in aggregate performance do not reveal what a smaller model actually inherits. Existing studies are largely designed and evaluated on limited task sets or aggregate metrics; as evaluation expands to broader task collections, whether different capabilities can transfer across scales remains poorly understood. To investigate this question, we introduce Cross-Scale Directional Parameter Injection (CDPI), a simple linear probe to analyze cross-scale knowledge transfer during heterogeneous fusion. A local theoretical analysis indicates that knowledge transfer selectivity is determined at first order by capability-dependent responses to a shared injection direction, while second-order curvature effects constrain the effective transfer regime. Across four Qwen3-VL model pairs and twelve multimodal benchmarks, our experiments reveal a consistent pattern of selectivity: gains concentrate on reasoning, particularly high-level reasoning, whereas perception performance remains close to that of the original target model. Component-wise ablations further show that high-level reasoning gains arise primarily from the language model, while ratio analysis finds that positive selective transfer occurs mainly in the small-ratio regime. These findings recast cross-scale heterogeneous MLLM fusion as selective language-side reasoning transfer within a narrow, low-interference regime, rather than broad capability inheritance.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 6 figures; includes supplementary material. Revised presentation and terminology; results unchanged
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究异构多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 在免训练融合中的跨尺度知识迁移机制，提出 Cross-Scale Directional Parameter Injection (CDPI)，一个用于分析跨尺度知识迁移的简单线性探针。基于四个 Qwen3-VL 模型对和十二个多模态基准的实验，作者发现迁移呈现选择性：增益集中在推理尤其是高层推理，而感知性能接近原目标模型。结论将跨尺度异构 MLLM 融合重新定义为窄低干扰区间内的选择性语言侧推理迁移，而非广泛能力继承。
Motivation: 免训练的异构 MLLM 融合能提升聚合性能，但现有研究多在有限任务集或聚合指标上评估，不清楚较小模型具体继承了什么能力，跨尺度能力是否可迁移也缺乏理解。
Method: 提出 CDPI (Cross-Scale Directional Parameter Injection)，一种简单线性探针方法，用于分析异构融合中的跨尺度知识迁移；局部理论分析表明知识迁移选择性在一阶上由能力相关的共享注入方向响应决定，二阶曲率效应则约束有效迁移区间。
Result: 在四个 Qwen3-VL 模型对和十二个多模态基准上，实验显示一致的迁移选择性：增益集中于推理特别是高层推理，感知性能接近原目标模型；组件消融表明高层推理增益主要来自语言模型，比例分析发现正的迁移主要出现在小比例区间。
Conclusion: 作者认为跨尺度异构 MLLM 融合应被理解为窄低干扰区间内的选择性语言侧推理迁移，而非广泛的能力继承，这挑战了融合即整体能力提升的直觉。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PathRIR: Physics-Guided Acoustic Path Selection and Late-Tail Compensation for Fast Room Impulse Response Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Image-source-method (ISM)-based room impulse response (RIR) simulation is a useful and physically interpretable tool for acoustic scene modeling, but full-order ISM becomes computationally expensive as the reflection order and room complexity increase. We propose a physics-guided framework for fast RIR simulation that preserves the geometric structure of ISM while learning to retain only acoustically important image-source paths during online traversal. To recover energy removed by pruning, the proposed PathRIR uses a lightweight compensation multilayer perceptron to predict the missing late-tail energy envelope and generate a compensation tail whose energy follows that envelope. Experiments on irregular 3D rooms show that PathRIR reduces image-source computation and improves runtime efficiency over a full-order ISM simulator, while achieving low waveform- and decay-related errors. Ablation results show that adding the compensation tail improves waveform fidelity and reduces energy-decay-curve error, reverberation-time error, and direct-to-reverberant-ratio error, with modest runtime overhead.
papers.comment: Published in IWAENC 2026. Code and data: https://github.com/ShaoHenry/PathRIR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PathRIR，一个用于快速房间冲激响应 (room impulse response, RIR) 仿真的物理引导框架。它保留镜像声源法 (image-source method, ISM) 的几何结构，同时在线遍历时学习只保留声学上重要的镜像声源路径，并用轻量补偿多层感知机预测缺失的晚期混响能量包络以生成补偿尾。在非规则 3D 房间上的实验表明，该方法相比全阶 ISM 仿真器减少了镜像声源计算量并提升运行效率，同时保持较低的波形与衰减相关误差；消融实验显示补偿尾提升了波形保真度并降低了能量衰减曲线误差、混响时间误差和直达混响比误差，代价是适度的运行时开销。
Motivation: 基于 ISM 的 RIR 仿真具有物理可解释性，但随着反射阶数和房间复杂度增加，全阶 ISM 的计算成本变得很高，限制了其实际可用性。
Method: 提出物理引导框架 PathRIR：在在线遍历中学习仅保留声学重要的镜像声源路径以削减计算，同时使用轻量补偿 MLP 预测缺失的晚期混响能量包络并生成对应能量的补偿尾，从而恢复剪枝移除的能量。
Result: 在非规则 3D 房间上，PathRIR 相比全阶 ISM 仿真器减少镜像声源计算并提升运行效率；实验报告其波形与衰减相关误差较低。消融结果表明加入补偿尾可改善波形保真度，并降低能量衰减曲线误差、混响时间误差和直达混响比误差，仅有适度的运行时开销。
Conclusion: 作者将该框架定位为兼顾 ISM 物理可解释性与计算效率的快速 RIR 仿真方案，实验范围主要针对非规则 3D 房间；论文发表于 IWAENC 2026，并公开了代码与数据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cryptographically verifiable authorization for autonomous AI agents: A falsifiable hypothesis and proof-of-concept
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous AI agents increasingly execute actions, invoke tools, and operate on protected resources with limited human oversight. Existing authentication and authorization mechanisms establish identity and delegate authority, but do not inherently provide cryptographic evidence that a concrete request issued by a specific agent satisfies the applicable policy in a specific execution context. This paper hypothesizes that agent authorization can be formalized as a cryptographically verifiable relation, denoted $R_{CVA}$, that jointly binds an agent principal, a concrete authorization request, an execution context, and the satisfaction of an applicable policy, while selectively preserving the confidentiality of private authorization attributes. We introduce a preliminary formal abstraction for Cryptographically Verifiable Agent Authorization (CVA), define a compact set of candidate security properties including authorization soundness, principal binding, request binding, policy binding, and replay resistance, and provide an executable zero-knowledge proof of concept that instantiates selected elements of the model over a Groth16 zk-SNARK construction. We further identify and formalize the structural separation among identity binding, authorization-request binding, and runtime execution binding as a central open problem in the design of secure agentic systems (a distinction {not explicitly addressed by} current agentic security frameworks) and present a falsifiable research agenda for its resolution.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, 2 Tables. Keywords: autonomous AI agents, zero-knowledge proofs, verifiable authorization, agentic security, zk-SNARKs, access control, cryptographic authorization, cryptographic protocols
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个可证伪假设：自主 AI 代理的授权可形式化为密码学可验证关系 $R_{CVA}$，该关系联合绑定代理主体、具体授权请求、执行上下文与策略满足性，同时有选择地保护私有授权属性的机密性。作者给出 Cryptographically Verifiable Agent Authorization (CVA) 的初步形式抽象、一组候选安全属性（授权可靠性、主体绑定、请求绑定、策略绑定、重放抵抗），并在 Groth16 zk-SNARK 上实现了可执行的零知识证明概念验证。文章还指出身份绑定、授权请求绑定与运行时执行绑定的结构分离是当前 agentic 安全框架未明确处理的中心开放问题，并给出可证伪的研究议程。
Motivation: 现有认证与授权机制只建立身份并委托权限，无法提供密码学证据来证明某个具体代理发出的特定请求在特定执行上下文中满足适用策略。
Method: 引入 CVA 形式抽象，定义候选安全属性集，并基于 Groth16 zk-SNARK 构造可执行的零知识证明概念验证来实例化模型中的选定元素；同时提出可证伪研究议程。
Result: 摘要仅报告了概念验证与问题形式化，未给出具体的实证性能数据或基准数字。

papers.title: The Human-AI Substitution Principle: When will you be replaced by AI in your organization?
papers.abstract_en: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming organizations, raising a fundamental organizational and economic question: when will a human employee be replaced by AI? We present an analytical model for studying Human--AI Task Allocation (HAT) in hierarchical organizations. A central feature of the HAT model is that it formally encodes the economic asymmetry between human skill acquisition and AI capability scaling. The HAT model allows us to derive how risk-adjusted costs, skills, organizational depth, deployment scale, strategic adaptation, and risk jointly determine when, where, why, and under what structural conditions human--AI replacement occurs. A key result is the Human--AI Substitution Principle, which provides a precise condition --- grounded in the formal asymmetry assumption --- under which AI replaces human labor. Building on this result, we show that AI adoption can produce abrupt workforce transitions, hybrid human--AI organizations, including cases where risk heterogeneity sustains human and AI roles without requiring a minimum-human-fraction constraint, and flatter managerial hierarchies with wider spans of control. The HAT model identifies structural conditions under which middle-management roles exhibit elevated vulnerability to automation, and shows that the vulnerability of highly skilled workers depends on a skill threshold shaped by organizational depth, baseline costs, and risk differentials. More broadly, the paper connects automation economics, organizational design, AI governance, and workforce planning into a unified theory of AI-driven organizational transformation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个分析性模型 HAT (Human--AI Task Allocation)，研究层级组织中人类员工何时会被 AI 取代。模型将人类技能习得与 AI 能力扩展之间的经济不对称性形式化，并据此推导出 Human--AI Substitution Principle，给出 AI 替代人类劳动力的精确条件。作者进一步证明该原则可解释突然的劳动力转变、混合人机组织、扁平化管理层级，以及中层管理岗位更高的自动化脆弱性。
Motivation: AI 正在快速改变组织，但关于人类员工何时、何地以及何种结构条件下被 AI 替代，缺乏统一的分析框架。现有研究没有系统编码人类技能获取与 AI 能力扩展之间的经济不对称性。
Method: 提出 HAT 分析模型，形式上编码人力技能获取与 AI 能力扩展之间的经济不对称性，并基于风险调整成本、技能、组织深度、部署规模、战略适应和风险等因素推导替代条件。
Result: 核心结果是 Human--AI Substitution Principle，给出 AI 替代人类劳动力的精确条件；模型还表明 AI 采纳可导致 abrupt workforce transitions、混合人机组织（风险异质性可在无最低人类比例约束下维持人机并存）、更扁平的层级结构，并识别中层管理岗位脆弱性升高的结构条件，以及高技能工人脆弱性取决于由组织深度、基准成本和风险差异塑造的技能阈值。
Conclusion: 论文将自动化经济学、组织设计、AI 治理与劳动力规划连接为统一的 AI 驱动组织转型理论。

papers.title: Pixel-Space Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Latent diffusion models (LDMs) enable efficient high-resolution image synthesis by denoising in a VAE-compressed latent space. However, fixed visual tokenizers can discard fine textures and structural details, while separate representation and diffusion training creates a mismatch between reconstruction and generation objectives. These limitations have renewed interest in pixel-space diffusion, which models raw pixels directly, removes the VAE bottleneck, and supports end-to-end optimization. This formulation better matches the demands of high-fidelity generation but introduces challenges in high-dimensional modeling, including noise scheduling, loss weighting, token efficiency, and scalable architecture design. Pixel-space modeling also offers a promising basis for unified multimodal systems: raw pixels, text, and task conditions can be represented in a shared token space and jointly processed by a single Transformer, narrowing the gap between visual understanding and generation. This paper reviews Pixel-Space Diffusion Transformers (pDiTs) from the perspectives of model architecture, continuous generative mechanisms, and unified multimodal modeling. We summarize representative methods, identify key technical challenges, and discuss future directions toward high-fidelity, end-to-end vision foundation models that integrate generation and understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于像素空间扩散 Transformer（pDiTs）的综述，从模型架构、连续生成机制和统一多模态建模三个视角进行梳理。作者总结了代表性方法，识别了高维建模中的噪声调度、损失加权、token 效率与可扩展架构等关键挑战，并讨论了以原始像素为共享 token 空间、融合视觉理解与生成的端到端视觉基础模型的未来方向。
Motivation: 潜在扩散模型（LDMs）依赖 VAE 压缩潜在空间，但固定视觉 tokenizer 可能丢弃精细纹理和结构细节，且表示学习与扩散训练的分离导致重建目标与生成目标不匹配。像素空间扩散直接建模原始像素，移除 VAE 瓶颈并支持端到端优化，更契合高保真生成需求，但面临高维建模的挑战。
Method: 以综述方式组织内容，按模型架构、连续生成机制和统一多模态建模展开，总结像素空间扩散 Transformer 的代表性方法，并讨论噪声调度、损失加权、token 效率以及将原始像素、文本和任务条件纳入共享 token 空间的单一 Transformer 设计。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数字或基准结果；其主要贡献在于系统总结代表性方法、提炼关键技术和开放问题，属于领域综述而非实验性研究。
Conclusion: 作者认为像素空间建模为统一多模态系统提供了有前景的基础，并指出未来方向是构建集成生成与理解的高保真、端到端视觉基础模型。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: OrderMoE: An expert similarity driven distributed edge MoE inference
papers.abstract_en: Although mixture-of-experts, MoE, models have been increasingly adopted to scale large language models with moderate computation cost, it remains challenging to deploy MoE inference over resource-constrained and bandwidth-limited edge infrastructures. Existing distributed MoE serving methods mainly rely on exact expert placement, caching, replication, or communication scheduling, while overlooking the functional similarity among experts, which provides an opportunity to reduce cross-server token transmission. Therefore, this paper introduces a similarity-aware expert allocation and distributed deployment framework, dubbed OrderMoE, which aims to accelerate edge MoE inference while balancing inference latency, communication overhead, server workload, and inference quality. OrderMoE first constructs an expert similarity model based on router-induced logits representations and partitions experts in each MoE layer into multiple similarity groups. Then, it develops a similarity-aware expert grouping and deployment strategy to improve local similarity coverage across edge servers. Since reducing remote expert invocation and preserving exact inference quality are conflicting objectives, OrderMoE further designs a quality-aware and trajectory-aware runtime server-expert selection algorithm to decide whether a token should invoke its remote target expert or use a feasible local substitute expert. Experimental results on a real distributed edge testbed show that OrderMoE significantly reduces average latency, tail latency, cross-server traffic, and remote expert invocation ratio, while introducing only small and controllable inference quality degradation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OrderMoE，一个面向资源受限且带宽有限的边缘基础设施的相似性感知专家分配与分布式部署框架。OrderMoE 基于路由器产生的 logits 表示构建专家相似性模型，将每层 MoE 的专家划分成多个相似性分组，并设计相似性感知的专家分组与部署策略以提高边缘服务器上的本地相似性覆盖。针对降低远程专家调用与保持精确推理质量之间的矛盾，论文进一步提出质量感知与轨迹感知的运行时服务器-专家选择算法，决定 token 应调用远程目标专家还是使用可行的本地替代专家。在真实分布式边缘测试台上的实验显示，OrderMoE 显著降低平均延迟、尾部延迟、跨服务器流量和远程专家调用率，同时只引入较小且可控的推理质量下降。
Motivation: 现有分布式 MoE 推理方法主要依赖精确的专家放置、缓存、复制或通信调度，忽视了专家之间的功能相似性；这种相似性本可减少跨服务器 token 传输，而边缘基础设施的资源与带宽限制使高效部署更具挑战。
Method: OrderMoE 首先基于路由器诱导的 logits 表示构建专家相似性模型，并将每层专家划分为若干相似性组；然后提出相似性感知的专家分组与部署策略以提升本地相似性覆盖；最后设计质量感知和轨迹感知的运行时服务器-专家选择算法，在远程专家调用与本地替代专家之间做决策。
Result: 在真实分布式边缘测试台上的实验表明，OrderMoE 显著降低平均延迟、尾部延迟、跨服务器流量和远程专家调用比例，同时仅引入较小且可控的推理质量下降。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，利用专家间的功能相似性可以在边缘 MoE 推理中有效平衡推理延迟、通信开销、服务器负载和推理质量。

papers.title: SportD: How do VLMs physically strategize?
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) can describe a scene, but can they act well within one? We study whether VLMs can make sound strategic decisions, using soccer as an objective testbed with quantifiably-valued actions. We introduce SportD, a dataset and evaluation consisting of 1415 decision scenarios across professional men's and women's soccer games, where a VLM observes the seconds before a decision and chooses the next action. Models only select the optimal action around 30% of the time, even less frequently than humans do. Furthermore, they exhibit a clear preference for safer actions, favoring lower-variance, lower-value choices that also make less physical progress toward goal. Frontier VLMs are better at estimating whether an action will succeed, placing the highest-success-probability action among their top choices in 83-92% of cases. Yet VLMs systematically conflate likelihood with value, assigning higher value to actions that are more likely to succeed (Spearman corr. 0.30 to +0.52), despite no such relationship in the ground truth (Spearman corr. -0.08). The conservatism therefore reflects a mis-calibration of value. SportD opens a new direction for rigorously evaluating physical strategic decision-making in VLMs, showing that careful decomposition of their choices can reveal the mechanisms underlying systematic biases such as risk aversion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SportD，一个基于职业男足与女足比赛视频的 1415 个决策场景数据集与评测基准，用于检验视觉语言模型 (VLM) 能否在动态场景中做出合理的物理策略决策。摘要报告 VLM 仅在约 30% 的场景中选择最优动作，低于人类表现，并表现出对低方差、低价值且推进较慢的安全动作的系统性偏好。作者进一步发现前沿 VLM 能较好地估计动作成功率，但将成功概率与价值相混淆，从而揭示了其保守行为源于价值校准失误。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 评测多关注场景描述或基础问答，很少检验模型能否在具有量化价值动作的动态环境中做出战略决策；作者以足球为客观测试平台，试图结构化地度量 VLM 的物理策略推理能力。
Method: 构建 SportD 数据集与评测流程：从职业男足和女足比赛中提取 1415 个决策场景，让 VLM 观察决策前若干秒的画面并选择下一动作；评测进一步将模型对动作成功率与动作价值的估计进行解耦分析，并用 Spearman 相关刻画二者的系统性关联。
Result: 模型仅在约 30% 的场景选择最优动作，低于人类；前沿 VLM 在 83-92% 的场景将最高成功概率动作放入前几选择，但模型对价值与成功概率的估计呈正相关 (Spearman 0.30 至 +0.52)，而真实数据中二者无此关系 (Spearman -0.08)。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 VLM 的保守策略源于对价值的错误校准而非对成功概率的估计失败，并指出 SportD 为严格评测 VLM 的物理战略决策提供了新方向，且对选择进行细致分解可以揭示风险厌恶等系统性偏差的机制。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: 模型仅在约 30% 的场景选择最优动作，低于人类；前沿 VLM 在 83-92% 的场景将最高成功概率动作放入前几选择，但模型对价值与成功概率的估计呈正相关 (Spearman 0.30 至 +0.52)，而真实数据中二者无此关系 (Spearman -0.08)。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要认为 VLM 的保守策略源于对价值的错误校准而非对成功概率的估计失败，并指出 SportD 为严格评测 VLM 的物理战略决策提供了新方向，且对选择进行细致分解可以揭示风险厌恶等系统性偏差的机制。

papers.title: Gauge-Fixing the Forward-Forward Objective: A Whitened Goodness Derived from a Likelihood-Ratio Account
papers.abstract_en: The Forward-Forward algorithm trains each layer locally, so that a scalar goodness - the sum of squared activations - is high on real inputs and low on contrastive ones. Under an explicit generative model this goodness is the sufficient statistic of a likelihood-ratio test, and the pairwise form of the objective admits a gauge: a layer can lower its loss by inflating the scale of its weights rather than by separating the two populations. The analysis prescribes the repair - a whitened, scale-invariant goodness trained online within each layer - which we evaluate as a training procedure. Across three corpora, three depths and a fourfold range of layer width (13 seeds per cell), it raises linear-probe accuracy over the standard pairwise objective in every measured cell - by 4 to 7 points on eight of nine corpus-depth combinations - and closes 16-61% of the gap to end-to-end backpropagation. A control isolates the mechanism: Hinton's fixed-threshold loss also bounds the runaway, to a factor of 1.4 against 133, yet tracks the unmodified baseline - invariance to the gauge, not a bound on it, is what pays. Against the strongest published alternative - a sparse, top-k goodness - the derived objective is statistically indistinguishable on two corpora of three, yet only it removes the runaway: sparsity and gauge-invariance are independent axes, and the published variant recovers accuracy while leaving the pathology in place. We state the boundaries we measured, and every prediction was recorded before its experiment with the refutations reported.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从显式生成模型的角度分析 Forward-Forward 算法，指出其逐层局部目标（平方激活之和作为 goodness）本质上是似然比检验的充分统计量，但 pairwise 形式的损失存在 gauge 自由度：网络层可通过放大权重尺度而非分离两个数据分布来降低损失。作者据此提出一种白化的、尺度不变的 goodness 并在每层在线训练，在多个语料库和深度/宽度配置上系统评估了该训练过程。
Motivation: Forward-Forward 算法以局部目标训练每层，但 pairwise 目标存在 gauge 问题：层可以通过膨胀权重尺度来降低损失，而不是真正把真实样本与对比样本分开；这种病理机制会影响表示质量，而此前缺乏对其正式的似然比解释和修复方案。
Method: 作者先给出似然比检验的理论框架，证明 goodness 是该检验的充分统计量，由此诊断出目标中的 gauge 自由度；随后给出修复——一个白化的、尺度不变的 goodness，并在每层内在线训练。文中还通过与 Hinton 固定阈值损失和稀疏 top-k goodness 的对照实验来隔离 gauge 不变性这一机制。
Result: 在三个语料库、三种深度和四倍宽度范围（每个配置 13 个随机种子）下，所提白化目标在每一个测量单元上都提升了线性探针准确率，其中九个语料-深度组合中的八个提升 4 到 7 个百分点，并填补了与端到端反向传播之间 16% 到 61% 的差距。对照实验显示 Hinton 固定阈值损失也能把 runaway 因子从 133 限制到 1.4，但准确率仍与未修改基线相近，说明真正起作用的是对 gauge 的不变性而非对 runaway 的约束；与最强的已发表替代（稀疏 top-k goodness）相比，该方法在两个语料库上统计上无显著差异，但只有它能消除 runaway，表明稀疏性与 gauge 不变性是相互独立的维度。
Conclusion: 作者强调 gauge 不变性（而非对权重大小的显式约束）才是修复 Forward-Forward 目标的关键，且稀疏化与尺度不变性应视为独立的改进方向。他们报告了所测量的边界，并说明所有预测都在对应实验之前记录，且已报告反例。

papers.title: The Path to Self-Evolving Clinical Systems: Scaling Medical Agents from Assistance to Autonomy
papers.abstract_en: The growing ability of large language models and vision-language models to jointly interpret and reason over images and text is reshaping medical imaging AI, moving it from task-specific predictors toward autonomous agents that perceive, reason, plan, remember, and act in clinical environments. This survey departs from the capability-first perspective of existing literature and instead begins from clinical deployment, asking what tasks, contamination-resistant benchmarks, and interactive training environments are required before medical agents can be trusted in practice. Medical agents are formalized as sequential decision-making systems under partial observability, together with a three-level autonomy taxonomy spanning assisted, cooperative, and fully autonomous operation. The field is organized along a unified scaling spine consisting of framework scaling, capability scaling, and environment scaling. Within this framework, clinical environment scaling, the integration of tools, data, and clinical gyms, is identified as the most actionable yet underexplored direction for agents operating in PACS, EHR, and FHIR ecosystems. Clinical self-evolution, where agents improve through interaction with their environments rather than parameter scaling alone, is further positioned as a key research frontier, drawing insights from self-improving agents, agent gyms, and test-time compute scaling. Applications across radiology, pathology, ophthalmology, and hospital workflows are examined together with deployment challenges including hallucination, cascading failures, and fairness. By consolidating more than 300 references, with particular emphasis on advances from 2025 to 2026, this survey provides a roadmap toward trustworthy, self-improving medical imaging systems for real clinical practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于医疗影像 AI 智能体的综述，从临床部署视角而非能力优先视角出发，将医疗智能体形式化为部分可观测下的序贯决策系统，并提出辅助、协作、完全自主的三级自主性分类。作者用框架扩展、能力扩展和临床环境扩展构成的统一扩展主线组织该领域，指出临床环境扩展（工具、数据与临床环境（clinical gym）集成）是最可行但尚未充分探索的方向，并将临床自进化定位为关键研究前沿。综述整合了 300 余篇参考文献，重点覆盖 2025 至 2026 年的进展，目标是为真实临床实践提供可信、自改进医疗影像系统的路线图。
Motivation: 现有医疗影像 AI 综述多从能力优先视角出发，忽视临床部署的实际约束；在智能体被信任用于实践之前，需要明确需要哪些任务、抗污染基准和交互训练环境。
Method: 以综述方式提出统一扩展主线，包括框架扩展（framework scaling）、能力扩展（capability scaling）和环境扩展（environment scaling），并给出覆盖辅助、协作、完全自主的三级自主性分类；同时借鉴自改进智能体、智能体环境和测试时计算扩展来讨论临床自进化。
Result: 综述识别出临床环境扩展（在 PACS、EHR 和 FHIR 生态系统中集成工具、数据与临床环境）是最可操作但尚未充分探索的方向，并将临床自进化列为关键前沿；系统梳理了放射学、病理学、眼科学与医院工作流中的应用及部署挑战。
Conclusion: 作者认为，通过环境交互而非单纯参数扩展实现临床自进化，是迈向可信、自改进医疗影像系统的重要路径，并据此给出面向真实临床实践的研究路线图。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Prompt-Driven Exploration
papers.abstract_en: Exploration is essential to RL since a policy cannot improve by repeatedly sampling the behaviors it already prefers. Standard methods inject stochasticity in the action space, but such jitter only yields rollouts close to the original. Escaping a weak policy often requires global perturbations that action noise cannot produce. Large language models (LLMs) and vision-language-action (VLA) models offer a pathway: they condition the policy on a natural language prompt, and since the rollout follows from it, modifying the prompt induces global changes. The challenge is finding prompts that induce useful global changes. With a weak policy that rarely succeeds, reward is too sparse to select on. Our idea is to refine prompts from the rollouts themselves: a vision-language model (VLM) reasons over the rollout video, diagnoses how the policy responded, and rewrites the prompt to elicit better behavior next time. This procedure resembles posterior sampling, a classical RL exploration framework, at the level of prompts: the VLM maintains an implicit distribution over useful prompts and updates it from observed rollouts. We call this strategy Prompt-Driven Exploration (PDE). Across manipulation and reasoning tasks, PDE enables RL to learn successful policies even from zero-reward starts, and improves sample efficiency more broadly. Our website is available at https://xinyunsunshine.github.io/prompt-rl.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Prompt-Driven Exploration (PDE)，一种利用视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 根据 rollout 视频诊断策略表现并重写自然语言 prompt 的强化学习探索方法。作者将这一过程类比为 prompt 层面的后验采样 (posterior sampling)，并报告在操控 (manipulation) 与推理任务中，PDE 能使 RL 从零奖励 (zero-reward) 起点学到成功策略，并在更广任务上提升样本效率。
Motivation: 标准 RL 探索依赖于动作空间随机性，但这类抖动只能产生接近原策略的 rollout，难以帮助弱策略脱困；LLM/VLA 可通过修改自然语言 prompt 引入全局行为变化，但稀疏奖励使选择有效 prompt 变得困难。
Method: PDE 让一个 VLM 观察 rollout 视频，诊断策略的响应方式，并重写 prompt 以在下一轮诱导更好的行为；该过程被形式化为 prompt 层面的后验采样，VLM 维护关于有用 prompt 的隐式分布并从观测 rollout 中更新它。
Result: 摘要报告在操控与推理任务上，PDE 使 RL 能从零奖励起点学习到成功策略，并在更广泛任务上提升样本效率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将探索从动作空间迁移到 prompt 空间、并用 VLM 做 rollout 驱动的提示精炼是一个可行的探索框架，更多内容见项目网站。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: WBMM: Windowed Batch Matrix Multiplication for Efficient Large Receptive Field Convolution
papers.abstract_en: Large kernel depthwise convolutions achieve strong performance but suffer from significant degradation as kernel size grows due to irregular memory access from gather-based computation; while Large Kernel Acceleration (LKA) helps on small feature maps, it becomes counterproductive on large feature maps, even slower than non-accelerated implementations. We propose Windowed Batch Matrix Multiplication (WBMM), which partitions input into contiguous windows and indexes a compact relative position bias table to construct weight matrices, enabling regular memory access via batched matrix multiplication. This yields a unique property: WBMM's throughput improves with larger windows, opposite to depthwise convolutions that degrade with larger kernels. Operator-level benchmarks show WBMM with 14x14 windows outperforms 5x5 depthwise convolution baselines in speed while providing a 7.8x larger per-layer receptive field. Combined with inter-block cross-window communication and hierarchical window reparameterization, WBMM achieves comparable or higher accuracy on ImageNet-1K, COCO, and ADE20K with 1.31-1.88x training speedup, and demonstrates consistent advantages across GPU, CPU, and edge devices without requiring specialized acceleration kernels. Our code is available at https://github.com/wansong-s/WBMM.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 4 figures. Accepted as a Spotlight paper at ICML 2026. Code available at https://github.com/wansong-s/WBMM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Windowed Batch Matrix Multiplication (WBMM)，将输入划分为连续窗口并索引紧凑的相对位置偏置表来构造权重矩阵，从而通过批量矩阵乘法实现规则内存访问，解决大核深度卷积因 gather 式计算导致的内存访问不规则和性能退化问题。WBMM 的吞吐量随窗口增大而提升，与深度卷积随核增大而退化的趋势相反；结合跨窗口通信和分层窗口重参数化后，在 ImageNet-1K、COCO、ADE20K 上达到相当或更高精度，并带来 1.31-1.88 倍训练加速。
Motivation: 大核深度卷积虽性能强，但随核增大因 gather 式计算的不规则内存访问而显著退化；现有 Large Kernel Acceleration (LKA) 在小特征图上有效，但在大特征图上反而比未加速实现更慢。
Method: 提出 WBMM，将输入分区为连续窗口，通过索引紧凑的相对位置偏置表构建权重矩阵，借助批量矩阵乘法实现规则内存访问。此外结合跨块窗口通信 (inter-block cross-window communication) 与分层窗口重参数化 (hierarchical window reparameterization)。
Result: 在操作符级基准上，14x14 窗口的 WBMM 在速度上超过 5x5 深度卷积基线，并提供 7.8 倍更大的逐层感受野；在 ImageNet-1K、COCO 和 ADE20K 上实现相当或更高精度，训练加速 1.31-1.88 倍，并在 GPU、CPU 和边缘设备上均表现一致优势，无需专用加速核。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 WBMM 通过规则内存访问和窗口化计算使大核卷积高效且跨硬件泛化，但摘要未提及方法在极端大核或特定任务上的局限性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在操作符级基准上，14x14 窗口的 WBMM 在速度上超过 5x5 深度卷积基线，并提供 7.8 倍更大的逐层感受野；在 ImageNet-1K、COCO 和 ADE20K 上实现相当或更高精度，训练加速 1.31-1.88 倍，并在 GPU、CPU 和边缘设备上均表现一致优势，无需专用加速核。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要表明 WBMM 通过规则内存访问和窗口化计算使大核卷积高效且跨硬件泛化，但摘要未提及方法在极端大核或特定任务上的局限性。

papers.title: From World Models to World Action Models: A Concise Tutorial for Robotics
papers.abstract_en: Rather than providing an exhaustive survey, this paper presents a concise tutorial on world models and world action models for robotics. After reading the tutorial, readers should have a clear understanding of what constitutes a "world", how world models and world action models are defined, and what roles they play within robotic AI systems. The tutorial also develops a unified perspective for comparing representative approaches, such as World Labs' spatial intelligence models, Yann LeCun's JEPA framework, and NVIDIA's Cosmos platform, and clarifies how these models differ in their representations, predictive capabilities, and interaction mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇面向机器人的世界模型与世界行动模型简明教程，而非综述。教程旨在帮助读者理解“世界”的构成、世界模型与世界行动模型的定义及其在机器人AI系统中的作用，并提供一个统一视角来比较World Labs的空间智能模型、LeCun的JEPA框架和NVIDIA Cosmos平台在表示、预测能力与交互机制上的差异。
Motivation: 机器人领域对世界模型和世界行动模型存在概念混淆，缺乏一个简洁统一的教学性梳理来区分不同代表性方法。
Method: 以教程形式系统阐述世界模型和世界行动模型的定义与角色，并提出统一比较框架，用于分析World Labs、JEPA与Cosmos等代表性方法在表示、预测和交互上的异同。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果或量化指标，主要贡献是概念澄清与比较视角。
Conclusion: 作者强调该教程帮助读者建立对机器人世界模型与世界行动模型的清晰理解，但明确表示其非详尽综述。

papers.title: Personalization as Inverse Planning: Learning Latent Design Intents for Agentic Slide Generation via Structural Denoising
papers.abstract_en: Slide design requires personalizing both deck themes and page layouts. Yet, current AI agent-based methods struggle with fine-grained, page-level design. Solely relying on prespecified templates or user verbose instructions, they fail to capture latent design intents, leaving Page-level Slide Personalization (PSP) unresolved. To close this gap, this work formulates PSP as an inverse planning problem. We propose to learn a design intent without assuming any knowledge of the specific executing tools (e.g., PowerPoint, Beamer) being used. However, relinquishing control over these tools makes the problem intractable to optimize end-to-end. To overcome this, we propose SPIRE, a principled framework to solve PSP approximately. By intentionally corrupting the visual structures of clean slides, SPIRE creates a verifiable task to denoise the corruption, whereby two agents learn to collaboratively refine executable designs via reinforcement learning (RL). We present a proof that structural denoising is a consistent surrogate for PSP, and that the multi-agent formulation strictly reduces policy gradient variance in RL. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of SPIRE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究智能体驱动的幻灯片生成中的页面级个性化问题（PSP），将任务重新表述为逆规划问题，并提出 SPIRE 框架。SPIRE 通过故意破坏干净幻灯片的视觉结构，让两个智能体通过强化学习（RL）协作去噪，从而近似求解 PSP。作者证明结构去噪是 PSP 的一致替代目标，并证明多智能体公式能严格降低策略梯度方差；实验表明 SPIRE 优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有基于模板或用户详细指令的 AI agent 方法难以捕获页面级潜在设计意图，导致细粒度、页面级的幻灯片个性化问题（PSP）尚未解决；同时，在不假设具体执行工具（如 PowerPoint、Beamer）的情况下直接端到端优化不可行。
Method: 将 PSP 建模为逆规划问题，提出 SPIRE 框架：通过有意破坏干净幻灯片的视觉结构来构造可验证的去噪任务，两个智能体通过强化学习协作地细化可执行设计，从而近似求解 PSP，并给出结构去噪替代目标的一致性证明以及多智能体公式降低策略梯度方差的证明。
Result: 摘要报告了理论结果（结构去噪是 PSP 的一致替代目标，多智能体公式严格降低策略梯度方差）以及大量实验，实验表明 SPIRE 在页面级幻灯片个性化上优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 本文主张将幻灯片个性化视为逆规划问题，并以结构去噪和协作式 RL 近似求解，为不依赖特定设计工具的页面级个性化提供了有原则的解决思路。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Optimizing Expert-Designed Crystal Graph Networks for Band-Gap Prediction with an Autonomous LLM Research Loop
papers.abstract_en: Predicting a material's properties from its structure is a central, fast-advancing problem in computational materials science. A decade of work has produced standard public benchmarks and many published machine-learning models for the task (Dunn et al., 2020). The task's fixed metric and these baselines make it a natural setting for autonomous agent research (Karpathy, 2026). On the MatBench band-gap benchmark ($>$100k crystals), a general-purpose coding agent autonomously built the most accurate model trained without external pretraining, ahead of all seventeen expert-designed models reported for the task. A closer analysis shows it reached this by implementing known methods: either already standard in crystal neural-network models, or borrowed from other areas of machine learning. The contributing implementations include element-pair features on each message-passing edge and a crystal space-group embedding. The work not only demonstrates that LLM-agent autonomous research can optimize an expert-designed machine learning model for material property prediction, but also investigates the limitations of such autonomous research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究用自主 LLM 智能体优化材料带隙预测模型。在 MatBench band-gap 基准（>10 万晶体）上，一个通用编码智能体在没有外部预训练的情况下，自主构建了准确率最高的模型，超越了该任务上全部 17 个专家设计模型。分析显示它主要通过实现已知方法达到这一结果，包括消息传递边上的元素对特征和晶体空间群嵌入。作者还探讨了此类自主研究的局限性。
Motivation: 材料性质预测是计算材料学的核心问题，已有标准公共基准和大量专家设计的机器学习模型；固定指标和基线使其成为自主智能体研究（autonomous agent research）的自然场景。
Method: 采用通用编码 LLM 智能体，以自主研究循环的方式迭代优化专家设计的晶体图网络（crystal graph network）。关键实现包括在每个消息传递边上加入元素对特征（element-pair features），以及引入晶体空间群嵌入（crystal space-group embedding）。
Result: 在 MatBench band-gap 基准上，该智能体自主构建的模型在不使用外部预训练的前提下，精度超过全部 17 个专家设计模型，成为该设置下最准确的模型。
Conclusion: 这项工作展示了 LLM 智能体的自主研究可以优化材料性质预测的专家设计机器学习模型，同时对其局限性进行了考察。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Reducing Per-Sample Interference in Stochastic Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Modern optimizers combine gradients from the current mini-batch with historical optimization state, such as momentum or adaptive moments. While effective, this standard practice can produce parameter updates that actively increase the loss of individual samples. We term this phenomenon per-sample interference and propose redefining the parameter update as an optimization problem that explicitly minimizes it. Because the exact formulation of the problem is computationally prohibitive, we introduce a highly efficient surrogate. By reducing the problem's dimensionality to the batch size and restricting the optimization to the last linear layer, we overcome memory and speed bottlenecks. This strategy hinges on our unexpected finding that this layer alone can reliably capture core second-order statistics of the full network. The resulting surrogate problem integrates readily into standard optimizers like SGD and AdamW, and can be solved using a small number of GPU-friendly iterations. Crucially, the method exhibits favorable scaling properties, as the relative computational overhead shrinks as the model size or input grows. Experiments on image classification benchmarks confirm reduced per-sample interference and improved generalization.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对随机优化中参数更新可能增加单个样本损失的现象，提出 per-sample interference 的概念，并将参数更新重新定义为一个显式最小化该干扰的优化问题。由于精确形式计算代价过高，作者提出了一个高效的替代问题，通过将问题维度降到 batch size 并仅优化最后一层线性层来克服内存与速度瓶颈。该替代问题可以方便地集成到 SGD 和 AdamW 等标准优化器中，并在图像分类基准上验证了减少 per-sample interference 与提升泛化能力的效果。
Motivation: 现代优化器将当前 mini-batch 的梯度与历史优化状态（如动量或自适应矩）结合，但这一标准做法可能产生主动增加单个样本损失的参数更新，作者称该现象为 per-sample interference，并希望显式地缓解它。
Method: 将参数更新重新定义为显式最小化 per-sample interference 的优化问题，并给出一个计算高效的替代形式：把问题维度降低到 batch size，且把优化限制在最后一层线性层上，依据是这一层能可靠地捕获全网络的核心二阶统计量。该替代问题可集成进 SGD 与 AdamW 等标准优化器，并用少量 GPU 友好的迭代求解。
Result: 在图像分类基准上的实验表明，该方法减少了 per-sample interference 并提升了泛化；相对计算开销随模型规模或输入增大而缩小，展现出有利的扩展性。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过将更新问题限制在最后一层线性和 batch 维度，可以在保持效率的同时缓解 per-sample interference，从而改进标准优化器的泛化表现。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MMLA: How Memory Lets the Past Shape the Future
papers.abstract_en: Proposal. Long context can replay history, but it does not decide which completed observations deserve authority. MMLA formalizes a bounded resident memory between transient context and slow weight updates. A completed local segment is eventized; for each event, a target-conditioned constructor proposes semantic content and a trusted assembler produces a complete versioned row; deployment either commits that row atomically or returns NULL. Realized futures may price actions during training, while deployment remains causal and future-blind. Validated components. Controlled studies establish narrower ingredients. Lifecycle execution is exact on 300/300 held-out records for each of three seeds. Calibrated selection with full-archive fallback improves over a weak budget-matched dense baseline by 5.5--16.6 F1 and over BM25 by 4.0--6.2 F1 on held-out multi-hop QA; the original Llama budget execution is retained as failed, while the corrected Qwen packer satisfies the stated per-record caps. Typed anchor--filler transport reaches 240/240 held-out exactness per seed while three same-checkpoint controls obtain 0/240 whole-record successes. Current blocker. The integration loop is not complete. Dense-row, structured-span, and checkpoint-native readers trained from V28, the frozen 352.3M-parameter model-only checkpoint produced by a 50.0M-token native-scaffold pilot, all fail semantic qualification across three seeds. Candidate exactness is 0--45/23,040, query exactness is 10--1,536/9,216, and record-macro Brier remains near the 1,025-class uniform reference. Structural mapping passes, but none of the nine jobs qualifies. Predictive overwrite is therefore closed by gate.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 11 figures, 5 tables. Substantially rewritten v3: retitled and reframed as MMLA; adds an eventized architecture, trusted row assembly, hard atomic overwrite/NULL, claim-evidence mapping, PM-I2 negative results, stop rules, and a conditional roadmap. Preserves the original Llama budget-gate failure. Project: https://github.com/MMLA-org/mmla-memory
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MMLA，一种有界驻留内存 (bounded resident memory) 形式化架构，介于瞬时上下文与慢速权重更新之间：完成的局部片段被事件化，构造器为目标条件地提议语义内容，可信装配器生成完整版本化行，部署时原子提交该行或返回 NULL。已验证组件包括生命周期执行精确性、多跳 QA 上的校准选择改进以及类型化 anchor-filler 传输精确性；但集成闭环未完成，三种读者模型在冻结检查点 V28 上均未通过语义资格，预测性覆写被门控关闭。
Motivation: 长上下文可以回放历史，但无法决定哪些已完成观测 (completed observations) 值得被赋予权威性；需要一种介于上下文与权重更新之间的机制来选择和固化可信的记忆。
Method: 提出事件化 (eventized) 架构：对每个事件，目标条件化构造器提议语义内容，可信装配器生成完整版本化行；部署要么原子提交该行，要么返回 NULL。训练中"已实现的未来"可对动作定价，而部署保持因果且对未来不可见。
Result: 生命周期执行在三种种子各 300/300 条封闭记录上精确；校准选择配合全归档回退在封闭多跳 QA 上比弱预算匹配密集基线高 5.5--16.6 F1、比 BM25 高 4.0--6.2 F1；类型化 anchor-filler 传输达 240/240 封闭精确率，而三个同检查点对照为 0/240。然而，基于 V28（352.3M 参数冻结检查点）训练的三类读者均未通过语义资格：候选精确率 0--45/23,040，查询精确率 10--1,536/9,216。
Conclusion: 当前集成循环不完整：结构映射通过，但九个作业均未合格，预测性覆写因此被门控关闭；摘要将其定位为 proposal 加已验证组件，并附带条件式路线图。

summary_sections.motivation: 长上下文可以回放历史，但无法决定哪些已完成观测 (completed observations) 值得被赋予权威性；需要一种介于上下文与权重更新之间的机制来选择和固化可信的记忆。
summary_sections.method: 提出事件化 (eventized) 架构：对每个事件，目标条件化构造器提议语义内容，可信装配器生成完整版本化行；部署要么原子提交该行，要么返回 NULL。训练中"已实现的未来"可对动作定价，而部署保持因果且对未来不可见。
summary_sections.result: 生命周期执行在三种种子各 300/300 条封闭记录上精确；校准选择配合全归档回退在封闭多跳 QA 上比弱预算匹配密集基线高 5.5--16.6 F1、比 BM25 高 4.0--6.2 F1；类型化 anchor-filler 传输达 240/240 封闭精确率，而三个同检查点对照为 0/240。然而，基于 V28（352.3M 参数冻结检查点）训练的三类读者均未通过语义资格：候选精确率 0--45/23,040，查询精确率 10--1,536/9,216。
summary_sections.conclusion: 当前集成循环不完整：结构映射通过，但九个作业均未合格，预测性覆写因此被门控关闭；摘要将其定位为 proposal 加已验证组件，并附带条件式路线图。

papers.title: SCoPE: Sightline-Coordinate Positional Encoding for Video Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Video diffusion transformers address their tokens by position on the pixel-time grid: an address in the tensor, not in the world. The address we would want, the world point a token depicts, lies on a surface not yet generated, while its camera ray is fixed once the user specifies a trajectory. SCoPE therefore treats the ray as a second positional coordinate, and camera control becomes a property of the coordinate system, not an added module. The ray is added to the pretrained attention's queries and keys, and the score gains a term that reads the two rays alone. Its canonical form, the reciprocal product of line geometry, measures how nearly two lines of sight meet. Normalize-Gate-Inject makes a single encoding trainable across metric and up-to-scale pose sources. The retrofit keeps RoPE bit-exact, starts from the unchanged pretrained DiT, and adds under 0.1/% new parameters. On Wan2.2 at 5B and 14B under matched data and budget, SCoPE improves every camera-controllability and fidelity metric, leads all closed-loop revisit metrics, and shows widening margins with model size. At 14B, rotation error falls 29/% and FVD 43/% below the strongest baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SCoPE，一种为视频扩散 Transformer 设计的视线坐标位置编码。它把相机射线作为第二位置坐标，使相机控制成为坐标系属性而非附加模块：射线被加到预训练注意力的查询和键上，并新增一个仅读取两条射线的评分项，其规范形式为线几何的倒数积，度量两条视线接近相交的程度。Normalize-Gate-Inject 让单一编码可在 metric 与 up-to-scale 位姿源上训练；改造保持 RoPE 位精确，从预训练 DiT 出发，新增参数少于 0.1%。在 Wan2.2 5B 和 14B 上，SCoPE 在匹配数据和预算下改善了所有相机可控性和保真度指标，14B 时旋转误差较最强基线下降 29%，FVD 下降 43%。
Motivation: 现有视频扩散 Transformer 按像素时间网格位置（张量中的地址）寻址 token，而用户实际期望的地址是世界点，位于尚未生成的表面上；相机射线在轨迹指定后即固定。现有方法因此需要额外模块来施加相机控制，本文旨在通过编码方式让相机控制天然融入坐标系。
Method: 将相机射线作为第二位置坐标，添加到预训练注意力模块的查询和键中，并在评分函数中加入一个只读取两条射线的项；其规范形式为线几何的倒数积，度量两条视线接近相交程度。提出 Normalize-Gate-Inject 方案使单一编码能跨 metric 与 up-to-scale 位姿源训练。改造保持 RoPE 位精确，从预训练 DiT 初始化，新增参数占比低于 0.1%。
Result: 在 Wan2.2 5B 和 14B 模型、匹配数据和预算条件下，SCoPE 在所有相机可控性和保真度指标上均有提升，并领先所有闭环重访指标；在 14B 规模下，旋转误差较最强基线下降 29%，FVD 下降 43%，且随模型规模增大优势扩大。
Conclusion: 摘要表明将视线射线作为坐标系统属性能够有效统一相机控制与位置编码，且该优势随模型规模增大而扩大。

papers.title: Dual Distribution Estimation for Zero-shot Noisy Test-Time Adaptation with VLMs
papers.abstract_en: While test-time adaptation (TTA) empowers vision-language models to adapt without costly retraining, it remains highly vulnerable to out-of-distribution (OOD) outliers prevalent in real-world applications. This discrepancy motivates Noisy TTA (NTTA), an online task to filter noisy OOD samples on the fly while maximizing in-distribution (ID) classification accuracy. Existing zero-shot NTTA approaches typically rely on test-time discriminative training, leading to overconfident misclassifications and significantly degraded inference efficiency. To address these limitations, we propose a novel framework named Dual Distribution Estimation (DDE), shifting the zero-shot NTTA paradigm from instance-level learning to training-free Gaussian distribution modeling. DDE incorporates two novel modules: Positive Feature Distribution Estimation (PFDE) and Negative Label Distribution Estimation (NLDE). PFDE explicitly models class-wise inclusion and exclusion Gaussian distributions to formulate a calibrated contrastive score, robustly enhancing ID accuracy. In parallel, NLDE improves OOD identification by explicitly modeling the negative label distribution to mine highly discriminative labels, effectively mitigating spurious correlations. Extensive experiments show that on the large-scale ImageNet benchmark, DDE achieves an improvement of 3.70\% in harmonic mean accuracy and reduces the FPR95 for OOD detection by 6.20\%, while ensuring highly scalable and efficient online inference. Furthermore, DDE is zero-shot and training-free, demonstrating remarkable robustness in data-scarce scenarios. Codes are available at https://github.com/ZhuWenjie98/DDE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Dual Distribution Estimation (DDE)框架，用于zero-shot noisy test-time adaptation (NTTA)，将零样本NTTA从实例级学习转向无需训练的Gaussian分布建模。DDE包含Positive Feature Distribution Estimation (PFDE)和Negative Label Distribution Estimation (NLDE)两个模块，在ImageNet基准上提升谐波平均精度3.70%，并将OOD检测的FPR95降低6.20%，同时保持高度可扩展的高效在线推理。
Motivation: 现有TTA易受真实场景中OOD异常值影响，NTTA需要在线过滤噪声OOD样本并最大化ID分类精度。已有的zero-shot NTTA方法依赖测试时判别训练，导致过度自信的错误分类和推理效率显著下降。
Method: DDE框架包含两个模块：PFDE显式建模类别的包含与排除Gaussian分布，形成校准的对比分数以提升ID精度；NLDE显式建模负标签分布，挖掘高判别力的标签以改善OOD识别并缓解虚假相关。整体方法为零样本且无需训练。
Result: 在ImageNet基准上，DDE的谐波平均精度提升3.70%，OOD检测的FPR95降低6.20%，并且推理过程高度可扩展和高效。DDE是zero-shot且training-free的，在数据稀缺场景下表现出显著鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过将zero-shot NTTA从实例级学习转向无需训练的Gaussian分布建模，DDE能够同时增强ID准确率与OOD识别能力，并提升推理效率。

papers.title: ATMA: Long-Context Language Modeling via Polar Attention and Gated-Delta Compression Memory
papers.abstract_en: Length extrapolation in language models involves competing objectives: retrieval fidelity, long-document likelihood, short-context quality, and inference cost. We present ATMA, a 378M-parameter hybrid recipe that combines Polar Attention with gated-delta recurrent memory, and study these objectives as a Pareto problem rather than claiming general architectural dominance. Polar Attention separates a normalized direction channel from a bounded participation-ratio magnitude channel. We select the recipe with a complete 120-cell, 1B-token factorial sweep, then train matched NoPE, RoPE, and Polar variants for 9.816B tokens at length 2K and evaluate them through 256K. Across the factorial, memory improves Polar's 64K retrieval score in all 20 matched cells (mean +47.8 points), whereas its effect on NoPE is small and inconsistent. At 256K, Polar retains 34.4% teacher-forced target-token accuracy and 9.0% exact five-token accuracy; exact retrieval is 18.0% on synthetic contexts but 0.0% on FinePDFs contexts. Polar also limits mean fixed-target bits-per-byte degradation to 1.26 times, at a 1.9-point mean cost on eight short-context tasks. Raven baselines lead BABILong and have length-independent decode state, illustrating a different point on the frontier. Finally, a post-hoc checkpoint audit shows that nearly identical 2K validation curves can conceal a 6.70-nat difference at 256K. Because those runs were neither seed-paired nor randomized across devices, we interpret this as checkpoint variability associated with an infrastructure transition, not a causal hardware effect. Code: https://github.com/kreasof-ai/atma
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ATMA，一个 378M 参数的混合架构，将 Polar Attention 与门控 delta 循环记忆 (gated-delta recurrent memory) 结合，并把长度外推中的多个目标（检索保真度、长文档似然、短上下文质量、推理成本）视为 Pareto 问题来研究，而非宣称普遍的架构优势。作者通过完整的 120 单元、1B token 因子扫描选择配方，训练匹配的 NoPE、RoPE 和 Polar 变体至 9.816B token（长度 2K），并评估到 256K。结果表明记忆模块在全部 20 个匹配单元中平均提升 Polar 的 64K 检索分数 47.8 点，但对 NoPE 影响小且不一致。
Motivation: 语言模型长度外推面临相互竞争的目标：检索保真度、长文档似然、短上下文质量和推理成本，现有工作往往只针对单一目标或笼统声称架构优势。作者希望把这些目标作为 Pareto 前沿上的权衡来系统研究。
Method: ATMA 将 Polar Attention 与门控 delta 循环记忆结合：Polar Attention 分离归一化方向通道与有界的参与比 (participation-ratio) 幅度通道。作者先执行 120 单元、1B token 的因子扫描来选择配方，再训练匹配的 NoPE、RoPE 和 Polar 变体并外推到 256K 进行评估，同时以 Raven 基线作为前沿上的不同参考点。
Result: 在 256K 长度下，Polar 保留 34.4% 的 teacher-forced 目标 token 准确率和 9.0% 的精确五 token 准确率；在合成上下文上精确检索为 18.0%，但在 FinePDFs 上下文上为 0.0%。Polar 将固定目标的 bits-per-byte 退化限制在 1.26 倍，代价是八个短上下文任务平均下降 1.9 点。记忆模块在全部 20 个匹配单元中提升 Polar 的 64K 检索分数（平均 +47.8 点），而 Raven 基线在 BABILong 上领先并具有与长度无关的解码状态。事后检查显示近乎相同的 2K 验证曲线可能掩盖 256K 处 6.70 nat 的差异，作者将其归因于基础设施切换相关的检查点变异性。
Conclusion: 作者强调本工作是在长度外推的多个目标之间做 Pareto 权衡，而非主张单一架构全面占优；同时指出 2K 验证曲线不足以预测长程表现，并明确将观察到的 6.70 nat 差异解释为基础设施切换带来的检查点变异性，而非因果性的硬件效应。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Vision-Reasoning-Guided Occlusion Removal from Light Fields
papers.abstract_en: Occlusion-robust scene recovery remains a major challenge in computational imaging, particularly where dense vegetation severely limits visibility. We propose a visionreasoning-guided light field occlusion removal framework combining light field integration (LFI) with vision-language model (VLM) semantic reasoning. Multi-view observations are first integrated via LFI to suppress foreground occlusions, producing an initial visibility-enhanced representation, a VLM then acts as a conditional semantic prior to restore degraded structures and fine details. A multi-sample fusion strategy aggregates multiple generated hypotheses to improve consistency and reduce hallucination. Experimental results on synthetic and real-world datasets show state-of-the-art performance, achieving the highest average SSIM across four synthetic benchmark scenes (4-Syn) and strong generalization across structured and unstructured acquisition settings, with applicability to search-and-rescue and exploratory robotic navigation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种视觉推理引导的光场遮挡去除框架，结合光场积分 (light field integration, LFI) 与视觉语言模型 (VLM) 的语义推理。多视角观测先由 LFI 集成以抑制前景遮挡，随后 VLM 作为条件语义先验恢复被遮挡的结构与细节，并通过多样本融合策略提高一致性、减少幻觉。在合成与真实数据集上达到当前最优，四个合成基准场景 (4-Syn) 上平均 SSIM 最高，且在结构化与非结构化采集设置下表现出强泛化能力。
Motivation: 遮挡鲁棒的场景恢复仍是计算成像中的主要挑战，尤其是浓密植被等场景会严重限制可见性，导致被遮挡区域的退化结构和细节难以恢复。
Method: 框架首先利用光场积分 (LFI) 对多视角观测进行集成以抑制前景遮挡，生成初始可见性增强表示；然后由视觉语言模型 (VLM) 作为条件语义先验恢复退化结构与细粒度细节；最后采用多采样融合策略聚合多个生成假设，以提高输出一致性并减少幻觉 (hallucination)。
Result: 实验在合成和真实数据集上均取得当前最优性能：在四个合成基准场景 (4-Syn) 上获得最高平均 SSIM，并在结构化与非结构化采集设置下展现出良好的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 该方法被指出适用于搜索救援和探索性机器人导航等需要遮挡鲁棒场景恢复的实际场景。

papers.title: MuseVLA: An Adaptive Multimodal Sensing Vision-Language-Action Model for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Humans naturally leverage diverse sensing modalities to interact with the physical world, while most Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for robotics rely solely on RGB observations. This limits their ability to perceive physical properties that are difficult or impossible to infer from RGB cameras, such as temperature, sound, or radar response. We present MuseVLA, an adaptive multimodal sensing VLA model that integrates novel sensors as on-demand tools for robotic manipulation. Given a task instruction and visual context, MuseVLA first generates a sensor token and target description that select the sensing modality to invoke and what to attend to, analogous to a tool call with arguments. It then converts the selected sensor measurement into a grounded sensor image, a unified intermediate representation that encodes heterogeneous readings for multimodal fusion and action generation. This design decouples sensor-specific processing from the VLA backbone, enabling efficient integration of diverse modalities. To reduce the need for expensive multisensory robot datasets, we further introduce a data synthesis pipeline that augments existing RGB video datasets with grounded sensor images, enabling generalization to unseen sensor-guided tasks. We evaluate MuseVLA on a real-world robot across challenging dexterous hand manipulation tasks that require multimodal sensing inputs, including temperature-guided pick-and-place, audio-driven object search, and radar-assisted hidden object retrieval. MuseVLA achieves 80.6% success rate on average, outperforming RGB-only and multisensory VLA baselines significantly, and exhibits strong zero-shot capabilities on unseen tasks. Code, model and dataset are available at https://github.com/microsoft/MuseVLA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MuseVLA，一个将多种新型传感器作为按需工具接入的视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型，用于机器人灵巧手操纵。模型先根据任务指令和视觉上下文生成传感器 token 与目标描述来选择调用哪种传感模态，再把传感器读数转换成统一的接地传感器图像 (grounded sensor image)，用于多模态融合和动作生成；同时配套数据合成流水线，用虚拟传感器图像扩增现有 RGB 视频数据集。真实机器人实验显示其在温度引导抓取、音频引导搜索、雷达辅助隐藏物体检索等任务上平均成功率 80.6%，显著超过 RGB-only 和多传感器 VLA 基线，并在未见任务上表现出强零样本能力。
Motivation: 大多数 VLA 机器人模型只依赖 RGB 观测，难以感知温度、声音、雷达响应等无法从 RGB 相机可靠推断的物理属性，限制了机器人的物理交互能力。
Method: MuseVLA 将传感器当作可调用的工具：先由模型输出传感器 token 和目标描述以选择模态和注意对象，再通过统一的接地传感器图像表示编码异构传感器读数，实现与 VLA 主干解耦的多模态融合；此外提出数据合成流水线，将接地传感器图像加入现有 RGB 视频数据集以降低多传感器机器人数据采集成本。
Result: 在真实灵巧手操纵任务上，MuseVLA 平均成功率为 80.6%，显著高于 RGB-only 与多传感器 VLA 基线，并在未见过任务上展示出较强的零样本泛化能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为将传感器特定处理与 VLA 主干解耦，能高效集成多种传感模态；数据合成流水线可减少对昂贵多传感器数据集的依赖，有助于模型泛化到未见过的传感器引导任务。

papers.title: Teaching agentic AI to learn expert reasoning for rare disease diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Rare disease diagnosis depends on expert reasoning that is scarce and difficult to transfer; off-the-shelf large language models (LLMs) rank the correct disease first in only 35.4% of benchmark cases. Here we show that this expert reasoning can be converted into a scalable AI capability through a governed learning process rather than model training alone. We developed liteOdyssey through Policy Iteration with Human Feedback (PIHF), an in-context policy-learning method adapted from generalized policy iteration in reinforcement learning, in which model failures and expert corrections consolidate into an explicit, clinician-gated policy that turns an off-the-shelf LLM into an agentic diagnostic system. We demonstrated that such a policy improved diagnostic accuracy to match the best published systems at a fraction of their deployment footprint, generalized to unseen diseases, transferred across models, and remained under clinician control. Across 1,243 public benchmark cases spanning 722 rare diseases, liteOdyssey ranked the correct disease first in 59.3% of cases versus 26.5% without the policy, with nearly identical gains on the 1,193 cases and 679 diseases excluded from policy development. Ablations showed that gains exceeded automated prompting improvement or source access alone, and the policy transferred without modification across closed- and open-weight models. In 515 Undiagnosed Diseases Network patients, liteOdyssey again improved accuracy, and blinded physicians rated its differentials more often exact and less often unhelpful. Through PIHF, expert reasoning becomes an LLM capability that experts can inspect, revise, and transfer across models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 liteOdyssey，一种通过 Policy Iteration with Human Feedback (PIHF) 将罕见病诊断中的专家推理转化为可扩展 AI 能力的代理诊断系统。该方法将模型失败与专家修正整合为显式的、由临床医生把关的策略，使现成 LLM 转变为代理诊断系统。在 1,243 个公开罕见病基准病例中，正确疾病排名第一的比例从无策略时的 26.5% 提升至 59.3%，并在未见疾病与跨模型迁移中保持增益，同时保持临床医生的可检查与可控性。
Motivation: 罕见病诊断依赖稀缺且难以转移的专家推理，而现成的大语言模型在基准病例中仅 35.4% 能将正确疾病排在首位，需要一种超越单纯模型训练的可扩展学习途径。
Method: 提出 PIHF，一种受强化学习中广义策略迭代 (generalized policy iteration) 启发的上下文策略学习方法，通过模型失败与专家修正不断整合成显式的、临床医生把关的策略，从而将现成 LLM 转化为代理诊断系统。
Result: 在覆盖 722 种疾病的 1,243 个公开基准病例中，liteOdyssey 将正确疾病排名第一的比例从 26.5% 提高到 59.3%；在排除于策略开发的 1,193 个病例和 679 种疾病上增益几乎相同。策略无需修改即可跨闭源与开源权重模型迁移；在 515 名 Undiagnosed Diseases Network 患者中，盲法医生评定其鉴别诊断更多时候精确且更少无帮助。
Conclusion: 通过 PIHF，专家推理可被转化为可检查、可修订、可跨模型迁移的 LLM 能力，且整个学习过程受临床医生治理而非仅依赖模型训练。

papers.title: Multi-Agent Embodied Autonomous Driving: From V2X Information Exchange to Shared World Models
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous driving is shifting from isolated vehicle intelligence toward multi-agent embodied systems that share perception, infer intent, and coordinate action under uncertainty. This survey examines this transition through the lens of Shared World Models (SWMs): predictive cross-agent representations maintained across vehicles, infrastructure, and other traffic participants. We review approximately 400 publications covering vehicle-to-everything (V2X) communication, collaborative perception, inter-agent cognition, cooperative planning, end-to-end cooperative driving, and simulation and data engines for closed-loop validation. The organizing question is how exchanged observations become aligned state, intent-aware interaction, and coordinated downstream action. Across the surveyed literature, evaluation remains concentrated in simulation, curated benchmarks, and offline protocols. Foundation-model-based coordination also lacks verifiable real-time safety guarantees in open traffic. These gaps motivate key research priorities for multi-agent embodied autonomous driving (MAEAD): verifiable shared-state maintenance, robust intent and plan alignment, and safe coordinated action under communication and computing constraints in real-world deployment. We maintain an open-source project to continuously track the latest developments at https://github.com/dl-m9/Multi-Agent-Embodied-Autonomous-Driving.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于多智能体具身自动驾驶（multi-agent embodied autonomous driving）的综述，以共享世界模型（Shared World Models, SWMs）为主线，回顾约 400 篇文献，覆盖 V2X 通信、协同感知、智能体间认知、协同规划、端到端协同驾驶以及闭环验证的仿真与数据引擎。综述指出当前评估仍集中在仿真、精选基准和离线协议，且基于基础模型的协调在开放交通中缺乏可验证的实时安全保证，并据此提出未来研究重点。
Motivation: 自动驾驶正从单一车辆智能转向多智能体具身系统，需要在不确定性下共享感知、推断意图并协调动作。作者以“交换的观测如何变成对齐的状态、意图感知的交互和协调的下游动作”为核心问题，梳理该转变中的关键环节。
Method: 采用综述方法，围绕共享世界模型（SWMs）组织文献，系统回顾了约 400 篇相关出版物，覆盖 V2X 通信、协同感知、智能体间认知、协同规划、端到端协同驾驶、仿真与数据引擎，并维护开源项目持续追踪最新进展。
Result: 综述发现，现有评估仍集中于仿真、精选基准与离线协议；基于基础模型的协调在开放交通中缺乏可验证的实时安全保证。据此提出多智能体具身自动驾驶（MAEAD）的关键研究优先项：可验证的共享状态维护、稳健的意图与计划对齐，以及在通信和计算约束下的安全协调动作。
Conclusion: 作者认为仿真与实际部署之间的差距是当前多智能体自动驾驶的核心瓶颈，并强调现实世界部署中需要可验证的共享状态、意图对齐与安全协调。

papers.title: Detecting Explanatory Insufficiency in Learned Representations: A Framework for Representational Vigilance
papers.abstract_en: Learned representations are central to modern machine learning and are typically evaluated through predictive performance, robustness, uncertainty estimation, and generalization. However, a learned representation may remain operationally successful while failing to organize persistent residual structures not fully captured by conventional evaluation metrics. This article introduces VER (Vigilant Evaluator of Representations), a conceptual framework for monitoring representational adequacy. VER does not propose a new learning algorithm, loss function, or model architecture. Instead, it defines a diagnostic process for identifying persistent residual structures and assessing whether they may indicate explanatory insufficiency rather than uncertainty, noise, data limitation, local model error, or distribution shift. The framework comprises five operations: representation identification, explanatory-domain delimitation, residual-structure detection, explanatory-resistance evaluation, and vigilance signaling. VER complements performance evaluation, uncertainty estimation, out-of-distribution detection, and robustness analysis by making representational adequacy an explicit object of inquiry. A path toward empirical evaluation through representational-vigilance benchmarks is also outlined.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 2 figures, no tables, 16 references. Conceptual and methodological framework for monitoring representational adequacy and detecting explanatory insufficiency in learned representations
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VER（Vigilant Evaluator of Representations），一个用于监测学习表示充分性（representational adequacy）的概念性诊断框架。VER 不提出新的学习算法、损失函数或模型架构，而是定义五个操作来识别持久残差结构（persistent residual structures），并判断它们是否反映解释性不足（explanatory insufficiency）而非不确定性、噪声、数据限制、局部模型误差或分布偏移。摘要还勾勒了通过表示警觉基准（representational-vigilance benchmarks）进行实证评估的路径。
Motivation: 学习表示通常只用预测性能、鲁棒性、不确定性估计和泛化来评估，但一个操作上成功的表示仍可能遗漏未被常规指标捕获的持久残差结构。现有评估没有把表示充分性作为明确的研究对象，导致这类结构性欠缺难以被发现。
Method: VER 定义了一个由五个操作组成的诊断流程：表示识别（representation identification）、解释域界定（explanatory-domain delimitation）、残差结构检测（residual-structure detection）、解释阻力评估（explanatory-resistance evaluation）和警觉信号发出（vigilance signaling）。它不引入新模型或训练目标，而是作为性能评估、不确定性估计、分布外检测和鲁棒性分析的补充工具。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实证数字或基准结果，仅说明该方法是一个概念与方法框架，并提出了通过 representational-vigilance benchmarks 进行实证评估的路径。
Conclusion: 作者主张把表示充分性变成显式可考察的对象，通过诊断残差结构并区分解释性不足与其他常见失效来源来补充现有评估体系。文章为概念性工作，范围限于框架定义与基准化路径的勾勒。

summary_sections.method: VER 定义了一个由五个操作组成的诊断流程：表示识别（representation identification）、解释域界定（explanatory-domain delimitation）、残差结构检测（residual-structure detection）、解释阻力评估（explanatory-resistance evaluation）和警觉信号发出（vigilance signaling）。它不引入新模型或训练目标，而是作为性能评估、不确定性估计、分布外检测和鲁棒性分析的补充工具。
summary_sections.result: 摘要未报告具体实证数字或基准结果，仅说明该方法是一个概念与方法框架，并提出了通过 representational-vigilance benchmarks 进行实证评估的路径。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者主张把表示充分性变成显式可考察的对象，通过诊断残差结构并区分解释性不足与其他常见失效来源来补充现有评估体系。文章为概念性工作，范围限于框架定义与基准化路径的勾勒。

papers.title: FACTR 2: Learning External Force Sensing for Commodity Robot Arms Improves Policy Learning
papers.abstract_en: Contact-rich manipulation requires force sensitivity, but many robot arms lack dedicated force sensors due to their high cost. We present Neural External Torque Estimation (NEXT), a data-driven method that estimates external joint torques without needing any dedicated force sensors. NEXT trains in 1 minute from only 10 minutes of free-motion data, yet achieves estimates comparable to dedicated joint-torque sensors. NEXT enables force-feedback teleoperation on low-cost arms and improves policy learning through Force-Informed Re-Sampling Training (FIRST), which up-samples pre-contact and contact segments during behavior cloning. Across five long-horizon tasks, FIRST outperforms prior force-aware policies by over 17% in task progress. Together, NEXT and FIRST bring force-aware teleoperation and policy learning to off-the-shelf robots without additional sensing hardware. Video results and code are available at https://jasonjzliu.com/factr2
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Neural External Torque Estimation (NEXT)，一种无需专用力传感器的数据驱动外部关节力矩估计方法，仅利用10分钟自由运动数据训练1分钟即可获得与专用关节力矩传感器相当的估计精度。配合 Force-Informed Re-Sampling Training (FIRST) 在行为克隆中上采样接触前与接触片段，在五个长时程任务上相较先前力感知策略提升任务进度超过17%。
Motivation: 接触丰富的操作任务需要力敏感性，但许多商用机器人手臂因专用力传感器成本高昂而缺乏力感知，限制了力反馈遥操作与策略学习的可用性。
Method: NEXT 从自由运动数据中学习估计外部关节力矩，无需任何专用力传感器；FIRST 在行为克隆训练中重采样数据以强调接触前和接触片段，使策略学习能够利用力信息。
Result: 摘要报告 NEXT 训练仅需1分钟、数据仅需10分钟自由运动，估计效果可与专用关节力矩传感器相比；在五个长时程任务上 FIRST 比先前的力感知策略在任务进度上提升超过17%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 NEXT 与 FIRST 的组合将力感知遥操作与策略学习推广到无需额外传感硬件的现成机器人上。

papers.title: ArtiFact: A Large-Scale Multi-Modal Cultural Heritage Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Multi-modal data management has emerged as a central research topic in the database community, spanning data integration, semantic query processing, and data quality assessment. Despite this growing interest, the community lacks large-scale, real-world datasets combining tables, text, and images. We present ArtiFact, a multi-modal cultural heritage dataset of 651045 museum records collected from the Metropolitan Museum of Art, the Art Institute of Chicago, and the Rijksmuseum. We demonstrate the utility of ArtiFact through two downstream tasks. For cross-modal error detection, we introduce a curated taxonomy of seven error categories injected into 130209 records and show that reliably detecting subtle domain-specific errors such as material anachronisms and temporal shifts remain an open challenge. For semantic query processing, we show that current systems struggle with queries involving cultural proximity, ambiguous object types, and historically contingent terminology. Our results position ArtiFact as a challenging benchmark for multi-modal data management research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ArtiFact，一个大规模多模态文化遗产数据集，包含来自大都会艺术博物馆、芝加哥艺术学院和荷兰国立博物馆的 651045 条博物馆记录，将表格、文本和图像结合成统一的真实世界数据基准。作者围绕跨模态错误检测和语义查询处理两个下游任务评估该数据集，注入七类错误的 130209 条记录用于错误检测，并考察现有系统在文化邻近性、歧义对象类型和历史上随时间变化的术语上的查询表现。结果显示现有系统在这些细粒度、领域特定的任务上仍面临明显困难。
Motivation: 数据库社区在多模态数据管理方面研究活跃，但缺乏结合表格、文本和图像的大规模真实世界数据集，这限制了跨模态错误检测与语义查询处理等方向的可复现研究。
Method: 从三个知名博物馆收集并整理 651045 条馆藏记录，构建表格、文本、图像兼具的数据集；针对跨模态错误检测设计包含七类错误的注入分类法并注入到 130209 条记录中；同时设计语义查询处理任务以检验文化相关查询能力。
Result: 摘要报告称，现有系统难以可靠检测诸如材料时代错误和年代偏移等细微领域特定错误；在语义查询处理上，涉及文化邻近性、歧义对象类型及历史相关术语的查询也使当前系统表现不佳。
Conclusion: 作者将 ArtiFact 定位为多模态数据管理研究的一个挑战性基准，强调其可用于推动跨模态错误检测和语义查询处理方面的进展。
Relevance: 2
