papers.title: Bootstrap Theory of Representational Emergence: Explanatory Insufficiency as a Driver of Representation Learning and World Models
papers.abstract_en: Representation learning is central to modern machine learning, yet most research focuses on optimizing representations after a representational framework has been selected. Less attention is given to when a new representational level becomes necessary. We introduce the Bootstrap Theory of Representational Emergence (TBER), a conceptual framework in which persistent explanatory insufficiency acts as a signal for representational transition. A representation may remain descriptively useful while becoming unable to make relevant observations, relations, transformations, or organizational properties intelligible. TBER describes a recursive five-stage process: stabilized observation, anomaly detection, recognition of explanatory insufficiency, representational emergence, and provisional stabilization. The revised framework distinguishes emergence from validation: candidate representations may require problem re-representation, discriminating tests, and representational selection before stabilization. TBER concerns transitions between scientific or computational representations rather than transitions within the physical systems being observed. It provides a meta-representational framework applicable to representation learning, latent spaces, foundation models, world models, adaptive systems, and scientific discovery. A possible implication for future AI is the development of systems capable not only of learning representations, but also of detecting their explanatory limits and initiating, testing, and selecting alternative representational frameworks.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 25 references, no figures or tables. Conceptual framework on representational emergence and explanatory insufficiency, with implications for representation learning, world models, autonomous AI, and scientific discovery
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出表征涌现的自举理论（Bootstrap Theory of Representational Emergence, TBER），一个概念框架，将持续的解释性不足（explanatory insufficiency）作为表征转换的信号。框架描述递归五阶段过程：稳定观察、异常检测、解释性不足识别、表征涌现、临时稳定，并明确区分涌现与验证。作者将其定位为元表征框架，适用于表征学习、潜在空间、基础模型、世界模型、自适应系统和科学发现。
Motivation: 现有表征学习研究大多在选定表征框架之后优化表征，很少关注何时需要新的表征层级。本文针对这一空白提出概念框架，强调持久解释性不足应被视为表征转换的驱动信号。
Method: 提出 TBER 概念框架，描述解释性不足驱动表征转换的递归五阶段过程，并将涌现与验证相区分：候选表征可能需要问题重表征、判别性测试和表征选择才能进入稳定阶段。
Result: 论文为概念性框架，未报告经验结果或实验数据，摘要中不包含数据集、基准或定量指标。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 TBER 关注科学或计算表征之间的转换，而非被观测物理系统内部的转换；对未来的可能启示是发展不仅能学习表征、还能检测其解释极限并启动、测试和选择替代表征框架的 AI 系统。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: RedditPersona: A Modular Framework for Community-Conditioned LLM Adaptation from Reddit
papers.abstract_en: Community-conditioned language model adaptation needs choices about data collection, community definition, and evaluation that are currently made independently in each study, making it hard to compare assumptions or reuse artifacts. We present RedditPersona, a modular framework that standardizes these choices: it collects Reddit posts and comments, profiles active users, partitions them under five grouping strategies (subreddit-based, graph-structural, semantic, hybrid, and interaction-based), trains a parameter-efficient adapter per strategy via QLoRA, and evaluates them under a shared metric suite spanning fluency, fidelity, distributional alignment, and community identifiability. Applied to 112 subreddits in the urban well-being domain (301,429 user profiles, 16M+ comments), we find that adapters' behavioral identifiability tracks each strategy's agreement with the subreddit baseline, and that a consistent trade-off between identifiability and distributional similarity to real text holds across all five strategies. The code and configuration files are available at: https://github.com/Ahghaffari/redditpersona.
papers.comment: Accepted manuscript (CC BY 4.0). To appear in ACM CIKM 2026, Rome, Italy, Nov 7-11, 2026. DOI: https://doi.org/10.1145/3799682.3840182
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RedditPersona，一个用于社区条件化语言模型适配的模块化框架，将数据收集、社区定义与评估流程标准化。框架收集 Reddit 帖子和评论，分析活跃用户，并在五种分组策略（基于 subreddit、图结构、语义、混合和基于交互）下划分用户，通过 QLoRA 为每种策略训练参数高效适配器，再用涵盖流畅性、保真度、分布对齐和社区可识别性的统一指标套件评估。在 112 个 subreddit（301,429 个用户画像、1600 万+ 评论）上，作者发现适配器的行为可识别性与各策略同 subreddit 基线的一致性相关，且五种策略均呈现出可识别性与真实文本分布相似性之间的固定权衡。
Motivation: 社区条件化语言模型适配涉及数据收集、社区定义和评估方式的选择，而现有研究各自独立地做出这些选择，导致假设难以比较、工件难以复用。
Method: 提出模块化框架 RedditPersona：收集 Reddit 帖子与评论，构建活跃用户画像，按五种分组策略（subreddit-based、graph-structural、semantic、hybrid、interaction-based）划分用户，使用 QLoRA 为每种策略训练参数高效适配器，并在共享指标套件下评估流畅性、保真度、分布对齐与社区可识别性。
Result: 应用于 112 个 subreddit、301,429 个用户画像和 1600 万+ 条评论，结果显示适配器的行为可识别性随各策略与 subreddit 基线的一致性而变化，且在所有五种策略中都存在可识别性与对真实文本分布相似性之间的一致权衡。
Conclusion: 该框架使不同社区定义和评估假设可比较，并揭示了社区条件化适配中可识别性与分布相似性的稳定权衡；代码和配置文件已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reproducing, Analyzing, and Detecting Reward Hacking in Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) uses an LLM-as-a-Judge (LaaJ) to score model outputs according to rubrics as rewards. However, policy models may exploit latent biases in the judge, leading to reward hacking and ineffective or unsafe training outcomes. In real-world rubric-based RL, such hacking behaviors are often subtle and entangled with multiple judge biases, making them difficult to analyze, detect, and mitigate. In this paper, we introduce CHERRL, a Controllable Hacking Environment for Rubric-based RL. By injecting known biases into LaaJ, CHERRL enables stable reproduction of reward hacking, explicit observation of reward divergence, and identification of hacking onset. This provides a clean experimental testbed for studying the mechanisms and mitigations of reward hacking in rubric-based RL. To demonstrate its utility, we analyze different judge biases from the perspectives of discoverability and exploitability, and explore an agent for automatically detecting reward hacking onset from training logs. The code and environment are publicly available at https://github.com/THUAIS-Lab/CHERRL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CHERRL，一个面向基于评分标准 (rubric) 的强化学习 (RL) 的可控奖励黑客 (reward hacking) 环境。通过向 LLM-as-a-Judge (LaaJ) 注入已知偏置，CHERRL 能稳定复现奖励黑客、显式观察奖励发散并识别黑客行为起始点，为研究该类奖励黑客机制与缓解方法提供干净实验平台。摘要还基于可发现性与可利用性分析了不同 judge 偏置，并探索了从训练日志自动检测黑客起始的 agent。
Motivation: 真实世界的 rubric-based RL 中，策略模型可能利用 judge 的潜在偏置导致奖励黑客，且黑客行为往往细微并与多种 judge 偏置纠缠，使得分析、检测和缓解都很困难。
Method: 构建可注入已知偏置的 CHERRL 环境，通过控制 judge 偏置来稳定复现奖励黑客、观测奖励发散并定位黑客起始点；同时从可发现性与可利用性两个视角分析 judge 偏置，并探索基于训练日志的自动检测 agent。

papers.title: Planar Symmetric Pattern Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generating objects with specific symmetries is essential in various real-world scenarios. However, adapting existing 2D continuous representations to enforce planar group symmetry remains a challenge, as the transformation of non-reflective group elements may disrupt continuity. To overcome this limitation, we propose a symmetrization framework for arbitrary planar groups. Our method transforms any 2D continuous representation into a symmetric one while preserving continuity. We provide the mathematical formulation of this representation, demonstrate its approximation capability for symmetric functions, and detail the construction methodology. We validate our approach through three visual design tasks (pattern design, paper-cutting design and stylized topology design) and one material design task. Experiments confirm that our representation enables effective symmetry control and demonstrate its broader applicability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于任意平面群的对称化框架，将任意2D连续表示变换为对称表示并保持连续性。摘要给出该表示的数学表述、对对称函数的逼近能力证明及构造方法，并通过三个视觉设计任务（图案设计、剪纸设计、风格化拓扑设计）和一个材料设计任务验证其有效性。
Motivation: 在现实场景中生成具有特定对称性的对象是必要的，但现有2D连续表示难以强制平面群对称，因为非反射群元素的变换可能破坏连续性。
Method: 提出一个对称化框架，将任意2D连续表示转换为对称表示，同时保持连续性；包括数学表述、逼近能力分析与构造方法论。
Result: 在图案设计、剪纸设计、风格化拓扑设计和材料设计四项任务上的实验确认该表示能实现有效的对称控制，并展示其更广泛适用性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该对称化表示能够实现有效的对称控制，并具有广泛适用性；未提及明显局限。

papers.title: Ranking vs. Assignment: The Metric Mismatch in Multi-View Object Association
papers.abstract_en: Multi-view object association is an important computer vision problem that underlies many multi-camera perception tasks. While this task is naturally formulated as a constrained one-to-one matching problem, recent works heavily rely on pairwise ranking metrics like AP and FPR-95 for model evaluation. We highlight a fundamental mismatch between these metrics and the actual assignment objective. Theoretically, we show that AP and FPR-95 can be imperfect even when the assignment is already correct, and that Sinkhorn-based normalization can make them perfect. Conversely, optimal pairwise ranking can still lead to incorrect assignments. We validate this mismatch in practice by using our Sinkhorn-based normalization as a controlled post-processing stress test. We show that optimizing just a few post-processing parameters significantly boosts AP and FPR-95 without corresponding improvements in assignment-level metrics such as ACC and IPAA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出多视角目标关联 (multi-view object association) 中常用的成对排序指标 AP 与 FPR-95 与实际的一对一匹配目标存在根本性不匹配。作者从理论上证明，即使分配已经正确，AP 和 FPR-95 仍可能不完美，而 Sinkhorn 归一化可使它们完美；反之，最优成对排序也可能导致错误分配。作为受控的后处理压力测试，他们用 Sinkhorn 归一化验证了该不匹配在实践中确实存在。
Motivation: 多视角目标关联通常被建模为带约束的一对一匹配问题，但近年工作却大量使用 AP 和 FPR-95 等成对排序指标评估模型，这种评估与实际分配目标之间的不一致可能误导模型选择。
Method: 首先给出理论分析，说明排序指标与分配目标之间的不匹配关系；然后提出将 Sinkhorn-based normalization 作为受控的后处理压力测试，仅优化少量后处理参数来观察排序指标与分配级指标的变化。
Result: 理论结果显示 AP 和 FPR-95 在分配已正确时仍可能不完美，而 Sinkhorn 归一化可使其完美；最优成对排序也可能导致错误分配。实践中，仅优化少量后处理参数就能显著提升 AP 和 FPR-95，而 ACC 和 IPAA 等分配级指标没有相应改善。
Conclusion: 作者强调排序指标与分配目标之间存在系统性不匹配，呼吁评估多视角目标关联时应采用分配级指标，而不是单纯依赖 AP 和 FPR-95。

papers.title: memorywire: A Vendor-Neutral Wire Format for Agent Memory Operations
papers.abstract_en: Agent-memory frameworks -- mem0, Letta/MemGPT, Cognee, Zep/Graphiti, MemoryOS, MemTensor -- each ship their own SDK, storage layout, and operational vocabulary. There is no shared wire format: every integration is bespoke, every migration rebuilds memory from scratch, and no framework ships a governance surface that lets a human review writes before they enter long-term storage. We present memorywire, a JSON-Schema 2020-12 wire format for five memory operations (remember, recall, forget, merge, expire) over four memory types (semantic, episodic, procedural, emotional), with a MemoryStore interface, a fan-out router, and an optional HITL governance channel. We describe an open-source reference implementation with five backend adapters (sqlite-vec, mem0, Letta, Cognee, pgvector); a microbenchmark on a 100-fact / 50-query labelled corpus (42 with non-empty gold ids + 8 no-match probes) achieving recall@5 = 1.000 on the 42 gold-id queries with ingest p50 = 37.8 ms and recall p50 = 40.6 ms; an adversarial-fusion experiment showing Reciprocal Rank Fusion holds recall@5 = 1.000 across a 1-of-N rank-0 injection sweep (K in {0, 5, ..., 50}) where max fusion collapses to 0.500 with 80% leak at K >= 5; and a 16-scenario cross-adapter conformance suite passing 68 of 80 cells with zero failures. The contribution is not a new algorithm; it is a packaging of established components (RRF, FSMs, STM/LTM consolidation, diff-and-approve workflows) into a venue-neutral protocol with an empirically validated reference, positioned to compose with the Model Context Protocol rather than compete with it. We further show that memorywire's provenance field is the strongest lever for recovering a poisoned store, evaluated with an companion benchmark (PurgeBench).
papers.comment: 18 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. v4: PurgeBench is a companion benchmark by the same author (previously called "external"), plus a threats-to-validity note; no results changed. v3 added the memory-poison recovery evaluation and recover tool. Code: github.com/mthamil107/memorywire
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 memorywire，一个基于 JSON-Schema 2020-12 的厂商中立（vendor-neutral）智能体内存线格式，覆盖五种内存操作（remember、recall、forget、merge、expire）和四种内存类型（semantic、episodic、procedural、emotional），并提供 MemoryStore 接口、fan-out 路由器和可选的 HITL 治理通道。作者给出带五个后端适配器的开源参考实现，并通过基准实验与并发一致性测试验证其可行性。作者强调贡献不是新算法，而是把现有组件打包成可组合的协议，并与 Model Context Protocol 互补而非竞争。
Motivation: 现有智能体内存框架（如 mem0、Letta/MemGPT、Cognee、Zep/Graphiti、MemoryOS、MemTensor）各自拥有独立 SDK、存储布局和操作词汇，缺少共享线格式，导致集成均为定制、迁移需从零重建内存，且没有框架提供让人类在写入长期存储前审查的治理表层。
Method: 设计 JSON-Schema 2020-12 的 wire format，定义五种操作与四种内存类型，搭配 MemoryStore 接口、fan-out 路由器和可选 HITL 治理通道；提供开源参考实现，含五个后端适配器（sqlite-vec、mem0、Letta、Cognee、pgvector），并引入 provenance 字段用于存储恢复。
Result: 在 100-fact/50-query 带标签语料上，42 个 gold-id 查询的 recall@5 达 1.000，ingest p50 为 37.8 ms、recall p50 为 40.6 ms；对抗性融合实验中，Reciprocal Rank Fusion 在 1-of-N rank-0 注入扫描（K in {0, 5, ..., 50}）下保持 recall@5=1.000，而 max fusion 在 K>=5 时降至 0.500 并出现 80% 泄漏；16 场景跨适配器一致性测试通过 68/80 单元且零失败；伴侣基准 PurgeBench 显示 provenance 字段是恢复中毒存储的最强杠杆。
Conclusion: 本文贡献是既有组件（RRF、FSM、STM/LTM 整合、diff-and-approve 工作流）的协议化封装，而非新算法；协议定位为与 Model Context Protocol 组合使用而非竞争，并通过经验验证的参考实现支撑其可用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hallucination Mitigation with Agentic AI, Nested Learning, and AI Sustainability via Semantic Caching
papers.abstract_en: This paper describes an approach to hallucination detection and mitigation using a HOPE-inspired Nested Learning architecture with Continuum Memory Systems (CMS) and semantic similarity caching, tested on a hybrid benchmark of 310 prompts (217 epistemic-uncertainty prompts, 93 fabrication-induction stress tests). A three-stage pipeline orchestrated via the Open Floor Protocol is evaluated with five KPIs; four score the response and aggregate into a Total Hallucination Score. The score improves end to end by 6.1% of its attainable range, but 83.5% of that gain is attributable to a single dimension, Explicit Contextualization, while Factual Claim Density, the dimension closest to unsupported content, stays flat; 97.7% of the gain arrives at the first review stage. The fifth indicator, observability, is reported separately, since it registers the presence of an OFP annotation channel rather than a property of the response: it rises 147% at the review stage, the only stage carrying explicit hallucination markers, then falls back at the final stage, which does not propagate the channel. Three annotators independently labelled every final-stage response on the 93 stress prompts: in 10 of 93 cases (10.8%, 95% CI 5.9-18.7) the final answer still presents the invented item as real, at alpha=0.586, below the conventional threshold; Explicit Contextualization tracks these labels monotonically. Re-scoring all 930 outputs with Llama 3.1, Gemma 4, and Qwen 3 as judges confirms the gain and ranks the cross-family judges above the original evaluator against human labels (rho=-0.772 vs -0.477). Semantic caching serves 47.7% of model calls. A nominally multi-dimensional reliability score is thus effectively one-dimensional, and only that dimension has external support.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于 HOPE 启发的嵌套学习 (Nested Learning) 架构、连续记忆系统 (Continuum Memory Systems, CMS) 与语义相似性缓存的幻觉检测与缓解方法，并在 310 条提示（217 条认知不确定性提示、93 条诱导虚构压力测试）的混合基准上评估。通过 Open Floor Protocol 编排的三阶段流水线使用五个 KPI，其中四个聚合为总幻觉分数 (Total Hallucination Score)；摘要报告该分数端到端改善其可达范围的 6.1%，但 83.5% 的提升来自单一维度 Explicit Contextualization，而最接近无依据内容的 Factual Claim Density 保持持平，且 97.7% 的提升发生在第一个审查阶段。独立标注显示 93 条压力提示中有 10 条（10.8%，95% CI 5.9-18.7）最终答案仍将虚构内容呈现为真实，alpha=0.586 低于常规阈值；用 Llama 3.1、Gemma 4 和 Qwen 3 重新评分 930 个输出确认了增益，并使跨家族评测器在人类标签上的排序优于原评测器（rho=-0.772 vs -0.477）。
Motivation: 幻觉检测与缓解的有效性常以多维可靠性分数衡量，但这类分数可能掩盖不同维度间的巨大差异；本文试图检验所提出方法的改善究竟来自真实的无依据内容抑制，还是只是某一个辅助维度的假象。
Method: 采用 HOPE 启发的嵌套学习架构、连续记忆系统与语义相似性缓存，构建由 Open Floor Protocol 编排的三阶段处理流水线；以五个 KPI 评估响应，其中四个聚合为总幻觉分数，第五个观测性指标单独报告，因为其记录的是 OFP 注释通道的存在而非响应本身属性。
Result: 总幻觉分数端到端提升可达范围的 6.1%，但 83.5% 来自 Explicit Contextualization，Factual Claim Density 持平，97.7% 的提升发生在第一审查阶段；观测性在审查阶段上升 147%，在最终阶段回落。93 条压力提示中 10.8% 的最终答案仍把虚构内容当作真实，alpha=0.586；跨家族大模型评测器与人类标签的相关性（rho=-0.772）优于原评测器（rho=-0.477）。语义缓存服务了 47.7% 的模型调用。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，该名义上的多维可靠性分数实际上是一维的，且只有这一维度获得了外部标注支持；其余维度的改进缺乏充分证据，说明此类评估设计需要更严格地拆分各维度的独立贡献。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 采用 HOPE 启发的嵌套学习架构、连续记忆系统与语义相似性缓存，构建由 Open Floor Protocol 编排的三阶段处理流水线；以五个 KPI 评估响应，其中四个聚合为总幻觉分数，第五个观测性指标单独报告，因为其记录的是 OFP 注释通道的存在而非响应本身属性。
summary_sections.result: 总幻觉分数端到端提升可达范围的 6.1%，但 83.5% 来自 Explicit Contextualization，Factual Claim Density 持平，97.7% 的提升发生在第一审查阶段；观测性在审查阶段上升 147%，在最终阶段回落。93 条压力提示中 10.8% 的最终答案仍把虚构内容当作真实，alpha=0.586；跨家族大模型评测器与人类标签的相关性（rho=-0.772）优于原评测器（rho=-0.477）。语义缓存服务了 47.7% 的模型调用。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调，该名义上的多维可靠性分数实际上是一维的，且只有这一维度获得了外部标注支持；其余维度的改进缺乏充分证据，说明此类评估设计需要更严格地拆分各维度的独立贡献。

papers.title: Emergent conservation in atmospheric chemical mechanisms
papers.abstract_en: Conservation laws are time-invariant properties that constrain many physical systems. For systems of chemical reactions, conservation of mass constrains how atoms flow between chemical species. Here, we demonstrate that chemical reaction networks can display emergent conserved quantities not explained by mass conservation that arise instead from coupled kinetics. While some of these kinetic relationships can be immediately recognizable in simple chemical systems, more complex mechanisms have hidden nontrivial relationships between species. We identify these emergent relationships as a broader class of invariant behavior in atmospheric chemical mechanisms, which we call kinetic invariants. Kinetic invariants emerge when branching reactions with proportional rates cause species concentrations to evolve in lockstep, and can be found across atmospheric chemical mechanisms spanning orders of magnitude in complexity. Identifying kinetic invariants can provide theoretical bounds for exact mechanism reduction and reveal underlying relationships in the atmospheric chemical system.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大气化学反应网络中的守恒律，指出除质量守恒外，耦合动力学可产生涌现的守恒量，称为动力学不变量（kinetic invariants）。这类不变量在支化反应速率成比例时出现，使物种浓度同步演化，并且可在复杂度跨越多个数量级的大气化学机制中找到。作者认为识别动力学不变量可为机制的精确约简提供理论界限，并揭示大气化学系统中的潜在关系。
Motivation: 化学反应体系通常仅以质量守恒作为时间不变约束，但摘要表明更丰富的守恒行为来自耦合动力学，现有认识不足以解释复杂化学机制中隐藏的物种间非平凡关系。
Method: 通过分析大气化学反应网络，识别出不能用质量守恒解释、而源于耦合动力学的涌现守恒量，并将其定义为动力学不变量；这类不变量产生于速率成比例的支化反应，使物种浓度同步演化。
Result: 摘要报告动力学不变量广泛存在于复杂度跨越多个数量级的大气化学机制中，并能为机制的精确约简（exact mechanism reduction）提供理论界限。
Conclusion: 识别动力学不变量有助于揭示大气化学系统内部的潜在关系，并为机制的精确约简提供理论边界。摘要未给出具体数值或实验对比。

papers.title: Large language models reorganize representational geometry during in-context learning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) show remarkable flexibility in adapting to novel tasks without parameter updates, a capacity known as in-context learning (ICL). Prior work has sought to understand ICL by studying the circuits, algorithms, and representations that support it. Yet why some ICL tasks are easy to solve while others are difficult remains unresolved. In this paper, we ask whether LLMs can adapt their representations arbitrarily to solve a simple linear classification task. Specifically, we construct a family of binary classification tasks in which labels are defined by projecting LLMs' own representations onto different axes. Surprisingly, although all tasks are linearly separable by construction, their in-context learnability varies systematically across axes. We find that successful ICL is accompanied by a geometric reorganization of internal representations that increases task-relevant separability. Causal interventions that amplify neural activity along the axis defining the task are insufficient to improve behavioral performance or induce this representational reorganization. We also show that LLM behavior is best described by a prototype-like algorithm operating on representations that are themselves reorganized in context to adapt to the task. Together, these findings offer a geometric account of ICL in LLMs, showing that representations acquired through training constrain what can be exploited through in-context learning.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型（LLM）在上下文学习（ICL）中能否任意调整其内部表示以解决简单的线性分类任务。作者构造了一族二元分类任务，其中标签由 LLM 自身表示在不同轴上的投影定义，发现尽管所有任务按构造都是线性可分的，其上下文可学习性仍随轴的变化而系统性地不同。成功的 ICL 伴随内部表示的几何重组，提升了与任务相关的可分性；对任务轴方向的神经活动进行因果放大既不能改善行为表现，也不能诱导这种表示重组。作者认为 LLM 行为最接近一种基于原型（prototype）的算法，该算法作用于在上下文中为适应任务而被重组的表示。
Motivation: 关于 ICL 的既有工作集中于电路、算法和表示，但为何某些 ICL 任务容易而另一些困难仍未解决。论文通过检验 LLM 是否能在简单线性分类任务上任意调整表示，直接探究表示可塑性与 ICL 难度之间的关系。
Method: 构造一族二元线性分类任务，用 LLM 自身表示在不同轴上的投影定义标签；结合神经活动沿任务轴放大的因果干预，以及原型类算法来刻画行为与表示动态。
Result: 虽然所有任务按构造都是线性可分的，ICL 可学习性却在不同轴上系统性变化；成功 ICL 伴随表示几何重组且任务相关可分性提高，而沿任务轴的因果干预不足以改善行为或诱发该重组。
Conclusion: 训练获得的表示约束了上下文学习能够利用的内容，为 ICL 提供了一种几何层面的解释。

papers.title: CalibAnyView: Beyond Single-View Camera Calibration in the Wild
papers.abstract_en: Camera calibration is fundamental to reliable geometric perception, yet classical approaches rely on dedicated targets, successful reconstruction, or dense view coverage, which casually captured imagery rarely satisfies. Recent learning-based single-image methods lift these requirements by exploiting visual cues, and extend calibration beyond intrinsics to gravity estimation. Yet in the common multi-view case, they predict each view independently and combine the estimates only afterwards, lacking full use of cross-view consistency. We bridge this gap with CalibAnyView, a framework that unifies single- and sparse multi-view calibration by enforcing that consistency inside the network: a transformer with cross-view attention predicts camera-model-agnostic perspective fields, followed by a multi-view optimization that fuses them into shared intrinsics and per-view gravity directions, covering camera models from pinhole to severely distorted lenses. To support this, we construct a large-scale in-the-wild multi-view video dataset spanning diverse camera models, dynamic scenes, realistic motion trajectories, and heterogeneous lens distortions. Extensive experiments show that CalibAnyView outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both sparse multi-view and single-view settings spanning pinhole to distorted optics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CalibAnyView，一个统一单目与稀疏多视角相机标定的框架，通过在网络内部实施跨视角一致性：带 cross-view attention 的 Transformer 预测与相机模型无关的 perspective fields，再用多视角优化将结果融合为共享内参和逐视角重力方向，覆盖从针孔到严重畸变镜头的相机模型。作者还构建了大规模的野外多视角视频数据集，包含多样相机模型、动态场景、真实运动轨迹和异构镜头畸变。实验表明其在稀疏多视角和单视角设置下均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 经典相机标定依赖专用靶标、成功的三维重建或密集视角覆盖，随意的日常拍摄通常不满足这些条件；近期基于学习的单图方法虽缓解了该限制，但在常见的多视角情况下仍逐图独立预测再后期合并，未能充分利用跨视角一致性。
Method: 使用带跨视角注意力 (cross-view attention) 的 Transformer 预测与相机模型无关的透视场 (perspective fields)，随后通过多视角优化将其融合成共享内参与逐视角重力方向，统一处理单目和稀疏多视角标定；同时构建了一个大规模的野外多视角视频数据集以支撑训练与评测。
Result: 大量实验表明，CalibAnyView 在稀疏多视角和单视角两种设置下都优于现有最先进方法，适用范围涵盖针孔到畸变光学模型。
Conclusion: 作者认为在网络内部强制跨视角一致性可以弥合单目与多视角标定的差距，并强调该框架对多种相机模型和现实拍摄条件的覆盖能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multilingual OCR-Aware Fine-Tuning and Prompt-Guided Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Optical character recognition (OCR) and multilingual scene-text understanding remain challenging for multimodal large language models (MLLMs), particularly in real-world images containing small or degraded text, cluttered layouts, occlusion, handwriting, and complex typography. We present an OCR-aware multilingual post-training framework that improves visual-text grounding in a general-purpose MLLM without requiring an external OCR engine, OCR-extracted text, or text bounding boxes at inference time. The framework combines large-scale multilingual OCR supervision, approximately 5M additional multilingual training samples, controlled synthetic OCR generation and in-image text translation, LoRA-based supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and lightweight OCR-oriented Chain-of-Thought prompting. On a held-out real-world multilingual OCR benchmark, OCR-SFT improves OCR completeness from 71.3 to 84.6, reduces hallucination rate from 18.3\% to 5.5\%, and improves translation BLEU-1 from 52.3 to 80.2, with substantial hallucination reductions under blur and rotation. Evaluation on public benchmarks further shows gains on OCR-intensive tasks while largely preserving broader multimodal capabilities; ablations show that SFT provides the primary improvement, with prompting offering smaller complementary gains. These results demonstrate that data-centric OCR-aware post-training provides a practical and scalable approach to improving multilingual visual-text grounding in general-purpose MLLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向多语言场景文本理解的 OCR-aware 多模态大语言模型后训练框架，在不依赖外部 OCR 引擎或推理时文本边界框的情况下提升视觉-文本对齐能力。框架结合约 500 万额外多语言训练样本、受控合成 OCR 生成与图像内文本翻译、LoRA 监督微调 (SFT) 和轻量级 OCR 导向的思维链 (Chain-of-Thought) 提示。在内部多语言 OCR 基准上，OCR 完整性从 71.3 提升到 84.6，幻觉率从 18.3% 降至 5.5%，翻译 BLEU-1 从 52.3 提升到 80.2，并在公开基准上保持大部分通用多模态能力。
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型在真实世界图像中的 OCR 和多语言场景文本理解仍具挑战性，尤其是小字或退化文本、杂乱布局、遮挡、手写和复杂排版等情况，需要一种不依赖外部 OCR 引擎的实用改进方案。
Method: 提出数据驱动的 OCR-aware 多语言后训练框架，包括大规模多语言 OCR 监督数据（约 500 万额外样本）、受控合成 OCR 生成与图内文本翻译、基于 LoRA 的监督微调，以及轻量级 OCR 导向的思维链提示；推理时无需外部 OCR 引擎或文本边界框。
Result: 在留出的真实世界多语言 OCR 基准上，OCR 完整性从 71.3 提升到 84.6，幻觉率从 18.3% 降至 5.5%，翻译 BLEU-1 从 52.3 提升到 80.2，且在模糊和旋转条件下幻觉显著减少；公开基准显示 OCR 密集任务提升，同时大体保留通用多模态能力。
Conclusion: 消融实验表明 SFT 是主要改进来源，提示带来较小的补充增益；作者认为数据中心的 OCR-aware 后训练是提升通用 MLLM 多语言视觉-文本接地能力的实用且可扩展途径。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: TMRL: Diffusion Timestep-Modulated Pretraining Enables Exploration for Efficient Policy Finetuning
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning pre-trained robot policies with reinforcement learning (RL) often inherits the bottlenecks introduced by pre-training with behavioral cloning (BC), which produces narrow action distributions that lack the coverage necessary for downstream exploration. We present a unified framework that enables the exploration necessary to enable efficient robot policy finetuning by bridging BC pre-training and RL fine-tuning. Our pre-training method, Context-Smoothed Pre-training (CSP), injects forward-diffusion noise into policy inputs, creating a continuum between precise imitation and broad action coverage. We then fine-tune pre-trained policies via Timestep-Modulated Reinforcement Learning (TMRL), which trains the agent to dynamically adjust this conditioning during fine-tuning by modulating the diffusion timestep, granting explicit control over exploration. Integrating seamlessly with arbitrary policy inputs, e.g., states, 3D point clouds, or image-based VLA policies, we show that TMRL improves RL fine-tuning sample efficiency. Notably, TMRL enables successful real-world fine-tuning on complex manipulation tasks in under one hour. Videos and code available at https://weirdlabuw.github.io/tmrl/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一框架，将行为克隆（BC）预训练与强化学习（RL）微调衔接起来，以解决预训练策略动作分布过窄、缺乏探索覆盖的问题。预训练方法 Context-Smoothed Pre-training (CSP) 通过向前扩散噪声注入策略输入，在精确模仿与广泛动作覆盖之间建立连续谱；微调方法 Timestep-Modulated Reinforcement Learning (TMRL) 则让智能体在微调中动态调节扩散时间步，从而显式控制探索。实验表明 TMRL 能提升 RL 微调的样本效率，并在一小时内完成真实世界复杂操作任务的微调。
Motivation: 基于行为克隆预训练的机器人策略在用于 RL 微调时，往往继承狭窄的动作分布，缺乏下游探索所需的覆盖，导致微调效率低下。
Method: 提出 CSP 预训练，在策略输入中加入前向扩散噪声以扩展动作覆盖；随后用 TMRL 微调，通过调制扩散时间步让智能体动态调节条件化程度，从而控制探索，且可与状态、3D 点云或图像 VLA 策略等任意策略输入结合。
Result: 摘要报告 TMRL 提高了 RL 微调的样本效率，并能在一小时内实现复杂操作任务的真实世界微调。
Conclusion: 作者认为在 BC 预训练与 RL 微调之间桥接扩散时间步调制，可高效实现真实机器人策略的微调。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hyper-FSAD: Training-Free and Language-Free Few-Shot Anomaly Detection via Sparse Hyper Matching
papers.abstract_en: Few-shot anomaly detection (FSAD) is particularly valuable when only a few normal images are available in a new target domain, while anomalous cases are rare, diverse, and difficult to enumerate in advance. However, existing methods often still require task-specific fitting or language prompts, and their patch-level retrieval commonly relies on brittle nearest-neighbor or fixed Top-$p$ rules. We propose \textbf{Hyper-FSAD}, a training-free and language-free framework that performs support-only inference with a frozen visual encoder. We formulate FSAD as support-only scoring in frozen feature space and establish the selective stability of sparse retrieval and sufficient conditions for normal--anomaly separation. Guided by this analysis, \textbf{Sparse Hyper Matching} uses \textit{sparsemax} to adaptively select support patches for each query patch, exactly suppressing below-threshold distractors without a manually specified retrieval hyperparameter. \textbf{Dual-Branch Image Scoring} further combines local reconstruction discrepancies with support-conditioned global <CLS> deviation. Across four industrial and two medical benchmarks, Hyper-FSAD achieves the best overall performance across the 1/2/4-shot settings, while requiring only 52.6\,ms per image and 0.89\,GB GPU memory. The code will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Hyper-FSAD，一个无需训练、无需语言提示的少样本异常检测框架，使用冻结的视觉编码器进行仅支持集推理。核心是 Sparse Hyper Matching，用 sparsemax 自适应地为每个查询 patch 选择支持 patch，从而精确抑制低于阈值的干扰项，无需手动设定检索超参数；Dual-Branch Image Scoring 则结合局部重建差异与支持条件下的全局 CLS 偏差。在四个工业与两个医学基准上，1/2/4-shot 设置下取得最佳整体性能，且每张图像仅需 52.6 ms、0.89 GB GPU 内存。
Motivation: 现有少样本异常检测方法仍依赖任务特定的拟合或语言提示，且 patch 级检索常使用脆弱的最近邻或固定 Top-p 规则。作者希望构建一个无需训练、无需语言提示的框架，仅用少量正常样本进行推理。
Method: 将 FSAD 建模为冻结特征空间中的仅支持集评分，并从理论上建立稀疏检索的选择稳定性以及正常与异常分离的充分条件。在此分析指导下，Sparse Hyper Matching 使用 sparsemax 自适应选择每个查询 patch 的支持 patch，无需手动指定检索超参数；Dual-Branch Image Scoring 将局部重建差异与支持条件下的全局 <CLS> 偏差相结合。
Result: 在四个工业异常检测和两个医学基准上，Hyper-FSAD 在 1/2/4-shot 设置下取得最佳整体性能，同时推理速度快（52.6 ms/图像）且 GPU 内存占用低（0.89 GB）。
Conclusion: 作者认为，训练无关和语言无关的稀疏超匹配能够在不进行任务特定拟合的情况下取得领先的少样本异常检测性能，并显著降低计算开销；代码将公开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Cavity-Enhanced Collective Quantum Processing with Polarization-Encoded Qubits
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a cavity-enhanced optical architecture for collective quantum processing in which logical qubits are encoded in the polarization subspace of recirculating intracavity modes. The physical carrier and computational degree of freedom are explicitly separated: harmonic cavity bundles provide a stable resonant substrate, while programmable polarization transformations implement single-qubit operations. A polarization-selective nonlinear interaction in the entanglement region generates tunable controlled-phase gates, enabling a universal gate set. A parameter-scaling analysis shows that order-unity conditional phases are attainable in centimeter-scale cavities using experimentally accessible solid-state nonlinear media, without requiring extreme nonlinear coefficients, millisecond photon lifetimes, or sub-hertz laser stabilization. The results indicate that resonant recirculation provides a physically plausible platform for cavity based collective quantum architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于集体量子处理的腔增强光学架构，将逻辑量子比特编码在循环腔内模式的偏振子空间中，并将物理载体与计算自由度显式分离。通过可编程偏振变换实现单比特操作，在纠缠区域利用偏振选择非线性相互作用生成可调受控相位门，从而构成通用门集。参数标度分析表明，在厘米级腔体中借助可实验获得的固态非线性介质即可实现单位量级的条件相位，无需极端非线性系数、毫秒级光子寿命或亚赫兹激光稳频。
Motivation: 现有腔量子电动力学平台往往依赖极端非线性系数或苛刻的稳频条件，难以在合理尺寸腔体中实现集体量子处理所需的强条件相位；本文旨在论证一种在实验可达参数下即可工作的替代架构。
Method: 架构将逻辑量子比特编码在再循环腔内模式的偏振子空间，谐波腔束（harmonic cavity bundles）提供稳定共振基底；可编程偏振变换负责单比特操作，纠缠区域的偏振选择非线性相互作用产生可调受控相位门，从而形成通用门集。
Result: 参数标度分析显示，在厘米尺度腔体中借助可实验获取的固态非线性介质即可获得单位量级的条件相位，不需要极端非线性系数、毫秒级光子寿命或亚赫兹激光稳频。
Conclusion: 作者认为共振再循环为基于腔体的集体量子架构提供了一条物理上可行的平台路径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Omni-Persona: Systematic Benchmarking and Improving Omnimodal Personalization
papers.abstract_en: While multimodal large language models have advanced across text, image, and audio, personalization research has remained primarily vision-language, with unified omnimodal benchmarking that jointly covers text, image, and audio still limited, and lacking the methodological rigor to account for absent-persona scenarios or systematic grounding studies. We introduce Omni-Persona, the first comprehensive benchmark for omnimodal personalization. We formalize the task as cross-modal routing over the Persona Modality Graph, encompassing 4 task groups and 18 fine-grained tasks across ~750 items. To rigorously diagnose grounding behavior, we propose Calibrated Accuracy (Cal), which jointly evaluates correct grounding and appropriate abstention, incorporating absent-persona queries within a unified evaluation framework. On our dedicated experiments, three diagnostic findings emerge: (i) recent open-weight models show a consistent audio-vs-visual grounding gap that RLVR partially narrows via dense rule-based supervision; (ii) recall score and parameter scale are incomplete diagnostics, since strong recall can coexist with absent-persona hallucination and larger models do not always achieve higher Cal, exposing calibration as a separate evaluation axis; and (iii) SFT is limited by the scalability of ground-truth annotation. RLVR improves recall but not calibrated abstention under our reward design, leaving Cal at or below the base model. Omni-Persona thus serves as a diagnostic framework that surfaces the pitfalls of omnimodal personalization, guiding future post-training and reward design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Omni-Persona，号称首个面向全模态个性化（omnimodal personalization）的综合基准，将任务形式化为在 Persona Modality Graph 上的跨模态路由，覆盖 4 个任务组、18 个细粒度任务和约 750 个项目。作者提出校准精度（Calibrated Accuracy, Cal）来同时评估正确的 grounding 与恰当的弃权（abstention），并将 absent-persona 查询纳入统一评价框架。基于该基准的实验得出三点诊断性结论，并表明现有模型在全模态个性化中仍存在系统性缺陷。
Motivation: 现有个性化研究主要集中在视觉-语言领域，缺乏统一覆盖文本、图像和音频的全模态基准，且在 absent-persona 场景与方法论严谨性（如 grounding 的系统研究）上有所欠缺。
Method: 构建 Omni-Persona 基准，将全模态个性化定义为基于 Persona Modality Graph 的跨模态路由；提出 Calibrated Accuracy (Cal)，联合评估正确 grounding 和合理弃权，并纳入 absent-persona 查询。
Result: 实验发现三点：(i) 近期开源模型存在一致的音频-视觉 grounding 差距，RLVR 通过密集规则监督可部分缩小该差距；(ii) recall 分数和参数规模不足以作为完整诊断指标，高 recall 可与 absent-persona 幻觉共存，更大模型也未必获得更高 Cal；(iii) SFT 受限于 ground-truth 标注的可扩展性，而 RLVR 在本文奖励设计下提升 recall 但不提升校准后的弃权，Cal 仍不高于基础模型。
Conclusion: 论文将 Omni-Persona 定位为诊断框架，用于揭示全模态个性化的缺陷，并为未来的后训练与奖励设计提供指引。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Pretraining large language models with MXFP4 on Native FP4 Hardware
papers.abstract_en: Why does full-pipeline FP4 training of large language models often diverge, even when forward activations and activation gradients remain stable? We address this question through a controlled study of MXFP4 quantization in transformer training, progressively enabling FP4 across forward propagation (Fprop), activation gradients (Dgrad), and weight gradients (Wgrad) while holding all other factors fixed. In full pretraining of Llama 3.1-8B on the C4 dataset, we observe that quantizing Wgrad is the primary driver of convergence degradation, whereas FP4 in Fprop and Dgrad alone introduces only modest additional token requirements. To interpret this behavior, we evaluate both structured and stochastic interventions under a controlled experimental setting. We find that stochastic rounding and randomized Hadamard rotations fail to stabilize training once Wgrad is quantized, whereas deterministic Hadamard rotations consistently restore stable optimization. These results suggest that FP4 training instability is driven by structured micro-scaling errors along sensitive gradient paths, rather than by insufficient stochasticity. We run experiments with native MXFP4 support on AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs, enabling controlled investigation of these effects without reliance on software emulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过受控实验研究 MXFP4 全流程 FP4 训练大语言模型时发散的原因，逐步在 Fprop、Dgrad 和 Wgrad 中启用 FP4，并在保持其他因素不变的情况下进行了分析。在 C4 数据集上预训练 Llama 3.1-8B 的实验中，发现 Wgrad 的量化是收敛退化的主要驱动因素，而 FP4 在 Fprop 和 Dgrad 中单独启用仅带来适度的额外 token 需求。实验使用 AMD Instinct MI355X GPU 的原生 MXFP4 支持。
Motivation: 大语言模型的全流程 FP4 训练常常发散，即使前向激活和激活梯度保持稳定；论文旨在厘清这一不稳定性的来源，以指导低精度训练方案的设计。
Method: 采用受控实验设计，在 Transformer 训练中逐步启用 FP4 的 Fprop、Dgrad 和 Wgrad 三类路径，并在混合精度设置下于 Llama 3.1-8B 上完成预训练；同时比较结构化与随机化干预，包括随机舍入 (stochastic rounding)、随机 Hadamard 旋转以及确定性 Hadamard 旋转。
Result: 摘要报告 Wgrad 的量化是最主要的收敛恶化来源；单独的 Fprop 与 Dgrad FP4 只引入较小的额外 token 开销。随机舍入和随机 Hadamard 旋转无法在 Wgrad 量化后稳定训练，而确定性 Hadamard 旋转能够一致地恢复稳定优化。
Conclusion: 作者认为 FP4 训练的不稳定性由沿敏感梯度路径的结构化微缩放误差 (structured micro-scaling errors) 驱动，而非随机性不足所致。

summary_sections.motivation: 大语言模型的全流程 FP4 训练常常发散，即使前向激活和激活梯度保持稳定；论文旨在厘清这一不稳定性的来源，以指导低精度训练方案的设计。
summary_sections.method: 采用受控实验设计，在 Transformer 训练中逐步启用 FP4 的 Fprop、Dgrad 和 Wgrad 三类路径，并在混合精度设置下于 Llama 3.1-8B 上完成预训练；同时比较结构化与随机化干预，包括随机舍入 (stochastic rounding)、随机 Hadamard 旋转以及确定性 Hadamard 旋转。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 Wgrad 的量化是最主要的收敛恶化来源；单独的 Fprop 与 Dgrad FP4 只引入较小的额外 token 开销。随机舍入和随机 Hadamard 旋转无法在 Wgrad 量化后稳定训练，而确定性 Hadamard 旋转能够一致地恢复稳定优化。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为 FP4 训练的不稳定性由沿敏感梯度路径的结构化微缩放误差 (structured micro-scaling errors) 驱动，而非随机性不足所致。

papers.title: simpleposter: A simple baseline for product poster generation
papers.abstract_en: Product poster generation poses distinct challenges beyond general poster design, requiring both faithful preservation of product appearance and precise control over dense, multi-line text layouts. Prior methods typically adopt inpainting frameworks augmented with auxiliary modules such as ControlNet and OCR encoders. However, these approaches introduce architectural complexity and computational overhead while still suffering from text errors and subject extension artifacts. We present SimplePoster, a simple yet effective inpainting-based framework that achieves faithful subject preservation and accurate, position-controllable text rendering without external controllers. Our approach builds on two observations: (1) full-parameter fine-tuning of the base model effectively suppresses subject extension, outperforming ControlNet-based alternatives; and (2) a zero-cost character-level position encoding enables geometry-aware text generation without dedicated layout modules. Experiments show that SimplePoster achieves a $98.7\%$ subject preservation rate, compared to $55.2\%$ for SeedEdit 3.0 and $85.3\%$ for PosterMaker, while also improving text rendering accuracy. Code, models, benchmark and a part of training data will be available at https://github.com/Alibaba-YuFeng/SIMPLEPOSTER
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SimplePoster，一个基于 inpainting 的简洁框架，用于产品海报生成。作者发现全参数微调基座模型能有效抑制主体延伸（subject extension），优于依赖 ControlNet 的方案；同时提出零成本字符级位置编码实现几何感知的文本渲染，无需专用布局模块。实验显示该方法在主体保真率上达到 98.7%，并提升了文本渲染准确率。
Motivation: 现有产品海报生成方法通常采用 inpainting 框架并附加 ControlNet、OCR 编码器等辅助模块，带来架构复杂度和计算开销，且仍存在文本错误与主体延伸伪影问题。
Method: 采用 inpainting 框架，对基座模型进行全参数微调以抑制主体延伸；并提出零成本字符级位置编码（zero-cost character-level position encoding），实现位置可控、几何感知的文本生成，无需外部控制器或专用布局模块。
Result: 摘要报告 SimplePoster 的主体保真率为 98.7%，对比 SeedEdit 3.0 的 55.2% 和 PosterMaker 的 85.3%，同时文本渲染准确率也有提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为全参数微调与零成本字符级位置编码即可在无需外部控制器的条件下实现忠实主体保持和准确的位置可控文本渲染，并计划开源代码、模型、基准和部分训练数据。

papers.title: Tools as Continuous Flow for Evolving Agentic Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in orchestrating tools for reasoning tasks. However, existing methods rely on a step-wise paradigm that lacks a global perspective, which causes error accumulation over long horizons and restricts generalization to unseen tools. To overcome these limitations, we propose Tools as Continuous Flow for Evolving Agentic Reasoning (FlowAgent), which reconceptualizes tool chaining as continuous trajectory generation within a semantic space. To systematically evaluate this paradigm, we introduce the first plan-level closed-loop benchmark dedicated to plan-level agentic reasoning in dynamic real-world environments. Specifically, the proposed FlowAgent leverages conditional flow matching to generate continuous latent trajectories, providing a global planning perspective to ensure coherent and robust tool execution. Theoretically, we establish formal bounds on utility convergence and prove that our continuous formulation fundamentally guarantees robust generalization and error attenuation. Empirical evaluations show that FlowAgent achieves superior robustness and adaptability in long-horizon reasoning tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FlowAgent，将 LLM 的工具链式调用重新建模为语义空间中的连续轨迹生成，以克服逐步范式（step-wise paradigm）缺乏全局视角、长程误差累积以及对未见工具泛化受限的问题。作者还引入首个面向动态真实环境的 plan-level 闭环基准，并从理论上给出效用收敛界与鲁棒泛化/误差衰减保证。实验表明该方法在长程推理任务上具备更好的鲁棒性和适应性。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 工具编排方法依赖逐步推理，缺少全局视角，导致长程任务中误差累积，并限制对未见工具的泛化能力。
Method: 提出 Tools as Continuous Flow for Evolving Agentic Reasoning (FlowAgent)，利用条件流匹配（conditional flow matching）在潜在空间中生成连续的轨迹，从而以全局规划视角协调工具执行；同时构建首个 plan-level 闭环基准用于动态真实环境下的评估。
Result: 摘要报告 FlowAgent 在长程推理任务上取得更优的鲁棒性与适应性，并给出理论上的效用收敛界以及连续形式对鲁棒泛化和误差衰减的保证。
Conclusion: 作者主张将工具链视为连续流能够从根本上改善 agentic reasoning 的鲁棒泛化与误差衰减，该范式通过全局规划视角降低长程推理中的错误累积。

papers.title: Text Corpora as Concept Fields: Black-Box Hallucination and Novelty Measurement
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the \textbf{Concept Field} of a text corpus: a local drift field with pointwise uncertainty, estimated in sentence-embedding space from the deltas between consecutive sentences. Given a candidate sentence transition, we score its agreement with the field by $ζ$, the mean absolute z-distance between the observed delta and the field's local Gaussian estimate. The score is black-box (no model internals), corpus-attributable (every score traces to nearby corpus sentences), and admits a probabilistically motivated interpretation under a local Gaussian approximation. We support the computation with the introduction of a \textbf{Vector Sequence Database (VSDB)} that stores embeddings together with sequence-position and next-delta metadata. We evaluate this approach on two large-scale settings: hallucination-style groundedness detection over the U.S. Code of Federal Regulations, and novelty detection over Project Gutenberg, where we show Concept Fields achieve strong selective classification performance under a grounded / ungrounded / unsure triage policy. Unlike retrieval-centric baselines, the resulting coverage-risk behavior is similar across both domains, supporting a degree of cross-domain stability for the standardized deviation score. We also sketch how divergence and curl of the Concept Field, computed on dense clusters, surface qualitatively meaningful semantic patterns (logic sources, sinks, and implicit topics), which we offer as hypothesis-generating rather than as a quantitative result. Concept Fields provide a fast, lightweight, and interpretable signal for groundedness and novelty, complementary to LLM-as-judge and white-box detectors.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 10 figures, 17 tables; additional analysis in appendix added
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出文本语料库的 Concept Field 概念：在句子嵌入空间中，用相邻句子的增量（delta）估计一个带逐点不确定性的局部漂移场，并以候选句子转换与该场局部高斯估计的平均绝对 z 距离 ζ 作为打分。该打分是黑盒的、可追溯到语料库句子的，并支持基于局部高斯近似的概率解释；同时引入 Vector Sequence Database (VSDB) 存储嵌入、序列位置和下一增量元数据来支撑计算。作者在联邦法规（U.S. Code of Federal Regulations）的幻觉式 groundedness 检测和 Project Gutenberg 的新颖性检测两个大规模设置上评估，显示在 grounded/ungrounded/unsure 分诊策略下具有较强选择性分类性能，且不同于检索类基线，两个领域的 coverage-risk 行为相似，显示标准化偏差分数有一定跨域稳定性。
Motivation: 现有幻觉与新异性检测常依赖模型内部信息（white-box）或 LLM-as-judge，作者希望提供一个快速、轻量、可解释且黑盒的文本信号，用于判断句子转换是否 grounded 或新颖，并希望该信号可归因到具体语料句子。
Method: 提出 Concept Field，即从语料库句子嵌入的相邻句 delta 估计的局部漂移场，并用 ζ（候选 delta 与局部高斯估计的平均绝对 z 距离）评分；计算由 Vector Sequence Database (VSDB) 支撑，后者存储嵌入、序列位置和 next-delta 元数据。
Result: 在 U.S. Code of Federal Regulations 的 hallucination 式 groundedness 检测和 Project Gutenberg 的新颖性检测两个大规模设置中，Concept Fields 在 grounded/ungrounded/unsure 三分类策略下取得较强的选择性分类性能；与检索类基线相比，两个领域的 coverage-risk 行为相似。作者还示意性地展示了密集簇上 Concept Field 的散度和旋度能浮现质性的语义模式，但将其定位为假设生成而非定量结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为 Concept Fields 提供了一种快速、轻量、可解释的 groundedness 和新颖性信号，与 LLM-as-judge 和 white-box 检测器互补；跨域相似性支持标准化偏差分数的一定稳定性，而有关散度/旋度的语义分析仍是假设生成性质。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CAR: Query-Guided Confidence-Aware Reranking for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) relies on evidence ranking to determine what information is exposed to the generator, yet existing retrieval and reranking methods primarily estimate query--document relevance. Relevance, however, is not equivalent to generator-side usefulness: a relevant passage may introduce ambiguity or distraction, whereas a lower-ranked passage may stabilize the generator's answer. We present CAR (Confidence-Aware Reranking), a training-free rank-correction framework that uses query-only answer stability as a control and measures each candidate by the change it induces in sampled-answer semantic stability. This controlled contrast estimates a document's marginal contribution to generator behavior without treating semantic stability as relevance or calibrated correctness. CAR converts these confidence changes into coarse precedence constraints and returns the feasible ranking with minimum Kendall distance from the baseline, preserving existing pairwise preferences unless generator-side evidence supports reversing them. Experiments on NQ, HotpotQA and FEVER across sparse and dense retrievers, seven ranking methods and three generator families show robust improvements. In the BM25-centered main analysis, CAR achieves a \textbf{+5.53\% mean relative NDCG@5 gain}; on the fixed NQ-answerable downstream evaluation, it improves token-level F1 by \textbf{+0.43 points}, with ranking and generation gains strongly aligned across rankers ($ρ= 0.93$). These results position CAR as a deployment-friendly, generator-aware correction layer that complements relevance while preserving informative prior rankings. CAR requires neither task-specific training nor access to model internals such as logits or hidden states, making it applicable to black-box LLMs through generated outputs alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CAR（Confidence-Aware Reranking），一种无需训练的生成器感知排序校正框架。现有检索与重排主要估计查询-文档相关性，但相关性并不等同于生成器侧的有用性；CAR 以仅查询答案稳定性为对照，度量每个候选文档对采样答案语义稳定性的边际影响，并将置信度变化转化为优先级约束，返回与基线 Kendall 距离最小的可行排名。实验在 NQ、HotpotQA 和 FEVER 上、跨稀疏/密集检索器、七种排序方法与三种生成器家族进行，BM25 主分析中 NDCG@5 平均相对提升 +5.53%，NQ-answerable 下 token 级 F1 提升 +0.43 点。
Motivation: 现有检索和重排方法主要估计查询-文档相关性，但相关段落可能引入歧义或干扰，而排名较低的段落有时反而能稳定生成器答案，因此相关性不等价于生成器侧的有用性，需要显式地对生成器行为进行建模来校正排名。
Method: CAR 是无训练 (training-free) 的排名校正框架：用 query-only 答案稳定性作为控制，衡量每个候选文档对采样答案语义稳定性 (semantic stability) 的诱导变化，以此估计文档对生成器行为的边际贡献；再把置信度变化转化为粗略的优先级约束，求解与基线排名 Kendall 距离最小的可行排名，仅在生成器侧证据支持时才反转原有配对偏好。该方法无需访问模型 logits 或 hidden states，仅依赖生成输出即可用于黑盒 LLM。
Result: 在 NQ、HotpotQA 和 FEVER 上，横跨稀疏/密集检索器、七种排序方法和三种生成器家族，CAR 在 BM25 主分析中实现平均相对 NDCG@5 提升 +5.53%；在固定的 NQ-answerable 下游评估中，token 级 F1 提升 +0.43 点，且排名与生成增益强对齐（ρ=0.93）。
Conclusion: CAR 作为部署友好的生成器感知校正层，在保留信息性先验排名的同时补充相关性信号，既不需要任务特定训练，也不需要模型内部访问，能够仅凭生成输出应用于黑盒 LLM。

summary_sections.conclusion: CAR 作为部署友好的生成器感知校正层，在保留信息性先验排名的同时补充相关性信号，既不需要任务特定训练，也不需要模型内部访问，能够仅凭生成输出应用于黑盒 LLM。

papers.title: Analytic Bridge Diffusions for Controlled Path Generation
papers.abstract_en: Most modern bridge-diffusion methods achieve finite-time transport by specifying an interpolation, Schrodinger-bridge, or stochastic-control objective and then learning the associated score or drift field with a neural network. In contrast, we identify a restricted but sufficiently broad analytically solvable class in which, for a deterministic source and a Gaussian-mixture target, the score and all intermediate marginals are explicit and protocol objectives of the type used in this paper can be differentiated without inner stochastic simulation loops. We recast the classical linear--quadratic--Gaussian stochastic-control structure as a transport problem of the Path Integral Diffusion type. Linear dynamics, Gaussian noise, and quadratic running costs reduce the bridge calculation to a matrix Riccati cascade, while the terminal state cost is replaced by a prescribed Gaussian-Mixture terminal probability density. Linear Quadratic -- Gaussian Mixture -- Path Integral Diffusion (LQ-GM-PID) thereby turns bridge diffusion from terminal target matching alone into an analytically controlled laboratory for path shaping. We demonstrate this on a 2D corridor task, a 2D multi-entrance task, and a high-dimensional study reaching d=32 and M=16 terminal modes in separate scaling sweeps. We position LQ-GM-PID as an analytically solvable reference model in which score approximations, path-shaping objectives, and protocol-learning procedures can be tested against explicit quantities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在桥扩散 (bridge diffusion) 问题中识别出一类解析可解但足够广泛的设定：确定性初始分布到高斯混合 (Gaussian-mixture) 目标分布，其 score 函数与所有中间边际分布均为显式，且协议目标可在无内层随机模拟循环的情况下求导。作者将经典线性二次高斯 (LQG) 随机控制重新表述为路径积分扩散 (Path Integral Diffusion) 类型的输运问题，提出 LQ-GM-PID 框架，并用于路径塑形 (path shaping) 的可控实验室场景。
Motivation: 现有桥扩散方法大多靠神经网络学习 score 或 drift 场，缺乏一个解析可解的参考模型来检验 score 近似、路径塑形目标与协议学习流程。
Method: 将线性动力学、高斯噪声与二次运行代价的桥计算化为矩阵 Riccati 级联 (matrix Riccati cascade)，并用指定的高斯混合终态概率密度替代终端状态代价，从而构成 LQ-GM-PID 方法。
Result: 在 2D 走廊任务、2D 多入口任务以及 d=32、M=16 个终端模式的高维分离缩放扫描中展示了方法的有效性。
Conclusion: 论文将 LQ-GM-PID 定位为解析可解的参考模型，可用于对照显式量测试 score 近似、路径塑形目标与协议学习方法。

papers.title: Enhancing Linux Privilege Escalation Attack Capabilities of Local LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Cloud-based Large Language Models (LLMs) can perform autonomous penetration-testing sub-tasks such as Linux privilege escalation, but raise security, privacy, and sovereignty concerns. Locally hosted open-weight models avoid these issues, yet prior work reports that small open-weight models succeed on only 8-16% of standardized privilege-escalation tasks, far below frontier cloud models. This paper is an empirical study of why small models fail at this task and which engineering techniques close the gap. From execution traces we distill six recurring failure modes, map each to an established enhancement technique, and evaluate five (chain-of-thought prompting, retrieval-augmented generation, structured prompting, history compression, and reflective analysis) as reproducible extensions to the open-source hackingBuddyGPT framework. Under a single shared harness and matched conditions, the set of techniques we evaluate raise two SLMs (Llama3.1 8B, Qwen2.5 7B) from 8% to 67% with guidance, matching guided GPT-4o. A larger open-weight reference model (Llama3.1 70B) reaches 83%. A full-factorial ablation shows that reflection-based techniques contribute most and reveals vulnerability discovery, not exploitation, as the main constraint for local models. We report these as transferable lessons for building reliable local offensive agents as well as to inform defenders.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对本地开源小模型在 Linux 权限提升 (privilege escalation) 任务上成功率远低于云端前沿模型的现象，开展实证研究。作者从执行轨迹中提炼出六类重复出现的失败模式，将其映射到既有的增强技术，并在 hackingBuddyGPT 框架上以统一测试基准评估五种技术。摘要报告称，这些技术使 Llama3.1 8B 和 Qwen2.5 7B 两个小模型（SLM）在引导（guidance）下的成功率从 8% 提升到 67%，与引导的 GPT-4o 相当；更大的 Llama3.1 70B 达到 83%。全因子消融显示反思类（reflection-based）技术贡献最大，并指出漏洞发现而非利用是本地模型的主要瓶颈。
Motivation: 云端 LLM 能执行自主渗透测试子任务，但带来安全、隐私和数据主权问题；本地开源权重模型可规避这些问题，但已有工作显示小模型在标准化权限提升任务上仅能成功 8-16%，远低于前沿云端模型。论文因此关注小模型为何失败以及哪些工程手段能缩小差距。
Method: 采用实证研究方法：从执行轨迹中归纳六种重复出现的失败模式，将每种模式对应到一种已确立的增强技术，并选择五种（chain-of-thought prompting、retrieval-augmented generation、structured prompting、history compression、reflective analysis）作为 hackingBuddyGPT 框架的可复现扩展进行评估。所有技术在同一共享测试环境和匹配条件下测试。
Result: 在统一测试条件下，所评估的技术集使 Llama3.1 8B 和 Qwen2.5 7B 从 8% 提升到 67%（带引导），与引导的 GPT-4o 持平；Llama3.1 70B 达到 83%。全因子消融表明反思类技术贡献最大，并揭示本地模型的主要约束是漏洞发现而非漏洞利用。
Conclusion: 作者将这些结果作为构建可靠本地攻击型智能体的可迁移经验，并用于辅助防御方；摘要未具体讨论该方法的适用范围或局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Flow-by-Flow:Content-Judgment Bypass for Governing AI Output in High-Loss Domains
papers.abstract_en: Prior work showed that human-in-the-loop oversight becomes structurally untenable in high-loss domains once AI output velocity V exceeds human cognitive capacity C_max. The operative constraint, however, is V x L, where L is per-item cognitive load: triage, judgment, and response. These components respond asymmetrically to capability improvement. Triage cost does not decline, because semantic indeterminacy is inherent in general-purpose design. Response cost is invariant to accuracy. Only judgment cost faces downward pressure, largely by inducing omission. Capability improvement therefore restructures L rather than reducing it. We prove a proposition: if V x L grows at any positive compound rate while supervisory capacity grows linearly, exceedance occurs in finite time; capacity investment buys time only logarithmically, while reducing the growth rate extends it hyperbolically. Supervision enhancement and flow control are therefore not remedies of the same kind. We propose Flow-by-Flow, a governance design that prices supervisory load without evaluating content, intent, or legitimacy. A cognitive cost score built from formal, countable features imposes compounding costs on volume expansion, and an institutional capacity cap fixes processing within C_max. Four design invariants characterize any admissible exceedance pathway: no content judgment, no scalable consumption of examiner capacity, identity-bound per-application friction, and no batch clearance. Excess claim and page fees in patent systems are precursors satisfying only the first two invariants. One reference implementation satisfying all four is presented. A Monte Carlo analysis across 1,000 parameter draws confirms that the analytically derived ordering survives the 30-year horizon in 90.8% of trials.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文讨论高损失领域中人类参与式AI监督在结构上难以持续的问题，指出实际约束是输出速度V与逐项认知负载L的乘积V×L，而非单纯的V。作者证明当V×L以正复合率增长而监督能力仅线性增长时，超限必然在有限时间内发生；并提出Flow-by-Flow治理设计，通过基于形式化可数特征的认知成本评分来定价监督负载，而不评估内容、意图或合法性。Monte Carlo分析（1000次参数抽样）显示该解析排序在30年视野内于90.8%的试验中成立。
Motivation: 在高损失领域，一旦AI输出速度超过人类认知容量，人工监督在结构上变得不可行；且分类、判断、响应三类认知负载对能力提升的响应不对称——分类成本不下降，响应成本与准确性无关，只有判断成本趋于下降但主要靠省略实现，因此需要不依赖内容判断的治理机制。
Method: 提出Flow-by-Flow治理设计：用由形式化、可数特征构建的认知成本评分对体积扩展施加复利成本，并设置机构容量上限以将处理限制在C_max之内；定义四个设计不变量（无内容判断、不可扩展消耗审查者容量、身份绑定的逐应用摩擦、无批量清关），并给出满足全部四个的参考实现。
Result: 证明若V×L以任何正复合率增长而监督容量线性增长，超限在有限时间内发生；容量投资只能对数性地争取时间，而降低增长率则双曲线性地延长时间。Monte Carlo分析（1000次参数抽样）确认解析得出的排序在30年视野内于90.8%的试验中成立。
Conclusion: 摘要强调监督增强与流量控制不属于同类补救措施；Flow-by-Flow通过完全绕开内容判断来治理高损失领域的AI输出。专利系统中的超额请求费和页费被视为制度前兆，但只满足四个不变量中的前两个。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Spend Less, Fit Better: Budget-Efficient Scaling Law Fitting via Active Experiment Selection
papers.abstract_en: Scaling laws are used to plan multi-million-dollar training runs, but fitting those laws can itself cost millions. In modern large-scale workflows, assembling a sufficiently informative set of pilot experiments is already a major budget-allocation problem rather than a routine preprocessing step. We formulate scaling-law fitting as budget-aware sequential experimental design: given a finite pool of runnable experiments with heterogeneous costs, choose which runs to execute so as to maximize extrapolation accuracy in a high-cost target region. We propose $\mathrm{SL}^2$ (Scaling Laws, Spend Less), an uncertainty-aware method for sequentially allocating experimental budget toward the runs most useful for target-region extrapolation. Across a diverse benchmark of scaling-law tasks, $\mathrm{SL}^2$ outperforms classical design-based baselines, and often approaches the performance of fitting on the full experimental set while using only about 10\% of the total training budget. Our code is available at https://github.com/PlanarG/active-sl.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SL^2（Scaling Laws, Spend Less），将 scaling-law 拟合建模为预算感知的序列实验设计问题：给定一个成本异构的有限实验池，主动选择要运行的实验，以最大化高成本目标区域的外推精度。摘要报告该方法在多样化的 scaling-law 任务基准上优于经典设计基线，并且通常仅使用约 10% 的训练预算即可接近用完整实验集拟合的性能。代码已开源。
Motivation: 拟合 scaling law 本身可能耗资巨大，现代大规模工作流中组装信息充分的试点实验已成为预算分配问题，而非常规预处理步骤。
Method: 提出 SL^2，一种不确定性感知的序列实验分配方法，在给定有限实验池和异构成本的情况下，依次选择对目标区域外推最有用的实验运行。
Result: 在多个 scaling-law 任务组成的基准上，SL^2 优于经典基于实验设计的基线，且经常能仅用约 10% 的总训练预算就接近使用全部实验集拟合的性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调预算高效的主动实验选择可以大幅降低 scaling-law 拟合的成本，并提供了开源代码。

papers.title: Making Gaussian Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks Reliable and Accurate
papers.abstract_en: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) replace fixed activations with learnable univariate edge functions whose behavior depends strongly on the chosen basis. Gaussian radial basis functions provide a simple and efficient alternative to splines, but their accuracy and stability are highly sensitive to the scale parameter \(ε\), which has not been studied systematically. We analyze this dependence through the geometry and conditioning of the first-layer feature matrix. Because the first layer is defined directly on the input domain, any loss of feature distinguishability introduced there propagates through the entire network. Based on this analysis, we identify the practical operating interval \[ ε\in \left[\frac{1}{G-1},\frac{2}{G-1}\right], \] where \(G\) is the number of Gaussian centers. This interval is proposed as a stable design rule rather than a universal optimum. Extensive experiments on function approximation and physics-informed problems confirm its reliability across different collocation densities, grid resolutions, architectures, and input dimensions. We also show how the same principle supports fixed-scale selection, variable-scale models, constrained optimization of \(ε\), and efficient scale search using early-stage training error. These results establish scale selection as a central design principle for reliable and accurate Gaussian KANs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究高斯径向基函数作为 KAN（Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks）激活基时尺度参数 ε 对精度和稳定性的影响。作者通过第一层特征矩阵的几何与条件数分析，提出实用工作区间 ε ∈ [1/(G-1), 2/(G-1)]（G 为高斯中心数），并作为稳定设计规则而非普适最优。大量函数逼近和物理信息问题（physics-informed）实验验证了该区间在不同配点密度、网格分辨率、架构和输入维度下的可靠性，并展示了其在固定/变尺度选择、ε 约束优化和高效尺度搜索中的应用。
Motivation: 高斯径向基函数是 KAN 中样条基的简单高效替代，但精度和稳定性对尺度参数 ε 高度敏感，而 ε 尚未被系统研究。由于第一层直接定义在输入域上，该层特征可区分性（feature distinguishability）的损失会传播到整个网络，因此需要系统分析其影响。
Method: 通过第一层特征矩阵的几何与条件数（conditioning）分析来刻画 ε 的影响，据此提出稳定工作区间 ε ∈ [1/(G-1), 2/(G-1)]。同一原则还被扩展用于固定尺度选择、变尺度模型、对 ε 的约束优化，以及利用早期训练误差进行高效尺度搜索。
Result: 在函数逼近和物理信息问题上的大量实验表明，所提出的 ε 区间在不同配点密度、网格分辨率、架构和输入维度下均保持可靠；摘要未报告具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 摘要将尺度选择确立为可靠且准确的 Gaussian KAN 的核心设计原则，并强调提出的区间是稳定设计规则而非普适最优。

papers.title: Towards Human Motion World Models via Executable Behaviour Representations
papers.abstract_en: Human motion world models should capture motion's intentionality by being executable: adaptable to different actions and capable of assessing motion quality. To achieve this, we introduce a domain-specific language ExAct that represents human motions as underspecified programs that can be compiled to a reward model for zero-shot policy inference. By leveraging the compositional nature of ExAct programs, we combine individual policies into executable behaviour representations. We evaluate the utility of the proposed approach by analysing human motion capture for the tasks of human action segmentation and human action anomaly detection. Our results suggest that the improvement in data efficiency and the capture of intuitive relationships between human actions are better than those of task-specific models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出领域特定语言 ExAct，将人体运动表示为可编译成奖励模型 (reward model) 的未完全指定程序 (underspecified programs)，用于零样本策略推理 (zero-shot policy inference)。利用 ExAct 程序的组合性，作者把单个策略整合为可执行行为表示 (executable behaviour representations)，并在人体动作分割与动作异常检测任务上评估。摘要称该方法在数据效率和对人类动作间直觉关系的捕捉上优于任务特定模型。
Motivation: 人体运动世界模型应通过可执行性来捕捉运动的意向性，即既能适配不同动作，又能评估运动质量；现有模型缺乏这种可执行且可组合的表示。
Method: 引入领域特定语言 ExAct，将人体运动表示为未完全指定程序并编译为奖励模型；利用程序的组合性，将个体策略组合成可执行行为表示，从而支持零样本策略推断。
Result: 在人体动作分割 (human action segmentation) 和人体动作异常检测 (human action anomaly detection) 两项任务上评估，摘要报告数据效率提升以及对动作间直观关系的捕捉优于任务特定模型。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 ExAct 可执行行为表示能提升数据效率并捕捉动作间关系，但效果证据主要来自动作捕捉数据上的两个下游任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Credo: Declarative Control of LLM Pipelines via Beliefs and Policies
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI systems are becoming commonplace in domains that require long-lived, stateful decision-making in continuously evolving conditions. As such, correctness depends not only on the output of individual model calls, but also on how to best adapt when incorporating new evidence or revising prior conclusions. However, existing frameworks rely on imperative control loops, ephemeral memory, and prompt-embedded logic, making agent behavior opaque, brittle, and difficult to verify. This paper introduces Credo, which represents semantic state as beliefs and regulates behavior using declarative policies defined over these beliefs. This design supports adaptive, auditable, and composable execution through a database-backed semantic control plane. We showcase these concepts in a decision-control scenario, where beliefs and policies declaratively guide critical execution choices (e.g., model selection, retrieval, corrective re-execution), enabling dynamic behavior without requiring any changes to the underlying pipeline code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Credo，一个用信念(beliefs)和策略(policies)以声明式方式控制 LLM 管线的系统。它将语义状态表示为信念，并在此基础上定义声明式策略，通过数据库支撑的语义控制平面来实现自适应、可审计、可组合的执行。论文在决策控制场景中展示了模型选择、检索、纠正性重执行等关键环节可由信念和策略动态引导，而无需修改底层管线代码。
Motivation: 现有 agentic AI 框架依赖命令式控制循环、临时记忆和嵌入在 prompt 中的逻辑，导致行为不透明、脆弱且难以验证；在需要长期有状态决策的连续演化环境中，正确性不仅取决于单次模型输出，还取决于如何纳入新证据或修订旧结论。
Method: Credo 将语义状态建模为信念(beliefs)，并允许用户用声明式策略(policies)定义这些信念之上的行为；通过数据库支撑的语义控制平面(semantic control plane)实现自适应、可审计、可组合的执行。
Result: 摘要只报告了概念演示：在一个决策控制场景中，信念和策略能够声明式地引导模型选择、检索和纠正性重执行等关键执行选择，从而在不改动底层管线代码的情况下实现动态行为；未给出量化实验结果。
Conclusion: 作者主张这种信念加策略的设计比命令式控制更透明、更稳健、更易验证，并强调其适用场景是长生命周期、状态持续演化的 agentic AI 决策系统；作为 VLDB demo 论文，贡献主要是系统架构与场景演示。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TEMPER: Testing Emotional Perturbation in Quantitative Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are trained and evaluated on quantitative reasoning tasks written in clean, emotionally neutral language. However, real-world queries are often wrapped in frustration, urgency or enthusiasm. Does emotional framing alone degrade reasoning when all numerical content is preserved? To investigate this, a controlled emotion translation framework is developed that rewrites problems into emotional variants while preserving all quantities and relationships. Using this framework, Temper-5400 (5,400 semantically verified emotion-neutral pairs) is constructed across GSM8K, MultiArith, and ARC-Challenge, and evaluated on eighteen models (1B to frontier scale). Two core results emerge: First, emotional framing reduces accuracy by 2-10 percentage points even though all numerical content is preserved. Second, neutralizing emotional variants recovers most of the lost performance, showing both that the degradation is tied to emotional style rather than content corruption and that neutralization can serve as a lightweight inference-time mitigation. Non-emotional paraphrases cause no such degradation, implicating emotional content rather than surface-level changes. Beyond emotion specifically, the benchmark construction procedure offers a controllable instrument for stylistic translation and robustness evaluation.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026. 30 pages, 4 figures, 29 tables. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/atahandokme/temper-5400 Code: https://github.com/atahandokme/temper-colm2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种受控情感翻译框架，在保留全部数值内容的前提下将数学推理题改写为带情感色彩的变体，并据此构建 Temper-5400 数据集（5,400 对语义验证的情感中立配对），覆盖 GSM8K、MultiArith 与 ARC-Challenge。作者在十八个模型（1B 到前沿规模）上评测发现：情感化表述会使准确率下降 2–10 个百分点，而将情感变体中立化可恢复大部分性能损失；非情感性改写则不会造成类似下降。
Motivation: 大语言模型的定量推理训练与评测通常使用干净、情感中性的语言，但真实世界查询常伴随沮丧、紧迫或兴奋等情绪。本文要回答的问题是：在数值内容完全不变时，仅情感化框架本身是否会损害推理表现。
Method: 开发一个受控情感翻译框架，将数学问题改写成情感变体并保持所有数量和关系不变；利用该框架构建 Temper-5400 数据集，并在 GSM8K、MultiArith 和 ARC-Challenge 上对十八个模型进行系统评测。
Result: 情感化框架在数值内容保持不变的情况下使准确率下降 2–10 个百分点；对情感变体进行情感中和可恢复大部分损失性能，且非情感性改写不产生此类退化，说明退化源于情感内容而非表层措辞变化。
Conclusion: 退化与情感风格相关而非内容损坏，情感中和可作为轻量的推理时缓解手段；该基准构建流程还可作为可控的风格转换与鲁棒性评估工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ReCodeAgent: A Multi-agent Workflow for Language-Agnostic Translation and Validation of Large-Scale Repositories
papers.abstract_en: Most repository-level code translation and validation techniques have been evaluated on a single source-target programming language (PL) pair, owing to the complex engineering effort required to adapt new PL pairs. Programming agents can enable PL-agnosticism in repository-level code translation and validation: they can synthesize code across many PLs and autonomously use existing tools specific to each PL's analysis. However, state-of-the-art has yet to offer a fully autonomous agentic approach for repository-level code translation and validation of large-scale programs. This paper proposes ReCodeAgent, an autonomous multi-agent approach for language-agnostic repository-level code translation and validation. Users only need to provide the project in the source PL and specify the target PL for ReCodeAgent to automatically translate and validate the entire repository. ReCodeAgent is the first technique to achieve high translation success rates across many PLs. We compare the effectiveness of ReCodeAgent with four alternative neuro-symbolic and agentic approaches to translate 118 real-world projects, with 1,975 LoC and 43 translation units for each project, on average. The projects cover 6 PLs and 4 PL pairs. Our results demonstrate that ReCodeAgent consistently outperforms prior techniques on translation correctness, improving test pass rate by 60.8% on ground-truth tests, with an average cost of $15.3. We also perform process-centric analysis of ReCodeAgent trajectories to confirm its procedural efficiency. Finally, we investigate how the design choices (a multi-agent vs. single-agent architecture) influence ReCodeAgent performance: on average, the test pass rate drops by 40.4%, and trajectories become 28% longer and persistently inefficient.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReCodeAgent，一个面向仓库级代码翻译与验证的自主多智能体方法，用户只需提供源语言项目并指定目标语言，即可自动完成整个仓库的翻译和验证。作者称其为首个在多种编程语言上实现高翻译成功率的技术，并在 118 个真实项目、6 种 PL、4 种 PL 对上与四种神经符号/智能体基线对比，ground-truth 测试通过率提升 60.8%，平均成本 15.3 美元。过程分析表明多智能体架构显著优于单智能体架构。
Motivation: 现有仓库级代码翻译与验证技术大多只在单一源-目标语言对上评估，适配新语言对需要大量工程工作。编程智能体有望实现语言无关性，但尚无完全自主的智能体方法用于大规模仓库级翻译与验证。
Method: 提出 ReCodeAgent，一种自主多智能体工作流，输入为源语言项目与目标语言，输出为整个仓库的翻译与验证结果。系统利用各编程语言现有的分析工具，以多智能体协作方式完成翻译和验证过程。
Result: 在平均 1,975 LoC、43 个翻译单元的 118 个真实项目上、覆盖 6 种 PL 与 4 种 PL 对，ReCodeAgent 在翻译正确性上一致优于四种替代的神经符号和智能体方法，ground-truth 测试通过率提升 60.8%，平均成本为 15.3 美元。消融显示，改用单智能体架构后测试通过率平均下降 40.4%，轨迹变长 28% 且持续低效。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 ReCodeAgent 是首个能够跨多种编程语言实现高翻译成功率的完全自主方法，并指出多智能体架构相比单智能体架构对翻译效果和过程效率至关重要。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调 ReCodeAgent 是首个能够跨多种编程语言实现高翻译成功率的完全自主方法，并指出多智能体架构相比单智能体架构对翻译效果和过程效率至关重要。

papers.title: Weaves, Wires, and Morphisms: Formalizing and Implementing the Algebra of Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Despite deep learning models running well-defined mathematical functions, we lack a formal mathematical framework for describing model architectures. Ad-hoc notation, diagrams, and pseudocode poorly handle nonlinear broadcasting and the relationship between individual components and composed models. This paper introduces a categorical framework for deep learning models that formalizes broadcasting through the novel axis-stride and array-broadcasted categories. This allows the mathematical function underlying architectures to be precisely expressed and manipulated in a compositional manner. These mathematical definitions are translated into human manageable diagrams and machine manageable data structures. We provide a mirrored implementation in Python (pyncd) and TypeScript (tsncd) to show the universal aspect of our framework, along with features including algebraic construction, graph conversion, PyTorch compilation and diagram rendering. This lays the foundation for a systematic, formal approach to deep learning model design and analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用范畴论 (category theory) 为深度学习模型架构建立形式化数学框架，引入轴步长 (axis-stride) 与数组广播 (array-broadcasted) 范畴来刻画非线性广播，并以可组合方式表达和操作网络背后的数学函数。作者提供了 Python (pyncd) 与 TypeScript (tsncd) 两个镜像实现，支持代数构建、图转换、PyTorch 编译和示意图渲染，旨在为模型设计与分析建立系统性形式化基础。
Motivation: 深度学习模型虽然运行明确定义的数学函数，但缺乏描述模型架构的形式化数学框架，现有的临时记号、示意图和伪代码难以处理非线性广播以及组件与组合模型之间的关系。
Method: 引入基于范畴论的框架，通过轴步长和数组广播范畴把广播等操作形式化，使架构对应的数学函数能以组合方式精确表达和操作，并将这些数学定义翻译为人类可读的示意图和机器可用的数据结构，同时提供 Python 与 TypeScript 双语言镜像实现。
Result: 摘要未报告具体的实验数值或基准结果，仅说明实现了 pyncd 和 tsncd 并支持代数构建、图转换、PyTorch 编译和示意图渲染等功能。
Conclusion: 该框架为深度学习模型设计与分析奠定系统化、形式化的基础，但摘要未提及与降水临近预报、天气预测或数据同化等应用相关的验证或扩展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards foundation-style models for energy-frontier heterogeneous neutrino detectors via self-supervised pre-training
papers.abstract_en: Accelerator-based neutrino physics is entering an energy-frontier regime in which interactions reach the TeV scale and produce exceptionally dense, overlapping detector signatures. In this regime, event interpretation becomes impractical for conventional reconstruction approaches, particularly when labelled data are scarce and the analysis spans diverse downstream objectives. We present a sparse ViT framework for learning reusable representations from heterogeneous detector data. Self-supervised pre-training combines masked autoencoder reconstruction with relational voxel-level objectives for hierarchy, ghost and particle identification, and the resulting shared encoder is then jointly fine-tuned across classification and regression tasks. Evaluated on simulated events from the proposed FASERCal concept at the LHC, we find that pre-training consistently improves neutrino flavour and charm-quark identification, momentum regression, and vertex reconstruction over training from scratch, with the addition of relational objectives yielding further gains in the most topologically complex channels. Interpretability analyses further show that pre-training yields a more structured latent space, while detector-subsystem ablations recover physically plausible channel-dependent roles for the heterogeneous inputs. A data-efficiency study shows that, with roughly $10^3$ labelled events, the pre-trained encoder already matches the flavour-classification performance of a randomly initialised model trained on an order of magnitude more data. The learned representations also transfer effectively to publicly available benchmarks spanning different detector technologies and energy scales, matching or exceeding published baselines. These results support self-supervised pre-training on multimodal detector data as a scalable route towards reusable representations for neutrino and particle-detector analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对加速器中微子物理进入 TeV 能级能量前沿后、探测器信号密集重叠且标注数据稀缺的问题，提出一个基于稀疏 ViT (sparse ViT) 的自监督预训练框架。预训练将掩码自编码器重建与体素级关系目标（层级、幻影和粒子鉴别）结合，共享编码器再在分类与回归任务上联合微调。在 LHC 上提出的 FASERCal 概念的模拟事件上，预训练一致地提升中微子味、粲夸克鉴别、动量回归和顶点重建效果，并展现出较好的数据效率与跨探测器迁移能力。
Motivation: 加速器中微子物理进入能量前沿后，TeV 尺度相互作用产生极其致密、重叠的探测器信号，传统重建方法难以解释事件；同时标注数据稀缺且下游分析目标多样，现有方法难以应对。
Method: 提出一个稀疏 ViT 框架，用于从异构探测器数据学习可复用表示；自监督预训练结合掩码自编码器重建与面向层级、幻影和粒子鉴别的体素级关系目标，随后将共享编码器在分类和回归任务上联合微调。
Result: 在 FASERCal 模拟事件上，预训练相比从头训练一致提升中微子味与粲夸克鉴别、动量回归和顶点重建，其中关系目标在拓扑最复杂通道带来额外增益；约 10^3 个标注事件下，预训练编码器已匹配用多一个数量级数据训练的随机初始化模型的味分类性能；学习到的表示还可迁移到不同探测器技术与能量规模的公开基准，达到或超过已发表基线。
Conclusion: 预训练使潜在空间更加结构化，探测器子系统的消融实验恢复出物理上合理的、按通道区分的输入角色；作者认为这支持将多模态探测器数据的自监督预训练作为中微子与粒子探测器分析可复用表示的可扩展路线。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Uncertainty as a Planning Signal: Multi-Turn Decision Making for Goal-Oriented Conversation
papers.abstract_en: Goal-oriented conversational systems require making sequential decisions under uncertainty about the user's intent, where the algorithm must balance information acquisition and target commitment over multiple turns. Existing approaches address this challenge from different perspectives: structured methods enable multi-step planning but rely on predefined schemas, while LLM-based approaches support flexible interactions but lack long-horizon decision making, resulting in poor coordination between information acquisition and target commitment. To address this limitation, we formulate goal-oriented conversation as an uncertainty-aware sequential decision problem, where uncertainty serves as a guiding signal for multi-turn decision making. We propose a Conversation Uncertainty-aware Planning framework (CUP) that integrates language models with structured planning: a language model proposes feasible actions, and a planner evaluates their long-term impact on uncertainty reduction. Experiments on multiple conversational benchmarks show that CUP consistently improves success rates while requiring fewer interaction turns. Further analysis demonstrates that uncertainty-aware planning contributes to more efficient information acquisition and earlier confident commitment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把目标导向对话建模为不确定性感知的序贯决策问题，提出 Conversation Uncertainty-aware Planning (CUP) 框架，将语言模型与结构化规划结合：语言模型提出可行动作，规划器评估这些动作对不确定性降低的长期影响。在多个对话基准上的实验显示，CUP 在提高成功率的同时减少了交互轮数，并能更早做出自信的目标承诺。
Motivation: 现有目标导向对话方法中，结构化方法虽然支持多步规划但依赖预定义 schema，而基于 LLM 的方法交互灵活但缺乏长程决策能力，导致信息获取与目标承诺之间协调不佳。作者希望以不确定性作为指导信号，弥补这一决策层面的缺口。
Method: 提出 CUP 框架，把对话视为不确定性感知的序贯决策问题；语言模型负责生成可行动作候选，规划器评估各候选在长程上对不确定性降低的影响，从而在信息获取与目标承诺之间做平衡。
Result: 在多个对话基准上，CUP 一致地提升任务成功率，同时所需的交互轮数更少；进一步分析表明，不确定性感知规划带来更高效的信息获取，并支持更早的自信承诺。
Conclusion: 作者认为使用不确定性作为规划信号，可以改进目标导向对话中信息获取与目标承诺之间的协调，并验证了语言模型与结构化规划结合的有效性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: On Data-Driven Koopman Representations of Nonlinear Delay Differential Equations
papers.abstract_en: This work establishes a rigorous bridge between infinite-dimensional delay dynamics and finite-dimensional Koopman learning, with explicit and interpretable error guarantees. While Koopman analysis is well-developed for ordinary differential equations (ODEs) and partially for partial differential equations (PDEs), its extension to delay differential equations (DDEs) remains limited due to the infinite-dimensional phase space of DDEs. We propose a finite-dimensional Koopman approximation framework based on history discretization and a suitable reconstruction operator, enabling a tractable representation of the Koopman operator via kernel-based extended dynamic mode decomposition (kEDMD). Deterministic error bounds are derived for the learned predictor, decomposing the total error into contributions from history discretization, kernel interpolation, and data-driven regression. Additionally, we develop a kernel-based reconstruction method to recover discretized states from lifted Koopman coordinates, with provable guarantees. Numerical results demonstrate reliable prediction of nonlinear delay systems, with potential relevance to future control applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在无限维时滞微分方程（DDE）与有限维 Koopman 学习之间建立理论桥梁，提出基于历史离散化（history discretization）和重建算子的有限维 Koopman 逼近框架，并用核扩展动态模式分解（kEDMD）实现可处理的 Koopman 算子表示。作者推导了预测器的确定性误差界，将总误差分解为历史离散化、核插值与数据驱动回归三部分，并给出从提升 Koopman 坐标恢复离散化状态的核重建方法及其可证明保证。数值结果展示了对非线性时滞系统的可靠预测，并指出对控制应用的潜在价值。
Motivation: Koopman 分析已较为成熟地用于常微分方程（ODE）和偏微分方程（PDE），但由于 DDE 的相空间是无限维的，Koopman 方法在时滞微分方程上的扩展仍然受限。该工作试图填补这一空白，为非线性 DDE 提供有明确误差保证的可学习有限维表示。
Method: 提出一种基于历史离散化和重建算子的有限维 Koopman 逼近框架，借助核 kEDMD 学习 Koopman 算子；同时开发基于核的重建方法，从提升后的 Koopman 坐标恢复离散化状态，并给出可证明的保证。推导的确定性误差界将总误差分解为历史离散化、核插值和数据驱动回归三部分。
Result: 数值结果表明该方法能够可靠预测非线性时滞系统，并具备未来控制应用的潜力。摘要未给出具体的数值提升幅度或基准对比。
Conclusion: 作者强调该工作建立了无限维时滞动力学与有限维 Koopman 学习之间带显式可解释误差保证的严格桥梁。摘要未明确讨论局限性，但指出控制应用是后续方向。
Relevance: 6

papers.title: Social Meaning in Large Language Models: Structure, Magnitude, and Pragmatic Prompting
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly exhibit human-like patterns of pragmatic and social reasoning. This paper addresses two related questions: do LLMs approximate human social meaning not only qualitatively but also quantitatively, and can prompting strategies informed by pragmatic theory improve this approximation? To address the first, we introduce two calibration-focused metrics distinguishing structural fidelity from magnitude calibration: the Effect Size Ratio (ESR) and the Calibration Deviation Score (CDS). To address the second, we derive prompting conditions from two pragmatic assumptions: that social meaning arises from reasoning over linguistic alternatives, and that listeners infer speaker knowledge states and communicative motives. Applied to a case study on numerical (im)precision across three frontier LLMs, we find that all models reliably reproduce the qualitative structure of human social inferences but differ substantially in magnitude calibration. Prompting models to reason about speaker knowledge and motives most consistently reduces magnitude deviation, while prompting for alternative-awareness tends to amplify exaggeration. Combining both components is the only intervention that improves all calibration-sensitive metrics across all models, though fine-grained magnitude calibration remains only partially resolved. LLMs thus capture inferential structure while variably distorting inferential strength, and pragmatic theory provides a useful but incomplete handle for improving that approximation.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 15th Workshop on Cognitive Modeling and Computational Linguistics (CMCL) @ LREC 2026, pages 162-171
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型（LLM）是否不仅在定性上、也在定量上逼近人类的社会意义（social meaning），并检验基于语用学理论的提示策略能否改进这种逼近。作者提出两个校准导向指标：效应量比值（Effect Size Ratio, ESR）和校准偏差分数（Calibration Deviation Score, CDS），并以三个前沿 LLM 上的数值（不）精确性（numerical (im)precision）为案例。结果发现所有模型都能复现人类社会推理的定性结构，但幅度校准差异显著；让模型推理说话者知识与动机可最稳定地减小幅度偏差，而提示其关注语言备选项反而放大夸张效应。
Motivation: 现有研究多关注 LLM 是否表现出类人的语用与社会推理，但对这种社会意义在定量层面是否与人类校准一致缺乏系统度量；本文同时追问能否用语用理论指导的 prompting 改善定量逼近。
Method: 提出两个面向校准的指标 ESR 与 CDS，分别刻画结构保真度与幅度校准；从两条语用假设（社会意义源于对语言备选项的推理、听者推断说话者知识状态与交际动机）推导出不同提示条件，并在数值（不）精确性任务上对三个前沿 LLM 进行案例研究。
Result: 所有模型都能可靠复现人类社会推理的定性结构，但幅度校准差异很大；提示模型推理说话者知识与动机最一致地降低幅度偏差，而提示备选项意识倾向于放大夸张；只有同时包含两个成分的提示能在所有模型上改善全部校准敏感指标，但细粒度幅度校准仍仅部分解决。
Conclusion: LLM 能捕捉推理结构，但对推理强度的扭曲因模型而异；语用理论为改进这种逼近提供了有用但不完全的工具。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Diffusion-Guided Cooperative Policy Learning for Target Tracking Based on Underwater Mobile Agent Networks
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) provides a promising solution for cooperative target tracking in networks of autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs). However, existing methods still face three major challenges: 1) policy non-stationarity caused by concurrent updates among multiple agents; 2) inefficient policy learning caused by the heterogeneous quality of experiences accumulated during exploration; and 3) policy drift between stochastic exploration and deterministic execution under dynamic underwater disturbances. To address these challenges, this paper develops a four-layer hierarchical MARL architecture comprising global training scheduling, multi-agent coordination, local policy generation, and real-time action execution. Building on this architecture, we propose a Supervised Diffusion-Aided MARL (SDA-MARL) algorithm with three closely coupled mechanisms. First, a dual-decision policy integrates a diffusion-based generative branch with a Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG) branch, while segregated experience pools reduce training interference between the two branches. Second, a supervised sample-selection mechanism identifies high-quality tracking transitions and uses their actions to guide reverse diffusion, enabling the generative policy to concentrate on effective regions of the action space. Third, a behavioral-cloning loss transfers diffusion-generated actions to the deterministic DDPG Actor, thereby aligning exploration with execution and suppressing policy drift. Experiments conducted in six-degree-of-freedom underwater environments across multiple AUV-target configurations show that SDA-MARL achieves faster convergence, higher tracking accuracy, more consistent inter-AUV velocities, and shorter tracking paths than the compared MARL methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对水下自主航行器（AUV）网络中的协同目标跟踪问题，提出监督式扩散辅助的多智能体强化学习算法 SDA-MARL。算法基于全局训练调度、多智能体协调、局部策略生成和实时动作执行的四层分层架构，并集成双决策策略、监督样本选择机制与行为克隆损失三个相互耦合的机制。在六自由度水下环境的多种 AUV-目标配置实验下，SDA-MARL 相比对比的 MARL 方法收敛更快、跟踪精度更高、AUV 间速度更一致且跟踪路径更短。
Motivation: 现有基于 MARL 的 AUV 协同目标跟踪存在三个主要挑战：多智能体并发更新导致的策略非平稳性（policy non-stationarity）；探索过程中经验质量不均导致的策略学习低效；动态水下扰动下随机探索与确定性执行之间的策略漂移（policy drift）。
Method: 提出四层分层 MARL 架构，并在此之上构建 SDA-MARL：双决策策略包含扩散生成分支与 DDPG 分支，并使用分离经验池降低两分支间的训练干扰；监督样本选择机制筛选高质量跟踪转移并用其动作引导反向扩散；行为克隆损失将扩散生成的动作迁移到确定性 DDPG Actor，以对齐探索与执行、抑制策略漂移。
Result: 在六自由度水下环境和多种 AUV-目标配置下的实验中，SDA-MARL 相比对比的 MARL 方法取得更快收敛、更高跟踪精度、更一致的 AUV 间速度以及更短的跟踪路径。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将扩散生成策略与确定性执行策略通过监督样本选择和克隆损失耦合，可以有效缓解 MARL 中的探索-执行不一致问题并提升水下协同跟踪性能；但摘要未提及额外局限或扩展场景。
Relevance: 2
