summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调该研究为动态电力市场提供了稳健的电价预测框架，并指出综合特征集成（尤其是发电结构）对预测性能的重要性。

papers.title: Variational Mixture of Graph Neural Experts for Alzheimer's Disease Recognition across Frequency Bands in EEG Brain Networks
papers.abstract_en: Dementia disorders such as Alzheimer's disease (AD) and frontotemporal dementia (FTD) exhibit overlapping electrophysiological signatures in electroencephalography (EEG) that challenge accurate diagnosis. Existing EEG-based methods are limited by full-band frequency analysis, which hinders precise differentiation of dementia subtypes and severity stages. To address this limitation, we propose a Variational Mixture of Graph Neural Experts (VMoGE) framework that integrates multi-band EEG analysis with variational graph neural networks and a mixture-of-experts architecture. Each expert specializes in a specific EEG frequency band and models brain connectivity using a Gaussian Markov Random Field prior, while a variational gating mechanism adaptively integrates expert outputs. This design enables the model to learn frequency-specific brain network representations while modeling latent uncertainty through variational inference. Experimental results on two EEG dementia datasets show that VMoGE achieves strong performance, with an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.89 for healthy controls (HC) vs. AD classification in the main comparison and competitive results across dementia subtyping and Clinical Dementia Rating (CDR) staging tasks. Clinically, VMoGE offers three key translational values: the expert gating weights correlate with Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE) scores and CDR severity, slow-wave $δ/ θ$-band contributions are associated with AD-related EEG slowing and disease progression, and spatially localized activation maps reveal posterior $θ$/$α$-band alterations and region-specific $β$-band changes, providing neurophysiologically interpretable patterns aligned with known AD neuropathology.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VMoGE（Variational Mixture of Graph Neural Experts）框架，针对阿尔茨海默病（AD）与额颞叶痴呆（FTD）在 EEG 上重叠的电生理特征，将多频段分析与变分图神经网络、混合专家架构结合。每个专家负责一个 EEG 频段，并用高斯马尔可夫随机场先验建模脑连接，变分门控机制自适应整合专家输出。在两个 EEG 痴呆数据集上，主比较中健康对照（HC）对 AD 分类的 AUC 达到 0.89，并在痴呆亚型和 CDR 分期任务上取得有竞争力的结果，同时提供了与已知 AD 神经病理相一致的频段特异解释模式。
Motivation: AD 和 FTD 等痴呆疾病在 EEG 中表现出重叠的电生理特征，现有基于 EEG 的方法局限于全频段（full-band）分析，难以精确区分痴呆亚型和严重程度分期，因此需要能利用频段特异信息的建模方案。
Method: 提出 VMoGE 框架，采用混合专家架构，每个专家专攻一个 EEG 频段并以高斯马尔可夫随机场（Gaussian Markov Random Field）先验建模脑连接；引入变分门控（variational gating）机制自适应整合专家输出，并通过变分推断（variational inference）建模潜在不确定性，从而学习频段特异的脑网络表征。
Result: 在两个 EEG 痴呆数据集上，主比较中 HC vs. AD 分类的 AUC 为 0.89，在痴呆亚型分类和 Clinical Dementia Rating（CDR）分期任务上也表现有竞争力；专家门控权重与 MMSE 评分及 CDR 严重程度相关，慢波 δ/θ 频段贡献与 AD 相关 EEG 减慢和疾病进展有关，空间激活图显示后部 θ/α 频段改变及区域特异 β 频段变化。
Conclusion: VMoGE 通过频段特异的专家建模和变分门控，在痴呆识别任务上取得强性能，并提供与已知 AD 神经病理一致的神经生理可解释模式，具有一定的临床转化价值。

papers.title: CORE-3D: Context-aware Open-vocabulary Retrieval by Embeddings in 3D
papers.abstract_en: Object retrieval from a scene has become a new trend of research due to its numerous applications. Recent approaches achieve zero-shot, open-vocabulary 3D semantic mapping by assigning embedding vectors to 2D class-agnostic masks generated via vision-language models (VLMs) and projecting these into 3D. However, these methods often produce fragmented masks and inaccurate semantic assignments due to the direct use of raw masks, limiting their effectiveness in complex environments. To address this, we leverage SemanticSAM with progressive granularity refinement to generate more accurate and numerous object-level masks, mitigating the over-segmentation commonly observed in mask generation models such as vanilla SAM, and improving downstream 3D semantic segmentation. To further enhance semantic context, we employ a context-aware CLIP encoding strategy that integrates multiple contextual views of each mask using empirically determined weighting, providing much richer visual context. We evaluate our approach on multiple 3D scene understanding tasks, including 3D semantic segmentation and object retrieval from language queries, across several benchmark datasets. Experimental results demonstrate significant improvements over existing methods, highlighting the effectiveness of our approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CORE-3D，一种用于 3D 场景开放词汇目标检索与语义分割的方法。方法利用 SemanticSAM 进行渐进粒度细化以生成更准确且数量更多的物体级掩码，并采用上下文感知的 CLIP 编码策略，通过经验确定的权重整合每个掩码的多个上下文视图。作者在多个 3D 场景理解基准上评估，报告相对现有方法有显著改进。
Motivation: 现有零样本开放词汇 3D 语义映射方法直接使用 VLM 生成的 2D class-agnostic masks 并投影到 3D，常导致掩码碎片化和语义分配不准确，限制其在复杂环境中的效果。
Method: 使用 SemanticSAM 进行渐进粒度细化 (progressive granularity refinement) 生成更准确、数量更多的物体级掩码，以缓解 vanilla SAM 等掩码生成模型的过分割问题；随后采用上下文感知的 CLIP 编码策略，基于经验确定的权重整合每个掩码的多个上下文视图，提供更丰富的视觉上下文。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上的 3D 语义分割和基于语言查询的目标检索任务中，实验结果显示相对现有方法有显著改进。
Conclusion: 作者强调结合细粒度掩码生成与上下文感知视觉编码能够有效提升复杂场景下的 3D 语义理解和开放词汇检索性能。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Patch-based Memory Gate Model in Time Series Foundation Model
papers.abstract_en: Recently reconstruction-based deep models have been widely used for time series anomaly detection, but as their capacity and generalization capability increase, these models tend to over-generalize, often reconstructing unseen anomalies accurately. Prior works have attempted to mitigate this by incorporating a memory architecture that stores prototypes of normal patterns. Nevertheless, these approaches suffer from high training costs and have yet to be effectively integrated with time series foundation models (TSFMs). To address these challenges, we propose MOMEMTO, an improved TSFM variant for anomaly detection, enhanced with a patch-based memory module to mitigate over-generalization. The memory module is designed to capture representative normal patterns from multiple domains and enables a single model to be jointly fine-tuned across these domains through a multi-domain training strategy. MOMEMTO initializes memory items with latent representations from a pre-trained encoder, organizes them into patch-level units, and updates them via an attention mechanism. We evaluate our method using 23 univariate benchmark datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that MOMEMTO, as a single model, achieves higher scores on AUC and VUS metrics compared to baseline methods, and further enhances the performance of its backbone TSFM, particularly in few-shot learning scenarios.
papers.comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MOMEMTO，一种带 patch 级记忆模块的时间序列基础模型 (TSFM) 变体，用于异常检测，以缓解重构模型因过泛化而准确重构未见异常的问题。记忆模块从预训练编码器初始化记忆项，按 patch 单元组织并通过注意力机制更新，采用多域训练策略使单个模型跨域联合微调。在 23 个单变量基准数据集上，MOMEMTO 在 AUC 和 VUS 指标上优于基线，并提升了其 backbone TSFM 的表现，尤其在少样本学习场景。
Motivation: 重构式深度模型在时间序列异常检测中随着容量和泛化能力增加而趋于过泛化，常能准确重构未见过的异常；已有记忆架构虽试图缓解该问题，但训练成本高且尚未与时间序列基础模型有效集成。
Method: 提出 MOMEMTO，在 TSFM 中集成基于 patch 的记忆模块：用预训练编码器的潜在表示初始化记忆项，将记忆组织为 patch 级单元，并通过注意力机制更新；同时设计多域训练策略，使单个模型可在多个域上联合微调。
Result: 在 23 个单变量基准数据集上的实验显示，作为单一模型，MOMEMTO 在 AUC 和 VUS 指标上超过基线方法，并进一步增强其 backbone TSFM 的性能，特别是在少样本学习场景中。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 patch 级记忆模块能捕获多域中的代表性正常模式，从而缓解异常检测中的过泛化问题，并改善基础模型在少样本条件下的异常检测能力。

papers.title: SteeringSafety: Benchmarking Representation Steering in LLMs Across Safety Perspectives
papers.abstract_en: We introduce SteeringSafety, a benchmark for evaluating representation steering methods across nine safety perspectives spanning 18 datasets. While prior work highlights the general capabilities of representation steering, we focus on safety perspectives including refusal, bias, hallucination, social behaviors, reasoning, epistemic integrity, and normative judgment. SteeringSafety provides modularized building blocks for state-of-the-art steering methods, enabling unified implementation of DIM, ACE, CAA, PCA, and LAT with recent enhancements such as conditional steering. Results on Gemma-2-2B, Llama-3.1-8B, and Qwen-2.5-7B show that strong steering performance depends on the pairing of method, model, and specific perspective. For instance, DIM is consistently effective, yet all methods exhibit substantial entanglement, where improving effectiveness on one safety perspective often significantly changes performance on others. Social behaviors are most vulnerable (degradation up to 76%), refusal steering (jailbreaking) frequently compromises normative judgment such as commonsense morality (up to 26%), and hallucination steering shifts political views unpredictably across models, ranging from a 25% shift to the right to a 28% shift to the left. These findings show the need to understand steering methods through multiple safety angles rather than a single target behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SteeringSafety，一个用于评测 LLM 表示操控 (representation steering) 方法的安全基准，覆盖 9 个安全视角、18 个数据集。作者统一实现了 DIM、ACE、CAA、PCA、LAT 等主流方法并加入条件操控 (conditional steering) 等增强，在 Gemma-2-2B、Llama-3.1-8B 和 Qwen-2.5-7B 上评测后发现，操控效果强烈依赖方法、模型与具体安全视角的配对。所有方法都表现出明显的纠缠性 (entanglement)，改善某一安全视角常会显著改变其他视角的表现。
Motivation: 以往研究主要展示表示操控的一般能力，而本文聚焦于安全视角，强调仅看单一目标行为不足以理解操控方法的安全影响。
Method: 构建包含 9 个安全视角和 18 个数据集的基准，并提供模块化组件以统一实现 DIM、ACE、CAA、PCA、LAT 等操控方法及最近的条件操控增强。
Result: 摘要报告 DIM 在各视角上持续有效，但所有方法都存在明显纠缠；社交行为最脆弱，性能下降最高达 76%；拒答操控（越狱）会显著损害常识道德等规范性判断，最高达 26%；幻觉操控对政治观点的改变不稳定，范围从右移 25% 到左移 28%。
Conclusion: 作者强调需要从多个安全视角而非单一目标行为来理解表示操控方法的效果与风险。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Local Cluster Cardinality Estimation for Adaptive Mean Shift
papers.abstract_en: This article presents an adaptive mean shift algorithm in which every parameter used at a point is derived from that point's own distance distribution. The distance distribution from a point to all others is used to estimate the cardinality of the local cluster by identifying a local minimum in the density of that distribution; the statistics of the identified subset then set the bandwidth and the kernel radius threshold applied at that point. The estimator built this way is scale invariant, since the $γ$ function it rests on is unchanged when the data is multiplied by a positive constant, so no length constant has to be chosen for the scale of the data. It is also local: $γ$ evaluated at rank $k$ depends only on the $k$ nearest distances, and the mean shift kernel is truncated at the estimated cluster radius, so data lying beyond that radius neither enters the estimate of the local cluster nor contributes to the weighted mean. This contrasts with kernel density estimation, which in its basic form measures density in a neighborhood of fixed size and needs a bandwidth chosen for the dataset as a whole. Our algorithm is competitive within the adaptive mean shift family: it obtains a higher Rand index than the weighted adaptive mean shift method of Ren et al. (2014) on seven of the nine datasets of that study, four of them by more than 0.03 and three by less than 0.012, and it performs competitively on a broader clustering benchmark, in both cases without being given the number of clusters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自适应均值漂移 (adaptive mean shift) 聚类算法，其中每个点的所有参数都由该点自身的距离分布导出。算法通过识别距离分布密度中的局部极小值来估计局部簇的基数，再用该子集的统计量设置当前点的带宽与核半径阈值，从而无需为整个数据集选择统一的长度常数，也不需要预先给定簇数。作者将该方法与 Ren 等人 (2014) 的加权自适应均值漂移在九个数据集上比较，并在七个数据集上获得更高的 Rand index。
Motivation: 传统核密度估计 (kernel density estimation) 使用固定大小的邻域测量密度，需要为整个数据集选择带宽；而均值漂移的参数设置往往依赖全局尺度和簇数，缺乏逐点自适应的尺度选择机制。
Method: 提出局部簇基数估计方法：利用点到所有其他点的距离分布，通过该分布密度中的局部最小值识别局部簇子集，并由该子集的统计量确定对应点的带宽和核半径阈值；核心的 γ 函数在数据乘以正常数时不变，且第 k 秩处的 γ 只依赖最近的 k 个距离，同时均值漂移核在估计的簇半径处截断。

papers.title: Ethics Practices in AI Development: An Empirical Study Across Roles and Regions
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in AI applications have raised growing concerns about the need for ethical guidelines and regulations to mitigate the risks posed by these technologies. In this paper, we present a mixed-methods survey study - combining statistical and qualitative analyses - to examine the ethical perceptions, practices, and knowledge of individuals involved in various AI development roles. Our survey comprises 414 participants from 43 countries, representing various roles such as AI managers, analysts, developers, quality assurance professionals, and information security and privacy experts. The results reveal varying degrees of familiarity and experience with AI ethics principles, government initiatives, and risk mitigation strategies across roles, regions, and other demographic factors. Our findings underscore the importance of a collaborative, role-sensitive approach that involves diverse stakeholders in ethical decision-making throughout the AI development lifecycle. We advocate for developing tailored, inclusive solutions to address ethical challenges in AI development, and we propose future research directions and educational strategies to promote ethics-aware AI practices.
papers.comment: Accepted at Empirical Software Engineering Journal (EMSE)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了一项混合方法 (mixed-methods) 调查，基于 43 个国家的 414 名参与者，研究 AI 开发中不同角色（如 AI 经理、分析师、开发者、质量保证人员、信息安全与隐私专家）对 AI 伦理原则、政府举措和风险缓解策略的认知与实践。摘要通过统计与定性分析揭示，这些认知和经验在不同角色、地区及人口因素间存在差异，并据此强调在 AI 开发生命周期中采取协作且角色敏感 (role-sensitive) 的伦理决策方式。
Motivation: AI 应用的快速发展引发了对伦理指南和监管需求的日益担忧，而针对各 AI 开发角色实际伦理认知与实践的系统性实证研究仍然不足。
Method: 采用问卷调查与统计、定性分析相结合的混合方法研究设计，收集 414 名来自 43 个国家的多角色参与者的数据，分析其对 AI 伦理原则、政府举措和风险缓解策略的熟悉度与经验。
Result: 摘要报告，不同开发角色、地区及其他人口因素对 AI 伦理原则、政府举措和风险缓解策略的熟悉程度和经验存在不同程度的差异。
Conclusion: 作者主张采用协作的、角色敏感的方法，让多元利益相关者参与 AI 开发全生命周期的伦理决策，并倡导制定定制化、包容性的解决方案，同时提出未来研究方向和促进伦理意识 AI 实践的教育策略。

papers.title: Empowering Children to Create AI-Enabled Augmented Reality Experiences
papers.abstract_en: Despite their potential to enhance children's learning experiences, AI-enabled AR technologies are predominantly used in ways that position children as consumers rather than creators. We introduce Capybara, an AR-based and AI-powered visual programming environment that empowers children to create, customize, and program 3D characters overlaid onto the physical world. Capybara enables children to create virtual characters and accessories using text-to-3D generative AI models, and to animate these characters through auto-rigging and body tracking. In addition, our system employs vision-based AI models to recognize physical objects, allowing children to program interactive behaviors between virtual characters and their physical surroundings. We demonstrate the expressiveness of Capybara through a set of novel AR experiences. We conducted user studies with 20 children in the United States and Argentina. Our findings suggest that Capybara can empower children to harness AI in authoring personalized and engaging AR experiences that seamlessly bridge the virtual and physical worlds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Capybara，一个基于 AR 的 AI 驱动可视化编程环境，旨在让儿童通过文本到 3D 生成模型创建虚拟角色和配饰，并利用自动骨骼绑定与身体追踪实现动画，同时通过视觉 AI 识别物理对象来编程虚拟角色与真实环境的交互。作者展示了若干新颖 AR 体验，并对美国与阿根廷的 20 名儿童进行了用户研究，结果表明该环境能帮助儿童利用 AI 创作个性化且融合虚实世界的 AR 体验。
Motivation: AI 增强的 AR 技术虽有潜力提升儿童学习体验，但当前主要将儿童定位为消费者而非创作者，缺少让儿童主动设计、编程和定制 AR 内容的工具。
Method: Capybara 是一个可视化编程环境，集成了 text-to-3D 生成模型、自动绑骨与身体追踪，以及基于视觉的物体识别，使儿童能够创建并编程虚拟角色与物理世界之间的互动行为。
Result: 在美国和阿根廷开展的 20 名儿童用户研究显示，Capybara 能够赋能儿童利用 AI 创作个性化且吸引人的 AR 体验，实现虚拟世界与物理世界的无缝融合。
Conclusion: 作者认为 Capybara 展示了儿童可以借助生成式 AI 和 AR 成为创作者，而不仅是技术消费者，为儿童友好的 AI 增强创作工具提供了设计参考。

papers.title: Learning Multi-Timescale Interventions under Safety and Resource Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Many sequential decision problems offer qualitatively different ways of influencing the environment: some interventions act immediately, whereas others induce persistent effects that continue to shape future states long after the decision that initiated them. An agent must then decide jointly when to intervene, which temporal mode to use and how strongly, while accounting for residual effects and limited intervention resources. We introduce MINT: Multi-timescale Intervention Network Training. Persistent effects are carried by an augmented intervention state that accumulates and decays, while a structured policy separates intervention-mode selection from conditional control. Unlike temporal abstractions that extend policy execution, persistent-effect interventions remain part of the environment dynamics and may overlap with later interventions. We show that the augmented state is a sufficient statistic for the intervention history, preserving the Markov property, and establish Bellman contraction and almost-sure convergence of a tabular Q-learning instance. Across persistent-control MuJoCo locomotion, stochastic inventory management, and a physiologically grounded Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus (T1DM) simulator, MINT attains the best mean primary metric on two of three benchmarks while using fewer intervention activations than an identically augmented flat policy. Its return advantage is present at every binding intervention budget and narrows to parity in the unconstrained reference setting. In T1DM it achieves $90.9\pm0.9\%$ time in range with zero time below range, improving on the strongest baseline by $21.5\%$ points. Code, benchmarks and the configuration for every reported run are available at https://github.com/heywanrong/mint-rl.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MINT（Multi-timescale Intervention Network Training），用于在安全与资源约束下学习多时间尺度的干预策略。持久效应通过一个累积并衰减的增强干预状态携带，策略结构将干预模式选择与条件控制分离；作者证明该增强状态是干预历史的充分统计量并保持马尔可夫性质，同时建立贝尔曼收缩和表格 Q-learning 的几乎必然收敛。实验覆盖持久控制 MuJoCo 运动、随机库存管理和 T1DM 模拟器，MINT 在三个基准中的两个取得最佳平均主要指标，且使用更少的干预激活次数。
Motivation: 许多序贯决策问题中，干预可立即生效或产生持久影响，且有限干预资源下需要联合决定何时干预、选择哪种时间模式及强度。现有方法缺乏对这种持久效应干预的系统处理，因此需要一种能同时考虑残留效应和资源预算的决策框架。
Method: 引入 MINT，通过增强干预状态来承载持久效应（累积与衰减），并设计结构化策略将干预模式选择与条件控制分离；证明增强状态保持马尔可夫性质，给出贝尔曼收缩和表格 Q-learning 的几乎必然收敛保证。
Result: 在持久控制 MuJoCo 运动、随机库存管理和基于生理的 T1DM 模拟器上，MINT 在三个基准的两个上取得最佳平均主要指标，且比同等增强的 flat policy 使用更少干预激活；其回报优势在每个约束干预预算下都存在，并在无约束参考设定中收窄至持平。T1DM 上达到 90.9±0.9% 的时间在范围内（time in range）且零时间低于范围，比最强基线提高 21.5 个百分点。
Conclusion: 持久效应的干预应被视为环境动态的一部分，且可与后续干预重叠，而非像时间抽象那样扩展策略执行；MINT 在资源受限时具备优势，在无约束情况下与基线持平。代码、基准和配置已公开。

papers.title: On the Definition of Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: To engineer AGI, we should first capture the essence of intelligence in a species-agnostic form that can be evaluated, while being sufficiently general to encompass diverse paradigms of intelligent behavior, including reinforcement learning, generative models, classification, analogical reasoning, and goal-directed decision-making. We propose a general criterion based on \textit{entity fidelity}: Intelligence is the ability, given entities exemplifying a concept, to generate entities exemplifying the same concept. We formalise this intuition as \(\varepsilon\)-concept intelligence: it is \(\varepsilon\)-intelligent with respect to a concept if no chosen admissible distinguisher can separate generated entities from original entities beyond tolerance \(\varepsilon\). We present the formal framework, outline empirical protocols, and discuss implications for evaluation, safety, and generalization.
papers.comment: Accepted at AGI-25. v2: Enhanced mathematical rigor and conceptual clarity; terminology was refined from "category"/"sample" to "concept"/"entity", and the concept-fibre-entity relationship was clarified. v3: Added a reference to subsequent mathematical development in Similarity Field Theory (arXiv:2509.18218); main results and conclusions unchanged
papers.journal_ref: In: Iklé, M., Kolonin, A., Bennett, M. (eds), Artificial General Intelligence, AGI 2025, Lecture Notes in Computer Science, vol. 16058, pp. 1-11, Springer, Cham (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种物种无关的智能定义，核心思想是基于实体保真度 (entity fidelity)：智能是在给定体现某概念 (concept) 的实体后，生成体现同一概念的新实体的能力。作者将其形式化为 ε-concept intelligence，即当任何允许的区分器 (admissible distinguisher) 都无法在容差 ε 内区分生成实体与原始实体时，称该系统对该概念是 ε-智能的。论文给出形式化框架、经验验证协议草案，并讨论了对评估、安全性和泛化的影响；该文发表于 AGI-25。
Motivation: 为了工程化 AGI，需要一个物种无关、可评估且足够通用的智能定义，能够涵盖强化学习、生成模型、分类、类比推理和目标导向决策等多种智能行为范式。
Method: 提出以实体保真度为标准的智能判据，并形式化为 ε-concept intelligence：针对某个概念，系统是 ε-智能的当且仅当没有选定的 admissible distinguisher 能在超过容差 ε 的程度上区分生成实体与原始实体。文中还概述了对应的经验验证协议。
Result: 摘要未报告实验数值结果，主要贡献是形式化框架、经验协议草案以及关于评估、安全与泛化的理论讨论。
Conclusion: 作者认为该定义可作为通用智能评估的候选标准，并讨论了其在评估、安全性和泛化方面的启示；后续数学发展见 Similarity Field Theory (arXiv:2509.18218)，主要结果与结论不变。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Quantization-Aware Neuromorphic Architecture for Skin Lesion Classification on Resource-Constrained Devices
papers.abstract_en: On-device skin lesion analysis is constrained by the compute and energy cost of conventional CNN inference and by the need for lightweight calibration under clinical data shift. Neuromorphic processors provide event-driven sparse computation, but practical deployment is often limited by CNN-to-SNN conversion failures, including unsupported operators, quantization distortion, and accuracy degradation under class imbalance. We propose QANA, a quantization-aware CNN backbone within an end-to-end pipeline for conversion-stable neuromorphic execution. QANA improves conversion robustness by bounding intermediate activations, aligning normalization with low-bit quantization, and replacing conversion-fragile components with spike-compatible transformations. Efficient representation is achieved through Ghost-based feature generation, spatially-aware efficient channel attention, and squeeze-and-excitation modules whose operations can be quantized, folded, or lowered into integer graph operations. The quantized projection head produces SNN-ready logits and supports lightweight readout calibration without full retraining or data offloading. On HAM10000, QANA achieves 91.6% Top-1 accuracy and 91.0% macro F1, improving the strongest converted SNN baseline by 3.5 points in accuracy and 12.1 points in macro F1. On a clinical dataset, QANA achieves 90.8% Top-1 accuracy and 81.7% macro F1, improving the strongest baseline by 3.2 points in accuracy and 3.6 points in macro F1. On BrainChip Akida, QANA runs in 1.5 ms with 1.7 mJ per image, outperforming the strongest size-matched Akida baseline by 4.1 points in accuracy, 10.0 points in macro F1, 21.1% in latency, and 22.7% in energy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 QANA，一个面向神经形态执行 (neuromorphic execution) 的量化感知 CNN 骨干，目标是解决皮肤病变分类在资源受限设备上的 CNN 推理开销以及 CNN-to-SNN 转换失败问题。方法通过约束中间激活、对齐低比特量化归一化、替换转换脆弱组件，并使用 Ghost 特征生成、空间感知通道注意力和可折叠的 SE 模块来实现转换稳定。在 HAM10000 与临床数据集上均超过最强转换 SNN 基线，并在 BrainChip Akida 上以更低的延迟和能耗达到更高精度。
Motivation: 设备端皮肤病变分析受限于传统 CNN 推理的计算与能耗成本，并且临床数据漂移下需要轻量校准；同时 CNN-to-SNN 转换常因不支持的算子、量化失真和类别不平衡下的精度退化而难以实际部署。
Method: 提出 QANA，即端到端流水线中的量化感知 CNN 骨干，通过限制中间激活范围、使归一化与低比特量化对齐，并用 spike 兼容变换替换转换脆弱组件来提高转换鲁棒性；特征表示采用 Ghost 生成、空间感知高效通道注意力和 squeeze-and-excitation 模块，这些操作可被量化、折叠或降低为整数图运算；量化投影头产生 SNN-ready logits，支持无需完整重训练或数据离线的轻量读出校准。
Result: 在 HAM10000 上 QANA 达到 91.6% Top-1 精度和 91.0% macro F1，较最强转换 SNN 基线分别提升 3.5 和 12.1 个百分点；在临床数据集上达到 90.8% Top-1 和 81.7% macro F1，较最强基线提升 3.2 和 3.6 个百分点；在 BrainChip Akida 上每张图运行 1.5 ms、能耗 1.7 mJ，较最强同尺寸 Akida 基线在精度、macro F1、延迟和能耗上分别提升 4.1、10.0、21.1% 和 22.7%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调量化感知的转换稳定设计能在资源受限设备上实现高效的神经形态皮肤病变分类，同时相对转换 SNN 基线显著改善精度与效率；其适用范围为皮肤病变分类及可落入整数图操作的量化友好组件。

papers.title: P2MFDS: A Privacy-Preserving Multimodal Fall Detection System for Elderly People in Bathroom Environments
papers.abstract_en: By 2050, people aged 65 and over are projected to make up 16% of the global population. As aging is closely associated with increased fall risk, particularly in wet and confined environments such as bathrooms where over 80% of falls occur. Although recent research has increasingly focused on non-intrusive, privacy-preserving approaches that do not rely on wearable devices or video-based monitoring, these efforts have not fully overcome the limitations of existing unimodal systems (e.g., WiFi-, infrared-, or mmWave-based), which are prone to reduced accuracy in complex environments. These limitations stem from fundamental constraints in unimodal sensing, including system bias and environmental interference, such as multipath fading in WiFi-based systems and drastic temperature changes in infrared-based methods. To address these challenges, we propose a Privacy-Preserving Multimodal Fall Detection System for Elderly People in Bathroom Environments. First, we develop a sensor evaluation framework to select and fuse millimeter-wave radar with 3D vibration sensing, and use it to construct and preprocess a large-scale, privacy-preserving multimodal dataset in real bathroom settings, which will be released upon publication. Second, we introduce P2MFDS, a dual-stream network combining a CNN-BiLSTM-Attention branch for radar motion dynamics with a multi-scale CNN-SEBlock-Self-Attention branch for vibration impact detection. By uniting macro- and micro-scale features, P2MFDS delivers significant gains in accuracy and recall over state-of-the-art approaches.
papers.comment: Accepted to appear in the 2025 IEEE International Workshop on AIoT and Smart Systems (AIoTSys'25)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出P2MFDS，一个面向浴室环境的老年人隐私保护多模态跌倒检测系统。系统融合毫米波雷达与三维振动传感，构造真实浴室场景的大规模数据集，并采用双流网络（CNN-BiLSTM-Attention与多尺度CNN-SEBlock-Self-Attention）分别提取宏观运动与微观冲击特征。摘要报告相比现有最先进方法在准确率和召回率上获得显著提升。
Motivation: 现有非侵入式隐私保护跌倒检测多为单模态（WiFi、红外、毫米波），在复杂环境下因系统偏差和环境干扰（如WiFi多径衰落、红外温度剧变）而准确率下降，作者认为需要多模态融合来克服这些局限。
Method: 提出传感器评估框架以选择并融合毫米波雷达与3D振动传感，构建并预处理真实浴室环境中的大规模隐私保护多模态数据集；提出P2MFDS双流网络，一个分支用CNN-BiLSTM-Attention处理雷达运动动态，另一个分支用多尺度CNN-SEBlock-Self-Attention处理振动冲击检测。
Result: 摘要称P2MFDS在准确率和召回率上比现有最先进方法有显著提升，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 论文的结论是，融合毫米波雷达与3D振动传感、结合宏观运动和微观冲击特征的多模态方法能显著提升浴室跌倒检测性能；数据集将在发表后公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OpenAg: Democratizing Agricultural Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Agriculture is undergoing a major transformation driven by artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, and knowledge representation technologies. However, current agricultural intelligence systems often lack contextual understanding, explainability, and adaptability, especially for smallholder farmers with limited resources. General-purpose large language models (LLMs), while powerful, typically lack the domain-specific knowledge and contextual reasoning needed for practical decision support in farming. They tend to produce recommendations that are too generic or unrealistic for real-world applications. To address these challenges, we present OpenAg, a comprehensive framework designed to advance agricultural artificial general intelligence (AGI). OpenAg combines domain-specific foundation models, neural knowledge graphs, multi-agent reasoning, causal explainability, and adaptive transfer learning to deliver context-aware, explainable, and actionable insights. The system includes: (i) a unified agricultural knowledge base that integrates scientific literature, sensor data, and farmer-generated knowledge; (ii) a neural agricultural knowledge graph for structured reasoning and inference; (iii) an adaptive multi-agent reasoning system where AI agents specialize and collaborate across agricultural domains; and (iv) a causal transparency mechanism that ensures AI recommendations are interpretable, scientifically grounded, and aligned with real-world constraints. OpenAg aims to bridge the gap between scientific knowledge and the tacit expertise of experienced farmers to support scalable and locally relevant agricultural decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OpenAg 框架，旨在推进农业通用人工智能（AGI），通过结合领域专用基础模型、神经知识图谱、多智能体推理、因果可解释性和自适应迁移学习，为农业决策提供上下文感知、可解释且可执行的洞察。系统包括统一农业知识库、神经农业知识图谱、自适应多智能体推理系统和因果透明机制，目标是弥合科学知识与经验农民隐性技能之间的鸿沟。
Motivation: 现有农业智能系统缺乏上下文理解、可解释性和适应性，尤其对资源有限的小农户支持不足；通用大语言模型（LLM）缺少农业领域知识和上下文推理能力，生成的建议往往过于泛化或不切实际。
Method: OpenAg 框架整合四部分：(i) 统一农业知识库，集成科学文献、传感器数据和农民生成知识；(ii) 神经农业知识图谱用于结构化推理；(iii) 自适应多智能体推理系统，AI 智能体在农业各领域分工协作；(iv) 因果透明机制，确保推荐可解释、有科学依据并符合实际约束。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数值或基准测试结果，主要描述系统架构与目标。
Conclusion: OpenAg 旨在支持可扩展且本地相关的农业决策，连接科学知识与农民经验，但摘要未提及验证结果或局限性。

papers.title: COLORA: Efficient Fine-Tuning for Convolutional Models with a Study Case on Optical Coherence Tomography Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: We introduce \textbf{CoLoRA} (Convolutional Low-Rank Adaptation), a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method for convolutional neural networks (CNNs). CoLoRA extends LoRA to convolutional layers by decomposing kernel updates into lightweight depthwise and pointwise components. This design reduces the number of trainable convolutional-update parameters by over 80\% compared with full convolutional fine-tuning, while allowing the learned updates to be merged into the pretrained convolutional kernels, thereby preserving the original model size and inference complexity. Experiments on MedMNIST datasets, particularly OCTMNISTv2, demonstrate that CoLoRA applied to VGG16 and ResNet50 achieves competitive classification performance while substantially reducing the number of trainable parameters. Comparisons with transfer learning, adapters, BitFit, and convolutional LoRA variants further characterize the trade-offs among predictive performance, trainable parameters, and training cost. Additional experiments on CIFAR-100 and Cats vs. Dogs provide preliminary evidence that the proposed adaptation strategy also transfers to non-medical image-classification tasks. Peak GPU-memory measurements further show that parameter efficiency does not translate directly into proportional training-memory savings, with memory consumption depending strongly on the placement of the adapted convolutional layers. Overall, CoLoRA provides a parameter-efficient and deployment-efficient alternative to full fine-tuning for convolutional models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoLoRA (Convolutional Low-Rank Adaptation)，一种针对卷积神经网络 (CNN) 的参数高效微调方法，将 LoRA 推广到卷积层，把卷积核更新分解为轻量的 depthwise 和 pointwise 分量。在 MedMNIST 特别是 OCTMNISTv2 上，CoLoRA 应用于 VGG16 和 ResNet50 时取得有竞争力的分类性能，同时可训练卷积更新参数比全量卷积微调减少超过 80%，且学习到的更新可合并回预训练卷积核，保持模型大小和推理复杂度不变。额外在 CIFAR-100 和 Cats vs. Dogs 上的实验初步表明该适配策略可迁移到非医学图像分类任务。峰值 GPU 内存测量显示参数效率并不直接转化为成比例的训练内存节省，内存消耗与适配卷积层的放置位置密切相关。
Motivation: 全量微调卷积模型需要大量可训练参数，且已有 LoRA 类方法主要面向 Transformer 结构，卷积层的高效低秩适配研究不足；此外需要厘清参数效率与训练期内存消耗之间的关系。
Method: 将 LoRA 扩展到卷积层，将卷积核的更新矩阵分解为轻量的 depthwise 与 pointwise 分量，从而大幅减少可训练卷积更新参数；该更新可在训练后合并进预训练卷积核，不增加推理时的模型大小或计算复杂度。
Result: 在 MedMNIST、尤其是 OCTMNISTv2 上，CoLoRA 使 VGG16 与 ResNet50 获得有竞争力的分类准确率，同时显著降低可训练参数数量；与迁移学习、adapter、BitFit 及卷积 LoRA 变体的对比刻画了预测性能、可训练参数和训练成本之间的权衡；CIFAR-100 与 Cats vs. Dogs 提供了向非医学任务迁移的初步证据；峰值 GPU 内存测量表明内存消耗强烈依赖被适配卷积层的位置，参数效率不等于成比例的内存节省。
Conclusion: CoLoRA 为卷积模型的微调提供了参数高效且部署高效（更新可合并、推理复杂度不变）的替代方案；但摘要同时指出其训练内存节省与参数效率不成比例，受适配层位置影响。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: CoLoRA 为卷积模型的微调提供了参数高效且部署高效（更新可合并、推理复杂度不变）的替代方案；但摘要同时指出其训练内存节省与参数效率不成比例，受适配层位置影响。

papers.title: 3D Scene Generation: A Survey
papers.abstract_en: 3D scene generation seeks to synthesize spatially structured, semantically meaningful, and photorealistic environments for applications such as immersive media, robotics, autonomous driving, and embodied AI. Early methods based on procedural rules offered scalability but limited diversity. Recent advances in deep generative models (e.g., GANs, diffusion models) and 3D representations (e.g., NeRF, 3D Gaussians) have enabled the learning of real-world scene distributions, improving fidelity, diversity, and view consistency. Recent advances like diffusion models bridge 3D scene synthesis and photorealism by reframing generation as image or video synthesis problems. This survey provides a systematic overview of state-of-the-art approaches, organizing them into four paradigms: procedural generation, neural 3D-based generation, image-based generation, and video-based generation. We analyze their technical foundations, trade-offs, and representative results, and review commonly used datasets, evaluation protocols, and downstream applications. We conclude by discussing key challenges in generation capacity, 3D representation, data and annotations, and evaluation, and outline promising directions including higher fidelity, physics-aware and interactive generation, and unified perception-generation models. This review organizes recent advances in 3D scene generation and highlights promising directions at the intersection of generative AI, 3D vision, and embodied intelligence. To track ongoing developments, we maintain an up-to-date project page: https://github.com/hzxie/Awesome-3D-Scene-Generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于3D场景生成的系统综述，将现有方法组织为四种范式：程序化生成、神经3D-based生成、基于图像的生成和基于视频的生成。摘要系统分析了各范式的技术基础、权衡与代表性结果，并回顾常用数据集、评估协议和下游应用。作者最后总结了生成容量、3D表示、数据与标注以及评估等关键挑战，并指出高保真度、物理感知与交互生成、统一感知-生成模型等有前景的方向。
Motivation: 3D场景生成面向沉浸式媒体、机器人、自动驾驶和具身智能等应用，但早期基于程序化规则的方法虽可扩展却多样性有限；深度生成模型与3D表示（如 NeRF、3D Gaussians）的发展使学习真实世界场景分布成为可能，因此需要系统性综述来梳理进展和开放问题。
Method: 采用综述方法，将近期3D场景生成方法划分为四种范式：程序化生成、神经3D-based生成、基于图像的生成和基于视频的生成，并分析其技术基础、权衡和代表性结果；同时整理常用数据集、评估协议及下游应用。
Result: 摘要未提供定量实验数据，主要结果体现在对四类范式的归纳和对领域挑战的识别，包括生成容量、3D表示、数据与标注、评估等方面，并展望高保真度、物理感知和交互生成、统一感知-生成模型等方向。
Conclusion: 作者认为该综述组织并突出了生成式AI、3D视觉与具身智能交叉方向上的近期进展，并建议未来关注更高保真度、物理感知与交互生成以及统一的感知-生成模型；同时维护持续更新的项目页面以追踪后续发展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Program Semantic Inequivalence Game with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) can achieve strong performance on everyday coding tasks, but they can fail on complex tasks that require non-trivial reasoning about program semantics. Finding training examples to teach LLMs to solve these tasks can be challenging. In this work, we explore a method to synthetically generate code reasoning training data based on a semantic inequivalence game (SInQ): a generator agent creates program variants that are semantically distinct, derived from a dataset of real-world programming tasks, while an evaluator agent has to identify input examples for which they behave differently. The agents train each other semi-adversarially, improving their ability to understand the underlying logic of code. We evaluated our approach on multiple code generation and understanding benchmarks, including cross-language vulnerability detection (Lu et al., 2021),, where our method improves vulnerability detection in C/C++ code despite being trained exclusively on Python code, and the challenging Python builtin identifier swap benchmark (Miceli Barone et al., 2023),, showing that whereas modern LLMs still struggle with this benchmark, our approach yields substantial improvements. We release the code needed to replicate the experiments, as well as the generated synthetic data, which can be used to fine-tune LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于语义不等价游戏（SInQ）的方法，用于合成代码推理训练数据。生成器代理从真实编程任务中创建语义不同的程序变体，评估器代理则寻找使这些变体行为不同的输入示例，两者以半对抗方式互相训练。作者在多个代码生成与理解基准上评估，包括跨语言漏洞检测和Python内置标识符交换基准，并发布代码和合成数据。
Motivation: 大语言模型在常规编码任务上表现良好，但在需要非平凡程序语义推理的复杂任务上会失败，且难以找到合适的训练样例来教授这类能力。
Method: 设计一个语义不等价游戏：生成器代理基于真实世界编程任务数据集创建语义不同的程序变体，评估器代理负责找出能区分这些变体的输入示例，两个代理通过半对抗训练互相提升对代码底层逻辑的理解。
Result: 在跨语言漏洞检测基准上，尽管仅用Python代码训练，该方法仍提升了C/C++代码的漏洞检测能力；在具有挑战性的Python内置标识符交换基准上，该方法相比现代LLM带来显著改进。
Conclusion: 作者认为该合成数据生成方法能有效提升LLM对程序语义的理解能力，并公开了实验复现代码与生成的合成数据供微调使用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Proportional Committee Elections with Positive and Negative Votes
papers.abstract_en: In the classic committee election setting each voter approves a subset of candidates and the goal is to select $k$ winners based on these preferences. A central focus of recent research in the area has been to achieve proportional representation. In this work, we explore notions of proportionality in a more expressive setting that allows voters to vote against candidates---a common feature on online polling platforms and beyond. We propose two conceptually distinct interpretations of negative votes, resulting in different perspectives of proportionality. In the first, preventing the election of disapproved candidates is as important to voters as electing approved ones. In the second, approvals and disapprovals are treated separately, with each receiving its own fairness guarantees. For each approach, we introduce suitable axioms capturing proportionality and examine their satisfiability by appropriate variants of Phragmén's rule, Proportional Approval Voting rule (PAV), and the Method of Equal Shares (MES).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究允许选民对候选人投反对票（negative votes）的委员会选举中的比例代表性问题。作者提出两种对负票的不同解释，分别对应不同的比例性视角，并为每种视角引入公理，考察 Phragmén 规则、比例批准投票规则（PAV）和等份额方法（MES）的变体是否满足这些公理。
Motivation: 经典委员会选举假设选民只批准候选人，而现实中的在线投票平台常允许选民同时表达反对意见，现有比例性理论未覆盖这种更富表达力的场景。
Method: 提出负票的两种概念性解释：一是阻止不赞成候选人当选与选举赞成候选人同等重要，二是将赞成与反对分开处理并分别提供公平性保证。针对每种解释定义比例性公理，并分析 Phragmén 规则、PAV 和 MES 的相应变体的可满足性。
Result: 摘要未报告具体的数值实验结果，而是给出对不同规则变体满足所提比例性公理的判定性结论。
Conclusion: 论文表明在带正负票的委员会选举中，比例性的确切含义取决于负票的解释方式，且不同规则变体在不同解释下提供相应的公平性保证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On Benchmarking Human-Like Intelligence in Machines
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Artificial Intelligence (AI) have yielded powerful computational models that, by learning from vast amounts of human-generated data, are increasingly posited as approximate models of human cognition. However, we argue that many current evaluation paradigms for AI are insufficient for assessing human-like cognitive capabilities in these models. We identify a set of key shortcomings: a lack of human-validated labels, inadequate representation of human response variability and uncertainty, and reliance on simplified and ecologically invalid tasks. We support our claims by conducting a human evaluation study on nine existing AI benchmarks, suggesting major limitations in task and label designs. To address these limitations, we propose five concrete recommendations for future AI evaluation efforts that will enable more rigorous and meaningful understanding of human-like cognitive capacities in AI models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文质疑当前AI评估范式不足以衡量机器中类人认知能力，指出缺乏人类验证标签、未充分表征人类反应变异与不确定性、依赖简化且生态效度低的任务等问题。作者对九个现有AI基准开展人类评估研究，验证了这些局限，并提出五条未来AI评估的具体建议。
Motivation: 尽管AI模型通过学习海量人类数据日益被视为人类认知的近似模型，现有评估范式却难以真正检验模型的类人认知能力，存在标签未经人类验证、忽略人类反应分布、任务生态效度低等关键缺陷。
Method: 作者识别出一组关键不足，并通过在九个现有AI基准上进行人类评估研究来支持其论点，基于实证结果提出五项面向未来AI评估的具体建议。
Result: 对九个AI基准的人类评估研究表明，任务与标签设计存在重大局限性，印证了当前评估框架在衡量类人认知能力方面的不足。
Conclusion: 作者主张采用更严谨且有意义的人类认知评估方案，五条建议旨在推动AI评估更贴近类人认知能力的真实测量。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Variational Analysis of Kernel Learning with Learnable Linear Transformations
papers.abstract_en: The classical kernel ridge regression problem aims to find the best fit for the output $Y$ as a function of the input data $X\in \mathbb{R}^d$, with a fixed choice of regularization term imposed by a given choice of a reproducing kernel Hilbert space, such as a Sobolev space. Here we consider a generalization of the kernel ridge regression problem, by introducing an extra matrix parameter $U$, which aims to detect the scale parameters and the feature variables in the data, and thereby improve the efficiency of kernel ridge regression. This naturally leads to a nonlinear variational problem to optimize the choice of $U$. We study various foundational mathematical aspects of this variational problem, including its Euler-Lagrange equation, continuity and first variation, limiting behavior under degenerate or diverging transformations, and the structure of its local minimizers. Particular attention is given to two data-distribution settings, namely multi-scale and multi-index models, where the learned transformation $U$ encodes intrinsic scale parameters and the essential low-dimensional feature variables, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究一类带可学习线性变换 U 的广义核岭回归问题，将传统固定再生核希尔伯特空间中的核岭回归推广为关于 U 的非线性变分问题。作者系统分析了该变分问题的数学基础性质，包括 Euler-Lagrange 方程、连续性、一阶变分、退化或发散变换下的极限行为，以及局部极小值的结构。重点关注多尺度 (multi-scale) 与多指标 (multi-index) 两种数据分布设定，其中学习到的 U 分别编码内在尺度参数与本质低维特征变量。
Motivation: 经典核岭回归在给定再生核希尔伯特空间（如 Sobolev 空间）时使用固定正则化项，无法自动适应数据中的尺度参数和特征变量。引入额外矩阵参数 U 可检测这些结构并提升核岭回归效率，由此产生一个值得深入研究的非线性变分问题。
Method: 论文对该变分问题做数学分析而非提出具体算法：推导并研究其 Euler-Lagrange 方程，考察目标关于 U 的连续性与一阶变分，分析变换退化或发散时的极限行为，并刻画局部极小值的结构。
Result: 摘要未报告数值实验，核心结果是对上述变分问题的基础理论性质给出严格刻画，包括 Euler-Lagrange 方程、连续性与一阶变分、退化/发散变换极限以及局部极小值结构，并在多尺度和多指标两类数据分布下讨论 U 所编码的信息。
Conclusion: 该工作为带可学习线性变换的核学习提供变分理论基础，揭示 U 在多尺度与多指标模型中对内在尺度和低维特征的编码作用。论文为 68 页的修订版，属纯理论性研究。

summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作为带可学习线性变换的核学习提供变分理论基础，揭示 U 在多尺度与多指标模型中对内在尺度和低维特征的编码作用。论文为 68 页的修订版，属纯理论性研究。

papers.title: Explainability in Practice: A Survey of Explainable NLP Across Various Domains
papers.abstract_en: Natural Language Processing (NLP) is now embedded in critical sectors including healthcare, finance, and customer relationship management, where models such as GPT-4o, Gemini, and BERT increasingly inform decisions. The black-box nature of these models has created an urgent need for transparency. This review examines explainable NLP (XNLP) as it is actually deployed, working through seven application domains: medicine, finance, systematic reviews, customer relationship management, chatbots, social and behavioral science, and human resources. For each domain, we ask what kind of explanation the setting needs, which methods are used there, and how they are evaluated. A structured cross-domain synthesis then contrasts how those requirements diverge. We compare the main explanation method families on scope, evidence of faithfulness, and computational cost. We also propose a two-tier evaluation protocol that separates a shared technical core of metrics from the domain-specific validation layer through which those metrics have to be read. The review also addresses areas that remain underrepresented in the XNLP literature, including real-world applicability, the gap between fidelity and faithfulness, and the role of human judgment in assessing explanations. It closes with research directions, among them personalized explanations, human-in-the-loop evaluation, and mechanistic interpretability for large language models.
papers.comment: 32 pages, 5 figures, 15 tables, 257 references. Under review at the Journal of Information Science. Supplementary materials and structured data: https://github.com/mohammadi-hadi/xnlp-survey
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇综述调查可解释NLP（XNLP）在七个应用领域中的实际部署情况，包括医学、金融、系统综述、客户关系管理、聊天机器人、社会和行为科学、人力资源。它对比了主要解释方法族在范围、忠实性证据和计算成本上的差异，并提出一个两层评估协议，将共享的技术指标与领域特定的验证层分开。综述还指出XNLP文献中代表性不足的问题，并给出未来研究方向。
Motivation: GPT-4o、Gemini、BERT等模型在关键领域影响决策，其黑箱特性带来紧迫的透明度需求；现有XNLP研究缺乏对实际部署方式及跨领域解释需求差异的系统梳理。
Method: 采用结构化综述方法，对七个应用领域逐一分析所需解释类型、所用方法和评估方式，并进行跨领域综合对比；同时提出一个两层评估协议，区分通用技术指标与领域特定验证层。
Result: 摘要未报告实证实验结果；其主要贡献在于方法族间的系统对比、对忠实性与保真度差距等未充分探索问题的识别，以及评估协议与研究方向的提出。
Conclusion: 综述强调真实世界适用性、忠实性与保真度之间的差距以及人类判断在评估解释中的作用，并提出个性化解释、人在回路评估和面向大语言模型的机制可解释性等未来方向。

papers.title: Heterogeneous transfer learning for high-dimensional regression with feature mismatch
papers.abstract_en: We study Heterogeneous Transfer Learning (HTL) for high-dimensional regression with differing feature sets. Such feature mismatch arises when some variables available in a data-rich source domain are unavailable in a data-poor target domain. Yet most homogeneous TL methods require the same feature space in both the source and target domains, limiting their practical applicability. Conversely, existing HTL methods lack statistical error guarantees, limiting their utility for scientific discovery. We propose an HTL method that first learns a feature map between the missing and observed features leveraging the vast source data, imputes the unavailable features in the target, and then performs a two-step TL for penalized regression. We consider both the linear and the nonparametric feature maps. We develop upper bounds on the estimation and prediction errors of HTL, assuming that the source and target parameters differ sparsely, without requiring the target model itself to be sparse. We also establish matching minimax lower bounds, showing that the proposed procedures achieve optimal rates. Our results elucidate the effects of model complexity, sample size, the quality and differences in feature maps, and differences in the models across domains. We also derive minimax rates for the misspecified homogeneous TL model that discards unavailable features and show that our HTL procedure can attain a smaller error rate than homogeneous TL. We further extend the framework to multiple source domains and develop a negative-transfer defense that provably excludes adversarial sources from transfer with high probability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究高维回归中特征集不一致的异构迁移学习（HTL），即源域拥有而目标域缺失某些变量的场景。作者提出先利用源域数据学习缺失特征与观测特征之间的映射并对目标域缺失特征进行插补，再执行两步惩罚回归迁移；在源域与目标域参数稀疏差异的假设下给出估计与预测误差上界，并证明匹配的极小化最大（minimax）下界。
Motivation: 现有同构迁移学习方法要求源域与目标域特征空间相同，限制了实际应用；而已有的异构迁移学习方法缺乏统计误差保证，难以支撑科学发现。
Method: 提出一个两步 HTL 流程：先用数据丰富的源域学习缺失特征与观测特征之间的特征映射（分别考虑线性映射和非参数映射），插补目标域不可用特征，再对惩罚回归进行两步迁移。该方法假设源域和目标域参数仅稀疏差异，不要求目标模型本身稀疏；框架还扩展到多源域，并提出一种负迁移防御，能以高概率排除对抗性源域。
Result: 摘要建立了估计误差与预测误差的上界以及匹配的极小化最大下界，证明所提过程达到最优速率；并推导了丢弃缺失特征的同构 TL 模型的极小化最大速率，表明 HTL 能取得更小的误差率。结果还阐明了模型复杂度、样本量、特征映射质量与跨域模型差异的影响。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法在特征不匹配的高维回归中具备可证明的统计保证，并优于同构迁移学习。摘要未报告具体数值实验或数据集。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: ReXrank: A Public Leaderboard for AI-Powered Radiology Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: AI-driven models have demonstrated significant potential in automating radiology report generation for chest X-rays. However, there is no standardized benchmark for objectively evaluating their performance. To address this, we present ReXrank, https://rexrank.ai, a public leaderboard and challenge for assessing AI-powered radiology report generation. Our framework incorporates ReXGradient, the largest test dataset consisting of 10,000 studies, and three public datasets (MIMIC-CXR, IU-Xray, CheXpert Plus) for report generation assessment. ReXrank employs 8 evaluation metrics and separately assesses models capable of generating only findings sections and those providing both findings and impressions sections. By providing this standardized evaluation framework, ReXrank enables meaningful comparisons of model performance and offers crucial insights into their robustness across diverse clinical settings. Beyond its current focus on chest X-rays, ReXrank's framework sets the stage for comprehensive evaluation of automated reporting across the full spectrum of medical imaging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 ReXrank，一个面向 AI 辅助放射学报告生成的公开排行榜与挑战平台。框架包含 ReXGradient（据称由 10,000 例研究构成的最大测试集）以及三个公开数据集（MIMIC-CXR、IU-Xray、CheXpert Plus），采用 8 个评估指标，并分别评估仅生成 findings 部分与同时生成 findings 和 impressions 部分的模型。作者希望通过该标准化评估框架实现模型性能的可比，并洞察其在多样化临床环境中的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 尽管 AI 模型在胸部 X 光报告生成上展现潜力，但目前缺乏客观评估其性能的标准化基准，导致不同模型之间难以进行公平比较。
Method: 提出 ReXrank 平台，整合 ReXGradient 测试集与三个公开数据集，使用 8 个评估指标，并区分仅生成 findings 与同时生成 findings 和 impressions 的模型进行独立评估。
Result: 摘要未报告具体性能数字或排名，主要贡献是提供公开排行榜、最大测试集 ReXGradient，以及跨多样临床环境的鲁棒性评估框架。
Conclusion: 当前聚焦于胸部 X 光，但该框架定位为后续覆盖整个医学影像谱系的自动化报告评估奠定基础；摘要未明确提及局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RankByGene: Gene-Guided Histopathology Representation Learning Through Cross-Modal Ranking Consistency
papers.abstract_en: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) provides essential spatial context by mapping gene expression within tissue, enabling detailed study of cellular heterogeneity and tissue organization. However, aligning ST data with histology images poses challenges due to inherent spatial distortions and modality-specific variations. Existing methods largely rely on direct alignment, which often fails to capture complex cross-modal relationships. To address these limitations, we propose a novel framework that aligns gene and image features using a ranking-based alignment loss, preserving relative similarity across modalities and enabling robust multi-scale alignment. To further enhance the alignment's stability, we employ self-supervised knowledge distillation with a teacher-student network architecture, which serves as an intra-modal stability regularizer that prevents image-representation drift during cross-modal alignment. Extensive experiments on seven public datasets that encompass gene expression prediction, slide-level classification, and survival analysis demonstrate the efficacy of our method, showing improved alignment and predictive performance over existing methods. Code is available at https://github.com/winston52/RankByGene.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RankByGene，一种针对空间转录组学 (spatial transcriptomics, ST) 与组织病理图像对齐的跨模态表示学习框架。方法采用基于排序的对齐损失 (ranking-based alignment loss) 保留跨模态相对相似性，并结合教师-学生网络的自监督知识蒸馏作为模态内稳定性正则项，防止图像表示在跨模态对齐中漂移。在七个公开数据集上的基因表达预测、切片级分类和生存分析实验中，该方法相比现有方法取得更好的对齐与预测性能。
Motivation: 空间转录组学数据与组织学图像的配准面临固有的空间畸变和模态特异性差异，现有方法多依赖直接对齐，难以捕捉复杂的跨模态关系。
Method: 提出基于排序的对齐损失，通过保持跨模态的相对相似性实现鲁棒的多尺度对齐；同时采用教师-学生网络架构进行自监督知识蒸馏，作为模态内稳定性正则器，以避免跨模态对齐过程中图像表示的漂移。
Result: 在涵盖基因表达预测、切片级分类和生存分析的七个公开数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在对齐质量和预测性能上均优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于排序的跨模态对齐配合知识蒸馏能够提升 ST 与组织学图像对齐的稳定性与预测表现，并公开了代码。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A New First-Order Meta-Learning Algorithm with Convergence Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: Learning new tasks by leveraging prior experience is a fundamental trait of intelligent systems. While Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (MAML) is a leading approach, it suffers from significant computational and memory overhead due to the requirement of computing second-order meta-gradients. We propose \textbf{FO-B-MAML}, a novel first-order variant of MAML derived from a bi-level optimization perspective. Our framework introduces a new expression of the meta-gradient, defined as the derivative of the solution of a perturbed optimization problem. This formulation allows the meta-gradient to be estimated using various finite difference methods; in this work, we propose and analyze two simple yet effective estimators: a forward and a symmetric approximation. Unlike existing first-order methods like FO-MAML and Reptile, which suffer from irreducible bias, we prove that FO-B-MAML converges to a stationary point of the meta-objective. Notably, the symmetric estimator achieves an improved $\mathcal{O}(δ^{2/3})$ bias rate, strictly enhancing previous first-order theory. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the MAML objective violates standard smoothness assumptions; we show instead that its smoothness constant grows with the norm of the meta-gradient. This property theoretically justifies the use of normalized or clipped-gradient methods (SNGDM) over vanilla gradient descent. Our empirical results validate these advancements: FO-B-MAML achieves high accuracy, closely following second-order MAML performance. Crucially, our method bypasses the ``activation bottleneck'' of second-order approaches, maintaining a flat memory footprint even when scaling to deep, activation-heavy CNNs and Transformers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FO-B-MAML，一种从双层优化视角推导的 MAML 一阶变体。作者把元梯度定义为扰动优化问题解的导数，并用前向与对称有限差分两种估计器来近似；理论上证明该一阶方法仍收敛到元目标的驻点，对称估计器达到 O(δ^{2/3}) 的偏差率。实验显示其精度接近二阶 MAML，同时内存占用平坦，可扩展到深 CNN 和 Transformer。
Motivation: MAML 依赖二阶元梯度，带来显著的计算与内存开销；已有的一阶近似如 FO-MAML 和 Reptile 存在不可消除的偏差。本文希望在保持一阶计算效率的同时获得收敛保证。
Method: 从双层优化视角重新表达 MAML 元梯度为扰动优化问题解的导数，提出前向和对称两种有限差分估计器；同时指出 MAML 目标的平滑常数随元梯度范数增长，从而理论上支持使用归一化或裁剪梯度方法（SNGDM）。
Result: 证明 FO-B-MAML 收敛到元目标的驻点；对称估计器将偏差率改进为 O(δ^{2/3})，优于此前一阶理论。实验表明精度接近二阶 MAML，且在激活密集的 CNN 与 Transformer 上保持平坦内存足迹，绕开二阶方法的激活瓶颈。
Conclusion: 作者认为一阶元学习可以在收敛性和偏差上弥补与传统 FO-MAML、Reptile 的差距，同时避免二阶方法的计算与内存负担，适合扩展到深层网络。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 FO-B-MAML，一种从双层优化视角推导的 MAML 一阶变体。作者把元梯度定义为扰动优化问题解的导数，并用前向与对称有限差分两种估计器来近似；理论上证明该一阶方法仍收敛到元目标的驻点，对称估计器达到 O(δ^{2/3}) 的偏差率。实验显示其精度接近二阶 MAML，同时内存占用平坦，可扩展到深 CNN 和 Transformer。
summary_sections.motivation: MAML 依赖二阶元梯度，带来显著的计算与内存开销；已有的一阶近似如 FO-MAML 和 Reptile 存在不可消除的偏差。本文希望在保持一阶计算效率的同时获得收敛保证。
summary_sections.method: 从双层优化视角重新表达 MAML 元梯度为扰动优化问题解的导数，提出前向和对称两种有限差分估计器；同时指出 MAML 目标的平滑常数随元梯度范数增长，从而理论上支持使用归一化或裁剪梯度方法（SNGDM）。

papers.title: Causal Agent based on Large Language Model
papers.abstract_en: The large language model (LLM) has achieved significant success across various domains. However, the inherent complexity of causal problems and causal theory poses challenges in accurately describing them in natural language, making it difficult for LLM to comprehend and use them effectively. Causal methods are not easily conveyed through natural language, which hinders LLM's ability to apply them accurately. Additionally, causal datasets are typically tabular, while LLM excels in handling natural language data, creating a structural mismatch that impedes effective reasoning with tabular data. To address these challenges, we have equipped the LLM with causal tools within an agent framework, named the Causal Agent, enabling it to tackle causal problems. The causal agent comprises tools, memory, and reasoning modules. In the tool module, the causal agent calls Python code and uses the encapsulated causal function module to align tabular data with natural language. In the reasoning module, the causal agent performs reasoning through multiple iterations with the tools. In the memory module, the causal agent maintains a dictionary instance where the keys are unique names and the values are causal graphs. To verify the causal ability of the causal agent, we established a Causal Tabular Question Answer (CausalTQA) benchmark consisting of four levels of causal problems: variable level, edge level, causal graph level, and causal effect level. CausalTQA consists of about 1.4K for these four levels questions. Causal agent demonstrates remarkable efficacy on the four-level causal problems, with accuracy rates all above 80\%. Through verification on the real-world dataset QRData, the causal agent is 6\% higher than the original SOTA. For further insights and implementation details, our code is accessible via the GitHub repository https://github.com/kairong-han/causal_agent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Causal Agent，一个将因果工具集成进大语言模型（LLM）智能体的框架，用于解决因果相关问题。该框架包含工具、记忆和推理三个模块：工具模块调用 Python 代码和封装的因果函数来对齐表格数据与自然语言，推理模块通过多轮迭代完成因果推理，记忆模块以字典形式存储因果图。作者构建了包含约 1.4K 个问题的 CausalTQA 基准，覆盖变量级、边级、因果图级和因果效应级四类问题，并报告该智能体在四个层级上的准确率均超过 80%。
Motivation: 因果问题和因果理论本身复杂，难以用自然语言精确描述，导致 LLM 难以准确理解和使用因果方法；同时因果数据通常是表格形式，与 LLM 擅长的自然语言数据存在结构不匹配，阻碍了其基于表格数据进行有效推理。
Method: 在 LLM 外构建智能体框架，通过工具模块调用 Python 代码和封装的因果函数模块来弥合表格数据与自然语言之间的差异；推理模块利用工具进行多轮迭代推理；记忆模块维护一个键为唯一名称、值为因果图的字典实例。
Result: 在自建的 CausalTQA 基准（约 1.4K 个问题）上，Causal Agent 在变量级、边级、因果图级和因果效应级四类问题上的准确率均高于 80%；在真实世界数据集 QRData 上比原有 SOTA 高 6%。
Conclusion: 作者认为将因果工具集成到智能体框架中能够显著增强 LLM 解决因果问题的能力，并开源代码；摘要未明确讨论方法的局限性。

papers.title: Deep Activity Model: A Generative Approach for Human Mobility Pattern Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Human mobility plays a crucial role in transportation, urban planning, and public health, but current approaches face important limitations. Existing deep learning models tend to overlook the semantic interdependencies among activities and households and rely on restricted GPS data, while activity-based models depend on rigid assumptions and extensive data, making them costly and difficult to adapt to new regions, especially those with limited conventional travel data. To address these limitations, we propose a generative Transformer model that uses socio-demographic and household attributes to synthesize daily activity chains, with a location module assigning spatial zones to produce complete daily trajectories. Trained on open-source and widely available household travel survey data and then fine-tuned with local data, the model captures national activity patterns and transfers effectively to California, Washington, and Mexico City. This approach offers potential for advancing synthetic human mobility modeling and provides urban planners and policymakers with improved tools for simulating transportation systems and supporting decisions in urban development and public health. Its practical utility is demonstrated through large-scale traffic simulations in Los Angeles County. Compared to the SCAG Activity-Based Model (ABM), the proposed method produces consistent spatial demand patterns, achieving an activity location cosine similarity of 0.997 and a network-level vehicle-miles-traveled Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of 4.97%. Compared to real-world observations from Caltrans PeMS, the simulated traffic achieves MAPE of 5.85% for traffic volume and 4.36% for speed on California's I-405 corridor, presenting the practicality of learning-based synthetic mobility for regional simulation and planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种生成式 Transformer 模型，利用社会人口与家庭属性合成每日活动链，并通过位置模块分配空间区域以生成完整日轨迹。模型在大规模开源 household travel survey 数据上训练，再用本地数据微调，可迁移至加利福尼亚、华盛顿和墨西哥城。在洛杉矶县的交通模拟中，该方法与 SCAG 活动基模型 (ABM) 相比，活动位置余弦相似度为 0.997，网络级车英里数 MAPE 为 4.97%；与 Caltrans PeMS 实测相比，I-405 走廊的交通流量 MAPE 为 5.85%，速度 MAPE 为 4.36%。
Motivation: 现有深度学习移动性模型忽视活动与家庭之间的语义依赖，且依赖受限的 GPS 数据；基于活动的方法则依赖刚性假设和大量数据，成本高且难以迁移到数据有限的新区域。
Method: 提出一个生成式 Transformer 模型，以社会人口和家庭属性为条件生成每日活动链，并设计位置模块将活动分配至空间区域，从而生成完整日轨迹。模型先在开源 household travel survey 上训练以捕捉全国性活动模式，再通过本地数据微调实现区域迁移。
Result: 在洛杉矶县大规模交通模拟中，该方法与 SCAG 活动基模型相比取得 0.997 的活动位置余弦相似度和 4.97% 的网络级车英里数 MAPE；与 Caltrans PeMS 实测相比，在 I-405 走廊上交通流量 MAPE 为 5.85%，速度 MAPE 为 4.36%。
Conclusion: 该研究展示了基于学习的合成移动性建模在区域交通模拟和规划中的实用性，可为城市规划者和政策制定者提供改进的交通系统模拟工具。

papers.title: Weak Correlations as the Underlying Principle for Linearization of Gradient-Based Learning Systems
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models, such as wide neural networks, can be conceptualized as nonlinear dynamical physical systems characterized by a multitude of interacting degrees of freedom. Such systems in the infinite limit, tend to exhibit simplified dynamics. This paper delves into gradient descent-based learning algorithms, that display a linear structure in their parameter dynamics, reminiscent of the neural tangent kernel. We establish this apparent linearity arises due to weak correlations between the first and higher-order derivatives of the hypothesis function, concerning the parameters, taken around their initial values. This insight suggests that these weak correlations could be the underlying reason for the observed linearization in such systems. As a case in point, we showcase this weak correlations structure within neural networks in the large width limit. Exploiting the relationship between linearity and weak correlations, we derive a bound on deviations from linearity observed during the training trajectory of stochastic gradient descent. To facilitate our proof, we introduce a novel method to characterise the asymptotic behavior of random tensors.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于梯度下降的学习算法中参数动力学的线性化现象，提出其源于假设函数关于参数的一阶与高阶导数在初始值附近的弱关联。作者在大宽度极限下的神经网络中展示这种弱关联结构，并利用线性与弱关联的关系推导随机梯度下降训练轨迹偏离线性性的界；证明中引入刻画随机张量渐近行为的新方法。
Motivation: 深度学习模型如宽神经网络可视为具有多自由度相互作用的非线性动力系统，在无限极限下动力学趋于简化。论文目标是解释梯度下降算法中类似神经正切核（NTK）的线性参数动力学的成因。
Method: 建立弱关联作为线性化的潜在机制：假设函数关于参数的一阶与高阶导数在初始值附近的弱关联导致表观线性；在大宽度极限下展示该结构，并引入刻画随机张量渐近行为的新方法，以推导SGD训练轨迹偏离线性性的上界。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值实验，主要理论结果是推导了随机梯度下降训练过程中偏离线性性的界，并在大宽度神经网络中佐证弱关联结构。
Conclusion: 论文提出弱关联可能是观测到的线性化的根本原因，并用该关系得到偏离线性性的理论界；为证明引入了随机张量渐近行为的新工具。

papers.title: Un-EVIMO: Unsupervised Event-Based Independent Motion Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Event cameras are a novel type of biologically inspired vision sensor known for their high temporal resolution, high dynamic range, and low power consumption. Because of these properties, they are well-suited for processing fast motions that require rapid reactions. Although event cameras have recently shown competitive performance in unsupervised optical flow estimation, performance in detecting independently moving objects (IMOs) is lacking behind, although event-based methods would be suited for this task based on their low latency and HDR properties. Previous approaches to event-based IMO segmentation have been heavily dependent on labeled data. However, biological vision systems have developed the ability to avoid moving objects through daily tasks without being given explicit labels. In this work, we propose the first event framework that generates IMO pseudo-labels using geometric constraints. Due to its unsupervised nature, our method can handle an arbitrary number of not predetermined objects and is easily scalable to datasets where expensive IMO labels are not readily available. We evaluate our approach on the EVIMO dataset and show that it performs competitively with supervised methods, both quantitatively and qualitatively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Un-EVIMO，据称是首个无监督的事件相机独立运动分割 (independent motion segmentation, IMO) 框架。它利用几何约束生成 IMO 伪标签，从而不依赖人工标注，可处理任意数量且未预先指定的物体，并易于扩展到缺乏昂贵 IMO 标签的数据集。作者在 EVIMO 数据集上评估，称其定量与定性结果均与有监督方法具有竞争力。
Motivation: 事件相机具有高时间分辨率、高动态范围和低功耗，适合快速运动场景，但事件数据上的独立运动物体分割性能仍落后于光流等任务，且现有方法严重依赖带标签数据。作者指出生物视觉无需显式标签即可学会避开运动物体，因此试图消除这种标签依赖。
Method: 提出第一个利用几何约束来生成 IMO 伪标签的事件数据框架；由于整个过程无需监督，方法不预设物体数量，并可扩展到没有现成 IMO 标签的数据集。
Result: 在 EVIMO 数据集上的评估显示，该方法在定量和定性两方面都能与有监督方法竞争。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该工作的核心价值在于以无监督方式降低对昂贵 IMO 标注的依赖，同时保持与有监督方法相当的性能，适合事件相机下的快速运动目标分割任务。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Soft-Attention Improves Skin Cancer Classification Performance
papers.abstract_en: In clinical applications, neural networks must focus on and highlight the most important parts of an input image. Soft-Attention mechanism enables a neural network toachieve this goal. This paper investigates the effectiveness of Soft-Attention in deep neural architectures. The central aim of Soft-Attention is to boost the value of important features and suppress the noise-inducing features. We compare the performance of VGG, ResNet, InceptionResNetv2 and DenseNet architectures with and without the Soft-Attention mechanism, while classifying skin lesions. The original network when coupled with Soft-Attention outperforms the baseline[16] by 4.7% while achieving a precision of 93.7% on HAM10000 dataset [25]. Additionally, Soft-Attention coupling improves the sensitivity score by 3.8% compared to baseline[31] and achieves 91.6% on ISIC-2017 dataset [2]. The code is publicly available at github.
papers.journal_ref: Publication date: 2021/9/21; Conference: Interpretability of Machine Intelligence in Medical Image Computing; Issue: 978-3-030-87444-5; Pages: 13-23; Publisher: Springer, Cham
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Soft-Attention 机制对深度神经网络在皮肤病变分类任务上的效果，将 VGG、ResNet、InceptionResNetv2、DenseNet 四种架构分别与 Soft-Attention 耦合，并在 HAM10000 和 ISIC-2017 数据集上比较有无该机制的性能。摘要报告 Soft-Attention 耦合后的网络在 HAM10000 上达到 93.7% 的精度，比基线提高 4.7%；在 ISIC-2017 上灵敏度达到 91.6%，比基线提高 3.8%。
Motivation: 在临床应用场景中，神经网络需要聚焦并突出输入图像中最重要的区域，而 Soft-Attention 机制被认为能帮助网络实现这一目标。论文旨在系统评估 Soft-Attention 对多种深度架构在皮肤癌分类任务中的有效性。
Method: 作者在 VGG、ResNet、InceptionResNetv2 和 DenseNet 四种深度神经网络架构上耦合 Soft-Attention 机制，比较其与未耦合版本在皮肤病变分类中的表现；Soft-Attention 的核心思想是增强重要特征并抑制引入噪声的特征。
Result: 在 HAM10000 数据集上，带 Soft-Attention 的原始网络比基线高出 4.7%，精度达 93.7%；在 ISIC-2017 数据集上，灵敏度比基线提高 3.8%，达到 91.6%。代码已在 GitHub 公开。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 Soft-Attention 耦合能一致提升多种深度架构在皮肤癌分类上的性能，证明了该机制在医学图像分类中的价值。

papers.title: Do Influence Tactics Matter? Investigating Prompt Framing Effects in LLM Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into software engineering workflows, helping developers write, debug, test, and maintain code. While prompt wording and structure are known to influence model performance, the impact of psychologically inspired prompt framings remains unexplored. This study investigates whether different psychology-based communication strategies that humans use to persuade or motivate others can lead to more effective prompt framing, which may, in turn, affect LLM behaviour in coding tasks. Drawing on Yukl & Falbe's well-known taxonomy, we operationalized eight influence tactics (like rational persuasion, ingratiation, and exchange) into reproducible prompt templates. These prompt templates were evaluated across five leading open-weight LLMs using two widely adopted benchmarks: LiveCodeBench and SWE-bench Verified. We assessed the resulting code output on four key software quality dimensions: functional correctness, quality, maintainability, and security. Our results show that certain influence-induced prompt framings, particularly those emphasizing urgency, were associated with reduced correctness and security. This work presents the first large-scale empirical study of influence-induced prompt framing in software engineering tasks, offering insights into how linguistic cues may shape LLM outputs. We conclude with practical insights for designing transparent and interpretable human-AI interactions in code generation.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in Empirical Software Engineering. This is the accepted manuscript version. 37 pages, 3 figures
papers.journal_ref: Empirical Software Engineering 32 (2026) 13
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次大规模研究心理学启发的提示框架对 LLM 代码生成的影响。作者基于 Yukl & Falbe 的影响力策略分类，将八种影响策略（如理性说服、讨好、交换）操作化为可复现提示模板，在五个开源权重 LLM 上用 LiveCodeBench 和 SWE-bench Verified 基准评估，并从功能正确性、质量、可维护性和安全性四个维度分析输出。结果显示，某些强调紧迫性的提示框架与正确性和安全性的下降相关。
Motivation: 提示措辞和结构已知会影响模型性能，但心理学启发的人际说服策略是否影响 LLM 代码生成行为尚未被探索；该研究填补这一空白，并为设计透明、可解释的人机交互提供依据。
Method: 将 Yukl & Falbe 的八种影响策略操作化为可复现的提示模板，在五个领先的开源权重 LLM 上结合 LiveCodeBench 和 SWE-bench Verified 两个基准进行评估，按功能正确性、质量、可维护性和安全性四个软件质量维度衡量代码输出。
Result: 摘要报告某些影响策略诱发的提示框架，尤其是强调紧迫性的框架，与代码正确性和安全性的降低相关；这是软件工程任务中影响诱导提示框架的首个大规模实证研究。
Conclusion: 研究指出语言线索可能塑造 LLM 输出，并为设计透明、可解释的人机交互中的代码生成提供实践见解。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Let it Cook: Learning to Wait in Sequential Decision Making
papers.abstract_en: In sequential decision making, an agent typically observes its environment and acts at every timestep. However, such active participation may not always be necessary; tasks such as brewing coffee include periods that are served equally well by letting the environment evolve without constant monitoring and control. During such periods, the agent could simply wait to conserve its resources, or redirect its attention to another task. We capitalize on these opportunities by training a "waiting policy" that decides where and how long to wait. This involves forgoing sensing to commit to a wait action, representing a deliberate pause for a set number of timesteps. We formalize "learning to wait" as minimizing the frequency of sensing and decision making without sacrificing task performance (e.g., the total amount of time to complete a task). To train a waiting policy, we propose an approach that employs reinforcement learning with lexicographically ordered objectives. In experiments across 4 discrete-state household tasks and 3 continuous-state environments, we show that our approach successfully learns waiting behaviors, and can adapt pre-trained policies to wait where appropriate. While different tasks permit different amounts of waiting without sacrificing task performance, our approach consistently finds solutions with significant waiting, sometimes waiting for over 50 percent of the task duration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出在序贯决策中学习“等待”的策略，允许智能体在无需频繁感知和决策的时间段内暂停行动，以节省资源或转移注意力。作者将“学习等待”形式化为在不牺牲任务表现（如任务完成总时间）的前提下最小化感知与决策频率，并提出基于词典序目标 (lexicographically ordered objectives) 的强化学习方法。在 4 个离散状态家务任务和 3 个连续状态环境中验证了该方法。
Motivation: 传统序贯决策假设智能体每一步都观察并行动，但许多任务（如煮咖啡）包含无需持续监控和控制的阶段。等待可以节省资源或转向其他任务，但现有方法未系统利用这一机会。
Method: 训练一个等待策略，决定在哪里等待以及等待多久，即放弃 sensing 并提交一个持续若干时间步的等待动作。训练采用带词典序目标的强化学习，在保持任务表现的同时最小化感知和决策频率，并能适配预训练策略。
Result: 在 4 个离散状态家务任务和 3 个连续状态环境中，该方法成功学到等待行为并可适配预训练策略；不同任务允许的等待量不同，但方法一致地找到显著等待的解决方案，有时等待时间超过任务时长的 50%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调学习等待可以在不牺牲任务表现的情况下大幅减少感知和决策，但未在摘要中说明对感知噪声或动态环境的鲁棒性等适用范围。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Conflict and Congruency Effects in Large Language Models: In-Weight and In-Context Competition in a Verbal Conflict Task
papers.abstract_en: Congruency effects, observed in conflict tasks such as Stroop and flanker tasks, have been investigated for nearly a century in psychology and neuroscience, but their mechanistic basis is not fully understood. We introduce a verbal-only LLM conflict task in which a prompt stem elicits a default same-color completion and an explicit rule either agrees with (congruent condition) or conflicts with (incongruent condition) the completion. Gemma-2-2B and six Pythia models ranging from 410M to 12B parameters showed strong default same-color tendencies, and six of seven models showed strong congruency effects. Using causal attribution analysis, attention analysis, and attention ablations, we identified distinct processing pathways in these LLMs: a pathway involving short-range attention to a superficial color cue that is preferentially activated in the congruent condition, and a pathway involving long-range attention to the rule prefix that is preferentially activated in the incongruent condition. Fine-tuning that strengthened the default same-color tendency had divergent effects on task conditions, reducing incongruent performance while increasing congruent performance. In contrast, increasing rule set size selectively impaired incongruent performance. These converging findings support an account in which congruency effects in this task arise from competition between an in-weight default mapping and an in-context rule-based mapping. More broadly, our findings illustrate how LLMs can serve as model systems for mechanistic analysis of competition between default and rule-governed response tendencies within a single learned network.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个纯语言的 LLM 冲突任务（类似 Stroop/flanker 的变体）：提示词干会诱发默认的同色补全，显式规则要么与该补全一致（congruent）要么冲突（incongruent）。Gemma-2-2B 和六种 Pythia 模型（410M 到 12B 参数）都表现出强烈的默认同色倾向，七个模型中有六个表现出强烈的 congruency 效应。通过因果归因分析、注意力分析和注意力消融，作者识别出两条不同的处理通路：congruent 条件下优先激活对表层颜色线索的短程注意，incongruent 条件下优先激活对规则前缀的长程注意。作者认为这些结果支持该任务中的 congruency 效应源于权重内默认映射与上下文内基于规则的映射之间的竞争。
Motivation: 心理学和神经科学对 Stroop 与 flanker 等冲突任务中的 congruency 效应已研究近一个世纪，但其机制基础尚未完全理解。作者希望借助 LLM 作为可分析的学习网络模型系统，来研究冲突任务中默认反应倾向与规则支配反应倾向之间竞争的机械基础。
Method: 引入一个纯语言的 LLM 冲突任务，其中提示词干诱发默认同色补全，显式规则与其一致或冲突；随后使用因果归因分析、注意力分析和注意力消融来定位处理通路，并通过微调强化默认同色倾向以及改变规则集大小来操纵任务条件。
Result: 摘要报告 Gemma-2-2B 和六种 Pythia 模型表现出强烈的默认同色倾向，七个模型中有六个表现出强烈的 congruency 效应；强化默认倾向的微调对两种条件产生相反效果（降低 incongruent 表现、提高 congruent 表现），而增大规则集大小则选择性损害 incongruent 表现。
Conclusion: 这些结果支持一个解释：该任务中的 congruency 效应来自权重内默认映射与上下文内规则映射之间的竞争，并说明 LLM 可以作为单一学习网络中默认与规则支配反应倾向竞争机制分析的模型系统。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RelShap: Relationally Consistent Shapley Explanations
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning pipelines commonly flatten relational data into single-table representations, discarding structural constraints. Widely used Shapley value-based feature attributions then rely on feature independence, evaluating the model on combinations that could never arise in the underlying data, producing misleading explanations. We propose RelShap, a framework that incorporates relational constraints and data provenance into Shapley value computation, restricting both background data and coalition evaluation to relationally valid configurations. The framework is estimator-agnostic and composes with Kernel SHAP, Monte Carlo, and Leverage SHAP without altering their sampling or weighting properties. Functional dependencies further induce equivalence classes over feature coalitions, which RelShap exploits to reduce runtime without changing Shapley values; we provide a combinatorial characterization of the expected speedup. Experiments across multiple datasets, models, and estimators show that RelShap produces explanations that are more faithful to the data-generating process, correctly identifying the dominant feature in controlled settings where existing methods, including Conditional SHAP and ManifoldShap, do not. Our code is available at: https://github.com/duneag2/relshap.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RelShap，一个将关系约束与数据血缘 (data provenance) 纳入 Shapley 值计算的框架，把背景数据和特征联盟 (coalition) 都限制在关系上有效的配置内。该框架与估计器无关，可与 Kernel SHAP、Monte Carlo 和 Leverage SHAP 组合而不改变其采样或加权性质。实验表明 RelShap 生成的解释更贴合数据生成过程，在受控设置中能正确识别主导特征，而 Conditional SHAP 和 ManifoldShap 不能。
Motivation: 机器学习流水线常把关系数据展平为单表表示，丢弃结构约束；广泛使用的 Shapley 值特征归因又依赖特征独立性，会在原始数据中不可能出现的组合上评估模型，从而产生误导性解释。
Method: RelShap 在 Shapley 值计算中引入关系约束和数据血缘，限制背景数据与联盟评估只能取关系上有效的配置；框架是估计器无关的，并利用函数依赖 (functional dependencies) 在特征联盟上诱导出的等价类来降低运行时间，同时不改变 Shapley 值。
Result: 作者给出期望加速的组合刻画；在多个数据集、模型和估计器上的实验显示，RelShap 的解释更忠实于数据生成过程，在受控场景下能正确识别主导特征，而现有方法如 Conditional SHAP 和 ManifoldShap 不能。
Conclusion: RelShap 提供了一种在保留关系结构的前提下计算 Shapley 解释的通用框架，既提升解释保真度又可利用函数依赖加速；代码已公开。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: RelShap 在 Shapley 值计算中引入关系约束和数据血缘，限制背景数据与联盟评估只能取关系上有效的配置；框架是估计器无关的，并利用函数依赖 (functional dependencies) 在特征联盟上诱导出的等价类来降低运行时间，同时不改变 Shapley 值。
summary_sections.result: 作者给出期望加速的组合刻画；在多个数据集、模型和估计器上的实验显示，RelShap 的解释更忠实于数据生成过程，在受控场景下能正确识别主导特征，而现有方法如 Conditional SHAP 和 ManifoldShap 不能。
summary_sections.conclusion: RelShap 提供了一种在保留关系结构的前提下计算 Shapley 解释的通用框架，既提升解释保真度又可利用函数依赖加速；代码已公开。

papers.title: Strengthening Full Justified Representation: Efficient Verification and Computation
papers.abstract_en: Full justified representation (FJR) is among the strongest known satisfiable proportionality axioms for approval-based committee elections. Recent work has shown that an FJR committee can be found in polynomial time, but verifying whether a given committee satisfies FJR remains coNP-complete. We introduce FJR+, a strict strengthening of FJR and EJR+ that can be verified and satisfied in polynomial time. We then analyze the Residual-Budget Greedy (RBG) algorithm and prove that it selects a partial committee such that every size-$k$ completion satisfies FJR+. This freedom allows us to use sequential Phragmén to obtain a priceable completion. The resulting rule always satisfies FJR+ and the sub-core, and it is priceable whenever at least $k$ candidates receive an approval. We also obtain a Droop-quota version of FJR+. Finally, we extend FJR+ to approval-based participatory budgeting with arbitrary project costs. A project-specific version of RBG computes this property in polynomial time and can be continued to a priceable outcome satisfying a cost-based version of the sub-core.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对批准型委员会选举 (approval-based committee election) 中的比例性公理 FJR (full justified representation) 展开研究。作者提出 FJR+，它是 FJR 与 EJR+ 的严格强化版本，并且满足 FJR+ 的委员会可以在多项式时间内验证和求解。文中证明 Residual-Budget Greedy (RBG) 算法选出的部分委员会使任意大小为 k 的完成结果都满足 FJR+，再结合顺序 Phragmén 可得到 priceable 的完成方案；该性质还扩展到带任意项目成本的参与式预算。
Motivation: FJR 是已知最强的可满足比例性公理之一，近期工作表明可在多项式时间内找到满足 FJR 的委员会，但验证给定委员会是否满足 FJR 仍是 coNP-complete，缺少高效的验证与构造途径。
Method: 引入 FJR+ 这一更强的公理，使其可被多项式时间验证和满足；分析 Residual-Budget Greedy (RBG) 算法，证明其选择的部分委员会的所有 size-k 完成都满足 FJR+，并利用这一自由度通过顺序 Phragmén 得到 priceable 完成。还给出 FJR+ 的 Droop-quota 版本，并推广到具有任意项目成本的批准型参与式预算。
Result: 摘要报告：RBG 输出的部分委员会保证每个 size-k 完成都满足 FJR+；由此得到的规则总是满足 FJR+ 与 sub-core，且在至少有 k 个候选获得批准时是 priceable。对于参与式预算，项目特定版本的 RBG 可在多项式时间内计算相应性质，并能续接为满足基于成本的 sub-core 的 priceable 结果。
Conclusion: FJR+ 在保持强比例性保证的同时实现了多项式时间的验证与满足，并自然延伸到成本感知的参与式预算场景，扩大了可高效处理的强比例性公理族。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HyperFix: Combinatorial Nonlinear Correction for Task Vector Merging
papers.abstract_en: Task vectors enable model merging without joint retraining. In practice, the subset of task vectors to be merged may vary, but many existing methods use scalar tuning for a particular subset, requiring repeated tuning across subsets and restricting task vector merging to linear rescaling. We therefore formulate merging across varying task subsets as a combinatorial correction problem and introduce HyperFix, a lightweight hypernetwork that predicts subset-conditioned nonlinear corrections in weight space. Trained once on singleton, pair, and triple subsets from a task bank, HyperFix generalizes to larger subsets without per-subset optimization. Our local perturbation analysis bounds the residual correction beyond linear merging and motivates learning it from small task updates. Experiments across diverse benchmarks show that HyperFix outperforms existing task vector merging methods while reducing tuning cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HyperFix，一个轻量级超网络，用于在权重空间中为任务向量合并 (task vector merging) 预测子集条件的非线性修正。针对合并子集变化时现有方法需要重复标量调参且仅限于线性缩放的局限，HyperFix 一次性在任务库的单/双/三元组子集上训练，即可泛化到更大子集。摘要报告其在多个基准上优于现有任务向量合并方法并降低调参成本。
Motivation: 实际应用中待合并的任务向量子集可能变化，而现有方法多针对特定子集做标量调参，子集变化时需要重复调参，且将任务向量合并限制在线性重缩放的范围内。
Method: 将不同任务子集上的合并形式化为组合修正问题，提出超网络 HyperFix 在权重空间中预测依赖子集的非线性修正；在单、双、三元组子集上训练一次，无需逐子集优化。通过局部扰动分析界定线性合并之外的残差修正，并从小任务更新中学习该修正。
Result: 摘要称在多样基准上 HyperFix 优于现有任务向量合并方法，同时降低了调参成本；未报告具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 HyperFix 可泛化到更大任务子集且无需 per-subset 优化，表明组合非线性修正能提升任务向量合并效果并减少调参开销。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Language-Structured Relational Q-Learning for Threat-Aware Control in Safety-Critical Driving
papers.abstract_en: Natural-language-based scenario generation offers an intuitive means of describing rare and complex driving interactions, yet it is still uncertain whether training with language-structured data leads to truly adaptive control policies. We propose Language-Structured Relational Q-Learning, instantiated through an Ego-Centric Relational Q-Network (ERQ-Net), which jointly learns inter-vehicle relevance and action values from dynamic traffic graphs. Language descriptions define surrounding-vehicle behaviours during training, while prompts and semantic actor roles are hidden from the policy. ERQ-Net must therefore infer threat relevance solely from observable kinematics and interactions. Across 2,500 safety-critical scenarios, language-structured training improves test success from 49-52% to 55-58% and increases adversary-focused attention from 1.2x to 2.1x, demonstrating emergent threat awareness. However, this representational gain does not consistently translate into adaptive control: trained policies perform similarly to the best constant action, while a portfolio of simple policies solves 76% of scenarios. We formalise this discrepancy as a recognition-control gap and show that reward reweighting and margin shaping do not eliminate the resulting policy collapse. Evaluations of realism, criticality, semantic accuracy, and transfer of state-interface representations to CARLA further highlight both the strengths and the constraints of language-structured relational policy learning in safety-critical driving scenarios.
papers.comment: Accepted manuscript: Workshop on Emerging Behaviors in Embodied AI for Achieving Robust Autonomy as part of European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Language-Structured Relational Q-Learning，以 Ego-Centric Relational Q-Network (ERQ-Net) 实现，在动态交通图上联合学习车辆间相关性和动作价值。训练时用自然语言描述周围车辆行为，但测试时隐藏语言提示与语义角色，迫使策略仅从可观测运动学推断威胁相关性。在 2500 个安全关键场景中，语言结构化训练将测试成功率从 49-52% 提高到 55-58%，并将对手聚焦注意力从 1.2x 增至 2.1x；作者将此差异形式化为 recognition-control gap，指出表征提升并未稳定转化为自适应控制。
Motivation: 自然语言场景生成能直观描述罕见且复杂的驾驶交互，但语言结构化数据训练能否产生真正自适应且安全关键的控制策略仍不确定，威胁感知控制在安全关键驾驶中尤为重要。
Method: 提出基于 ERQ-Net 的关系型 Q 学习方法，利用动态交通图联合估计车辆间相关性（relevance）与动作价值；语言描述仅在训练阶段定义周围车辆行为，测试时对策略隐藏 prompts 和语义角色，使其仅依据可观测运动学推断威胁相关性。
Result: 在 2500 个安全关键场景中，语言结构化训练将测试成功率从 49-52% 提升至 55-58%，并将对手聚焦注意力从 1.2x 增至 2.1x。但训练策略表现与最优恒定动作相当，而简单策略组合可解决 76% 的场景；奖励重加权和 margin shaping 未能消除策略坍缩。
Conclusion: 作者将语言结构带来的表征收益与自适应控制不足之间的差距形式化为 recognition-control gap，并通过对真实性、关键性、语义准确性以及向 CARLA 的状态-接口迁移评估，指出语言结构化关系策略学习在安全关键驾驶中的优势与约束。
Relevance: 3
