papers.title: Defending against Model Extraction for GNNs with Model Reprogramming
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) serve as the backbone for high-stakes applications in Machine-Learning-as-a-Service (MLaaS). Still, their black-box deployment exposes them to Model Extraction (ME) attacks, in which adversaries steal intellectual property by querying APIs. Existing defenses suffer from a critical ''Euclidean bias'': they transfer image-based strategies (e.g., random noise) to graphs, ignoring the complex topological dependencies between nodes, which often results in severe utility degradation. Passive methods like watermarking also fail to prevent theft in real time. To bridge this gap, we propose GraphRP (Graph Reprogramming Protection), a proactive defense framework that repurposes Model Reprogramming for security. Unlike static perturbations, GraphRP introduces a Structure-Aware Gating Mechanism driven by learnable topological prototypes. This creates a dynamic ''structural firewall'' that selectively modulates the model's decision boundary: it preserves fidelity for benign queries residing on the training manifold, while maximizing the Fisher Information along the perturbation direction for adversarial queries. Under standard assumptions (bounded loss, optimal attacker, and local second-order approximation), we prove a lower bound on the attacker's estimation error that increases with the structural sensitivity of the reprogramming noise. Extensive experiments on both hard-label and soft-label ME attacks demonstrate that GraphRP significantly degrades attack effectiveness while preserving benign utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GraphRP（Graph Reprogramming Protection），一个用于 GNN 模型提取攻击的主动防御框架。它借用模型重编程（model reprogramming）思想，通过结构感知门控机制和可学习拓扑原型构建动态"结构防火墙"，在保持良性查询效用的同时干扰敌对查询。理论上证明攻击者估计误差的下界，实验表明能显著降低硬标签与软标签模型提取攻击的有效性。
Motivation: 现有 GNN 防御存在"欧几里得偏差"，将图像领域的随机噪声等策略直接迁移到图上，忽略图节点间的拓扑依赖，导致严重效用退化；被动水印方法也无法实时阻止模型窃取。
Method: GraphRP 将模型重编程用于安全防御，核心是结构感知门控机制（Structure-Aware Gating Mechanism），由可学习拓扑原型驱动，动态调制模型决策边界：对训练流形上的良性查询保留保真度，对对抗查询沿扰动方向最大化 Fisher Information。
Result: 在标准假设（有界损失、最优攻击者、局部二阶近似）下，证明攻击者估计误差的下界随重编程噪声的结构敏感性（structural sensitivity）增加；在硬标签和软标签模型提取攻击上的大量实验显示，GraphRP 显著降低攻击有效性，同时保持良性查询效用。
Conclusion: 该工作将模型重编程从任务迁移工具重新定位为安全防御手段，强调通过动态结构防火墙在防御 GNN 模型提取攻击与维持良性效用之间取得平衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Prompting to Behavioral Alignment: Personalized LLM Judges for Recommendation Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Traditional offline recommendation evaluation relies heavily on complex, manually maintained feature pipelines that are difficult to scale. While Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a promising alternative by predicting user engagement directly from raw text logs, empirical analysis in this study identifies a critical failure mode termed bidirectional rationalization. In a zero-shot setting, LLMs are found to convincingly argue for both positive and negative user engagement outcomes on the exact same item with identical evidence, highlighting the unreliability of off-the-shelf LLMs in predicting user engagement. To resolve this, we develop and apply a sequential behavioral alignment framework pairing fine-tuning with preference optimization over paired correct and counterfactual rationales. Evaluated on real-world homepage interaction logs, this aligned reasoning approach achieves a 32.19\% lift in Macro-F1 score over the zero-shot baseline and matches the production feature-engineered baseline. The results demonstrate that behavioral alignment mitigates bidirectional rationalization while delivering human-interpretable reasoning traces without manual pipeline overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究直接用 LLM 从原始文本日志预测用户参与度以替代传统离线推荐评估的可行性，并发现零样本 LLM 存在名为双向合理化 (bidirectional rationalization) 的失效模式：面对完全相同的物品与证据，模型能分别给出正反两种用户参与结论。作者提出顺序行为对齐框架，将微调与偏好优化配对，在真实首页交互日志上使 Macro-F1 较零样本基线提升 32.19%，并与生产级特征工程基线持平。
Motivation: 传统离线推荐评估依赖复杂且难以扩展的人工维护特征管线；LLM 虽能直接从原始文本预测用户参与度，但实证分析显示现成 LLM 在零样本下预测不可靠。
Method: 提出顺序行为对齐 (sequential behavioral alignment) 框架，将微调与偏好优化 (preference optimization) 结合，在成对的正例与反事实推理 (counterfactual rationales) 上进行训练。
Result: 在真实首页交互日志上，该方法较零样本基线取得 32.19% 的 Macro-F1 提升，并达到生产环境特征工程基线的水平。
Conclusion: 行为对齐能缓解双向合理化问题，同时提供人类可解释的推理轨迹，且无需人工管线开销。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Cross-Corpus Evaluation of Generalizable Vulnerability Detection in IoT Firmware
papers.abstract_en: IoT firmware vulnerability detection remains challenging due to heterogeneous firmware ecosystems, resource-constrained platforms, and limitations in existing benchmarks. Many datasets are synthetic or general-purpose and lack human-verified, contamination-screened annotations, limiting evidence on cross-corpus generalization across training sources, model architectures, and curriculum strategies. To address this gap, this paper introduces IoTVulBench, a human-verified benchmark for cross-corpus firmware vulnerability detection. IoTVulBench-Core was constructed from GitHub repositories, validated by three expert reviewers, and evaluated on a contamination-screened held-out target across five model architectures, two tuning methods, and three curriculum strategies, with ensemble, distillation, and robustness analyses. Models trained on IoTVulBench achieved the highest MCC among matched single-source datasets, reaching 0.58 versus 0.44 for PrimeVul and 0.39 for D2A. Staged curriculum learning increased MCC to 0.69, while a diversity-optimized ensemble achieved 0.73, improving by 0.42 MCC over the strongest reference comparator, a static analyzer at 0.31, and by 0.29 over PrimeVul. At a 0.5% false-positive rate, the model missed only 21% of vulnerabilities, compared with 71% for the strongest comparator. It retained 86% of its performance under identifier renaming and demonstrated strong calibration and largely faithful explanations. These findings indicate that domain-matched training data and curriculum design, rather than model scale alone, are key drivers of generalization in firmware vulnerability detection. The results provide a benchmark for future research and deployment-ready configurations for practical IoT security applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IoTVulBench，一个面向跨语料库（cross-corpus）固件漏洞检测的人工验证基准，包含由 GitHub 仓库构建、三位专家评审的核心集以及经污染筛查的留出目标集。作者在五种模型架构、两种微调方法和三种课程学习策略上评测，并加入集成、蒸馏与鲁棒性分析，结论是领域匹配的训练数据与课程设计比模型规模更能驱动泛化。摘要报告最高 MCC 达到 0.73。
Motivation: 现有 IoT 固件漏洞检测数据集多为合成或通用用途，缺少人工验证和污染筛查标注，难以可靠评估模型跨训练来源、架构和课程策略的泛化能力。
Method: 构建 IoTVulBench-Core（来自 GitHub 仓库，三位专家评审验证），在污染筛查的留出目标集上评估五种模型架构、两种 tuning 方法和三种 curriculum 策略，并开展集成、蒸馏及鲁棒性分析（如标识符重命名）。
Result: 在 IoTVulBench 上训练的模型在匹配单源数据集中取得最高 MCC 0.58，优于 PrimeVul 的 0.44 与 D2A 的 0.39；分阶段课程学习使 MCC 升至 0.69，多样性优化集成达到 0.73，较最强参考基线静态分析器（0.31）提升 0.42，较 PrimeVul 提升 0.29；在 0.5% 假阳率下仅漏报 21% 漏洞，标识符重命名下保留 86% 性能。
Conclusion: 作者强调领域匹配的训练数据和课程设计而非模型规模本身是固件漏洞检测泛化的关键驱动因素，并将该基准定位为未来研究及实际 IoT 安全部署配置的参考。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Stability of Finite-Batch Particle Mean-Field Variational Inference Beyond Strong Convexity
papers.abstract_en: We study the implementable finite-batch particle algorithm for mean-field variational inference as a fully discrete stochastic approximation of the projected Wasserstein dynamics. The target potential is globally smooth but need not be strongly convex. The departure from contractivity is quantified by the curvature defect \[ \mathfrak d_α(x,y) = \bigl[α\|x-y\|^2- \langle\nabla V(x)-\nabla V(y),x-y\rangle\bigr]_+, \] which is the additive loss in the one-step Euler contraction estimate. We prove a non-asymptotic Wasserstein stability bound that separates initialization, product-empirical approximation, finite-batch drift error, time discretization, and the defects accumulated along the coupled trajectories. Under the uniform bound $\mathfrak d_α\leqβ$, the particle iterates remain within $O(\sqrt{β/α})$ of any MFVI minimizer, up to explicit errors in the particle number, batch size, and step size. The proof uses a stationary comparison array whose population law is an MFVI minimizer but whose particle-level law is a random product empirical measure, and it controls the resulting projected-drift discrepancy explicitly. We also give coordinatewise defect estimates and structural conditions for dimension-independent projected-drift sensitivity, construct an arbitrary-dimensional smooth nonconvex benchmark with a closed-form MFVI minimizer, and explain why polynomially growing drifts require a modification of the untamed explicit scheme.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究有限批次粒子均值场变分推断（finite-batch particle mean-field variational inference）可实现的算法，将其视为投影 Wasserstein 动力学的全离散随机逼近。目标势能全局光滑但不一定强凸，作者用曲率缺陷（curvature defect）量化非收缩性，证明非渐近 Wasserstein 稳定性界，将初始化、乘积经验近似、有限批次漂移误差、时间离散化等误差项显式分离。在均匀缺陷界下，粒子迭代保持在任意 MFVI 极小点的 O(√(β/α)) 范围内。
Motivation: 现有多数均值场变分推断粒子算法的理论分析依赖强凸或收缩性假设，而实际目标势能常非凸；需要在非强凸条件下为可实现的有限批次算法建立稳定性保证。
Method: 将有限批次粒子算法建模为投影 Wasserstein 动力学的全离散随机逼近，引入曲率缺陷 d_α(x,y) 量化一步欧拉收缩估计的加性损失。证明使用平稳比较数组（stationary comparison array），其总体分布是 MFVI 极小点而粒子级分布是随机乘积经验测度，并显式控制投影漂移差异；同时给出坐标方向缺陷估计、维度无关投影漂移敏感性的结构条件，构造任意维光滑非凸基准，并解释多项式增长漂移需修改未驯服的显式格式。
Result: 证明非渐近 Wasserstein 稳定性界：在均匀缺陷界 d_α≤β 下，粒子迭代保持在任意 MFVI 极小点的 O(√(β/α)) 范围内，误差显式依赖于粒子数、批大小和步长。
Conclusion: 在不强凸条件下，通过曲率缺陷量化与平稳比较阵列技术，有限批次粒子均值场变分推断仍可获得可量化的 Wasserstein 稳定性；多项式增长漂移的情形则需要修改显式时间离散格式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Modular Agentic Framework for Synthetically Constrained Multi-Objective Hit-to-Lead Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Hit-to-lead optimization requires iterative design of hit analogs across competing potency, selectivity, physicochemical, pharmacokinetic, safety, and synthetic constraints. We present SABLE (Synthetically-accessible Agentic Bayesian Ligand Exploration), an open-source framework that employs natural-language orchestration to guide chemical structure optimization. SABLE uses an LLM to interpret user-defined goals and route tasks, while specialized tools perform reaction-templated analog enumeration, physicochemical and ADMET property prediction, structure-based affinity scoring, and Bayesian optimization. The resulting workflow is a computational twin of the analytical and prioritization stages of the design-make-test-analyze cycle, providing provenance of each numerical output. Across single, and multi-objective optimization studies, SABLE enriches candidate sets for user-defined computational objectives while evaluating only a subset of the enumerated search space. Its modular architecture allows tools and characterization backends to be replaced by editing a simple config file, without modifying operational logic. SABLE provides an extensible decision-support framework for prioritizing synthetically constrained analogs in early-stage drug discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SABLE（Synthetically-accessible Agentic Bayesian Ligand Exploration），一个开源模块化框架，用自然语言编排指导化学结构优化，结合 LLM 解释用户目标并路由任务，以及反应模板模拟枚举、理化性质和 ADMET 预测、结构亲和力评分、贝叶斯优化等专门工具。在单目标和多目标优化研究中，SABLE 在仅评估枚举搜索空间子集的情况下富集了用户定义的计算目标候选集，为早期药物发现中的合成受限类似物优先级排序提供可扩展决策支持。
Motivation: 命中到先导（hit-to-lead）优化需要在效力、选择性、理化性质、药代动力学、安全性和合成约束等相互冲突的目标之间迭代设计命中类似物，现有方法缺乏一个可扩展且可追溯的决策支持框架。
Method: 提出模块化智能体框架，利用 LLM 进行自然语言编排和任务路由，结合多种专门工具（反应模板模拟枚举、性质预测、结构亲和力评分、贝叶斯优化），通过编辑配置文件即可替换工具和后端，无需修改操作逻辑。
Result: 在单目标和多目标优化研究中，SABLE 在仅评估枚举搜索空间子集的情况下富集了用户定义的计算目标候选集；该工作流相当于设计-制造-测试-分析循环中分析和优先级排序阶段的计算孪生，并为每个数值输出提供来源。
Conclusion: SABLE 为早期药物发现中优先考虑合成受限类似物提供了一个可扩展的决策支持框架；模块化架构允许通过配置文件更换工具和后端，且框架为开源实现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Forward Trajectory Steering for Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) reachability provides a mathematically rigorous framework for safe control of dynamical systems, but its practical application is bottlenecked by the computational complexity of solving Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs variational inequality PDEs in high dimensions. Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to classical mesh-based solvers, yet their performance is highly sensitive to the choice of collocation sampling. In order to learn accurate safety value functions, existing PINNs-based HJ reachability solvers must rely on complex training pipelines and auxiliary supervision. In this work, we propose STEER2REACH (S2R), a PINNs-based HJ reachability solver that requires minimal modification on top of standard PINNs training. S2R's key contribution is a lightweight, low-overhead adaptive collocation sampling distribution constructed by steering forward trajectories using a combination of the optimal control and disturbance signals induced by the current value function, with injected stochastic exploration noise. We demonstrate that despite its simplicity, S2R achieves competitive--and in some cases improved--performance on safety metrics while reducing relative L2 error across a range of reachability benchmarks compared with SoTA MPC-guided HJ reachability solvers, all without requiring multi-stage training or MPC-based supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 STEER2REACH (S2R)，一种基于物理信息神经网络 (PINNs) 的 Hamilton-Jacobi 可达性分析求解器，用于安全控制中的高维 HJI 偏微分方程。S2R 的核心是在标准 PINNs 训练之上加入轻量级自适应配点采样，通过当前值函数诱导的最优控制与扰动信号向前引导轨迹，并注入随机探索噪声。摘要称该方法在多个可达性基准上取得与 SoTA 的 MPC 引导求解器相当甚至更好的安全性指标，并降低相对 L2 误差，且无需多阶段训练或 MPC 监督。
Motivation: Hamilton-Jacobi 可达性分析为动态系统安全控制提供严格框架，但高维情况下求解 Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs 变分不等式 PDE 的计算复杂度成为瓶颈；PINNs 作为替代方案对配点采样高度敏感，现有 PINNs 求解器依赖复杂训练流程和辅助监督。
Method: 提出 S2R，在标准 PINNs 训练基础上仅做最小修改；关键创新是一种低开销的自适应配点采样分布，通过结合当前值函数诱导的最优控制和扰动信号来引导前向轨迹，并加入随机探索噪声。
Result: 摘要报告 S2R 在一系列可达性基准上取得与 SoTA MPC 引导求解器竞争、部分情况下更好的安全指标，同时降低相对 L2 误差，并且不需要多阶段训练或 MPC 监督。
Conclusion: 作者强调 S2R 的简单性：在标准 PINNs 训练之上只需最小改动，即可避免复杂的 MPC 监督与多阶段流程，同时保持或提升求解精度。

summary_sections.motivation: Hamilton-Jacobi 可达性分析为动态系统安全控制提供严格框架，但高维情况下求解 Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs 变分不等式 PDE 的计算复杂度成为瓶颈；PINNs 作为替代方案对配点采样高度敏感，现有 PINNs 求解器依赖复杂训练流程和辅助监督。
summary_sections.method: 提出 S2R，在标准 PINNs 训练基础上仅做最小修改；关键创新是一种低开销的自适应配点采样分布，通过结合当前值函数诱导的最优控制和扰动信号来引导前向轨迹，并加入随机探索噪声。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 S2R 在一系列可达性基准上取得与 SoTA MPC 引导求解器竞争、部分情况下更好的安全指标，同时降低相对 L2 误差，并且不需要多阶段训练或 MPC 监督。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调 S2R 的简单性：在标准 PINNs 训练之上只需最小改动，即可避免复杂的 MPC 监督与多阶段流程，同时保持或提升求解精度。

papers.title: Convergence Guarantees of Gradient Descent for Neural Networks via Generalized Lipschitz Smoothness
papers.abstract_en: We establish convergence guarantees of gradient descent for general feedforward neural networks of arbitrary width or depth, with no special requirements on the initialization or dataset. We only assume that the activation functions are Lipschitz smooth, Lipschitz continuous, and linearly bounded--- properties that hold for linear, tanh, softplus, and sigmoid activation functions. For the loss function, we require that it is Lipschitz smooth in the model outputs, which is true for mean-squared error. The key theoretical insight is that the Lipschitz properties of the activation functions are partially preserved even through repeated compositions, leading to a novel generalized Lipschitz smoothness condition where the change in gradient is upper bounded by the change in the parameter space, multiplied by polynomial terms of the parameter norms at both endpoints. This type of condition holds for both the model function and the loss function, enabling a descent lemma where the loss decreases as long as the learning rate is small enough with respect to the parameter norms. By ensuring that the parameter norms do not grow too quickly to infinity, we prove that the minimum squared gradient norm converges to zero in $T$ iterations at rate $O(1/T^{1/L})$ for an $L$-layer neural network.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为一般前馈神经网络（任意宽度或深度）的梯度下降建立收敛保证，不依赖特殊初始化或数据集。作者仅假设激活函数满足 Lipschitz 光滑、Lipschitz 连续且线性有界，损失函数在模型输出上 Lipschitz 光滑；核心论证是 Lipschitz 性质在复合中部分保持，得到参数范数多项式项刻画的广义 Lipschitz 光滑条件，进而证明 L 层网络的最小梯度范数平方以 O(1/T^{1/L}) 的速率收敛到零。
Motivation: 现有神经网络梯度下降收敛性分析往往对初始化或数据分布有特殊要求，该文希望覆盖更一般的网络结构，在宽松条件下给出确定性收敛保证。
Method: 从激活函数（如 linear、tanh、softplus、sigmoid）的 Lipschitz 光滑性出发，说明其经反复复合后仍部分保留该性质，导出参数范数两端点多项式上界的广义 Lipschitz 光滑条件；该条件同时适用于模型函数与损失函数，从而建立小学习率下损失下降的 descent lemma，并通过控制参数范数不至过快发散完成证明。
Result: 证明了对 L 层神经网络，最小平方梯度范数在 T 次迭代内以 O(1/T^{1/L}) 收敛到零；所要求的激活函数性质覆盖线性、tanh、softplus、sigmoid，损失条件适用于均方误差 (mean-squared error)。
Conclusion: 该文强调其收敛保证无需特殊初始化或数据集假设，限制主要落在激活函数与损失函数的光滑性上，属于优化理论层面的贡献。

papers.title: Probing and steering biology across Boltz-1s trunk-diffusion boundary
papers.abstract_en: AlphaFold3-class structure predictors pair a representational trunk, which processes sequence and context, with a diffusion module, which generates atomic coordinates. How biological information changes as it crosses this architectural boundary remains poorly understood. We analyze per-residue activations from the Pairformer trunk and diffusion module of Boltz-1 using linear probes, sparse autoencoders (SAEs), and causal interventions. From the trunk, both geometry (secondary structure, disorder) and sequence chemistry (amino-acid identity, signal peptides, disulfide-bond annotations) are linearly decodable. In the diffusion module, the two diverge. Secondary structure transfers essentially unchanged, whereas sequence chemistry is strongly attenuated. We then test whether decodable directions can steer the model, intervening on the final trunk single representation that conditions the diffusion module. Helix and coil directions change predicted structure dose-dependently against matched-norm random controls, but a beta-strand direction that is highly predictive (F1 =0.82) produces no measurable increase in strand content: linear decodability does not imply causal influence at the site we tested. The same probes also score markedly lower against sparse SwissProt annotations than against dense DSSP labels, because unannotated residues that the model gets right are charged as false positives; such scores are therefore lower bounds. Finally, supervised probes outscore single SAE features wherever a label already exists. We release the trained trunk and diffusion SAEs, Boltz-1 per-residue activations, and the analysis code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 AlphaFold3 类结构预测器中生物信息如何跨越“trunk-扩散模块”架构边界。作者对 Boltz-1 的 Pairformer trunk 与扩散模块逐残基激活使用线性探针、稀疏自编码器 (SAE) 和因果干预分析：trunk 中几何（二级结构、无序性）与序列化学（氨基酸身份、信号肽、二硫键注释）均可线性解码，而扩散模块中二级结构近乎不变地传递、序列化学被显著削弱。对最终 trunk 单表示进行干预可剂量依赖地改变螺旋和卷曲结构，但高预测性的 beta-strand 方向（F1=0.82）未产生可测量的链含量增加，说明线性可解性不等于因果影响力。作者发布了训练好的 SAE、Boltz-1 逐残基激活和分析代码。
Motivation: AlphaFold3 类模型将表示 trunk 与扩散生成模块配对，但生物信息在这一架构边界如何转变尚不清楚；理解该边界有助于解释模型内部表征与可控生成。
Method: 对 Boltz-1 的 Pairformer trunk 和扩散模块逐残基激活进行线性探针、稀疏自编码器 (SAEs) 与因果干预；干预针对条件化扩散模块的最终 trunk 单表示，并与匹配范数的随机对照比较。
Result: trunk 中几何与序列化学均可线性解码；扩散模块中二级结构近乎不变传递而序列化学显著衰减。螺旋与卷曲方向干预可剂量依赖地改变预测结构，但预报 F1=0.82 的 beta-strand 方向无显著链含量增加；稀疏 SwissProt 注释上的探针分数显著低于稠密 DSSP 标签，且监督探针优于单个 SAE 特征。
Conclusion: 作者强调线性可解性并不蕴含所测位点的因果影响，并指出稀疏注释会低估探针分数；同时公开 SAE、激活与分析代码以供后续研究。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Test-Time Hallucination Control in Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Object Hallucination in large vision-language models (LVLMs), where models generate non-factual content about input images, remains a critical barrier to their reliability in real-world applications. Existing mitigation strategies can be categorized into training-based and training-free methods. Training-based methods often achieve strong performance but are costly, requiring extensive computational resources, large-scale data, and time-consuming fine-tuning. Training-free approaches are particularly appealing due to their efficiency. However, existing training-free methods either require multiple decoding rounds, which adds computational overhead, or modify internal states in a model-specific way that risks degrading pretrained knowledge. We propose Test-Time Hallucination Mitigation (TTH) method, a novel training-free method that addresses both limitations. TTH introduces a token-validator module, implemented as a zero-shot Multi-Modal Classifier (MMC), to generate auxiliary logits grounded in the input image. These logits are fused with the original LVLM outputs at the token level for object tokens selected from a candidate pool. An entropy-based weighting scheme is then applied to enable robust and accurate predictions. Extensive experiments across multiple LVLM families and diverse benchmarks demonstrate that TTH consistently improves accuracy and robustness, underscoring its generalizability and practical effectiveness. Code is released at https://github.com/Mehran-TAM/TTH
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为 Test-Time Hallucination Mitigation (TTH) 的训练无关 (training-free) 方法，用于抑制大视觉语言模型 (LVLM) 的对象幻觉。TTH 引入一个零样本多模态分类器 (MMC) 作为 token 验证器，生成基于输入图像的辅助 logits，并在 token 级别与原始 LVLM 输出融合，再通过基于熵的加权方案进行预测。实验覆盖多个 LVLM 家族和多种基准，显示该方法能持续提升准确率与鲁棒性。
Motivation: LVLM 的对象幻觉会生成与图像不符的非事实内容，是实际部署可靠性的关键障碍。已有训练无关方法要么需要多轮解码造成额外计算开销，要么以模型特定方式修改内部状态，可能损害预训练知识；TTH 旨在同时解决这两个局限。
Method: TTH 是一种训练无关方法，核心是一个 token 验证器模块，实现为零样本多模态分类器 (MMC)，产生基于输入图像的辅助 logits。对于从候选池中选出的对象 token，这些 logits 在 token 级别与原始 LVLM 输出融合，并采用基于熵的加权方案实现鲁棒且准确的预测。
Result: 摘要报告在多个 LVLM 家族和多样化基准上的大量实验表明，TTH 一致地提升了准确率和鲁棒性，并强调其泛化性与实际有效性。
Conclusion: 作者认为 TTH 作为训练无关方法兼具效率与泛化能力，能克服以往训练无关方法的计算开销与模型特定修改问题；代码已开源。

papers.title: Dual-Primal Graph VAEs for Noisy Label Aggregation
papers.abstract_en: Inferring the ground-truth from noisy crowdsourced labels is an important theoretical and practical problem. Neural network-based methods offer an alternative to classical Bayesian models which require specifying a family of generative models used for inference. However, current models either still rely on fairly simple generative models for inference or require pseudo-labels or synthetic data to train the aggregate classifier. We propose a graph VAE architecture in which the decoder and encoder use GAT-based message passing on the adjacency graph of a crowdsourced dataset and its dual, respectively. The ground-truth labels are treated as latent variables, enabling unsupervised representation learning without needing to train a separate classifier. We show our model achieves state of the art performance on crowdsourcing benchmarks. We then demonstrate the generality of our approach by showing how the original crowdsourcing graph can be augmented to incorporate side information such as representations from neural network classifiers trained on the noisy labels to substantially boost their classification performance at test time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于从含噪众包标签中推断真实标签的图变分自编码器（graph VAE），其编码器和解码器分别在众包数据集的邻接图及其对偶图上进行基于 GAT 的消息传递，并将真实标签视为潜变量，从而无需单独训练分类器即可完成无监督表示学习。摘要在众包基准上报告了 state-of-the-art 性能，并展示可通过在图中加入来自噪声标签训练的神经网络的表示等辅助信息进一步提升测试时分类性能。
Motivation: 从噪声众包标签中恢复真实标签是重要理论和实际问题；现有神经网络方法要么仍依赖较简单的生成模型，要么需要伪标签或合成数据来训练聚合分类器，这些限制促使作者探索更灵活的无监督图模型方案。
Method: 提出图 VAE 架构，解码器和编码器分别使用 GAT 消息传递作用于众包数据集的邻接图与其对偶图，把真实标签作为潜变量进行推断；并展示可将原始众包图扩展以融入辅助信息（如基于噪声标签训练的分类器表示）。
Result: 摘要在多个众包基准上取得当前最优（state of the art）表现；此外，将神经网络分类器在噪声标签上学到的表示作为辅助信息加入图后，能显著提升测试时的分类性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为该图 VAE 方法无需单独的聚合分类器即可进行无监督表示学习，并能泛化到带有辅助信息的众包图，从而改善噪声标签聚合效果。

papers.title: Gaussian Meta-Space Augmentation for Stacking Ensembles in Multimodal IPMN Risk Stratification
papers.abstract_en: Pancreatic cancer is among the most lethal malignancies; risk stratification of intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasms (IPMNs) offers a crucial opportunity for early intervention but typically requires invasive tissue biopsy. Dominant vision-based approaches, including radiomics and deep learning, provide promising but initially separate discrimination opportunities. Similarly, multisequence MRI (T1W/T2W) and anatomically decomposed (head, body and tail) analysis of the pancreas provide additional and potentially complementary signals. Effective fusion of this information is crucial in ordinal IPMN dysplasia risk prediction and can be accomplished via a meticulously regularized and calibrated ensemble stacking combiner. We present cUPMI, a class-conditional Gaussian augmentation of a combiner's log-probability meta-features, and test it on various prediction paradigms. In our multi-center analysis, we find cUPMI adds limited value to properly regularized L2-logistic binary classification stacks, but consistently regularizes higher-capacity tree combiners in the binary and radiomics-only setting (RF +0.015 and XGBoost +0.024 binary AUC, positive in all seeds). Its cleanest ordinal benefit appears for XGBoost on an 8-stream radiomics task (3-class no < low < high, +0.022 QWK in all seeds). Separately, fold-locked fusion of radiomics and 2.5D CNN streams yields the strongest overall model, an RF stack reaching QWK 0.595 (95% CI [0.54, 0.64]) and binary AUC 0.839, surpassing radiomics, 2.5D ResNet, and 3D DenseNet-121 baselines.

papers.title: The Next Challenge for Agentic Cybersecurity: A Realistic, Contamination-Free Reverse Engineering Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are rapidly improving in cybersecurity capabilities when the source code is available for analysis, yet much of the software most consequential to cybersecurity, including malware, firmware, and proprietary applications, is available only as binaries. Analyzing such software requires reverse engineering(RE): recovering program semantics before the analysis can be meaningfully performed. However, evaluating agentic RE poses a fundamental challenge: benchmark instances must be unseen as source code in the LLMs' training data to prevent models from taking shortcuts by recognizing them rather than really analyzing them, while also matching the scale and anti-analysis protections of real software. Unfortunately, however, existing benchmarks do not jointly satisfy these requirements. To this end, we introduce SRE-Bench, the first realistic, contamination-free RE benchmark. Built entirely from scratch by RE experts with over 5,000 hours, SRE-Bench comprises 19 private, real-world-scale programs averaging 16.9K lines of code. We further developed 44 in-house anti-analysis primitives, yielding 262 binary instances and 1572 deterministically graded tasks. Our evaluation across five frontier LLMs (GPT-5.6-sol,Claude-Opus-5,GPT-5.5,Grok-4.5, and GLM-5.2) shows that RE remains largely unsolved: the strongest model, GPT-5.6-sol, scores 61.4% per instance, and fully solves only 31.5% of the instances. Our analysis further reveals that agents behave differently from human engineers, where agents are relatively insensitive to compiler optimization and static linking. Controlled ablations also confirm that both contamination control and realistic scale are essential. These results indicate that strong source-code security capabilities do not yet transfer to binary analysis, highlighting RE as an important frontier for agentic cybersecurity and SRE-Bench as a rigorous testbed to measure progress.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SRE-Bench，宣称是首个现实且无数据污染 (contamination-free) 的智能体逆向工程 (RE) 基准。该基准由 RE 专家耗时 5000 多小时从零构建，包含 19 个私有且达到真实软件规模的程序（平均 16.9K 行代码）、44 个自研反分析原语，共生成 262 个二进制实例和 1572 个确定性评分任务。对五个前沿 LLM（GPT-5.6-sol、Claude-Opus-5、GPT-5.5、Grok-4.5、GLM-5.2）的评估显示，最强模型 GPT-5.6-sol 每实例得分仅 61.4%，完全解决 31.5% 的实例，说明 agentic RE 仍基本未被解决。
Motivation: 评估智能体逆向工程存在根本性难题：基准实例必须未以源码形式出现在 LLM 训练数据中，防止模型走捷径，同时还要匹配真实软件的规模与反分析保护；现有基准无法同时满足这两个要求，因此缺乏可靠的评测手段。
Method: 构建 SRE-Bench：由逆向工程专家从零编写私有程序，加入 44 种自研反分析原语生成真实规模的二进制实例，并采用确定性判分；随后用五个前沿 LLM 进行评估，并做去除污染与改变规模的消融实验。
Result: 最强模型 GPT-5.6-sol 每实例得分 61.4%，完全解决 31.5% 的实例；智能体对编译器优化和静态链接相对不敏感，行为与人类工程师不同；消融实验确认污染控制和现实规模两者都至关重要。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，LLM 的强源码安全能力尚未迁移到二进制分析，RE 是 agentic 网络安全的重要前沿，SRE-Bench 可作为衡量进展的严格测试平台。

papers.title: PAC-Bayes Beyond Parameter Space: Behavioral Equivalence, Z-Information, and Exact Complexity Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: PAC-Bayes theory provides generalization guarantees by controlling the Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence between posterior and prior distributions over a chosen hypothesis representation. However, predictive risk depends only on the predictive behavior induced by a hypothesis, not on the particular internal realization that implements that behavior. In over-parameterized systems, many distinct configurations induce identical predictive behavior, yet the classical PAC-Bayes KL divergence does not distinguish uncertainty over predictive behavior from variation among behaviorally equivalent realizations. We show that this distinction induces an exact structural decomposition of classical PAC-Bayes complexity. We formalize behavioral equivalence through a measurable behavior map and use measure disintegration to decompose probability measures on the configuration space into a distribution over predictive behaviors and conditional distributions over behavioral fibers. This yields an exact decomposition of the classical PAC-Bayes KL divergence into a behavior-selection term and a realization-level term given by an expected conditional KL within fibers. We define Z-information as the negative of this realization-level contribution: the exact gap between the KL divergence and the complexity of uncertainty over predictive behavior alone. We further show that the behavior-selection term admits an exact variational characterization: it is the minimum KL divergence among all posteriors inducing the same distribution over predictive behaviors, attained by a canonical fiber-symmetrized representative. Finally, we show that symmetry, behavior-preserving directions, fiber geometry, and invariance under fiber-preserving perturbations arise naturally from the same behavior-map structure. Together, these results identify predictive behavior as the natural object of PAC-Bayes complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从行为等价（behavioral equivalence）的角度重新审视 PAC-Bayes 理论，指出经典 PAC-Bayes KL 散度无法区分对预测行为的不确定性与等价实现之间的差异。作者利用可测行为映射和测度分解（measure disintegration），将经典 PAC-Bayes 复杂度精确分解为行为选择项和实现层项，并定义 Z-information 作为二者之间的精确差距。进一步给出行为选择项的变分刻画，并说明对称性、保持行为的扰动方向等结构自然源于同一行为映射框架。
Motivation: 经典 PAC-Bayes 泛化界依赖于假设表征空间上的 KL 散度，但预测风险只取决于假设诱导的预测行为，而非其具体内部实现。在过参数化系统中，大量不同配置可产生相同预测行为，现有 KL 散度混淆了行为层面的不确定性与等价实现间的差异，从而无法将预测行为作为复杂度的自然对象。
Method: 通过可测行为映射形式化行为等价，并运用测度分解将配置空间上的概率测度分解为预测行为上的分布和各个行为纤维（behavioral fiber）上的条件分布。由此将经典 PAC-Bayes KL 散度精确分解为行为选择项与纤维内期望条件 KL 构成的实现层项，并将 Z-information 定义为该实现层贡献的负值。
Result: 摘要报告了经典 PAC-Bayes KL 的精确结构分解，证明行为选择项等于所有诱导相同行为分布的后续分布中 KL 的最小值，且由规范化的纤维对称化代表达到。此外，行为映射结构可以自然导出对称性、行为保持方向、纤维几何以及纤维保持扰动下的不变性。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果共同表明，预测行为应被视为 PAC-Bayes 复杂度的自然对象，而非任意内部实现。

papers.title: Multi-Agent Target-Existence Verification and Learned Mask Geometry Refinement: Winning Report of the MeViS-Text Track at the 8th LSVOS Challenge 2026
papers.abstract_en: We present the first-place solution to the MeViS-Text track of the 8th Large-scale Video Object Segmentation (LSVOS) Challenge 2026: referring video object segmentation guided by written motion expressions, including deceptive no-target expressions that match no object in the video and must yield empty masks in every frame. Our pipeline, SSUPER, resolves each expression into a visual concept, generates full-video candidate masklets with SAM~3.1, and selects target IDs. At every reasoning stage, three heterogeneous multimodal large language models independently execute the same stage-specific prompt before a single synthesis pass commits one schema-validated verdict. Although this system rejects every no-target expression in validation, the leaderboard reveals that a substantial share of test no-target cases still slips through. The reason is that hard negatives name a plausible object and fail only under the complete temporal predicate, so when selection and existence are decided together, a category-plausible masklet anchors the verdict. Hence, we decouple existence verification into an independent multi-agent audit of the full predicate (category, count, action, trajectory, event order, and semantic role) that distinguishes absence from temporary invisibility, discounts apparent motion caused by camera movement, and requires contradicting evidence rather than mere uncertainty for a no-target verdict. Without any new segmentation call, this audit recovers most of the residual no-target errors. A training-data-only StyleRefiner then aligns mask geometry with the annotation style of MeViSv2 while preserving every presence decision by construction, showing that once the semantics are fixed, part of the remaining error is stylistic rather than semantic. The complete system reaches a Final score of 0.9081339614 on the official challenge leaderboard.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是第 8 届 LSVOS Challenge 2026 MeViS-Text 赛道（基于书面运动表达的视频目标分割，含欺骗性无目标表达式）的第一名方案 SSUPER。系统用 SAM 3.1 生成全视频候选 masklet，并在每个推理阶段由三个异构多模态大语言模型并行执行同一提示词后统一合成裁决；随后将目标存在性验证解耦为独立的谓词级多智能体审计，并用仅依赖训练数据的 StyleRefiner 对齐 mask 几何风格。官方排行榜最终得分为 0.9081339614。
Motivation: 验证集上系统能拒绝所有无目标表达式，但测试集中相当一部分无目标案例仍被漏过，因为困难负样本命名了貌似合理的对象，仅在完整时间谓词下失败；当目标选择与存在性判定合在一起时，类别上合理的 masklet 会锚定裁决。
Method: 提出 SSUPER 流水线：将表达式解析为视觉概念，用 SAM 3.1 生成全视频候选 masklet 并选择目标 ID；每个推理阶段由三个异构多模态 LLM 独立执行同一阶段提示，再经一次综合传递提交经模式校验的裁决。存在性验证被解耦为独立多智能体审计，覆盖类别、数量、动作、轨迹、事件顺序与语义角色，以区分不存在与暂时不可见、剔除镜头运动造成的表观运动，并要求矛盾证据而非仅凭不确定性来判定无目标。最后用仅训练数据的 StyleRefiner 在不改变存在性判定的前提下使 mask 几何对齐 MeViSv2 标注风格。
Result: 该审计在不进行任何新分割调用的情况下恢复了大部分残留的无目标错误；完整系统在官方挑战排行榜上取得 0.9081339614 的最终得分。
Conclusion: 作者表明一旦语义被固定，剩余错误的一部分是风格性而非语义性的；将存在性验证解耦并配合风格细化可显著提升无目标表达的处理效果，并由此获得赛道第一名。

papers.title: TangPoetryBench: A Multi-Dimensional Benchmark and Rubric-Conditioned Evaluator for Poetry-to-Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image (T2I) models are increasingly asked to illustrate literary and cultural content, yet we cannot measure how well an image renders the meaning of a poem. The task is many-sided: a good illustration must be visually sound, faithful to the poem's imagery and scene, culturally and stylistically apt, free of spurious text, and true to its emotion, and its deepest requirements, imagery and especially implicit emotion, are never stated in the words. Existing metrics (CLIPScore, BLIPScore, VQAScore) reward literal text-image correspondence and so cannot tell whether an illustration succeeds, let alone why, or even separate the best model from the worst. We introduce TangPoetryBench, a multi-dimensional benchmark of 1,280 images (320 classical Chinese Tang poems x 4 state-of-the-art T2I models) with quality-controlled human annotations across ten dimensions. Analyzing this data, we reveal the shared and model-specific strengths and weaknesses of current T2I models, including their ability to evoke a poem's implicit emotion. We further introduce PoemAutoEvaluator (PAE), an open, rubric-conditioned evaluator that reaches parity with a strong proprietary judge (Claude), generalizes to an unseen generator and a second poetic tradition (Song Ci), and lets the benchmark scale to new images without fresh human annotation. We release the benchmark, annotations, and evaluator.

papers.title: Herding End-to-End Autonomous Driving via Neuro-Symbolic Safety Guards
papers.abstract_en: Modern end-to-end driving agents can achieve high average performance yet still violate basic traffic rules that a human driver would never miss. The reason is structural: they learn statistical patterns rather than the physical conditions that guarantee safe driving, leaving their decision-making process opaque and safety constraints unenforced. We introduce a neuro-symbolic safety guard, a lightweight module that attaches to the final command interface of an already-trained agent. Immediately before a command reaches the vehicle, it checks the command against explicit safety rules and, only when necessary, replaces it with the nearest safe alternative. Each intervention is directly executable and traceable to the rule that triggered it, while the guard itself requires no retraining and adds no learned component. Evaluated on the long-tail benchmarks Fail2Drive and Bench2Drive using the state-of-the-art TransFuser v6 (TFv6) as a case study, the guard improves Success Rate by 15% and reduces safety-critical collisions by up to 53%, while preserving the original Driving Score.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种神经符号安全卫士 (neuro-symbolic safety guard)，作为轻量模块附加在已训练的端到端驾驶代理的最终命令接口上。在命令到达车辆前，该模块依据显式安全规则检查命令，仅在必要时将其替换为最近的安全替代方案；每次干预都可执行且可追溯到触发它的规则，无需重训练、无新增学习组件。以 TransFuser v6 (TFv6) 为案例，在 Fail2Drive 和 Bench2Drive 长尾基准上，该卫士将 Success Rate 提升 15%，安全关键碰撞减少最高 53%，并保留原有 Driving Score。
Motivation: 现代端到端驾驶代理的平均性能虽高，但仍会违反人类驾驶员不会忽略的基本交通规则；其根源在于这类系统学习的是统计模式而非保证安全驾驶的物理条件，导致决策过程不透明且安全约束得不到强制执行。
Method: 提出神经符号安全卫士：一个不参与训练、不含学习参数的轻量模块，挂在已训练代理的命令输出与车辆之间；它以显式安全规则逐条检查即将执行的命令，仅在违规时用最近的合法替代命令替换，并使每次干预都能对应到具体触发规则。
Result: 在 Fail2Drive 和 Bench2Drive 基准上以 TFv6 为案例，该卫士将 Success Rate 提升 15%，安全关键碰撞减少最高 53%，同时保持原始 Driving Score 不变。
Conclusion: 作者表明在已训练端到端驾驶代理外部附加可解释的安全约束模块，可以在无需重训练的情况下有效减少安全违规并保持已有性能，干预过程可直接执行且可追溯。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: XGBoost "is all you need": the case of forecasting transmitted heat energy in District Heating Systems
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a comparative study of two distinct approaches, XGBoost and Long-Short Term Memory (LSTM), for forecasting transmitted heat energy in District Heating Systems (DHS). The objective is to explore scenarios in which conventional ML algorithms demonstrate better performance over deep learning networks in time series forecasting and the associated benefits in terms of computational cost and environmental impact. The study focuses on a real-world DHS dataset. Through experimentation and analysis, it is demonstrated that XGBoost consistently outperforms LSTM in this specific forecasting task. The difference is explained by the error distribution illustrating that LSTM makes more significant errors in the intervals of less data availability. The reduced computational demands of conventional ML approaches not only result in cost savings but also minimize the carbon footprint associated with data analysis tasks in energy systems.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 7 figures. This preprint corresponds to the paper published in Lecture Notes in Networks and Systems, vol. 860 (ICIST 2024), Springer
papers.journal_ref: Lecture Notes in Networks and Systems, Vol. 860 (ICIST 2024), Springer, 2024
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对 XGBoost 与长短期记忆网络（LSTM）在区域供热系统（DHS）传输热能预测任务上做了对比研究，基于真实 DHS 数据集实验。摘要显示 XGBoost 在该任务上始终优于 LSTM，并将差异归因于误差分布：LSTM 在数据可用性较少的区间产生更显著误差。作者同时强调传统机器学习方法计算需求更低，可节省成本并减少碳足迹。
Motivation: 旨在探索时间序列预测中传统机器学习算法优于深度学习网络的情景，并考察其计算成本与环境影响方面的收益。
Method: 在真实世界区域供热系统数据集上，对 XGBoost 和 LSTM 两种方法进行预测传输热能的对比实验，并通过误差分布分析解释二者表现差异。
Result: XGBoost 在该预测任务上一致优于 LSTM；LSTM 在数据可用性较少的区间出现更大误差，传统方法还带来更低计算需求与碳足迹。
Conclusion: 摘要指出在供热系统热能预测这一特定时间序列任务中，传统机器学习方法可替代深度学习方法，同时兼顾预测性能与计算/环境成本。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Large-scale AI-Ready Data for Anti-Cancer Drug Response Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Drug response prediction (DRP) models are an active area of research in pharmacogenomics, with growing potential to accelerate the identification of effective anticancer drugs. However, their predictive performance is often constrained by limited dataset scale and insufficient coverages of cancer and chemical spaces. In addition, inconsistent benchmarking practices hinder reliable comparison across models. Standardized frameworks, such as the Innovative Methodologies and New Data for Predictive Oncology Model Evaluation (IMPROVE) project, provide unified data schemas and evaluation protocols for consistent benchmarking, but improving model generalizability requires larger and more diverse training data. In this work, we substantially expand the IMPROVE benchmark through large-scale integration of pharmacogenomic data, primarily from PharmacoDB, together with additional smaller data sources. The expanded resource includes millions of drug response measurements, broader multi-omics coverage, and a major increase in chemical diversity, adding more than 50,000 compounds. To evaluate the impact of the new dataset compared to the original IMPROVE benchmark dataset, we trained DRP models using the two datasets and assess their prediction performance using a common test set and several evaluation strategies, including drug-blind, cancer-blind, and disjoint data splits. While cancer-blind performance remained comparable to the original benchmark, models trained on the expanded dataset showed consistent improvements in drug-blind and disjoint settings, indicating enhanced generalization to previously unseen compounds. These results position the expanded dataset as a community resource that provides a richer foundation for developing DRP models intended to aid in the discovery of novel anticancer drugs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过大规模整合 PharmacoDB 等药物基因组学数据，显著扩展了 IMPROVE 基准数据集，新增超过 5 万种化合物，涵盖数百万条药物反应测量和更广的多组学覆盖。作者用扩展数据集与原 IMPROVE 数据分别训练药物反应预测 (DRP) 模型，并在共同测试集上比较多种评估策略。结果显示，在 drug-blind 和 disjoint 划分下扩展数据带来一致改进，而 cancer-blind 表现与原基准相当，表明新数据集能增强对未见化合物的泛化能力。
Motivation: 药物反应预测模型的性能常受限于数据集规模较小、癌症空间和化学空间覆盖不足，且缺乏一致的评测协议；现有标准化框架如 IMPROVE 提供了统一数据模式和评估流程，但提升模型泛化性仍需要更大更多样的训练数据。
Method: 在 IMPROVE 基准基础上进行大规模数据扩展，主要整合 PharmacoDB 数据并补充多个更小的数据源，形成包含数百万药物反应测量、更广多组学覆盖和超过 5 万新增化合物的资源；随后用该扩展数据集和原 IMPROVE 数据集分别训练 DRP 模型，并用共同测试集及 drug-blind、cancer-blind、disjoint 等多种数据划分评估。
Result: 在 cancer-blind 设置下扩展数据表现与原基准相当，但在 drug-blind 和 disjoint 设置下，基于扩展数据训练的模型表现一致提升，说明对未见化合物的泛化能力增强。
Conclusion: 扩展后的数据集可作为社区资源，为面向新抗癌药物发现的 DRP 模型开发提供更丰富的数据基础。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Variational Parameter Calibration with Physics-Aware Latent-Space Surrogates
papers.abstract_en: Forward and inverse modeling of parametric dynamical systems requires surrogate models that are not only accurate for state prediction, but also informative for parameter calibration. However, a systematic end-to-end differentiable formulation for coupling deep-learning-based reduced-order surrogates with variational parameter estimation remains underdeveloped. In this work, we introduce a physics-aware neural-network-based latent-space framework for reduced-order forward modeling and variational parameter estimation. The proposed autoencoder-based approach yields a differentiable surrogate that maps physical parameters to predicted flow fields through a latent representation. The observable supervision is used during offline training to encourage the latent variables to retain information correlated with system parameters, while the online inverse problem is solved in the parameter space through the surrogate-induced observation operator. The method is evaluated on two computational-fluid-dynamics benchmarks. The results show that reconstruction accuracy alone is insufficient for inverse modeling, owing to the lack of end-to-end differentiability or physics awareness for variational parameter calibration. Quantitative latent-space analysis further shows that observable supervision improves case-level separability and temporal organization of latent representations. Experiments with realistic measurement settings, including noisy, low-resolution, randomly masked, and block-wise partial observations, demonstrate the robustness of the proposed framework and show that it generally reduces calibration error and variability compared with the standard surrogate models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种物理感知的神经网络潜空间框架，用于参数化动力系统的降阶前向建模与变分参数估计。方法基于自编码器得到可微代理模型，将物理参数经潜变量映射到预测流场，离线训练时通过可观测监督使潜变量保留与系统参数相关的信息，在线则在参数空间通过代理诱导的观测算子求解逆问题。在两类计算流体动力学基准上的实验表明，仅重建精度不足以支撑逆建模，而所提框架在含噪、低分辨率、随机掩码和块状部分观测等实际设置下通常能降低校准误差与变异性。
Motivation: 参数化动力系统的前向与逆向建模需要代理模型既能准确预测状态，又能为参数校准提供信息，但将基于深度学习的降阶代理与变分参数估计进行端到端可微耦合的系统性方法仍不成熟。
Method: 提出基于自编码器的物理感知潜空间框架：通过可微的潜空间代理将物理参数映射到预测流场；离线训练使用可观测监督促使潜变量保留与参数相关的信息；在线逆问题在参数空间通过代理诱导的观测算子进行变分求解。
Result: 在两个计算流体动力学基准上，重建精度本身不足以支撑逆建模；可观测监督改善了潜表示在案例层面的可分性与时间组织；在含噪、低分辨率、随机掩码和块状部分观测等实际观测设置下，该方法相比标准代理模型普遍降低校准误差与变异性。
Conclusion: 作者强调端到端可微性与物理感知对于变分参数校准的必要性，并展示了所提框架在真实观测条件下的鲁棒性；论文面向计算流体动力学基准，未涉及气象或降水场景。
Relevance: 25

summary_sections.method: 提出基于自编码器的物理感知潜空间框架：通过可微的潜空间代理将物理参数映射到预测流场；离线训练使用可观测监督促使潜变量保留与参数相关的信息；在线逆问题在参数空间通过代理诱导的观测算子进行变分求解。
summary_sections.result: 在两个计算流体动力学基准上，重建精度本身不足以支撑逆建模；可观测监督改善了潜表示在案例层面的可分性与时间组织；在含噪、低分辨率、随机掩码和块状部分观测等实际观测设置下，该方法相比标准代理模型普遍降低校准误差与变异性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调端到端可微性与物理感知对于变分参数校准的必要性，并展示了所提框架在真实观测条件下的鲁棒性；论文面向计算流体动力学基准，未涉及气象或降水场景。

papers.title: Benchmarking LLM Judges for Mobile Agent Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Mobile agent benchmarks increasingly rely on LLM-based judges to evaluate task completion, yet the reliability of these judges on mobile agent trajectories remains largely unexamined. We introduce MobileJudgeBench, a benchmark for systematically evaluating LLM-as-judge methods on mobile agent trajectories. Our benchmark comprises 931 human-annotated trajectories spanning 6 mobile agent benchmarks, 4 agent models, and 68 apps. We evaluate 6 judge methods (five adapted from SPA-Bench, A3 with two modes, AndroidArena, and AgentRewardBench, plus a simple baseline we design) across multiple LLM backends. Our experiments reveal three key findings. First, a simple baseline judge with sampled screenshots is competitive with, and often exceeds, purpose-built methods, indicating that more elaborate judge pipelines do not consistently improve judge quality; among competitive methods, the LLM backbone is the primary driver. Second, benchmark quality metrics reliably predict real-world judge utility: they correlate with both agent ranking fidelity for evaluation and downstream performance when judges serve as reward signals for on-policy reinforcement learning. Third, failure analysis across two LLM backends uncovers qualitatively opposite failure profiles, one conservative and the other permissive, linked to the backbone's precision-recall characteristics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MobileJudgeBench，一个系统评估 LLM 作为裁判（LLM-as-judge）在移动智能体轨迹上可靠性的基准。基准包含 931 条人工标注轨迹，覆盖 6 个移动智能体基准、4 个智能体模型和 68 个应用，并评估 6 种裁判方法。实验发现简单基线裁判与专用方法相当或更优，LLM 主干是主要驱动因素，且基准质量指标能预测真实世界裁判效用。
Motivation: 移动智能体基准越来越依赖 LLM 裁判来评估任务完成情况，但这些裁判在移动智能体轨迹上的可靠性尚未被系统检验。
Method: 构建包含 931 条人工标注轨迹的 MobileJudgeBench，覆盖多基准、多模型、多应用；评估 6 种裁判方法（其中 5 种改编自现有工作，另加一个简单采样截图基线）和多个 LLM 后端，并进行失败模式分析。
Result: 三个主要发现：简单基线裁判与专用方法竞争甚至超越，表明复杂裁判流程并不总能提升质量，LLM 主干是主要驱动；基准质量指标能可靠预测真实裁判效用，包括智能体排序保真度和作为强化学习奖励信号的下游性能；两个 LLM 后端的失败分析揭示相反失败画像，一个保守、一个宽松，与主干的精确率-召回率特性相关。
Conclusion: 摘要强调移动智能体评估中 LLM 裁判的可靠性需要专门基准检验，简单基线可能足够，且基准指标具有实际预测价值。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: AutoGrable: What Is a Good Graph for a Table?
papers.abstract_en: Graph learning presupposes a graph, and tables and relational databases do not come with one. Applying a GNN to them requires deciding which entities become nodes, which of them to connect, and through which relations---a decision made by hand, by schema heuristics, or by training a model on every candidate graph and keeping the best. We give a criterion that requires no trained graph model. In the minimal table-to-graph abstraction each row is a node, so a message-passing GNN, bounded by 1-WL, sees a construction only as a partition of the rows into colour-refinement classes: a construction is good for a task when that partition separates rows with different labels and does not split rows that share one. AutoGrable turns this criterion into a construction procedure. For incidence constructions the partition is fixed by the selected columns, so building a graph reduces to choosing them, and we score a candidate subset by a label-alignment risk: the held-out risk of the best predictor constant on its blocks, penalised by an occupancy term measuring how thinly the blocks are populated. The score materialises no graph and trains no GNN, so AutoGrable can search the space of subsets greedily and cheaply, and returns the resulting grable for single tables and for foreign-key schemas alike. Our experiments show that over a space of candidate graphs the score discards a large fraction while retaining the best; that AutoGrable recovers the columns that generate the label on controlled tasks and outperforms fixed, random, and task-aware constructors on real tasks under a fixed predictor; and that it is the only method compared that can decline to build a graph when none helps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AutoGrable，一种无需训练图模型的准则来判断表格数据应构造什么样的图。在最小表到图抽象中，每行是一个节点，1-WL 有界的消息传递 GNN 只能看到行的一种划分；标签不同的行应被分开、共享标签的行不应被拆分。AutoGrable 将该准则转化为构造过程，对候选列子集用标签对齐风险打分，不生成图也不训练 GNN，并支持单表和 foreign-key schemas。
Motivation: 表格和关系数据库本身不附带图，应用 GNN 前需要决定哪些实体成为节点、如何连边以及通过哪些关系相连；手动或启发式选择缺乏标准，而枚举所有候选图并训练模型取最优的代价很高。
Method: 用颜色细化类（colour-refinement classes）刻画 1-WL 划分；对 incidence construction，图的结构由所选列固定，建图退化为选择列子集。AutoGrable 用一个标签对齐风险（label-alignment risk）对子集打分：每个块上最佳常量预测器的留出风险，并用占用项惩罚被稀疏填充的块。该分数无需物化图或训练 GNN，因此可以贪心地、廉价地搜索子集空间。
Result: 实验显示，该分数能在候选图空间中丢弃大部分候选同时保留最优；在受控任务中能恢复生成标签的列；在固定预测器下优于固定、随机和任务感知的构造函数；并且它是所比较方法中唯一能在没有图有帮助时拒绝建图的方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该准则为表到图构造提供了一种无需训练、可解释的选择机制，并且显式支持“不建图”的决策，适用于单表与多表关系模式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Three Tokens Force Exponential Feature Rank in Nonnegative Kernel Attention
papers.abstract_en: Full attention exposes every token pair, whereas kernel attention compresses a sequence into a fixed-dimensional sketch. We show that this distinction becomes exponential at the first context length containing two competing candidates. On Min-IP over Boolean inputs, rank-one normalized kernel attention solves every sequence of length at most two exactly. In contrast, any single normalized nonnegative kernel-attention head that succeeds on all three-token sequences with error strictly below $1/2$ requires $2^{Ω(m)}$ features, even with arbitrary finite-dimensional tokenwise values and an arbitrary query-dependent affine readout. Dense softmax solves the same task with $m$-dimensional scores and constant temperature. The conclusion survives position-dependent token maps and a causal final query. As context length grows, the lower bound approaches the exact $2^m$-feature realization. Separately, for deterministic multihead, multilayer sketch models whose cross-token channels have finite alphabets, we prove a transcript lower bound linear in the number of independent answers and logarithmic in their alphabet size.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论上对比全注意力 (full attention) 与核注意力 (kernel attention) 的表达能力：全注意力暴露所有 token 对，而核注意力把序列压缩成固定维草图 (sketch)。作者证明在布尔输入上的 Min-IP 任务中，rank-one 归一化核注意力只能精确求解长度不超过 2 的序列；任何能对所有三 token 序列以严格低于 1/2 误差求解的归一化非负核注意力头都需要 $2^{\Omega(m)}$ 个特征，而稠密 softmax 用 $m$ 维分数和常数温度即可解决同一任务。
Motivation: 核注意力通过固定维草图压缩序列，但其表达能力相对全注意力的损失程度缺乏严格刻画；作者希望从理论上说明这种差异何时会变得指数级，尤其是在第一个包含两个竞争候选的上下文长度上。
Method: 采用 Min-IP over Boolean inputs 作为任务，分析 rank-one 归一化非负核注意力与稠密 softmax 的表达边界；证明前者的特征数量下界，并扩展到位置相关 token 映射、因果最终查询以及确定性多head、多层草图模型的 transcript 下界。
Result: 摘要给出的核心结果是：任何在全部三 token 序列上误差严格低于 1/2 的归一化非负核注意力头需要 $2^{\Omega(m)}$ 个特征，即使允许任意有限维逐 token 值和查询相关的仿射读出；稠密 softmax 只需 $m$ 维分数与常数温度。下界随上下文长度趋近精确的 $2^m$ 特征实现，另对有限字母表跨 token 信道的确定性多头多层草图模型证明了与独立答案数线性、与字母表大小对数相关的 transcript 下界。
Conclusion: 摘要强调核注意力与全注意力之间的表达差异在包含两个竞争候选的上下文中变成指数级，且单层非负核注意力头的特征需求随精度要求指数增长，说明该差异本质上是结构性的而非仅由温度或读出层造成。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VLMs Win a Systematic Evaluation of Underwater Image Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Underwater image restoration consists of recovering an image which looks like there is no water present. To date, evaluation has not been systematic. This paper describes a systematic evaluation pipeline for underwater reconstruction, which can be used to assess a method for accuracy; consistency of reconstruction over camera moves; and the effect of water parameters. We use this pipeline to evaluate a range of current procedures, from models constructed using explicit but approximate physical models of scattering to Vision-Language Models (VLMs which are not currently trained with explicit physical models). Overall, VLMs wholly and significantly outperform physically based models in our evaluation, likely because of the importance of a strong image prior. Results on images of real underwater scenes strongly confirm the evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一套系统化的水下图像重建评估流程，用于衡量重建精度、相机移动下的重建一致性以及水参数的影响。作者用该流程比较了基于显式近似物理散射模型的传统方法与未显式训练物理模型的视觉语言模型（Vision-Language Models, VLMs），结果显示 VLM 整体显著优于基于物理的模型，可能归因于强图像先验的重要性；真实水下场景图像的评估结果强烈支持这一结论。
Motivation: 水下图像恢复的目标是恢复出看似没有水存在的图像，但迄今为止评估缺乏系统性，缺少统一衡量精度、一致性和水参数影响的评估方法。
Method: 提出一个系统化的水下重建评估流水线，可用来评估方法的重建准确性、相机移动下重建的一致性以及水参数的影响；并用该流程评估多种现有方法，包括使用显式但近似物理散射模型的构建方法，以及未使用显式物理模型训练的视觉语言模型（VLM）。
Result: 在评估中，VLM 整体上以显著优势胜过基于物理的模型，作者认为这很可能源于强图像先验（strong image prior）的重要性；真实水下场景图像上的结果也强烈确认了该评估结论。
Conclusion: 作者认为系统化评估表明 VLM 在水下图像重建任务上优于基于显式物理模型的方法，强图像先验是关键因素。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Click2Poly: A VLM for vector mapping buildings and walls
papers.abstract_en: Accurate vector mapping of buildings and walls is critical for geospatial applications but remains a labor-intensive process. While recent deep learning methods have improved automatic extraction, in order to meet cartographic standards they always require a human to perform quality control and fix complex cases in the extraction. We present Click2Poly, a human-in-the-loop AI assistant designed to speed up this manual step. Extending the Florence-2 Vision Language Model (VLM), Click2Poly responds to user clicks by editing the building or wall vector layer directly. Implemented as a QGIS plugin, Click2Poly speeds up the manual editing of building and wall vector layers in a real-world production environment.
papers.journal_ref: IGARSS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Click2Poly，一个基于 Florence-2 视觉语言模型（VLM）扩展的人机协作 AI 助手，用户点击后可直接编辑建筑物和墙体矢量图层，并作为 QGIS 插件实现，用于加速真实生产环境中的手动制图编辑。摘要未提供定量评估，主要展示系统设计与落地方式。
Motivation: 建筑物和墙体的高精度矢量制图对地理空间应用至关重要，但手动过程劳动密集；现有自动提取方法虽已改进，仍需人工进行质量控制和修复复杂案例，因此希望加快这一人工编辑步骤。
Method: 扩展 Florence-2 VLM，使模型响应用户点击并直接编辑建筑物或墙体矢量图层；同时将系统实现为 QGIS 插件，以便在真实生产环境中使用。
Result: 摘要仅声称 Click2Poly 能加速真实生产环境中建筑物和墙体矢量图层的手动编辑，未报告具体数值或基准结果。
Conclusion: 本文将贡献定位为以人机协作方式加速制图编辑步骤，并通过 QGIS 插件形式提供实用性；摘要层面未涉及详细的性能评估或局限性讨论。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Analysis of Federated Aggregation under Model Poisoning and Backdoor Attacks: A Reconstructed Cross-Dataset and Cross-Architecture Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Robust comparisons of federated aggregation methods require joint consideration of predictive performance, threat definitions, metric semantics, and execution provenance. A 500-cell seed-1 evaluation matrix was reconstructed across five aggregation methods, five datasets, five architectures, and four recorded conditions: clean, sign-flipping, Gaussian, and BadNets. Successful execution logs were identified for 454 original runs and 36 repaired or rerun executions, whereas 10 clean SVHN cells were supported by summary-only provenance. Trimmed Mean achieved the highest clean macro-mean accuracy (76.02%) and the lowest mean within-task rank (1.70). Krum attained the highest recorded accuracy under both sign-flipping and Gaussian configurations. These relative rankings remained unchanged when analysis was restricted to 21 task pairs for which original successful logs were available for every method-condition combination. Audit of the supplied BadNets metric implementation established that every test input is triggered prior to target-label counting; consequently, the retained metric represents Triggered Target-Label Rate (TTLR) rather than a conventional target-excluding attack success rate. An audit of the supplied FedPARETO scaffold further identified a pathway in which predictive summaries may characterize an uncorrupted local model while the aggregation weight is applied to a separately corrupted update, introducing a potential discrepancy between reported predictive outcomes and the updates used for aggregation. The canonical matrix contains a single identified seed for each cell, and exact attack and configuration lineage is incomplete. Accordingly, the findings should be interpreted as descriptive comparisons within the recorded configurations and not as statistical estimates or universal claims regarding robustness.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 7 main figures, 7 main tables; includes 11 pages of Supplementary Information with 14 supplementary figures. Code and reproducibility resources: https://github.com/mazumdarsoumya/RobustFL-Bench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重建了一个大规模联邦聚合方法鲁棒性评估基准，覆盖五种聚合方法、五个数据集、五种架构以及干净、符号翻转、高斯和 BadNets 四种条件，共 500 个单元。摘要报告 Trimmed Mean 在干净条件下取得最高宏平均准确率（76.02%）和最低平均任务内排名（1.70），Krum 在符号翻转和高斯配置下记录准确率最高。作者还审计了 BadNets 指标实现与 FedPARETO 脚手架，指出前者实为触发目标标签率（TTLR），并提示存在预测摘要与聚合更新不一致的路径，强调结果仅为记录配置内的描述性比较。
Motivation: 联邦聚合方法的鲁棒性比较需要同时考虑预测性能、威胁定义、指标语义和执行来源，但现有比较往往缺乏这种联合一致性。作者旨在通过重建大规模评估矩阵，提供可复现且来源可追溯的基准。
Method: 重建了一个 500 单元的种子-1 评估矩阵，覆盖五种聚合方法、五个数据集、五种架构和四种记录条件（clean、sign-flipping、Gaussian、BadNets），对 454 次原始运行和 36 次修复或重跑执行进行成功日志识别，并对 BadNets 指标实现和 FedPARETO 脚手架进行审计。
Result: Trimmed Mean 在干净条件下取得最高宏平均准确率 76.02% 和最低平均任务内排名 1.70；Krum 在 sign-flipping 和 Gaussian 配置下取得最高记录准确率。当分析限制在 21 个所有方法-条件组合均有原始成功日志的任务对上时，相对排名保持不变。审计发现 BadNets 指标实为 TTLR，而非传统排除目标的攻击成功率。
Conclusion: 由于规范矩阵每个单元只有一个种子且攻击与配置血统不完整，作者强调结果应视为记录配置内的描述性比较，而非统计估计或关于鲁棒性的普遍性声明。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: COGENT: Counterfactual Gaussian Explanations for Volumetric Medical Images
papers.abstract_en: Explainability is essential for deploying deep learning models in high-stakes medical applications. Existing explainability methods for volumetric imaging predominantly operate in voxel space, overlooking the structured representations introduced by recent advances in 3D scene modeling. We present COGENT (Counterfactual Gaussian Explanations), a framework that generates counterfactual explanations directly in the parameter space of Gaussian-based volumetric representations. Built upon MedGS and the Sybil lung cancer risk prediction model, COGENT optimizes selected Gaussian primitives through a differentiable rendering pipeline, enabling gradients from the downstream predictor to identify representation components that most influence model decisions. Unlike conventional pixel- or voxel-level attribution methods, our approach formulates explainability as a counterfactual optimization problem over an explicit 3D scene representation, producing sparse and spatially localized explanations while preserving anatomical consistency. We evaluate COGENT on lung CT scans using quantitative comparisons with existing explainability methods together with qualitative analysis by medical experts. The results demonstrate that representation-space counterfactual optimization provides clinically meaningful explanations while offering a new perspective on interpreting volumetric deep learning models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 COGENT (Counterfactual Gaussian Explanations)，一种面向体素医学影像的可解释性框架，直接在基于高斯的三维体积表示（Gaussian-based volumetric representations）的参数空间中生成反事实解释。该方法基于 MedGS 与 Sybil 肺癌风险预测模型，通过可微渲染管线优化选定的 Gaussian 基元，利用下游预测器的梯度定位影响模型决策的表示组件，从而产生稀疏、空间局部化且保持解剖一致性的解释。作者在肺部 CT 扫描上进行定量比较与医学专家定性分析，结果表明表示空间中的反事实优化能提供具有临床意义的解释。
Motivation: 现有面向体积影像的可解释性方法主要在体素空间（voxel space）中运作，忽视了近期 3D 场景建模进展所引入的结构化表示。在高风险医疗应用中，需要一种能利用显式三维场景表示来生成反事实解释的方法。
Method: COGENT 将可解释性建模为显式 3D 场景表示上的反事实优化问题：构建于 MedGS 和 Sybil 肺癌风险预测模型之上，通过可微渲染管线优化选定的 Gaussian 基元，使下游预测器的梯度能够识别对模型决策影响最大的表示组件，从而生成稀疏且局部化的解释。
Result: 在肺部 CT 扫描上，COGENT 与现有可解释性方法进行了定量比较，并由医学专家进行定性分析；摘要报告表示空间中的反事实优化提供了具有临床意义的解释，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调表示空间反事实优化为解释体积深度学习模型提供了新的视角，并能够产生临床上有意义的解释，但未讨论方法的适用范围或局限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Social Chain of Thought: A Multi-Agent Architecture Grounded in Medical Differential Diagnosis Methodology
papers.abstract_en: Medical diagnostic reasoning is a high-impact use case for LLMs that carries significant implications for the health and wellbeing of users. When OpenAI (2026) reports that more than 5% of ChatGPT messages globally are healthcare-related, the transparency of these systems becomes a serious design concern. This is especially true for complex cases, where differential diagnosis often requires integrating multiple forms of specialist reasoning. Existing work has proposed multi-agent approaches to medical diagnosis, but it remains unclear when such systems are needed, why they help, and where they outperform monolithic inference. We introduce Social Chain of Thought (SCoT),a multi-round pipeline for medical differential diagnosis that structures multi-agent interaction as a deliberative framework for collabora. tive LLM reasoning. Evaluating SCoT against single-agent baselines, one-agent pipeline ablations, and best-of-n scaling, we show that its recall advantage is not reproduced by monolithic inference alone. SCoT is most successful in the hardest diagnostic cases, where multiple rounds of specialist conversation help recover ground-truth diagnoses and converge on a higher-recall differential.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Social Chain of Thought (SCoT)，一种基于医学鉴别诊断 (differential diagnosis) 方法论的多智能体 LLM 推理架构。它将多智能体交互组织为多轮协作推理管线，并与单智能体基线、单智能体管线消融和 best-of-n 缩放对比，发现其召回优势无法由单体推理复现，且在最难的诊断案例中收益最大。
Motivation: 医学诊断是 LLM 的高风险应用场景，复杂病例往往需要整合多种专科推理，但已有工作尚不清楚多智能体诊断系统何时需要、为何有效、以及相比单体推理 (monolithic inference) 在哪里更优。
Method: 提出 SCoT，把多智能体对话结构化为一种 deliberative framework，模拟医学鉴别诊断的协作推理流程，通过多轮专科医生式对话逐步收敛诊断结果。
Result: 摘要报告 SCoT 在召回率上优于单智能体基线、单智能体管线消融和 best-of-n scaling，且该优势无法由单体推理单独复现；在最难的诊断案例中，多轮专科对话能帮助恢复 ground-truth 诊断并收敛到更高召回率的鉴别列表。
Conclusion: 作者强调多轮专科协作对最困难诊断案例的召回提升，说明多智能体方法在复杂医学鉴别诊断中具有明确价值。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Diffusion-Based Data-Driven Assortment Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Assortment optimization is a fundamental problem in revenue management, typically addressed using parametric choice models such as the multinomial logit (MNL) and its variants. While these models enable tractable formulations, their performance is sensitive to model misspecification and often struggles to capture complex customer behavior. In this paper, we propose a model-agnostic framework for assortment optimization based on guided discrete diffusion. We represent assortments as binary vectors and perform stochastic search via a learned reverse diffusion process, avoiding explicit combinatorial enumeration. To incorporate decision objectives, we introduce a reward-guided mechanism that biases local transitions using estimates of expected revenue. This allows the method to effectively balance exploration and exploitation during generation. Empirically, we show that the proposed approach consistently identifies high-quality assortments and remains robust under model misspecification, often recovering near-optimal solutions in high-dimensional settings. Moreover, the generative nature of diffusion enables the production of diverse high-performing assortments, offering flexibility beyond a single deterministic solution. These results highlight the potential of generative modeling as a scalable and robust paradigm for combinatorial optimization in data-driven decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于引导离散扩散的模型无关品类组合优化框架，将品类组合表示为二进制向量，通过学习到的逆扩散过程进行随机搜索，并以期望收益估计作为奖励信号偏置局部转移。实验表明该方法在模型误设下保持稳健，常能在高维场景中恢复近最优解，同时利用生成特性产出多样化的高表现品类组合。
Motivation: 传统参数化选择模型（如 Multinomial Logit, MNL）及其变体虽可求解，但对模型误设敏感，难以刻画复杂顾客行为；而显式组合枚举在维度升高时不可行，需要一种不依赖特定参数模型的组合优化方法。
Method: 提出基于 guided discrete diffusion 的模型无关框架：将品类组合编码为二进制向量，学习逆扩散过程执行随机搜索，并引入奖励引导机制，用期望收益估计偏置局部转移，从而在生成过程中平衡探索与利用。
Result: 实验显示该方法能稳定识别高质量品类组合，在模型误设条件下保持稳健，常恢复近最优解；生成式特性还可产出多样化的高表现组合，提供超越单一确定性解的灵活性。
Conclusion: 摘要认为生成式建模可作为数据驱动决策中组合优化的可扩展且稳健的范式，但未给出具体数据集或数值细节，也未讨论与现有选择模型方法的大规模对比。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: TRACES: A Benchmark for Epistemic Reliability in Scientific Reasoning by LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are being proposed as agents in scientific workflows, in domains where no downstream verifier exists. Such deployment assumes the model can distinguish reliable scientific literature from unreliable literature, a capability that has not yet been directly measured. Existing benchmarks evaluate factuality on questions with known answers; the failure mode we target here is different. We introduce a probe corpus of 42 retracted, fraudulent, and pseudoscientific papers, paired with a methodology for eliciting and scoring single-shot model engagement with each paper's framing. Each probe pairs a preamble extracted near-verbatim from the target paper with a scientifically plausible study-design request. The probes span five claim types: fabricated observation, pseudophysical mechanism, magical premise, legitimization bridge, and cargo-cult experiment. Two complementary scores measure whether a model rejects the flawed premise outright (IFR-a) and whether it recognizes the unreliability while still engaging (IFR-i). A depth score, the Engagement Depth Index (EDI), quantifies reproduction of paper- or field-specific withheld details. Across 30 models and 10 repeated runs, aggregate IFR-a is 0.93 $\pm$ 0.004 and aggregate IFR-i is 0.809 $\pm$ 0.009. Models engaged with untenable premises in 95% of all non-empty responses. Every evaluated model fails more than 71% of agentic probes, and 22 of 30 models fail more than 90% of the time. Rejections are concentrated on a small number of high-notoriety topics and specific probes, and disappear under matched-structure controls. These results are consistent with topic-keyed safety behavior rather than robust epistemic competence, and indicate an urgent need for guardrail infrastructure for scientific deployment of language models.

papers.title: Unmasking Toxic Mimicry in Medical Offline Reinforcement Learning for ICU Sepsis Management via Counterfactual Clinical Audits
papers.abstract_en: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) offers considerable promise for optimizing ICU treatment decisions, yet standard evaluation metrics Mean Squared Error (MSE) and Fitted Q-Evaluation (FQE) assess only behavioral imitation and cannot detect Toxic Mimicry, a failure mode in which agents replicate harmful patterns such as treatment withdrawal during comfort-care transitions. Using the MIMIC-III database, we propose the Counterfactual Clinical Audit (CCA) framework, which stress-tests RL agents through physiological perturbations anchored in Surviving Sepsis Campaign (SSC) guidelines. We audit a Medical Decision Transformer (MedDT) and a Historical Causal Transformer (HCT-RL), the latter employing Causal Action Shielding, propensity-based importance weighting, and Conservative Q-Learning. CCA reveals that MedDT paradoxically reduces vasopressor dosage as lactate escalates, contradicting resuscitation guidelines, while HCT-RL maintains physiologically consistent responses. These findings expose a systemic misalignment between statistical fit and clinical safety, supporting counterfactual audits as a necessary evaluation standard for medical RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 ICU 脓毒症治疗中的离线强化学习 (offline RL) 提出一个评估缺陷：标准指标 MSE 和 Fitted Q-Evaluation (FQE) 只能衡量行为模仿，无法识别 Toxic Mimicry——即智能体复现如舒适护理过渡期停止治疗等有害模式。作者基于 MIMIC-III 数据库提出 Counterfactual Clinical Audit (CCA) 框架，通过锚定 Surviving Sepsis Campaign (SSC) 指南的生理扰动对智能体进行压力测试。审计发现 Medical Decision Transformer (MedDT) 在乳酸升高时反而降低血管加压药剂量，违背复苏指南，而 Historical Causal Transformer (HCT-RL) 则保持生理一致的反应，从而揭示统计拟合与临床安全之间的系统性错位。
Motivation: 现有医疗离线 RL 的评估指标只关注行为模仿和值函数拟合，无法捕捉智能体复现临床有害模式这类失败方式，可能导致看似拟合良好但不安全的治疗策略被部署。
Method: 提出 Counterfactual Clinical Audit (CCA) 框架，利用基于 SSC 指南的生理扰动对 RL 智能体进行反向事实压力测试；审计对象包括 Medical Decision Transformer (MedDT) 和带有 Causal Action Shielding、倾向性重要性加权与 Conservative Q-Learning 的 Historical Causal Transformer (HCT-RL)。
Result: 在 MIMIC-III 上，CCA 显示 MedDT 在乳酸升高时矛盾地降低血管加压药剂量，与复苏指南相悖；HCT-RL 则给出生理一致的反应。
Conclusion: 作者认为统计拟合与临床安全可能系统性不一致，反事实审计应成为医疗 RL 的必要评估标准。

papers.title: When Self-Consistency Backfires: Majority Vote Hurts the Majority of Hard Science Problems for Small LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Self-consistency (SC) via majority vote is a widely used way to spend inference-time compute: sample N chains of thought, return the plurality answer. On the full GPQA Diamond benchmark (198 graduate-level science questions), majority voting reduces per-problem accuracy on a majority of problems for two instruction-tuned models from different families: 56.6% of problems for Qwen2.5-7B and 65.7% for Llama-3-8B, with Qwen the primary demonstration and Llama corroborating the direction from a near-chance baseline. The effect was pre-registered on a 151-problem confirmatory split after being observed on 47 exploratory problems, and all four confirmatory hypotheses passed. A grid oracle that routes each problem to the best N across {1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64} marks a theoretical upper bound 14 accuracy points above N = 1 for Qwen and 17 for Llama, an oracle bound requiring ground truth rather than a deployable method. No verifier-free gate reaches it: neither a plurality-agreement gate nor a token-entropy gate moves accuracy more than 0.002 from fixed-budget voting at N = 64. The mechanism is direct: confidence does not track correctness on these problems. In the highest-agreement bin the plurality answer is correct about half the time for Qwen, and for Llama that bin is less accurate than its lowest-agreement bin. We pre-register and confirm these findings on small instruction-tuned models; we do not test reasoning-native models, which we flag as the central open question.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the COLM 2026 Workshop on Efficient Reasoning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在 GPQA Diamond 基准（198 道研究生级科学题）上检验 self-consistency（SC）多数投票对小型指令微调模型的影响，发现多数投票在大部分问题上反而降低准确率：Qwen2.5-7B 上 56.6% 的问题、Llama-3-8B 上 65.7% 的问题变差。作者采用预注册流程，先观察 47 个探索性问题，再在 151 个确认性问题上验证，四项确认假设全部通过。机制分析表明模型的置信度并不跟随正确性，且两类无验证器门控都无法接近 oracle 上界。
Motivation: self-consistency 通过多数投票是常用的推理时计算分配方法，但作者质疑其在硬科学问题场景下对小 LLM 是否始终有效，并发现它实际上会在多数问题上产生反效果。
Method: 在 GPQA Diamond 上对两个不同系列的指令微调模型（Qwen2.5-7B 和 Llama-3-8B）采样 N∈{1,2,4,8,16,32,64} 条思维链并做多数投票；同时构造路由到最佳 N 的网格 oracle 作为理论上界，并测试 plurality-agreement 门控与 token-entropy 门控这两种不依赖验证器的门控策略。
Result: 多数投票使 Qwen 在 56.6%、Llama 在 65.7% 的问题上准确率下降；oracle 路由的理论上界比 N=1 分别高 14 和 17 个准确率点；在 N=64 时两种无验证器门控对准确率的改变均不超过 0.002。在最高 agreement 区间里，Qwen 的多数答案约一半正确，而 Llama 该区间准确率低于其最低 agreement 区间。
Conclusion: 作者在小规模指令微调模型上确认了置信度不跟踪正确性这一机制，说明多数投票在这些硬科学问题上会适得其反；他们明确未测试推理原生模型，并指出这是核心开放问题。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Generative Learning for Quantum Measurement Design
papers.abstract_en: Extracting quantum information from a quantum state is a fundamental task of quantum computation, often requiring the estimation of many non-commuting observables under a finite measurement budget. For both near-term and early fault-tolerant settings, the measurement protocol must balance statistical efficiency against implementation resources such as circuit depth, connectivity, and entangling-gate count. Many existing strategies focus on two extremes: hardware-friendly product measurements with high sampling cost, and fully commuting measurements with deep circuits. Here we recast resource-constrained measurement design as a generative learning problem. We introduce FlowMeas, which uses a generative flow network to directly sample finite ensembles of shallow Clifford measurement circuits subject to a prescribed shot budget and hardware constraints. At zero entangling depth, FlowMeas learns qubit-wise commuting measurement schedules and already matches or improves leading product-measurement methods on nearly all molecular benchmarks. Allowing one or two entangling gate layers yields further reductions in energy estimation error of up to $27\%$ relative to the strongest state-independent product-measurement baseline. The learned policy can also be reused across related Hamiltonians, substantially accelerating retraining along a molecular potential-energy surface. We further obtain results for molecular Hamiltonians with up to 20 qubits and apply the framework to a compactly encoded 54-qubit interacting fermionic model, extending the demonstrated scale beyond prior molecular benchmarks. These results establish generative learning as a flexible and unified framework for quantum measurement design under practical resource constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FlowMeas，将资源受限的量子测量设计重构为生成式学习问题，用生成流网络 (generative flow network) 在给定 shot 预算和硬件约束下直接采样浅层 Clifford 测量电路。零纠缠深度下即可匹配或改进领先的 product-measurement 方法；允许一至两层纠缠门时，能量估计误差相对最强态无关基线最多降低 27%。该策略还可在相关哈密顿量间复用，并已扩展到 20 比特分子体系及 54 比特费米子模型。
Motivation: 量子态信息提取常需在有限测量预算下估计多个不对易观测量，现有策略多在硬件友好的 product measurements（采样成本高）与深电路的完全对易测量之间取折中，缺少在电路深度、连通性和纠缠门数等约束下统一设计测量协议的方法。
Method: FlowMeas 使用生成流网络直接采样满足给定 shot budget 和硬件约束的浅层 Clifford 测量电路集合；零纠缠深度时学习 qubit-wise 对易测量调度，并可加入一至两层纠缠门层来进一步降低估计误差。
Result: 摘要报告在几乎所有分子基准上，零纠缠深度即匹配或改进领先的 product-measurement 方法；加入一或两层纠缠门后，能量估计误差相对最强态无关 product-measurement 基线最多降低 27%；学习到的策略可跨相关哈密顿量复用，加速分子势能面上的重训练，并已应用于最多 20 比特的分子体系及 54 比特交互费米子模型。
Conclusion: 作者认为生成式学习为量子测量设计提供了一个灵活统一的框架，能够在实际资源约束下兼顾统计效率与实现成本。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: AI Guardrail Survival under Single-Cycle Agentic Self-Summarization
papers.abstract_en: Long-running agents periodically compact their context, replacing the transcript with a model-generated summary.Recent work shows that dropping a standing safety constraint during compaction drives behavioral violations acrossmany models (Governance Decay; Chen, 2026). We ask a finer question: under a single compaction cycle, how is a safetyrule lost, and what does that imply for detection and evaluation? Our central finding is that a presence check is not asafety check: when compaction does not drop a rule outright, it often leaves something that looks like a rule but doesnot act like one. On behavioral replay, a degraded residue leads the model to perform the prohibited action far more oftenthan an intact welded rule does (all-case gaps of +34 and +57 points under two replay models, both positive), category-level survival behaves like a residue, and even intact rules sometimes fail to fire, so an audit that checks only textualpresence gives false assurance. Sharpening this, rule-form items are retained substantially more often than prominence-matched facts, which is exactly why presence-based checking feels adequate even though survival is not protection.Textual loss is regime-dependent (weld-or-drop with a single rule; degraded predicate-loss residues under a tighterbudget), and we did not observe the hypothesized textual severing mode. Such loss is silent at runtime and detectableonly by comparison with retained external ground truth (such as a constraint registry), which reveals textual absence butnot whether a surviving rule still fires. We also document evaluation pitfalls where LLM-judge labels alone would havereversed a conclusion. All results concern a single compaction cycle.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究长时运行智能体在单次上下文压缩 (context compaction) 周期内，安全规则是如何丢失的，以及这对检测与评估的启示。核心发现是「存在性检查不等于安全检查」：压缩即使没有直接删除规则，也常留下看似规则但行为上不再起作用的退化残迹 (degraded residue)。行为回放显示，退化残迹导致的违规远多于完整的焊接规则 (weld-or-drop)，两种回放模型下分别有 +34 和 +57 个百分点的差距；规则形式条目比显著性匹配的事实更易被保留，因而基于文本存在性的审计会给人虚假的安全感。文本丢失具有机制依赖性，运行时不产生任何信号，只能通过与外部约束注册表 (constraint registry) 对比来发现；所有结论仅针对单次压缩周期。
Motivation: 已有工作 (Governance Decay; Chen, 2026) 表明压缩过程中直接丢弃安全约束会造成行为违规，本文进一步追问一个更细的问题：在单次压缩周期内规则究竟以何种方式丢失，以及这种丢失模式对检测和评估意味着什么。
Method: 作者在单次压缩周期下对比文本层面的规则保留检查与行为层面的回放测试，刻画规则从完整焊接规则到退化残迹再到文本缺失的转换；统计类别层面的存活率，并比较规则形式条目与显著性匹配事实的保留差异，同时检验 LLM-judge 标签单独使用时的评估陷阱。
Result: 摘要报告在两种回放模型下，退化残迹导致禁止行为的发生率比完整焊接规则高出 +34 和 +57 个百分点；规则形式条目比显著性匹配事实保留更频繁；在更紧的预算下出现退化的谓词丢失残迹，但未观察到假设的文本截断模式；甚至完整的规则有时也无法触发。
Conclusion: 作者强调存在性检查不能替代安全检查：只检查文本是否存在的审计会给出虚假保证，规则丢失在运行时是静默的，只能通过与保留的外部真值 (如约束注册表) 对比来发现，且文本缺失不能说明存活规则是否仍会触发；同时指出仅凭 LLM-judge 标签可能得出相反的结论，全部结果限于单次压缩周期。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mechanism Design for Generative Engines: From Exploitation toward Win-Win Outcomes
papers.abstract_en: Generative engines are reshaping the web ecosystem by making citations a key mechanism for allocating attention, attribution, and downstream value. This creates a strategic tension: content providers are incentivized to optimize for model citation, while platforms must preserve answer quality and trustworthy attribution. We show that this tension can escalate into citation wars. In repeated simulations, state-of-the-art generative engine optimization (GEO) attacks adapt to conventional defenses by producing citation-seeking rewrites that degrade document quality and introduce unsupported claims. To study this problem, we formulate the supplier--platform interaction as a repeated Stackelberg game with partial monitoring. A local best-response analysis identifies when citation competition approaches an inert stationary outcome. Motivated by this finding, we propose a platform--creator mechanism called VCR based on verifiable-content rewards. Rather than only penalizing suspicious rewrites, the platform also credits rewrites that surface checkable factual substance, aligning creator incentives with answer trustworthiness. Experiments on three benchmarks show that VCR consistently achieves the largest Net defense-utility score, outperforming the strongest baseline by an average of 12.1 percentage points, and produces a win--win outcome under our empirical equivalence criterion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究生成引擎（generative engines）生态中内容提供者与平台之间的战略博弈。作者将互动建模为带部分监控的重复 Stackelberg 博弈，指出 GEO 攻击会引发 citation wars，并提出基于可核验内容奖励的平台机制 VCR。实验显示 VCR 在三个基准上平均比最强基线高出 12.1 个百分点的净防御效用，并达到作者定义的 win-win 结果。
Motivation: 生成引擎通过引用分配注意力与价值，内容提供者有动机为模型引用而优化，平台则需保持答案质量与可信归因，这种张力可能升级为引用战（citation wars），且传统防御会被 GEO 攻击适应。
Method: 将供应商-平台交互建模为带部分监控的重复 Stackelberg 博弈，进行局部最佳响应分析，并提出平台-创作者机制 VCR（verifiable-content rewards），在惩罚可疑改写的同时，对呈现可核查事实内容的改写给予信用。
Result: 在三个基准上，VCR 始终取得最大的净防御效用分数，平均比最强基线高 12.1 个百分点，并在经验等效准则下产生 win-win 结果。
Conclusion: 作者主张平台除惩罚可疑改写外，还可通过奖励可核验的事实内容来对齐创作者激励与答案可信度，从而缓解引用竞争并实现双赢。

papers.title: Reoptimization Algorithms for Contextual Bandits with Knapsack Constraints
papers.abstract_en: We study new algorithms for Contextual Bandits with Knapsack. In these problems, there are finitely many types of customers, products, and resources. Each product is made from a fixed combination of resources, and resources have finite capacity. A decision maker must assign each arriving customer one out of a set of multiple possible products. Every assignment of a customer to a product will generate a random reward, which equals an unknown linear function of customer and product features, plus a noise term. The objective is to jointly learn the mean reward function, and to make online assignments to minimize the expected revenue loss relative to an optimal policy that knows the reward function. We propose a natural and simple extension of the Upper-Confidence-Bound (UCB) family of algorithms and apply re-optimization techniques. We show that by taking advantage of re-optimization, our algorithm achieves an average regret of $O(\frac{(\ln T)^3}{T})$ where $T$ is the horizon length. Our bound significantly reduces the $O(\frac{1}{\sqrt{T}})$ bound in the literature for closely related dynamic-pricing problems that are based on re-optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究带背包约束的上下文赌博机（Contextual Bandits with Knapsack）问题，提出一种自然简单的 UCB 算法扩展并应用重优化（re-optimization）技术。作者证明在 horizon T 下该算法达到平均遗憾 O((ln T)^3 / T)，显著优于文献中基于重优化的动态定价问题所达到的 O(1/√T) 界。
Motivation: 现有基于重优化的相关动态定价问题仅达到 O(1/√T) 的平均遗憾，本文目标是利用重优化技术获得更快的遗憾收敛速度。
Method: 基于 Upper-Confidence-Bound (UCB) 家族算法提出一种自然简单的扩展，并在每轮在线决策时结合重优化技术求解带背包约束的分配问题。
Result: 算法达到平均遗憾 O((ln T)^3 / T)，其中 T 为 horizon 长度，显著改善了文献中 O(1/√T) 的界限。
Conclusion: 摘要强调利用重优化可以大幅降低带背包约束的上下文赌博机问题的平均遗憾，为在线资源受限分配问题提供更优的理论保证。
Relevance: 0
