papers.title: From Numbers to Judgment: Specialist LLM Agents and Reinforcement Learning for European Listed Real Estate
papers.abstract_en: We study whether the localized numerical operations and integrative judgments of financial analysis benefit from the same form of LLM specialization. Larix maps a 16-lens European listed-real-estate analysis framework to eight lens-aligned specialists; we compare a frontier LLM under monolithic versus specialist-decomposed prompting while holding the model, source evidence, task instructions, output schema, and scoring fixed. Across 19 firms spanning seven regulatory wrappers, decomposition improves the numerical-task aggregate by 15.8 percentage points but does not reliably improve, and can reduce, performance on judgment tasks, a pattern stable across four frozen-template dispatches; a single-agent control given the complete framework does not reproduce the numerical gain. Post-training Qwen3.5-9B with GRPO using task-aligned structured rewards then raises the development-split score by 12.0 points and the judgment aggregate by 14.2 points, with gains on all four sub-ceiling tasks; the gains transfer to unseen firms (+15.2 points overall; +40.4 on covenant stress) and to unseen regulatory wrappers (+4.3), with positive transfer on all three anti-memorization splits. Prompt-level decomposition thus improves modular numerical execution, whereas targeted parameter adaptation improves integrative financial judgment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究金融分析中的局部数值运算与整合性判断是否受益于同一种 LLM 专业化方式。作者提出 Larix，将欧洲上市房地产的 16 视角分析框架映射为八个视角对齐的专家智能体，并在固定模型、证据、指令、输出格式与打分的条件下对比前沿 LLM 的 monolithic 与 specialist-decomposed 提示。摘要报告分解提示使数值任务聚合得分提升 15.8 个百分点，但对判断类任务没有可靠提升甚至可能降低；用 GRPO 对 Qwen3.5-9B 做后训练后，开发集得分提升 12.0、判断任务聚合提升 14.2，且增益可迁移到未见公司和未见监管框架。
Motivation: 作者想检验金融分析中局部的数值化操作和整体性判断是否需要不同形式的 LLM 专业化，以及提示级分解与参数级适配各自适合哪种任务。
Method: Larix 将 16-lens 欧洲上市房地产分析框架映射为八个 lens-aligned 专家；在保持模型、源证据、任务指令、输出模式和评分不变的情况下对比 monolithic 与 specialist-decomposed 提示，并另设一个拿到完整框架的单智能体对照。随后用任务对齐的结构化奖励对 Qwen3.5-9B 进行 GRPO 后训练。
Result: 在跨越七个监管框架的 19 家公司上，分解提示使数值任务聚合提升 15.8 个百分点，但对判断任务不产生可靠提升且可能下降；GRPO 后训练使开发集得分提高 12.0、判断聚合提高 14.2，并带来所有四个 sub-ceiling 任务的增益。迁移结果显示：未见公司整体 +15.2（covenant stress +40.4），未见监管框架 +4.3，三个 anti-memorization 拆分均为正迁移。
Conclusion: 摘要的结论是：提示级分解改善模块化数值执行，而针对性的参数适配改善整合性金融判断；这一分工模式在多个防记忆拆分上保持稳定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards an approach to multivariate outlier detection for District Heating System data
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we test different methods for multivariate detection of outliers in the data of transmitted heat energy in the selected substation of local District Heating System, by also considering outside ambient temperature, namely Z-score (univariate, as a benchmark), Mahalanobis distances, Principal Component Analysis (PCA), Isolation Forest and Hotelling's T-squared test. The overall research aims at uncovering irregular plant operation, with a wider objective of identifying the opportunities for reducing the consumption of gas in central heating plants as well as the CO2 emission. The proposed approach considers specific domain circumstances, such as irrelevance of zero transmit-ted energy timepoints as indication of off-grid plant. The outcomes of the different methods are discussed with domain experts. It was concluded that PCA, Isolation Forest and Hotelling method provide relevant results. Finally, we adopt the ensemble method (selection based on the agreement of all three methods on the detected outliers) as the final approach.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 4 figures. This preprint corresponds to the paper published in Lecture Notes in Networks and Systems, vol. 860 (ICIST 2024), Springer
papers.journal_ref: Lecture Notes in Networks and Systems, Vol. 860 (ICIST 2024), Springer, 2024
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对区域供热系统（District Heating System）中传输热能数据的多变量异常检测，在考虑室外环境温度的情况下，比较 Z-score（单变量基准）、马氏距离、主成分分析（PCA）、孤立森林和 Hotelling T-squared 检验等方法，目标是揭示不规则工厂运行并寻找减少燃气消耗与 CO2 排放的机会。与领域专家讨论后，作者认为 PCA、孤立森林和 Hotelling 方法结果相关，最终采用三种方法一致同意的集成方式作为最终异常检测方案。
Motivation: 区域供热系统的运行数据存在多变量异常，识别这些异常有助于发现设备运行不正常并降低燃气消耗与碳排放；同时需要考虑零传输能量时间点不代表离网运行等特定领域情境。
Method: 采用多种多变量异常检测方法对选定的 DHS 子站传输热能数据（结合室外温度）进行测试，包括 Z-score、马氏距离、PCA、孤立森林和 Hotelling T-squared 检验，并最终使用基于三种有效方法一致同意的集成选择方案。
Result: 摘要未给出定量结果；与领域专家讨论后认为 PCA、孤立森林和 Hotelling 方法能提供相关结果，而最终集成方法被采纳为最终方案。
Conclusion: 作者建议采用三种有效方法一致同意的集成方法作为最终异常检测方案，但摘要未报告具体性能数字或对该方法局限性的讨论。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对区域供热系统（District Heating System）中传输热能数据的多变量异常检测，在考虑室外环境温度的情况下，比较 Z-score（单变量基准）、马氏距离、主成分分析（PCA）、孤立森林和 Hotelling T-squared 检验等方法，目标是揭示不规则工厂运行并寻找减少燃气消耗与 CO2 排放的机会。与领域专家讨论后，作者认为 PCA、孤立森林和 Hotelling 方法结果相关，最终采用三种方法一致同意的集成方式作为最终异常检测方案。

summary_sections.method: 采用多种多变量异常检测方法对选定的 DHS 子站传输热能数据（结合室外温度）进行测试，包括 Z-score、马氏距离、PCA、孤立森林和 Hotelling T-squared 检验，并最终使用基于三种有效方法一致同意的集成选择方案。

papers.title: PAIR: Pairwise-Aware Inclusion Reweighting for Adaptive Rollout Allocation in RLVR
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) spends most of its compute generating groups of long reasoning trajectories. Recent allocators reduce this cost by assigning budgets to prompts, rollouts, or tokens according to a pointwise notion of difficulty or utility. We identify a statistical mismatch: the unclipped leave-one-out group-relative score gradient is not a sum of independent point contributions, but a second-order U-statistic over pairs of rollouts. Completing one rollout therefore reveals contrast with every other completed rollout, and adaptive endpoint selection changes which pair terms are observable. We introduce PAIR (Pairwise-Aware Inclusion Reweighting), which treats short rollout prefixes as vertices and pair-gradient terms as edges of a contrast graph. A prefix-only predictor estimates correctness and remaining token cost; a convex design chooses positive continuation probabilities under an expected suffix-token budget; and each edge induced by completed vertices is inverse-weighted by its logged joint inclusion probability. Under conditionally independent on-policy rollouts and an unclipped, unstandardized objective, the resulting estimator is design-unbiased for the complete candidate-pair gradient. Across compute-matched RLVR runs on Qwen3-1.7B/4B, PAIR improves average accuracy by +1.2 and +1.4 over the strongest pointwise allocator while using 51% and 52% fewer generated tokens than full-group GRPO. A frozen-population estimator audit confirms that unweighted adaptive selection is biased, whereas pair-inclusion correction recovers the complete-pair target at matched suffix cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对可验证奖励强化学习 (RLVR) 中自适应 rollout 分配的计算浪费问题，指出未裁剪的留一法组相对得分梯度本质上是关于 rollout 对的二阶 U-统计量，而非逐点贡献之和。作者提出 PAIR (Pairwise-Aware Inclusion Reweighting)，把前缀视为顶点、pair 梯度项视为对比图 (contrast graph) 的边，并用前缀预测器与凸设计选择继续采样概率，再按联合包含概率的倒数加权每条边，得到设计无偏的估计器。计算量匹配的实验中，PAIR 在 Qwen3-1.7B/4B 上比最强的逐点分配器平均准确率提升 +1.2 和 +1.4，同时比全组 GRPO 少生成 51% 和 52% 的 token。
Motivation: 现有 RLVR 预算分配器按 prompt、rollout 或 token 的逐点难度/效用分配预算，忽略了完成一个 rollout 会揭示它与所有已完成 rollout 之间的对比信息；由于自适应端点选择会改变可观测的 pair 项，对 U-统计量结构的误读会导致有偏的梯度估计。
Method: PAIR 将短 rollout 前缀作为顶点、pair 梯度项作为对比图的边；用一个仅基于前缀的预测器估计正确性与剩余 token 成本，通过凸设计在期望后缀 token 预算约束下选择正继续概率，并将每个由已完成顶点诱导的边按其对数联合包含概率 (logged joint inclusion probability) 逆加权，从而构造对完整候选 pair 梯度的设计无偏估计器。
Result: 在条件独立 on-policy rollout 与未裁剪、未标准化目标下，估计器对完整候选 pair 梯度设计无偏；Qwen3-1.7B/4B 的 compute-matched RLVR 实验中，PAIR 比最强逐点分配器平均准确率提升 +1.2 和 +1.4，并相对全组 GRPO 节省 51% 和 52% 的生成 token。冻结总体的估计器审计确认，未加权的自适应选择有偏，而 pair 包含校正可在匹配后缀成本下恢复完整 pair 目标。
Conclusion: 摘要强调把 rollout 分配问题显式建模为 pair-level U-统计量并做包含概率校正，可以在显著降低生成成本的同时提高 RLVR 训练准确率，且估计器具备设计无偏性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Gaze Target Estimation Anywhere with Concepts
papers.abstract_en: Estimating human gaze targets from images in-the-wild is an important and formidable task. Existing approaches primarily employ brittle, multi-stage pipelines that require explicit inputs, like head bounding boxes and human pose, in order to identify the subject of gaze analysis. As a result, detection errors can cascade and lead to failure. Moreover, these prior works lack the flexibility of specifying the gaze analysis task via natural language prompting, an approach which has been shown to have significant benefits in convenience and scalability for other image analysis tasks. To overcome these limitations, we introduce the Promptable Gaze Target Estimation (PGE) task, a new end-to-end, concept-driven paradigm for gaze analysis. PGE conditions gaze prediction on flexible user text or visual prompts (e.g., "the boy in the red shirt" or "person in point [0.52, 0.48]") to identify a specific subject for gaze analysis. This approach integrates subject localization with gaze estimation, and eliminates the rigid dependency on intermediate analysis stages. We develop a scalable data engine to generate Gaze-Co (Gaze Estimation with Concepts), a dataset and benchmark of 120K high-quality, prompt-annotated image pairs. We also propose GazeAnywhere, the first model designed for PGE. GazeAnywhere uses a transformer-based detector to fuse features from frozen encoders and simultaneously solves subject localization, in/out-of-frame presence, and gaze target heatmap estimation. GazeAnywhere achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple PGE benchmarks, setting a strong baseline for this new problem even on a difficult out-of-domain, real-world clinical dataset. GazeAnywhere is open-sourced in github.com/IrohXu/GazeAnywhere.
papers.comment: CVPR 2026 Code and Benchmark are aviliable at https://github.com/IrohXu/GazeAnywhere and https://huggingface.co/datasets/IrohXu/Gaze-Co-Benchmark
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出可提示的注视目标估计 (Promptable Gaze Target Estimation, PGE) 任务，将注视分析从多阶段显式输入管线改为端到端的、以概念为驱动的范式，允许用户用文本或视觉提示指定被分析对象。作者构建了包含 120K 标注图像对的 Gaze-Co 数据集与基准，并提出 GazeAnywhere 模型，用基于 Transformer 的检测器融合冻结编码器特征，同时解决主体定位、画面内外存在性与注视热图估计。摘要报告 GazeAnywhere 在多个 PGE 基准上达到 SOTA，并在困难的域外真实临床数据集上仍表现良好。
Motivation: 现有野外注视目标估计方法依赖脆弱的级联管线，需要头部边界框、人体姿态等显式中间输入，检测误差会逐级放大；同时这些方法无法通过自然语言提示灵活指定注视分析任务，限制了便利性与可扩展性。
Method: 定义端到端的 PGE 任务，以用户提供的文本或视觉概念提示（如“穿红衬衫的男孩”或“点 [0.52, 0.48]”处的人）作为条件，将主体定位与注视估计融合为单一问题。作者开发可扩展数据引擎生成 Gaze-Co 数据集，并提出 GazeAnywhere：基于 Transformer 的检测器融合多个冻结编码器特征，联合输出主体定位、画面内外存在性和注视目标热图。
Result: 摘要报告 GazeAnywhere 在多个 PGE 基准上取得最先进性能，为这一新问题建立了强基线，并且在困难且域外（out-of-domain）的真实世界临床数据集上依然有效。
Conclusion: 作者认为概念驱动的可提示范式能够消除对中间分析阶段的刚性依赖，并强调 GazeAnywhere 与 Gaze-Co 基准均已开源，可供社区继续研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Adaptation of Generalist Robot Policies with Minimal Data
papers.abstract_en: A central goal in robot learning is to move beyond task-specific human data collection toward robots that improve through autonomous interaction. Yet fully autonomous learning remains difficult with current policies: sparse rewards and weak zero-shot exploration make it unlikely that a robot will discover successful behavior from scratch. We study minimal-data adaptation, a regime in which a pre-trained robot policy must learn a new task from as little as one demonstration followed by autonomous online interaction. This setting serves as the closest tractable proxy for fully autonomous improvement, allowing us to study whether minimal human guidance can bootstrap autonomous learning and what algorithmic ingredients make it feasible. We build MiDAS, a simple offline-to-online RL recipe that first anchors a pre-trained VLA to the target task with behavior cloning on single/few demonstrations, then improves it through value-based online RL on a residual policy parameterization. Across LIBERO and RoboCasa, MiDAS recovers strong task performance from as little as one demonstration, substantially outperforming baselines and generalizing beyond demonstrated conditions. We further evaluate MiDAS on a bimanual YAM platform. Starting from a fragile low-success policy obtained from a single demonstration, MiDAS improves its robustness and learns new successful behaviors over ~6 hours of online interaction. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of reliable robot policy adaptation from a single task demonstration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究最小数据自适应（minimal-data adaptation）问题，即预训练机器人策略只依赖一条演示加自主在线交互来学会新任务。作者提出 MiDAS，一个简单的离线到在线强化学习（offline-to-online RL）流程：先用行为克隆把预训练 VLA 策略锚定到目标任务，再通过基于残差策略参数化的值函数在线 RL 进行改进。在 LIBERO、RoboCasa 及双臂 YAM 平台上，MiDAS 从单条演示即可恢复强任务性能并泛化到未演示条件。
Motivation: 机器人学习的目标是摆脱针对任务的人工数据收集，转向通过自主交互改进，但稀疏奖励和弱零样本探索使得从零开始发现成功行为非常困难。作者把最小数据自适应视为完全自主改进最接近的可操作替代方案，希望弄清最小人类引导能否启动自主学习以及哪些算法要素是可行的。
Method: 提出 MiDAS，一个离线到在线 RL 配方：先在单条或少量演示上对预训练 VLA 策略做行为克隆（behavior cloning）以锚定目标任务，然后采用残差策略参数化（residual policy parameterization）并结合基于值函数的在线 RL 进一步提升策略。
Result: 在 LIBERO 和 RoboCasa 上，MiDAS 从少至一条演示即可恢复强任务性能，显著优于基线并能泛化到演示条件之外；在双臂 YAM 平台上，从单条演示得到的脆弱低成功率策略出发，MiDAS 在大约 6 小时在线交互内提升了鲁棒性并学会新的成功行为。
Conclusion: 作者称这是首次展示从单条任务演示出发的可靠机器人策略自适应，表明最小数据自适应可以作为完全自主改进的可操作代理，并且简单的离线锚定加在线 RL 组合在该机制下是有效的。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Lifecycle-Optimal Tokenization: Vocabulary Size as a Deployment-Regime-Dependent Infrastructure Parameter
papers.abstract_en: Tokenizer vocabulary size is a foundational design choice in large language model (LLM) infrastructure, yet it is typically fixed at training time based on convention rather than deployment analysis. We show that the cost-optimal vocabulary is not a constant but a function of the serving regime. We formalize total deployment cost as $C_{lifecycle}(V) = C_{train}(V) + λ\cdot C_{infer}(V, B)$, where $λ$ is inference volume and $B$ is the serving batch size. Through controlled experiments on two GPU families spanning the memory-bound to compute-bound regimes (A10G, ridge $\approx$ 117 FLOP/byte; A100, ridge $\approx$ 183 FLOP/byte), we demonstrate: (1) the inference-optimal vocabulary shifts 16x with serving batch, from 32k at $B=1$ to 524k at $B=64+$, driven by amortization of the $V \times d$ unembedding matrix read; (2) at 1.3-2.3B model scale, quality (bits per byte, BPB) is optimized at $V=65$k, confirming scale-dependent vocabulary preference; (3) the lifecycle-optimal vocabulary diverges from training-optimal by up to 16x for production deployments. Quality is approximately invariant across the optimal range ($<$2% BPB spread), making vocabulary a pure systems optimization with no quality penalty in the measured range. Our results provide actionable capacity planning guidance: on-device deployments ($B=1$) should use $V \approx 32$k; datacenter serving ($B \geq 64$, $λ\geq 10$) should use $V \approx 131$-262k.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文论证大语言模型（LLM）的分词器词表大小不应按惯例在训练时固定，而应作为依赖部署场景的基础设施参数。作者将总部署成本形式化为 C_lifecycle(V) = C_train(V) + λ·C_infer(V, B)，并在 A10G 与 A100 两类 GPU 上进行受控实验，发现推理最优词表随服务批次大小变化最高达 16 倍，且在测量范围内质量几乎不变，使词表选择成为纯系统优化问题。
Motivation: 分词器词表大小是 LLM 基础设施的基础设计选择，但通常在训练时按惯例确定，而非基于部署分析；论文指出成本最优词表不是常数，而是服务场景（serving regime）的函数。
Method: 提出生命周期总部署成本模型 C_lifecycle(V) = C_train(V) + λ·C_infer(V, B)，其中 λ 为推理量、B 为服务批次大小；通过在跨内存受限到计算受限区间的两类 GPU（A10G 与 A100）上做受控实验来刻画词表大小的影响。
Result: 推理最优词表随批次大小从 B=1 时的 32k 变为 B=64+ 时的 524k，即 16 倍偏移，源于 V×d unembedding 矩阵读取的摊销；在 1.3-2.3B 模型规模下质量（bits per byte, BPB）在 V=65k 最优；生命周期最优词表与训练最优相差可达 16 倍，而最优区间内 BPB 差异小于 2%。

papers.title: Market-Information-Aware Gated-LoRA of Foundation Models for Transferable Day-Ahead Electricity Price Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Electricity price forecasting is crucial for market participants but remains difficult because prices are volatile, market-specific, and closely tied to anticipated system conditions. Existing supervised methods depend largely on market-specific historical data, limiting their use in newly established or data-scarce markets. This paper proposes a market-information-aware adaptation framework that transfers the Chronos-2 time-series foundation model to day-ahead electricity price forecasting. It first constructs a multi-source market information (MSMI) interface aligning 7-day price context with pre-clearing supply--demand, reserve, maintenance, generator-capacity, and intertie variables, and then trains a source-domain gated low-rank adapter (LoRA), updating about $1\%$ of model parameters without target-market labels. The gate scales the frozen source adapter according to reserve-tightness and operating-state signals. A leave-one-market-out protocol is adopted for evaluating cross-market transferability. Experiments on four Chinese provincial day-ahead spot markets show that the proposed framework reduces the average MAE/RMSE by $6.24\%/7.99\%$ relative to market-information-aware zero-shot Chronos-2 and by $3.05\%/3.52\%$ relative to vanilla Source-LoRA. Experiments show that the gain is not reproduced by a learned global scalar or by random gate initialization, while the additional improvement over Source-LoRA is limited. These results suggest that market-structured inputs and state-dependent gated LoRA can provide a practical transfer path for data-scarce electricity markets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向日前电力市场价格预测的市场信息感知适配框架，将 Chronos-2 时间序列基础模型迁移到电价预测任务。框架先构建多源市场信息（MSMI）接口，将 7 天价格背景与预出清供需、备用、检修、机组容量和联络线变量对齐，再训练源域门控低秩适配器（gated LoRA），仅更新约 1% 参数且不需要目标市场标签。在四个中国省级日前现货市场上的留一市场（leave-one-market-out）实验中，该方法相对市场信息感知的零样本 Chronos-2 平均降低 MAE/RMSE 6.24%/7.99%，相对 vanilla Source-LoRA 降低 3.05%/3.52%。
Motivation: 电价预测对市场参与者关键但困难，因为价格波动大、具有市场特异性且与预期系统状态密切相关；现有监督方法依赖市场特定历史数据，在新建立或数据稀缺市场中受限。
Method: 提出市场信息感知适配框架：构建 MSMI 接口对齐 7 天价格上下文与预出清供给需求、备用、检修、机组容量及联络线变量，并训练源域门控 LoRA，门根据备用紧张程度和运行状态信号缩放冻结的源适配器，全程无需目标市场标签。
Result: 在四个中国省级日前现货市场实验中，该方法相对市场信息感知零样本 Chronos-2 平均降低 MAE/RMSE 6.24%/7.99%，相对 vanilla Source-LoRA 降低 3.05%/3.52%；但摘要指出相对于 Source-LoRA 的额外提升有限，且该增益无法由学习到的全局标量或随机门初始化复现。
Conclusion: 摘要认为市场结构化输入和状态依赖的门控 LoRA 可为数据稀缺电力市场提供一条实际可行的迁移路径。

papers.title: Inverse Theory of Mind Modeling for Content Recommendation: From Web Browsing to Dynamic Intelligent Interfaces
papers.abstract_en: Modern recommender systems treat observed actions as reliable proxies for user preferences, yet interactions often reflect exploration or comparison rather than stable preference expression. As interfaces evolve from static layouts toward generative UIs and immersive extended reality (XR), the need for deeper, modality-agnostic user understanding grows: these adaptive environments must decide not only what to present but where, when, how prominently, and most importantly why a user acts. We propose an Inverse Theory of Mind (IToM) pipeline that reasons backward from observed interactions to infer the beliefs, preferences, and decision-making traits that explain behavior. The pipeline reconstructs each user's decision context, including what was chosen and what alternatives were available, applies LLM-driven counterfactual reasoning to produce evidence-grounded natural-language belief statements, and synthesizes these beliefs through multi-hypothesis abductive inference into a structured user persona. We evaluate on the OPeRA dataset against ground-truth personality assessments, attitudinal surveys, and interview-based personas across four tasks: next action prediction, shopping attitude alignment, Big Five personality inference, and held-out category prediction. Results show that inferred personas match or exceed ground-truth personas and that multi-hypothesis reasoning is essential for accurate personality prediction. We further demonstrate cross-modal transferability with a persona-driven spatial banking application on VisionOS.
papers.comment: Preprint for conference full paper at 20th ACM Conference on Recommender Systems (RecSys '26), Minneapolis, MN, USA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种逆心智理论 (Inverse Theory of Mind, IToM) 流水线，从用户观测行为反推其信念、偏好与决策特质，进而生成结构化用户人设 (persona)。该方法在 OPeRA 数据集上结合真实人格评估、态度问卷与访谈式人设进行验证，覆盖下一行为预测、购物态度对齐、Big Five 人格推断与保留类目预测四项任务；结果显示推断出的人设匹配或超越真实人设，且多假设推理对人格预测至关重要。作者还在 VisionOS 上的空间银行应用演示了人设驱动的跨模态迁移能力。
Motivation: 现有推荐系统把观测行为视为用户偏好的可靠代理，但交互常反映探索或比较而非稳定的偏好表达；随着界面从静态布局走向生成式 UI 与沉浸式 XR，系统不仅需要决定展示什么，还需要理解用户为何行动，因此需要更深的、跨模态的用户建模。
Method: 构建 IToM 流水线：先从观测行为重建每个用户的决策上下文（包括被选项与可用备选），再用 LLM 驱动的反事实推理 (counterfactual reasoning) 生成有证据支撑的自然语言信念陈述，最后通过多假设溯因推理 (multi-hypothesis abductive inference) 将这些信念综合为结构化用户人设。
Result: 在 OPeRA 数据集上的四项任务（下一行为预测、购物态度对齐、Big Five 人格推断、保留类目预测）中，推断出的人设匹配或超过真实人设；消融表明多假设推理对准确的人格预测必不可少；并展示了在 VisionOS 银行空间应用上人设的跨模态可迁移性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调从行为反推信念与决策特质的逆推理思路可以超越静态偏好代理，支撑更动态、智能且模态无关的推荐界面；跨模态应用演示表明该方法适用于超出传统 Web 浏览推荐的场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ODE-Based Transformer Decoders for Iterative Sign Language Translation
papers.abstract_en: Sign language translation has achieved strong results with Transformer architectures, yet recent improvements largely rely on scaling model capacity at the cost of increased computation. We propose a parameter-efficient alternative that improves expressiveness without increasing model size. Rather than scaling capacity, we focus on enhancing the update dynamics of iterative refinement decoders, where each refinement step corresponds to one internal decoder iteration that progressively improves the latent representation before translation generation. We reinterpret residual refinement updates from an Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE) perspective and replace them with higher-order numerical integration schemes, namely Runge--Kutta methods (RK-2 and RK-4). These methods perform multiple function evaluations within each refinement step to produce more accurate and stable representation updates without adding decoder parameters. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first application of ODE-inspired update dynamics to sign language translation. RK-2 achieves 22.96 BLEU-4 on the PHOENIX-2014-T test set and 19.34 BLEU-4 on the CSL-Daily test set, outperforming the IPSLT baseline on both benchmarks, with fewer decoder layers and refinement iterations on CSL-Daily. These results suggest that stronger refinement dynamics can improve translation performance under parameter-efficient decoder designs, providing a complementary alternative to conventional model scaling.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 14th International Workshop on Assistive Computer Vision and Robotics (ACVR 2026), held in conjunction with ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对手语翻译中 Transformer 改进主要依赖扩大模型容量、计算代价高的问题，提出一种参数高效替代方案。作者从常微分方程 (ODE) 视角重新解释迭代精炼解码器中的残差更新，用高阶数值积分格式 Runge--Kutta (RK-2, RK-4) 在每个精炼步内进行多次函数评估，在不增加解码器参数的前提下提升表示更新的精度与稳定性。这是 ODE 启发的更新动态首次用于手语翻译。
Motivation: 现有手语翻译模型的性能提升主要来自扩大模型规模，导致计算开销显著增加；需要一种在不增加模型大小的情况下提高表达能力的参数高效方法。
Method: 将迭代精炼解码器中的残差更新视为 ODE 离散化，并用 Runge--Kutta 方法 (RK-2 和 RK-4) 替代原始残差更新；每个精炼步内多次函数求值以生成更准确、更稳定的潜在表示更新，且不增加解码器参数。
Result: RK-2 在 PHOENIX-2014-T 测试集上达到 22.96 BLEU-4，在 CSL-Daily 测试集上达到 19.34 BLEU-4，均优于 IPSLT 基线；在 CSL-Daily 上还使用更少的解码器层和精炼迭代次数。
Conclusion: 更强的精炼更新动态能在参数高效解码器设计下提升翻译性能，为常规的模型缩放提供互补替代方案。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Dynamics Models for Offline Hyperparameter Selection in Real-World RL
papers.abstract_en: A key obstacle to deploying reinforcement learning in real-world systems is hyperparameter selection, particularly when simulators are unavailable and online experimentation is costly. Prior work has proposed calibration models trained on offline data to approximate environment dynamics and enable offline hyperparameter selection, but these methods have so far been evaluated only in simple simulated settings. In this paper, we present the first application of calibration models in a real-world industrial setting: a municipal water treatment plant. We evaluate several calibration model approaches, including a k-nearest neighbors model with a Laplacian distance metric, on high-dimensional, non-stationary sensor data for nexting prediction tasks. Our results show that these models can generate realistic long-horizon rollouts and recover meaningful hyperparameter sensitivity trends. We further examine how calibration models scale to year-long datasets, how they support the selection of fine-tuning learning rates for pre-trained agents, and how robust they are under distribution shift. Overall, our findings provide a proof of concept for using offline dynamics models to support RL deployment in real-world environments, while highlighting important practical challenges for future work.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 2026 Reinforcement Learning Conference (RLC)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次将校准模型 (calibration model) 应用于真实工业场景——市政水处理厂，用于离线超参数选择，以解决无仿真器且在线实验成本高昂时强化学习 (RL) 部署的难题。作者在高层维、非平稳的传感器数据上评估了包括带拉普拉斯距离度量的 k 近邻模型在内的多种校准方法，用于 nexting 预测任务。结果表明这些模型能生成逼真的长时程 rollout，并恢复有意义的超参数敏感性趋势。
Motivation: 在真实世界系统中部署 RL 的主要障碍是超参数选择，尤其在无仿真器且在线实验昂贵时。已有的校准模型虽在离线数据上训练以近似环境动态并支持离线超参数选择，但仅在简单模拟环境中评估过。
Method: 提出将校准模型用于真实工业环境（市政水处理厂）的首个应用，评估多种校准模型方法，包括带 Laplacian 距离度量的 k 近邻模型，任务为基于高层维、非平稳传感器数据的 nexting 预测。
Result: 实验显示这些模型能生成逼真的长期 rollout，并恢复有意义的超参数敏感性趋势。研究还考察了校准模型扩展到全年数据集的能力、对预训练智能体微调学习率选择的支持，以及在分布偏移下的稳健性。
Conclusion: 作者认为这是离线动态模型支持真实环境 RL 部署的概念验证，同时强调了未来工作面临的重要实际挑战。

summary_sections.method: 提出将校准模型用于真实工业环境（市政水处理厂）的首个应用，评估多种校准模型方法，包括带 Laplacian 距离度量的 k 近邻模型，任务为基于高层维、非平稳传感器数据的 nexting 预测。
summary_sections.result: 实验显示这些模型能生成逼真的长期 rollout，并恢复有意义的超参数敏感性趋势。研究还考察了校准模型扩展到全年数据集的能力、对预训练智能体微调学习率选择的支持，以及在分布偏移下的稳健性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为这是离线动态模型支持真实环境 RL 部署的概念验证，同时强调了未来工作面临的重要实际挑战。

papers.title: Governing Agentic AI in FinTech
papers.abstract_en: Financial institutions are delegating consequential decisions to agentic AI systems that decompose goals, coordinate models and tools, and act with little oversight. Yet agentic AI governance in FinTech is under-investigated. We argue the binding governance constraint is not capability but verifiability. We define the Verifiability Gap as the shortfall between the verification delegated authority demands and the explainability and reproducibility retained after a decision. It is indexed to a verifier, evidentiary standard, and audit lag. We develop a multilevel governance theory for agentic AI and test its mechanisms in three studies over nine model versions, from a three-billion-parameter local model to a commercial frontier system. Study 1 shows that provider releases alter historical financial actions, and that the controls replay needs belong to the provider: the frontier model rejects temperature, top_p and top_k outright and exposes no random seed. Under the tightest controls each endpoint allows, a local model reproduced 320 of 320 executions, hosted models 319 of 320 and 959 of 960. Study 2 shows that orchestration is a latent policy layer. Architecture changes final actions, and no execution record repeated in any configuration at any scale. The frontier model reproduces its own actions more often than the local ones, its record no better, and loses a comparable share of its differentiation. Capability buys a higher starting point, not auditability. Study 3 shows two deterministic credit-model versions each reproduce their current action perfectly, yet the current cannot recover a historical one. We conceptualize reproducibility as a governance profile, not a scalar, yielding evidence-contingent delegation: authority is defensible only while retained evidence substantiates its exercise. Beyond finance, the framework extends to other high-stakes domains requiring auditability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究金融科技中代理型 AI（agentic AI）的治理问题，提出约束性瓶颈在于可验证性（verifiability）而非能力，并定义“可验证性差距”（Verifiability Gap）。作者构建多层治理理论，通过三项研究、九个模型版本（从 30 亿参数本地模型到商业前沿系统）检验机制，发现能力并不购买可审计性，可复现性应被理解为治理画像而非标量，进而提出基于证据的授权（evidence-contingent delegation）。
Motivation: 金融机构正将重大决策委托给能够自主分解目标、协调模型与工具且几乎不受监督的代理型 AI 系统，而金融科技中的代理型 AI 治理研究不足；作者主张治理的真正约束不是能力而是可验证性。
Method: 定义 Verifiability Gap 为授权所要求的验证与决策后保留的可解释性和可复现性之间的落差，并以验证者、证据标准与审计滞后（audit lag）为索引；据此发展多层级治理理论，并通过三项研究、九个模型版本检验治理机制。
Result: 研究 1 显示提供商发布行为会改变历史金融动作，前沿模型直接拒绝 temperature、top_p、top_k 且不暴露随机种子，在最严格控制下本地模型复现 320/320 次执行，托管模型分别复现 319/320 与 959/960。研究 2 表明编排（orchestration）是潜在的政策层，架构变化会改变最终动作且任何配置下都没有重复的执行记录，前沿模型比本地模型更常复现自身行为但记录并不更好。研究 3 显示两个确定性信贷模型版本都能完美复现各自当前动作，但当前版本无法恢复历史动作。
Conclusion: 作者将可复现性概念化为治理画像而非单一标量，认为只有保留证据能证实授权行使时，权威才可辩护；该框架可扩展到金融之外需要可审计性的高风险领域。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Can Frontier LLMs Match Natively Multimodal Embeddings? A Comparison on Hard-Negative Text-to-Image Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal retrieval and classification across different types of media, spanning text, images,video and audio, has traditionally relied on dual-encoder models that align visual and textual representations through contrastive learning. The March 2026 release of Gemini Embedding 2, Google's first natively multimodal embedding model to map text, images, video, audio, and documents into a single shared space, raises competition among multimodal retrieval systems. Simultaneously, frontier Large language models (LLMs) have also demonstrated strong visual understanding, raising the question of whether they can serve as effective zero-shot rankers. Our study provides the first direct comparison of native multimodal embeddings against LLM-based visual ranking on Flickr30k. We observe that GPT-4.1 and Claude Sonnet 4.6 perform on par with Gemini Embedding 2. Additionally, once embeddings are precomputed, multimodal embeddings are better suited for low-latency applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次直接比较原生多模态嵌入模型与前沿 LLM 在 Flickr30k 硬负样本文本-图像检索上的零样本排序能力。摘要报告 GPT-4.1 和 Claude Sonnet 4.6 的表现与 Google 原生多模态嵌入模型 Gemini Embedding 2 相当；而在嵌入预计算的前提下，多模态嵌入更适合低延迟应用。
Motivation: 多模态检索传统依赖双编码器，而 2026 年发布的 Gemini Embedding 2 将文本、图像、视频、音频和文档映射到单一共享空间，加剧了检索系统的竞争；同时前沿 LLM 已展现出强视觉理解能力，但它们能否作为有效的零样本排序器尚未被直接比较。
Method: 在 Flickr30k 上以硬负样本文本-图像检索为任务，对原生多模态嵌入（Gemini Embedding 2）与基于 LLM 的视觉排序方法（GPT-4.1、Claude Sonnet 4.6）进行直接对比。
Result: 摘要显示 GPT-4.1 和 Claude Sonnet 4.6 在检索性能上与 Gemini Embedding 2 相当；一旦嵌入预先计算完成，多模态嵌入在低延迟场景下更具优势。
Conclusion: 摘要未给出强倾向性结论，仅指出在性能接近的情况下，预计算嵌入更适合低延迟应用。

papers.title: Weightless Fine-Tuning: Personalizing LLMs via Logit-Space Transport
papers.abstract_en: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is a standard approach for adapting LLMs to a target distribution, but in settings such as personalization, where each author requires separate weight access, optimization, storage, and retraining, its costs become prohibitive. We propose Weightless Fine-Tuning (WFT), a training-free decoding-time method that approximates the distributional effect of SFT without weight updates. WFT computes supervised residuals on an author's training sequence and transports them to the current prompt through a cross-prefix transport operator estimated from dropout-induced cross-covariance. The operator captures how a perturbation at one context propagates to predictions at another, replacing gradient-based parameter updates with logit-space corrections. On three LaMP personalization benchmarks, WFT achieves the best average performance across datasets, matches or exceeds SFT on individual tasks, and outperforms other lightweight baselines on average. In a budget-controlled comparison, WFT approaches SFT performance using less than 7% of the effective computation. Logit-level analysis shows a cosine similarity of 0.875 between the logit shifts induced by WFT and SFT over 95% of the next-token probability mass, suggesting that WFT captures the distributional effect of supervised adaptation without modifying model weights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Weightless Fine-Tuning (WFT)，一种无需训练、在解码时进行的方法，通过 logit 空间运输 (logit-space transport) 逼近监督微调 (SFT) 的分布效果。在三个 LaMP 个性化基准上，WFT 平均性能最佳，在个别任务上匹配或超过 SFT，并在预算控制比较中用不到 7% 的有效计算接近 SFT 性能。logit 级分析显示，WFT 与 SFT 的 logit 位移余弦相似度为 0.875。
Motivation: 在个性化等场景中，每个作者都要求独立的权重访问、优化、存储和重训练，SFT 的成本变得过高；因此需要在不更新模型权重的前提下近似 SFT 的分布调整效果。
Method: WFT 在作者的训练序列上计算监督残差，并通过由 dropout 诱导的交叉协方差估计的 cross-prefix transport operator 将其运输到当前提示。该算子刻画一个上下文中的扰动如何传播到另一个上下文的预测，从而用 logit 空间修正替代基于梯度的参数更新。
Result: 在三个 LaMP 个性化基准上，WFT 取得最佳平均性能，在个别任务上匹配或超过 SFT，并平均优于其他轻量级基线；预算控制比较中，WFT 以不到 7% 的有效计算接近 SFT 性能。logit 分析表明，在超过 95% 的下一 token 概率质量上，WFT 与 SFT 诱导的 logit 位移余弦相似度为 0.875。
Conclusion: 摘要指出 WFT 能够在不修改模型权重的情况下捕捉监督适配的分布效果，可作为训练自由的解码时替代方案，适用于个性化等成本敏感场景。

papers.title: Apodex Discovery: Reality Benchmarks and Environments for Evaluating and Building Discoverative Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Apollo did not reach the Moon merely because its engineers could solve difficult equations. It succeeded by turning a distant ambition into a mission architecture of explicit objectives, simulation, verification, and repeated correction. AI now faces a similar transition: frontier models can solve difficult tasks once the problem, tools, and success criteria are specified, yet consequential real-world challenges rarely arrive in an executable or verifiable form. We introduce Apodex Discovery, a framework for building and evaluating discoverative AI through the heavy-duty solver, a system comprising a foundation model, harness, tools, and control policies that pursues extended, stateful, verifiable investigations. It has three core components. First, a problem-scouting process surveyed 561 industries across 16 sectors, assembled 423 high-value real-world problems, and selected 20 for the initial release. Second, a common environment-task-episode abstraction provides data, tools, constraints, feedback, trajectory recording, and verification of intermediate artifacts and final submissions. Third, HDS6 evaluates Tools, Repair, Alternatives, Coherence, Evidence, and Scope independently of final-task success. In AAV capsid design, Apodex surpassed the published state of the art by 7% across viability, tropism, structure prediction, and generative design. In drug repurposing and reformulation, a task-specific biomedical environment improved the mean normalized prediction score of GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.6-sol by 2.5 and 7.6 points over the same closed-book backbone. Controlled ablations show that the fixed TRACES episode interface enables attribution of performance differences to specific solver components. Apodex Discovery moves AI evaluation beyond predefined benchmarks toward verifiable investigations aimed at genuine discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Apodex Discovery，一个用于构建和评估“发现式 AI”（discoverative AI）的框架，核心是名为 heavy-duty solver 的系统，由基础模型、工具、控制策略等组成，能够执行长时间、有状态且可验证的调查研究。框架包含问题扫描、环境-任务-情节抽象和独立于最终任务成败的 HDS6 评估三部分。在 AAV 衣壳设计中超过已发表 SOTA 7%，在药物重定位中使 GPT-5.5 和 GPT-5.6-sol 的平均归一化预测分数分别提升 2.5 和 7.6 点。
Motivation: 前沿模型在问题、工具和成功标准被明确指定时能解决困难任务，但现实世界的重要挑战很少以可执行或可验证的形式呈现，现有评估体系难以衡量真正的发现能力。
Method: 框架通过 problem-scouting 在 16 个行业的 561 个行业中筛选出 423 个高价值问题并选取 20 个；采用统一的 environment-task-episode 抽象提供数据、工具、约束、反馈、轨迹记录和中间产物/最终提交的验证；HDS6 独立评估 Tools、Repair、Alternatives、Coherence、Evidence 和 Scope 六个维度。
Result: 在 AAV 衣壳设计中，Apodex 在可行性、趋向性、结构预测和生成设计上超过已发表 SOTA 7%；在药物重定位与改剂中，任务特定的生物医学环境使 GPT-5.5 和 GPT-5.6-sol 的平均归一化预测分数比同一 closed-book 骨干提升 2.5 和 7.6 点；固定 TRACES episode 接口的消融实验能把性能差异归因到具体 solver 组件。
Conclusion: Apodex Discovery 旨在将 AI 评估从预定义基准推进到面向真实发现的可验证调查研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Self-evolving network verifiers
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic network verifiers can reason about correctness across vast spaces of routing inputs and failures, but only for the protocols and features an expert has encoded by hand. Creating and maintaining a faithful model of the control plane is both difficult and never-ending, since no written source specifies perfectly what a network does: vendor implementations deviate from the RFCs, and behaviour shifts with releases. The burden of constant upkeep ultimately keeps verification out of many networks that need it. We argue that the model should instead evolve automatically to faithfully capture the actual network behaviour. To achieve that, we leverage the only source that specifies it unambiguously: the router software itself. In a counterexample-guided loop, a coding agent proposes extensions to the verifier's symbolic encoding, while a trusted oracle (e.g., emulated routers) supplies the ground-truth routing state. The agent iteratively refines the network model using each disagreement with the oracle. As early evidence, a prototype of this system taught a 3,000-line SMT-based verifier three features it did not support: OSPF areas, BGP route reflection, and L3VPN over EVPN, converging autonomously on models that match the oracle, even noticing vendor-specific behaviour. Automating model growth shifts the hard problem from writing verification systems to systematically testing them; we propose a research agenda for trusting and harnessing automatically evolved verifiers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文主张符号化网络验证器（symbolic network verifier）的模型应当自动演化，以忠实捕获真实网络行为，而唯一无歧义的来源是路由器软件本身。作者提出一个反例引导（counterexample-guided）的闭环：编码智能体（coding agent）提出对验证器符号编码的扩展，可信的 oracle（例如仿真路由器）提供真实路由状态，智能体利用与 oracle 的分歧迭代修正网络模型。早期原型让一个约 3000 行的基于 SMT 的验证器自主学会了 OSPF 区域、BGP 路由反射和 L3VPN over EVPN 三个原本不支持的特性，且收敛到与 oracle 一致的模型，甚至注意到厂商特有行为。
Motivation: 手工构建并维护控制平面的形式化模型既困难又永无止境，因为厂商实现偏离 RFC、行为随版本变化，没有任何书面规范能完全描述网络真实行为；持续的维护负担使许多有需要的网络无法使用验证。
Method: 利用路由器软件本身作为唯一无歧义的规范来源，在反例引导循环中让编码智能体扩展验证器的符号编码，同时由可信 oracle（如仿真路由器）提供真实路由状态，智能体根据与 oracle 的每次不一致迭代精化网络模型。
Result: 原型系统使一个约 3000 行的 SMT 验证器自主学会了 OSPF areas、BGP route reflection 和 L3VPN over EVPN 三个新特性，模型与 oracle 匹配，并能发现厂商特有行为。
Conclusion: 将模型增长自动化后，核心难题从编写验证系统转向系统化测试验证系统；作者据此提出关于信任和利用自动演化验证器的研究议程。

papers.title: Better, Faster, Stronger: Programmatic Skill Learning Best Reduces Agent Cost
papers.abstract_en: Recently, the practice of augmenting LLM agent capability with skills has gained prevalence. We explore the cost effective adaptation of agents to novel domains by means of learning skills. Existing works focus on performance gain over cost effectiveness. As a result, little is known about what skill learning strategies save cost. We argue that among all the different skill learning methods, those that view skills as programs can achieve the best cost reduction. By executing sequences of actions deterministically, a program-augmented agent can reliably and cheaply achieve goals that would otherwise require trial and error and risk degenerate behavior over long horizons. An agent can learn at inference time by incrementally discovering these programs and equipping them for future tasks. We hypothesize that past trajectories contain enough signal to guide skill learning, even without replay or validation, provided the agent can learn to analyze them. To test our claims, we propose SpeedRunner, a coding agent that analyzes trajectories and refactors skills for better performance on future tasks. Across three different embodied environments, we show that SpeedRunner consistently achieves the frontier in learning and cost reduction while remaining robust against distribution shifts and environmental randomness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何通过技能学习（skill learning）降低大语言模型（LLM）智能体在新领域中的部署成本，提出将技能视为可执行程序的思路，并据此实现名为 SpeedRunner 的编码智能体。SpeedRunner 在推理时分析历史轨迹、重构技能以提升未来任务表现，并在三个具身环境（embodied environments）中同时取得学习效果与成本降低的最优前沿。
Motivation: 现有工作主要关注技能学习带来的性能提升，而较少考察哪些技能学习策略真正节省成本；程序化技能可确定性执行动作序列，从而避免试错和长程任务中的退化风险，有望实现更可靠且更低成本的智能体适应。
Method: 假设历史轨迹含有足够信号来指导技能学习，即使没有回放或验证，只要智能体能学会分析这些轨迹；据此提出 SpeedRunner，一个分析轨迹并重构（refactor）技能以改善未来任务表现的编码智能体。
Result: 在三个不同的具身环境中，SpeedRunner 一致地达到学习收益与成本降低的最优前沿，并对分布偏移（distribution shifts）和环境随机性保持稳健。
Conclusion: 摘要强调程序化技能学习是实现最优成本削减的途径，且无需重放或验证即可从过往轨迹中学习，但并未给出跨更广泛领域的泛化结论。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Dual-Domain Cross-Modal Decoding for Clinical Text-Guided Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Clinical text can narrow down what to segment, but recent text-guided designs emphasize spatial alignment while overlooking frequency content that governs texture and boundaries. We propose Dual-Domain Cross-Modal Decoding (DD-CMD) for clinical text-guided pulmonary infection segmentation, integrating two complementary forms of language guidance during decoding. In the spatial domain, Text-Guided Spatial Cross-Attention (TGSA) aligns multi-scale visual tokens with text semantics and updates features through gated residual fusion. In the frequency domain, Spectral-Text Adaptive Modulation (STAM) applies a 2D DCT to compute learnable band-energy statistics and predicts text-conditioned FiLM parameters to recalibrate decoder channels for frequency-aware decoding. DD-CMD embeds TGSA and STAM into a coarse-to-fine decoder (7x7 to 56x56) and restores full-resolution masks using a lightweight two-stage refinement module. Experiments on QaTa-COV19 and MosMedData+ show that DD-CMD achieves 91.46% Dice / 84.26% mIoU and 81.95% Dice / 69.42% mIoU, respectively, with average gains of +1.96 Dice and +2.67 mIoU over the strongest prior baselines. Code: https://github.com/maklachur/DD-CMD.
papers.comment: Accepted at MICCAI 2026 (Main). Final version to appear in the MICCAI 2026 proceedings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Dual-Domain Cross-Modal Decoding (DD-CMD)，用于临床文本引导的肺部感染医学图像分割。方法在解码阶段同时利用空间域与频域的语言引导：空间域用 Text-Guided Spatial Cross-Attention (TGSA) 对齐多尺度视觉 token 与文本语义，频域用 Spectral-Text Adaptive Modulation (STAM) 基于 2D DCT 的频带能量统计预测文本条件 FiLM 参数。在 QaTa-COV19 和 MosMedData+ 上分别达到 91.46% Dice / 84.26% mIoU 与 81.95% Dice / 69.42% mIoU，平均超过最强基线 +1.96 Dice 和 +2.67 mIoU。
Motivation: 现有文本引导分割设计侧重空间对齐，忽略了控制纹理和边界的频率内容，导致跨模态解码不完整。该工作针对这一缺失，希望在文本引导分割中引入频域信息以提升分割质量。
Method: 提出 DD-CMD，将 TGSA 和 STAM 嵌入从 7x7 到 56x56 的 coarse-to-fine 解码器，并用轻量两阶段细化模块恢复全分辨率掩码。STAM 对 2D DCT 计算可学习的频带能量统计，并预测文本条件 FiLM 参数来重校准解码器通道。
Result: 在 QaTa-COV19 上取得 91.46% Dice / 84.26% mIoU，在 MosMedData+ 上取得 81.95% Dice / 69.42% mIoU，平均比最强先前基线提升 +1.96 Dice 和 +2.67 mIoU。
Conclusion: 摘要强调空间与频域两种互补的语言引导形式可以共同提升临床文本引导分割的性能，并指出 DD-CMD 使用轻量细化模块恢复全分辨率掩码。代码已公开。

papers.title: Gloss-Free Representation Learning for Cross-Dataset Sign Spotting
papers.abstract_en: Sign-language research for resource-constrained languages is often limited by the cost of dense linguistic labels such as glosses, temporal boundaries, and sign order. Broadcast news offers a practical alternative by pairing continuous signing with spoken-language transcripts, but this supervision is weak since text and signing are loosely aligned. Morphologically rich languages such as Turkish add further difficulty, as the same lexical meaning can appear in many inflected forms while some derived forms should remain distinct. We study whether weak transcript-based supervision can pretrain a reusable sign encoder in this setting, where poor text normalization can fragment pseudo-gloss targets and weaken representation learning. Unlike prior pseudo-gloss pipelines designed mainly to improve translation, we test whether the pretrained encoder transfers as a reusable representation for cross-dataset sign spotting. We pretrain on TSL-News, a new Turkish broadcast corpus, using pseudo-gloss labels derived from transcripts rather than manual annotation, comparing rule-based morphological lemmatization with constrained LLM-assisted normalization over a fixed vocabulary. We evaluate the learned representations via cross-dataset sign spotting on a new TSL Spotting Benchmark built from the TSL Dictionary corpus. The LLM-assisted encoder raises top-5 temporal localization mean IoU from 0.235 to 0.465, with 56.2% of examples reaching an IoU of at least 0.50; a frequency analysis suggests this gain is not mainly driven by memorizing frequent pseudo-gloss labels. In a downstream translation check, the same pretraining improves BLEU-4 from 9.60 to 11.04 and ROUGE from 23.48 to 27.43. These results show that loosely aligned broadcast data can provide effective weak supervision for learning sign representations that capture both lexical content and temporal structure.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 4th LIMIT Workshop (Representation Learning with Very Limited Resources), ECCV 2026. The abstract was shortened to comply with arXiv's 1,920-character limit
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在资源受限的手语语言中，能否用弱对齐的转录文本监督预训练可复用的手语编码器。作者在土耳其语广播语料 TSL-News 上用转录推导的伪词条标签 (pseudo-gloss) 进行预训练，并通过跨数据集手语定位 (sign spotting) 评估表征质量。结果表明，LLM 辅助的归一化方法显著提升时序定位性能，预训练编码器兼具词汇内容与时间结构信息。
Motivation: 手语研究常受限于词条 (gloss)、时间边界等密集语言标注的高成本；广播新闻可提供连续手语与口语转录的弱对齐监督，但形态丰富的语言（如土耳其语）导致文本归一化困难，可能削弱伪词条目标的表征学习。
Method: 在 TSL-News 土耳其语广播语料上，基于转录生成伪词条标签进行预训练；对比基于规则的原形词形还原 (morphological lemmatization) 与受限 LLM 辅助的固定词表归一化；随后通过跨数据集手语定位任务（TSL Spotting Benchmark）评估编码器表征。
Result: LLM 辅助编码器将 top-5 时序定位平均 IoU 从 0.235 提升至 0.465，56.2% 的样本达到至少 0.50 的 IoU；下游翻译检查中，同一预训练将 BLEU-4 从 9.60 提升至 11.04，ROUGE 从 23.48 提升至 27.43。频率分析表明该增益并非主要来自对高频伪词条标签的记忆。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，松散对齐的广播数据可以为学习同时捕获词汇内容与时间结构的手语表征提供有效的弱监督。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Qwen-MusicAVQA-7B: A Multimodal Model for Music Audio-Visual QA
papers.abstract_en: A common approach to adding audio to a vision-language model is to train or adapt a large omni-modal system. We show that a lightweight alternative can be highly effective for music audio-visual question answering (AVQA). Qwen-MusicAVQA-7B connects a frozen Whisper encoder to Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct through learned linear projections. The same frozen encoder processes both the video's music track and a TTS-spoken question through separate projectors, while the language model fuses visual frames, music, and question audio through pretrained self-attention, with no task-specific fusion network. On MUSIC-AVQA, our system reaches 96.0% +/- 3.9% accuracy across three independent training seeds on the 7,402-question available-video test subset. Our central finding is that downstream accuracy tracks how much fine-grained local temporal information the audio representation preserves. In a matched 32-token comparison, a stride-pooled Whisper frame sequence outperforms a globally pooled PANNs representation expanded to the same budget by 26 percentage points, even though PANNs sees at least as much audio and uses a far larger projector. The effect is not simply sequence versus vector: within Whisper alone, reducing temporal resolution at a fixed token budget costs a comparable amount. Under matched data and inputs, fine-tuned Qwen2.5-Omni-7B reaches 80.9%, against 95.9% for our 30 s variant; because the systems differ in backbone and adaptation, this is a system-level comparison. Accuracy remains high on sampled head and tail splits of the rephrased MUSIC-AVQA-R benchmark (96.5% and 95.6%). Because both encoders stay frozen and the music features are cached, the entire adaptation is cheap to train: the complete two-stage AVQA run takes approximately 5 hours on a single A100 80GB, and every run reported here fits on that one GPU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出轻量级多模态音乐音视频问答模型 Qwen-MusicAVQA-7B，将冻结的 Whisper 音频编码器通过线性投影接入 Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct，由语言模型的预训练自注意力融合视觉帧、音乐与 TTS 问题音频，不设任务专用融合网络。在 MUSIC-AVQA 的 7,402 题可用视频测试子集上，三个训练种子的平均准确率为 96.0%±3.9%；核心发现是下游准确率取决于音频表示保留的细粒度局部时间信息。整个两阶段训练约 5 小时即可在单张 A100 80GB 上完成。
Motivation: 常见的给视觉-语言模型添加音频能力的方式是训练或适配大型全模态系统，成本高昂；作者希望验证轻量替代方案在音乐音视频问答 (AVQA) 中是否同样有效，并厘清音频表示的何种特性决定下游表现。
Method: 冻结 Whisper 编码器同时处理视频的音乐轨和 TTS 口头问题，通过两个独立的线性投影器映射到语言模型空间；冻结的视觉编码器与语言模型保持预训练权重，音乐特征被缓存，整个适配仅学习投影与必要的轻量参数。
Result: 在 MUSIC-AVQA 的 7,402 题可用视频测试子集上，三颗训练种子平均准确率为 96.0%±3.9%；在匹配的 32-token 预算下，stride-pooled Whisper 帧序列比全局池化的 PANNs 表示高出 26 个百分点；仅用 Whisper 时，固定 token 预算下降低时间分辨率也会造成相当损失。在重述的 MUSIC-AVQA-R 基准的头尾子集上准确率为 96.5% 与 95.6%；系统级比较中，微调的 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 为 80.9%，本模型 30 秒变体为 95.9%。

papers.title: Long-Horizon Forecasting of Complete Financial Statements with Forma
papers.abstract_en: Specialist training beats generalist scale when forecasting financial statements. To our knowledge, no prior work jointly forecasts complete financial statements beyond one year, yet in a discounted-cash-flow valuation most firm value sits past that window. We release ProForma-20Q, a reproducible benchmark for forecasting 78 statement line items 1-20 quarters ahead, for anonymized firms, from past statements and an industry code, scored by change-space $R^2$. On it, Forma, a transformer that reads statements as sets of (account, quarter, value) tuples and maximizes a masked-tuple Gaussian likelihood, beats every competitor we field: classical machine learning, chained gradient boosting, a zero-shot time-series foundation model, and frontier large language models. Its lead widens with horizon, where valuation needs accuracy most, and its Gaussian predictive intervals never under-cover. Forma's forecasts nearly satisfy accounting identities; exact coherence is recoverable at no statistically significant accuracy cost. Its tuple interface supports scenario analysis without retraining, and we show that pinning future revenue paths sharpens the rest of the statement.
papers.comment: 46 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Benchmark: https://github.com/forma-lab-mccombs/proforma-20q. Model and weights: https://github.com/forma-lab-mccombs/forma-release
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Forma，一种用于完整财务报表长期预测的 Transformer 模型，并发布 ProForma-20Q 基准，覆盖 78 个报表行项目、1-20 个季度前的预测，以变化空间 R² 评分。摘要报告 Forma 在多个竞争对手（经典机器学习、链式梯度提升、零样本时序基础模型、前沿大语言模型）上均胜出，且优势随预测期限拉大；其高斯预测区间从不欠覆盖，预测结果几乎满足会计恒等式，并支持无需重训的情景分析。
Motivation: 现有工作未能在一年以上期限联合预测完整财务报表，而贴现现金流估值中大部分企业价值恰恰落在该窗口之外，因此长期完整报表预测存在明显空白。
Method: Forma 将财务报表视为 (account, quarter, value) 元组集合，通过最大化掩码元组高斯似然 (masked-tuple Gaussian likelihood) 进行训练；同时发布 ProForma-20Q 可复现基准，以变化空间 R² 评分衡量 78 个报表行项目未来 1-20 季的预测质量。
Result: 摘要显示 Forma 击败经典机器学习、链式梯度提升、零样本时序基础模型和前沿大语言模型，且领先幅度随预测期限扩大；高斯预测区间从不欠覆盖；预测近乎满足会计恒等式，且可在无统计显著精度损失下恢复精确一致性；固定未来营收路径能提升其余报表项目的预测精度。
Conclusion: 作者强调针对财务报表预测的专业化训练胜过通用大模型的规模优势；元组接口使情景分析无需重新训练即可进行。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Contextual Quality-Diversity Evolutionary Reinforcement Learning for HVAC Control in Tropical Commercial Buildings
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a contextual quality-diversity evolutionary reinforcement-learning controller, CQD-ERL, for the supervisory control of a tropical, water-cooled chiller plant and its associated air side. Rather than converging to a single scalarised policy, the controller maintains a product archive of specialised policies indexed jointly by a data- driven operating context, a cluster of daily weather and load regime, and a context-invariant behaviour descriptor, filled by a gradient-free evolutionary operator and a soft-actor-critic policy-gradient operator that share one replay buffer. Every action is filtered through a deterministic safety shield before execution. The controller is trained on a two-tier reduced-order environment representing the latent load, cooling-tower approach and humidity constraints of a Singapore commercial building, and is evaluated over a full annual backtest against an ASHRAE Guideline 36 baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种上下文质量多样性的进化强化学习控制器 CQD-ERL，用于热带商业建筑中水冷制冷机厂及其风侧的监督控制。它不收敛到单一标量化策略，而是维护一个由数据驱动的运行上下文（每日天气与负荷模式的聚类）和上下文不变行为描述符联合索引的策略档案，由无梯度进化算子和 soft-actor-critic 策略梯度算子共同填充，并共享同一回放缓冲区，每个动作在执行前都经过确定性安全盾过滤。控制器在一个表示新加坡商业建筑潜热负荷、冷却塔逼近度和湿度约束的两层降阶环境中训练，并以 ASHRAE Guideline 36 为基线进行全年回测评估。
Motivation: 暖通空调系统监督控制通常收敛到单一标量化策略，难以应对热带商业建筑中由天气和负荷变化带来的多种运行状态，需要一种能同时保持行为多样性和上下文自适应的控制策略。
Method: 提出 CQD-ERL，将质量多样性进化搜索与 soft-actor-critic 策略梯度结合，在共享回放缓冲区上维护由运行上下文上下文（context）与行为描述符索引的策略档案，并通过确定性安全盾在动作执行前进行过滤，以保证安全性。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在代表新加坡商业建筑的两层降阶环境上训练，并在完整年度回测中以 ASHRAE Guideline 36 为基线进行对比评估，但未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 作者主张将上下文条件与质量多样性进化方法结合，能够为暖通空调系统监督控制提供比单一标量化策略更具适应当地天气与负荷条件的控制方案；摘要中未明确说明局限。
Relevance: 7

papers.title: Deployment Decision Reliability: A Generalizability-Theory Framework for Sizing Long-Horizon Agent Evaluations
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise practitioners read agent leaderboards as if they ranked agent capability. We show, across three open agent-trace benchmarks (TheAgentCompany, $τ^2$-bench, and AppWorld), that the agent main effect accounts for less than 3% of total variance in every dataset and check type, while the agent-by-task interaction accounts for 7-23%. Leaderboards rank specialization, not capability. We arrive at this through a four-facet Generalizability Theory variance decomposition, fit with three estimators (Henderson Method-I, REML via lme4, and a Bayesian binomial GLMM) that agree to three decimal places. Four further findings sharpen what the leaderboard is hiding. First, aggregate reliability collapses on the hardest task quartile: $Eρ^2$ on $τ^2$ action_checks falls from 0.752 to 0.000. Second, training-cell reliability negatively correlates with held-out reliability ($r = -0.90$ on $τ^2$), meaning the designs that look most reliable replicate worst. Third, population-level diagnostics transfer across enterprise benchmarks (capability-gap ratio stable at 0.35-0.40) but per-family agent rankings invert. Fourth, on the MAST failure taxonomy, trace-level mode profiles are idiosyncratic (MAE = 0.261) while cell-level profiles generalise (MAE = 0.056, $r = 0.83$). We package these into Deployment Decision Reliability (DDR), a one-page reporting discipline that turns the variance-component table into five decisions an enterprise buyer can defend. All code, data loaders, and fit artifacts are released under an open-source license.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Code and reproducibility artifacts: https://github.com/vasundras/agent-reliability-engineering-lab
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对企业实践者把智能体排行榜当作能力排名的误读，提出基于四侧面概化理论 (Generalizability Theory) 的方差分解框架，对 TheAgentCompany、τ²-bench 和 AppWorld 三个开放智能体轨迹基准进行分析。结果表明智能体主效应仅占不到 3% 的总方差，而智能体-任务交互占 7-23%，因此排行榜衡量的是特化程度而非能力。作者进一步封装出 Deployment Decision Reliability (DDR) 一页式报告规范，将方差组分表转化为企业买家可辩护的五项决策，并开源全部代码与复现产物。
Motivation: 企业实践者长期将智能体排行榜解读为能力排序，但该解读缺乏统计依据；长时程智能体评估的规模设计与可靠性度量需要更严谨的方差来源分解，以支撑部署决策。
Method: 采用四侧面概化理论方差分解，分别用 Henderson Method-I、lme4 的 REML 和贝叶斯二项 GLMM 三种估计器拟合，三种估计结果在小数点后三位一致；另基于 MAST 失败分类体系分析轨迹级与单元级失效模式，并将结果封装为 DDR 报告规范。
Result: 智能体主效应在每个数据集和检查类型上的方差占比均低于 3%，智能体-任务交互占 7-23%；τ² action_checks 上最困难任务四分位的 Eρ² 从 0.752 跌至 0.000；τ² 上训练单元可靠性与留出可靠性负相关 (r=-0.90)；能力差距比在跨基准间稳定于 0.35-0.40，但按家族划分的智能体排名发生反转；单元级 MAST 失效画像可泛化 (MAE=0.056, r=0.83)，而轨迹级画像高度特异 (MAE=0.261)。
Conclusion: 作者主张排行榜排名的是特化而非能力，并提出 DDR 作为将方差组分转化为可辩护部署决策的报告规范；所有代码、数据加载器和拟合工件均已开源。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Socioduality: A Relational Process Framework for Human-AI Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Human-AI research often evaluates individual capabilities, combined performance, or final outputs, but these approaches do not preserve how one party's response becomes part of the conditions under which the other party's next contribution is formed. This article introduces socioduality, a sequential, reciprocal, and history-carrying relational process between two distinguishable parties in which a response from one party becomes part of the observable conditions under which the other party's subsequent contribution, judgement, decision, or action is formed. Specified for human-AI dyads, the construct uses nested units: moves, confirmed sociodual episodes, linked pathways, and the broader interaction container. A minimum episode A1-B1-A2 requires evidence of response contingency and return contingency; candidate episodes are classified as confirmed, non-sociodual, or indeterminate before secondary coding of response orientation and substantive contribution re-formation. Three propositions address history-conditioned formation, pathway divergence, and robustness differences among endpoint-equivalent pathways. A frozen operational protocol was calibrated on three previously unseen natural human-AI records through two separately executed model-based evaluator series. Move and candidate reconstruction converged exactly in two cases and differed by one local multimodal unitisation decision in the third; remaining disagreement was concentrated at return-contingency boundaries. Socioduality therefore provides a bounded and empirically tractable process construct for analysing how human and AI contributions are formed through interaction while preserving pathway information that endpoint-centred analysis cannot recover.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 socioduality 这一概念，用于刻画人与 AI 之间顺序、互惠且携带历史的关系过程：一方响应成为另一方后续贡献形成的可观察条件之一。作者将该构造具体化为人类-AI 二元组，定义了 move、确认的 sociodual episode、联通路径 (linked pathways) 与交互容器等嵌套单元，并给出最小 episode A1-B1-A2 的判定条件。文章在三个未见过的自然人机记录上校准了冻结操作协议，通过两个模型评估器系列验证了可操作性。
Motivation: 现有研究多评估个体能力、组合性能或最终输出，未能保留互动中一方响应如何成为另一方下一步决策形成条件这一过程性信息。
Method: 提出 socioduality 框架，以嵌套单元刻画人机互动；要求最小 episode 满足响应条件性与返回条件性，并将候选 episode 分类为确认、非 sociodual 或不确定，随后进行响应取向与实质性贡献再形成的二级编码。
Result: 在三个未见过的自然记录上，两个案例的 move 与候选重建完全收敛，第三个案例仅在一个局部多模态单元化决策上不同；剩余分歧集中在返回条件性边界。
Conclusion: socioduality 提供了一个有界且经验可处理的过程构造，用于分析人机贡献如何通过互动形成，能保留端点中心分析无法恢复的路径信息。

papers.title: Spectral graph clustering with inhomogeneous latent geometry
papers.abstract_en: We study spectral clustering in the presence of a confounding latent geometry. The leading eigenvectors may then be dominated by the latent geometry rather than by the communities. Nevertheless, we show in a block latent-space model that communities can be recovered from eigenvectors deeper in the spectrum. We analyze the spectral properties of the adjacency matrix through a limiting integral operator and use its structure to develop DBSPEC, a density-based spectral clustering algorithm that requires only approximate localization of the informative eigenvalue and is robust to poor eigenvalue separation. Crucially, this approach handles general latent geometries, overcoming restrictions to homogeneous toroidal models in prior works. Our theoretical predictions for the location of the informative eigenvalue notably align with observations in real-world experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究谱聚类在存在混淆潜在几何（latent geometry）时的性能，指出前导特征向量可能被潜在几何主导而非社区结构，但在块潜在空间模型（block latent-space model）中，社区仍可从谱中更深层次的特征向量恢复。作者通过极限积分算子分析邻接矩阵的谱性质，提出基于密度的谱聚类算法 DBSPEC，该算法仅需近似定位信息特征值，并对较差的特征值分离具有鲁棒性。理论预测的信息特征值位置与真实世界实验观察一致。
Motivation: 谱聚类通常依赖前导特征向量识别社区，但当数据存在混淆的潜在几何时，这些特征向量被几何结构主导，社区信号移到谱的更深处；同时先前工作局限于齐次环面（homogeneous toroidal）等特殊几何模型，缺乏对一般潜在几何的通用方法。
Method: 建立块潜在空间模型，并利用极限积分算子刻画邻接矩阵的谱结构；基于该谱结构开发 DBSPEC，一种基于密度的谱聚类算法，只需近似定位信息特征值即可工作，且不依赖特征值之间的良好分离。
Result: 摘要报告该方法能处理一般潜在几何，摆脱了先前工作的齐次环面模型限制；理论预测的信息特征值位置与真实世界实验观察一致。
Conclusion: 作者表明，即使前导特征向量被潜在几何污染，仍可通过更深层次的特征向量恢复社区，且 DBSPEC 只需近似特征值定位即可实现鲁棒聚类。

papers.title: Terminal Symmetry as a Decision Resource: Statewise Refinement for Anytime Verified Construction
papers.abstract_en: Many sequential construction tasks exhibit exact symmetry at completion while their execution remains directed and history-dependent. We develop a decision-resource view of terminal symmetry: process evidence supplies directionality, terminal correspondence transports that structure across equivalent outcomes, realized-state evidence refines its current decision relevance after transitions, and a fixed verifier certifies execution. This decomposition yields transport--refine--certify. \method{} instantiates the principle with an episode-fixed transported process structure, its state-restricted process rank, a state-dependent residual rank refreshed after accepted transitions, and an ordinal rank meet whose top-$k$ set is exactly the union of the two proposal prefixes. The meet provides a completion guarantee under prefix coverage and attains the tight worst-case verifier-query bound under the corresponding prefix information model; a two-state construction predicts a strict post-transition dynamic--static separation. Across CAD assembly, Mini-Programs, and exact-fill packing, statewise refresh improves anytime AUC by up to $6.77$, $21.75$, and $8.68$ points, respectively. On 1,135 target-removal episodes from the official GRN OOD scenes, \method{} attains the lowest mean capped verifier cost at all three scales among the compared GRN and CDGS-style planners. The statewise signal also transfers across aggregation and scheduler organizations. Terminal symmetry thereby becomes a reusable decision resource for directed construction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个决策资源视角，将顺序构造任务在完成时的精确对称性（terminal symmetry）转化为可复用的决策资源，并实例化为 transport-refine-certify 流程。作者用 episode 固定的迁移过程结构、状态受限过程秩、接受迁移后刷新的状态依赖残差秩以及序数秩 meet 来构造方法，使得 top-k 集合恰为两个 proposal 前缀的并集。实验在 CAD 装配、Mini-Programs 和 exact-fill 装箱上分别提升 anytime AUC 最多 6.77、21.75 和 8.68 个点，并在 GRN OOD 场景上取得更低的验证器成本。
Motivation: 许多顺序构造任务在完成时具有精确对称性，但执行过程是有方向且依赖历史的；现有方法没有把这种完成时的对称性作为可供决策利用的结构化资源。
Method: 将过程证据提供方向性、终端对应关系跨等价结果迁移结构、已实现状态的证据在迁移后被刷新以修正当前决策相关性、以及固定验证器认证执行四者分解，得到 transport-refine-certify 原则。具体实现采用 episode 固定的迁移过程结构、状态受限过程秩、接受迁移后刷新的状态依赖残差秩，以及 top-k 集合等于两个 proposal 前缀并集的序数秩 meet。
Result: statewise 刷新在 CAD assembly、Mini-Programs、exact-fill packing 上分别提升 anytime AUC 最多 6.77、21.75、8.68 个点；在官方 GRN OOD 场景的 1,135 个 target-removal episodes 上，该方法在所有三种规模下取得比较的 GRN 与 CDGS 风格规划器中的最低平均 capped verifier cost。
Conclusion: 终端对称性可以成为有向构造任务中可复用的决策资源，statewise 信号还能跨聚合与调度器组织迁移。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Clinical Feasibility of Low-Magnification Fluorescence Imaging for Breast Cancer Margin Detection Using Texture Analysis and Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: High-resolution images of unprocessed surgical breast tissue can be obtained using microscopy with ultraviolet surface excitation (MUSE). This technique is considered a promising method for checking surgical margins during breast cancer surgery. In this study, MUSE images at 4x and 10x magnifications were compared using patch-level classification methods. Texture analysis (TA) based on local binary patterns (LBP) and deep learning (DL) with a base Vision Transformer (ViT) model were used. Both methods achieved similar performance at both magnifications. Using DL method, both 4x and 10x magnifications achieved 96.30% sensitivity, 100% specificity and 98.18% accuracy. Using TA method, 4x achieved better specificity (100% vs 93.33%) and 10x yielded higher sensitivity (100% vs 93.33%), but both had the same accuracy (96.67%). No clear improvement in performance was observed with 10x magnification. These results show that 4x imaging achieves the same diagnostic accuracy as 10x imaging. At the same time, 4x offers a larger field of view and faster image capture. Therefore, lower magnification can be effectively used in MUSE systems for accurate and efficient intraoperative margin assessment.
papers.comment: This research has been accepted and published in Journal "Biomedical Optics Express" in July 2026 with Manuscript ID is 596807

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估低倍率荧光成像用于乳腺癌手术切缘检测的临床可行性。作者比较了 MUSE 显微镜在 4x 和 10x 倍率下采集的未经处理手术组织图像的切缘分类性能，分别使用基于局部二值模式 (LBP) 的纹理分析 (TA) 和基于 Vision Transformer (ViT) 的深度学习 (DL) 方法。结果显示两种倍率下两种方法表现相近，DL 在 4x 和 10x 均达到 96.30% 灵敏度、100% 特异性和 98.18% 准确率，而 4x 与 10x 的诊断准确率无显著差异，因此 4x 因更大视野和更快采集速度而更适合术中切缘评估。
Motivation: 乳腺癌手术中需要快速准确的术中切缘评估，MUSE 成像被认为有潜力，但高倍率成像视野小、采集慢，可能不适合术中实时使用；需要验证低倍率成像是否能达到与高倍率相同的诊断准确率。
Method: 使用显微镜紫外表面激发 (MUSE) 获取未处理手术组织的 4x 和 10x 显微图像，在 patch 级别进行分类比较。分类方法包括基于局部二值模式 (LBP) 的纹理分析 (TA) 和基于 Vision Transformer (ViT) 的深度学习 (DL)。
Result: DL 方法在 4x 和 10x 下均达到 96.30% 灵敏度、100% 特异性和 98.18% 准确率；TA 方法在 4x 下特异性更高（100% vs 93.33%），在 10x 下灵敏度更高（100% vs 93.33%），但两者准确率相同（96.67%）。摘要未发现 10x 倍率带来明显性能提升。
Conclusion: 4x 成像与 10x 成像具有相同的诊断准确率，同时提供更大的视野和更快的图像采集，因此低倍率可以有效地用于 MUSE 系统，以实现准确高效的术中切缘评估。

papers.title: Backdoor Decontamination Dynamics in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Open-weight LLM agents are vulnerable to backdoors installed during fine-tuning, which may be undetectable if the trigger conditions are never met during testing. Assuming defenders do not know the existing trigger, they cannot unlearn it directly. One decontamination strategy is to install a known backdoor (defensive poisoning) then to unlearn it, hoping that the original unknown backdoor is removed as a side effect. However, this procedure has uncertain outcomes: the original backdoor may persist or be erased or rerouted, among other possibilities. We introduce a framework for studying these dynamics in tool-calling agents, decoupling trigger, response, teacher, and fine-tuning method across systematic experiments on AgentDyn. Across 115 experiments, defensive poisoning alone erases around 56% of original backdoors; subsequent decontamination then drives almost all survivors to erasure, confirming that trigger recognition and malicious execution are behaviorally dissociable. Interestingly, our experiments find that malicious backdoors never persist when using different triggers of the same general type as the defensive backdoor when followed by decontamination via unlearning. Co-installing up to four backdoors increases resistance (around 36% erased), yet decontaminating a single known co-resident backdoor collaterally clears 52/60 co-residents (87%). Upon visualizing postdecontamination model internals using J-lens, we confirm that although the decontamination restores benign LLM responses, traces of original trigger awareness persist at intermediate layers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究开放权重 LLM 智能体 (tool-calling agents) 中后门 (backdoor) 的净化 (decontamination) 动力学：防御者不知道原始触发条件，因此尝试先植入一个已知后门（防御性投毒, defensive poisoning），再通过 unlearning 将其消除，希望未知后门被连带清除。作者在 AgentDyn 上解耦触发器、响应、教师模型与微调方法，开展 115 组实验，发现防御性投毒单独可消除约 56% 的原始后门，后续 decontamination 几乎将幸存者全部清除；同一通用触发类型下的恶意后门在 unlearning 后从未持续存在。J-lens 可视化显示净化虽恢复良性回答，但中间层仍保留原始触发器感知痕迹。
Motivation: 开放权重 LLM 智能体在微调阶段可能被植入后门，若测试阶段触发条件从未出现则难以被检测；由于防御者不知道现有触发器，无法直接 unlearn 它。防御性投毒后 unlearning 的效果不确定，原始后门可能持续存在、被清除或被重路由，因此需要系统研究这些动力学。
Method: 提出一个研究框架，在 tool-calling agent 中系统解耦触发器 (trigger)、响应 (response)、教师 (teacher) 和微调方法，并在 AgentDyn 上开展 115 组受控实验；流程为防御性投毒安装已知后门，再通过 unlearning 净化，并用 J-lens 检查模型内部表示。
Result: 摘要报告：防御性投毒单独消除约 56% 的原始后门，随后的 decontamination 将几乎全部幸存者清除；使用与防御后门同类别但不同的触发器时，恶意后门在 unlearning 后从不持续。同时植入最多四个后门会提高抗清除能力（约 36% 被消除），但净化单个已知共驻后门可连带清除 60 个中的 52 个（87%）。J-lens 显示净化后中间层仍残留原始触发器的感知痕迹。
Conclusion: 摘要认为触发识别与恶意执行在行为上可分离 (behaviorally dissociable)，防御性投注加 unlearning 能有效清除大多数后门，且同类型触发器的共驻后门最易被连带净化；但即使良性响应恢复，中间层仍存在触发器感知痕迹，提示净化并非完全擦除内部记忆。

summary_sections.motivation: 开放权重 LLM 智能体在微调阶段可能被植入后门，若测试阶段触发条件从未出现则难以被检测；由于防御者不知道现有触发器，无法直接 unlearn 它。防御性投毒后 unlearning 的效果不确定，原始后门可能持续存在、被清除或被重路由，因此需要系统研究这些动力学。
summary_sections.method: 提出一个研究框架，在 tool-calling agent 中系统解耦触发器 (trigger)、响应 (response)、教师 (teacher) 和微调方法，并在 AgentDyn 上开展 115 组受控实验；流程为防御性投毒安装已知后门，再通过 unlearning 净化，并用 J-lens 检查模型内部表示。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告：防御性投毒单独消除约 56% 的原始后门，随后的 decontamination 将几乎全部幸存者清除；使用与防御后门同类别但不同的触发器时，恶意后门在 unlearning 后从不持续。同时植入最多四个后门会提高抗清除能力（约 36% 被消除），但净化单个已知共驻后门可连带清除 60 个中的 52 个（87%）。J-lens 显示净化后中间层仍残留原始触发器的感知痕迹。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要认为触发识别与恶意执行在行为上可分离 (behaviorally dissociable)，防御性投注加 unlearning 能有效清除大多数后门，且同类型触发器的共驻后门最易被连带净化；但即使良性响应恢复，中间层仍存在触发器感知痕迹，提示净化并非完全擦除内部记忆。

papers.title: Self-Evolving Code-with-Image Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal models increasingly reach for tools when solving visual tasks (crop, zoom, rotate, brighten), a paradigm known as thinking-with-images. The central challenge is one of perception: tools mostly serve to expose visual evidence, reasoning over that evidence stays in language, and most targets are ones a human could in principle determine by inspection. Some visual questions, however, are not bottlenecked by perception: recovering their answers requires executing a multi-step visual algorithm over the pixels. On such questions a model often names the correct algorithm at once yet still answers wrong, because language can describe an algorithm without being able to run one. Code-with-Image crosses that line: given nothing but a Python interpreter, the model must implement a genuine visual algorithm in code to solve the task; the program itself becomes the reasoning. The bottleneck then shifts from executing code to deciding which algorithm to implement. So we let the model teach itself: a training-free reflection loop studies its own failed programs, tests repairs against constructive ground truth, and keeps what survives as portable skills. On our Code-with-Image Bench (CwI-Bench), thirty task families induced by hidden visual computations with disjoint learning and evaluation splits, even GPT-5.6-luna stays below 30% with tool-free chain of thought; given a bare interpreter it reaches 43%, and with skills evolved through its own executable reflection, 67%. The open 27B model climbs the same ladder (9% $\rightarrow$ 33% $\rightarrow$ 56%), and the skills are plain text, transferable across scales and families. When code carries the reasoning, debugging code becomes debugging reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Code-with-Image 范式，让多模态模型仅凭 Python 解释器，把视觉任务中的多步视觉算法用代码实现，使程序本身成为推理载体。作者构建 CwI-Bench 基准（三十个由隐藏视觉计算诱导的任务族，学习与评测划分不重叠），并设计免训练的自演化反思循环：模型研究自身失败程序、用构造性 ground truth 测试修复、将幸存的技能作为可迁移文本保留。摘要报告 GPT-5.6-luna 在无工具思维链下低于 30%，使用解释器达 43%，经自演化技能后达 67%；开源 27B 模型从 9% 提升到 56%。
Motivation: 许多视觉问题并不受感知瓶颈限制，而是需要执行多步视觉算法；语言可以描述算法却无法运行算法，导致模型能指出正确算法却答错答案。作者希望跨越这道界线，把瓶颈从执行代码转移到决定实现哪种算法，并让模型通过自反思自行积累解题技能。
Method: 提出训练自由的反思循环（reflection loop）：模型分析自己失败的编程尝试，依据构造性 ground truth 检验修复后的程序，并将通过检验的程序以纯文本形式保存为可迁移技能。评测设置是仅提供裸 Python 解释器，模型必须用代码实现真正的视觉算法。
Result: 在 CwI-Bench 上，GPT-5.6-luna 在无工具思维链下低于 30%，获得解释器后达到 43%，加入自演化技能后达到 67%；开源 27B 模型按同一路径从 9% 提升到 33% 再到 56%，且技能为纯文本、可跨模型规模和任务族迁移。
Conclusion: 摘要强调当代码承担推理时，调试代码就等同于调试推理；作者认为这种方式让模型在无需额外训练的情况下，通过执行性反思持续积累可移植的视觉算法技能。

papers.title: Dueling Deep Q-Learning for Intrusion Detection
papers.abstract_en: Intrusion detection systems (IDS) and automated systems for detecting and reporting cyber threats, are commonly handled via supervised machine learning methods. Though effective, these models struggle to effectively adapt to new attack types. This study proposes a novel approach by employing a reward-based, dueling Q-learning model for IDS, achieving an average accuracy of 99.68% across multiple attack classes. The proposed model has a dueling network architecture which separates its predictions into value and advantage streams. This has the benefit of improving learning efficiency and stability. The model was trained on the CIC-IDS2018, a benchmark dataset based on real-world intrusion detection scenarios, having multiple attack classes such as DDoS, botnets, and brute-force attacks. Furthermore, Explainable AI (XAI), specifically SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations), was also integrated into the training and evaluation process to provide interpretability into the model's predictions.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 5 figures. Published in Proc. IEEE SoutheastCon 2025, pp. 1192-1197
papers.journal_ref: L. Luna, M. P. Berkowitz, L. Niure Kandel, and S. Jansen-Sánchez, "Dueling Deep Q-Learning for Intrusion Detection," in Proc. IEEE SoutheastCon 2025, pp. 1192-1197, 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将基于奖励的 dueling Q-learning 应用于入侵检测系统 (IDS)，以缓解监督学习方法难以适应新型攻击的问题。模型在 CIC-IDS2018 基准数据集上对多个攻击类别取得 99.68% 的平均准确率，并引入 SHAP 提供预测可解释性。
Motivation: 现有 IDS 多依赖监督式机器学习，虽然有效，但在面对新型攻击类型时适应性不足。
Method: 提出 reward-based dueling Q-learning 模型，采用 dueling 网络结构将预测拆分为 value stream 和 advantage stream，以提升学习效率与稳定性；在 CIC-IDS2018 上训练，并集成可解释人工智能 (XAI) 中的 SHAP 用于训练和评估阶段的解释。
Result: 摘要报告模型在 DDoS、botnet、暴力破解等多个攻击类别上达到 99.68% 的平均准确率。
Conclusion: 作者认为 dueling 网络的价值/优势分流设计有利于提升学习效率与稳定性，且借助 SHAP 增强了模型预测的可解释性；摘要未提及明显局限。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Compositional Localization and Placement Assessment of Catheters and Tubes in Chest X-Rays
papers.abstract_en: Assessing catheter and tube placement on chest X-rays is safety-critical yet tedious and error-prone. Current deep learning methods either classify placement globally -- losing track of which device is where -- or segment all devices into a single mask, making per-device assessment impossible when catheters overlap. We introduce UCompCXR, a compositional framework that detects local catheter fragments, associates them into device instances via graph-based clustering, fuses per-fragment tip predictions through precision-weighted Gaussian estimation, and classifies placement per device. On the RANZCR CLiP dataset (30,083 images, 5-fold patient-level CV with bootstrap CIs), UCompCXR detects 26% more devices than a strong multi-task baseline sharing the same MobileNetV3 backbone, with 75% fewer false positives and well-calibrated tip uncertainty (95% coverage = 0.948). The aggregate tip error rises -- but only because the model finds devices the baseline misses entirely, especially nasogastric tubes. On matched devices, catastrophic localization failures drop substantially. At 2.27M parameters in a single forward pass, the model is deployable on resource-constrained clinical hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UCompCXR，一个用于胸部 X 光片中导管与插管放置评估的组合式框架：先检测局部导管片段，再经由基于图的聚类聚合成设备实例，通过精度加权高斯估计融合各片段的尖端预测，最后逐设备分类放置状态。在 RANZCR CLiP 数据集（30,083 张图像，5 折患者级交叉验证）上，该方法比使用相同 MobileNetV3 骨干的强多任务基线多检测出 26% 的设备，假阳性减少 75%，尖端不确定性校准良好（95% coverage = 0.948），且单次前向传播仅需 2.27M 参数。
Motivation: 导管和插管放置评估在临床上安全关键但繁琐且易错；现有深度学习方法要么做全局分类而丢失具体设备的位置信息，要么将所有设备分割为单一掩码，导致导管重叠时无法逐设备评估。
Method: 提出 UCompCXR 组合式框架，包含局部导管片段检测、基于图的聚类将片段关联为设备实例、通过精度加权高斯估计融合每个片段的尖端预测，以及逐设备的放置分类。
Result: 在 RANZCR CLiP 数据集上，UCompCXR 比同骨干的多任务基线多检测 26% 的设备，假阳性减少 75%，尖端不确定性的 95% 覆盖率达 0.948；总体尖端误差上升，但原因在于模型找到了基线完全遗漏的设备（尤其是鼻胃管），而在匹配设备上的灾难性定位失败大幅减少。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该模型在单次前向传播中仅 2.27M 参数，可部署在资源受限的临床硬件上；组合式逐设备推理比全局分类或单一掩码分割更有利于重叠场景下的导管评估。

papers.title: CLEAR: Class-wise Expert Aggregation with Structured Sampling for Long-Tailed Classification
papers.abstract_en: Long-tailed classification poses a reliability challenge because models trained on imbalanced data are unevenly reliable across frequent and underrepresented classes. While existing methods address imbalance through re-balancing, adjustment, representation learning, or multi-expert modeling, they rarely estimate which expert should be trusted for each class. This paper proposes CLEAR (Class-wise reLiability-aware Expert Aggregation for long-tailed Recognition), a modular ensemble framework for long-tailed classification. CLEAR generates diverse experts through threshold-based structured sampling while preserving the full label space, then estimates a class-wise trust score for each expert using a smoothed class-wise precision formulation. During inference, expert predictions are combined through class-wise generalized product-of-experts aggregation, allowing different experts to be emphasized for different classes. Experiments on CIFAR-100-LT, ImageNet-LT, and Places-LT across multiple backbones show that CLEAR achieves competitive overall accuracy and particularly strong few-shot performance. These results support class-wise expert reliability as a useful design principle for long-tailed ensemble learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CLEAR，一个面向长尾分类的模块化集成框架，通过阈值结构化采样生成多样性专家并保留完整标签空间，用平滑的类级精度估计每个专家的类级信任分数，推理时采用类级广义 product-of-experts 聚合。在 CIFAR-100-LT、ImageNet-LT 和 Places-LT 上配合多种 backbone 的实验显示，该方法取得有竞争力的总体准确率，并特别在少样本类别上表现强。
Motivation: 长尾分类中模型在频繁类和稀缺类上的可靠性不均衡，而现有重平衡、调整、表示学习或多专家建模方法很少显式估计每个类别应该信任哪个专家。
Method: 提出 CLEAR 框架，通过基于阈值的结构化采样生成多样专家且保持完整标签空间，使用平滑的类级精度公式估计每个专家的类级信任分数，推理时以类级广义 product-of-experts 聚合各专家预测，使不同类别可侧重不同专家。
Result: 在 CIFAR-100-LT、ImageNet-LT 和 Places-LT 上使用多个骨干网络的实验中，CLEAR 取得有竞争力的总体准确率，并实现特别强的 few-shot 性能。
Conclusion: 摘要认为类级专家可靠性可以作为长尾集成学习的一个有用设计原则，实验结果支持该观点。

papers.title: Benchmarking Cyberattack Detection in Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure with Benign User Updates
papers.abstract_en: Cyberattack detection in electric vehicle charging infrastructure is complicated by legitimate post-activation revisions to requested energy and departure time. Charging manipulation attacks can exploit the same interface and variables; therefore, detecting a request change alone does not establish malicious intent. This paper develops a leakage-controlled session-level benchmark that preserves the ordered inputs of real Adaptive Charging Network (ACN) sessions and models legitimate revisions as normal behavior. A fixed pool keeps each generated attack in its source session's split and contains six physically motivated attacks and their coordinated variants. We compare 22 profile-only, transition-aware, and context-stratified model families under common source-grouped folds, attack data, and operating constraints. The proposed Dual-Branch Masked-Autoencoder (Masked-AE) Transition Boost model evaluates whether the current request is normal and whether its producing transition resembles an observed benign update. Its state branch combines masked reconstruction with a radial-basis-function one-class support boundary, while its transition branch combines masked reconstruction with shrinkage covariance distance. Source-grouped five-fold cross-validation selects complete configurations under explicit overall-normal and benign-update acceptance constraints; disjoint normal data then calibrate the final threshold before one test evaluation. The developed dual-branch model provides the strongest robust validation performance while detecting malicious request manipulations without learning to reject legitimate user choices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对电动汽车充电基础设施中的网络攻击检测问题，指出合法的激活后能量与出发时间修订会与充电操纵攻击共用同一接口和变量，因此仅检测请求变化不足以判定恶意意图。作者构建了一个防泄漏的会话级基准，保留真实 Adaptive Charging Network (ACN) 会话的有序输入，并将合法修订建模为正常行为；基准包含六种物理动机攻击及其协调变体，固定池保证每个攻击样本留在其源会话所在划分中。在此基础上提出 Dual-Branch Masked-Autoencoder (Masked-AE) Transition Boost 模型，用于判断当前请求是否正常以及产生该请求的转换是否类似已观测的良性更新。
Motivation: 合法的激活后请求修订与充电操纵攻击使用相同的接口和变量，导致检测请求变化本身无法区分恶意与正常行为；现有方法在这种混淆下难以可靠识别攻击。
Method: 提出防泄漏的会话级基准，并对比 22 个仅配置文件、转换感知和上下文分层模型族；核心贡献是双分支模型：状态分支结合掩码重建与径向基函数单类支撑边界，转换分支结合掩码重建与收缩协方差距离。模型通过源分组五折交叉验证在显式整体正常与良性更新接受约束下选择完整配置，并用独立正常数据校准最终阈值后进行一次测试评估。
Result: 摘要报告该双分支模型在稳健验证性能上表现最强，能够在检测恶意请求操纵的同时不学会拒绝合法用户选择；摘要未给出具体量化数字。
Conclusion: 作者认为将请求正常性判定与转换是否属于已观测良性更新相结合，可以有效区分恶意操纵与合法修订；文章强调基准的泄漏控制、统一评估协议和操作约束对公平比较的重要性。

papers.title: SegPAR: Class-Centric Decision-Based Sparse Attack for Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Despite the practical relevance of sparse decision-based black-box threats, they have received limited attention in semantic segmentation. To bridge this gap, we adapt the most representative decision-based black-box sparse attacks from the classification domain to serve as baselines, establishing a rigorous benchmark for this underexplored setting. In this context, we demonstrate that one of the existing methods suffers from severe query inefficiency due to its image-centric pixel accumulation, which rapidly exhausts query budgets across the vast image space. To overcome this, we propose SegPAR, a novel decision-based framework that shifts to a class-centric exploration paradigm. Furthermore, to eliminate the misleading feedback generated by standard decision rewards during pixel accumulation, we introduce a novel discrepancy reward. Extensive experiments show that SegPAR significantly outperforms black-box baselines in sparsity efficiency and MIoU reduction, while remaining competitive with white-box sparse attacks. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/KAU-QuantumAILab/SegPAR}{https://github.com/KAU-QuantumAILab/SegPAR}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对语义分割中的稀疏决策式黑盒攻击 (sparse decision-based black-box attack) 这一研究不足的问题，先将分类领域最具代表性的决策式黑盒稀疏攻击适配为基线，建立基准评测，并提出 SegPAR 框架。SegPAR 把探索范式从图像中心 (image-centric) 的像素累积转为类中心 (class-centric)，同时引入 discrepancy reward 来消除像素累积过程中标准决策奖励产生的误导性反馈。实验表明该框架在稀疏性效率和 MIoU 下降幅度上显著优于黑盒基线，并与白盒稀疏攻击相当。
Motivation: 稀疏决策式黑盒威胁具有实际意义，但在语义分割中受到的关注有限；现有方法采用图像中心式像素累积，在巨大的图像空间下会迅速消耗查询预算，表现出严重的查询低效问题。
Method: 提出 SegPAR，一种基于决策的黑盒攻击框架，核心思想是从图像中心式探索转向类中心式 (class-centric) 探索；并设计一种新的 discrepancy reward，用于剔除像素累积过程中标准决策奖励带来的误导性反馈。
Result: 实验显示 SegPAR 在稀疏性效率 (sparsity efficiency) 和 MIoU 下降上显著优于黑盒基线，并与白盒稀疏攻击性能保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 作者认为类中心的探索范式能有效缓解查询预算被快速耗尽的问题，并为语义分割中的决策式黑盒稀疏攻击建立了可复用的基准；代码已公开在 GitHub 上。
Relevance: 0
