papers.title: Chemically Meaningful Textualization Enables Explainable Validation of Metal-Organic Frameworks by Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Computation-ready metal-organic framework (MOF) databases are essential for high-throughput screening, yet many reported crystal structures remain chemically unreasonable or disordered, compromising simulation fidelity. Existing validation approaches can identify non-computation-ready structures, but they often rely on heuristic rules, license requirement, or offer limited interpretability. Here, we show that large language models (LLMs) can serve as interpretable validators of MOF structures when crystallographic information is transformed into chemically meaningful text. By benchmarking nine descriptors, we find that successful LLM-based validation depends not on the amount of structural information alone, but on whether local coordination, framework connectivity, and chemical context are organized into a linguistically learnable representation. Fine-tuned LLMs using specialized descriptors (mof2text) achieve performance comparable to graph-based models in identifying unreasonable MOFs. Importantly, these models extend beyond black-box classification by generating diagnostic rationales for likely error sources, including abnormal bonding, connectivity, and charge states, as well as error-category predictions for annotated datasets. This work establishes chemically informed textualization as the key step that transforms LLMs from generic text models into practical and explainable tools for curating MOF databases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何利用大语言模型（LLM）对金属有机框架（MOF）晶体结构进行可解释验证。作者将晶体学信息转换为化学上有意义的文本描述，并系统比较九种描述符，发现验证效果不取决于结构信息量本身，而取决于局部配位、框架连通性和化学上下文是否被组织成语言上可学习的形式。使用专门描述符（mof2text）微调后的 LLM 在识别不合理 MOF 上达到与基于图的模型相当的性能，并能输出诊断理由。
Motivation: 计算就绪的 MOF 数据库对高通量筛选至关重要，但许多已报道晶体结构存在化学不合理或无序问题，影响模拟保真度；现有验证方法依赖启发式规则、可能需要许可或可解释性有限。
Method: 提出将晶体学信息转化为化学上有意义的文本描述，评估九种描述符的表示方式，并使用专门描述符（mof2text）微调 LLM，使其不仅做分类判断，还能生成基于局部配位、框架连通性和化学上下文的可解释诊断。
Result: 微调后的 LLM 在识别不合理 MOF 结构上取得与基于图模型相当的性能；与黑盒分类不同，模型能生成异常键合、连通性和电荷状态等错误来源的诊断理由，以及针对注释数据集的错误类别预测。
Conclusion: 作者强调化学信息化的文本化（chemically informed textualization）是将 LLM 从通用文本模型转化为实用且可解释的 MOF 数据库整理工具的关键步骤。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Physics-Informed Implicit Neural Representations for Improved Myocardial Perfusion MRI Quantification
papers.abstract_en: Quantifying myocardial perfusion from cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) can be achieved by fitting tracer-kinetic models to the dynamic contrast-enhanced MR data. However, fitting the observed data with multi-compartment exchange models, which describe the evolution of the contrast agent in the tissue, to estimate perfusion parameters is a challenging inverse problem that is sensitive to noise and acquisition variability. Previously, physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have been proposed as an alternative to conventional non-linear least squares fitting methods with promising results for quantitative perfusion CMR. In this work, we extend the previously proposed PINN framework with spatiotemporal implicit neural representations (INRs) to represent the MR signal as a continuous spatiotemporal function and to improve the accuracy, smoothness, and physical consistency of the PINN model. In realistic simulated CMR datasets, our proposed PINN with INRs demonstrates improved robustness and parameter estimation accuracy over the previously established methods. The code is available at https://github.com/q-cardIA/pinn-inr.
papers.comment: Accepted at the STACOM workshop at MICCAI, Strasbourg 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对心肌灌注心脏磁共振（CMR）中通过示踪剂动力学模型估计灌注参数的逆问题，在已有物理信息神经网络（PINN）框架基础上引入时空隐式神经表示（implicit neural representations, INRs），将MR信号表示为连续时空函数，以提升参数估计的精度、平滑性和物理一致性。在逼真的模拟CMR数据集上，该方法相较既有方法展现出更好的鲁棒性和参数估计准确性，代码已开源。
Motivation: 利用多室交换模型拟合动态对比增强MR数据来估计心肌灌注参数，是受噪声和采集变异性影响的困难逆问题；此前提出的PINN虽是有前景的替代方案，但仍有改进空间。
Method: 将时空隐式神经表示（INRs）集成到已有的PINN框架中，用连续时空函数表示MR信号，从而改善重建的平滑性并强化物理一致性约束。
Result: 在逼真的模拟CMR数据集上，带有INR的PINN相比此前已建立的方法，表现出更优的鲁棒性和参数估计准确性。
Conclusion: 作者认为扩展的PINN+INR框架能提升心肌灌注CMR定量分析的精度与稳健性；摘要未报告真实临床数据验证，适用范围限于模拟数据集。

papers.title: Federated Learning for Distributed CNC Tool Wear Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Tool wear prediction is an important task in CNC machining, where accurate monitoring of tool condition supports product quality and process reliability. Machine learning methods have shown potential for this task, but their use in industrial environments is limited by the distributed nature of machining data and by restrictions on data sharing between machines, sites, or organizations. Federated learning offers a suitable framework for this setting by enabling collaborative model training without transferring raw operational data. This paper investigates federated learning for CNC tool wear prediction. Tool trajectories are distributed across simulated clients to represent a federated learning scenario. The federated models are compared against centralized references and local client baselines. Results show that federated learning achieves performance close to centralized learning and improves significantly over local client models. These findings indicate that federated learning can support collaborative tool wear prediction in distributed CNC manufacturing environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究联邦学习（federated learning）在CNC加工刀具磨损预测中的应用。刀具轨迹被分布到模拟客户端上以构建联邦学习场景，并将联邦模型与集中式参考模型及本地客户端基线进行比较。结果显示联邦学习性能接近集中式学习，并显著优于本地客户端模型。
Motivation: CNC加工中刀具磨损预测对产品质量和过程可靠性至关重要，但工业数据分布在不同机器、站点或组织之间，且受数据共享限制，传统机器学习应用受限。联邦学习无需传输原始运营数据即可协作训练，适合该场景。
Method: 将刀具轨迹分布到多个模拟客户端以模拟联邦学习场景，训练联邦模型，并与集中式参考模型和本地客户端基线进行对比评估。
Result: 摘要报告联邦学习达到了接近集中式学习的性能，并显著优于本地客户端模型。
Conclusion: 联邦学习可支持分布式CNC制造环境下的协作式刀具磨损预测。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware and Explainable Ensemble Deep Learning Framework for Multi-Class Skin Lesion Classification
papers.abstract_en: Skin cancer diagnosis from dermoscopic images remains challenging due to high intra-class variability, inter-class similarity, class imbalance, and the limited interpretability of deep learning models. This paper proposes an uncertainty-aware and explainable deep learning framework for multi-class skin lesion classification. The framework combines a vision transformer model (MaxViT-Tiny) with CNN-based models (ConvNeXt-Tiny and EfficientNetV2-B0) through deep ensemble learning. Monte Carlo (MC) Dropout estimates predictive uncertainty and identifies unreliable predictions, while Grad-CAM++, an explainable AI (XAI) technique, provides visual explanations by highlighting lesion regions that influence model decisions. Evaluated on the HAM10000 dataset, the framework achieves 96% accuracy and 99% ROC-AUC under uncertainty-aware filtering (entropy < 1.0, confidence >= 0.7), with macro-average precision, recall, and F1-score of 94%, 95%, and 95%, respectively, and 96% weighted-average scores across all three metrics. The results demonstrate accurate, interpretable, and uncertainty-aware skin lesion classification for trustworthy computer-aided diagnosis.

papers.title: Basin: Efficient and Extensible Numerical Optimization in Rust
papers.abstract_en: Basin is a numerical optimization library for the Rust programming language. Numerical optimization is the task of finding the inputs that minimize a function, and it is a fundamental element across the sciences: fitting a model to data, calibrating a simulation, training a machine learning model, or choosing engineering parameters that minimize cost. Basin gives users a single, consistent way to both state and solve such problems, with a broad catalog of solvers and first-class support for constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Basin 是一个面向 Rust 编程语言的数值优化库，提供一个统一且一致的方式来陈述和求解最优化问题，包含广泛的求解器目录，并对约束条件提供了一流支持。摘要将其定位为覆盖从模型拟合、模拟校准到机器学习训练与工程参数选择等科学场景的基础工具。
Motivation: 数值优化广泛存在于各科学领域，包括拟合模型、校准模拟、训练机器学习模型以及选择最小化成本的工程参数；现有的 Rust 生态中缺少一个一致、可扩展且对约束条件支持良好的通用优化库。
Method: 作者提出 Basin，一个 Rust 数值优化库，设计上提供统一的接口来陈述和求解优化问题，并内置广泛的求解器目录以及一等公民的约束支持。
Result: 摘要未报告具体的数值实验或性能评测，只描述了库的设计目标与功能特性。
Conclusion: Basin 的目标是为 Rust 用户提供一种统一且可扩展的方式来解决数值优化问题；摘要没有提及与特定应用领域的实证结论或限制。

papers.title: Every pooling rule has its world: matching probability combination rules to situations and stakes
papers.abstract_en: Systems often need to combine two numerical assessments of the same yes/no question. The appropriate formula depends on what the numbers represent and on how the sources are related. Averaging is correct when one of several alternative interpretations applies; multiplying odds is correct when probability reports are based on conditionally independent evidence and a common prior; and probabilities of alternative successful derivations require their dependence or shared evidence to be taken into account. We state the assumptions behind several common combination rules and derive the corresponding combined probabilities. Two groups of Monte Carlo experiments address different questions. First, controlled generating mechanisms verify that the derived rule recovers the correct probability in the situations for which its assumptions hold. Second, the same mechanisms measure the consequences of using a mismatched rule, using logarithmic score and threshold decisions with different costs. Distinct pooling rules can produce the same binary decision at threshold 1/2 while assigning substantially different probabilities, so binary accuracy alone can conceal important differences. We also give probabilistic interpretations of conflicting-evidence rules and show that, for overlapping derivations, retaining the identities of shared uncertain premises permits direct calculation of the probability that at least one derivation is available. Pairwise combination of proof probabilities loses information when there are three or more derivations.
papers.comment: 36 pages, 6 figures. Experiment code and data available at https://github.com/tammet/poolingworlds
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何将同一 yes/no 问题的两个数值评估合成为一个概率，指出没有普遍适用的组合公式：平均、odds 相乘以及基于依赖证据的计算各有其适用场景。作者为几种常见组合规则明确假设并推导对应概率，然后用受控生成机制的蒙特卡洛实验验证规则在假设成立时的正确性，并测量使用错配规则时对数分数 (logarithmic score) 与阈值决策的代价。
Motivation: 系统需要组合两个数值评估，但适用公式取决于数值含义和来源关系；选错规则会带来后果，而二进制决策精度可能掩盖概率层面的差异。
Method: 陈述若干常见组合规则背后的假设并推导相应组合概率；设计两组蒙特卡洛实验：一组用受控生成机制验证规则在其假设成立时能否恢复正确概率，另一组测量错配规则在对数分数和不同成本阈值决策下的后果；同时给出冲突证据规则的概率解释，并说明重叠推导时可利用共享不确定前提直接计算至少一个推导可用的概率。
Result: 受控实验确认规则在假设成立时能恢复正确概率，且错配规则会带来可量化的分数和决策代价；不同池化规则在阈值 1/2 下可能产生相同二进制决策却赋予显著不同的概率；当存在三个或更多推导时，成对组合证明概率会丢失信息。
Conclusion: 作者强调组合规则的选择必须匹配实际情境与代价结构，二进制准确性不足以评估组合质量，且多证据场景下应保留共享前提的身份而非做两两组合。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Agent Safety Should Be a Runtime Contract
papers.abstract_en: The dominant paradigm treats AI safety as a property to be instilled during model training via RLHF, DPO, or Constitutional AI. We argue this is structurally insufficient for autonomous agents that execute code, mutate files, send messages, and modify databases. Agent safety should be a runtime contract enforced by the harness, and the contract has two complementary faces. The preventive face blocks dangerous actions before they happen via sandboxes, permission gates, output filters, and trajectory monitors. The evidential face requires verifiable proof that good actions actually happened, gating task submission on hard evidence such as test runs, log captures, file diffs, and citation grounding. We ground the position in four lines of public evidence, with row-level protocols and data released in the supplementary JSON files: a survey of 52 documented AI-agent and LLM safety incidents, a false-completion audit with 31 non-contested core cases plus one disputed illustrative case, a trajectory-schema audit of 12 public agent systems and harnesses, and a title-level audit of all 28,560 papers accepted at NeurIPS, ICML, and ICLR 2023-2025 showing a pooled 8-12x imbalance between training-time and deployment-time publication. Two prior communities that needed to enforce safety, computer security and the experimental sciences, converged on runtime contracts with both preventive and evidential elements; agentic AI is now under the same pressure. We formalize an Agent Trajectory Schema and Evidence Chain, state a compositional gating proposition based on standard monitor composition, and outline a research agenda. The right unit of safety in agentic AI is the trajectory-with-checkable-evidence, not the model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文主张智能体安全不应只靠训练阶段注入（RLHF、DPO、Constitutional AI），而应作为由运行环境（harness）强制执行的运行时契约（runtime contract）。契约包含预防性（preventive）与证据性（evidential）两副面孔：前者通过沙箱、权限门、输出过滤器与轨迹监控阻止危险动作；后者要求用测试运行、日志捕获、文件差异和引用溯源等硬证据来证明好行为确实发生，并以此作为任务提交的门控条件。作者将安全单元定义为“带可核查证据的轨迹”（trajectory-with-checkable-evidence），而非模型本身。
Motivation: 当前主流范式把 AI 安全视为训练期间通过 RLHF、DPO 或 Constitutional AI 植入的属性，但这对会执行代码、修改文件、发送消息和操作数据库的自主智能体而言结构上不充分，缺乏部署时强制保证。
Method: 提出代理安全应作为运行时契约，由 harness 强制执行，包含预防性与证据性两类互补机制，并形式化 Agent Trajectory Schema 与 Evidence Chain，基于标准监控器组合提出组合式门控命题（compositional gating proposition）。
Result: 论文以四类公开证据支撑论点：52 起 AI 智能体与 LLM 安全事件的调查；31 个无争议核心案例外加 1 个有争议示例的虚假完成审计；12 个公开智能体系统与 harness 的轨迹模式审计；以及 NeurIPS、ICML、ICLR 2023-2025 年全部 28,560 篇论文的标题级审计，显示训练时与部署时研究发表数量存在约 8-12 倍的失衡。
Conclusion: 作者认为计算机安全与实验科学两个领域都曾因需要强制安全而收敛于同时包含预防与证据要素的运行时契约，智能体 AI 正面临同样压力；因此安全单位应是可核查证据的轨迹，并据此提出研究议程。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Geometry-Based Compression of Plenoptic Point Clouds
papers.abstract_en: Plenoptic point clouds (PPC) are novel data structures that represent the light from different viewing directions in order to provide a higher degree of realism to regular point clouds. This is achieved by associating each point to multiple colors instead of a single one. Here, we present a method to efficiently compress the attributes of a PPC, consisting of a Karhunen-Loève transform over the color attributes followed by multiple attribute coders with intra prediction capability. This compression scheme can be incorporated within the MPEG's geometry-based PCC (G-PCC) standard, using any of G-PCC's existing solutions for attribute coding. Compression performance assessment using PPCs of different spatial resolutions reveals competitive results in comparison to existing methods, such as RAHT-based or video-based PCC solutions. We believe our coder to be the new state of the art.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对全光点云 (plenoptic point clouds, PPC) 属性的压缩方法：先对每个点的多个颜色属性做 Karhunen-Loève 变换 (KLT)，再用多个带帧内预测能力的属性编码器编码。该方案可嵌入 MPEG G-PCC 标准，实验显示在不同空间分辨率的 PPC 上相比 RAHT-based 和 video-based PCC 方案具有竞争力，作者认为其成为新的 state of the art。
Motivation: 常规点云每个点只关联一个颜色，而 PPC 用多个颜色表示来自不同视角的光，以增强逼真度，因此属性数据量更大，需要高效的属性压缩方案。
Method: 方法由两部分组成：对颜色属性应用 Karhunen-Loève 变换去相关，随后使用多个具备帧内预测能力的属性编码器；整体可作为 G-PCC 属性编码流程的一部分，并兼容 G-PCC 现有的属性编码方案。
Result: 摘要报告在不同空间分辨率的 PPC 数据集上，该方法相对现有 RAHT-based 或 video-based PCC 方案取得有竞争力的压缩性能，并声称达到新的 state of the art。
Conclusion: 摘要将该方法定位为可用于 MPEG G-PCC 标准的 PPC 属性编码方案，自评性能领先；但未给出具体量化数值。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Geodesic Cut-Cell Prior for Neural Skinning
papers.abstract_en: We introduce cut-cell skinning, a geometric prior designed to augment data-driven skinning weight generation. While data-driven methods show promise in producing high-quality skinning weights, they often lack the generalizability of classic geometric approaches. To bridge this gap, we propose a geometric prior that can be robustly computed for in-the-wild meshes and is efficient for large-scale machine learning workflows. The key idea of our cut-cell skinning is a fast graph-based approximation of the volumetric geodesics distances, motivated by their importance in classic skinning weight computation. Our method achieves orders of magnitude speedup compared to optimization-based solvers and remains resilient to topological artifacts common in cage- or voxel-based alternatives. We demonstrate the efficacy of the cut-cell skinning prior by integrating it into recent neural skinning models, showing consistent improvements across existing methods and achieving state-of-the-art results. Project page: https://wenchao-m.github.io/CutCell.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 cut-cell skinning，一种用于增强数据驱动蒙皮权重 (skinning weights) 生成的几何先验。该方法用基于图的快速近似来逼近体积测地距离 (volumetric geodesic distances)，相比优化求解器带来数量级加速，并对 cage 或 voxel 类替代方案常见的拓扑伪影具有鲁棒性。作者将该先验集成到近期神经蒙皮 (neural skinning) 模型中，报告了跨现有方法的一致改进并达到 state-of-the-art 结果。
Motivation: 数据驱动方法能生成高质量蒙皮权重，但往往缺乏经典几何方法的泛化性；本文旨在弥合这一差距，提供一个可对 in-the-wild 网格稳健计算、且适合大规模机器学习工作流的几何先验。
Method: 核心思想是 cut-cell skinning：一种快速的基于图的近似体积测地距离计算方法，其设计动机来自体积测地距离在经典蒙皮权重计算中的重要性。
Result: 摘要报告该方法相比优化求解器实现数个数量级的加速，并对 cage 或 voxel 替代方案中常见的拓扑伪影保持鲁棒；集成到近期神经蒙皮模型后，在现有方法上取得一致改进并达到 state-of-the-art。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该几何先验能够增强数据驱动蒙皮权重生成的泛化性与计算效率，适合大规模机器学习流程。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hardware-Aware Deployment of Joint SAR Compression and Despeckling on FPGA
papers.abstract_en: Next-generation Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) missions will generate data far faster than they can downlink, making onboard data reduction essential for near-real-time Earth observation. Learned Image Compression (LIC) offers better rate-distortion performance than handcrafted codecs used operationally today, and recent work shows that simultaneously despeckling and compressing SAR imagery enables better representation capacity while unlocking higher compression rates. These methods, however, have yet to be confronted with the strict power, compute, and operational constraints of spaceborne systems. In this work, we bridge this gap by deploying a joint SAR Despeckling and Data Compression (DDC) framework on an embedded ZCU102 FPGA-based platform, introducing model adaptations that respect the accelerator's fixed-point arithmetic and limited set of supported operations. We evaluate four model topologies across precision levels and across CPU, GPU, and FPGA platforms, revealing several findings with direct design implications. We find that replacing conventional GDN activation functions with plain ReLU improves quality on SAR, suggesting that design principles established for compression of natural images do not necessarily transfer to SAR imagery. In addition, we demonstrate that residual blocks offer little representational benefit for ten times the compute, and show that the FPGA is the most energy-efficient of the platforms tested. Together, these results set a functioning edge deployment workflow and an evidence-based starting point for onboard SAR compression. The code is available at https://github.com/CedricLeon/SAR_DDC_FPGA.
papers.comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing (TGRS). 11 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对下一代星载合成孔径雷达（SAR）数据下传瓶颈，在嵌入式 ZCU102 FPGA 平台上部署联合 SAR 去斑与数据压缩（DDC）框架，并引入适配定点算术与受限算子集的模型改动。作者在 CPU、GPU、FPGA 三种平台和多种精度设置下评估四种模型拓扑，发现将 GDN 激活替换为普通 ReLU 可提升 SAR 图像质量，残差块带来约十倍计算开销而表示收益甚微，FPGA 在能效上最优。文章提供了一个可运行的边缘部署工作流和基于证据的星上 SAR 压缩起点，代码已开源。
Motivation: 下一代 SAR 任务产生数据的速度远超下行链路容量，机载（在轨）数据缩减对近实时对地观测至关重要；现有的联合去斑与压缩学习方法虽能提升表示能力和压缩率，但尚未在星载系统严格的功耗、算力和运行约束下得到验证。
Method: 作者将联合 SAR 去斑与数据压缩（DDC）框架部署到基于 ZCU102 的 FPGA 加速器上，针对定点算术和有限算子集进行模型适配，并在多种精度水平下比较四种模型拓扑在 CPU、GPU 与 FPGA 平台上的表现。
Result: 摘要报告：用普通 ReLU 替换 GDN 激活可提高 SAR 图像质量，说明为自然图像压缩建立的设计原则不一定迁移到 SAR；残差块以约十倍计算量仅带来很少的表示收益；FPGA 是所测平台中能效最高的。
Conclusion: 结果显示了一套可行的边缘部署工作流，并为星上 SAR 压缩提供了基于证据的出发点；作者公开了代码，但摘要未给出具体的率失真、能耗或精度数值。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CosMAP: Contrastive Manifold Approximation and Projection for Dimensionality Reduction of Omics and Genealogical Data
papers.abstract_en: Omics datasets, particularly single-cell RNA sequencing data, are high-dimensional, sparse, noisy, and dominated by zero values, making faithful low-dimensional representation challenging. Existing dimensionality-reduction methods may distort local neighbourhoods, global organization, or the cohesion of meaningful populations, with similar limitations arising in genealogical data. We introduce Contrastive Manifold Approximation and Projection (CosMAP), a graph-based unsupervised dimensionality-reduction method for producing faithful and interpretable embeddings. CosMAP extends the graph-based framework of UMAP by combining cosine-similarity neighbourhoods with temperature-normalized contrastive affinities, which are optimized in the embedding space using an attractive--repulsive objective. It further employs a two-phase refinement strategy: an intermediate higher-dimensional representation is first learned and then used to reconstruct the neighbourhood graph and initialize the final low-dimensional embedding. We evaluate CosMAP on MNIST and USPS handwritten-digit datasets, mouse retina and cortex single-cell RNA-sequencing datasets, and a large genealogical kinship dataset derived from BALSAC-CARTaGENE. Compared with state-of-the-art dimensionality-reduction methods, CosMAP produces more coherent visual representations, improves neighbourhood preservation, and provides clearer global organization of digit classes, biological cell populations, and regional genealogical patterns. These results indicate that CosMAP offers a robust framework for exploratory analysis of complex, sparse, high-dimensional data. The implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/FenosoaRandrianjatovo/CosMAP-dr.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CosMAP (Contrastive Manifold Approximation and Projection)，一种基于图的非监督降维方法，面向单细胞 RNA 测序等组学数据以及系谱数据。CosMAP 在 UMAP 的图框架上引入余弦相似度邻域与温度归一化的对比亲和度 (contrastive affinities)，并用吸引-排斥目标在嵌入空间优化；同时采用两阶段细化策略，先学习中间高维表示，再重建邻接图并初始化最终低维嵌入。作者在 MNIST、USPS、小鼠视网膜和皮层单细胞数据集以及 BALSAC-CARTaGENE 系谱数据上评估，声称相比现有方法获得了更连贯的可视化、更好的邻域保持和更清晰的全局组织。
Motivation: 组学数据尤其是单细胞 RNA 测序数据具有高维、稀疏、含噪和零值主导的特点，现有降维方法可能扭曲局部邻域、全局结构或有意义群体的内聚性，系谱数据也有类似问题。
Method: CosMAP 扩展 UMAP 的图框架，使用余弦相似度邻域和温度归一化的对比亲和度，结合吸引-排斥目标函数优化嵌入；并采用两阶段细化策略，先学习中间高维表示用于重建邻接图并初始化最终低维嵌入。
Result: 摘要报告在 MNIST、USPS、小鼠视网膜和皮层单细胞 RNA 测序数据以及 BALSAC-CARTaGENE 大型系谱亲缘数据集上，相比现有降维方法，CosMAP 产生更连贯的可视化表示，改善邻域保持，并提供更清晰的数字类别、生物细胞群体和区域系谱模式的全局组织。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 CosMAP 为复杂、稀疏、高维数据的探索性分析提供了一个稳健框架，并公开了实现代码。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: What Iterated Self-Feeding Probes of Language Models Measure, and a test that separates the construction from the model
papers.abstract_en: A growing class of methods probes a language model by feeding it its own output: self-consistency, iterated refinement, agentic loops. We ask what such a probe measures, in a construction chosen to make the question sharp: a ring of token cells resampled in place by the model's own windowed conditional p_r(x_i | x_{i+-r}). The substrate is Glauber dynamics on token sequences and is not new; what we change is the coupling. Advancing two rings that differ in one token under common random numbers makes undamaged copies diverge by exactly zero, so damage spreading becomes measurable where a maximal coupling gives mixing times instead. The answer is that it measures two different things at once, in readings that look alike. Some quantities are fixed by the construction: the damage light cone is kinematic, and the radius scaling of the token-space Lyapunov exponent lambda_ca(r) is model-invariant across 19 models and two scale ladders spanning 70x. Others genuinely track the model: lambda_ca crosses zero at a reproducible point in training, and the attractor share ranks models consistently however the lattice is built. Left undistinguished, the first kind is readily mistaken for the second -- we did so ourselves for four months, and report a phase transition we measured to three decimal places that belongs to the probe rather than to any language model. We give the test that separates them: hold the construction fixed and vary the model, or hold the model fixed and vary the construction, and see which readings move. We validate the instrument by reproduction first, recovering a Domany-Kinzel damage field bit-exactly against an independent prediction, and we report the estimator failures that this discipline caught -- four retracted verdicts, each on a quantity that looked like a measurement. The methodology ships as a package.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 4 figures. Code, per-run results, and the findings ledger: https://github.com/nicoveraz/token-lattice-ca (archived: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21880472)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究一类通过让语言模型消费自身输出来探测模型的方法（自一致性、迭代精炼、智能体循环），并在一个精心构造的环境中分析这类探针究竟测量了什么。作者使用 token 环上的 Glauber 动力学，采用共同随机数推进两个相差一个 token 的环，使未损坏副本的差异严格为零，从而将损伤传播与最大耦合下的混合时间区分开。摘要报告同一类读数中既有由构造固定的运动学量，也有真正跟踪模型的量，并给出区分两者的测试。
Motivation: 自反馈式探针方法越来越多，但这类探针测量的是什么并不清楚；若不加以区分，由探针构造本身决定的假象容易被误认为模型属性。作者自述曾为此误报一个属于探针而非语言模型的相变，因此需要可操作的判别测试。
Method: 构造一个 token 单元环，用模型自身的窗口条件分布 p_r(x_i | x_{i±r}) 进行原位重采样，形成 Glauber 动力学；关键改动是耦合方式——用共同随机数推进两个仅差一个 token 的环，使未损伤副本的差异精确为零，从而可测量损伤传播。判别测试为：固定构造并变化模型，或固定模型并变化构造，观察哪些读数发生移动。
Result: 摘要报告损伤光锥是运动学量，token 空间 Lyapunov 指数 lambda_ca(r) 的半径标度在 19 个模型、跨度 70 倍的两个尺度阶梯上具有模型不变性；而 lambda_ca 在训练中的过零点可复现，吸引子份额对格点构造方式稳健。损伤场在 Domany-Kinzel 上与独立预测逐位一致，且估计器失败导致四项结论被撤回。
Conclusion: 自反馈探针同时测量两类外观相似但性质不同的量，必须通过固定构造/变化模型或固定模型/变化构造的测试加以分离；作者将方法以软件包形式发布，并强调先用复现验证仪器再报告测量结果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Epistemic Transfer in AI-Assisted Verification: A Framework and Evaluation Protocol
papers.abstract_en: AI tools that help people judge online claims are usually evaluated while the tool is present. This paper asks a different question: after using such a tool, what can the user still do on their own? I call this epistemic transfer. It refers to the effect of prior AI-assisted verification on later unassisted performance on new claims. In this paper, I make three contributions. First, I distinguish epistemic transfer from nearby outcomes such as correction effects, trust, reliance, and human--AI team performance. Second, I introduce two simple quantities for studying it: the Epistemic Transfer Effect (ETE), which compares delayed unassisted performance across conditions, and Tool-Removal Cost (TRC), which measures the immediate drop in performance when the tool is taken away. Third, I turn these ideas into a practical evaluation protocol that can be used in online experiments or field studies. The protocol combines answer-first and evidence-first AI conditions with active-practice and no-practice controls, delayed tests on held-out claims, behavioral measures, and participant- and item-level analyses. Putting ETE and TRC together yields a diagnostic space that separates capability building, capability plus tool advantage, epistemic inertness or de-skilling, and verification on loan. The point is not that every AI tool must teach. The point is that when independent judgment matters, we should test not only whether a tool helps now, but also what it leaves behind.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“认知迁移”（epistemic transfer）概念，用以刻画用户在使用 AI 辅助工具判断在线声称之后、脱离工具时对新声称的独立表现。作者区分了该概念与纠正效应、信任、依赖及人机团队绩效等邻近概念，并引入两个量化指标：认知迁移效应（ETE）与工具移除成本（TRC）。文章进一步给出一个可复用的评估协议，结合作答优先与证据优先的 AI 条件、主动练习与无练习对照、延迟测试及被试/题目层面分析，最终形成一个诊断空间来区分能力培养、能力加工具优势、认知惰性或技能退化以及“工具代偿性验证”（verification on loan）。
Motivation: 现有 AI 辅助判断工具的评估通常在工具在场时进行，忽略了工具移除后用户是否仍能独立完成任务这一问题；当独立判断能力重要时，需要检验工具在帮助当下之外还留下了什么。
Method: 提出一个评估协议：将作答优先和证据优先的 AI 条件与主动练习和无练习的对照组结合，对保留（held-out）声称进行延迟测试，并收集行为测量数据，同时进行被试层面与题目层面分析；用 ETE 和 TRC 两个量构成诊断空间。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数据或基准结果，主要贡献是概念框架、两个量化指标（ETE 与 TRC）以及可部署于在线实验或现场研究的评估协议。
Conclusion: 论文强调并非每个 AI 工具都必须具备教学功能，但当独立判断本身很重要时，评估不应只看工具当下是否有效，还应考察工具使用后的残留影响。
Relevance: 9

papers.title: SeqLoc: Beyond the Single Frame for Cross-View Geo-Localization in Feature-Sparse Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Cross-View Geo-Localization (CVGL) with OpenStreetMap (OSM) performs well in structure-rich urban environments but collapses in feature-sparse scenes such as rural roads. To study this failure mode, in this work, we introduce CV-FSS, a benchmark that pairs sequential panoramas from five rural regions with aligned OSM maps, on which single-frame methods degrade drastically. We then propose SeqLoc, an online test-time sequence aggregation mechanism that recursively maintains a log-belief volume with three key components: (1) Entropy-Tempered Uncertainty (ETU) tempers each incoming pose likelihood volume by its normalized entropy; (2) Map-Guided Relocalization (MGR) mixes a map-shaped recovery distribution into the belief so that a suppressed true pose can recover; (3) Peak-Anchored Smoothing (PAS) derives the final pose at sub-grid precision. Extensive experiments on CV-FSS and CV-RHO demonstrate that SeqLoc outperforms single-frame localization by a large margin, improving both position and orientation recall by over 50%. The benchmark and source code are publicly available at https://zhengjunwei.com/publications/SeqLoc/SeqLoc.html.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究跨视角地理定位（Cross-View Geo-Localization）在特征稀疏场景（如乡村道路）中的退化问题，提出新基准 CV-FSS（包含五个乡村区域的序列全景图与对齐的 OSM 地图）与在线测试时序列聚合方法 SeqLoc。SeqLoc 递归维护 log-belief volume，结合熵调节不确定性、地图引导重定位与峰值锚定平滑，在 CV-FSS 和 CV-RHO 上相对单帧定位大幅提升位置与朝向 recall。
Motivation: 现有基于 OpenStreetMap 的跨视角地理定位在结构丰富的城市环境表现良好，但在特征稀疏场景如乡村道路中会崩溃；针对该失败模式缺乏专门基准与有效方法。
Method: 提出 SeqLoc，一种在线测试时序列聚合机制，递归维护 log-belief volume，包含三个关键组件：Entropy-Tempered Uncertainty (ETU) 按归一化熵调节每个姿态似然体；Map-Guided Relocalization (MGR) 将地图形状的恢复分布混入信念以让被抑制的真实位姿恢复；Peak-Anchored Smoothing (PAS) 在亚网格精度下导出最终位姿。
Result: 在 CV-FSS 与 CV-RHO 上的大量实验表明，SeqLoc 相对单帧定位有大幅度优势，位置 recall 与朝向 recall 均提升超过 50%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调序列聚合机制能显著改善特征稀疏场景下的跨视角地理定位，并公开了 CV-FSS 基准与源码供后续研究使用。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Agentic Bayesian Optimization through Surrogate-Augmented Autoresearch
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian optimization (BO) has become the standard tool for sample-efficient optimization and owes its efficiency to uncertainty-aware search driven by generic statistical priors. Richer domain priors can improve BO in principle, but encoding them through tailored kernels or problem structure is difficult and rarely done in practice. LLMs can help sidestep this difficulty by making informal priors from natural language, code, and documentation directly available to the optimizer. However, existing LLM-based BO methods either insert the LLM into a fixed role (surrogate, acquisition proxy, or configuration interface) or hand it broad control, sacrificing the systematic exploration that makes BO reliable. We introduce agentic Bayesian optimization: a paradigm in which an LLM agent is the central decision maker in the BO loop while a Bayesian backend provides the uncertainty-aware optimization substrate. The agent configures the problem, queries the backend, selects and commits evaluations, and can revise the optimization strategy during the run by tightening bounds, switching acquisition functions, proposing targeted evaluations, or even reframing the problem following new instructions or observed evidence. We instantiate this idea in Sara, a surrogate-augmented autoresearch agent, and lenz, a modular BoTorch-based backend that the agent can inspect and modify through a structured interface. Across synthetic and real-world benchmarks, Sara preserves the reliability of state-of-the-art BO without prior knowledge, outperforms LLM-based baselines, and uses natural-language priors to improve beyond standard BO. We further demonstrate the practical value of agentic BO in dynamic settings, where Sara reconfigures the full optimization problem on the fly as requirements change, a capability not previously available in standard BO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 agentic Bayesian optimization (agentic BO) 范式，让 LLM agent 作为 BO 循环中的核心决策者，同时保留贝叶斯后端提供的不确定性感知优化基础，并实例化为 Sara (surrogate-augmented autoresearch agent) 与基于 BoTorch 的模块化后端 lenz。摘要称该方法在合成与真实基准上无需先验知识即可保持 state-of-the-art BO 的可靠性，优于基于 LLM 的基线，并能在动态设置中随需求变化实时重构整个优化问题。
Motivation: BO 依赖通用统计先验，但将更丰富的领域先验编码进定制核函数或问题结构在实践中很困难；现有基于 LLM 的 BO 方法要么把 LLM 固定在某角色（代理模型、采集函数代理或配置接口），要么交给 LLM 过宽的控制权，从而牺牲了 BO 赖以可靠的系统性探索。
Method: 提出 agentic Bayesian optimization 范式：LLM agent 是 BO 循环的中心决策者，贝叶斯后端提供不确定性感知的优化基座。agent 可以配置问题、查询后端、选择并提交评估，还能在运行中通过收紧边界、切换采集函数 (acquisition function)、提出定向评估甚至根据新指令或证据重新表述问题来修订优化策略；该思想由 Sara 与可被 agent 通过结构化接口检查和修改的 lenz 后端实现。
Result: 在合成与真实世界基准上，Sara 在无先验知识条件下保持 state-of-the-art BO 的可靠性，优于基于 LLM 的基线，并利用自然语言先验获得优于标准 BO 的结果；在动态设置中，Sara 能够随需求变化在运行中重构完整优化问题。
Conclusion: 作者将 agentic BO 视为一种新范式，使 LLM agent 成为 BO 循环中的决策者而无需牺牲贝叶斯优化所提供的可靠性，并强调其能够在运行中重构问题，这是标准 BO 此前不具备的能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Constitution-Grid Instrument for Data-Efficient RL Alignment (C-Guard)
papers.abstract_en: Conflicting objectives are general in RL alignment, and training on them data-efficiently is hard. Training a safety guard with RL means optimizing two objectives that conflict: catch real harm, and do not refuse benign prompts. Our finding is that over-refusal improves 22.4% to 12.8%, while under-refusal on adversarial attacks silently worsens 0.27 to 0.33. We present C-Guard, a constitution-grid instrument that generates the RL training data, and C-LIM, a per-cell learnability score that decides each cell's move: prune, densify, amend, expand. C-LIM flags the dead-weight data region before any training budget is spent: 187 untargeted rows had bought zero gain, and our method lifts the same region's learning impact 0.733 to 0.80. Code and the constitution are open-sourced.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 C-Guard，一种用于 RL 对齐的宪法网格（constitution-grid）数据生成工具，以及 C-LIM，一种逐格（per-cell）可学习性评分，用于决定每个数据格子的处理方式：剪枝（prune）、加密（densify）、修正（amend）或扩展（expand）。摘要报告在安全护栏训练中，过度拒绝率从 22.4% 改善到 12.8%，而对对抗攻击的拒绝不足从 0.27 恶化到 0.33；C-LIM 能在训练预算投入前标记无效数据区域，例如 187 条未定向数据行收益为零，并将同一区域的学习影响从 0.733 提升到 0.80。代码与 constitution 已开源。
Motivation: RL 对齐训练中普遍存在相互冲突的目标，例如安全护栏需要同时捕捉真实危害且不拒绝良性提示，而在这类冲突目标上进行数据高效训练是困难的。
Method: 提出 C-Guard 宪法网格（constitution-grid）来生成 RL 训练数据，并引入 C-LIM 逐格可学习性评分，据此对每个格子执行剪枝（prune）、加密（densify）、修正（amend）或扩展（expand）操作。
Result: 摘要报告过度拒绝率从 22.4% 改善到 12.8%，但对抗攻击下的拒绝不足从 0.27 恶化到 0.33；C-LIM 在训练前标记出 187 条零收益的未定向数据行，并将该区域的学习影响从 0.733 提升到 0.80。
Conclusion: 作者强调在训练预算投入前使用 C-LIM 识别无效数据区域能提升数据效率，并开源代码与 constitution；论文聚焦 RL 对齐中的冲突目标处理，属于 cs.CL/cs.LG 范畴。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LakeQuest: A Three-Domain Benchmark for Grounded Question Answering across Data Lakes
papers.abstract_en: While modern question answering (QA) systems excel on clean, schema-aligned corpora, real-world knowledge is rarely so neatly packaged. Answering questions over enterprise and scientific data lakes requires systems to navigate heterogeneous, weakly structured collections of tables, passages, and linked metadata. Current benchmarks abstract away this noisy discovery process, failing to evaluate end-to-end performance. To bridge this gap, we introduce LakeQuest, a human-validated benchmark of 9,846 QA pairs designed to evaluate the end-to-end retrieve-and-synthesize pipeline over realistic data lakes. LakeQuest spans three diverse domains (AI/ML metadata, retail banking, and multimodal biomedical drug information) and pairs every question with exact, modality-aware evidence pointers. By isolating source discovery from cross-modal synthesis, LakeQuest exposes critical failure modes in modern QA systems. Our baseline evaluations, including standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and agentic tool-use methods, reveal that high-quality retrieval does not guarantee correct reasoning. Systems consistently struggle with relation chaining in metadata graphs, policy grounding in bank ledgers, and joint tabular QA in biomedical contexts, highlighting the need for robust discovery and faithful cross-file composition mechanisms in future agentic QA systems.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 4 figures, 18 tables. Accepted at the Conference on Language Modeling (COLM) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 LakeQuest，一个用于数据湖上端到端检索-综合 (retrieve-and-synthesize) 评估的人工验证基准，包含 9,846 个 QA 对，覆盖 AI/ML 元数据、零售银行和多模态生物医学药物信息三个领域，并为每个问题提供精确的模态感知证据指针。基线评估包括标准 RAG 和 agentic tool-use 方法，结果显示高质量检索并不能保证正确推理，系统在元数据图关系链、银行账本策略 grounding 和生物医学联合表格 QA 上表现挣扎。
Motivation: 现代 QA 系统在干净、schema 对齐的语料上表现出色，但真实企业或科学数据湖中的知识是异构、弱结构化的表格、段落和链接元数据集合。现有 benchmark 抽象掉了这种含噪的发现过程，无法评估端到端性能，因此缺少对真实数据湖场景的评测。
Method: 构建 LakeQuest 基准：9,846 个人工验证 QA 对，横跨三个领域，并把每个问题与精确的、模态感知的证据指针配对；通过将来源发现 (source discovery) 与跨模态综合 (cross-modal synthesis) 隔离，来暴露现代 QA 系统的关键失败模式。
Result: 基线实验发现，标准 RAG 与 agentic tool-use 方法都呈现“检索高质量但不保证正确推理”的现象；系统特别在元数据图中的关系链推理、银行账本中的策略 grounding、以及生物医学情境下的联合表格 QA 上持续失败。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，未来 agentic QA 系统需要鲁棒的来源发现机制和忠实的跨文件合成 (cross-file composition) 机制，以应对数据湖中的异构证据。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文介绍 LakeQuest，一个用于数据湖上端到端检索-综合 (retrieve-and-synthesize) 评估的人工验证基准，包含 9,846 个 QA 对，覆盖 AI/ML 元数据、零售银行和多模态生物医学药物信息三个领域，并为每个问题提供精确的模态感知证据指针。基线评估包括标准 RAG 和 agentic tool-use 方法，结果显示高质量检索并不能保证正确推理，系统在元数据图关系链、银行账本策略 grounding 和生物医学联合表格 QA 上表现挣扎。
summary_sections.motivation: 现代 QA 系统在干净、schema 对齐的语料上表现出色，但真实企业或科学数据湖中的知识是异构、弱结构化的表格、段落和链接元数据集合。现有 benchmark 抽象掉了这种含噪的发现过程，无法评估端到端性能，因此缺少对真实数据湖场景的评测。

papers.title: Quantum Port-Hamiltonian Neural Networks: Learning Conservative and Dissipative Dynamics via Measurement-Induced Nonlinearity
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Quantum Port-Hamiltonian Neural Networks (Q-pHNNs), parameterised quantum circuits that learn classical dynamics in a structure-preserving manner. The framework rests on the Isomorphic Hamiltonian Mapping (IHM): the skew-symmetric interconnection matrix $\mathbf{J}$ corresponds to unitary gate evolution, and the positive-semidefinite dissipation matrix $\mathbf{R}$ to Measurement-Induced NonLinearity (MINL), realised by mid-circuit measurement with classical feedforward. Conservation and passivity are then enforced by construction rather than by penalty terms, and dissipation becomes an intrinsically quantum effect: energy leaves through the act of measurement. We instantiate the IHM in three architectures: a Quantum HNN that extracts Hamilton's equations via the Parameter-Shift Rule; a Q-pHNN that dissipates through MINL; and a topology-entangled Quantum Graph Neural Network lifting both channels to $N$-node coupled-phasor networks. In simulation, where every model here was trained, we obtain $1.35\%$ relative energy drift under a symplectic integrator, $100\%$ energy monotonicity for the single-oscillator MINL circuit, and $92$--$98\%$ phase-space energy decay across ring, star and chain networks at $N\in\{3,6,9\}$. On an IBM Heron processor the trained energy surface and its parameter-shift gradients reproduce their simulated values, with an error budget dominated by readout rather than gate infidelity; the dissipative channel executes natively, but its decay is not separable from measurement back-action at these depths.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出量子Port-Hamiltonian神经网络（Q-pHNNs），用参数化量子电路以结构保持方式学习经典动力学。核心是Isomorphic Hamiltonian Mapping（IHM）：将反对称互连矩阵J对应为酉门演化，半正定耗散矩阵R对应为Measurement-Induced NonLinearity（MINL），即中电路测量加经典前馈。作者在三种架构中实例化IHM，并报告仿真中相对能量漂移1.35%、单振荡器MINL电路100%能量单调性，以及N∈{3,6,9}下环/星/链网络92%-98%的相空间能量衰减；IBM Heron硬件上训练的能量表面与参数偏移梯度复现了仿真值。
Motivation: 传统神经网络学习动力学时通常用罚项软约束守恒与耗散，无法在结构上保证这些性质。本文旨在通过量子电路构造直接强制守恒性与无源性（passivity），使耗散成为内在的量子测量效应。
Method: 提出IHM，把J映射为酉门演化、R映射为MINL（中电路测量与经典前馈）。实例化三种架构：量子HNN（用Parameter-Shift Rule提取哈密顿方程）、通过MINL耗散的Q-pHNN，以及将两个通道提升到N节点耦合相量网络的拓扑纠缠量子图神经网络（Quantum Graph Neural Network）。
Result: 仿真中，辛积分器下相对能量漂移为1.35%，单振荡器MINL电路能量单调性为100%，环、星、链网络在N∈{3,6,9}下相空间能量衰减为92%-98%。在IBM Heron处理器上，训练后的能量表面及参数偏移梯度与仿真一致，误差预算以读出误差为主而非门保真度；耗散通道原生执行，但在该深度下其衰减无法与测量反作用分离。
Conclusion: 作者表明守恒与耗散可通过构造而非罚项同时实现，耗散表现为测量带来的内在量子效应。但当前电路深度下耗散衰减与测量反作用不可分离，是该方法的一个明确局限。

papers.title: Modeling Spectral Energy Shifts in Spatio-Temporal Graph Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Graph anomaly detection methods aim to distinguish anomalous nodes. While prior methods characterize anomalies through increased variation in the spectral energy distributions, they overlook those that result in decreased variation, i.e., camouflaged anomalies that appear normal. We show that this type of anomaly persists across multiple datasets and remains undetectable by existing spectral approaches. To address this limitation, we propose a node-level spectral energy formulation that is fully compatible with message passing and enables the detection of camouflaged anomalies. Building on this formulation, we introduce an energy-aware graph learning framework that models spectral shifts through energy-driven message passing in both static and time-series graphs. Besides, our unified architecture extends to temporal settings without introducing specialized sequence modules, enabling efficient learning under long sliding windows. Extensive experiments on large-scale benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and scalability of our approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对图异常检测中的一类被现有方法忽略的异常：那些导致谱能量分布变异减小的‘伪装异常’（camouflaged anomalies），它们看起来与正常节点无异。作者提出一种与消息传递完全兼容的节点级谱能量表示，并在此基础上构建能量感知图学习框架，通过能量驱动的消息传递在静态图和时间序列图上建模谱能量偏移。该统一架构无需专门的序列模块即可扩展到时间设置，支持长滑动窗口下的高效学习，并在大规模基准上验证了有效性和可扩展性。
Motivation: 现有图异常检测方法主要刻画谱能量分布变异增大的异常，而忽视了变异减小的伪装异常；作者表明这类异常在多个数据集中持续存在，并且现有谱方法无法检测到它们。
Method: 提出节点级谱能量公式，使其完全兼容消息传递机制；随后引入能量感知图学习框架，通过能量驱动的消息传递（energy-driven message passing）在静态图和时间序列图中建模谱偏移。该统一架构不需要专门的序列模块即可处理时间设置，从而支持长滑动窗口下的高效学习。
Result: 在大规模基准上的大量实验表明该方法有效且具有可扩展性；摘要未给出具体的数值结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作弥补了谱异常检测的盲区，使谱偏移减小型伪装异常在静态与时间序列图中都可被检测，同时保持长滑动窗口下的高效性。摘要未明确讨论方法的局限性。

papers.title: Pop-Up Distractions Reveal Bag-of-Events Behavior in Video Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: A key capability for video understanding is reliably linking subjects to events across time, yet whether Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) actually achieve this remains unclear. In this work, we introduce DistractionBench to evaluate whether VideoLLMs can robustly link subjects and events in the presence of unrelated video segments. Through controlled interventions, such as inserting short advertisement clips into longer videos, we show that VideoLLMs frequently hallucinate interactions between entities from different segments, incorrectly attributing actions from injected advertisements to subjects in the main video. We characterize this systematic hallucination as bag-of-events (BoE) behavior, where models process videos as collections of events rather than temporally structured sequences. Evaluating 11 popular VideoLLMs, we find that all models exhibit substantial BoE behavior. Our findings suggest that VideoLLMs lack reliable mechanisms for temporal grounding and motivate the development of models with more robust subject-event association.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DistractionBench 基准，通过在长视频中插入无关广告片段等受控干预，检验视频大语言模型（VideoLLMs）是否能在跨时间维度上稳健地把主体与事件关联起来。摘要报告评估的 11 个主流 VideoLLM 均表现出系统性幻觉：模型频繁把插入片段中的动作错误归属到主视频主体，并将视频当作无时间结构的事件集合（bag-of-events, BoE）来处理。
Motivation: 视频理解的关键能力是在时间上可靠地关联主体与事件，但 VideoLLM 是否真正具备这一能力尚不明确。作者针对存在无关视频片段时模型产生主体-事件关联幻觉这一问题展开研究。
Method: 引入 DistractionBench 基准，采用受控干预手段，例如在较长视频中插入短广告片段，并通过分析模型在跨片段场景下的行为来刻画 bag-of-events（BoE）现象。
Result: 对 11 个主流 VideoLLM 的评估显示，所有模型都表现出明显的 BoE 行为，即把不同片段中的实体交互进行幻觉式关联，并将注入广告中的动作错误归因于主视频中的主体。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 VideoLLM 缺乏可靠的时间接地（temporal grounding）机制，并指出需要开发具有更强主体-事件关联能力的模型。

papers.title: BlitzGS: City-Scale Gaussian Splatting at Lightning Speed
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale 3D Gaussian Splatting underpins digital twins, simulation, and aerial mapping, yet city-scale training remains computationally expensive even with multi-GPU execution because every iteration must preprocess, communicate, and rasterize an overly dense set of primitives. At any given step, only a small fraction of these primitives contribute meaningfully to the loss; the rest incur redundant storage, communication, and rasterization costs. Existing approaches improve individual cost factors but do not fully address the underlying question: which Gaussians should be stored on each GPU, rendered for each view, and retained after early geometry formation? We present BlitzGS, a distributed 3DGS framework that reduces the active Gaussian workload at three coupled levels. At the system level, it shards Gaussians across GPUs by index parity rather than spatial blocks, mitigating the cross-block visibility redundancy of spatial partitioning, and distributes each render step through a single cross-GPU exchange that routes projected Gaussians to their tile owners. At the model level, it controls the population from both ends of densification. Scheduled importance-scoring passes prune redundant survivors, and a lightweight spawn gate withholds candidates predicted not to survive. The same importance signal also feeds back into density control. At the view level, a distance-based LOD gate and an importance-based mask trim each camera's active set. On large-scale benchmarks, BlitzGS matches the rendering quality of recent large-scale baselines while delivering nearly an order-of-magnitude speedup, training city-scale scenes in tens of minutes. Our code is available at https://github.com/AkierRaee/BlitzGS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BlitzGS 是一个面向城市场景的分布式 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) 训练框架，旨在降低大规模场景训练中冗余 primitive 带来的存储、通信与光栅化开销。它从系统、模型、视图三个层面耦合地削减活跃 Gaussian 数量：按索引奇偶性切分 Gaussian、单次跨 GPU 交换完成渲染、调度式重要性剪枝与 spawn gate 控制密度，以及基于距离和重要性的视图裁剪。摘要报告称在保持与近期大规模基线相当渲染质量的同时，实现近一个数量级的加速，可在几十分钟内完成城市场景训练。
Motivation: 城市场景的 3DGS 训练即使使用多 GPU 也十分昂贵，因为每一步都要预处理、通信并光栅化过密的 primitive 集合，而其中只有一小部分对 loss 有实质贡献，其余造成冗余开销；现有方法只改进单个成本因素，没有完整回答哪些 Gaussian 应存储、渲染并在几何形成后保留的问题。
Method: 系统层面按索引奇偶性而不是空间块对 Gaussian 进行 GPU 分片，以缓解空间划分带来的跨块可见性冗余，并通过一次跨 GPU 交换将投影后的 Gaussian 路由到所属 tile；模型层面用调度式重要性评分剪枝删除冗余幸存者，并用轻量 spawn gate 抑制预计无法存活的候选，同时将重要性信号反馈给密度控制；视图层面用基于距离的 LOD gate 和基于重要性的 mask 裁剪每个相机的活跃集合。
Result: 在大规模基准上，BlitzGS 匹配近期大规模 3DGS 基线的渲染质量，同时实现近一个数量级的速度提升，将城市场景训练时间缩短到几十分钟。
Conclusion: 作者强调三个层面耦合地压缩活跃 Gaussian 工作负载是获得大规模加速的关键；方法已在大型基准上验证，代码已开源。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Linear-Core Surrogates: Smooth Loss Functions with Linear Rates for Classification and Structured Prediction
papers.abstract_en: A fundamental dichotomy in the theory of classification sets smoothness against statistical efficiency: smooth surrogate losses such as the logistic loss enable fast $O(1/T)$ optimization but yield slow square-root $H$-consistency bounds, while piecewise-linear losses like the Hinge loss achieve optimal linear $H$-consistency rates but are non-differentiable. We introduce Linear-Core (LC) Surrogates, the first family of explicit convex loss functions that provably resolve this tension. By stitching a linear core to a smooth tail, we construct surrogates that are differentiable everywhere ($C^1$, and even $C^2$ under mild conditions) while retaining strict linear $H$-consistency bounds, the strongest known form of consistency guarantee. We establish these linear bounds across three increasingly complex settings: binary classification, multi-class classification, and structured prediction. To our knowledge, this is the first explicit construction to simultaneously achieve smoothness and linear $H$-consistency in any of these settings. Beyond their theoretical appeal, Linear-Core Surrogates offer practical advantages. In multi-class classification, their constant gradient profile near the decision boundary provides natural robustness to instance-dependent label noise, outperforming Cross-Entropy by 2.6% on corrupted CIFAR-10. In structured prediction, their smoothness enables an unbiased stochastic gradient estimator that bypasses the $O(|Y|^2)$ per-step complexity of exact inference, yielding a 23$\times$ speedup over Structured SVMs on large-vocabulary sequence tagging tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Linear-Core (LC) Surrogates，一类显式凸损失函数，通过将线性核心与光滑尾部拼接，同时实现处处可微（C1，温和条件下 C2，甚至更光滑）和严格的线性 H-一致性界。作者在二分类、多分类和结构化预测三种设置下建立了这些线性界，并声称这是首个在这些设置中同时达到光滑性与线性 H-一致性的显式构造。此外，论文还展示了该方法在噪声标签鲁棒性和结构化预测加速方面的实际优势。
Motivation: 分类理论中存在一个基本矛盾：逻辑损失等光滑替代损失具有 O(1/T) 的快速优化率，但只能得到平方根的 H-一致性界；而 Hinge 损失等分段线性损失能达到最优线性 H-一致性率，却不可微。作者的目标是构造一类损失函数，同时具备光滑性和严格的线性 H-一致性保证。
Method: 提出 Linear-Core Surrogates 损失函数族，构造方式是将线性核（linear core）与光滑尾部（smooth tail）拼接，得到处处可微且保持线性 H-一致性界的凸损失。论文在二分类、多分类和结构化预测三种复杂度递增的设置中分别建立这些线性一致性界。
Result: 在多分类中，LC Surrogates 在决策边界附近的恒定梯度轮廓对实例依赖的标签噪声具有自然鲁棒性，在 corrupted CIFAR-10 上比 Cross-Entropy 高 2.6%。在结构化预测中，其光滑性支持一种无偏随机梯度估计器，绕过精确推理每步 O(|Y|^2) 的复杂度，在大词汇表序列标注任务上相对 Structured SVMs 实现了 23 倍加速。
Conclusion: 作者认为这是首个同时实现光滑性和线性 H-一致性的显式损失构造，兼具理论保证和实际加速优势；摘要强调该构造在三个设置中统一解决了光滑性与统计效率之间的张力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mind the Gap: Structure-Aware Consistency in Preference Learning
papers.abstract_en: Aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with human intent, whether through explicit reward modeling or direct methods such as DPO, fundamentally relies on minimizing a surrogate loss as a proxy for the true pairwise ranking objective. We prove that this reliance is flawed for the standard surrogate losses used: for the equicontinuous hypothesis sets characteristic of neural networks, no standard surrogate provides a meaningful consistency guarantee. Minimizing the surrogate loss to zero can leave the true ranking error arbitrarily high. To resolve this, we formulate LLM alignment within a margin-shifted ranking framework and derive $H$-consistency bounds showing that enforcing a confidence margin $γ$ is not merely beneficial but necessary for consistency. We further introduce Structure-Aware $H$-consistency and a corresponding objective (SA-DPO) that adapts the margin to the semantic distance between responses, preventing instability on near-synonymous pairs. Finally, we analyze the trade-off between the margin required for consistency and the model's finite capacity to satisfy it, revealing a strict hierarchy of surrogate losses: heavy-tailed surrogates (e.g., the Polynomial Hinge family) offer strictly superior consistency guarantees for capacity-bounded models compared to the logistic loss used in DPO. Experiments on UltraFeedback and Argilla DPO-Mix-7k confirm that SA-DPO consistently outperforms DPO and SimPO, with a 58.5% head-to-head win-rate in downstream generation quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 LLM 对齐中把替代损失 (surrogate loss) 最小化当作真实成对排序目标代理的做法，证明在神经网络等特征性的等连续假设集上，标准替代损失无法提供有意义的一致性保证，把替代损失降到零仍可能使真实排序误差任意高。作者由此提出 margin-shifted ranking 框架并推导 H-consistency bounds，引入结构感知一致性目标 SA-DPO，根据响应间语义距离自适应调整 margin。实验在 UltraFeedback 和 Argilla DPO-Mix-7k 上显示 SA-DPO 一致优于 DPO 和 SimPO，生成质量 head-to-head 胜率 58.5%。
Motivation: 偏好学习方法（如显式奖励建模或 DPO）依赖最小化替代损失来近似真实排序目标，但论文证明常用的标准替代损失在该设定下缺乏一致性保证，导致优化代理目标并不等于优化真实目标。
Method: 将 LLM 对齐形式化为 margin-shifted ranking 问题，推导 H-consistency bounds 以说明置信度 margin 对一致性的必要性；进一步提出 Structure-Aware H-consistency 及对应目标 SA-DPO，按响应间语义距离调整 margin 以避免近义样本对上的不稳定，并分析一致性所需 margin 与模型有限容量之间的权衡，比较 heavy-tailed 与 logistic 等替代损失的保证层级。
Result: 摘要报告 SA-DPO 在 UltraFeedback 和 Argilla DPO-Mix-7k 上始终优于 DPO 和 SimPO，下游生成质量 head-to-head 胜率 58.5%；理论部分还表明 heavy-tailed 替代损失（如 Polynomial Hinge 族）对容量受限模型的一致性保证严格优于 DPO 使用的 logistic loss。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 margin 不仅有益而且对一致性是必要的，结构感知 margin 可缓解近义词对引发的不稳定，并揭示替代损失之间存在严格的一致性层级；实证范围限于两个偏好数据集。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Optimized Deferral for Imbalanced Settings
papers.abstract_en: Learning algorithms can be significantly improved by routing complex or uncertain inputs to specialized experts, balancing accuracy with computational cost. This approach, known as learning to defer, is essential in domains like natural language generation, medical diagnosis, and computer vision, where an effective deferral can reduce errors at low extra resource consumption. However, the two-stage learning to defer setting, which leverages existing predictors such as a collection of LLMs or other classifiers, often faces challenges due to an expert imbalance problem. This imbalance can lead to suboptimal performance, with deferral algorithms favoring the majority expert. We present a comprehensive study of two-stage learning to defer in expert imbalance settings. We cast the deferral loss optimization as a novel cost-sensitive learning problem over the input-expert domain. We derive new margin-based loss functions and guarantees tailored to this setting, and develop novel algorithms for cost-sensitive learning. Leveraging these results, we design principled deferral algorithms, MILD (Margin-based Imbalanced Learning to Defer), specifically suited for expert imbalance settings. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, showing clear improvements over existing baselines on both image classification and real-world Large Language Model (LLM) routing tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究两阶段学习退避（learning to defer）中的专家不平衡（expert imbalance）问题，即当现有预测器集合（如多个 LLM 或分类器）被复用时，退避算法容易偏向多数专家而导致次优表现。作者将退避损失优化建模为输入-专家域上的代价敏感学习（cost-sensitive learning）问题，推导新的基于间隔（margin-based）的损失函数和理论保证，并提出专门面向该场景的算法 MILD（Margin-based Imbalanced Learning to Defer）。实验表明该方法在图像分类和真实 LLM 路由任务上均优于现有基线。
Motivation: 两阶段学习退避依赖已有的预测器集合，但专家不平衡会使退避算法过度选择多数专家，造成整体性能次优；现有工作缺少针对这一失衡设置的原则性解法。
Method: 将退避损失优化重新表述为输入-专家域上的代价敏感学习问题，据此推导新的间隔型损失函数与保证，并开发代价敏感学习算法，最终设计出 MILD 算法以适配专家不平衡场景。
Result: 摘要报告大量实验显示，MILD 在图像分类和真实世界大语言模型（LLM）路由任务上相比现有基线有清晰改进，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为针对专家不平衡定制的间隔式退避算法能有效提升两阶段学习退避的性能；摘要未提及明显局限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DORA Explorer: Improving the Exploration Ability of LLMs Without Training
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents for sequential decision-making struggle to produce diverse outputs. This leads to insufficient exploration, suboptimal solutions, and repeated actions. Actions are generated at the sequence level, but existing sampling strategies, such as temperature scaling, introduce diversity at the token level, not at the sequence level. We introduce DORA EXPLORER (Diversity-Oriented Ranking of Actions), a training-free, inference-time algorithm for improving exploration in LLM agents. DORA generates multiple candidate actions, scores them using sequence-level log-probability statistics, and samples an action via a tunable exploration parameter. We first study exploration in the classic Multi-Armed Bandit setting, where DORA substantially outperforms temperature-based sampling. Our main evaluation is on the Text Adventure Learning Environment Suite (TALES), where prompting strategies fail to explore but DORA delivers consistent gains across model families, e.g., 31.43% (ReAct) -> 45.5% (DORA) for Qwen-2.5 7B in TextWorld. Beyond exploration, DORA prevents common failures, such as getting stuck in loops. Our project is available at: https://dora-explore.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DORA EXPLORER（Diversity-Oriented Ranking of Actions），一种无需训练、仅在推理时运行的算法，用于提升 LLM 智能体在序列决策中的探索能力。DORA 生成多个候选动作，用序列级 log-probability 统计量评分，并通过可调探索参数采样。在经典 Multi-Armed Bandit 上大幅优于温度采样，在 Text Adventure Learning Environment Suite（TALES）上跨模型族一致提升，例如 Qwen-2.5 7B 在 TextWorld 中从 ReAct 的 31.43% 提升到 DORA 的 45.5%，并可避免陷入循环。
Motivation: LLM 智能体在序列决策中难以产生多样化输出，导致探索不足、次优解和重复动作。现有采样策略如 temperature scaling 是在 token 级引入多样性，而动作是在序列级生成的，两者不匹配。
Method: 提出训练无关的推理时算法 DORA：生成多个候选动作，使用序列级 log-probability 统计进行评分，再通过一个可调的探索参数采样一个动作。
Result: 在 Multi-Armed Bandit 设定中 DORA 大幅优于基于温度的采样；主要评估在 TALES 上进行，提示策略无法有效探索而 DORA 跨模型族带来一致提升，例如 Qwen-2.5 7B 在 TextWorld 中从 ReAct 的 31.43% 提升到 45.5%。除探索外，DORA 还能防止常见的陷入循环类失败。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 DORA 是无需训练、推理时的探索增强方法，通过序列级多样性改善 LLM 智能体的探索能力并缓解重复/循环失败，项目已开源。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Trust Region Constrained Bayesian Optimization with Penalized Constraint Handling
papers.abstract_en: Constrained optimization in high-dimensional black-box settings is difficult due to expensive evaluations, the lack of gradient information, and complex feasibility regions. In this work, we propose a Bayesian optimization method that combines a penalty formulation, a surrogate model, and a trust region strategy. The constrained problem is converted to an unconstrained form by penalizing constraint violations, which provides a unified modeling framework. A trust region restricts the search to a local region around the current best solution, which improves stability and efficiency in high dimensions. Within this region, we use the Expected Improvement acquisition function to select evaluation points by balancing improvement and uncertainty. The proposed Trust Region method integrates penalty-based constraint handling with local surrogate modeling. This combination enables efficient exploration of feasible regions while maintaining sample efficiency. We compare the proposed method with state-of-the-art methods on synthetic and real-world high-dimensional constrained optimization problems. The results show that the method identifies high-quality feasible solutions with fewer evaluations and maintains stable performance across different settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种高维黑箱约束优化下的贝叶斯优化方法，将罚函数形式的约束处理、代理模型 (surrogate model) 与置信域 (trust region) 策略结合。约束问题被转化为无约束形式，置信域将搜索限制在当前最优解附近，并使用 Expected Improvement 采集函数平衡改进与不确定性。在合成和真实高维约束优化问题上，该方法以更少的评估次数找到高质量可行解。
Motivation: 高维黑箱约束优化面临评估昂贵、缺乏梯度信息以及可行域复杂等困难，现有方法难以在样本效率与稳定性之间取得平衡。
Method: 通过惩罚约束违反将约束优化转为无约束形式，建立统一建模框架；采用置信域限制搜索范围以提升高维下的稳定性与效率，并在该区域内使用 Expected Improvement 采集函数选择评估点。
Result: 在合成与真实世界的高维约束优化问题上与现有最优方法比较，该方法能用更少的评估次数找到高质量可行解，并在不同设置下保持稳定性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为罚函数式约束处理与局部代理建模的组合能够高效探索可行域，同时保持样本效率，适合高维黑箱约束优化场景。

papers.title: Designing Agentic AI-Based Screening for Portfolio Investment
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a new agentic artificial intelligence (AI) platform for portfolio management. Our architecture consists of three layers. First, two large language model (LLM) agents are assigned specialized tasks: one agent screens for firms with desirable fundamentals, while a sentiment analysis agent screens for firms with desirable news. Second, these agents deliberate to generate and agree upon buy and sell signals from a large portfolio, substantially narrowing the pool of candidate assets. Finally, we apply a high-dimensional precision matrix estimation procedure to determine optimal portfolio weights. We show, through information acquisition theory, that screening with agentic AI can bring utility gains in screening compared with humans. We introduce the concept of \emph{sensible screening} and establish that, under mild screening errors, the squared Sharpe ratio of the screened portfolio consistently estimates its target. Empirically, our method achieves superior Sharpe ratios relative to an unscreened baseline portfolio and to conventional screening approaches, evaluated on S\&P~500 data over both short and medium terms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向投资组合管理的三层 agentic AI 平台：两个 LLM 代理分别负责基本面筛选和新闻情绪筛选，协商后生成买入/卖出信号以大幅缩小候选资产池，最后用高维精度矩阵估计（precision matrix estimation）确定最优组合权重。作者通过信息获取理论（information acquisition theory）论证 agentic AI 筛选能带来效用提升，并提出 "sensible screening" 概念，证明在温和筛选误差下筛选组合的平方 Sharpe 比率可一致估计其目标。实证基于 S&P 500 数据，在短期和中期区间上该方法相对未筛选基线和传统筛选方法取得更优的 Sharpe 比率。
Motivation: 投资组合管理面临候选资产数量庞大、基本面与新闻信息筛选成本高的问题，传统人工筛选或简单筛选方法可能效率不足。作者希望用 agentic AI 的多个 LLM 代理协同筛选，在缩小候选池的同时提升筛选效用并支持后续的最优权重估计。
Method: 构建三层架构：第一层为两个承担专项任务的 LLM 代理，一个筛选基本面优良的公司，另一个进行新闻情绪分析；第二层由这些代理协商而产生并达成一致的买入与卖出信号，显著收窄候选资产范围；第三层应用高维精度矩阵估计程序来确定最优组合权重。理论上借助信息获取理论说明 agentic AI 筛选相对人工筛选的效用增益，并定义 sensible screening 以保证估计一致性。
Result: 实证评估在 S&P 500 数据上进行，涵盖短期和中期区间；该方法比未筛选的基线组合和传统筛选方法获得更高的 Sharpe 比率。理论上，在温和筛选误差条件下，筛选后组合的平方 Sharpe 比率能够一致估计其目标值。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 agentic AI 分层筛选与高维精度矩阵估计相结合，可以在投资组合筛选中带来显著收益，理论结果保证了 sensible screening 下估计的一致性。

papers.title: LLM Router: Rethinking Routing with Prefill Activations
papers.abstract_en: Existing routers rely on semantic query features or handcrafted features, which often fail to capture model-specific failures or intrinsic task difficulty. We instead route using internal LLM activations, specifically the residual stream. Our key idea, Encoder-Target Decoupling, separates the model that produces the predictive signal (the Encoder) from the model whose correctness is being estimated (the Target), allowing open-weight encoders to predict the performance of closed-source target models. We evaluate layerwise geometric probes, finding that Fisher Separability ($J$) effectively identifies informative layers, supported by Effective Dimensionality ($d_{\mathrm{eff}}$) diagnostics. We then utilize a SharedTrunkNet, a joint multi-output MLP that predicts simultaneous correctness probabilities across candidate models using concatenated prefill features. In our experiments, SharedTrunkNet consistently outperforms semantic baselines. At its best, SharedTrunkNet closes 45.58% of the gap between the strongest standalone model and the oracle while achieving 74.31% cost savings relative to the most expensive model. These results demonstrate that prefill activations provide a robust routing signal, establishing activation-based routing as a high-performance alternative to purely semantic selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用 LLM 的内部 prefill 激活（残差流）而不是语义特征来做路由，核心思路是 Encoder-Target Decoupling，即将产生预测信号的 Encoder 与待评估正确性的 Target 模型分离，从而让开放权重模型预测闭源模型的表现。作者用 Fisher Separability 与 Effective Dimensionality 挑选信息量高的层，并提出 SharedTrunkNet 这一共享多输出 MLP，输入拼接的 prefill 特征同时预测多个候选模型的正确率。实验显示 SharedTrunkNet 一致优于语义基线，最好情况下弥合了最强单模型与 oracle 之间 45.58% 的差距，并相对最贵模型节省 74.31% 成本。
Motivation: 现有路由器依赖语义查询特征或手工特征，往往无法捕捉模型特定的失败模式或任务内在难度，因此需要一种能反映模型内部状态的更稳健路由信号。
Method: 利用残差流预填充激活作为路由特征，提出 Encoder-Target Decoupling 解耦编码器与目标模型；通过逐层几何探针，用 Fisher Separability 和 Effective Dimensionality 识别信息层；最后用 SharedTrunkNet（联合多输出 MLP）基于拼接的 prefill 特征同时预测多个候选模型的正确率。
Result: SharedTrunkNet 在实验中持续超越语义基线，最佳结果弥合了最强单模型与 oracle 之间 45.58% 的差距，并相对最贵模型实现 74.31% 的成本节省。
Conclusion: 作者认为 prefill 激活能提供稳健的路由信号，基于激活的路由可作为纯语义选择的更优替代方案。

papers.title: A Theoretical Framework for Modular Learning of Robust Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: Training large-scale generative models is resource-intensive and relies heavily on heuristic dataset weighting. We address two fundamental questions: Can we train Large Language Models (LLMs) modularly, combining small, domain-specific experts to match monolithic performance, and can we do so robustly for any data mixture, eliminating heuristic tuning? We present a theoretical framework for modular generative modeling where a set of pre-trained experts are combined via a gating mechanism. We define the space of normalized gating functions $\mathcal{G}_{1}$ and formulate the problem as a minimax game to find a single robust gate that minimizes divergence to the worst-case data mixture. We prove the existence of such a robust gate using Kakutani's fixed-point theorem and show that modularity acts as a strong regularizer, with generalization bounds scaling with the lightweight gate's complexity. Furthermore, we prove that this modular approach can theoretically outperform models retrained on aggregate data, with the gap characterized by the Jensen-Shannon Divergence. Finally, we introduce a scalable Stochastic Primal-Dual algorithm and a Structural Distillation method for efficient inference. Empirical results on synthetic and real-world datasets confirm that our modular architecture effectively mitigates gradient conflict and can robustly outperform monolithic baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个模块化生成建模的理论框架：将一组预训练专家通过门控机制（gating mechanism）组合，以匹配甚至超越单体训练（monolithic training）的大规模生成模型。作者把门控函数空间 G1 上的鲁棒门选择建模为 minimax 博弈，用 Kakutani 不动点定理证明鲁棒门的存在性，并证明模块性可作为强正则化器。摘要还给出可扩展的 Stochastic Primal-Dual 算法与用于高效推理的 Structural Distillation 方法，并在合成与真实数据集上验证模块化架构能缓解梯度冲突并稳健超越单体基线。
Motivation: 训练大规模生成模型资源消耗大且依赖启发式的数据集加权，作者希望回答两个基本问题：能否模块化地训练 LLM，将小型领域专家组合起来达到单体性能；以及能否对任意数据混合都做到鲁棒，从而省去启发式调参。
Method: 定义归一化门控函数空间 G1，将问题表述为最小化与最坏情况数据混合（worst-case data mixture）之间散度的 minimax 博弈，寻找单一鲁棒门控；利用 Kakutani 不动点定理证明该鲁棒门存在，并建立随轻量门控复杂度增长的泛化界。此外提出可扩展的 Stochastic Primal-Dual 算法和面向高效推理的 Structural Distillation 方法。
Result: 理论上证明模块性是一种强正则化器，且该模块化方法可以在理论上优于在聚合数据上重新训练的模型，性能差距由 Jensen-Shannon 散度刻画；实证结果（合成与真实数据集）显示模块化架构能有效缓解梯度冲突，并稳健地超过单体基线。
Conclusion: 作者从理论和经验两方面论证了模块化生成建模的鲁棒性优势：任意数据混合下存在鲁棒门控，且模块化组合可超越单体重训模型；摘要未讨论该方法在实际大规模部署中的具体局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Probably Approximately Correct Maximum A Posteriori Inference
papers.abstract_en: Computing the conditional mode of a distribution, better known as the maximum a posteriori (MAP) assignment, is a fundamental task in probabilistic inference. However, MAP is generally intractable, and remains hard even under many common structural constraints and approximation schemes. We take a novel approach inspired by multi-armed bandits, recasting MAP as a best arm identification task. We introduce probably approximately correct (PAC) algorithms for MAP that provide provably optimal solutions in both the fixed-confidence and fixed-budget regimes. We characterize tractability conditions using information theoretic measures that can be estimated from finite samples. Our PAC-MAP solvers are efficiently implemented using probabilistic circuits and graphical models with appropriate architectures. The algorithms we develop can be used either as standalone MAP estimators or to improve on standard heuristics, fortifying their solutions with rigorous guarantees. Experiments confirm the benefits of our method in a range of benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究概率推断中的最大后验（MAP）赋值问题，将其重新表述为多臂老虎机中的最优臂识别（best arm identification）任务，并提出在固定置信度（fixed-confidence）和固定预算（fixed-budget）两种体制下可证明最优的或许近似正确（PAC）算法。算法使用概率电路和图模型高效实现，既可独立作为 MAP 估计器，也可用于增强标准启发式方法。实验在一系列基准上验证了其收益。
Motivation: MAP 推断在一般情况下不可解，且在常见结构约束与近似方案下仍然困难，缺乏具有严格保证的高效求解途径。
Method: 受多臂老虎机启发，将 MAP 转化为最优臂识别问题，引入 PAC 算法；用可从有限样本估计的信息论度量刻画可处理性，并通过概率电路和图模型实现求解器。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值，仅报告实验在一系列基准上证实了所提方法相对标准方法的收益。
Conclusion: 所提算法可作为独立 MAP 估计器，或用于改进标准启发式方法并赋予其严格保证；可处理性由信息论度量表征，且这些度量可从有限样本估计。

papers.title: Commonsense on Demand: Generating and Selectively Integrating Commonsense Knowledge for Natural Language Inference
papers.abstract_en: Natural Language Inference (NLI) determines whether a premise entails, contradicts, or is neutral with respect to a hypothesis. The task is often framed as emulating human inference, in which commonsense knowledge plays a major role. This study examines whether Large Language Models (LLMs) can reliably generate factual commonsense axioms for NLI, and evaluates their utility on the SNLI and ANLI benchmarks using Llama-3.1-70B and gpt-oss-120b. Because commonsense axioms lack explicit textual references, standard factuality metrics are ill-suited to their evaluation. We therefore introduce a reference-free method using an LLM-as-Judge framework. The evaluation reveals a substantial gap between models: gpt-oss-120b generates predominantly accurate axioms, whereas Llama produces more incorrect than correct ones. We further evaluate three prompting pipelines: direct inference, inference augmented with generated commonsense axioms, and a hybrid approach that selectively incorporates highly factual axioms based on judged factuality. The hybrid approach yields consistent accuracy gains of 3.87%-8.5% across tested configurations. Targeted commonsense knowledge also helps models overcome a bias toward the Neutral class by providing essential real-world context.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）能否为自然语言推理（NLI）生成事实性的常识公理（commonsense axioms），并在 SNLI 和 ANLI 基准上使用 Llama-3.1-70B 与 gpt-oss-120b 评估其效用。由于常识公理缺少显式文本参照，标准事实性指标不适用，作者提出基于 LLM-as-Judge 的无参照评估框架。结果显示 gpt-oss-120b 生成的公理大部分准确，而 Llama 的错误公理多于正确公理；混合提示流程根据判定的事实性选择性整合公理，在测试配置上获得 3.87%-8.5% 的稳定准确率提升，并帮助模型克服对 Neutral 类别的偏见。
Motivation: NLI 常被理解为模拟人类推理，而常识知识在其中起重要作用；但常识公理缺乏显式文本引用，导致标准事实性评估方法不适用，需要无参照评估方式，且需要检验 LLM 能否可靠生成这样的公理。
Method: 提出一种使用 LLM-as-Judge 框架的无参照事实性评估方法，并比较三种提示流程：直接推理、用生成的常识公理增强推理、以及基于判定事实性选择性整合高事实性公理的混合方法。
Result: gpt-oss-120b 生成的公理以准确为主，Llama 则错误多于正确；混合方法在各配置上带来 3.87%-8.5% 的一致准确率提升，且针对性常识知识通过提供真实世界背景帮助模型克服对 Neutral 类别的偏见。
Conclusion: 选择性整合高事实性的生成常识公理能够稳定提升 NLI 准确率，LLM-as-Judge 可作为无参照环境下评估常识公理事实性的可行手段。

papers.title: DREAMS: Density Functional Theory Based Research Engine for Agentic Materials Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents can execute long-horizon scientific workflows, but their numerical outputs are difficult to trust: agents lose context, game verification checks, and can produce large volumes of plausible yet invalid results. We introduce the DFT-based Research Engine for Agentic Materials Simulation (DREAMS), a hierarchical multi-agent framework for density functional theory (DFT) built around a multi-tier safety guard. The guard applies deterministic checks wherever explicit criteria exist and scoped LLM judgment elsewhere, evaluating one parameter at a time and tracing every value to its registered source. Verification extends from tool-call time, where fabricated, laundered, or unsourced values are rejected before entering the workflow, to report time, where a judge audits the full provenance graph behind every claim; a shared canvas preserves information integrity across hundreds of steps. DREAMS achieves average errors below 1% on the Sol27LC lattice-constant benchmark, reproduces expert-level adsorption-energy differences on the CO/Pt(111) puzzle, and quantifies functional-driven uncertainty with Bayesian ensemble sampling, confirming the face-centered-cubic (FCC) site preference at the generalized gradient approximation (GGA) level. Compared with its unguarded counterpart, which reached a nearly correct answer while only 81% of its essential steps succeeded, the guarded system verifies every essential step at approximately 13 times the input tokens; verification layers can be disabled individually to balance trustworthiness against cost, and the tuned judge rules transfer across five judge models. DREAMS operates at an enhanced L2 (L2+) automation level and demonstrates capabilities approaching L3 automation, providing a path toward trustworthy, high-throughput autonomous materials simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DREAMS，一个面向密度泛函理论 (DFT) 的层级式多智能体框架，核心是一个多层安全守卫机制，用于保障长周期科学工作流中数值输出的可信度。框架在工具调用时拒绝伪造、清洗或无来源的值，并在报告阶段由法官审计每个论断背后的完整来源图 (provenance graph)。摘要报告其在 Sol27LC 晶格常数基准上平均误差低于 1%，复现 CO/Pt(111) 吸附能的专家级差异，并通过贝叶斯集成采样量化泛函驱动的误差。
Motivation: 大语言模型智能体能够执行长周期科学工作流，但其数值输出难以信任：智能体可能丢失上下文、钻验证规则的空子，并产生大量看似合理但无效的结果。
Method: DREAMS 构建了围绕多层级安全守卫的层级式多智能体 DFT 工作流；守卫在存在明确标准处使用确定性检查，在其他位置使用限定范围的 LLM 判断，逐参数评估并将每个值追溯到已登记来源。验证贯穿工具调用与报告生成两个阶段，共享画布 (shared canvas) 保持跨数百步骤的信息完整性，并用贝叶斯集成采样量化泛函相关不确定性。
Result: DREAMS 在 Sol27LC 晶格常数基准上达到平均误差低于 1%，复现 CO/Pt(111) 吸附能的专家级差异，并在广义梯度近似 (GGA) 水平确认面心立方 (FCC) 位点偏好。与其未加守卫的版本（关键步骤成功率仅 81%）相比，守卫系统以约 13 倍的输入 token 代价验证每个关键步骤；调优后的法官规则可迁移到五种法官模型，系统达到增强的 L2 (L2+) 自动化水平并接近 L3。
Conclusion: DREAMS 为可信、高通量的自主材料模拟提供了一条路径；各验证层可单独关闭以在可信度与成本之间取舍。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Small Data Explainer -- The impact of small data methods in everyday life
authors: the Collaborative Research Center 1597 Small Data
papers.abstract_en: The emergence of breakthrough artificial intelligence (AI) techniques has led to a renewed focus on how small data settings, i.e., settings with limited information, can benefit from such developments. This includes societal issues such as how best to include under-represented groups in data-driven policy and decision making, or the health benefits of assistive technologies. We provide a conceptual overview, clarify the relationship between small data and big data, and identify common themes from exemplary case studies and application areas. Potential solutions are described in a more detailed technical overview of current data analysis and modelling techniques, highlighting contributions from different disciplines, such as knowledge-driven modelling from statistics and data-driven modelling from computer science. By linking application settings, conceptual contributions and specific techniques, we highlight what is already feasible and suggest what an agenda for fully leveraging small data might look like.
papers.comment: Written in collaboration with the Royal Society, contributing to the Disability Technology report (https://royalsociety.org/news-resources/projects/disability-data-assistive-technology/)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文是一篇概念性综述，讨论小数据（small data）情境如何从突破性 AI 技术中获益，澄清小数据与大数据的区别，并从案例研究和应用领域中提炼共同主题。摘要还概述了当前数据分析与建模技术，涵盖统计学中的知识驱动建模和计算机科学中的数据驱动建模等学科视角。该工作与英国皇家学会的残疾技术报告合作撰写，聚焦社会与健康应用。
Motivation: 突破性 AI 技术使信息有限的小数据情境重新受到关注，涉及如何将代表性不足的群体纳入数据驱动的政策与决策、以及辅助技术带来的健康收益等社会问题，但缺乏连接应用、概念与具体技术的框架。
Method: 提供概念性概述，明确小数据与大数据的边界，从多个案例研究和应用领域总结共同主题；再以更详细的技术综述介绍当前数据分析与建模方法，涵盖统计学知识驱动建模与计算机科学数据驱动建模等学科贡献。
Result: 摘要未报告量化实验结果，而是通过连接应用场景、概念贡献与具体技术，展示目前已可行的小数据方案，并勾勒出充分利用小数据的未来议程。
Conclusion: 论文的要点在于指出小数据方法在现有条件下已能实现的内容，并提出一个充分利用小数据的议程；文章性质为概念综述，且与皇家学会残疾技术报告相关。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: Deep Fictitious Play-Based Potential Differential Games for Learning Human-Like Interaction at Unsignalized Intersections
papers.abstract_en: Modeling vehicle interactions at unsignalized intersections is a challenging task due to the complexity of the underlying game-theoretic processes. Although prior studies have attempted to capture interactive driving behaviors, most approaches relied solely on game-theoretic formulations and did not leverage naturalistic driving datasets. In this study, we learn human-like interactive driving policies at unsignalized intersections using Deep Fictitious Play. Specifically, we first model vehicle interactions as a Differential Game, which is then reformulated as a Potential Differential Game. The weights in the cost function are learned from the dataset and capture diverse driving styles. We also demonstrate that our framework provides a theoretical guarantee of convergence to a Nash equilibrium. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to train interactive driving policies using Deep Fictitious Play. We validate the effectiveness of our Deep Fictitious Play-Based Potential Differential Game (DFP-PDG) framework using the INTERACTION dataset. The results demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves satisfactory performance in learning human-like driving policies. The learned individual weights effectively capture variations in driver aggressiveness and preferences. Furthermore, the ablation study highlights the importance of each component within our model. Code is available at https://github.com/zeonchen/DFP-PDG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于 Deep Fictitious Play 的势微分博弈框架（DFP-PDG），用于学习无信号交叉口的类人交互驾驶策略。作者将车辆交互建模为微分博弈并重构为势微分博弈，从自然驾驶数据中学习代价函数权重，并证明框架收敛到纳什均衡。在 INTERACTION 数据集上的实验显示，该框架能学习到类人驾驶策略，所学权重可捕捉驾驶员攻击性与偏好的差异。
Motivation: 无信号交叉口的车辆交互建模因潜在博弈过程复杂而具有挑战性。以往研究大多只采用博弈论公式，未利用自然驾驶数据集来指导交互策略学习。
Method: 先将车辆交互建模为微分博弈（Differential Game），再将其重构为势微分博弈（Potential Differential Game）；利用 Deep Fictitious Play 从数据集中学习代价函数权重，以捕捉多样化的驾驶风格，并提供收敛到纳什均衡的理论保证。
Result: 在 INTERACTION 数据集上的验证表明，所提框架在类人驾驶策略学习上表现令人满意；学习到的个体权重能有效反映驾驶员攻击性和偏好差异，消融研究也说明了各模型组成的重要性。
Conclusion: 作者强调这是首个使用 Deep Fictitious Play 训练交互驾驶策略的研究，并指出框架具备收敛到纳什均衡的理论保证，代码已公开。

papers.title: Improving Performance of Spike-based Deep Q-Learning using Ternary Neurons
papers.abstract_en: We propose a new ternary spiking neuron model to improve the representation capacity of binary spiking neurons in deep Q-learning. Although a ternary neuron model has recently been introduced to overcome the limited representation capacity offered by binary spiking neurons, we show that its performance is worse than that of binary models in deep Q-learning tasks, contradicting previous findings from recent studies. Through mathematical and empirical analysis, we hypothesize that gradient estimation bias during training is the underlying cause. The proposed ternary spiking neuron model mitigates this issue by reducing the estimation bias. We use the proposed ternary spiking neuron as the fundamental computing unit in a deep spiking Q-learning network, which we call the deep asymmetric ternary spiking Q-network (DATSQN), and evaluate the network's performance in seven Atari games from the Gym environment. The results show that the proposed ternary spiking neuron mitigates the performance degradation of ternary neurons in DQN tasks and improves the mean game score relative to the binary baseline under the evaluation settings used in this paper.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对深度 Q-learning 中二元脉冲神经元表示能力有限的问题，提出一种新的三元脉冲神经元模型，并构建了基于该神经元的深度脉冲 Q 网络 DATSQN。作者发现已有三元神经元模型在深度 Q-learning 任务上反而比二元模型差，并将其归因于训练中的梯度估计偏差；所提出的模型通过降低该偏差改善了性能。在 Gym 环境的七个 Atari 游戏上，该方法缓解了三元神经元在 DQN 任务中的性能退化，并相对二元基线提高了平均游戏得分。
Motivation: 二元脉冲神经元的表示能力有限，而近期提出的三元神经元模型在深度 Q-learning 任务中表现反而更差，与先前研究结论相矛盾；作者试图找出原因并加以改进。
Method: 通过数学与经验分析提出梯度估计偏差是三元神经元性能下降的根源，并据此设计一种新的三元脉冲神经元模型来减小估计偏差，将其作为深度脉冲 Q 网络 DATSQN 的基本计算单元。
Result: 摘要报告在 Gym 环境的七个 Atari 游戏中，所提出的三元脉冲神经元缓解了三元神经元在 DQN 任务中的性能退化，并在本文评估设置下相对二元基线提升了平均游戏得分。
Conclusion: 作者将性能改进归因于梯度估计偏差的降低，并指出结果是基于论文中使用的评估设置得出的。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 通过数学与经验分析提出梯度估计偏差是三元神经元性能下降的根源，并据此设计一种新的三元脉冲神经元模型来减小估计偏差，将其作为深度脉冲 Q 网络 DATSQN 的基本计算单元。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告在 Gym 环境的七个 Atari 游戏中，所提出的三元脉冲神经元缓解了三元神经元在 DQN 任务中的性能退化，并在本文评估设置下相对二元基线提升了平均游戏得分。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者将性能改进归因于梯度估计偏差的降低，并指出结果是基于论文中使用的评估设置得出的。

papers.title: Computational Algebra with Attention: Transformer Oracles for Border Basis Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Solving systems of polynomial equations, particularly those with finitely many solutions, is a crucial challenge across many scientific fields. Traditional methods like Gröbner and Border bases are fundamental but suffer from high computational costs, which have motivated recent Deep Learning approaches to improve efficiency, albeit at the expense of output correctness. In this work, we introduce the Oracle Border Basis Algorithm, the first Deep Learning approach that accelerates Border basis computation while maintaining output guarantees. To this end, we design and train a Transformer-based oracle that identifies and eliminates computationally expensive reduction steps, which we find to dominate the algorithm's runtime. By selectively invoking this oracle during critical phases of computation, we achieve substantial speedup factors of up to 3.5x compared to the base algorithm, without compromising the correctness of results. To generate the training data, we develop a sampling method and provide the first sampling theorem for border bases. We construct a tokenization and embedding scheme tailored to monomial-centered algebraic computations, resulting in a compact and expressive input representation, which reduces the number of tokens to encode an $n$-variate polynomial by a factor of $O(n)$. Our learning approach is data efficient, stable, and a practical enhancement to traditional computer algebra algorithms and symbolic computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Oracle Border Basis Algorithm，号称是首个在保持输出正确性保证的前提下加速 Border basis 计算的深度学习方法。作者训练一个基于 Transformer 的 oracle 来识别并消除算法中耗时主导的归约步骤，并在关键计算阶段选择性调用，相对基础算法获得最高 3.5 倍加速。此外还给出了首个 border bases 采样定理，以及面向单项式中心代数计算的 tokenization 与 embedding 方案，可将 n 元多项式编码所需的 token 数减少 O(n)。
Motivation: 求解多项式方程组（尤其是有有限解的情形）广泛存在于多个科学领域，但 Gröbner 基和 Border 基等传统方法计算成本很高；已有的深度学习方法能提升效率却牺牲输出正确性。本文的目标是在加速计算的同时保留结果正确性保证。
Method: 设计并训练一个 Transformer oracle，识别并消除计算中代价高昂的归约步骤；算法仅在关键阶段选择性调用该 oracle。为生成训练数据，提出一种采样方法并给出第一个 border bases 采样定理；同时构造以单项式为中心的 tokenization 与 embedding 表示，使 n 元多项式编码 token 数减少 O(n)。
Result: 摘要报告相对基础算法最高获得 3.5 倍加速，且不损害结果正确性；学习方案据称数据高效、稳定。
Conclusion: 该方法被定位为对传统计算机代数算法和符号计算的一种实用增强，是首个在加速 Border basis 计算的同时维持输出保证的深度学习方法。摘要未提及明显局限。
