papers.title: Decodable but Not Accessible: Auditing Distance-Based Reliability Estimation on Disentangled Skin-Lesion Representations
papers.abstract_en: Distance-based reliability estimation assumes that a representation's geometry reflects its trustworthiness, yet this assumption is rarely tested under training interventions that reshape geometry directly. We audit this assumption under domain-adversarial representation learning using a disentanglement dose-response ladder. Three checkpoint families share the same architecture and a 16-dimensional representation, differing only in orthogonality strength (lambda = 0, 1, 5). Representation geometry changed substantially with disentanglement strength: the condition number shifted by two orders of magnitude (Kendall tau = 0.84, exact p = 2.8e-5). This change was not accompanied by improved reliability estimation: Mahalanobis-distance AUROC (ISIC-test vs. PAD-UFES) remained flat and below chance (about 0.40) at every level, with no significant association with any of five geometry metrics tested. The same failure was observed for cosine-to-centroid and pooled k-nearest-neighbor scorers, plus three non-distance-based scorers: an energy-based confidence score, Virtual-Logit Matching, and a kernel density estimator. Seven of eight scorers converged on the same result; the energy-based score showed an isolated upward trend that we report but do not treat as evidence against the overall pattern. A supervised probe with no access to the training objective recovered domain membership from the identical embeddings at 0.72-0.81 AUROC across every level, showing that the relevant information was not absent from the representation. These findings indicate that classification performance alone can overlook whether information in a learned representation is organized in a form that downstream reliability estimators can use. Information can remain decodable while becoming largely inaccessible to non-probing reliability estimators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文审计了基于距离的可靠性估计在域对抗表征学习下的有效性，使用解纠缠剂量-反应阶梯（disentanglement dose-response ladder）对皮肤病变表征进行干预。作者发现更强的解纠缠显著改变了表示几何（条件数变化两个数量级），但 Mahalanobis 距离、cosine-to-centroid 和 k-NN 等基于距离的评分器以及多种非距离评分器在跨数据集 OOD 检测（ISIC-test vs. PAD-UFES）上的 AUROC 始终徘徊在约 0.40 的低于随机水平。而有监督探针能从相同嵌入中以 0.72–0.81 AUROC 恢复域成员信息，说明信息可解码但下游可靠性估计器难以访问。
Motivation: 距离基可靠性估计假设表示几何反映可信度，但这一假设很少在直接重塑几何的训练干预（如域对抗学习和解纠缠强度变化）下被检验；分类性能可能掩盖表示中信息对下游估计器是否可用的问题。
Method: 作者在固定架构和 16 维表示上，通过改变正交性强度（lambda = 0, 1, 5）构建三个检查点系列，并系统比较多种评分器：Mahalanobis 距离、cosine-to-centroid、池化 k-NN、基于能量的置信度、Virtual-Logit Matching 和核密度估计器，同时用有监督探针检测域信息的可解码性。
Result: 表示几何随解纠缠强度显著改变（条件数跨两个数量级，Kendall tau = 0.84，p = 2.8e-5），但所有基于距离的评分器 AUROC 保持平坦且低于随机（约 0.40），与五个几何指标无显著关联；八个评分器中有七个收敛到同一失败结论，仅能量基评分器出现孤立的上升趋势。有监督探针从相同嵌入恢复域成员的 AUROC 为 0.72–0.81。
Conclusion: 研究发现分类性能无法反映表示中信息是否以适合下游可靠性估计器使用的形式组织；信息可以保持可解码，但对非探针式可靠性估计器变得基本不可访问，提示需要直接审计可靠性估计器所依赖的表示几何。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: GeoUniPR: A Geometry-Consistent Unified Framework for Cross-Modal Place Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Cross-modal place recognition (CMPR) aims to identify the same location across heterogeneous sensing modalities, such as vision and LiDAR. Existing methods commonly bridge the modality gap using complex alignment modules, multi-stage training, or full fine-tuning of pretrained backbones. In this work, we revisit CMPR from the perspective of geometric consistency and propose GeoUniPR, a unified and concise geometry-consistent framework. GeoUniPR reduces cross-modal discrepancy at the representation level by projecting LiDAR point clouds into the camera perspective to construct Geometry-Consistent depth image views (DIV), which establish direct RGB-LiDAR correspondence. We further augment DIV with native LiDAR cues, including intensity and surface-normal information, yielding a multi-channel geometric representation that improves structural consistency. Based on this representation, GeoUniPR learns a unified embedding space using two modality-specific ViT-based encoders with identical architectures, trained through parameter-efficient adaptation without auxiliary alignment modules, multi-stage training, or full backbone fine-tuning. In addition, we introduce Spatially-Consistent InfoNCE (SC-InfoNCE), a CMPR-specific contrastive objective that suppresses distance-induced false negatives under spatial continuity. Extensive experiments on KITTI and KITTI-360 demonstrate that GeoUniPR achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in both same-modal and cross-modal place recognition, with strong cross-dataset generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GeoUniPR，一个统一且简洁的几何一致性框架，用于跨模态位置识别（CMPR）。其核心做法是将 LiDAR 点云投影到相机视角以构造 Geometry-Consistent 深度图像视图（DIV），并融入 LiDAR 强度与表面法线信息形成多通道几何表示，再通过两个同构 ViT 编码器以参数高效方式学习统一嵌入空间。此外引入 CMPR 专用的 Spatially-Consistent InfoNCE (SC-InfoNCE) 对比目标以抑制距离导致的假负样本；在 KITTI 和 KITTI-360 上取得同模态与跨模态位置识别的 SOTA 性能，并展示强跨数据集泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有跨模态位置识别方法通常依赖复杂对齐模块、多阶段训练或对预训练骨干的全量微调，且未显式利用几何一致性。作者认为从几何一致性视角可以更直接地缩小视觉与 LiDAR 的模态差异。
Method: 将 LiDAR 点云投影到相机视角构建 Geometry-Consistent 深度图像视图（DIV），再补充强度与表面法线等原生 LiDAR 线索，形成多通道几何表示；使用两个结构相同的 ViT 编码器学习统一嵌入空间，采用参数高效适配训练，无需辅助对齐模块、多阶段训练或全骨干微调；并设计 Spatially-Consistent InfoNCE (SC-InfoNCE) 损失来处理空间连续性下的距离诱导假负样本。
Result: 在 KITTI 与 KITTI-360 基准上，GeoUniPR 在同模态和跨模态位置识别任务中均达到 SOTA 性能，并展现出较强的跨数据集泛化能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为几何一致性表示配合 CMPR 特定的对比目标，可以在简化训练流程（避免对齐模块、多阶段训练与全量微调）的同时取得领先性能；摘要未报告除 KITTI/KITTI-360 之外的实验范围。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Temperature-Driven Sequential Modeling for the Prediction of Annual Power Conversion Efficiency Profiles of Organic Photovoltaic Materials: Douala Case Study
papers.abstract_en: Organic photovoltaic (OPV) materials are promising candidates for distributed solar energy in tropical regions, yet existing virtual screening tools report static power conversion efficiency (PCE) values at standard testing conditions (STC) that fail to capture the temperature-driven performance degradation experienced under real deployment conditions. Here we introduce a Climate-Native computational framework that forecasts the annual PCE profile of OPV donor molecules under geographically realistic operating conditions. The framework combines GFN2-xTB molecular dynamics with an equivariant graph neural network surrogate ($268$ Neyman-stratified CEP molecules; $120,600$ training geometries; $\sim 1050\times$ speedup over explicit quantum chemistry) and sequential deep learning models trained on annual time series anchored in NASA POWER climate data for Douala, Cameroon, and validated by zero-shot transfer to Yaoundé and Maroua. Applied to $\sim 30,000$ molecules from the Harvard Clean Energy Project (CEP) and validated against $350$ HOPV15 experimental device measurements, the framework demonstrates that sequential models trained on full molecular dynamics trajectories outperform time-averaged baselines ($35\%$-$48\%$ relative MAE improvement over static baselines), confirming that thermal conformational dynamics carry information beyond mean geometry. We further introduce a seasonal stability score that reranks OPV candidates by performance consistency under tropical conditions, identifying molecules whose deployment suitability differs substantially from their static PCE ranking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个 "Climate-Native" 计算框架，用于预测有机光伏 (OPV) 供体分子在热带真实部署条件下的年度功率转换效率 (PCE) 曲线。框架结合 GFN2-xTB 分子动力学、等变图神经网络代理（约 1050 倍加速）以及以 NASA POWER 气候数据为锚的时序深度学习模型，以喀麦隆杜阿拉为案例，并零样本迁移到雅温得和马鲁阿。摘要报告在约 30,000 个哈佛 CEP 分子上验证、并以 350 个 HOPV15 实验测量对照，显示基于完整分子动力学轨迹的时序模型比时间平均基线相对 MAE 改进 35%-48%。
Motivation: 现有 OPV 虚拟筛选工具只在标准测试条件 (STC) 下报告静态 PCE，无法反映热带地区真实部署中温度驱动的性能衰减，导致筛选结果与实际环境适用性不匹配。
Method: 提出 Climate-Native 框架：用 GFN2-xTB 分子动力学生成构象，训练等变图神经网络代理（268 个 Neyman 分层 CEP 分子，120,600 个训练几何构型），再使用时序深度学习模型学习以 NASA POWER 气候数据为锚的年度 PCE 时间序列；并用 350 个 HOPV15 实验设备测量进行验证。
Result: 摘要报告时序模型相对静态基线的 MAE 改进 35%-48%；代理相对显式量子化学计算约 1050 倍加速；并引入季节性稳定性评分，在热带条件下重排 OPV 候选，识别出部署适用性与静态 PCE 排名差异明显的分子。
Conclusion: 摘要强调热构象动力学 (thermal conformational dynamics) 携带超越平均几何的信息，说明在热带气候下基于温度驱动的动态 PCE 曲线比静态 PCE 排名更能反映实际部署适用性。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有 OPV 虚拟筛选工具只在标准测试条件 (STC) 下报告静态 PCE，无法反映热带地区真实部署中温度驱动的性能衰减，导致筛选结果与实际环境适用性不匹配。
summary_sections.method: 提出 Climate-Native 框架：用 GFN2-xTB 分子动力学生成构象，训练等变图神经网络代理（268 个 Neyman 分层 CEP 分子，120,600 个训练几何构型），再使用时序深度学习模型学习以 NASA POWER 气候数据为锚的年度 PCE 时间序列；并用 350 个 HOPV15 实验设备测量进行验证。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告时序模型相对静态基线的 MAE 改进 35%-48%；代理相对显式量子化学计算约 1050 倍加速；并引入季节性稳定性评分，在热带条件下重排 OPV 候选，识别出部署适用性与静态 PCE 排名差异明显的分子。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调热构象动力学 (thermal conformational dynamics) 携带超越平均几何的信息，说明在热带气候下基于温度驱动的动态 PCE 曲线比静态 PCE 排名更能反映实际部署适用性。

papers.title: Reproducing and Stress-Testing Two Approaches to LLM Reasoning Reliability: Test-Time Probability Aggregation and Logic-Representation Editing
papers.abstract_en: We independently reproduce two recent methods for making large language model (LLM) reasoning more reliable, and stress-test them across domains and models (RPC across four new task domains with Qwen3-8B, LCF across four 7-8B models). The first, RPC, aggregates token probabilities and self-consistency at inference; the second, LCF, trains projectors that split hidden states into "content" and "logic" and edits the logic part toward a valid region. Validating such reliability claims matters because the original evaluations are run by each method's own authors and were never independently reproduced or stress-tested across models and domains, and LCF shipped no public code. We re-run RPC's published-path aggregation and re-implement LCF's projector, contrastive, and intervention pipeline, then extend both to text-to-SQL, legal extraction, fallacy identification, and precedent grading, and probe LCF's representation directly. RPC reproduces the original grid exactly on the authors' released reasoning paths; on four new domains its edge over self-consistency is never significant (ties or small mixed differences, paired p >= 0.28), and on BIRD, the one domain where we vary the budget, the edge grows with K as predicted but its largest gap (+2.5 accuracy at K=32, p=0.16) reverses to -0.25 when we enlarge the sample to n=200. LCF's logic-validity direction is real but weak (0.82 separability at the single best sub-layer versus 0.95 for a semantic-attribute control); its one positive effect (Qwen3 $Δ$Prob) is not significant (p=0.56), while it significantly reduces $Δ$Prob on two of the other three models.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables. Code, data, and experiment logs: https://github.com/rabqatab/llm-reasoning-reliability-reproduction
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文独立复现并压力测试两种提升LLM推理可靠性的方法：RPC（推理时聚合token概率与自一致性）和LCF（训练投影器将隐藏状态拆分为“内容”与“逻辑”，并编辑逻辑部分至有效区域）。作者在四个新任务域（text-to-SQL、法律抽取、谬误识别、先例分级）和多种7-8B模型上测试，发现RPC在自一致性之上没有显著优势，LCF的逻辑有效性方向真实但较弱，且在某些模型上有副作用。
Motivation: 原始评估均由方法作者自行完成，从未被独立复现，也未经跨模型、跨领域压力测试；此外LCF没有公开代码，因此其可靠性声明需要外部验证。
Method: 重跑RPC的已发布路径聚合流程，重新实现LCF的投影器、对比与干预管线，并将两者扩展到四个新任务领域；同时直接探测LCF的表示（representation）。
Result: RPC在作者发布的推理路径上精确复现原始网格结果；在四个新领域上与自一致性相比均无显著差异（配对p >= 0.28）。在BIRD上，随K增大的增益被复现，但最大差距（K=32时+2.5准确率，p=0.16）在样本扩大到n=200时反转为-0.25。LCF的逻辑有效性方向真实但弱（最佳子层分离度0.82，语义属性控制为0.95）；其唯一正面效果（Qwen3的ΔProb）不显著（p=0.56），并在其余三个模型中的两个上显著降低ΔProb。
Conclusion: 独立复现和压力测试表明，两种方法在跨领域和跨模型条件下的收益有限或不稳定，尤其LCF在部分模型上存在显著的负面影响，可靠性声明需要谨慎解读。

papers.title: Glance, Scrutinize, and Think: Advancing Video Anomaly Detection from Training-Free to Agentic Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) aims to identify anomalous events and localize their temporal intervals. Existing approaches exhibit a "when-what" dissociation: traditional DNN-based methods localize when anomalies occur but lack semantic understanding, whereas LLM-based methods explain what happens but neglect precise temporal grounding. We attribute this to the absence of a unified reasoning paradigm. Inspired by how humans inspect surveillance videos - glancing globally to form temporal hypotheses, scrutinizing suspicious segments, and thinking iteratively to correct errors - we study this global-to-local paradigm from two perspectives. We first propose Glance then Scrutinize (GtS), a training-free framework using static and dynamic textual guidance for coarse-to-fine anomaly grounding and understanding, balancing accuracy and speed. To break the ceiling imposed by frozen external modules, we further propose a tool-augmented agentic VAD method, where a multimodal large language model learns to invoke a video cropping tool, inspect densely resampled frames, and self-correct mislocalized hypotheses, via cold-start supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning with a joint answer-grounding reward. For training and evaluation, we extend our prior VAGU benchmark into VAGU-T (Video Anomaly Grounding, Understanding, and Thinking), comprising 7,567 real-world videos over 21 anomaly categories with human-validated grounding, explanations, QA pairs, and chain-of-thought tool-calling traces. We further introduce JeAUG, a metric jointly evaluating semantic interpretability and temporal precision. Experiments show that GtS substantially surpasses training-free baselines, while the agentic model delivers both higher accuracy and faster inference.
papers.comment: 34 pages, 8 figures, 8 tables. Journal extension of our AAAI 2026 paper (arXiv:2507.21507)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视频异常检测（VAD）中传统方法只定位何时发生、LLM 方法只解释发生了什么这一"when-what"割裂，提出从全局到局部的统一推理范式。作者先提出无训练框架 Glance then Scrutinize (GtS)，用静态与动态文本引导做粗到细的异常定位与理解；再提出工具增强的 agentic VAD 方法，让多模态大语言模型学会调用视频裁剪工具、检查密集重采样帧并自我纠正定位，采用冷启动监督微调加联合答案-定位奖励的强化学习。论文将 VAGU 基准扩展为 VAGU-T（7,567 个真实视频、21 类异常），并提出联合评估语义可解释性与时间精度的 JeAUG 指标；实验显示 GtS 大幅超过无训练基线，agentic 模型同时取得更高准确率和更快推理。
Motivation: 现有 VAD 方法存在"when-what"分离：传统 DNN 方法能定位异常发生的时间但缺乏语义理解，LLM 方法能解释发生了什么但忽略精确时间定位，作者将此归因于缺少统一的推理范式。
Method: 提出两条技术路径：一是无训练框架 GtS，利用静态和动态文本引导进行粗到细的异常定位与理解；二是工具增强的 agentic VAD，让多模态大语言模型学习调用视频裁剪工具、检查密集重采样帧并自我纠正错误定位，通过冷启动监督微调与带联合 answer-grounding 奖励的强化学习训练。
Result: 摘要报告 GtS 显著超过无训练基线，agentic 模型在更高准确率的同时推理更快；并构建了含 7,567 个真实视频、21 类异常的 VAGU-T 基准，包含人工验证的 grounding、解释、QA 对和思维链工具调用轨迹，以及联合评估语义可解释性和时间精度的 JeAUG 指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为模仿人类"全局浏览、细查可疑片段、迭代思考"的 global-to-local 范式可以弥合 VAD 中定位与理解的割裂，并通过新基准与联合指标支持该方向；摘要未提及明确的局限。

papers.title: Methodologies for Improving the Quality of AI Tutoring in K-12 Education
papers.abstract_en: Many AI tutors leverage large language models (LLMs) today. Given that LLMs are opaque black boxes, robust evaluation and live experimentation to measure the impact of every change are essential. We pioneered AI-powered tutoring for K-12 with the launch of Khanmigo (Khan Academy, 2023). We describe the metrics we use to measure AI tutoring quality and student engagement as well as various experiments we have run. We highlight the changes that have moved our metrics, including models, prompting, personalization and agents.
papers.comment: 15 pages. Accepted at AIED 2026 (27th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education). Published version: Artificial Intelligence in Education, LNCS vol. 16582, Springer, Cham, first online 25 June 2026 (cite as 2027)
papers.journal_ref: In: Blanchard, E.G., Chen, G., Chi, M., Isotani, S. (eds) Artificial Intelligence in Education. AIED 2026. Lecture Notes in Computer Science, vol 16582. Springer, Cham (2027)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文由可汗学院作者撰写，介绍 Khanmigo 等 K-12 AI 辅导系统中用于评估 AI 教学质量和学生参与度的指标体系，以及团队开展的一系列在线实验。由于 LLM 是黑盒，作者强调对每次改动进行稳健评估与实时实验的必要性，并总结了在模型、提示词 (prompting)、个性化 (personalization) 与智能体 (agents) 层面的调整中哪些改动带动了指标变化。
Motivation: 当前许多 AI 辅导系统基于不透明的 LLM，难以预先判断任何改动对教学效果的影响，因此需要建立可靠的评估指标和实时实验机制来衡量每次变更的实际效果。
Method: 作者描述了测量 AI 辅导质量与学生参与度的指标，并汇报了在生产环境（Khanmigo）中运行的多项实验，覆盖模型选择、提示词工程、个性化策略和智能体设计等改进杠杆。
Result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，仅定性报告了所采用的指标和实验，并指出模型、提示词、个性化与智能体方面的改动对指标产生了可观测的影响。
Conclusion: 作者强调，对于基于 LLM 的 K-12 AI 辅导系统，持续进行稳健评估与实时实验是质量保障的关键，且指标提升来自多个层面的系统化调整。

papers.title: Adaptive Hybrid Particle Swarm Optimization with Gradient Descent
papers.abstract_en: Gradient injection helps Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) only when the swarm has identified a basin with smooth local structure, not universally. We propose Adaptive Hybrid PSO (AHPSO), which uses a sigmoid function on swarm diversity to automatically modulate gradient influence: near-zero during exploration, near-maximum during exploitation, with no manual phase-switching. Under budget-normalized comparison (PSO given equivalent total function evaluations), PSO wins 52.5% of 40 configurations versus AHPSO's 20% (p = 7.0e-5, Friedman). AHPSO retains advantage specifically on problems with smooth local basins (F8, F24-F27) where directed descent outperforms undirected sampling even at equal cost. Under iteration-matched comparison across 29 functions (42 configurations, 14,700 runs), AHPSO-Adadelta ranks first of 9 methods including CMA-ES (p = 9.75e-4). The contribution is a principled characterization of when gradient injection provides value in swarm-based search, not a claim of universal superiority.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 8 figures, 8 tables, 25 references. 14,700+ independent optimization runs
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自适应混合粒子群优化 (Adaptive Hybrid PSO, AHPSO)，用群多样性 (swarm diversity) 的 sigmoid 函数自动调节梯度影响，避免手动切换探索与利用阶段。在预算归一化比较中，标准 PSO 在 40 个配置上胜率 52.5%，高于 AHPSO 的 20%；在迭代匹配比较中，AHPSO-Adadelta 在 9 个方法（含 CMA-ES）中排第一。作者强调贡献在于刻画梯度注入在群搜索中何时有效，而非宣称普遍优越。
Motivation: 梯度注入只在群已找到具有平滑局部结构的盆地时对 PSO 有帮助，而并非普遍有效；现有方法缺乏对梯度影响的自适应调节机制，需要人工切换相位。
Method: 提出 AHPSO，通过群多样性的 sigmoid 函数自动调制梯度影响：探索阶段接近零、利用阶段接近最大，无需手动相位切换，并与 Adadelta 等梯度下降变体结合。
Result: 在预算归一化比较中，PSO 胜率 52.5%（40 个配置，Friedman p=7.0e-5）；在迭代匹配比较中，29 个函数、42 个配置、14,700 次运行的条件下，AHPSO-Adadelta 在 9 个方法中排名第一（p=9.75e-4）；优势集中在平滑局部盆地问题 (F8, F24-F27)。
Conclusion: 论文的贡献是对梯度注入在群搜索中何时提供价值的原理性刻画，并明确表示不宣称方法的普遍优越性；在非平滑或崎岖问题上，AHPSO 并不优于同等预算的 PSO。

summary_sections.result: 在预算归一化比较中，PSO 胜率 52.5%（40 个配置，Friedman p=7.0e-5）；在迭代匹配比较中，29 个函数、42 个配置、14,700 次运行的条件下，AHPSO-Adadelta 在 9 个方法中排名第一（p=9.75e-4）；优势集中在平滑局部盆地问题 (F8, F24-F27)。

papers.title: Why AI Detection Fails for Academic Integrity
papers.abstract_en: Institutions use commercial AI detectors for academic integrity, yet detectors cannot distinguish AI editing from full LLM drafts and may treat both as misconduct. In a controlled study of published English abstracts (four domains; 2013 to 2015 vs. 2023 to 2025), we quantify this policy failure under proxy human/AI labels at tau=0.50. Light "refine abstract only" edits, a proxy for guideline-compliant AI assistance, are flagged at 64 to 80% (Pangram/GPTZero). Unmodified 2023 to 2025 originals are flagged at 9 to 15%, with non-STEM rates far above STEM (p<0.001); elevated scores track long-token and Academic Word List density, not authorship intent alone. After Undetectable AI humanization, evasion is near-total: fewer than 4% of AI-labeled rewrites remain flagged (post-humanization detection rate <4%; FNR >96%). Honest AI-editing results in a higher sanction risk than humanizer-assisted evasion. Therefore, detector scores should not serve as standalone misconduct evidence.
papers.comment: Accepted to ACM AI Leadership Summit
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过对照实验量化商用AI检测器在学术诚信场景中的失效问题。研究基于已发表英文摘要（四个领域，2013-2015 对比 2023-2025），在代理人类/AI标签 tau=0.50 下，发现轻度“仅润色摘要”的编辑（符合指南的AI辅助）被标记率高达64-80%，而未修改的近期原文被标记率仅9-15%，且非STEM领域显著更高。人类化改写后检测率低于4%，作者结论是检测器分数不应单独作为学术不端证据。
Motivation: 高校使用商业AI检测器维护学术诚信，但检测器无法区分AI编辑与全LLM草稿，可能将两者均视为不端行为，导致政策执行失效。
Method: 在四领域已发表英文摘要上设计受控研究，以2013-2015与2023-2025两个时段对比，设置代理人类/AI标签（tau=0.50），测试浅度“仅润色摘要”编辑、未修改原文、以及经Undetectable AI人类化改写后的检测标记率。
Result: 轻度AI辅助编辑被Pangram/GPTZero标记的比例为64-80%；未修改的近期原文被标记9-15%，非STEM显著高于STEM（p<0.001），且高分与长token和学术词汇密度相关而非仅作者意图；对人类化改写的检测率低于4%，漏报率超过96%。
Conclusion: 诚实进行AI编辑的制裁风险高于使用人类化工具逃避检测，因此检测器分数不应作为学术不端行为的独立证据。

papers.title: Symbolic Machine Learning for Vapor-Liquid Equilibrium Prediction in Cx-N2 Binary Mixtures
papers.abstract_en: Accurate prediction of vapor--liquid equilibrium (VLE) for hydrocarbon-nitrogen mixtures remains challenging for cubic equations of state, particularly across broad ranges of composition and hydrocarbon chain length. While deep learning models can provide accurate predictions, they often lack interpretability and explicit analytical expressions. In this work, we propose a symbolic machine learning approach to discover interpretable symbolic corrections to Peng-Robinson equation-of-state (PR-EOS) predictions from experimental data. The proposed approach adopts a two-level strategy: symbolic expressions are first identified for individual hydrocarbon systems, after which their coefficients are represented as functions of carbon number to enable accurate prediction across different hydrocarbon systems. The results demonstrate significantly improved prediction accuracy over the original PR-EOS across all hydrocarbon-nitrogen systems. Overall, the proposed approach provides an interpretable symbolic correction framework for improving PR-EOS predictions of hydrocarbon-nitrogen VLE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对烃-氮二元混合物的汽液相平衡 (VLE) 预测问题，提出一种符号机器学习方法，从实验数据中发现可解释的符号修正项，用以改进 Peng-Robinson 状态方程 (PR-EOS) 的预测。该方法采用两层级策略：先为各个烃类系统辨识符号表达式，再将其系数表示为碳数的函数，从而跨不同烃类系统进行预测。摘要报告该方法在所有烃-氮系统上显著提升了相对原始 PR-EOS 的预测精度，并提供了可解释的符号修正框架。
Motivation: 立方型状态方程（尤其是 PR-EOS）在宽组分范围和烃链长度范围内预测烃-氮混合物的 VLE 仍存在困难；而深度学习模型虽精度高，但缺乏可解释性和显式解析表达式。
Method: 提出两层级符号机器学习策略：先从实验数据中为单个烃类系统辨识符号修正表达式，随后将这些表达式的系数建模为碳原子数的函数，以支持跨不同烃类系统的预测。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在全部所考虑的烃-氮系统上相对原始 PR-EOS 显著提高了预测精度。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了一个可解释的符号修正框架，可用于改进 PR-EOS 对烃-氮 VLE 的预测；其适用对象为烃-氮二元混合物体系。

papers.title: FarSky: Task-Aware Latent-Space Coupling for Generative Intra-Hour Solar Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Accurate solar irradiance forecasting is essential for the reliable integration of photovoltaic power into modern electricity grids. All-sky imagers (ASI) provide high-resolution observations of clouds, making them well suited for intra-hour forecasting. Recent deep learning approaches have substantially improved forecast accuracy but are often limited by deterministic predictions and a reduced capability to anticipate ramp events. This work proposes FarSky, a generative forecasting framework that leverages latent-space coupling to learn task-aware representations of sky images. A multi-task autoencoder first learns a shared latent representation for image reconstruction and irradiance estimation. A latent diffusion model then generates future latent states conditioned on recent observations, from which irradiance forecasts are directly decoded. Probabilistic forecasts are inherently obtained through stochastic sampling. The framework is developed using a multi-year ASI dataset acquired at the Plataforma Solar de Almería, Spain, and evaluated on two independent test datasets against persistence, state-of-the-art end-to-end, and generative forecasting approaches. FarSky achieves the best overall deterministic and probabilistic forecasting performance, improving forecast skill by up to 11 percentage points. Furthermore, it substantially improves ramp event detection over existing methods, achieving F1-scores above 60%. These results demonstrate the potential of combining generative models with task-aware latent-space coupling for solar forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FarSky，一种用于日内太阳辐照度预测的生成式框架，通过潜在空间耦合 (latent-space coupling) 学习天空图像的任务感知表征。多任务自编码器先学习图像重建与辐照度估计的共享隐表示，再由潜在扩散模型基于近期观测生成未来隐状态并直接解码出辐照度，经随机采样获得概率预测。作者使用西班牙 Plataforma Solar de Almería 的多年度 ASI (all-sky imager) 数据集开发，并在两个独立测试集上与持续性预测、端到端预测及生成式预测方法对比，取得最好的整体确定性与概率预测性能。
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法虽提升了太阳辐照度预测精度，但多为确定性预测，难以预估辐照度骤变事件 (ramp events)，限制了光伏并网的可靠性。
Method: FarSky 包含多任务自编码器，同时优化图像重建与辐照度估计以学习任务感知的共享隐空间；训练后的隐空间上部署潜在扩散模型 (latent diffusion model)，以近期观测为条件生成未来隐状态，再直接解码为辐照度预测，并通过随机采样天然得到概率预测。
Result: 在两个独立测试集上，FarSky 的整体确定性和概率预测性能均优于对比方法，预测技巧评分提升最多 11 个百分点；在骤变事件检测上大幅超越现有方法，F1 分数超过 60%。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，将生成模型与任务感知的潜在空间耦合相结合，是提升太阳辐照度概率预测与骤变事件检测能力的有效途径。
Relevance: 72

papers.title: Local verification cannot detect non-transportability: a cohomological theory of context preservation in agentic reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI systems routinely transport conclusions across biological, clinical and financial contexts, and the emerging safeguard is local verification: checking at each step that the entity is representable in the chosen tool, that parameters are compatible, and that outputs cohere with the plan. We prove this class of safeguard is structurally incomplete. Modelling a covering of context space by its nerve and evidence by a real-valued 1-cochain, an agent chaining evidence performs path integration: its conclusion is path-independent if and only if the cochain is exact, and disagreement between valid reasoning paths is exactly the holonomy of a first Cech cohomology class. Hodge decomposition partitions evidence conflict into a gradient part (calibration), a curl part (local inconsistency, visible at triple overlaps) and a harmonic part. Our central result is that no family of simplex-supported consistency checks can distinguish omega from omega+h for harmonic h, which nonetheless generates non-zero disagreement between valid paths; detection requires a statistic on a cycle basis. The resulting procedure, Ksetra, estimates by coboundary projection and gates abstention on the harmonic component, which we give a mechanism: it arises from effect modification combined with overlap-specific population composition, and vanishes to machine precision when effect modification is absent. The degrees of freedom of an evidence network partition into calibration, coherence and transport, yielding an exact F-test for the existence of a global claim; we quantify its distortion under unequal precision and supply the precision-whitened form that restores exactness. Foreign exchange, where the arbitrage-free null makes the cochain exactly a coboundary, serves as a calibration bench: the test is correctly sized, fires on loop arbitrage, and ignores triangular arbitrage.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 10 figures. Includes an exact F-test for non-transportability with verified size and power, its precision-whitened generalisation, and a foreign-exchange case where the null hypothesis is known analytically rather than estimated
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究智能体推理中跨语境结论传输的安全保障，证明局部验证（local verification）这类检查在结构上不完整。作者用上下文空间的 nerve 覆盖和实值 1-上链（1-cochain）建模证据，指出结论路径无关等价于上链恰真（exact），有效推理路径的分歧对应第一 Čech 上同调类（first Čech cohomology class）的和乐；Hodge 分解将证据冲突分为梯度、旋度与调和部分，并证明任何单纯形支撑的一致性检查都无法区分恰真上链与叠加调和分量后的扭曲，检测需要基于圈基（cycle basis）的统计量。
Motivation: 智能体系统常在生物、临床和金融等语境间搬运结论，现有防护手段是逐步进行局部验证；论文的目标是论证这类检查存在结构性盲区，即无法检测非传输性（non-transportability）。
Method: 提出 Ksetra 程序：通过余边界投影（coboundary projection）估计证据网络，并以调和分量作为弃权（abstention）门控；将调和分量的产生机制解释为效应修饰与重叠特异的群体构成；将证据网络自由度分解为校准、一致性与传输三部分，给出精确 F 检验，并给出恢复精确性的精度白化（precision-whitened）形式。
Result: 摘要报告在外汇场景中，无套利零假设使上链恰为余边界，可作校准基准：该检验 size 正确，能触发环路套利（loop arbitrage）而忽略三角套利（triangular arbitrage），从而验证方法有效性。
Conclusion: 作者认为局部验证无法检测非传输性，检测需要基于圈基的统计量而非逐点一致性检查；所提检验在零假设可解析已知的外汇场景得到验证。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Variable Selection in the Context of AI Fairness
papers.abstract_en: Fairness in AI systems has become more important with recent regulatory demands, such as the EU AI Act. Traditional approaches often do not take into account philosophical ethics and social awareness. Variable selection processes, in particular, can introduce implicit bias, affecting equity across different subgroups. We discuss a mathematical approach that evaluates fairness in AI, aligning mathematical methodologies with ethical considerations and regulatory requirements. Our aim is to advocate for interdisciplinary collaboration to address fairness, emphasizing the importance of understanding broader ethical and societal contexts. Our approach emphasizes maintaining all potentially relevant variables to allow for more granular fairness assessments and to reduce implicit bias. The findings suggest that the exclusion of sensitive or critical variables may compromise equity between subgroups. In contrast, retaining all relevant variables could reduce implicit bias. Thus, the interdisciplinary approach could provide deeper insight into the ethical implications and compliance with regulatory standards. By integrating a mathematical approach with ethical and social awareness, we suggest more equitable outcomes and responsible AI deployment. This work underscores the necessity of interdisciplinary collaboration in effectively addressing fairness in AI systems aligned with the objectives of the European Union's AI Act, which seeks to promote trustworthy and fair AI systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从哲学伦理与社会意识角度讨论 AI 公平性中的变量选择问题，提出一种评估公平性的数学方法，主张保留所有潜在相关变量而非预先剔除敏感变量，以减少隐式偏见 (implicit bias)。作者结合欧盟 AI Act 的监管要求，倡导跨学科合作，认为该方法有助于更细粒度的公平性评估与监管合规。摘要主要基于概念性讨论，未报告具体实验数据。
Motivation: 随着欧盟 AI Act 等监管要求出现，AI 公平性日益重要，但传统方法往往忽视哲学伦理与社会意识，变量选择过程可能引入隐式偏见，影响不同子群体间的公平。
Method: 讨论一种评估 AI 公平性的数学方法，强调保留所有潜在相关变量以支持更细粒度的公平性评估，并将数学方法与伦理和社会意识相结合，倡导跨学科协作。

papers.title: AgonAlpha: Autonomous Alpha Discovery via Prompt Economy and Scalable Agentic Search
papers.abstract_en: Language models can propose many plausible trading factors, but an autonomous research system must also allocate its evaluation budget, verify its own evidence, and preserve how each candidate was produced. We present AgonAlpha, an architecture that searches over frozen research artifacts---hypotheses, executable expressions, platform evidence, rationales, and review status---rather than formulas alone. To our knowledge, AgonAlpha is the first alpha-mining system to combine verified artifact search, a fresh-context adversarial reviewer with re-execution and veto authority, and pending-aware parallel budget allocation, together with a complete public evidence trail. Independent deployments on WorldQuant BRAIN produced SPECTACULAR-grade alphas across five users and six model backends, with Fitness reaching 9.50 and Sharpe reaching 3.48, while retaining prompt-to-expression provenance for every submission.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgonAlpha，一个面向量化交易因子挖掘的自主研究系统，搜索的对象是冻结的研究工件（假设、可执行表达式、平台证据、理由和评审状态），而非仅搜索公式。摘要称该系统首次结合了带验证的工件搜索、拥有重新执行与否决权的新鲜上下文对抗评审者，以及考虑未决任务的并行预算分配，并提供完整公开证据链。在 WorldQuant BRAIN 上的独立部署跨五个用户和六个模型后端生成了 SPECTACULAR 级 alpha，Fitness 达 9.50、Sharpe 达 3.48，且保留每次提交的 prompt-to-expression 来源记录。
Motivation: 语言模型可以提出大量看似合理的交易因子，但自主研究系统还必须分配评估预算、验证自身证据并保存每个候选因子的产生过程。
Method: 提出 AgonAlpha 架构，在冻结的研究工件上搜索：维护假设、可执行表达式、平台证据、理由与评审状态；引入新鲜上下文对抗评审者，可重新执行候选并行使否决权；采用 pending-aware 的并行预算分配来调度评估。
Result: 在 WorldQuant BRAIN 平台上的独立部署覆盖五个用户和六个模型后端，获得 SPECTACULAR 级 alpha，Fitness 达到 9.50，Sharpe 达到 3.48，并为每次提交保留 prompt-to-expression 的完整来源记录。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这是首个同时具备验证工件搜索、对抗评审与预算分配的 alpha 挖掘系统，并通过公开证据链支持可审计的自主研究。

papers.title: Diffuse to Compress: Leveraging Diffusion LMs for Lossless Compression
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of lossless text compression, motivated by the rapid growth in the collection and storage of digital textual data - including plain text, source code, and structured formats such as XML - and by recent advances in neural language model-based compression. In particular, recent LLM-based approaches, whether built on symbol-ranking pipelines or paired with a statistical compressor, have demonstrated compression ratios significantly superior to general-purpose compressors such as zstd, gzip, or bzip on text and code. However, these neural approaches suffer from severe throughput limitations, making them not yet practically usable. For the first time in the context of lossless neural text compression, we introduce Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) as an alternative inference paradigm to autoregressive LLM-based approaches. We argue that replacing autoregressive LLMs with DLMs within the same compression framework could overcome the throughput bottleneck caused by their one-symbol-per-step limitation. However, achieving these improvements requires addressing algorithmic challenges introduced by applying DLMs to lossless compression, where the architecture allows the number and positions of symbols encoded at each forward pass to be decided independently. We design efficient and effective strategies to solve these challenges and evaluate them experimentally against LLM-based and general-purpose compressors on enwik8, a well-established textual benchmark. Our results show that the newly proposed DLM-based framework advances the state of the art in lossless text compression. Moreover, as DLMs are still a relatively young paradigm, recent advances toward increasingly capable and efficient models suggest substantial room for further improvements.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 11 figures, 2 tables. Main paper: 9 pages (7 pages text + 2 pages references). Includes 9 pages of supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究无损文本压缩问题，首次在无损神经文本压缩的背景下引入扩散语言模型（DLM）作为自回归LLM推理范式的替代方案，目标是突破自回归模型一次一个符号（one-symbol-per-step）带来的吞吐瓶颈。作者针对DLM在每次前向传播中可独立决定编码符号数量和位置所带来的算法挑战设计了相应策略，并在enwik8基准上实验，称所提出的框架推进了无损文本压缩的最先进水平。
Motivation: 数字文本数据（纯文本、源代码、XML等）的收集与存储快速增长，而现有基于LLM的压缩方法尽管压缩比显著优于zstd、gzip、bzip等通用压缩器，却受限于严重吞吐量不足，难以实用。
Method: 提出在相同压缩框架内用扩散语言模型（DLM）替代自回归LLM，并针对DLM允许单次前向传播独立决定符号数量与位置的特点，设计高效策略以解决将其应用于无损压缩时出现的算法难题。
Result: 在enwik8基准上的实验显示，所提出的DLM框架相比LLM方法和通用压缩器推进了无损文本压缩的最先进水平（state of the art）。
Conclusion: 摘要指出扩散语言模型仍属于较年轻范式，随着更强更高效模型的发展，该方向存在实质性的进一步改进空间。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: EvoGraph-Mem: Failure-Aware Editable Graph Memory for Long-Term Language Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory is essential for language agents operating across extended interactions and evolving tasks. Existing memory-augmented agents mainly focus on storing and retrieving past experience, but the quality of stored memories may degrade over time. In particular, previously distilled insights can become outdated, over-generalized, or harmful under new task contexts, causing memory pollution when repeatedly reused. To address this issue, we study insight-level memory maintenance for long-term language agents and propose a failure-aware memory maintenance framework based on an editable insight graph. Each insight node tracks positive evidence, negative evidence, and an activation state, enabling the agent to distinguish reusable insights from conflicting or invalid ones. We further introduce a utility-aware retrieval mechanism and a graph controller that updates the memory graph after task execution by keeping reliable insights, archiving invalid ones, revising outdated ones, and adding newly discovered reusable insights. Extensive experiments show that our method consistently outperforms representative memory-based agent baselines across different backbone models. Ablation studies further demonstrate that append-only memory is insufficient for long-horizon tasks, while evidence-aware retrieval and graph-level editing improve memory reliability and downstream task performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究长期语言代理的洞察级记忆维护问题，提出基于可编辑洞察图（editable insight graph）的失败感知维护框架。每个洞察节点跟踪正负证据与激活状态，并引入效用感知检索与图控制器，在任务执行后更新记忆图。实验表明该方法在不同骨干模型上优于代表性记忆型代理基线，消融显示仅追加记忆不足以支撑长周期任务。
Motivation: 现有记忆增强代理主要关注存储和检索过去经验，但存储记忆质量会随时间下降：先前提炼的洞察可能过时、过度泛化或在新的任务上下文中产生危害，反复复用将造成记忆污染（memory pollution）。
Method: 提出基于可编辑洞察图的失败感知记忆维护框架。每个洞察节点记录正证据、负证据和激活状态；引入效用感知检索机制（utility-aware retrieval）和图控制器（graph controller），在任务执行后通过保留可靠洞察、归档无效洞察、修订过时洞察并添加新发现的可复用洞察来更新记忆图。
Result: 大量实验表明，该方法在不同骨干模型上持续优于代表性记忆型代理基线；消融研究显示仅追加（append-only）记忆不足以应对长期任务，而证据感知检索和图级编辑能提升记忆可靠性与下游任务性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调洞察级记忆维护对长期语言代理的重要性，并表明证据感知检索与图级编辑结合可提高记忆可靠性和下游性能。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Conformity Mitigations in Large Language Models Lie on a Single Resistance-Receptivity Frontier
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in language models have enabled collaborative settings in which multiple models leverage one another's capabilities, iteratively improving, transforming, and extending each other's outputs. Each agent sees what the others assert before it answers, so peer opinion competes with the model's own parametric knowledge, and a wrong majority can overturn an answer the model would otherwise get right. We measure that displacement in 23 open-weight models, 19 conditions, and three datasets, yielding more than a million graded responses. A unanimous wrong majority reverses 22.8% of a model's correct MMLU answers, 54.8% on GPQA and 71.0% on SimpleQA, and 84-89% of the reversed answers match the peers' answers. Existing mitigations aim to increase Resistance, the rate at which a model keeps its correct answer under this pressure, which is only half of what a collaborating agent needs. We pair it with Receptivity, the rate at which a model adopts a correct peer answer after initially answering incorrectly. We score six methods on both axes, four drawn from prior work and two of our own. Each gains Resistance only by losing Receptivity, and their means fall on a single Resistance-Receptivity frontier with $R^2$ between 0.80 and 0.90. Reflection, the strongest published method, gains 7.9 points of MMLU Resistance and gives up 15.3 of Receptivity. Reasoning is the one exception. On GPQA and SimpleQA it trades like the rest, but on the MMLU subjects whose answers a model can derive for itself it raises Resistance by 7.2 points and Receptivity by 9.6 at once, the only intervention we find that improves both.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多模型协作场景下，LLM 在看到同伴回答后再作答时因从众压力而翻转原本正确答案的现象。作者用 23 个开放权重模型、19 种条件和三个数据集测得上百万条评分，并引入 Resistance（抵抗压力保持正确）与 Receptivity（初始错误后采纳正确同伴）两个维度来评估六种缓解方法。结果显示现有干预都落在这两个维度相互权衡的同一条前沿上，而 reasoning 是唯一能同时提升两者的干预。
Motivation: 多智能体协作中，每个 agent 在同伴意见与自身参数知识之间作权衡，一致的错误多数可能推翻模型原本正确的回答；现有缓解工作只关注 Resistance，而忽略了协作所需的 Receptivity，缺少对两种能力联合评估的视角。
Method: 作者将正确率位移分解为两个正交指标：Resistance（正确时坚持自己答案的比率）和 Receptivity（先答错后接受正确同伴答案的比率），对六种方法（四种来自已有工作、两种自创）在两个维度上评分，并考察多个条件与数据集下的权衡关系。
Result: 一致错误多数分别翻转 22.8% 的 MMLU、54.8% 的 GPQA 和 71.0% 的 SimpleQA 正确答案，其中 84-89% 的翻转答案与同伴答案一致。所有方法均以牺牲 Receptivity 为代价换取 Resistance，均值落在 R² 为 0.80-0.90 的单条前沿上；最强的已有方法 Reflection 在 MMLU 上提升 7.9 点 Resistance 却损失 15.3 点 Receptivity。reasoning 是唯一例外：在 GPQA 和 SimpleQA 上仍随大流权衡，但在模型可自行推导的 MMLU 子科目上同时提升 Resistance 7.2 点和 Receptivity 9.6 点。
Conclusion: 论文强调协作环境中的缓解不能只看 Resistance，必须同时考虑 Receptivity；除 reasoning 外，现有干预均在这两个维度上单向取舍，而 reasoning 在处理可推导内容时是唯一同时改善两者的方法。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Towards the Harness of Embodied Agents
papers.abstract_en: The success of coding agents has established the harness as a paradigm: what an agent achieves depends not on the model alone, but on the infrastructure around it. We ask whether the same paradigm extends to embodied agents in the physical world. We present Thea, a harness in which an agentic loop orchestrates robot capabilities, each wrapped as a callable tool. It inherits the core components of coding agents, modified as the physical world requires. The world, however, withholds two abilities that software grants for free: reading the state of the world, and judging the outcome of an action. To bridge these gaps, Thea introduces Scene Graph as Context, a persistent, symbolic representation of the world, and Evaluation as Exit Codes, which detects when an action should terminate, judges whether it succeeded, and on failure diagnoses the cause. Together they close the loop between the agent and the physical world. Rich behaviors then emerge from the composition of tools, and the closed loop carries long-horizon tasks to completion in real environments.

papers.title: Towards Sustainable Learning in Online Education: A Reinforcement Learning Approach
papers.abstract_en: Online education offers unprecedented scalability and accessibility to global learners from diverse backgrounds, but it often suffers from low engagement and poor long term learning effectiveness. To address these challenges, we introduce AI Tutor, a reinforcement learning based model designed to promote sustainable learning by optimizing both short and longterm learning outcomes. In the short term, AI-Tutor draws on cognitive theory to guide learners through a balance of acquiring new knowledge and reinforcing prior learning. In the long term, it models learner engagement to inform strategies that sustain motivation and reduce dropout. These enhancements enable AI-Tutor to provide personalized guidance that fosters both effective learning and sustained participation. Empirical evaluations on 23 million learning records from 33,700 learners show that AI Tutor consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across engagement, knowledge retention, and final learning outcomes. Learning path analyses further reveal how AI-Tutor adapts its strategies to learners with diverse profiles, offering adaptive and human-centered support.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AI-Tutor，一个基于强化学习的在线教育模型，旨在同时优化短期与长期学习效果。短期上借鉴认知理论，在获取新知识与巩固先前学习之间取得平衡；长期上对学习者参与度建模，以维持动机并减少辍学。在 33,700 名学习者的 2300 万条学习记录上，AI-Tutor 在参与度、知识保留和最终学习效果上均优于现有基线。
Motivation: 在线教育虽具可扩展性和可及性，但普遍存在参与度低、长期学习效果不佳的问题，需要能兼顾短期与长期目标的个性化学习指导。
Method: 提出基于强化学习的 AI-Tutor 模型：短期利用认知理论引导学习者平衡新知识获取与旧知识巩固，长期通过建模学习者的参与度来设计维持动机、降低辍学的策略，从而提供个性化引导。
Result: 摘要报告在来自 33,700 名学习者的 2300 万条学习记录上的实验，AI-Tutor 在参与度、知识保留和最终学习效果方面一致优于最先进基线；学习路径分析显示其能针对不同学习者画像调整策略。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过强化学习同时优化短期与长期学习目标，可以促进在线学习中的有效学习与持续参与，并提供自适应、以人为本的个性化支持。

papers.title: BEST-KAG: Enhancing Question Answering of Building Engineering Standards with Multimodal Knowledge Graph Modeling and Large Language Model
papers.abstract_en: Construction standards are critical for building safety and sustainability. Existing standard application workflows rely on keyword-based document retrieval and manual cross-clause interpretation, which cannot reliably support multi-clause reasoning, multimodal knowledge utilization, or traceable clause-level evidence linkage. To address these limitations, this study develops a multimodal knowledge-driven framework that supports question answering on standard knowledge named BEST-KAG (Knowledge-Augmented Generation for Building Engineering STandards). The framework introduces 1) a multimodal knowledge graph (MKG) for unified representation of document hierarchy and heterogeneous standard knowledge with various connections, 2) a rule-LLM hybrid knowledge construction pipeline for scalable multimodal knowledge extraction, creating a large MAG with 251 building engineering standards, 171,652 nodes and 310,914 edges, and 3) a graph-retrieval-based knowledge-augmented generation architecture for clause-grounded and traceable question answering. Experiments demonstrate that BEST-KAG consistently outperforms multiple mainstream LLMs in terms of Expert evaluation, and metrics including BLEU, and ROUGE, with the best improvement up to 74.01% compared to the baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BEST-KAG (Knowledge-Augmented Generation for Building Engineering STandards)，一个面向建筑工程标准问答的多模态知识驱动框架。框架用多模态知识图谱 (MKG) 统一表示文档层级和异构标准知识，配合规则-LLM 混合知识构建流水线，构建了包含 251 项标准、171,652 个节点和 310,914 条边的知识图谱，并采用图检索增强生成架构实现条款可追溯的问答。实验在专家评估及 BLEU、ROUGE 等指标上优于多个主流 LLM，最佳提升达 74.01%。
Motivation: 现有标准应用工作流依赖关键词检索和人工跨条款解读，难以可靠支持多条款推理、多模态知识利用以及可追溯的条款级证据链接。
Method: 框架包含三部分：1) 多模态知识图谱 (MKG)，用于统一表示文档层级和异构标准知识及其连接；2) 规则-LLM 混合知识构建流水线，支持可扩展的多模态知识提取；3) 基于图检索的知识增强生成架构，提供条款级可追溯的问答能力。
Result: 实验表明 BEST-KAG 在专家评估以及 BLEU、ROUGE 等指标上持续优于多个主流 LLM，相比基线的最佳提升达 74.01%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该多模态知识驱动框架能够支持标准知识的多条款推理、多模态利用和条款级证据可追溯性，从而改进建筑工程标准问答。

papers.title: The Off-Support Barrier: Why Semantic Safety Constraints Are Not Learning-Problem Invariants, and What Follows for Prior Design, Containment, and Verification
papers.abstract_en: We argue that a single structural fact organizes a wide range of phenomena in contemporary AI safety: a semantic safety constraint (e.g., the agent does not escape its sandbox) is an off-support object. Formally, if q is the data distribution and \(p(\cdot\mid w)\) the model, the safety predicate B is not measurable with respect to \(σ(\text{model}, q)\), whereas the real log-canonical threshold (RLCT) of singular learning theory (SLT) is. From this non-invariance we derive, as corollaries rather than independent observations: (i) why reward hacking and sandbox escape arise under outcome-based optimization; (ii) why encoding such constraints through Bayesian prior design or soft penalty weighting has poor leverage in singular models; (iii) why hard invariants belong in the harness and soft dispositions in the model; (iv) why the same B is nonetheless soundly and locally certifiable by formal verification, exactly as the local learning coefficient (LLC) locally pins the same RLCT --- with two precise points of disanalogy; and (v) why the residual difficulty, identifying which off-support region matters, coincides with performative prediction and self-referential functional dynamics, where SLT's analytic machinery breaks down. We use the July 2026 OpenAI--Hugging Face evaluation incident as the motivating case. Numerical experiments code and related proofs in lean are available at https://github.com/xiangze/Preventing_Jailbreak_as_regularization
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个结构性论点：语义安全约束（如智能体不逃出沙箱）是数据分布与模型之外的“离支撑集”对象，因而不具有学习问题的不变性；相比之下，奇异学习理论 (singular learning theory, SLT) 中的实对数规范阈值 (RLCT) 是可测量的。作者由此推导出奖励黑客、沙箱逃逸、贝叶斯先验设计与软惩罚权重在奇异模型中的局限、硬不变量应放入护栏 (harness) 而软倾向放入模型、以及形式化验证可局部证明同一约束等结论，并以2026年7月OpenAI–Hugging Face评估事件为例。
Motivation: 现有AI安全文献将语义安全约束当作可被学习过程优化的对象，但作者认为这类约束在数学上具有“离支撑”性质，导致先验设计、软惩罚等常见手段在奇异模型中效果有限，需要从结构上重新理解安全约束的定位。
Method: 论文采用形式化论证：形式化定义安全谓词B相对模型与数据分布σ-代数不可测，而RLCT可测；据此把奖励黑客、沙箱逃逸、先验设计与软惩罚的失效、硬/软约束分工、形式化验证的局部可证性等作为推论导出，并给出与局部学习系数 (LLC) 的精确类比和两点不相似之处。
Result: 摘要没有给出量化实验指标，仅说明提供了数值实验代码与Lean相关证明；核心结果是得到关于安全约束非不变性的若干推论，并指出剩余困难与执行性预测 (performative prediction) 及自指函数动力学重合，此时SLT分析机制失效。
Conclusion: 作者强调语义安全约束不是学习问题的不变量，硬不变量应放在护栏中、软倾向放在模型中；残余挑战在于识别哪个离支撑区域是关键，这超出SLT的分析范围。该结论以具体安全事件为动机，但摘要未讨论局限或更广泛验证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Lost in Compaction: Evaluating Side-Constraint Loss under Context Compaction
papers.abstract_en: When the context window is under pressure, LLM systems compact prior context to continue ongoing tasks. We identify a class of user-issued instructions, Session Constraints (SCs), such as "do not delete any emails until I confirm," that are meant to constrain LLM's behavior for the remainder of a session but are silently dropped during compaction. To quantify this loss, we introduce COMPINT, an evaluation suite that evaluates compactors across three long-context scenarios: multi-turn chat, agentic trajectory, and long-horizon research. Current compactors retain only 17% of injected SCs on average, and most perform worse than running the same task without compaction. Retention varies sharply with compactor, prompt, context length, SC phrasing, and injection location, showing that the loss is systematic rather than tied to any single setting. We propose an SC-aware extractor that runs alongside the compactor as a plug-and-play module, achieving over 90% retention across all three scenarios without modifying the compactor or LLM. The COMPINT evaluation suite and accompanying implementation are available at https://github.com/ZhiqiEliWang/compaction-integrity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 LLM 系统在上下文窗口紧张时进行上下文压缩 (context compaction) 对用户会话约束 (Session Constraints, SCs) 的丢失问题，提出评估套件 COMPINT，覆盖多轮对话、智能体轨迹 (agentic trajectory) 和长期研究 (long-horizon research) 三类长上下文场景。摘要报告当前压缩器平均仅保留 17% 的注入 SC，且多数压缩器表现比不压缩直接运行更差；作者提出一个与压缩器并行的即插即用 SC-aware extractor，无需修改压缩器或 LLM 即可在三个场景中实现 90% 以上的保留率。
Motivation: 用户发布的会话约束（例如“在我确认前不要删除任何邮件”）旨在约束 LLM 在会话剩余时间内的行为，但这类指令会在上下文压缩过程中被静默丢弃，且现有工作缺少对此类损失的量化评估。
Method: 引入 COMPINT 评估套件，在多轮对话、智能体轨迹和长期研究三个场景中评估压缩器对 SC 的保留能力；并提出一个与压缩器并行的即插即用 SC-aware extractor，无需改动压缩器或底层 LLM。
Result: 当前压缩器平均仅保留 17% 的注入 SC，大多数压缩器在压缩后的任务表现上差于不压缩直接运行；保留率随压缩器、提示、上下文长度、SC 措辞和注入位置显著变化。SC-aware extractor 在全部三类场景中达到 90% 以上的 SC 保留率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 SC 在压缩中的丢失是系统性问题而非某一单一设置所致；所提 SC-aware extractor 可作为插件缓解该问题，COMPINT 套件与实现已开源。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 引入 COMPINT 评估套件，在多轮对话、智能体轨迹和长期研究三个场景中评估压缩器对 SC 的保留能力；并提出一个与压缩器并行的即插即用 SC-aware extractor，无需改动压缩器或底层 LLM。
summary_sections.result: 当前压缩器平均仅保留 17% 的注入 SC，大多数压缩器在压缩后的任务表现上差于不压缩直接运行；保留率随压缩器、提示、上下文长度、SC 措辞和注入位置显著变化。SC-aware extractor 在全部三类场景中达到 90% 以上的 SC 保留率。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调 SC 在压缩中的丢失是系统性问题而非某一单一设置所致；所提 SC-aware extractor 可作为插件缓解该问题，COMPINT 套件与实现已开源。

papers.title: RecSys Factory: Bounding LLM Agent Autonomy to Decision Points in the Industrial Recommender Lifecycle
papers.abstract_en: Deploying LLM agents into industrial recommender operations exposes a three-way tension we frame as the autonomy-determinism-efficiency trilemma: general autonomy (interpreting operator intent, generating glue code zero-shot), industrial determinism (schema-conforming feature extraction, non-crashing A/B, zero compliance-path hallucination), and end-to-end efficiency. Any two can be maximized against the third. We present RecSys Factory, an LLM-agent platform deployed for 78 days across three heterogeneous Tencent recommender business lines. The design principle is autonomy at decision points, not over pipelines, made concrete through three deconstructions that each discharge one vertex of the trilemma. Runtime is deconstructed into three host-emitted event sources (Claude Code Stop hooks, corporate-IM webhooks, workflow scheduler APIs): the platform carries no long-running daemon during the wait phase and consumes zero CPU during the 94% of wall-clock spent waiting on Spark or GPU jobs. Capability is deconstructed into a 29-file skill ecosystem (8,971 lines of SKILL.md) whose per-skill pitfall tables mechanically compile into a 400-entry PitfallStore, confining autonomy to bounded typed decision surfaces inside pre-committed pipelines. Deployment spans three business lines with disjoint label semantics, A/B layer topologies, and operator personas; an onboarding-time compression is observed on two of the three and is reported as a case-study observation, not a generalization claim, and not measured against a controlled pre-platform baseline. The human is retained at the diagnostic-versus-execution boundary via a human-in-the-loop card protocol, deployed as an audit-trail primitive (schema-validated, idempotent, replayable) and reported from an 8-day 16-run pilot. Across the 78-day window the platform recorded 1,624 CLI-tool dispatches at a 78.6% aggregate success rate.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 6 figures, 9 tables. Reports a 78-day deployment across three heterogeneous industrial recommender business lines (1,624 CLI-tool dispatches). Companion paper: AutoResearch (P3b), which instantiates the same substrate for autonomous research
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RecSys Factory，一个面向工业推荐系统生命周期的 LLM 智能体平台，核心设计原则是将自主性限制在决策点（decision points）而非整条流水线。平台在腾讯三条异构推荐业务线上部署 78 天，记录 1,624 次 CLI 工具调度，聚合成功率为 78.6%；等待阶段无常驻守护进程，在 94% 的墙钟等待时间内消耗零 CPU。作者将自主性-确定性-效率三难问题（autonomy-determinism-efficiency trilemma）通过运行时、能力、人机边界三种解构分别对应。
Motivation: 将 LLM 智能体部署到工业推荐运营中面临三难张力：通用自主性、工业确定性与端到端效率，任意两者最大化都会牺牲第三者。现有方案难以同时满足意图理解、schema 一致的特征提取、无崩溃的 A/B 测试与零合规路径幻觉等工业要求。
Method: 提出"自主性在决策点而非流水线上"的设计原则，通过三种解构实现：运行时解构为三类宿主事件源（Claude Code Stop hooks、企业 IM webhook、工作流调度器 API）；能力解构为 29 文件的技能生态（8,971 行 SKILL.md），其逐技能陷阱表机械编译为 400 条目的 PitfallStore；人机边界通过人类在环（human-in-the-loop）卡片协议保留，作为 schema 校验、幂等、可重放的审计轨迹原语。
Result: 78 天部署覆盖三条标签语义、A/B 层拓扑和操作者画像各异的业务线，共记录 1,624 次 CLI 工具调度，聚合成功率 78.6%；等待阶段零 CPU 占用；8 天 16 次运行的人机协议试点亦有报告。两条业务线观察到上线期压缩（onboarding-time compression），但作者明确说明这是案例观察而非受控基线下的泛化结论。
Conclusion: 作者认为将自主性限定在预提交流水线内的有界类型化决策表面，可以在保留工业确定性与效率的同时释放 LLM 智能体的部分自主性；但部署观测不设受控基线，结果应视为案例研究而非通用性声明。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: VQ-bench: A Composable Vector Quantization Framework
papers.abstract_en: Vector quantization is an old problem but has recently become central to AI infrastructure. It is therefore experiencing a surge of renewed engineering and research activity. This paper provides a unified framework for developing and benchmarking new quantization algorithms. We describe 7 common conceptual quantization primitives and show how to compose them arbitrarily. We then re-express 25 common quantizers as pipelines of these primitives. Finally, we publish VQ-bench as open-source to be extended further and make reproducible benchmarks publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于开发与评测向量量化 (vector quantization) 算法的统一框架 VQ-bench。作者总结了 7 种常见的概念级量化原语 (primitives)，允许任意组合，并将 25 种常见量化器重新表达为这些原语构成的流水线。该框架以开源形式发布，并提供可复现的基准测试。
Motivation: 向量量化近年成为 AI 基础设施的核心问题，相关工程与研究活动激增，但缺少一个统一框架来系统化地开发和比较新的量化算法。
Method: 定义 7 种通用的概念量化原语，并展示如何任意组合这些原语；随后将 25 种常见量化器表示为这些原语构成的流水线。
Result: 论文发布开源的 VQ-bench，并提供公开可复现的基准测试结果，结果可在 www.vq-bench.com 获取。
Conclusion: 该框架旨在成为可扩展的统一基准平台，供社区进一步扩展量化算法与评测。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning based DBMS Buffer Pool Auto-Tuning for Optimal Memory Utilization
papers.abstract_en: Administering Database Management Systems (DBMS) instances requires Database Administrators (DBA) to balance performance in terms of Service Level Agreement (SLA) against resource usage, often prompting RAM over-allocation that wastes memory. We introduce MicroTune, an online RL-based buffer adjustment system that minimizes unnecessary memory allocation while ensuring SLA compliance. To identify the most effective RL core, we evaluate multiple algorithms under diverse benchmark workloads, training MicroTune on extensive traces of both external metrics (latency, throughput) and internal DBMS metrics (status variables and performance statistics). Experimental results demonstrate that MicroTune dynamically adapts buffer sizes to workload fluctuations, outperforming baselines by achieving significant memory savings with fewer SLA violations. These findings underscore the promise of reinforcement learning for adaptive resource management in DBMS environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MicroTune，一个基于在线强化学习的数据库管理系统（DBMS）缓冲池自动调节系统，目标是在满足服务水平协议（SLA）的前提下最小化不必要的内存分配。作者在多种基准工作负载下评估多个 RL 算法，并使用外部指标（延迟、吞吐量）和内部 DBMS 指标（状态变量与性能统计）的大量轨迹训练 MicroTune。实验表明 MicroTune 能动态适应工作负载波动，相比基线实现显著内存节省并减少 SLA 违规。
Motivation: 数据库管理员需要在 SLA 性能与资源使用之间权衡，常常通过过度分配 RAM 来保证性能，导致内存浪费；需要一种能自动调节缓冲池大小、同时兼顾 SLA 与内存利用率的方案。
Method: 提出 MicroTune，一种在线 RL 缓冲池调整系统；系统比较多种强化学习算法，并利用外部与内部 DBMS 指标的轨迹数据进行训练，以决定缓冲池大小的动态调整。
Result: 摘要报告 MicroTune 能随工作负载波动动态调整缓冲池大小，相比基线方法在满足 SLA 的前提下实现显著内存节省，同时减少 SLA 违规次数。
Conclusion: 摘要认为这些结果展示了强化学习在 DBMS 自适应资源管理中的潜力，但未提及具体数据集、基准名称或量化指标。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Towards Query-Agnostic RAG Evaluation via Query Coverage and Claim Verifiability
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation improves the factuality of large language models by grounding responses in retrieved evidence, yet existing evaluation frameworks struggle to provide consistent, fine-grained diagnostics across the diverse spectrum of user queries, ranging from close-ended fact-seeking to open-ended explanatory requests. We propose Q-CARE, a query-agnostic and fully reference-free framework that enables fine-grained assessment by decomposing queries into sub-queries and answers into atomic claims. Q-CARE establishes a unified evaluation principle based on query coverage and claim verifiability, yielding coverage-aware retriever metrics (C-Prec@k, C-nDCG@k) and claim-level generator metrics (Completeness, Conciseness, and Verifiableness). On a human-annotated benchmark spanning eight datasets, Q-CARE achieves higher correlation with human judgments than four existing RAG evaluation metrics, including RAGEval and RAGChecker, proving its effectiveness as a reliable, automated evaluation framework. Code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/DISL-Lab/Q-CaRE-COLM-26.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Q-CARE，一个查询无关（query-agnostic）且完全无参考（reference-free）的 RAG 评估框架。它将查询分解为子查询、将答案分解为原子声明（atomic claims），并以查询覆盖率（query coverage）和声明可验证性（claim verifiability）为统一原则，提出检索器指标 C-Prec@k、C-nDCG@k 和声明级生成器指标 Completeness、Conciseness、Verifiableness。在覆盖八个数据集的 human-annotated benchmark 上，Q-CARE 与人类判断的相关性高于 RAGEval、RAGChecker 等四种现有 RAG 评估指标。代码与数据已公开。
Motivation: 现有 RAG 评估框架难以在从封闭式事实查找到开放式解释请求的各类用户查询上提供一致且细粒度的诊断，影响自动化评估的可靠性。
Method: 将查询拆分为子查询、将答案拆分为原子声明，建立以查询覆盖率和声明可验证性为基础的统一评估原则，并据此设计 coverage-aware 的检索器指标和 claim-level 的生成器指标，从而实现无需参考答案的细粒度评估。
Result: 在覆盖八个数据集的 human-annotated 基准上，Q-CARE 与人类判断的相关性高于四种已有 RAG 评估指标（包括 RAGEval 和 RAGChecker），表明其作为自动化评估框架的有效性。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 Q-CARE 是一种可靠、自动化的 RAG 评估框架，其查询无关设计使其能覆盖不同类型的用户查询。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Geometry-aware Incremental Neural Operator for Long-Horizon PDE prediction
papers.abstract_en: Neural operators have shown strong potential for learning solution operators of partial differential equations (PDEs). However, long-horizon autoregressive prediction remains challenging: local errors accumulate as spectral inconsistency, phase misalignment, or mean drift. Existing methods mainly improve state representations and operator backbones, while leaving the repeatedly applied latent transition increment weakly structured, allowing spectral errors and unstable channel couplings to accumulate during rollout. To address these issues, we propose a geometry-aware incremental neural operator (GeoIncNO) for stable long-horizon PDE prediction. GeoIncNO predicts latent increments for residual advancement and uses lightweight low-rank projectors to regulate channel coupling within active frequency bands derived from the increment spectral energy distribution. To reduce physical-space reconstruction errors, GeoIncNO further introduces a mean--fluctuation decoupled reconstruction mechanism, where stable mean structures and dynamic fluctuations are fused separately, and phase correction is applied only to the zero-mean fluctuation component. Extensive experiments on six PDE benchmarks, covering 1D, 2D, and 3D dynamical systems, show that GeoIncNO achieves consistently strong prediction accuracy, improved rollout stability, and better spectral fidelity compared with competitive neural-operator baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种几何感知的增量神经算子（GeoIncNO），用于稳定偏微分方程的长时间自回归预测。GeoIncNO 通过预测潜空间增量进行残差推进，并使用轻量低秩投影器在由增量谱能量分布导出的活跃频带内调节通道耦合；同时还引入均值-波动解耦重建机制，将稳定均值结构与动态波动分开融合，相位校正只施加于零均值波动分量。在覆盖 1D、2D、3D 动力系统的六个 PDE 基准上，GeoIncNO 相比竞争性神经算子基线在预测精度、滚动稳定性和谱保真方面表现一致。
Motivation: 神经算子在长时程自回归预测中面临局部误差累积导致的谱不一致、相位错位或均值漂移问题；现有方法主要改进状态表示和算子主干，却让重复应用的潜变量增量过渡结构保持弱约束，使谱误差和通道耦合在 rollout 中不断累积。
Method: 提出 GeoIncNO，用残差增量预测实现潜空间推进；依据增量谱能量分布确定活跃频带，并利用轻量级低秩投影器约束这些频带内的通道耦合。为减小物理空间重建误差，进一步引入均值-波动解耦重建，分别融合稳定均值结构与动态波动，且相位校正仅作用于零均值波动分量。
Result: 在 1D、2D、3D 共六个 PDE 基准上的大量实验显示，GeoIncNO 相对竞争性神经算子基线取得持续更好的预测精度、提升的 rollout 稳定性以及更好的谱保真；摘要未给出具体数值。

papers.title: TRACE Bench: Task-driven Roleplay Agentic Checklist Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Roleplay evaluation should do more than assign a single score: it should reveal which role requirements were tested, which failed, and which dialogue evidence supports the judgment. We propose TRACE Bench, a task-driven agentic checklist evaluation framework. It decomposes each role profile offline into a fixed checklist, then uses a User Agent to converse naturally with the target roleplay model while privately updating checklist states from model responses. Scores therefore trace back to checklist items and supporting dialogue turns rather than a black-box holistic impression. For coverage cross-validation, we audit released M2 free-dialogue transcripts from the MiniMax Role-play Benchmark against the same role-derived checklist. The released free-chat transcripts cover only 73.74% of key role-profile points, whereas TRACE Bench reaches 99.91% coverage in fewer turns. Robustness experiments show stable rankings under repeated runs and User Agent replacement. Across 26 models, TRACE Bench reports overall rankings together with capability breakdowns and checklist traces. It also supports Closed-Loop Benchmark Evolution, distilling verification methods proven effective in failed traces so later evaluations can more reliably elicit and examine observed failure modes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TRACE Bench，一个任务驱动的智能体式清单评测框架，用于角色扮演 (roleplay) 评估。它将每个角色设定离线分解为固定检查清单，由 User Agent 与目标角色扮演模型自然对话，并私下根据模型回复更新清单状态，使评分可回溯到清单项与支撑对话轮次。对 MiniMax Role-play Benchmark 公开的 M2 自由对话记录进行评测审计后，作者报告自由聊天记录仅覆盖关键角色设定点的 73.74%，而 TRACE Bench 在更少轮次内达到 99.91% 的覆盖率。
Motivation: 角色扮演评测不应只给出单一分数，而应揭示哪些角色要求被测试、哪些失败以及哪些对话证据支持该判断；现有方法偏向黑盒的整体印象评分，缺少可追溯的细粒度评估。
Method: 提出 TRACE Bench 框架：离线将每个角色设定分解为固定检查清单，使用 User Agent 以自然方式与目标模型对话并私下更新检查清单状态；同时支持 Closed-Loop Benchmark Evolution，从失败轨迹中提炼被验证有效的验证方法，供后续评估更可靠地引出和检查失败模式。
Result: 摘要报告 M2 自由聊天记录的关键角色设定点覆盖率为 73.74%，而 TRACE Bench 在更少轮次内达到 99.91%；重复运行与更换 User Agent 的鲁棒性实验显示排名稳定；在 26 个模型上给出总体排名以及能力细分和清单轨迹。
Conclusion: 摘要强调可追溯清单评分比黑盒整体印象更能支撑角色扮演评测，并支持通过闭环基准演化不断提升对失败模式的验证能力。

papers.title: CORA-Diff: Confidence-Oriented Residual Acceptance for Efficient Diffusion Language Model Inference
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion language models (DLMs) update many tokens in parallel, yet practical decoders often use a fixed denoising horizon. Many predictions stabilize early, but blockwise decoding continues until all positions are resolved, causing repeated dense forward passes. Existing accelerators often rely on learned filters, modified scores, dependency models, or cache-specific mechanisms. We ask whether native trajectory signals can identify residual positions likely to match the deterministic dense endpoint. We propose CORA-Diff, a training-free method that preserves the original transfer rule and applies confidence-and-persistence gating only to positions that rule leaves unresolved. Accepted tokens remain visible as context, and the block terminates once all positions are resolved. This requires no backbone change, learned acceptance model, or logit modification. Our theory explains why high-confidence, persistent predictions are more likely to match the fixed-horizon dense endpoint, and paired post-intervention trajectories provide direct empirical support. We select one operating point on a separate GSM8K calibration subset and freeze it for all evaluations. Under a matched Learn2PD-style LLaDA protocol, CORA-Diff has the lowest measured runtime in all eight task-length settings. Task scores match or exceed dense decoding in five settings, and the largest observed drop is 1.22 points. Its incremental speedups over EOS-aware dense decoding are 2.70x and 3.32x on GSM8K and HumanEval. It also reaches 13.14x under the fixed-horizon 1024/1024 mechanism-isolation protocol and transfers to Dream without retuning at 3.18x-3.53x. These results show that native confidence and persistence enable reliable residual acceptance, reducing repeated denoising computation while preserving task quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CORA-Diff，一种免训练 (training-free) 的扩散语言模型 (diffusion language model) 推理加速方法。它利用轨迹本身的置信度与持续性信号，只对原传递规则未解决的位置施加门控，从而提前终止去噪过程，无需修改 backbone、接受模型或 logit。在 Learn2PD 风格的 LLaDA 协议下，CORA-Diff 在全部八个任务长度设置中取得最低实测运行时间，并在 GSM8K 与 HumanEval 上相对 EOS-aware 稠密解码获得 2.70x 和 3.32x 加速。
Motivation: 扩散语言模型虽然并行更新多个 token，但实际解码常使用固定去噪步数；许多预测很早便稳定下来，而 blockwise 解码仍要等所有位置都被解析，导致重复的稠密前向传播。现有加速器多依赖学习过滤器、修改评分、依赖模型或特定缓存机制，作者想探索原生轨迹信号能否识别出与确定性稠密端点匹配的残余位置。
Method: CORA-Diff 保留原始传递规则，只对规则未解决的 token 位置施加置信度与持续性 (confidence-and-persistence) 门控；被接受的 token 保留为可见上下文，当所有位置都解析完毕时 block 终止。该方法无需 backbone 改动、无需学习型接受模型、无需修改 logit，并用理论解释高置信且持续的预测更可能匹配固定步数稠密端点，配对的干预后轨迹提供了直接经验支持。
Result: 在独立的 GSM8K 校准子集上选定一个操作点并冻结用于所有评估。在匹配 Learn2PD 风格的 LLaDA 协议下，CORA-Diff 在全部八种任务长度设置中实测运行时间最低；五个设置的任务分数达到或超过稠密解码，最大下降为 1.22 分。GSM8K 与 HumanEval 上的增量加速为 2.70x 与 3.32x，在固定步数 1024/1024 的机制隔离协议下达到 13.14x，并无需重新调参迁移到 Dream，得到 3.18x–3.53x 加速。
Conclusion: 作者认为原生置信度与持续性信号能够支持可靠的残余位置接受 (residual acceptance)，从而减少重复去噪计算并保持任务质量。摘要强调该方法无需修改 backbone 或学习接受模型，但评估主要依托 LLaDA 协议与 GSM8K 校准，未讨论其他扩散语言模型架构上的泛化情况。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: InfraBench: Evaluating Infrastructure Agents Across Layers, Lifecycle, and Risk
papers.abstract_en: Managing modern computing infrastructure has become a steadily harder problem due to the ever-increasing complexity. Recent advances in AI agents create a timely opportunity to automate infrastructure management tasks, but it remains unclear how well such agents can handle real-world infrastructure complexity. We present InfraBench, a benchmark suite for evaluating AI agents on realistic infrastructure tasks across the full system stack and full operational lifecycle with fine-grained risk assessment. Experiments with 15 agent-model configurations show that even the strongest agent cannot secure a full score across all tasks. Mean effective scores range from roughly 40% to 88% (with per-configuration standard errors of 6-12 points), repeating every task three times reveals that top configurations still pass only a fraction of their attempts, and per-check scoring exposes a general failure pattern: agents may routinely satisfy short-term objectives while leaving non-durable changes, broken distributed invariants, unsafe side effects, and uncleaned state behind. INFRABENCH, including its live leaderboard, tasks, and evaluation harness, is publicly available at infraben.ch.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 InfraBench，一个用于评估 AI 智能体在真实基础设施任务上表现的基准套件，覆盖完整系统栈、全运维生命周期和细粒度风险评估。摘要报告 15 种智能体-模型配置的平均有效分数在约 40% 到 88% 之间（各配置标准误为 6-12 分），顶级配置在每任务重复三次的情况下仍只通过部分尝试。per-check 评分显示普遍失败模式：智能体常满足短期目标，却遗留非持久改动、破坏分布式不变量、产生不安全副作用以及未清理的状态。基准、实时排行榜和评估框架公开于 infraben.ch。
Motivation: 现代计算基础设施管理因复杂度不断上升而变得越发困难，AI 智能体为此提供了自动化机会，但现有研究缺乏对智能体处理真实基础设施复杂度的系统性评估手段。
Method: 构建 InfraBench 基准套件，覆盖完整系统栈与完整运维生命周期，并采用细粒度风险检查（per-check scoring）评估智能体行为；实验包含 15 种智能体-模型配置，每个任务重复三次。
Result: 摘要报告最强智能体也无法在所有任务上获得满分；平均有效分数约为 40% 到 88%，标准误为 6-12 分；重复三次后顶级配置仍只通过部分尝试；失败模式包括非持久改动、分布式不变量破坏、不安全副作用和状态未清理。
Conclusion: 摘要指出当前 AI 智能体在基础设施管理任务上存在系统性的可靠性与安全性缺口，并公开 InfraBench（含实时排行榜、任务与评估框架）以支持后续研究。

papers.title: Retrofitting Recurrent Depth into a Pretrained Language Model: Installation, Extrapolation, Transfer, and Retention at Two Parameter Budgets
papers.abstract_en: A dense, pretrained language model can be retrofitted with recurrent depth and learn an iterative latent transition that persists after outcome-only annealing. Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct is split into a Prelude, a weight-tied Recurrent Block, and a Coda, with an identity-preserving one-loop path and a re-entry bridge on later loops. At loop 1 the retrofit remains non-inferior to its base on a preregistered ARC battery. Three findings. First, the mechanism is a reusable procedure rather than terminal-answer lookup, and installs at two budgets: 6M trained parameters over frozen base weights and 180M full-block. With intermediate-step supervision, the model computes one task step per loop and persists when only final answers are graded. The adapter matched the full block overall (83.8% versus 84.0%), led through depth 11, and trailed beyond. Verbal fine-tuning reached 79-86% on controlled verbal renderings (zero-shot transfer was minimal), and adapter verbal training begun from the installed mechanism outpaced matched fresh training by 18.6 points, including on a held-out test set. Second, the operation extrapolates to roughly 1.5 times its supervised depth, holding 70% accuracy through depth 18. Third, a same-size scratchpad-trained model matched the recurrent model within its learned horizon but collapsed beyond it. The recurrent model won overall, 84% versus 72%, retained 53% versus 2.5% beyond depth 10, and answered 7.6 times faster. An iterative transformer can therefore perform deeper reasoning in latent space faster than comparable or larger models fine-tuned on the same task, in a system-level comparison. A second task, running the rule in reverse, exposed the limits: the inverse was learnable in isolation, but no continuation acquired it while preserving the installed mechanism and general capability, a catastrophic-interference boundary. Learned depth selection remains open.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文尝试把循环深度 (recurrent depth) 以改造方式装入预训练稠密语言模型，使其学习一种在仅以最终答案退火 (outcome-only annealing) 后仍能保持的迭代隐状态转移。作者将 Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct 拆分为 Prelude、权重共享的 Recurrent Block 和 Coda，加入保持恒等的一圈路径与后续循环的重入桥；在预注册 ARC 测试组上，循环改造在 loop 1 不劣于基座模型。摘要报告该机制可外推到监督深度的约 1.5 倍，并在系统级对比中优于同规模或更大的 scratchpad 微调模型，但反向任务暴露了灾难性干扰边界。
Motivation: 核心问题是预训练稠密语言模型能否被改造出循环深度，从而学习一种持久的迭代隐状态转移，而不是只做终答查询；同时要检验该机制在两种参数预算下的可安装性、外推性、迁移性与保持性。
Method: 将 Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct 分为 Prelude、权重共享 Recurrent Block 与 Coda，设置保持恒等的一圈路径和后续循环的重入桥；在冻结基座权重上加 6M 适配器或在全块 180M 参数上训练，并结合中间步监督与 verbal fine-tuning。
Result: 适配器整体接近全块（83.8% 对 84.0%），在深度 11 前领先、之后落后；机制可外推到约 1.5 倍监督深度，深度 18 时保持 70% 准确率。同规模 scratchpad 模型在所学范围内匹配、超范围即崩溃，循环模型整体胜出（84% 对 72%），深度 10 之后保持率 53% 对 2.5%，回答速度快 7.6 倍；verbal fine-tuning 达到 79-86%，从已安装机制开始的适配器 verbal 训练比同等新训练高 18.6 分（含留出测试集）。
Conclusion: 摘要认为迭代 Transformer 能在隐空间中比同规模或更大的任务微调模型更快地执行更深推理；但反向规则任务在隔离时可学，任何延续训练都无法在保持已安装机制和通用能力的同时习得它，构成灾难性干扰边界，且学习到的深度选择仍未解决。

papers.title: Backtrader-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Algorithmic Trading with Self-Generated MCQs
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating LLM coding agents in algorithmic trading is difficult because static benchmarks risk data contamination and numerical backtest outputs require ground truth from actual code execution. We present Backtrader-Bench, a framework with two complementary pipelines. A deterministic multiple-choice question (MCQ) pipeline generates questions from backtest configurations across five trading strategies, 33 templates, and three difficulty tiers, with an independent checker that re-derives every answer. A generator-solver filtering pipeline autonomously mines harder questions: a generator writes questions verified by executable code, converts them to MCQs, and discards any that a no-tool solver can answer without code execution. We evaluate 11 models without tools (10 runs each) and four with-tools configurations on a 30-question curated set. Tool-augmented agents reach 90.0% accuracy in a single pass (GPT-5.5 and Opus 4.7), outperforming the best no-tools baselines (73.0%, averaged over 10 runs) by 17 percentage points. On 38 separately mined questions, no-tools accuracy drops further, with half the models falling to roughly random-chance level (25%). Beyond evaluation, the scalable MCQ infrastructure is designed to produce a training corpus for reinforcement learning, with the ultimate goal of building a specialized agent for quantitative trading workflows.
papers.comment: Accepted to the FinLLM Workshop at IJCAI 2026. Code and data: https://github.com/rzhao999/Backtrader-Bench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Backtrader-Bench，一个用于评估 LLM 编码智能体在算法交易中表现的框架，包含两条互补的流水线：确定性多项选择题（MCQ）流水线从回测配置生成问题，以及生成器-求解器过滤流水线自动挖掘更难的问题。作者在 30 道精选题上评估了 11 个无工具模型（各 10 次运行）和 4 个带工具配置，工具增强智能体单次通过达到 90.0% 准确率（GPT-5.5 和 Opus 4.7），比最优无工具基线（10 次平均 73.0%）高出 17 个百分点；在另外 38 道挖掘出的题目上，无工具准确率进一步下降，半数模型接近随机水平（25%）。该框架设计为可扩展的 MCQ 基础设施，旨在进一步生成强化学习训练语料。
Motivation: 在算法交易中评估 LLM 编码智能体很困难，因为静态基准存在数据污染风险，而数值回测输出需要真实代码执行得到的 ground truth。
Method: 提出双流水线框架：确定性 MCQ 流水线从跨五种交易策略、33 个模板和三个难度等级的回测配置生成问题，并由独立检查器重新推导每个答案；生成器-求解器过滤流水线自动挖掘更难的问题，生成器编写经过可执行代码验证的问题，转换为 MCQ，并丢弃无需代码执行即可回答的问题。
Result: 在 30 道精选问题上，工具增强智能体单次达到 90.0% 准确率（GPT-5.5 和 Opus 4.7），较最优无工具基线（10 次平均 73.0%）高 17 个百分点。在 38 道独立挖掘的问题上，无工具准确率进一步下降，一半模型降至约 25% 的随机水平。
Conclusion: 除评估外，该可扩展的 MCQ 基础设施被设计来生成强化学习训练语料，最终目标是构建面向量化交易工作流的专用智能体。

papers.title: LinearKV: One Cached State Suffices for Position-Independent Caching in Hybrid LLMs
papers.abstract_en: LLM serving is increasingly accelerated by position-independent caching (PIC). Existing PIC methods, however, are built for full-attention models, where a token-indexed KV cache underlies its core operations: matching reusable token chunks, concatenating their KV entries, and selectively recomputing a few tokens to restore cross-chunk context. Hybrid LLMs break these primitives---they replace most attention layers with linear recurrences that expose only a fixed-size state, leaving no token-indexed KV to concatenate or to locally repair. This raises a natural question: can PIC benefit hybrid models, and what would it take? We present LinearKV, a training-free hybrid-PIC framework. Its key insight is a \emph{decoupled initialization}: each linear layer maps its $K$ matched local states to a single initial state, while full-attention layers concatenate their KV as before. LinearKV is therefore compatible with existing PIC methods, reusing their token selection and recomputation as-is. Under this framework, we find that a \emph{single cached state} suffices as the linear layer's initializer. The algebraically principled alternative---composing all $K$ cached states into the exact full-prefix state, as concurrent work HYPIC does---is unnecessary and, on some architectures, even harmful. We compare the two across three hybrid models and three PIC selectors. On the two GDN models the two tie, both recovering most of full quality (up to $92\%$); on the Mamba-2 model, exact composition instead collapses under every selector---under EPIC, for instance, it recovers only $46.6\%$ of full quality, versus $86.8\%$ for a single cached block initializer. A single state initializer is also cheaper, cutting time-to-first-token to $0.46\times$ full prefill versus a further $5$--$17\%$ overhead for exact composition; results hold across LongBench QA and RULER at 8K--32K.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LinearKV，一个面向混合 LLM（hybrid LLMs）的训练无关的位置无关缓存（position-independent caching, PIC）框架。其核心是解耦初始化：每个线性层把 K 个匹配到的局部状态映射为单一初始状态，而全注意力层仍按原有方式拼接 KV，从而兼容现有 PIC 的 token 选择与重算逻辑。摘要报告在三个混合模型和三个 PIC 选择器上的对比表明，单一缓存状态初始化不仅更便宜，而且在某些架构上优于精确组合所有缓存状态的做法。
Motivation: 现有 PIC 方法建立在全注意力模型之上，依赖 token 索引的 KV 缓存来完成可复用片段匹配、KV 拼接和局部重算；混合 LLM 用线性递归替换了大部分注意力层，只暴露固定大小的状态，破坏这些原语。因此需要回答 PIC 能否惠及混合模型以及需要什么条件。
Method: 提出 LinearKV，关键思想是解耦初始化：每个线性层将其 K 个匹配的局部状态映射到一个初始状态，同时全注意力层照常拼接 KV。该框架与现有 PIC 方法兼容，直接复用其 token 选择与重算；并将单一缓存状态初始化与代数上更精确但更昂贵的完整前缀状态组合方案（并发工作 HYPIC）进行对比。
Result: 在两个 GDN 模型上两种初始化方法持平，均恢复大部分全质量（最高 92%）；在 Mamba-2 模型上，精确组合在所有选择器下崩溃，例如 EPIC 下仅恢复 46.6% 的全质量，而单一缓存块初始化恢复 86.8%。单一状态初始化还更便宜，将 time-to-first-token 降至全量 prefill 的 0.46 倍，而精确组合额外增加 5–17% 开销；结果在 LongBench QA 和 RULER 的 8K–32K 长度上成立。
Conclusion: 摘要的结论是：对混合 LLM 的线性层而言，单一缓存状态足以作为初始化器，而精确组合全部 K 个缓存状态为完整前缀状态既无必要，在某些架构上甚至有害；LinearKV 使混合模型可以直接复用现有 PIC 的 token 选择与重算机制。摘要未明确说明方法局限。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: The Edge-based Contiguous p-median Problem with Connections to Logistics Districting
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces the edge-based contiguous p-median (ECpM) problem to partition the roads in a network into a given number of compact and contiguous territories. Two binary programming models are introduced, both of which incorporate a network distance. The first model requires an exponential number of cut set-based constraints to model contiguity; it is paired with a separation scheme that usually generates only a small number of these constraints, namely, a branch-and-cut (B&C) algorithm. The second model utilizes a polynomial number of shortest-path constraints to model contiguity and can be solved with off-the-shelf solvers. The respective solution approaches are tested on road networks with over 2,700 nodes and close to 3,400 edges, yielding models with over 9.6 million binary variables. Solving the model based on shortest path contiguity (SPC) constraints via standard branch and bound attains speedups in computational time of up to 17x relative to the cut set-based B&C implementation. In addition, the SPC constraints are demonstrated to be supervalid inequalities of the edge-based p-median (EpM) model (i.e., for which contiguity is not explicitly required), meaning that they may cut off integer-feasible solutions and some, but not all, of the optimal solutions of this simpler problem. Finally, the paper explores structural insights and connections between ECpM and the edge-based districting (EBD) problem, which enforces an additional work balance criterion. An existing model that utilizes cut set-based contiguity constraints was unable to find a feasible solution within 12 hours for any of the tested instances, while an SPC-based EBD model was able to solve most of these to optimality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出边基连续 p-中位 (edge-based contiguous p-median, ECpM) 问题，用于将路网中的道路划分成给定数量的紧凑且连续的片区。作者给出两个引入网络距离的二进制规划模型：一个基于指数数量的割集约束并用分支切割 (branch-and-cut) 求解，另一个用多项式数量的最短路径连续性 (SPC) 约束建模，可直接用现成求解器求解。在超过 2,700 个节点、近 3,400 条边的路网上测试，模型包含超过 960 万个二进制变量；基于 SPC 约束的标准分支定界相对割集 B&C 实现最高获得 17 倍加速。
Motivation: 路网划分需要同时保证片区的紧凑性和连通性，而现有基于割集的连通性约束数量庞大、计算开销高，实际物流分区 (logistics districting) 场景下可能难以求解。
Method: 提出 ECpM 问题的两种二进制规划模型：第一种用指数数量割集约束建模连通性并配分离算法 (branch-and-cut)；第二种用多项式数量的最短路径连续性 (SPC) 约束建模连通性，可直接用现成求解器求解。论文还证明 SPC 约束是边基 p-中位 (EpM) 模型的超有效不等式 (supervalid inequalities)，并进一步研究 ECpM 与加入工作负荷平衡准则的边基分区 (EBD) 问题的联系。
Result: 在超过 2,700 节点、近 3,400 边的路网实例上，基于 SPC 的标准分支定界比割集 B&C 实现最多快 17 倍。现有基于割集连通性约束的 EBD 模型在 12 小时内无法为任何测试实例找到可行解，而基于 SPC 的 EBD 模型能对大多数实例求到最优。
Conclusion: SPC 约束为边基分区问题提供了一种更高效的连通性建模方式，并可作为 EpM 模型的超有效不等式；ECpM 与 EBD 之间的结构联系表明该框架可用于带工作平衡约束的物流分区。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 提出 ECpM 问题的两种二进制规划模型：第一种用指数数量割集约束建模连通性并配分离算法 (branch-and-cut)；第二种用多项式数量的最短路径连续性 (SPC) 约束建模连通性，可直接用现成求解器求解。论文还证明 SPC 约束是边基 p-中位 (EpM) 模型的超有效不等式 (supervalid inequalities)，并进一步研究 ECpM 与加入工作负荷平衡准则的边基分区 (EBD) 问题的联系。
summary_sections.result: 在超过 2,700 节点、近 3,400 边的路网实例上，基于 SPC 的标准分支定界比割集 B&C 实现最多快 17 倍。现有基于割集连通性约束的 EBD 模型在 12 小时内无法为任何测试实例找到可行解，而基于 SPC 的 EBD 模型能对大多数实例求到最优。
summary_sections.conclusion: SPC 约束为边基分区问题提供了一种更高效的连通性建模方式，并可作为 EpM 模型的超有效不等式；ECpM 与 EBD 之间的结构联系表明该框架可用于带工作平衡约束的物流分区。

papers.title: Synchronizing Beliefs with Second-Order Theory-of-Mind in Human-Autonomy Teams (Extended Version)
papers.abstract_en: Comparative feedback, asking people which of two behaviors they prefer, has become a standard way to align robot and agent behavior with human intent when the reward itself cannot be specified directly. Preference-based reward learning typically casts the human teacher as a passive oracle answering learner-generated queries. We argue this forfeits the teacher's defining advantage: knowledge of the objective. A teacher who knows the target can construct training examples more efficiently than any learner-driven acquisition strategy, an advantage that widens as the reward's feature dimension grows. However, exploiting this advantage requires an accurate model of what the learner currently knows. We therefore recast preference learning as a human-autonomy team problem coupling two behavioral models: the teacher maintains a model of the learner to design an informative curriculum, and the learner maintains a second-order model of the teacher's model, emitting structured preference constraints (understanding statements) that keep the teacher's model of the learner synchronized. In simulation, an informed teacher outperforms learner-led selection; teacher-model drift under alternating teachers erodes this advantage; and understanding statements repair it, with second-order (ToM-2) statements outperforming mean-belief statements when the teacher's error about the learner is concentrated in a particular direction rather than spread evenly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把偏好学习 (preference-based reward learning) 重新表述为一个人机自主团队问题：教师维护对学习者的模型来设计教学课程，学习者则维护对教师模型的二阶模型，并发出结构化的偏好约束（理解陈述，understanding statements）来让教师的模型保持同步。模拟实验显示，知情教师优于学习者主导的选择；交替教师造成的教师模型漂移会削弱这一优势；理解陈述可以修复漂移，且当教师的错误集中在特定方向而非均匀分布时，二阶 (ToM-2) 陈述优于均值信念陈述。
Motivation: 现有偏好学习通常将人类教师视为被动 oracle，只会回答学习者生成的查询，这浪费了教师对目标 (objective) 的知识；而利用这种知识需要准确建模学习者当前所知。作者主张将偏好学习建模为耦合教师与学习者两种行为模型的人机团队问题。
Method: 提出耦合两个行为模型的框架：教师维护学习者模型以设计更具信息量的课程，学习者维护教师模型的二阶模型，并生成结构化的偏好约束（理解陈述）来同步教师对学习者的认知。
Result: 模拟结果显示知情教师优于学习者主导的选择；交替教师导致的教师模型漂移会侵蚀优势；理解陈述能修复漂移，且当教师的误差方向集中时，二阶 (ToM-2) 陈述优于均值信念 (mean-belief) 陈述。
Conclusion: 作者认为利用教师的目标知识需要精确建模学习者，而二阶心智理论 (second-order theory-of-mind) 陈述有助于维持团队成员之间的信念同步。
Relevance: 2
