papers.title: Forecasting Side Effects of Activation Steering
papers.abstract_en: Activation steering modifies a language model by adding a learned direction to its hidden activations, enabling targeted behavioral changes without retraining. While effective, steering often produces unintended side effects on other behaviors, making it difficult to deploy safely. We therefore ask: can these side effects be forecasted before steering is applied? We answer this question by constructing a cross-effect matrix over a taxonomy of 67 behaviors across three open-weight language models. We find that side effects are common, structured, and often asymmetric, revealing interactions that cannot be explained by existing similarity-based heuristics. Despite this complexity, we show that side effects are largely predictable before steering is performed. Their magnitude depends primarily on the target behavior, while their direction can be forecasted from the model's unsteered representations with substantially higher accuracy than simple baselines. Our results demonstrate that activation steering has systematic and forecastable side effects, enabling proactive safety auditing and more informed deployment of steering interventions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究激活操控 (activation steering) 在修改语言模型行为时产生的副作用能否在施加操控前被预测。作者在三个开放权重语言模型上构建覆盖 67 种行为的交叉效应矩阵，发现副作用普遍、结构化且常不对称，且幅度主要取决于目标行为，方向可从未操控的表示中预测。结果表明激活操控的副作用是系统且可预测的，可用于主动安全审计。
Motivation: 激活操控无需重训即可实现定向行为改变，但往往在其他行为上引发意外副作用，影响安全部署；因此需要一种在施加操控前预判副作用的方法。
Method: 作者通过构建 67 种行为上的交叉效应矩阵 (cross-effect matrix)，在三个开放权重语言模型上系统测量副作用，并利用模型未操控时的表示预测副作用方向，与基于相似性的启发式基线进行比较。
Result: 摘要报告副作用在模型中常见、结构化且常不对称，无法由现有相似性启发式解释；副作用幅度主要取决于目标行为，而方向预测的准确率显著高于简单基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调激活操控的副作用具有系统性并可预测，能够支持主动安全审计以及更知情的部署决策。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Cutting AI Datacenter Energy with Reinforcement Learning: Measured Power Control of LLM Training from One GPU to the Fleet
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement-learning post-training dominates modern language-model development, yet its power behavior on GPU hardware has not been characterized, and datacenters manage GPU power with workload-blind mechanisms, static caps and reactive throttling, that slow hardware indiscriminately. We instrument GRPO training with half-second power telemetry at 7B, 14B, and 72B scales on one to four A100s (380,000+ samples), and train a PPO meta-controller that adapts the workload's own generation parameters to measured power. Against the full 500-step 7B trace, the controller cuts power-limit violations by 89.8% while increasing token output by 18.1% and energy efficiency by 26.2% (tokens per MWh). Deployed live at 72B, the same controller family yields replicated null results, diagnosed as the group-size actuator losing authority under model sharding. An actuator-authority sweep shows the same parameters applied as generation concurrency retain 17-22% power authority, isolating an occupancy-versus-volume principle; a controller rebuilt on that actuator controls a live 72B rollout-generation workload across three replications: 35.7% more output than a static safe baseline at 2.27 +/- 1.08% budget violations, 87.2% fewer violations than uncontrolled operation, and the best mean throughput and energy per token among constrained controllers, with an adaptive threshold rule matching it in one of three operating conditions. Under realistic measurement windows the original 72B transients fall from 23.6% at half-second resolution to 1.6% at 30 s and zero at 5 min; a composed 16-GPU fleet shows zero violations at 30 s and longer, with peak demand at 50-56% of nameplate. For this fleet mix, roughly twofold oversubscription of nameplate appears feasible, subject to operator validation. We quantify the economic and carbon consequences and specify a low-cost operator pilot.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次刻画强化学习后训练（GRPO）在GPU上的功率行为，并在7B/14B/72B规模、1至4块A100上采集半秒级功率遥测。作者训练一个PPO元控制器，调整训练自身的生成参数来响应实测功率：在7B上减少89.8%的功率上限违规并提升18.1%的token输出和26.2%的能效。72B在线部署出现重复的无效结果，被诊断为模型分片导致组大小执行器失效；改用生成并发作为执行器后，72B在线 rollout 生成在三次重复中实现35.7%更高输出、2.27±1.08%预算违规率。
Motivation: 数据中心使用与工作负载无关的静态功率上限和反应式限流机制管理GPU功率，但这些机制不区分硬件地降速。强化学习后训练已成为主流，但其GPU功率行为此前未被刻画，缺少能适应工作负载自身参数的功率控制手段。
Method: 对GRPO训练进行半秒级功率遥测，采集38万以上样本；训练一个PPO元控制器，以实测功率为观测，调整工作负载自身的生成参数（组大小、生成并发）作为执行器。随后进行执行器权威扫描，并在16-GPU组合舰队上分析测量窗口对违规率的影响。
Result: 在7B完整500步轨迹上，控制器减少89.8%的功率上限违规，同时提高18.1%的token输出和26.2%的能效（tokens per MWh）。72B下原执行器在模型分片时失效；改为生成并发后，72B在线负载的违规率从23.6%（半秒窗口）降至30秒窗口的1.6%和5分钟窗口的0；16-GPU舰队在30秒及以上窗口零违规，峰值需求为铭牌功率的50-56%。
Conclusion: 对于该舰队组合，约两倍的铭牌功率超订（oversubscription）看起来可行，但需运营商验证；作者量化了经济与碳影响，并给出低成本运营商试点方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Identity from the Outside: A Conceptual Framework and Research Program for AI Personality Clones
papers.abstract_en: AI "personality clones" force a re-examination of personal identity in operational terms. Setting aside the hard problem of consciousness, we approach identity through the indiscernibility of manifestations, as assessed by an observer over a duration. We distinguish three criteria that "identity" conflates: fidelity to a target person, generic human-likeness, and individuality. We propose a six-term factorization of observed identity (substrate, dispositions, memory, update dynamics, context, exogenous contingencies), with a state-space formulation. Indiscernibility is defined as one minus a judge's distinguishing advantage, and the factorization's coefficients become local sensitivities estimable by randomized ablation. The central claim is a conditional conjecture: given hypotheses about the agent's information on its own persistence and about consequences bearing on its own stakes, versionability tends to degrade long-horizon indiscernibility. An analogy with lambda-calculus, linear typing, and bisimulation clarifies what linearity does and does not establish. Between product-clone and individual we identify a third object, the delegate: a task-limited, bounded-lifespan partial clone ending in a bandwidth-limited testament. We map the empirical literature onto the three criteria, propose an experimental program, and argue that the correct long-horizon criterion is not trajectory fidelity but climate fidelity: matching the conditional distribution of a person's possible responses. The best clone is the one that diverges from the original as the original would have diverged from itself.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个针对 AI 人格克隆 (personality clones) 的概念框架与研究议程，搁置意识难题，将身份操作化为观察者在时间跨度上对表现 (manifestations) 不可区分性的判断。作者区分忠实度、类人性和个体性三种标准，提出六项身份分解因子，并主张长期视角下应追求气候保真 (climate fidelity) 而非轨迹保真。整篇为理论性工作，核心是一个条件性猜想。
Motivation: AI 人格克隆迫使人们以操作性术语重新审视个人身份；已有讨论常混淆忠实度、类人性和个体性三个标准，且缺乏可估计、可验证的量化框架。
Method: 提出将观察到的身份分解为六个因子（substrate、dispositions、memory、update dynamics、context、exogenous contingencies）并用状态空间表述；将不可区分性定义为 1 减去评判者的区分优势，其系数可用随机消融 (randomized ablation) 估计。还引入 delegate 作为介于 product-clone 与 individual 之间的第三类对象，并用 lambda 演算、线性类型与双模拟 (bisimulation) 作类比。
Result: 摘要未报告实证数据；其核心主张是一个条件性猜想：在关于智能体对自身持续存在的信息以及影响其自身利害后果的假设下，版本化 (versionability) 倾向于降低长期不可区分性。
Conclusion: 作者认为长期正确的判据不是轨迹保真而是气候保真，即匹配一个人可能响应的条件分布；最好的克隆应以原个体自我分化的方式偏离原个体。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Harnessing agent memory to build lifelong AI partners for materials scientists
papers.abstract_en: Materials research advances through accumulated experience - scripts that work, protocols that are trusted, warnings attached to failed calculations or experiments, and judgement that links a new question to an old result. This experience is essential for reproducibility and knowledge transfer, yet it is usually fragmented across notebooks, repositories, job logs and individual memory, and it is rarely portable across artificial-intelligence agents. Here we argue that a lifelong AI partner for materials science can be designed around persistent memory rather than around a particular agent implementation. We introduce a self-evolving memory framework that stores scientific experience as inspectable facts and executable skills, so that observations, failure boundaries, protocols and validation checks can be retrieved, revised and migrated across models. We evaluate the idea in three computational settings that expose different layers of materials-research competence. In 49 real-world materials-tool-use questions comprising 138 executable subtasks, memory nearly doubles GPT-5.2 task success without model-parameter updates. In elemental-solid equation-of-state calculations, memory converts a wavefunction-initialization failure into a pre-execution guardrail, improving outcomes from 22/1/4 to 25/2/0 Correct/Partial/Error and avoiding 92% of repeated errors. In 13 practical material simulation workflows, remembered skills and failure facts halve the aggregate trace burden (tokens) and reduce tool calls by over a factor of two by the third round, while preserving physically meaningful outputs in band-gap, phonon, vacancy and work-function analyses. These results show that agent memory can serve as a durable scientific asset; a portable, self-improving record of materials-research experience that outlives any single model or agent stack.

TL;DR: 本文提出以持久记忆为核心构建材料科学终身AI伙伴的框架，将科学经验存储为可检查的事实与可执行技能，使其能在不同模型间检索、修订和迁移。摘要报告在49个真实材料工具使用问题（含138个可执行子任务）上，记忆机制使GPT-5.2任务成功率接近翻倍而无需更新模型参数；在元素固体状态方程计算和13个实际模拟工作流中分别减少了重复错误与token/工具调用负担。
Motivation: 材料研究的经验（可用的脚本、可信协议、失败警告和跨问题判断）对可复现性与知识传递至关重要，但通常碎片化地分布于笔记本、代码仓库、作业日志和个人记忆中，且难以跨AI智能体移植。论文因此主张终身AI伙伴应围绕持久记忆而非特定智能体实现来设计。
Method: 提出一个自演化的记忆框架，把科学经验编码为可检查的事实（facts）和可执行的技能（skills），支持对观察、失败边界、协议和验证检查的检索、修订以及跨模型迁移，而不依赖具体智能体实现。
Result: 在49个真实材料工具使用问题中，记忆使GPT-5.2任务成功率几乎翻倍且无需模型参数更新；在元素固体状态方程计算中，记忆把波函数初始化失败转化为执行前防护，结果由Correct/Partial/Error的22/1/4改善为25/2/0，并避免92%的重复错误；在13个实际材料模拟工作流中，记忆使累计trace负担（token数）减半，第三轮起工具调用减少超过一半，同时带隙、声子、空位和功函数分析仍保持物理有效输出。
Conclusion: 摘要认为智能体记忆可以成为一种持久、可移植、自改进的科学资产，是超越任何单一模型或智能体栈的材料研究经验记录。

papers.title: Transit Destination Inference from Tap-In-Only Bus Smart-Card Data: A Hierarchical Bayesian Approach
papers.abstract_en: Entry-only automatic fare collection systems record boardings but not alightings, preventing direct construction of origin-destination (OD) matrices. This study develops a Hierarchical Bayesian Latent-Destination (HBLD) model that combines station-hour boarding and inferred alighting demand with passenger card histories. Trip-chain destinations are treated as noisy evidence with a reliability parameter, allowing destination uncertainty to propagate into OD flows. The model was applied to 838,305 bus tap-ins collected in Changzhou in May 2025 and linked to stop-network and hourly weather data. It estimates destination distributions over feasible downstream and reverse-direction through-terminal stops using network, time-of-day, weather, and smoothed historical demand effects. A Bayesian personalization layer uses prior card trips and reverts to the shared trip-level distribution when history is unavailable. Fitted by stochastic variational inference and evaluated on the final week, HBLD outperformed the strongest baseline. Observed boarding patterns consistently improved prediction, especially without card history, while inferred alighting patterns helped only when trip-chain evidence was strongly trusted. The model captured travel consistent with through-terminal riding and bus-assisted road crossing and estimated destinations for trips unresolved by deterministic chaining. Because true alightings were unavailable, scores measure agreement with trip-chain outputs rather than actual destination accuracy. HBLD provides uncertainty-aware destination predictions and OD matrices for service management, planning, scheduling, and resource allocation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种分层贝叶斯潜目的地（HBLD）模型，用于从仅记录刷上（tap-in）的公交智能卡数据推断乘客下车目的地，从而构建OD矩阵。模型将行程链目的地视为带可靠性参数的噪声证据，结合网络、时段、天气和平滑的历史需求估计可行下游及反方向终点站的目的地分布。模型应用于常州市2025年5月的838,305条刷上记录，用随机变分推断拟合并在最后一周评估中超过最强基线。由于缺少真实下车数据，评估指标衡量的是与行程链输出的一致性而非实际目的地准确度。
Motivation: 仅刷上自动售检票系统记录了上车但未记录下车，无法直接构建起讫点（OD）矩阵，阻碍了公交服务管理与规划。
Method: 提出分层贝叶斯潜目的地模型，将站小时上车量与推断的下车需求及乘客卡历史结合；通过贝叶斯个性化层利用先验卡行程，在无历史时回退到共享行程级分布；采用随机变分推断（stochastic variational inference）拟合。
Result: 在常州市838,305条公交刷上记录（2025年5月）的应用中，模型在最后一周评估中优于最强基线；观察到上车模式持续改善预测（尤其是无卡历史时），而推断的下车模式仅在行程链证据被高度信任时才有帮助，并成功估计了确定性链式方法无法解决的目的地。
Conclusion: 由于真实下车数据不可得，分数只能反映与行程链输出的一致性而非真实目的地的准确性；HBLD提供不确定性感知的目的地预测和OD矩阵，可服务于运营管理、规划、排班和资源配置。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: A Conceptual Framework for Refining Influence Knowledge from Simulation Evidence in Cyber-Physical Systems
papers.abstract_en: Cyber-physical systems (CPS) are typically developed by multiple stakeholders who produce artefacts tailored to their specific domains of expertise. The behaviour of these systems emerges from the interaction between those artefacts and their operational environment. Simulation and co-simulation have become essential approaches for analysing CPS behaviour and, through simulation campaigns, developers can explore system responses under changing conditions, including interactions with the environment. However, the lack of details and understanding of some environmentmediated interactions (typically the ones beyond direct sensing and actuation), which remain unmodelled due to their complexity, a lack of time, or a lack of domain experience, hinders the proper comprehension and exploitation of simulation results. To address these limitations, we propose a conceptual framework leveraging the novel concept of Influences to support the iterative and incremental refinement of simulation campaigns and deepen the understanding of the system behaviour. We demonstrate the proposed approach through a case study involving a mobile robot implemented using Simulink/Gazebo co-simulation.
papers.journal_ref: ACM/IEEE 29th International Conference on Model Driven Engineering Languages and Systems, Oct 2026, Malaga, Spain
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向网络物理系统 (CPS) 的仿真与协同仿真 (co-simulation) 场景，提出一个基于新型“Influences”概念的概念框架，用于迭代、增量地细化仿真活动并加深对系统行为的理解。作者通过一个基于 Simulink/Gazebo 协同仿真的移动机器人案例研究来演示该框架，但摘要未给出定量评估结果。
Motivation: CPS 通常由多个领域利益相关方开发，系统行为取决于各领域工件之间及其与运行环境的交互。仿真中很多由环境中介的交互（超出直接感知与执行范围）因复杂、时间或领域经验不足而未被建模，导致仿真结果难以被正确理解和利用。
Method: 提出一个概念框架，引入“Influences”概念来显式刻画和细化仿真活动中的影响关系，从而支持迭代、增量式地改进仿真活动 (simulation campaigns) 并深化对系统行为的理解。
Result: 摘要报告了该框架在一个使用 Simulink/Gazebo 协同仿真的移动机器人案例研究中的应用，展示了所提方法的可行性，但没有提供定量的性能指标或对比实验。
Conclusion: 论文将自身定位为一个概念框架，旨在弥补环境中介交互未建模所导致的仿真结果理解不足；通过单一案例研究进行初步验证，未涉及定量评估或广泛适用性的讨论。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LLMs in Process Diagram Engineering: From Optimal PFDs to Validated P&IDs
papers.abstract_en: Nowadays, the creation of a process flow diagram (PFD) and its subsequent transformation into a piping and instrumentation diagram (P&ID) is predominantly performed manually. Applying artificial intelligence in the task could potentially lead not only to process automation and time savings, but also to financial gains by exploring numerous diagram's topology options and reducing manual labor. This research presents P&ID Pilot - a practical end-to-end AI pipeline capable of handling flowsheet developing for both stages. The first stage focuses on PFD synthesis, whereas the second is directed toward modifying the generated PFD into P&ID. After comparing four different methods, the hybrid approach combining genetic algorithms (GA) and large language models (LLM) is shown to generate the optimal valid PFD topology, achieving the lowest loss value among all the methods, while satisfying the required outlet flow parameters without engineering-rule violations. For the second stage, the proposed LLM-based agent successfully transforms the generated PFD into a source-grounded P&ID by producing validated, executable modifications through a restricted engineering software development kit, achieving 100% execution success while maintaining compliance with domain-specific rules and reference graph structures. This unified pipeline - coupling GA/LLM-driven synthesis with an LLM-based transformation agent - offers a feasible path toward end-to-end process design automation by producing validated, deployable outputs and substantially reduces manual engineering effort.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 P&ID Pilot，一个面向流程工业的两阶段端到端 AI 管线，用于流程流程图 (PFD) 合成及其到管道仪表图 (P&ID) 的自动转换。第一阶段比较四种方法，其中遗传算法 (GA) 与大语言模型 (LLM) 结合的混合方法生成最优且满足工程规则的 PFD 拓扑；第二阶段利用基于 LLM 的智能体通过受限工程软件开发工具包将 PFD 转换为可执行的 P&ID。作者报告该管线在满足领域规则和参考图结构的同时显著减少人工工程工作量。
Motivation: PFD 的创建及其到 P&ID 的转换目前主要依赖人工完成，既耗时又成本高；引入 AI 不仅能自动化流程、节省时间，还能通过探索多种拓扑方案带来经济效益。
Method: 提出端到端管线 P&ID Pilot：第一阶段用遗传算法与大语言模型结合的混合方法合成 PFD 拓扑；第二阶段用基于 LLM 的智能体，通过受限工程软件开发工具包 (SDK) 生成源可溯源的 P&ID 修改并确保其可执行。
Result: 在四种方法对比中，GA/LLM 混合方法的损失值最低，且满足出口流量参数要求、不违反工程规则；LLM 智能体阶段达到 100% 的执行成功率，并保持与领域特定规则和参考图结构一致。
Conclusion: 该统一管线将 GA/LLM 驱动的合成与 LLM 转换智能体结合，为端到端流程设计自动化提供了可行路径，能产出经过验证、可部署的结果，并大幅减少人工工程投入。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: From Monolithic to Modular: Segment-level Automatic Prompt Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Automatic Prompt Optimization (APO) often rewrites prompts monolithically, which can improve one behavior while degrading others. We present SAPO, a segment-level APO method that decomposes prompts into role, context, tasks, and output format, then applies targeted improvements based on top-5 and bottom-5 examples. The optimization loop uses one LLM with static meta-prompts and structured outputs for segmentation, weakness analysis, and candidate generation. We describe a train/validation protocol and a two-stage generation process: (1) segment-level diagnosis and recommendation extraction, (2) candidate synthesis constrained by weak/strong segment signals. Using the evaluation setup across SQuADv2, TweetEval, XSUM, CommonGen, and GSM8K on GPT-3.5-Turbo and GPT-4o-mini, SAPO achieves the best average score against Zero-shot and strong APO baselines including APE, OPRO, EvoPrompt, GEPA, and StraGO.
papers.comment: Accepted at the IJCAI-ECAI 2026 Workshop on Robustifying Generative AI for Reliable, Safe, and Human-Centric Systems (RobustifAI)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAPO，一种段落级 (segment-level) 自动提示优化方法，将提示分解为角色、上下文、任务和输出格式四个段落，并基于 top-5 与 bottom-5 样例进行针对性改进。优化循环使用单个 LLM 配合静态元提示和结构化输出来完成段落分割、弱点分析与候选生成。在 SQuADv2、TweetEval、XSUM、CommonGen 和 GSM8K 上以 GPT-3.5-Turbo 与 GPT-4o-mini 评测，SAPO 的平均得分优于 Zero-shot 和 APE、OPRO、EvoPrompt、GEPA、StraGO 等强基线。
Motivation: 现有自动提示优化 (APO) 通常以整体方式重写提示，可能改善某一行为的同时损害其他行为。
Method: SAPO 将提示分解为角色、上下文、任务和输出格式，并利用 top-5 与 bottom-5 样例做针对性改进；优化循环采用单个 LLM 和静态元提示、结构化输出来完成段落级分割、弱点分析与候选生成，并采用两阶段生成：先做段落级诊断与建议提取，再在强弱段落信号约束下合成候选。
Result: 在 SQuADv2、TweetEval、XSUM、CommonGen 和 GSM8K 上，使用 GPT-3.5-Turbo 和 GPT-4o-mini，SAPO 的平均得分超过 Zero-shot 以及 APE、OPRO、EvoPrompt、GEPA 和 StraGO 等基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为段落级分解与弱/强段落信号约束的生成过程有助于避免整体重写导致的副作用，并给出了相应的训练/验证协议。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 SAPO，一种段落级 (segment-level) 自动提示优化方法，将提示分解为角色、上下文、任务和输出格式四个段落，并基于 top-5 与 bottom-5 样例进行针对性改进。优化循环使用单个 LLM 配合静态元提示和结构化输出来完成段落分割、弱点分析与候选生成。在 SQuADv2、TweetEval、XSUM、CommonGen 和 GSM8K 上以 GPT-3.5-Turbo 与 GPT-4o-mini 评测，SAPO 的平均得分优于 Zero-shot 和 APE、OPRO、EvoPrompt、GEPA、StraGO 等强基线。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有自动提示优化 (APO) 通常以整体方式重写提示，可能改善某一行为的同时损害其他行为。
summary_sections.method: SAPO 将提示分解为角色、上下文、任务和输出格式，并利用 top-5 与 bottom-5 样例做针对性改进；优化循环采用单个 LLM 和静态元提示、结构化输出来完成段落级分割、弱点分析与候选生成，并采用两阶段生成：先做段落级诊断与建议提取，再在强弱段落信号约束下合成候选。

papers.title: MaSRead: Content-Addressed Reading of Replicated Latent Stores
papers.abstract_en: Independent agents that reason in latent space can share computed state as key-value cache fragments rather than text. Merged by a conflict-free replicated data type, these fragments form a store that converges under any delivery order or duplication. Yet a later query, unknown at encode time, cannot reliably read the merged cache: colocated fragments interfere, so colocation is not addressability. MaSRead addresses the read to content. It routes through opaque keyed tag sets derived from fragment words and decodes each selected fragment under a hard attention mask that hides the rest. Under lexical connectivity, a graph walk reaches the fragments required by a multi-hop query. Across chain, pipeline, symmetric, hub, and natural-language stores, MaSRead recovers visited fragments in isolation, remains effective as unrelated fragments accumulate, and transfers to another model family. After routing, materialized decoding depends on fragment length rather than total store size; end-to-end work still includes store-dependent routing and one read per visited fragment. The limits are explicit: lexical routing can miss disconnected evidence, and answer composition remains bounded by the frozen reader. Thus a replicated latent store becomes selectively readable for later queries when the needed fragments connect to the query through content.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MaSRead，一种针对复制潜在存储（replicated latent store）的内容寻址读取机制。多个智能体在潜在空间中共享 key-value 缓存片段，并通过无冲突复制数据类型（CRDT）合并，但编码时未知的后续查询无法可靠读取合并后的缓存。MaSRead 通过不透明键标签集进行路由，并在硬注意力掩码下解码选定片段；在词法连通条件下，图遍历可到达多跳查询所需片段，且对孤立读取具有鲁棒性并可迁移到其他模型族。
Motivation: 在潜在空间中独立推理的智能体可以共享计算状态，但合并后的缓存片段相互干扰，导致共置（colocation）并不等于可寻址性；编码时未知的后续查询无法可靠读取合并后的缓存。
Method: MaSRead 把读取定向到内容：经由从片段词派生的不透明键标签集（opaque keyed tag sets）路由，并在硬注意力掩码（hard attention mask）下逐个解码选中片段以隐藏其余片段；在词法连通（lexical connectivity）条件下，通过图遍历（graph walk）获取多跳查询所需的片段。
Result: 在链式、流水线、对称、枢纽（hub）和自然语言存储上，MaSRead 能在隔离状态下恢复已访问片段，随无关片段累积仍保持有效，并可迁移到另一模型族；路由后的物化解码开销取决于片段长度而非总存储大小，端到端工作仍包括与存储相关的路由以及每个访问片段的一次读取。
Conclusion: 作者明确给出限制：词法路由可能漏掉不连通的证据，答案组合受限于冻结的读取器（frozen reader）；只要所需片段通过与查询的内容联系相连，复制潜在存储就能对后续查询实现选择性读取。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AutoWorldModel-Bench: A State-Centric Benchmark for Automated World-Model Research
papers.abstract_en: World modeling is an unsettled field: architectures, training objectives, and state representations interact in complex ways, and no single recipe dominates across environments. This makes it an ideal testbed for AI coding agents acting as autonomous researchers--a setting in which the improvement direction is not specified in advance, unlike the engineering-to-spec tasks that dominate current agent benchmarks. We introduce AutoWorldModel-Bench, a closed-loop benchmark in which frontier coding agents autonomously improve a provided world-model starter under a fixed compute budget. The benchmark spans eight game environments under a unified structured-state representation--ground-truth entity state extracted from each game and consumed through a shared tensor format--which isolates dynamics modeling from perception and enables minutes-per-run iteration. Across 64 sessions, Codex-5.4 and Claude Opus 4.6 improve their starter on 63; in 91% of sessions the winning edit is a non-trivial research-style modification--a new objective, representation, rollout procedure, or architectural change--rather than a hyperparameter tweak. Our benchmark offers a setting in which frontier coding agents can be evaluated on open-ended research rather than engineering-to-spec problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AutoWorldModel-Bench，一个闭环基准，用于评测前沿编码智能体作为自主研究者改进世界模型 (world model) 的能力。基准覆盖 8 个游戏环境，采用统一结构化状态表示，将动力学建模与感知隔离，支持分钟级迭代。在 64 个会话中，Codex-5.4 和 Claude Opus 4.6 在 63 个会话中改进了起点模型，其中 91% 的获胜编辑属于非平凡的研究型修改。
Motivation: 世界建模领域尚未定型，架构、训练目标和状态表示之间交互复杂，没有单一方案能在所有环境中占优，因此适合作为开放式研究测试床。现有智能体基准多为 engineering-to-spec 任务，改进方向预先给定，而该工作希望评测智能体在未指定改进方向时的自主研究能力。
Method: 提出闭环评测协议：给定一个世界模型 starter 和固定计算预算，让编码智能体自主改进模型，并在一组游戏环境中用统一的真实实体状态张量形式进行评测，从而把动力学建模与感知分离并加速迭代。
Result: 摘要报告在 64 个会话中，Codex-5.4 和 Claude Opus 4.6 在 63 个会话中提升了 starter；91% 的会话中获胜编辑是新的目标函数、表示、回滚过程或架构变化，而非超参数调整。
Conclusion: 作者认为该基准为在开放式研究任务（而非工程到规范任务）上评估前沿编码智能体提供了可行设置。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Poor Man's Agentic Modeling: Simulating Large LLM-Agent Societies on a Laptop
papers.abstract_en: Simulating societies of many large language model (LLM) agents is expensive, yet the questions asked of such simulations are usually macroscopic: phase behaviour, stylised facts, and scaling with the number of agents $N$, not the cognition of any single agent. We turn a statistical-physics observation into a method: replace each LLM agent by a low-parameter model fitted from a few hundred to a few thousand cheap queries, then run the society at any $N$ on a laptop. Whether this works is decided before the simulation runs, chiefly by what each agent perceives. We introduce an [interaction order x memory] taxonomy that maps perception and memory to an effective theory and a predicted $N$-trend of the surrogate error. We validate it on a faithful reimplementation of the LLM macroeconomy EconAgent and seven further named LLM simulations, with agent decisions cloned from genuine LLM elicitations (primarily DeepSeek) for a few dollars; the predicted error trends hold cell by cell, and the two refuted predictions, both on a strongly saturating response and traced to its curvature, are themselves matched quantitatively by the theory with no free parameters.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 12 figures. Code and data at github.com/YehudaItkin/poor-mans-agentic-modeling; systematic review and pre-registration archived at Zenodo (doi:10.5281/zenodo.21198322, doi:10.5281/zenodo.21340310)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种在笔记本电脑上模拟大规模 LLM 智能体社会的低成本方法：将每个智能体替换为由几百到几千次廉价查询拟合出的低参数模型，从而以任意智能体数量 N 运行社会模拟。作者引入 [交互阶数 x 记忆]（interaction order x memory）分类法，将感知与记忆映射到有效理论（effective theory）和代理误差（surrogate error）的 N 趋势预测，并在 EconAgent 重实现及另外七个 LLM 模拟上验证。摘要报告预测的误差趋势逐格成立，两个被推翻的预测也由无自由参数的理论定量匹配。
Motivation: 模拟大量 LLM 智能体社会成本高昂，但这类模拟关心的问题通常是宏观的，如相行为、典型事实（stylised facts）和随智能体数量 N 的标度行为，而非单个智能体的认知机制。现有方法难以低成本地扩展到任意规模的智能体社会。
Method: 将统计物理的观察转化为方法：用从少量廉价查询中拟合的低参数模型替代每个 LLM 智能体，然后在笔记本电脑上以任意 N 运行社会模拟。同时提出 [交互阶数 x 记忆] 分类法，把智能体的感知与记忆映射到有效理论，并据此预测代理误差随 N 的变化趋势。
Result: 在 EconAgent 的忠实重实现及其他七个具名 LLM 模拟上验证，智能体决策从真实 LLM 启发（主要是 DeepSeek）克隆，成本仅数美元。预测的误差趋势在各单元上成立；两个被推翻的预测均涉及强饱和响应（strongly saturating response），且被无自由参数的理论定量匹配。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，基于感知-记忆分类法的代理模型能够以可预测的误差趋势在笔记本电脑上运行大规模 LLM 智能体社会，使研究宏观社会现象不再依赖昂贵的全量 LLM 推理。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: WavePhaseNet: A DFT-Based Method for Constructing Semantic Conceptual Hierarchy Structures (SCHS)
papers.abstract_en: This paper reformulates Transformer/Attention mechanisms in Large Language Models (LLMs) through measure theory and frequency analysis, theoretically demonstrating that hallucination is an inevitable structural limitation. The embedding space functions as a conditional expectation over a σ-algebra, and its failure to be isomorphic to the semantic truth set fundamentally causes logical consistency breakdown. WavePhaseNet Method The authors propose WavePhaseNet, which explicitly constructs a Semantic Conceptual Hierarchy Structure (SCHS) using Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT). By applying DFT along the sequence dimension, semantic information is decomposed into frequency bands: low-frequency components capture global meaning and intent, while high-frequency components represent local syntax and expression. This staged separation enables precise semantic manipulation in diagonalized space. Dimensionality Reduction GPT-4's 24,576-dimensional embedding space exhibits a 1/f spectral structure based on language self-similarity and Zipf's law. Through cumulative energy analysis, the authors derive that approximately 3,000 dimensions constitute the lower bound for "complete representation." This demonstrates that reduction from 24,576 to 3,000 dimensions preserves meaning and intent while enabling rigorous reasoning and suppressing hallucination. Cohomological Consistency Control The reduced embedding space, constructed via cohomological regularization over overlapping local windows, allows defining a graph structure and cochain complex. This quantifies inconsistencies among local inferences as coboundary-based losses. Applying harmonic projection based on Hodge theory positions cohomology as a computable regularization principle for controlling semantic consistency, extracting maximally consistent global representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从测度论与频率分析角度重新表述 Transformer/Attention 机制，论证幻觉是 LLM 的结构性必然缺陷：嵌入空间作为 σ-代数上的条件期望，无法与语义真值集同构，从而导致逻辑一致性崩塌。作者提出 WavePhaseNet，用离散傅里叶变换 (DFT) 沿序列维度将语义分解为不同频带（低频对应全局意义，高频对应局部句法），并给出 GPT-4 嵌入空间从 24,576 维约减到约 3,000 维的下界论证；最后用上同调正则化与 Hodge 理论的调和投影来量化并控制局部推理间的不一致性。
Motivation: 大语言模型的幻觉被指出并非偶然错误，而是嵌入空间的数学结构限制所决定；现有方法缺少对语义空间的规范性构造，导致局部推理之间的一致性问题难以形式化。
Method: 提出 WavePhaseNet 方法：沿序列维度施加 DFT，将语义信息按频带分离以在对角化空间中进行操作；通过累计能量分析导出约 3,000 维的完整表示下界；在重叠局部窗口上构造上同调正则化，以余边界（coboundary）损失量化局部推理不一致性，并基于 Hodge 理论应用调和投影提取全局一致表示。
Result: 摘要报告 GPT-4 的 24,576 维嵌入空间呈现基于语言自相似与 Zipf 定律的 1/f 频谱结构，且约 3,000 维构成“完整表示”的下界；从 24,576 维到约 3,000 维的约减在保持意义与意图的同时，能够支持严格推理并抑制幻觉。
Conclusion: 作者将幻觉定位为嵌入空间与语义真值集非同构所带来的不可避免结构限制，并把上同调刻画为可计算的语义一致性正则化原则。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 GPT-4 的 24,576 维嵌入空间呈现基于语言自相似与 Zipf 定律的 1/f 频谱结构，且约 3,000 维构成“完整表示”的下界；从 24,576 维到约 3,000 维的约减在保持意义与意图的同时，能够支持严格推理并抑制幻觉。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者将幻觉定位为嵌入空间与语义真值集非同构所带来的不可避免结构限制，并把上同调刻画为可计算的语义一致性正则化原则。

papers.title: Detecting a Route Flip Is Easier Than Knowing Whether to Fix It: Causal Route-Mediated Damage in Quantized Mixture-of-Experts
papers.abstract_en: Top-k Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routing is discontinuous, so a deployment-motivated numerical disturbance -- simulated 4-bit KV-cache quantization read by a protected BF16 gate -- pushes tokens across decision boundaries and flips which experts fire. This paper proposes no new mitigation; it supplies a causal apparatus, empirical findings, and a detection-limit result. A four-run apparatus prices the route-mediated fraction (RMF) of quantization damage, a token-level attribution decomposes it by mechanism, and pre-registered probes carry the findings across three architectures. On OLMoE-1B-7B at 4-bit KV (pilot), about a third of the damage is routing-mediated: RMF ~ 0.31 (discovery 0.31 [0.20, 0.41]; process-replicated mean 0.313 +/- 0.020; pre-registered re-execution 0.231). The deployable router margin detects that a flip occurred (AUC 0.772) but cannot tell a harmful flip from a helpful one (at chance): among the tested local, inference-observable router statistics we find no predictor of a flip's loss sign above chance -- an empirical benefit-detection barrier bounding selective repair restricted to this feature family. The signed-flip tax and sign-inseparability carry cross-model; the clean-reference remedy's payout is architecture-modulated; a controlled same-checkpoint flag-swap re-scopes the gate's normalization convention to a damage-magnitude moderator, not a route-recoverability mechanism. A real int4 KV kernel yields a fraction compatible with the fake-quant dose curve but underpowered (95% CI [-0.111, 0.394] includes zero) -- ruling out gross disagreement, not an independent replication. Hypotheses, thresholds, and evaluations were pre-registered before measurement, with misses reported; a pre-registered held-out read replicates the partition and the near-cancelling tax out of sample, while the strict impossibility exclusion narrowly misses.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 2 figures, 8 tables. Pre-registered pilot study
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Top-k Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) 路由的不连续性：部署动机下的数值扰动（模拟 4-bit KV-cache 量化，由受保护的 BF16 gate 读取）会把 token 推过决策边界并改变激活的专家。作者不提出新的缓解方法，而是提供因果分析框架、经验结果和一个检测极限结论。在 OLMoE-1B-7B 的 4-bit KV 试点中，约三分之一的量化损伤经由路由介导（RMF ~0.31），可部署的路由 margin 能检测到翻转发生（AUC 0.772），但无法区分有害与有益的翻转。
Motivation: Top-k MoE 路由是离散不连续的，因此 4-bit KV-cache 量化等数值扰动会改变专家选择，造成额外损伤；但缺少因果工具来分离路由介导损伤，也不清楚可观测的路由统计量能否区分有害翻转。
Method: 提出一个四轮运行的因果装置来估计路由介导分数 (route-mediated fraction, RMF)，用 token 级归因按机制分解损伤，并跨三个架构进行预注册探针。同时通过受控同检查点 flag-swap 实验，将 gate 的归一化约定重新界定为损伤幅度调节因素，而非路由可恢复性机制；论文不提出新的缓解方案。
Result: 在 OLMoE-1B-7B 的 4-bit KV 试点中，RMF 约为 0.31（discovery 0.31 [0.20, 0.41]；过程复制均值 0.313 ± 0.020；预注册重执行 0.231）。路由 margin 检测翻转的 AUC 为 0.772，但对翻转损失符号的预测处于随机水平；测试的局部可观测路由统计量中没有任何一个能高于机会水平。真实 int4 KV 内核得到的分数与 fake-quant 剂量曲线相容，但功效不足（95% CI [-0.111, 0.394] 包含零）。
Conclusion: 检测路由翻转比判断是否修复更容易：在测试的统计特征族内，不存在高于机会水平的有害翻转预测器，形成选择性修复的经验收益检测屏障；带符号翻转代价与符号不可分性跨模型成立，干净参考补救的收益受架构调制，gate 归一化约定只是损伤幅度调节器而非路由可恢复机制。预注册的留出重读在样本外复制了划分与近乎抵消的代价，但严格的不可可能排除仅以微弱差距未达到。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Forced-Structure Reduction and Verifiable Bounds for Conway's 99-Graph
papers.abstract_en: Conway's 99-graph problem asks whether a strongly regular graph with parameters $\mathrm{srg}(99,14,1,2)$ exists. We report a systematic, fully reproducible attack by an autonomous AI research agent, scored under the track's partial-credit metric. Our verifiable contributions are: (1) an exhaustive proof that no circulant graph on $\mathbb{Z}/99$ satisfies more than $3366/4950=68.0\%$ of the constraints ($33$ of $49$ difference-classes), with the same ceiling for the other abelian group of order $99$; (2) a forced-structure reduction: $λ=1$ makes each neighbourhood a perfect matching and $μ=2$ puts the outer vertices in bijection with non-matched neighbour-pairs, collapsing existence to a $12$-regular graph on $84$ vertices, encoded for CP-SAT and validated by recovering the unique $\mathrm{srg}(9,4,1,2)$; (3) a validated prescribed-automorphism orbit-existence framework (fixed-point-free and single-fixed-point actions, checked on $\mathrm{srg}(9,4,1,2)$ and the Paley graph $\mathrm{srg}(13,6,2,3)$), and (4) a best verified artifact at $69.43\%$, with evidence that this is a robust frontier (fourteen distinct methods, none exceeding it) entangled with the open question, since any provable bound below $4950$ is a non-existence proof.
papers.comment: This paper is accepted to the first Conference For AI Scientists (CAISc)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告由一个自主 AI 研究代理对 Conway 99-graph 问题（是否存在强正则图 srg(99,14,1,2)）进行的系统且可复现的求解尝试。主要成果包括：对 Z/99 上的循环图给出穷举证明，即没有任何循环图能满足超过 3366/4950=68.0% 的约束；提出一个强制结构归约，将存在性问题转化为 84 个顶点上的 12-正则图并用 CP-SAT 编码；以及一个经过验证的指定自同构轨道存在性框架。代理得到的最佳已验证工件为 69.43%，且十四种不同方法均未超过该值。
Motivation: Conway 的 99-graph 问题是一个长期未决的图论存在性问题，直接搜索 srg(99,14,1,2) 的难度大；作者希望通过可验证的局部约束满足率与结构归约，为最终判定存在性或非存在性提供可复现的中间结论。
Method: 作者采用自主 AI 研究代理进行多方法攻击，并结合若干可验证技术：对阶 99 的两个阿贝尔群上的循环图做差分类 (difference-classes) 约束满足度的穷举分析；利用 λ=1 使每个邻域成为完美匹配、μ=2 使外部顶点与非匹配邻点对双射的性质，将问题归约为 84 顶点 12-正则图并用 CP-SAT 编码；还设计了固定点自由与单固定点作用的指定自同构轨道存在性框架，并在 srg(9,4,1,2) 与 Paley 图 srg(13,6,2,3) 上验证。
Result: 摘要报告：循环图情形下最大满足约束数为 3366/4950（33/49 个差分类）；两种阿贝尔群得到相同上限。代理获得的最佳已验证工件满足率为 69.43%，且十四种不同方法均未超过该值；强制结构归约与轨道框架均通过已知图（srg(9,4,1,2) 与 srg(13,6,2,3)）的恢复得到验证。
Conclusion: 作者认为 69.43% 是一个稳健的探索前沿，并指出该结果与开放问题直接纠缠：任何可证明的低于 4950 的约束上限都将构成 srg(99,14,1,2) 不存在性的证明；当前工作尚未给出这样的非存在性证明。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Distribird: Literature-Informed Prior Distribution Design for Bayesian Model Calibration
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian calibration of process-based models requires a prior distribution for each model parameter. Despite decades of methodological work, researchers almost always fall back on uniform priors. The main reason is that building informative priors from scientific literature is slow and needs both domain and statistical expertise. We present \textbf{Distribird}, an agentic web application that automates this process. Given a parameter name, physical description, and domain context, Distribird deploys a multi-agent pipeline that searches the literature, extracts and weights reported values by domain relevance, and fits a probability distribution via AIC model selection. When no literature is available, the system falls back to sensible uninformative alternatives, and clearly reports both the evidence behind and the confidence level of every prior it produces. It is designed for the problems where the models have physically interpretable parameters, where domain knowledge exists in the published literature. We evaluate the tool on 24~parameters across 10 scientific domains comparing three open-weight models (Qwen3.6 27B, Gemma 4 31B, Mistral Small 4 119B) with a single-prompt LLM baseline. On prior quality the full pipeline \emph{matches} this baseline. Every prior is traced to the specific papers and values from which it was constructed; a built-in validity layer declines to produce priors for out-of-scope requests, whereas the single-prompt baseline returns confident but unfounded priors for them in 11 of 30~model--parameter cases; and every language-model call runs locally, so no parameter description or unpublished modelling detail is transmitted to a third-party LLM provider (only generated search terms reach the public literature databases). For scientific use, we argue these properties matter more than a marginal improvement in point-estimate accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Distribird，一个基于多智能体流程的网页应用，用于从科学文献中自动构建贝叶斯模型校准所需的先验分布。输入参数名、物理描述和领域上下文后，系统检索文献、按领域相关性加权提取报告值，并通过 AIC 模型选择拟合概率分布；无文献可用时回退到无信息先验，并明确报告每个先验的证据来源和置信水平。评估覆盖 10 个科学领域的 24 个参数，比较三种开源模型与单提示 LLM 基线，完整管线在先验质量上与基线持平，但具备可追溯、拒答和本地推理等特性。
Motivation: 尽管贝叶斯校准方法论已发展数十年，研究者几乎总是回退到均匀先验，因为从科学文献构建信息先验既缓慢又需要领域知识与统计专业能力的结合。Distribird 旨在自动化这一过程，并解决先验可追溯性以及超出范围请求下系统可靠性这两个实际问题。
Method: Distribird 是一个多智能体 (multi-agent) 网页应用：给定参数名、物理描述和领域上下文，它部署一条检索文献、按领域相关性加权提取数值、并用 AIC 模型选择拟合概率分布的流水线。系统内置有效性层 (validity layer)，对超出范围请求拒绝生成先验；所有语言模型调用均在本地执行，只有生成的搜索词会发送到公开文献数据库。
Result: 在 10 个科学领域的 24 个参数上，与单提示 LLM 基线相比，完整管线在先验质量上与之持平；在 30 个模型-参数组合中，单提示基线有 11 次对超出范围请求给出自信但无依据的先验，而 Distribird 会拒绝此类请求。每个先验都能追溯到构建它的具体论文和数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为对科学用途而言，先验的可追溯性、对无依据先验的拒答行为以及本地推理（不外传参数描述或未发表的建模细节）比点估计精度的边际提升更重要。该工具面向具有物理可解释参数、且相关领域知识存在于公开文献的问题。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Dynamic Governance of Multi-LLM Agent Systems for Collaborative Conversational Outcomes
papers.abstract_en: When two LLM agents with structurally opposed objectives interact across multiple turns, the absence of a shared goal function produces not competition but collapse: the visitor capitulates, the site agent stops varying its approach, and the conversation terminates without achieving either agent's stated objective. This paper asks whether a control-theoretic governance layer can substitute for that missing goal function. The Experience Orchestrator (EO) addresses this in a simulated financial services environment where a site agent guides a visitor toward advisor contact while the visitor maintains psychologically realistic resistance. EO governs the joint trajectory through three mechanisms: a Contextual Bandit (CB) that selects content arms calibrated from real-world web analytics, a PID controller that enforces behavioral consistency via dynamic schema constraints, and a POMDP belief tracker that maintains a probabilistic model of visitor intent. Across 60,000 simulations, EO achieves a +32 percentage point lift in high-intent advisor contact rate (78.1% vs. 46.1% over a naive LLM control), with CB variant selection accounting for 97% of between-factor outcome variance -- confirming that the governance policy, not environmental initial conditions, determines where trajectories end up. Persona-level analysis reveals two distinct regimes: for visitors with no natural inclination toward conversion, the governance layer is the difference between a functional system and a non-functional one; for visitors already near alignment, a naive LLM's empathetic defaults are largely sufficient. All findings are conditional on LLM-to-LLM simulation. The PID controller has not been calibrated against real human unpredictability, and validating EO on live traffic is the critical next step.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多轮对话中目标结构对立的两个 LLM 智能体因缺少共享目标函数而出现对话崩溃的问题，提出控制理论式治理层 Experience Orchestrator (EO)。在模拟金融客服场景中，EO 通过 Contextual Bandit、PID 控制器和 POMDP 信念追踪器共同治理对话联合轨迹。基于 60,000 次模拟，EO 将高意向顾问联系率从 46.1% 提升至 78.1%（+32 个百分点），且 CB 变体选择解释了 97% 的组间结果方差。
Motivation: 两个目标对立的 LLM 智能体在多次交互中缺乏共享目标函数时，对话不是竞争而是崩溃：一方让步、另一方停止变化方法，最终提前终止且双方目标均未实现。作者试图用控制理论治理层替代缺失的目标函数。
Method: 提出 Experience Orchestrator (EO) 治理层，包含三个机制：由真实 web 分析校准的 Contextual Bandit 选择内容臂 (content arms)；PID 控制器通过动态 schema 约束强制行为一致性；POMDP 信念追踪器维护访问者意图的概率模型。
Result: 在 60,000 次模拟中，EO 相对朴素 LLM 控制将高意向顾问联系率提高 32 个百分点（78.1% vs. 46.1%），CB 变体选择占组间结果方差的 97%，表明治理策略而非环境初始条件决定轨迹终点。Persona 级分析显示：对无自然转化倾向的访问者，治理层是系统可用与不可用的分界；对已接近一致的访问者，朴素 LLM 的共情默认已基本足够。
Conclusion: 所有发现均以 LLM 到 LLM 模拟为条件；PID 控制器尚未针对真实人类不可预测性校准，在真实流量上验证 EO 是关键的下一步。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Evaluating LLM Generated Detection Rules in Cybersecurity
papers.abstract_en: LLMs are increasingly pervasive in the security environment, with limited measures of their effectiveness, which limits trust and usefulness to security practitioners. Here, we present an open-source evaluation framework and benchmark metrics for evaluating LLM-generated cybersecurity rules. The benchmark employs a holdout set-based methodology to measure the effectiveness of LLM-generated security rules in comparison to a human-generated corpus of rules. It provides three key metrics inspired by the way experts evaluate security rules, offering a realistic, multifaceted evaluation of the effectiveness of an LLM-based security rule generator. This methodology is illustrated using rules from Sublime Security's detection team and those written by Sublime Security's Automated Detection Engineer (ADE), with a thorough analysis of ADE's skills presented in the results section.
papers.comment: Preprint of a paper accepted at the Conference on Applied Machine Learning in Information Security (CAMLIS 2025). 11 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个开源评估框架和基准指标，用于评测 LLM 生成的网络安全检测规则。框架基于留出集 (holdout set) 方法，将 LLM 生成的规则与人工生成的规则语料进行对比，并提供三种受专家评估方式启发的关键指标，以多维度评估 LLM 规则生成器的有效性。示例使用了 Sublime Security 检测团队编写的规则及其 Automated Detection Engineer (ADE) 生成的规则，并在结果部分对 ADE 的能力进行了详细分析。
Motivation: LLM 在安全环境中的应用日益广泛，但缺乏对其有效性的量化评估手段，这限制了安全从业者对 LLM 的信任与实际使用。
Method: 构建开源的评估框架与基准指标，采用基于留出集的方法衡量 LLM 生成安全规则相对人工规则语料的有效性，并提供三种来自专家评估实践的指标以实现多维度评测。
Result: 摘要未给出具体量化数字，仅在结果部分报告了对 Sublime Security 检测团队规则与 ADE 生成规则的对比分析，以及 ADE 技能的详细分析。
Conclusion: 作者强调需要一个现实且多面的评估方式来衡量 LLM 安全规则生成器的有效性，并以此开源框架作为支持工具。
Relevance: 0
